div.ab: Dī. atha vṛṣaṇaśothe phalatriketi | gomūtreṇaiva kathitaṃ triphalodbhavaṃ kaṣāyamiti | ayaṃ vātakaphakṛte vṛṣaṇaśophe | tantrāntare vātodbhave vṛṣaṇaśothe kathitaḥ | tatra triphalākvāthaḥ sagomūtraprakṣepaḥ prātareva yojyaḥ ||

ab.seg: Gū. sugamam || 122 ||
rāstrādiḥ antravṛddhau - rāsnāmṛtābalāyaṣṭīgokaṇṭairaṇḍajaḥ śṛtaḥ | eraṇḍatailasaṃyukto vṛddhimantrabhavāṃ jayet || 123 ||

Dī. athāntravṛddhau rāsneti | rāsnādiko'yaṃ śṛtaḥ kathitaḥ | rāsnā surabhī, balā ‘khirahaṭī’ti loke | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, gokaṇṭako gokṣurakaḥ | kecit paṭolaṃ revataṃ ruvu iti paṭhanti | tacca bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate || 123 ||
Gū. rāsnā prasiddhārāsanā| , amṛtā guḍūcī, balā pratītākharahaṭī| , yaṣṭīmadhukaṃmoleṭī| , gokaṇṭakaṃ gokharu, eraṇḍam eraṇḍamūlam eṣāṃ śṛtaḥ eraṇḍatailayutaḥ antrodbhavāṃ vṛddhiṃ jayet ||123||
kāñcanārakvāthaḥ gaṇḍamālāyāṃ - kāñcanāratvacaḥ kvāthaḥ śuṇṭhīcūrṇena nāśayet | gaṇḍamālāṃ tathā kvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa varuṇatvacaḥ || 124||

Dī. atha gaṇḍamālāyāṃ kāñcanāratvaca iti | etadyogadvayaṃ gaṇḍamālāyāṃ praśastam | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmapratītaḥ | śuṇṭhīcūrṇamatra prakṣepaḥ | varuṇo'pi vṛkṣabhedo vikhyātaḥ | atra madhuprakṣepe | tatheti gaṇḍamālāharo yogo'yam || 124 ||
Gū. kāñcanāraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥkacanāraḥ | tasya tvakkvāthaḥ gaṇḍamālāṃ nāśayediti sambandhaḥ || 124 ||
atha śākhoṭakvāthaḥ ślīpade medoroge ca - śākhoṭavalkalakvāthaṃ gomūtreṇa yutaṃ pibet | ślīpadānāṃ vināśāya medodoṣanivṛttaye || 125 ||
punarbhavāvaruṇayoḥ kvātho'ntarvidramadhiṃ jayet | tathā śigrubhavaḥ kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 126||

div.ab: Dī. atha ślīpadaroge śākhoṭeti | śākhoṭaḥ prasiddhaḥ ‘sihoro’ iti loke, gomūtraṃ prakṣepe | etacca kaphaślīpade prāyaśo yojyam | atha vidradhau punarnaveti atra śvetavarṣābhūḥ tasyā mūlaṃ, varuṇasya tvak | ayaṃ yogo'ntarvidradhau apakve yojyaḥ| aparayogamāha - tathetyādi | śigra: śobhāñjanakaḥ | hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyuta iti vyavahārāt prakṣepe | hiṅgu raktikācatuṣṭayaṃ, saindhavaṃ māṣaikaṃ pratyūhopayogitvāt || 125 || 126 ||

Gū. śākhoṭakaḥ hiṃgoṭaḥ tasya valkalakvāthaṃ gomūtreṇa yutaṃ ślīpadānāṃ vināśāya tathā medodoṣanivṛttaye pibet | atha punarnavādirantarvidradhau - punarnavāvaruṇayoḥ kvāthastathā śigrubhavaḥ kvāthontarvidradhiṃ jayet, kiṃbhūta: ? hiṅgukalkenu saṃyutaḥ || 125 || 126 ||

ab.seg: aparamapi vidradhau varuṇādikayogamāha - varuṇādigaṇakvāthamapakve madhyavidradhau | ūṣakādirajoyuktaṃ pibecchamanahetave || 127 ||
varuṇo bakapuṣpaśca bilvāpāmārgacitrakāḥ | agnimanthadvayaṃ śigrudvayaṃ ca bṛhatīdvayam || 128 ||
saureyakatrayaṃ mūrvā meṣaśṛṅgī kirātakaḥ | ajaśṛṅgī ca bimbī ca karañjaśca śatāvarī ||129||
varuṇādigaṇakvāthaḥ kaphamedoharaḥ smṛtaḥ | hanti gulmaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ tathābhyantaravidradhīn ||130||

Dī. varuṇādigaṇeti | varuṇādigaṇaḥ atrevāgre vakṣyamāṇo'sti | ūṣakādirgranthāntarādavagantavyaḥ | sa yatheti grahaṇāt varuṇādikayogamāha - varuṇa ityādi | evaṃ varuṇādikvātho vidradhau praśastaḥ | sa ca ūṣakādigaṇarajasā prakṣiptaḥ pūrvaṃ kathita eva | varuṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ, bakapuṣpaḥ kākaī iti loke | bilvaḥ, apāmārgaḥ śikharīpratītaḥ | agnimanthadvayamiti tarkārī, tasya bhedo'raṇiḥ | śigrudvayamiti śigru madhuśigru ca haritaraktabhedābhyām | bṛha- tīdvayamiti kaṇṭakārīdvayam, tena laghukaṇṭakārikā bṛhatī ca | saureyakatrayamiti sahacaratrayam | tacca puṣpabhedena bhinnaṃ vikhyātameva | mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, meṣaśṛṅgī vallīsaṃjñā prasiddhā | meḍhāśṛṅgīti loke | kirātakaḥ bhūnimbaḥ, ajāśṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā | bimbīti virautī loke, sā ca pīluparṇī kathitā, karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | ūṣakādigaṇo yathā - “ūṣakasaindhavaśilājatukāśīsadvayahiṅguguggulututthakaśca” iti gaṇo'yaṃ granthāntarādboddhavyaḥ | etadvyastaṃ vā prakṣepe praśastam | ayaṃ kvātho medaḥkaphaje vidradhau vihitaḥ | varuṇādigaṇasya kaphamedoviśeṣatvāt ||127-130||

Gū. varuṇādigaṇo yathā - varuṇaḥ, bakapuṣpaḥ agastivṛkṣaḥ,bilvaḥ,apāmārgaḥ,hiṅguḥ,citrakaḥ,agnimanthaḥ araṇiḥ taddvayaṃ | śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ, tadapi dvayaṃ dviprakāraṃ | saureyakatrayaṃ tatra śvetapītakṛṣṇabhedaiḥ mūrvā dhanurguṇā meṣaśṛṅgī, kirātakaḥ bhūnimbaḥ, ajaśṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, bimbakarañjau, śatāvarī ayaṃ varuṇādigaṇaḥ medorogādiharaḥ || atha ūṣakādigaṇaḥ | ūṣakaḥ kṣāramṛttikā vārāṇasīsamīpe vahaḍādeśe bāhulyena bhavati | anye tadbhavadravyamāhuriti ḍalhaṇaḥ | kāśīsadvayamekalavaṇarasaṃ śvetaṃ, dvitīyaṃ puṣpakāśīsaṃ īṣatpītaṃ tubararasaṃ tadbheda eva, tutthaṃ khaparikātutthaṃ, khapariyā iti loke | anye mayūragrīvamāhuḥ | kāśīsadvayaṃ tathā śuddhaṃ nirvamanaṃ kṛtvā melanīyam, śilājatu satvaṃ, śeṣaṃ sugamaṃ; yadvā kāśīsatutthābhāve tadgaṇe dravyāntaraṃ deyam || 127-130 ||
khadirādirbhagandare - khadiratriphalākvātho mahiṣīghṛtasaṃyutaḥ | viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktaśca bhagandaravināśanaḥ || 131 ||

Dī. atha bhagaṃdare khadireti | khadirādikvātho mahiṣīghṛtaprakṣiptaḥ viḍaṅgacūrṇā'vakīrṇaśca bhagaṃdare vihitaḥ | khadiraḥ kaṇṭakīvṛkṣaḥ pratītaḥ tasya sāro grāhyaḥ, mahiṣīvṛtamiti vyādhivihitatvāt || 131 ||
Gū. khadiraḥ khadirasāraḥ, viḍaṅgaḥ krimighnaḥ spaṣṭamanyat || 131 ||
paṭolādiḥ upadaṃśaroge -- paṭolatriphalanimbakirātakhadirāsanaiḥ | kvāthaḥ pīto jayetsarvānupadaṃśānsagugguluḥ || 132 ||
Dī. athopadaṃśe paṭoleti | atrāriṣṭo nimbaḥ, asano vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ pītasāraḥ, gugguluratra prakṣepe māṣacatuṣṭayaṃ vyavahārāt | sarvāniti pañcaprakārān || 132 ||

Gū. paṭolapatraṃ, triphalā, nimbaḥ, kirāto bhūnimbaḥ, khadirasāraḥ, asano vijayasāra eṣāṃ kvātha upadaṃśaṃ phiraṅgavātaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ jayet | gugguluḥ kanakābhastasya mānuṣye prayogāt; kanakākhyo manuṣyāṇāṃ hitakaratvāt ||132||
amṛtādirvātarakte - amṛtairaṇḍavāsānāṃ kvātha eraṇḍatailayuk | pītaḥ sarvāṅgasaṃcāri vātaraktaṃ jayeddhruvam ||133||

Dī. atha vātarakte yogadvayamāha - amṛteti | eṣa amṛtādikvāthaḥ eraṇḍatailaprakṣiptaḥ amṛtā guḍūcī vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ| sarvāṅgasañcārīti sarvaśarīraprasaraṇe kṣamaṃ | dhruvamiti grahaṇena dṛṣṭaphalo'yaṃ yogaḥ | ‘amṛtāragvadhavṛṣai: kvātha’ iti kecit paṭhanti | ayamapi sādhuḥ anyato darśanāt | tathāhi ‘vāsāguḍūcīcaturaṅgulānāmeraṇḍatailena pibet kaṣāyam| krameṇa sarvāṅgajamapyaśeṣaṃ jayedasṛgvātabhavaṃ vikāram’ iti || 133 ||
Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī, eraṇḍaḥ, vāsā, eṣāṃ kvātha eraṇḍatailayuktaḥ sarvāṅgasañcāri prasaraṇaśīlaṃ vātaraktaṃ jayet || 133 ||
atha paṭolādikvātho vātarakte - paṭolaṃ triphalā tiktā guḍūcī ca śatāvarī | etatkvātho jayetpīto vātāstraṃ dāhasaṃyutam||134||
Dī. paṭolamiti| ayaṃ paṭolādikvātho vātarakte sādhuḥ‘'pi sādhya:’ pā.| | tiktā kaṭurohiṇī, śeṣaṃ sugamam | ayaṃ yogaḥ pittaprāye prāyaśaḥ‘praśasta:’ pā. | pracarati || 134 ||
Gū. paṭolādīnāṃ kvāthaḥ pītaḥ sadāhaṃ dāhasahitaṃ vātāsraṃ vātaraktaṃ jayet || 134 ||
śvetakuṣṭhe bākucīkvāthaḥ | kvātho'valgujacūrṇāḍhyo dhātrīkhadirasārayoḥ | jayetsuśīlito nityaṃ śvitraṃ pathyāśināṃ nṛṇām ||135 ||

Dī. atha śvitre kvātho'valgujeti | asau kvātho nityaṃ pratidinaṃ, suśīlitaḥ satatābhyastaḥ, pathyāśināṃ śvitravihitapathyāśinām | avalgujo bākucīti śabdaḥ vācyadravyaviśeṣaḥ tasya cūrṇaṃ prakṣepe | dhātrī āmalakī - phalāni || 135 ||
Gū. avalgujacūrṇāḍhyo dhātrīkhadirasārayoḥ kvāthaḥ nityaṃ suśīlitaḥ pathyāśināṃ nṛṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ śvitraṃ śvetakuṣṭhaṃ jayet | dhātrī āmalakī, avalgujo bākucī || 135 ||

div.ab: raktakuṣṭhādaulaghumañjiṣṭhādikvāthaḥ | mañjiṣṭhā triphalā tiktā vacā dāruniśāmṛtā | nimbaścaiṣāṃ kṛtaḥ kvātho vātaraktavināśanaḥ ||136|| pāmākapālikākuṣṭharaktamaṇḍalajinmataḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha kuṣṭhādau kvathanadvayamāha - mañjiṣṭheti | ayaṃ laghumañjiṣṭhādiko yogaḥ | tatra dāruniśā dāruharidrā, amṛtā guḍūcī, eke dāru niśeti dravyadvayaṃ vyākhyānayanti tena dāru devadāruḥ, niśā haridrā, etadapi vyavaharanti pāmādayo'pi kuṣṭhasyaiva bhedāḥ ||136 ||
Gū. mañjiṣṭhādirvātaraktakuṣṭhādau - tiktā kaṭukī, dāruniśā dāruharidrā, amṛtā guḍūcī, spaṣṭamanyat | kapālikā rogaviśeṣaḥ || 136 ||

div.ab: bṛhanmañjiṣṭhādiḥ sarvakuṣṭhe - mañjiṣṭhāmustakuṭajaguḍūcīkuṣṭhanāgaraiḥ ||137 || bhārṅgīkṣudrāvacānimbaniśādvayaphalatrikaiḥ | paṭolakaṭukīmūrvāviḍaṅgāsanacitrakaiḥ || 138 || śatāvarītrāyamāṇākṛṣṇendrayavavāsakaiḥ | bhṛṅgarājamahādārupāṭhākhadiracandanaiḥ || 139 || trivṛdvaruṇakairātabākucīkṛtamālakaiḥ | śākhoṭakamahānimbakarañjātiviṣājalaiḥ ||140|| indravāruṇikānantāsārivāparpaṭaiḥ samaiḥ | ebhiḥ kṛtaṃ pibetkvāthaṃ kaṇāguggulusaṃyutam || 141|| aṣṭādaśasu kuṣṭheṣu vātaraktārdite tathā | upadaṃśe ślīpade ca prasuptau pakṣaghātake || 142 || medodoṣe netraroge mañjiṣṭhādiḥ praśasyate |

ab.seg: Dī. aparamapyāha - mañjiṣṭheti | bṛhanmañjiṣṭhādisaṃjñako'yaṃ kvāthaḥ prasiddhaḥ | atra kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak | niśādvayaṃ haridrādvayam | mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, asano vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | trāyamāṇā svanāmaprasiddhā | kṛṣṇā pippalī, vāsakaḥ āṭarūṣakaḥ | bhṛṅgarājaḥ keśarañjanaḥ ‘vamanā ’‘ghamarā’ iti prasiddhaḥ | mahādāru devadāru:, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, trivṛt niḥsṛtāniśotha | , kairātonāsti‘kha’ pustake | bhūnimbaḥ, śākhoṭako vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | mahānimbo nimbārkaḥ, ‘bakā’ iti loke pratītaḥ | karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, anantā yavāsakaḥ, sārivā āsphotā, sā dvividhā śvetā kṛṣṇā bhedābhyāṃ | śuklā jambuvat patrā vratatiḥ, kṛṣṇā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā | śeṣaṃ subodham | ebhirmañjiṣṭhādidravyaiḥ samaiḥ samamānaiḥ kṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ kvāthamityarthaḥ | kaṇāguggulusaṃyutamiti kaṇācūrṇaṃ gugguluśca prakṣepe sādhuḥ ||137-142 ||

Gū. ayaṃ mañjiṣṭhādiḥ kuṣṭhādau praśasyate ucito bhavati | (uṣavo bījakaḥ?) trivṛtniśotha niḥsṛtā, varuṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ, kairāto bhūnimbaḥ, bākucī, kṛtamāla āragvadhaḥ, anantā yavāsā, sārivā anantamūlaṃ yadvā uttarāpathe ‘sārisa’ iti sugandhidravyaṃ, kaṇā pippalī || 137-142 ||
pathyādiṣaḍaṅgakvāthaḥ śiroroge netrarogādau ca - pathyākṣadhātrībhūnimbairniśānimbāmṛtāyutaiḥ ||143||
kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'yaṃ saguḍaḥ śīrṣaśūlahṛt?hā ? pā. | | bhrūśaṅkhakarṇaśūlāni tathārdhaśiraso rujam ||144||
sūryāvartaṃ śaṅkhakaṃ ca dantapātaṃ ca tadrujam | naktāndhyaṃ paṭalaṃ śukraṃ cakṣu:pīḍāṃ vyapohati ||145||

Dī. atha śiroroge pathyādikaṃ yogamāha - pathyā iti | pathyā harītakī, akṣo vibhītakaḥ, dhātrī āmalakī, bhūnimbaḥ kairātaḥ, niśā haridrā, amṛtā guḍūcī, nimbaḥ pratītaḥ | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgasaṃjñaḥ, ṣaṭ aṅgāni yasya sa tathā | atra triphalā ekamaṅgaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṅgaṃ guḍamiti guḍo'tra prakṣepe sādhuḥ | ayamapi sāyamupayojyaḥ, prāyeṇa ūrdhvajatrugatarogaharatvāt | śīrṣaśūlaṃ śirovyathā | bhrūśūlaṃ śaṅkhaśūlaṃ karṇaśūlamiti ca | tadrujamiti dantaśūlaṃ | śukramiti netrapuṣpam || 143-145 ||

Gū. pathyādi | amṛtāyutaḥ (kṛtaḥ) kvāthaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo bhavati guḍena saha vartate iti saguḍaḥ; saguḍeti prakṣiptaguḍaḥ guḍasya pakṣaikadravyatvāt | sa ṣaḍaṅgaḥ śīrṣaśūlahā syāt| tathā bhrūśaṅkhakarṇaśūlān vyapohati | śaṅkhaḥ kapālaikadeśaḥ, sūryāvartaḥ sūryodayādārabhya śūlaṃ, śaṅkakamekādaśaśiroroge'bhihitaṃ, dantapātaṃ dantaśūlaṃ tadrujaṃ dantarujaṃ | naktāndhyaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭyabhāvalakṣaṇaṃ na divā, paṭalaṃ paṭalagatanetrarogaḥ, śukraṃ netrapuṣpaṃ cakṣuḥ pīḍāṃ cakṣurvyathām etān vyapohati | kaḥ? pathyādiḥ | pathyā harītakī, akṣo vibhītakaḥ, dhātrī āmalakī, bhūnimbaḥ kirātakaḥ, niśā haridrā, nimbo nimbaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī etairyutaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo guḍopari prakṣipyate | ṣaṭ aṅgāni yasyāsau ṣaḍaṅga iti vigrahe kṛte pathyādīnāṃ saptakatvāt guḍena sahāṣṭakatvānna ṣaḍaṅgaḥ, yadi pathyādidhātryantānāṃ triphalā kriyate triphalā ekatvena gamyate tadā pañcāṅgatvāt guḍasya prakṣepakatvānna ṣaḍaṅgaḥ, atha ca triphaletyukte auṣadhatrayasya grahaṇaṃ naikasya | tathāca sudarśanacūrṇe - triphalā rajanīyugmamityatra triphaletyukte harītakyāmalakavibhītakaṃ gṛhyate; navāyasacūrṇe ca “citrakaṃ triphalā mustaṃ viḍaṅgatryūṣaṇāni ca | nava bhāgāni caitāni navabhāgā hatāyasaḥ” ityatra triphalāyā auṣadhatrayaṃ; tathāca kaiśoraguggulau vanamahiṣalocanodarasannibhavarṇasya gugguloḥ prasthaṃ saṃkṣipya toyarāśau triphalāmamṛtāṃ yathoktaparimāṇāṃ triphalāmiti pratyekaṃ prasthaṃ matam | tathāca pramāṇam - ‘pratyekaṃ triphalā prasthā jalaṃ tatra - ṣaḍāṣṭakam’ iti | tasmāttriphale'pi saptakatve siddhe saṃjñāparo'yaṃ ṣaḍaṅga śabdaḥ | yathā ṣaṇṇāṃ yūṣaḥ ṣaḍyūṣaḥ iti vaktavye ṣaḍyūṣaḥ saṃjñāparaḥ | tathānyānyeva khaṇḍakhādyacandrodayamṛgāṅkādayaḥ saṃjñāparā dṛśyante | tathāca cakranidānamadhukośe likhitam atrodarāveṣṭā hṛdayā mahākuhā ete nāmaviśeṣāḥ kecitsānvayāḥ vyavahārārthaṃ pūrvācāryaiḥ praṇītāḥ, yastu vaṅgasenādibhirnetraroge ṣaḍaṅgāni yasyeti vyutpattyā likhitaḥ sosmādvilakṣaṇaḥ, tathā coktaṃ “vibhītakaśivādhātrīpaṭolāriṣṭavāsakaiḥ | kvātho ṣaḍaṅgakaraṇam” iti | kimarthamucyate ? pathyāyukte'pi asya ṣaḍaṅgakaraṇam ṛṣipraṇītasaṃjñāpratipādanārtham || 143-145 ||
atha vāsādirnetraroge - vāsāviśvāmṛtādārvīraktacandanacitrakaiḥ | bhūnimbanimbakaṭukāpaṭolatriphalāmbudaiḥ || 146||
yavakāliṅgakuṭajaiḥ kvāthaḥ sarvākṣirogahā | vaisvaryaṃ pīnasaṃ śvāsaṃ nāśayedurasaḥ kṣatam || 147 ||

Dī. athānantaramakṣiroge vāseti | eka eva vāsādiko gaṇaḥ akṣiroge praśastaḥ | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, amṛtā guḍūcī, dārvī dāruharidrā, kaṭukā tiktarohiṇī, samāsāntatvāt kaṭukāyā hrasvatvaṃ ca | paṭolaḥ kulakaḥ tasya patrāṇi, ambudo mustaṃ, yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ nijanāmavikhyātaḥ, sa ca nistuṣo grāhyaḥ | kāliṅga indrayavaḥ, kuṭajo vatsakatvak | ayaṃ prātareva yojyaḥ kaṣāyatvāt | tathāhyuktam - ‘vāsā ghanaṃ nimbapaṭolapatraṃ tiktāmṛtā candanavatsakaṃ ca | kāliṅgadārvīdahanaṃ ca śuṇṭhī bhūnimbadhātrī vijayā bibhītakam || tathā yavāḥ kvāthamathāṣṭabhāgikaṃ pibedimaṃ pūrvadine kaṣāyam | taimiryakaṇḍūṃ paṭalārbudaṃ ca śuklaṃ tathā savraṇamavraṇaṃ ca || nihanti dāhaṃ sarujaṃ sarāgaṃ sarvān nihantyakṣigatāṃśca rogān’ iti | tatra vaisvaryaṃ vikṛtasvaratvaṃ, yavo'tra netrarogavihitatvāt kathitaḥ (tathāhyuktaṃnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | - ?triphalā ghṛtaṃ madhu yavā pādābhyaṅgaḥ śatāvarī mudgāḥ | cakṣuṣyaḥ saṃkṣepādvargaḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirayam’) ||146-147||

Gū. viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, amṛtā guḍūcī, dārvī dāruharidrā, bhūnimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ, triphalā harītakyāmalakabibhītakāni, ambudo mustā, yavāḥ, kāliṅgaḥ indrayavaḥ, kuṭajaḥ vatsakatvakbūḍhā hi.bhā.| | ayaṃ kvāthaḥ vāsādiḥ sarvākṣirogahā bhavati tathā vaisvaryādikaṃ nāśayecca | vaisvaryaṃ svarabhaṅgaḥ, pīnasaṃ nāsārogaḥ, urasaḥ kṣataṃ uraḥkṣatam || || 146-147 ||
athāmṛtādirnetraroge - amṛtātriphalākvāthaḥ pippalīcūrṇasaṃyutaḥ | sakṣaudraḥ śīlito nityaṃ sarvanetravyathāṃ jayet ||148 ||

Dī. aparamapi netraroge prayogamāha - amṛteti | amṛtādikvātho'yaṃ sakalanetrāmaye praśastaḥ | amṛtā guḍūcī, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ pippalīcūrṇaṃ prakṣepe | sakṣaudramiti madhvapi prakṣepe sādhu | ata eva śītalo himasparśaḥ madhvavirodhāt | nityamiti sārvakālīnamidamityarthaḥ || 148 ||
Gū. triphalā harītakyādikā amṛtā triphalākvāthe pippalīcūrṇasya prakṣepaḥ madhu kṣaudraṃ madhusahitaḥ nityaṃ śīlitaḥ abhyastaḥ kvāthaḥ sarvanetravyathāṃ pīḍāṃ jayet || 148 ||
pañcavalkalakvātho vraṇakṣālanādau -- aśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭavetasajaṃ śṛtam | vraṇaśothopadaṃśānāṃ nāśanaṃ kṣālanātsmṛtam||149||

Dī. atha vraṇeṣvapi kṣālanārthaṃ kaṣāyamāha - aśvattheti | aśvatthādīnāṃ pañcānāmatra valkalaṃ grāhyam | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgapānīyena sādhyaḥ | kṣālanaṃ prakṣālanaṃ vraṇasya | iti kvāthasamūho'bhihitaḥ || 149 ||

div.ab: Gū. aśvattha: pippalaḥ, udumbaraḥ yakṣavṛkṣaḥgūlara , plakṣaḥ parkaṭīvṛkṣaḥpilakhana , vaṭaḥ, veta eṣāṃ kvāthaḥ, vraṇānāṃ śothānām, upadaṃśo medorogaḥ kṣālanānnāśanaḥ | mukharoge jātīpatrādikvāthaḥjātipatrādikvāthastruṭita: pratīyate, tadyathā-‘jātīpatrāmṛtādrākṣāyāsadārvīphalatrikaiḥ | kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ śīto gaṇḍūṣo mukhapākanut’ iti bhāvaprakāśe| | śeṣaṃ sugamam | iti kvāthāḥ ||149|| iti kvāthaprakathanam|

ab.seg: pramathyā procyate dravyapalātkalkīkṛtācchṛtāt | toye'ṣṭaguṇite tasyāḥ pānamāhuḥ paladvayam ||150||
sā yathā - mustakendrayavaiḥ siddhā pramathyā dvipalonmitā| suśītā madhusaṃyuktā raktātīsāranāśinī || 151 ||

Dī. idānīṃ tadbhedānpramathyādīnāhakvāthabhedānityartha:| -tasyāḥ pūrvaṃ paribhāṣāṃ kathayati - pramathyeti | dravyapalāditi kalkārthaṃ dravyasya palapramāṇam | kalkīkṛtāditi dṛṣadi peṣitāt, peṣaṇamatra jalenānuktatvāt | aṣṭaguṇite toye dravyabhāgāpekṣayā'ṣṭaguṇapānīye śṛtā kvathitā paladvayamityanena caturthāṃśāvaśeṣitaṃ grāhyam | atha yā pramathyā sā kīdṛśīti vivakṣāyāmāha - sā yatheti - grahaṇena tāmeva prakaṭayannāha - mustaketi | indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ | siddhetyanena pūrvaṃ kalkitā paścāt kvathitetyarthaḥ | dvipalonmiteti pānanimittam | suśītā himasparśā ata eva madhuprakṣiptā | prakṣepadravyāṇāmapi parimāṇaṃ pūrvavat jñātavyam ||150-151 ||

div.ab: Gū. atha pramathyāvidhijñānārthaṃ atraiva pramathyādaya ucyante | dravyapalātkalkīkṛtājjalena saha piṣṭān aṣṭa- guṇitatoye śṛtāt sā pramathyā maṇḍaviśeṣaḥ procyate tasyāḥ pānaphalamāha | sā yathā sugamam || 150-151 || iti pramathyā|

ab.seg: idānīṃ yavāgūparibhāṣāmāha - sādhyaṃ catuṣpalaṃ dravyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale'mbunijale pā. | | tatkāthenārdhaśiṣṭena yavāgūṃ sādhayeddhanām || 152 ||
sā yathā - āmrāmrātakajambūtvakkaṣāye vipacedbudhaḥ | yavāgūṃ śālibhiryuktāṃ tāṃ bhuktvā grahaṇīṃ jayet ||153||

div.ab: Dī. sādhyamiti | iyaṃ dravyakvāthe taṇḍulādibhiḥ paripācikā yavāgūśabdavācyā | catuḥṣaṣṭipale'mbunīti dravyabhāgāt ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | ghanāmityanena śālyādinā sādhayet yāvat dravarahitā syāt | ata eva taṇḍulādīnāṃ parimāṇamanumānato nirūpaṇīyam | na tu annaprakṛtyoktāyā mānam | yathā - “pañcakolena saṃsiddhā yavāgūrdīpanī tathā | balāmūlakaṣāyeṇa sādhitā grāhiṇī matā” iti | atrāpi mānaṃ doṣādyapekṣayānumānato nirūpaṇīyam | atra catuḥpalagrahaṇaṃ yat tat sāmānyaṃ viśeṣato nyūnamapi dṛśyate | tathāca tantrāntare - “vṛddhavaidyā: palaṃ dravyaṃ grāhayantyāḍhake'mbhasi | bheṣajasyātibāhulyāt kadācidarucirbhavet” iti | atha sā yathetyanena tasyāḥ svarūpamāha - āmreti | āmro vṛkṣaviśeṣo vikhyātaḥ āmrātakastadbhedaḥ, rājāmra iti kecit | jambūḥ prasiddha eva, eṣāṃ tvak challī grāhyā kaṣāya iti grahaṇena svarasādayo'pi pañcakaṣāyāstairapi kṛtāyāṃ na doṣo vyavahārāt | yataḥ - pañcakolabalādīnāṃ kalkarasenaiva sādhitā bahavo yavāgavo dṛśyante | bāhulyaṃ ca dravyaguṇāvalyāmuktaṃ yathā -“yairyairevauṣadhaguṇairyavāgū: sādhusādhitā | tāṃstānevauṣadhaguṇān puṣṇāti vidhiyojitā” iti budha iti grahaṇenānnādiparimāṇena randhanavidhau dakṣa ityarthaḥ || 152 || 153 ||

Gū. atha yavāgū: catuṣpalaṃ dravyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale'mbuni jale sādhyam ardhaśiṣṭena kvāthena ca yavāgūṃ sādhayet | sā yathā - āmraṃ, āmrātakam ambarātakā jambū prasiddhaḥ, eṣāṃ tvak catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale sādhyam ardhaśiṣṭe jale śālitaṇḍulacatuṣpalasādhyaṃ sā yavāgūḥ bhavati tāṃ bhuktvā grahaṇīṃ jayet || 152 || 153 ||iti dravyakṛtayavāgū: ||

ab.seg: saṃprati yūṣamāha - kalkadravyapalaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī | vāriprasthena vipacetsa dravo pūṣa ucyate || 154 ||

div.ab: Dī. ayaṃ dravyakṛtayūṣo'pi vikhyāta eva | kīdṛśaḥ ? tatparibhāṣāmapyādāvāha - kalkadravyamiti | kalkārhaṃ dravyaṃ tacca dhānyamūlakaśuṇṭhikādikaṃ | yathā śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī pratyekaṃ tīkṣṇatvāt | kecittu śuṇṭhī pippalīcūrṇaṃ paścāt prakṣepe kṣipanti | vāriprastheneti dravadvaiguṇyāt dvātriṃśatpalamitena jalena sa dravo dravaprāyaḥ | atrāpyannaparimāṇādikaṃ yannoktaṃ tadanumānato grāhyaṃ, yadvā jalānusārato randhanavidhida- kṣasakāśāddṛṣṭaparipākaparipāṭyā kuryādityaryaḥ |

Gū. atha yūṣaḥ | yūṣe rulkadvayasya palaṃ deyaṃ, śuṇṭhī pippalī cedardhakārṣikasamuditā deyā, vāriprasthena vipacet, sa dravaḥ jalamātraḥ yūṣaḥ ucyate | sa yathā kulatthādibhiryuktaiḥ kṛtaḥ yūṣaḥ śleṣmānilāpaho bhavati yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, kolaṃ badaraṃ, mūlakaśuṇṭhaṃ śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍam | śeṣaṃ sugamam | muṣṭipalamātraṃ, saptānāṃ

ab.seg: saptamuṣṭiyūṣaḥ | sa yathā - kulatthayavakolaiśca mudgairmūlakaśuṇṭhakaiḥ | śuṇṭhīdhānyākayuktaiśca yūṣaḥ śleṣmānilāpahaḥ ||155||
saptamuṣṭika ityeṣa saṃnipātajvarāñjayet | āmavātaharaḥ kaṇṭhahṛdvakrāṇāṃ viśodhanaḥ ||156||

Dī. sa yathetyanena vakṣyamāṇasaptamuṣṭikayūṣavidhi darśayannāha - kulattha iti | ayaṃ satamuṣṭikasaṃjñako yūṣaḥ prasiddha eva | kulattho'nnaviśeṣaḥ, kolaṃ badaraphalaṃ, mūlakaśuṇṭhakairiti laghumūlakaśuṇṭhaiḥ śuṇṭhamatra nālagranthiḥ | mūlakapotiketi kecid guṇaprābalyāt | tathāhi - ”kaṭutiktarasā hṛccā rocanī vahnidīpanī | sarvadoṣaharā laghvī kaṇṭhyā mūlakapotikā iti | dhānyākaṃ kustumburu, saptamuṣṭika ityanena kulatthādīnāṃ muṣṭisaptakaṃ grāhyaṃ, tantrāntaradarśanāt yathā - ekaikamuṣṭimāhṛtya ityādi muṣṭimukhāntarmuṣṭiḥ na tu muṣṭipalam, ayameva pakṣaḥ kaiścidādriyate | cakrastu pratyekameṣāṃ palaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvasammatatvāt | nanu sakalameva dravyam ucitamātrayānvitaṃ, yat kvāthavidhānena yūṣaḥ kriyate tadasmatsaṃpradāye na manoharaṃ, kiṃtu vyavahārāt kartavyavidhau yavakulatthamudgā anyadravyāpekṣayā bahu deyāḥ śuṇṭhyāścūrṇaṃ paścāt kaṭukārthaṃ tāvaddeyaṃ yāvat kaṭumātraṃ syāt | evamamlārthaṃ badarādīnāṃ dānaṃ, kvātho dhānyakamūlakaśuṇṭhayoḥ pṛthak palaparimitayośca dānamiti kartavyavidhiḥ sādhuḥ | kaṇṭhahṛdvakrāṇāṃ viśodhana iti | kaṇṭhaviśodhanaḥ hṛdviśodhanaḥ vakraviśodhanaśca | viśodhanaṃ kaphasyetyarthaḥ ||154-156||

div.ab: Gū. muṣṭimātraprayogādayaṃ saptamuṣṭikaḥ | eke tu saptamuṣṭiprayogātsaptamuṣṭikāḥ, yataḥ yūṣakriyāyā yūṣadravyasya palamātragṛhītatvāt anye saptānām ekaikamuṣṭimādāya pacettoye caturguṇe tatraivaṃ vyākhyātaṃ pratyekameṣāṃ sakṣamuṣṭimāhṛtya na tu muṣṭiḥ palaṃ, dravyatvādayameva pakṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ | cakrastu pratyekameṣāṃ palaṃ dravyabahutvaṃ vyavahāradravyatvānna doṣaḥ | iti saptamuṣṭiyūṣaḥ || 154-156 || iti dravyakṛtayūṣaprakriyā ||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pānādikalpanāmāha - kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ sādhyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale | ardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca taddeyaṃ pāne bhaktādisaṃvidhau || 157 ||

div.ab: Dī. kṣuṇṇamiti | iyaṃ pānādikalpanāyāḥ paribhāṣā | kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ, dravyaṃ vyādhivihitaṃ‘vidhi’ pā.| , sādhyaṃ kvathitam | taditi dravaṃ ardhāvaśeṣitaṃ jalamityarthaḥ | pāne iti pānasvarūpe yathā vakṣyamāṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅgādipānīyam | bhaktādisaṃvidhāviti yūṣarasayavāgvādirūpe |
Gū. atha pānādikalpanā | bhaktādisaṃvidhau pāne bhojanādau auṣadhapānārtham | etaddhimalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ |

ab.seg: ṣaḍaṅgapānam | sā‘sā’ pānādikalpanā ityartha:| yathā - uśīraparpaṭodīcyamustanāgaracandanaiḥ | jalaṃ śṛtaṃ himaṃ peyaṃ pipāsājvaranāśanam || 158 ||

div.ab: Dī. sā yatheti vākyena pānādikārthaṃ prakriyāṃ prakaṭayati granthakāraḥ | uśīreti | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgasaṃjñakaḥ | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ, himaṃ śītasparśaṃ, peyamiti vāraṃvāram yataḥ - ‘muhurmuhuśca tṛṭchardihikvāśvāsagareṣu ca’ iti vacanāt | atrodīcyaṃ vālakaṃ, pānīyaṃ śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, candanaṃ raktam | eṣāṃ yogo jvarādau yuktaḥ | tathāhi ”ṣaḍaṅgādeḥ śṛtaṃ toyaṃ deyamādau jvarasya vai” || 157 || 158 ||
Gū. sā yathā uśīrādibhiḥ pūrvakriyāśṛtaṃ toyaṃ himaṃ himasaṃjñaṃ jñeyaṃ pipāsājvaranāśakaṃ bhavati | parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, udīcyaṃ bālakaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 157 || 158 || iti pānādikalpanā ||

ab.seg: jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhiṃ darśayannāha -- aṣṭamenāṃśaśeṣeṇa caturthenārdhakena vā | athavā kathanenaiva siddhamuṣṇodakaṃ vadet || 159 ||
śleṣmāmavātamedoghnaṃ bastiśodhanadīpanam | kāsaśvāsajvaraharaṃ pītamuṣṇodakaṃ niśi || 160 ||

div.ab: Dī. aṣṭameneti | yat kevalameva pānīyamaṣṭamāṃśādikalpanayā siddhaṃ bhavati taduṣṇodakamiti saṃjñaṃ vadediti | aṃśaśeṣeṇāṣṭādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate; tena aṣṭāṃśena caturthāṃśenārdhāṃśenetyarthaḥ | aṃśastvatra kvathanāvaśiṣṭaḥ | athavetyanena pakṣāntaramāha | kvathanenaivetyādi | kvathanamityatra tripādaśeṣamityarthaḥ | etat kriyācatuṣṭayaṃ doṣāpekṣayābhihitam | tathāhi - “tatpādahīnaṃ pittaghnaṃ taccheṣamanilāpaham | ardhaṃ kṣayakaphaharaṃ śeṣaṃ grāhi tridoṣajit” iti | nanu yathaivaṃ tarhi suśrutena “tatpādahīnavātaghnamardhahīnaṃ tu pittajit | kaphaghnaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca pānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ smṛtam” iti kathametadviparītamuktam ? | satyam | ādyaḥ pakṣo vyavahārī sa ca jvaradīnāṃ doṣaprakope praśastaḥ, dvitīyastu ṣaḍṛtuṣu doṣāpekṣayā'bhihitaḥ | suśrute uktaṃ ca “śāradaṃcārdhapādonaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu haimakam | śiśire ca vasante ca grīṣme pādāvaśeṣitam | viparītamṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā vārṣikaṃ cāṣṭabhāgikam” iti | yadvirodhaparihāraḥ kṛtastat sādhubhirvicāraṇīyaḥ atra vistarabhayānna likhitaḥ | siddhamiti yadgrahaṇaṃ laghūktikvathananimittam | yataḥ “yat kvāthyamānaṃ nirvegaṃ niṣphenaṃ nirmalaṃ tathā | śṛtaśītaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ vāṣpāntarbhāvaśītalam” iti | anyathā doṣakaraḥ syāt | tathāhi - “dhārāpātena viṣṭambhi durjaraṃ pavanāhṛtam | śṛtaśītaṃ punastaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ doṣalaṃ smṛtam” iti | athoṣṇodakasya niśi pītasya guṇamāha - kāseti | etaduṣṇodakaṃ yadā niśi pītaṃ tadā śleṣmādikān hantīti | uṣṇodakaṃ vadediti | īṣaduṣṇam uṣṇodakaṃ kathitaṃ | vātamedoghnamiti vātaghnaṃ medoghnaṃ ca | śleṣmāmavātamedoghnamiti vā pāṭhāntaram | bastiśodhanaṃ mūtrāśayaśuddhikaraṃ, dīpanamagneḥ | pītamuṣṇodakamiti | īṣaduṣṇaṃ pītam | niśīti niśāmukhe śayanakāle vā na tu sakalaniśāyāṃ muhurmuhuḥ pānaṃ tatra niṣedhaparatvāt | tathāhi - “yathā divā tathā rātrau yadi toyaṃ pibennaraḥ | bhavet tatra rasādhikyaṃ taccheṣāddoṣakopanam” iti satyam | eṣa svasthe prasaṅga iti vartate vyavahārādāture na kutracit pratiṣedhaḥ | tathāhyuktam - “pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā viśvameva ca tanmayam | ato'tyantaniṣedhena na kvacidvāri vāryate” iti || 159 || 160 ||

Gū. atha jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhi: | aṣṭamenāṃśena caturthena caturthāṃśaśeṣe ardhakenārdhāṃśaśeṣeṇa athavā kvathanena kvathitamātreṇa siddham uṣṇodakaṃ vadet uṣṇodakaṃ niśi pītaṃ śleṣmāmavātādīnhantīti yojanā | atrānukramamapi granthāntarāt jvarādau uṣṇajalavidhānamāha - kaphavātajvarā iti | kaphajvare vātajvare kaphavātajvare vā vyaste samaste vā uṣṇam ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ, “ardhāvaśiṣṭatoyaṃ yat taduṣṇodakamucyate” ityuktatvāt pittamadyaviṣotthajvareṣu tiktakaiḥ smṛtaṃ śītalaṃ deyaṃ, tiktakaśṛtastu ṣaḍaṅgakastaruṇajvare tasyaiva vidhānāt, tathācoktaṃ ‘tiktaparpaṭakośīracandanodīcyanāgaraiḥ | śṛtaśītaṃ jalaṃ dadyātpipāsājvaraśāntaye’ | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgastiktakaḥ smṛtaḥ, asyaiva taruṇajvare vidhānamuktaṃ suśrute - “laṅghanaṃ kārayetkāle yāvanastiktako rasaḥ | pācanānyapyapakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇajvare” suśrutādetat | svedanaṃ taruṇajvare niṣiddhamapi sannipātajvare vihitatvāduktaṃ kālo'pi pāvanatvena gṛhītastathā vātakaḥ saptarātreṇetyādi | anya evamāhuḥ “pādaśeṣaṃ ca vātaghnam ardhaśeṣaṃ ca pittajit | kaphaghnaṃ pādāśeṣaṃ syātpānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu” | iti madanavinodāt || 159 || 160|| ityuṣṇodakavidhi: ||

idānīṃ kṣīrapākavidhimāha - kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ dravyātkṣīrānnīraṃ caturguṇam | kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ tatpītaṃ śūlamāmodbhavaṃ jayet || 161 || pañcamūlapayaḥ | (sarvajvarāṇāṃ jīrṇānāṃ kṣīraṃ bhaiṣajyamuttamam | śvāsātkāsācchiraḥśūlātpārśvaśūlātsapīnasāt ||162|| mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ | trikaṇṭakapayaḥ | trikaṇṭakabalāvyāghrīguḍanāgarasādhitam || 163 || varcomūtravibandhaghnaṃ kaphajvaraharaṃ payaḥprakṣiptam |)

ab.seg: Dī. kṣīramiti | kṣīramatra gavyam | atrānuktatvāt | dravyamiti śuṇṭhīvitunnakādikamanyato darśanāt | tathāhi -“śuṇṭhīvitunnakairaṇḍaśṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ” iti | kartavyatāsya dravyāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ yathā doṣāpekṣayā parimitaṃ kṣīrasya bhāgāṣṭakaṃ, pānīyaṃ dvātriṃśadbhāgayutam | etat sakalaṃ kvāthyakṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ vastreṇa saṃsrāvya pibet | pānamānaṃ cāsya kvāthavadboddhavyam | doṣānusārato vā | āmodbhavaṃ śūlamiti | āmaśūlaṃ nanu āmavātajanitapīḍāṃ tatra kṣīrasya niṣiddhatvāt | taduktam - “dadhimatsyaguḍakṣīrapotakīmāṣapiṣṭakam | varjayedāmavātārto māṃsamānūpajaṃ tathā” iti | āmaḥ aparipakvo'nnarasaḥ | tathāhi - “jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopajaḥ” iti | kecidatrāmaśūlaṃ pariṇāmajaṃ śūlamāmananti etadapi saṅgatam | dravyāditi sāmānyagrahaṇenānyeṣāmapi kṣīrayogānāṃ vidhānameva boddhavyam | yathā - “bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ payaḥ | āvārināśāt kvathitaṃ śukrodāvartanāśanam” iti | etadapi prasaṅgato vyācaṣṭe | atra bastiśuddhikarāṇi tṛṇapañcamūlīvīratarvādīni āvāpa iha kṣīraśodhanārthaṃ kalkaḥ | tathāhyuktam - “kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro darbha ikṣuśceti tṛṇodbhavam | pittakṛcchraharaṃ pañcamūlaṃ bastiviśodhanam || etat siddhaṃ payaḥ pītaṃ meḍhragaṃ hanti śoṇitam” iti ||161-163||

div.ab: Gū. atha kṣīrapākavidhiḥ | dravyamauṣadhaṃ tathāca vṛndaḥ - “pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pippalī vāpi tacchṛtaṃ | śiṃśipā gaṇḍikā nimbā dhāroṣṇaṃ vājvarāpaham” | śiṃśipāyā: gaṇḍikā na bhinnaṃ dravyaṃ śiṃśipāyāḥ suśrute sāro gṛhītaḥ, tathāca ‘udakāddviguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ śiṃśipāsārasaṃyutaṃ | kvāthitaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca sarvajvaragadāpaham’ ||161-1 63|| iti kṣīrapākavidhiḥ ||

saṃprati yavāgūprabhṛtikānnaprakriyāmāha - athānnaprakriyātraiva procyate nātivistarāt || 164 || yavāgūḥ ṣaṅguṇajale siddhā syātkṛśarā ghanā | taṇḍulairmudgamāṣaiśca tilairvā sādhitā hitā || 165 || yavāgūrgrāhiṇī bālyā tarpaṇī vātanāśinī |

Dī. athānneti | athetyanantaram | annaprakriyeti yavāgūvilepīpeyādirūpā | atrāsmingranthe nātivistarāt saṃkṣepamātrāt, yato vistarakathanaṃ sarveṣāmapyālasyakaraṃ bhavati | teṣu pūrvaṃ yavāgūvidhimāha - yavāgūrityādi | ṣaḍguṇe jale pānīye yā siddhā sā yavāgūśabdavācyā, ṣaḍguṇamityannaparimāṇāt | eṣā taṇḍulaireva sādhyā vyavahārāt tathā sādhyā yathā viraladravā bhavati | yataḥ - ‘yavāgūrvidravā’ iti vacanāt | asyā bhedaḥ kṛśareti nāmnā kathitā, sā ghanā dravarahitā ityarthaḥ | iyamapi taṇḍulādibhiḥ sādhitā bhavati atra mudgamāṣaiśceti cakārāt vyastaṃ grāhyaṃ tena mudgasādhitā māṣasādhitā vā | tilānyatrobhayatra yojyāni | tantrāntare'pi tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūreva kṛśarā kathyate | kecidanuktatvāt tilamāṣataṇḍulānāmatra sāmyaṃ manyante, tanna manoharam, kintu vyavahārāttaṇḍulānāṃ bhāgadvayaṃ, māṣasya bhāgaikam, ardhabhāgikaṃ tilānāmiti | sakalebhyaḥ ṣaḍguṇajalamityarthaḥ | yavāgūriti sāmānyenāsyā bahavo bhedāḥ santi | tadyathā dugdhataṇḍulayavāgū:, ghṛtataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, māṃsataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, phalakandataṇḍulayavāgūrityetāḥ sarvā yavāgvo dravyā'nusārato guṇakarāḥ sādhanīyāśca bhavanti | idānīṃ tasyā guṇamāha - yavāgūrityādi | grāhiṇī saṃgrāhikā atīsārādīnāṃ, balyā balakāriṇī ojovṛddhikarītyarthaḥ | tarpaṇī dhātūnāṃ tṛptijananī | vātapraṇāśinī ceti svabhāvāt ||164||1 65||

Gū. athānnaprakriyā | ṣaḍguṇe jale siddhā yavāgū: syāt | tataḥ ghanā kṛśarā syāt, sā taṇḍulairmudgamāṣaiśca tilairvā sādhitā vātādīnāṃ, kṛśarānnaprakārabhedabhinnā ||164||65||ityannaprakriyāyāṃ yavāgū ||
atha vilepīvivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - vilepī ghanasikthā syātsiddhā nīre caturguṇe ||166|| tarpaṇī bṛṃhaṇī hṛdyā madhurā pittanāśinī |

ab.seg: Dī. vilepīti | yā caturguṇe nīre pānīye siddhā niṣpannā sā vilepīśabdavācyā | svarūpeṇa ghanasikthā bhavati caturguṇanīratvāt | caturguṇamityatra annaparimāṇāt | iyamapyatra kevalaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ siddheti rūḍhi: | asau gulahathīti loke kathitā | guṇānapyasyā darśayannāha - tarpaṇītyādi | tarpaṇī tṛptijanikā, hṛdyetyāhlādakāriṇī, madhurā miṣṭarasā, ata eva pittavināśini vihitā || 166 ||

div.ab: Gū. atha vilepītyādi spaṣṭam || 166 |

idānīṃ peyāyūṣāvapyāha - dravādhikā svalpasikthā caturdaśaguṇe jale ||167|| siddhā peyā budhairjñeyā yūṣaḥ kiṃcidghanastataḥ | peyā laghutarā jñeyā grāhiṇī dhātupuṣṭidā || 168 || yūṣo balyastataḥ kaṇṭhyo laghupākaḥ kaphāpahaḥ |

Dī. dravādhikā iti | yā caturdaśaguṇe jale siddhā bhavati sā peyā jñeyā | svarūpeṇa ca sā dravādhikā svalpasikthā| kecit sa bhaktamaṇḍa iti vadanti | maṇḍastu siktharahita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathāhi - “yavāgū: ṣaḍguṇe toye saṃsiddhā viraladravā | caturguṇāmbusaṃsiddhā vilepī ghanasikthakā || peyā sikthānvitā toye caturdaśaguṇe kṛtā | maṇḍaścaturdaśaguṇe siddhastoye sasikthakaḥ” iti | yūṣamapyāha - tata iti | tasmāt peyā rūpadravyāt yaḥ kiñcidghanasāndro bhavati sa yūṣa ityucyate | eṣa yūṣaḥ kevalamudgaiḥ kṛtaḥ iti sāmānyenāsya kecit | yato mudgarasa iti loke atrāpi caturdaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam | annaparimāṇāt yūṣa iti sāmānyenāsya bahavo bhedāḥ santi te cāṣṭādaśaguṇe jale sādhyā iti tantrāntarīyamatam | tathāhi “syāddhitaḥ sādhito yūṣastvaṣṭādaśaguṇe jale” iti | guṇamanayorvaktumāha - peyā laghutaretyādi | laghutarā atyarthaṃ laghupākā, grāhiṇī grāhikā atisārādīnāṃ | nanu dravamannamatīsāre niṣiddhaṃ | yaduktam | “varjayedvidalaṃ śūlī kuṣṭhī māṃsaṃ kṣayī striyam | dravamannamatīsārī sarvaṃ ca taruṇajvarī” tatkathaṃ peyā'tīsāre vihitā ? ucyate, avihitadravā'nnaniṣedhārthaṃ vākyamidam, peyāyavāgvādivihitameva | tathācoktaṃ suśrute “kāryaṃ cānaśanasyānte pradravaṃ laghubhojanam” iti | atra pradravaṃ prakṛṣṭadravaṃ, laghu yavāgvādi | tathaiva niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ bhojenā'pyuktam “vraṇodarasthāpanapātitānāṃ pramehiṇāṃ chardyātisāriṇāṃ ca | dravaṃ na dayādathavāpi koṣṇaṃ svalpaṃ hitaṃ bheṣajasaṃprayuktam” iti | yūṣo'pi balyo balakaraḥ, kaṇṭhyaḥ kaṇṭhe hitaḥ, pāke laghuḥ kaphāpahaśca ata evātra mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaśca kathitaḥ | tathāhi “kaphaghno dīpano hṛdyaḥ śuddhānāṃ vraṇināmapi | uktaḥ pathyatamaścāpi mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ” iti || 167 || 168 ||
Gū. peyāyūṣau kṛtānnabhedau || 167 || 168 || iti peyāyūṣau ||
idānīṃ bhaktavidhimāha - jale caturdaśaguṇe taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalam ||169 || vipacetsrāvayenmaṇḍaṃ sa bhakto madhuro laghuḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. jala iti | taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalaṃ kuḍavamitaṃ grāhyam | caturdaśaguṇe pānīye vipācya taddravaṃ pānīyo'vaśiṣṭaḥ sa bhakta iti prasiddhaḥ | guṇo'pi rase madhuraḥ, pāke laghuriti | etadbahujalaparimāṇaṃ parisrutārtham | na tu tantrāntare bhaktaṃ pañcaguṇe sādhyamiti | tathāhi - “śṛtaṃ pañcaguṇe bhaktaṃ vilepīti caturguṇe” iti | tatkathaṃ caturdaśaguṇamatra jalam ? ucyate - bhaktaṃ dvividhaṃ sudhautaprasrutam adhautāsrutaṃ ca, yat sudhautaprasrutaṃ tacca caturdaśaguṇe jale sādhyam, adhautāsrataṃ ca pañcaguṇe iti bhāvaḥ | tathācoktam - “sudhautaprasrutaṃ coṣṇaṃ viśadaṃ guṇavanmatam | adhautaprasrutaṃ śītaṃ guruvṛṣyaṃ kaphapradam” iti ||169||
Gū. jala iti sarvaṃ sugamam || 169 ||

div.ab: adhunā śuddhamaṇḍamāha - nīre caturdaśaguṇe siddho maṇḍastvasikthakaḥ ||170|| śuṇṭhīsaindhavasaṃyuktaḥ pācano dīpanaḥ smṛtaḥ |

Dī. nīre iti | caturdaśaguṇe nīre taṇḍulaparimāṇāt siddho niṣpannaḥ | asikthaka iti siktho bhaktāvayavaḥ tena rahita ityarthaḥ | ya īdṛśaḥ maṇḍasaṃjñayā prasiddhaḥ | eṣa yadā śuṇḍīsaindhavacūrṇena prakṣiptastadā pācana āmādīnām, dīpano jaṭharāgneśca smṛtaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ.| ayamabhṛṣṭataṇḍulairjanitaḥ | ata eva śuddhamaṇḍo'bhihitaḥ | yato maṇḍastantrāntare trividho darśitaḥ | tadyathā “maṇḍastu trividho jñeya ekadvitriparisrutaḥ | lājairbhṛṣṭairabhṛṣṭaiśca taṇḍulaiḥ parisaṃskṛtaḥ | catustriṃśadguṇaṃ bhaktāt pūrvaḥ pūrvo laghurhitaḥ” iti ||170|| iti śuddhamaṇḍaḥ ||

athāṣṭaguṇamaṇḍamāha -- dhānyatrikaṭusindhūtthamudgataṇḍulayojitaḥ‘yuktastakreṇa’ pā.| || 171 || bhṛṣṭaśca hiṅgutailābhyāṃ sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | dīpanaḥ prāṇado bastiśodhano raktavardhanaḥ ||172 || jvarajitsarvadoṣaghno maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇa ucyate |

Dī. dhānyeti | dhānyādibhirdravyaiḥ saṃskṛto hiṅgutailābhyāṃ saha bhṛṣṭo bharjitaḥ sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇasaṃjñaḥ kathitaḥ | atra taṇḍulamudgayordānamannaprakaraṇādavagantavyam | tathāca tantrāntare “sutaṇḍulānāṃ prasṛtidvayaṃ ca tadardhamudgāḥ kaṭukatrayaṃ ca | kustumbarīsaindhavahiṅgutakrairebhiḥ samastaiḥ kriyate ca maṇḍaḥ” ityādi | atra yat śārṅgadhareṇa tailagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat bharjanārthaṃ taṇḍulamudgayoḥ | anyatrāpyuktam “taṇḍulairardhamudgāṃśaiḥ kiṃcidbhṛṣṭaiḥ supācitaḥ | hiṅgusindhū- tthadhanikātakratrikaṭusaṃskṛtaḥ || jñeyaḥ so'ṣṭaguṇo maṇḍo jvaradoṣatrayāpahaḥ” ityādi | kecit kartavyavidhau cāsya kaṭukatrayacūrṇaṃ paścāt prakṣepe manāg deyamiti vadanti | sa maṇḍa iti sthāne sa bhakta ityapare paṭhanti; tanmate tu īṣatsikthayuta ityarthaḥ, gato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ | aṣṭaguṇa iti yat pūrvaṃ tānāha - dīpana ityādi | agnerdīpanaḥ, prāṇado balakaraḥ, bastiśodhano bastiśuddhikaraḥ, bastirmūtrādhāraḥ, ata eva mūtralo vikhyātaḥ | raktavardhana iti śoṇitavṛddhi- karaḥ | jvarajit sarvajvaraharaḥ prabhāvāt | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphānāṃ pratyekaṃ hantā na tu sannipātajvaraharaḥ aṣṭasaṃjñatvāt | tathāca tantrāntare “kṣuddīpano bastiviśodhanaśca prāṇaprado raktavivardhanaśca | jvarāpahārī kaphapitta- hantā vāyuṃ jayedaṣṭaguṇo hi maṇḍaḥ” || 171 || 172 ||

Gū. atha maṇḍaḥ | asikthakaḥ siktharahitaḥ dhānyādibhiryojitaḥ hiṅgutailābhyāṃ bhṛṣṭaśca sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ | aṣṭau dīpanādayo guṇā yasya sudīpanādvayo jvarāntāḥ pañca | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphaghneti tritayaṃ evamaṣṭaguṇaḥ | taṇḍulaṃ mudraṃ palamātraṃ, dhānyaṃ trikaṭusindhūtthaṃ yathāparimitam | anye'ṣṭaguṇamaṇḍamevāhuḥ, sugamamanyat || 171 || 172 || ityaṣṭaguṇamaṇḍa: ||
idānīṃ vāṭyamaṇḍamāha - sukaṇḍitaistathā bhṛṣṭairvāṭyamaṇḍo yavairbhayet ||173|| kaphapittaharaḥ kaṇṭhyo raktapittaprasādanaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. sukaṇḍitairiti | ayaṃ vāṭyamaṇḍo dalitayavagodhūmādikṛto vyakta eva tathā'pi kiñcidvyācaṣṭe sukaṇḍitairiti | musalādibhirulūkhale saṅkuṭṭitaiḥ tuṣavarjitairityaryaḥ | tathā bhṛṣṭairiti bharjitaiḥ | tatheti grahaṇena yathā na dagdhairityarthaḥ | īdṛśaiḥ yavaiḥ, yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, bahuvacanatvena godhūmādayo grāhyāḥ | sa ca kaphapittaharaḥ, kaphaharaḥ pittaharaśca | saṃyogaharo vā | kaṇṭhya iti kaṇṭharogebhyo hitaḥ | raktapittaprasādan iti prakarṣeṇa sādayati iti sādanaḥ kupitāsrapittaśāntikara ityarthaḥ, na tu raktapittapravṛddhikaraḥ | tathāhi “vāṭyamaṇḍo laghurgrāhī śūlānāhāsrapittajit” iti| keciditi vyākhyānayanti | prakupitaṃ raktapittaṃ nirmalaṃ karoti svaprakṛtisthitaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | apare raktapittaniṣūdana iti paṭhanti | tadyaktam || 173 ||

div.ab: Gū. atha vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ | sukaṇḍitaiḥ kṛtanistuṣai: bhraṣṭairyavairvāṭyamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kaṇṭharogeṣu hitaḥ rakta- pittaprasādanaḥ śamakaḥ ||173 || iti vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ ||

atha lājamaṇḍamāha - lājairvā taṇḍulairbhṛṣṭairlājamaṇḍa: prakīrtitaḥ || 174|| śleṣmapittaharo grāhī pipāsājvarajinmataḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthakalpanā- dhyāyo dvitīyaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. lājairiti | bhṛṣṭaśālibhavā lājā ityucyante| taiḥ kṛtvā yaḥ sādhitaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ kathitaḥ | sādhanamatra pūrvavat jñātavyam | athavā bhṛṣṭaistaṇḍulaiśca kṛto yaḥ so'pi lājamaṇḍasaṃjñitaḥ | asya guṇamāha - śleṣmapittaharaḥ ityādi| śleṣmaharaḥpittaharaśca | grāhī saṃprāhakaḥ | pipāsājvarajinmata iti | pipāsā pātumicchā iti sāmānyagrahaṇenāṣṭadhā | atra lājādīnāṃ parimāṇaṃ pūrvamaṇḍavajjñātavyam | nanu yadyevaṃ tarhi kimasau pṛthak darśitaḥ ? ucyate, lājamaṇḍasaṃjñādijñāpanārthaṃ pṛthaguktam| iti na doṣaḥ ||174||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kvāthakalpanādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 ||
Gū. atha lājamaṇḍa: | lājā purātanabharjitaśālidhānyajāḥ taiḥ kṛtaḥ tadvattairvā bhṛṣṭaiḥ kṛtaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ sa śleṣmādiharaḥ grāhī grahaṇyatisārasaṃbhaktaḥ || 174 ||
iti lājamaṇḍaḥ | iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthādikalpanādhyāyaḥ ||2||

div.head: atha phāṇṭādikalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | phāṇṭakalpanā | kṣuṇṇe dravyapale samyagjalamuṣṇaṃ vinikṣipet | mṛtpātre kuḍavonmānaṃ tatastu srāvayetpaṭāt || 1 ||
tasya?sa syāccū.? pā. cūrṇadravaḥ phāṇṭastanmānaṃ dvipalonmitam | sitāmadhuguḍādīṃśca kvāthavattatra nikṣipet || 2 ||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ phāṇṭakalpanāṃ darśayitumāha -- kṣuṇṇe dravyeti | anena phāṇṭaparibhāṣā abhihitā | kṣuṇṇe dravyapale iti samyak kṣuṇṇe atyantakuṭṭite, cūrṇasadṛśa ityarthaḥ | uṣṇamityardhaviśoṣitaṃ kvathitamātramiti kecit | vinikṣipet viśeṣeṇa kṣipediti grahaṇena dravyasya pramāṇādikaṃ sūcitam | etenoktaparimitaṃ dravyaṃ jale nirmathya visrāvyamityarthaḥ | tasya dravarūpaphāṇṭasya paryāyavācakaśabdaścūrṇadravaḥ proktaḥ | tanmānamiti pānārtham | atha tatprakṣepārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - sitetyādi | atra ādiśabdāt kṣīraghṛtatailamūtralavaṇakṣārahiṅgutrikaṭukaprabhṛtayo gṛhyante eteṣāṃ prakṣepamānaṃ kvāthavajjñātavyam ||1||2||

Gū. atha phāṇṭakalpanā | kvāthānantaraṃ phāṇṭavidhānāt kṣuṇṇe kuṭṭite dravyapale mṛtpātre kuḍavonmitacatuṣpalaṃ uṣṇajale vinikṣipet | tataḥ paṭādvastrātsrāvayet | sa cūrṇadravaḥ syāt, tathā phāṇṭaparyāyeṇa tanmānaṃ bhakṣaṇamānaṃ tu dvipalaṃ madhukādīni kvāthavat ||1||2||

ab.seg: atha bṛhanmadhūkaphāṇṭaḥ | sa yathā - madhūkapuṣpaṃ madhukaṃ candanaṃ saparūṣakam | mṛṇālaṃ kamalaṃ lodhraṃ kambhārī nāgakeśaram ||3||
triphalā-sārivā-drākṣā-lājānkoṣṇajale kṣipet | sitāmadhuyutaḥ peyaḥ phāṇṭo vāsau himo'thavā ||4||
vātapittajvaraṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrcchāratibhramān | raktapittaṃ madaṃ hanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||5||

Dī. sa yathetyanena taddarśayati granthakāraḥ | idānīṃ vivaraṇamasmābhirapi likhyate | madhūkapuṣpamiti | ayaṃ madhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭasaṃjñaḥ himasaṃjño vā kalpanādvayabhedāt | atra madhūko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya puṣpāṇi, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, candanamatra raktaṃ, parūṣakamiti phalaviśeṣaṃ, ‘phalasā ’‘pheruṣā’ pā. | iti loke | mṛṇālaṃ kamalanālaṃ, ‘bhasīḍa’ iti loke; kamalaṃ puṣpaviśeṣaṃ vikhyātam | tadabhāve padmabījamiti sarvatra | kambhārīti kambhārīphalaṃ, triphalā iti harītakyādikaṃ, sārivā āsphotā, ’āsphoī’ iti śabdavācyā | lājāniti bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavān, (etatsarvaṃnāsti ‘ka’ pustake | samamānena palaikaṃ grāhyam | samatā'trānuktatvāt) koṣṇa itīṣaduṣṇaḥ, sitā madhu ca prakṣepe praśastam | himo'pi purato yadapekṣamāṇo'stīti | aratimasaukhyam | bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva, madaṃ duṣṭapūgadhattūrakodravādijanitam | atra vicāraṇā na kāryeti yadgrahaṇam, tat “acintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ” iti vākyānurodhāt | tathācoktam “nauṣadhīrhetubhirvidvān parīkṣeta kathañcana | sahasreṇāpi hetūnāṃ nāmbaṣṭhādirvirecayet” iti | ata eva vṛddhavaidyavyavahāreṇānusartavya iti janaśrutirityarthaḥ | kecit pratyekadvitīyāntadravyagrahaṇena vyastayogānapi praśaṃsanti etadapi manoharaṃ na doṣaḥ | “nātra kāryā vicāraṇā” iti vacanāt ||3-5||

Gū. madhūkapuṣpaṃ‘mahuvā’ hi.bhā. | guḍapuṣpaṃ, madhukayaṣṭī, candanaṃ raktaṃ, parūṣakaṃ‘phalasā’ hi.bhā. | giripīluḥ, mṛṇālaṃ‘miṣa’ hi.bhā. | kandaḥ, kamalaṃ kamalapatraṃ phalaṃ vā | lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, kambhārī gambhārī, sārivā anantamūlaṃ yadvā sugandhadravyaṃ, lājā dhānyakṛtā | koṣṇajale īṣaduṣṇe palamātraṃ yaddravyaṃ catuṣpale jale sthitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ dvipalaṃ peyam | sitā matsyaṇḍī, tathā madhuyutaṃ peyam | asau phāṇṭaḥ athavā himaḥ kriyate rātristhitatvāt vātajvarādīnhanyānmadarogaṃ ca | iti madhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭaḥ || 3-5 ||

div.ab: athāmrādiphāṇṭaḥ jvarādau | āmrajambukisalayairvaṭaśuṅgaprarohakaiḥ | uśīreṇa kṛtaḥ phāṇṭa: sakṣaudro jvaranāśanaḥ || 6 || pipāsāchardyatīsārānmūrcchāṃ jayati dustarām |

ab.seg: Dī. athāmrādiphāṇṭamāha - āmrajambūkisalayairiti | āmrakisalayairjambūkisalayaiśca kisalayaṃ komalapatram | vaṭaśuṅgaprarohakairiti vaṭavṛkṣasya śuṅgāni komalapallavāni, prarohakā vaṭāvarohāḥ, varārohā iti loke | uśīrastṛṇabhedaḥ sugandhāṅghiḥ prasiddhaḥ | kartavyatāsya pūrvavat | kṣaudramatra prakṣepe | dustarāmityanivāryām || 6 ||
Gū. āmrasya tathā jambūkisalayaiḥ pallavairvaṭaśuṅgaḥ vaṭaprarohaḥ‘varāroha’ baḍakī dāḍhī, hi.bhā. vaṭāṅkuraḥ, uśīraḥ etaiḥ kṛtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ kṣaudreṇa jvarādināśakaḥ ||6||
laghumadhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭo dāhapittādau | madhūkapuṣpakambhārīcandanośīradhānyakaiḥ || 7 ||
drākṣayā ca kṛtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ śītaḥ śarkarayā yutaḥ | tṛṣṇāpittaharaḥ prokto dāhamūrcchābhramāñjayet ||8||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ laghumadhūkapuṣpādikaphāṇṭaṃ darśayannāha - madhūkapuṣpeti | madhūkapuṣpaṃ vikhyātaṃ, ‘mahuvā’ śabdavācyam | kambhārī kāśmarī, tasyāḥ phalāni, candanamatra raktacandanam, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ, dhānyakaṃ kustumbarī, drākṣā phalottamā | śīta iti sparśāt, yadvā śīto himaḥ kaṣāyo'yaṃ kartavyaḥ, pūrvavākyānurodhāt | śarkarā atra prakṣepe | tṛṣṇāharaḥ pittaharaśca, pittaṃ prakupitam || 7 || 8 ||
Gū. sugamam || 7 || 8 || iti phāṇṭaḥ ||
manthavidhiḥ | mantho'pi phāṇṭabhedaḥ syāttena cātraiva kathyate | jale catuḥpale śīte kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ kṣipet || 9 || mṛtpātre manthayetsamyaktasmācca dvipalaṃ pibet |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ manthavidhimāha - mantha iti | yato'yaṃmanthaḥ phāṇṭasya bhedo darśitaḥ | tadvedibhistena kāraṇenātra kalpanayā kathyate | ācāryeṇeti śeṣaḥ | śīte jala iti grahaṇenaiva phāṇṭādbhinno'yaṃ kathitaḥ | ‘jale catuḥpale’ ityādiko'yaṃ ślokaḥ prakṣepaka iti vadanti kecit, yato bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate | jalamānaṃ tu dravyānumānato boddhavyaṃ yathā vakṣyamāṇe saktumanthake ||9||
Gū. atha manthaḥ | sa yathā kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ dravyaṃ palaṃ, catuḥpale śītajale kṣipet punaḥ manthayet tasmāddvipalaṃ pibet | ato'yaṃ bhinnaḥ || 9 ||

div.ab: madātyayādau kharjūrādimanthaḥ | sa yathā - kharjūradāḍimīdrākṣātintiḍīkāmlikāmalaiḥ ||10|| saparūṣaiḥ kṛto manthaḥ sarvamadyavikāranut |

ab.seg: Dī. sa yatheti manthasūcakaṃ vākyamidam | atastaṃ darśayannāha - kharjūreti | atra kharjūrādīnāṃ phalāni grāhyāṇi | kharjūrī bṛhatkharjūrikā, tasyāḥ phalāni ‘utatī’ti loke; dāḍimaṃ dāḍimīphalaṃ, tintiḍīkaṃ viṭapiviśeṣaḥ, tasya phalāni amlāni bhavanti | amlikā ciñcā, tasyāḥ phalāni prasiddhāni, āgalamāmalakaphalaṃ, parūṣakaṃ phālasāśabdavācyaṃ hrasvaviṭapaṃ, tasyāpi phalaiḥ kṛta ityeṣāṃ paripakvaphalaiḥ saṃskārita ityarthaḥ | sarvaṃ madyaṃ duṣṭapūgakodravāriṣṭādikaṃ tajjanitaṃ vikāraṃ madātyayādikaṃ, taṃ nāśayatītyarthaḥ | eke cātra śarkarāṃ vadanti pānakatvāt ||10||

Gū. kharjūraḥ prasiddhaḥ, dāḍimaphalaṃ tasya bījāni, drākṣā gostanī, tintiḍīkaṃ vṛkṣāmlam, amlikā prasiddhā, āmalam āmalakaṃ, paṣarūko giripīluḥ | etaiḥ kṛtaḥ manthaḥ madyavikāraṃ madātyayādikaṃ harati | iti kharjūrādimantho madātyayādau ||10||

div.ab: atha masūrādimanthaḥ chardyām - kṣaudrayuktā masūrāṇāṃ saktavo dāḍimāmbhasā || 11|| mathitā vārayantyāśu chārdiṃ doṣatrayodbhavām |

Dī. idānīṃ masūrādimanthavivaraṇamāha - kṣaudrayuktā iti | kṣaudrayuktā madhuplāvitāḥ | masūro'nnaviśeṣaḥ, sa ca bharjitaḥ saktunimittatvāt | dāḍimāmbhasā paripakvadāḍimaphalatoyena mathitā nirmathitā | doṣatrayodbhavāmiti vyastāṃ samastāṃ vā |
Gū. masūrāṇāṃ bharjitānāṃ saktavaḥ dāḍimāṃbhasā dāḍimajalena amlena vā pīto doṣatrayodbhavāṃ tridoṣajāṃ chardiṃ vānti jayanti |

tṛṣṇādāhādau yavasaktumanthaḥ | plāvitaiḥ śītanīreṇa saghṛtairyavasaktubhiḥ ||12|| nātisāndradravo manthastṛṣṇādāhāstrapittahā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe phāṇṭādikalpanā nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha yavasaktumāha - plāvitairiti | yavasaktubhiḥ kṛtvā kṛto yo mantha: sa tṛṣṇādāhāsrapittahā bhavati | kīdṛśaiḥ ? śītanīreṇa śītalapānīyena plāvitairāloḍitaiḥ | eke plāvitaiḥ śītanīreṇetyasya sthāne “plāvitaiḥ śarkarātoyaiḥ” iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | punaḥ kīdṛśaiḥ ? saghṛtaiḥ uktaparimāṇaghṛtayuktaiḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ ? nātisāndradravai: nātiśayena sāndradravāstairiti | sāndraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, dravaṃ toyasadṛśam | tathāca tantrāntare “saktavaḥ sarpiṣābhyaktāḥ śītavāripariplutāḥ | nātidravā nātisāndrā mantha ityabhidhīyate” | eke “nātisāndrairdravairmantha” iti paṭhanti | tanmate tu sāndratvaṃ niṣiddhaṃ dravatvaṃ praśastamiti | tathāca matāntare vākyadvayamāha “gurvī piṇḍī kharātyarthaṃ laghvī saiva viparyayāt | na jalāntīratān dviḥ saktūnadyānna kevalān” iti drave'pi sāphalyamanugrāhakena darśayitumāha | tadyathā “pītāḥ satarpaṇā hṛdyāḥ sadyo balavivardhanāḥ | vātātapādhvavyāyāmakarśitānāṃ śramāpahā || madhurā laghavaḥ śītāḥ saktavo raktapittahā iti | ayamapi śarkarādisaṃyuktaḥ kartavyo vyavahārāt | uktaṃ ca “śarkarekṣumadhudrākṣāyukta: pitta- vikāranut | drākṣāmadhusamāyuktaḥ kapharogaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || vargatrayeṇopahito maladoṣānulomanaḥ iti ||11 ||
12|| iti śrīvāstavyānvabaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyakhaṇḍe phāṇṭa- kalpanā nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
Gū. atha yavaśaktumanthaḥ | plāvitaiḥ bharjitaiḥ ghṛtasahitairyavaśaktubhirnātisāndradravaiḥ nātighanairnātidravaiḥ kṛtaḥ manthaḥ tṛṣṇādihā; asrapittaṃ raktapittam || 11 ||
12 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpakāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne phāṇṭādikalpanādhyāyaḥ ||3||

div.head: atha himakalpanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ samyakṣaḍbhirnīrapalaiḥ plutam | niśoṣitaṃ himaḥ sa syāttathā śītakaṣāyakaḥ ||1|| tanmānaṃ phāṇṭavajjñeyaṃ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha himakalpanāṃ nidarśayannāha - kṣuṇṇamiti | ayaṃ himakaṣāyo'nayā paribhāṣayā prathito bhavati | kathaṃ ? yathā “kṣuṇṇaṃ samyakkuṭṭitaṃ ṣaḍbhirnīrapalaiḥ” iti dravyaparimāṇāt | niśoṣitamiti sakalaniśāyāmadhyuṣitaṃ, tena prātaḥ saṃsrāvya dravaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | etasya paryāyanāmnā śītakaṣāyaḥ kathitaḥ | taduktaṃ tantrāntare - “śīto rātriṃ drave sthitaḥ” iti | tanmānaṃ tu phāṇṭavajjñeyamiti tasya parimāṇaṃ pānārthaṃ phāṇṭavajjñātam | mānagrahaṇenāpi prakṣepādayo'pi phāṇṭavajjñātavyāḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatraiva nānyat || 1 ||
Gū. himakalpanā | kṣuṇṇaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ dravyapalaiḥ ṣaḍbhirnīrapalaiḥ plutaṃ niśoṣitaṃ rātristhāpitaṃ himaḥ syāt tanmānaṃ bhakṣaṇamānaṃ phāṇṭavaddvipalam || 1||

div.ab: āmrādihimo raktapitte | sa yathā - āmra-jambū ca kakubhaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya jale kṣipet ||2|| himaṃ tasya pibetprātaḥ sukṣaudraṃ raktapittajit |

ab.seg: Dī. sa yatheti vākyena himakaṣāyayogāt darśayati | āmreti | tadyathā - ayam āmrādikasaṃjñako himo madhuprakṣipto raktapittajidbhavati | atra kakubho'rjunaḥ sa ca vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | āmrādīnāṃ tvakcūrṇamiti vyavahārāt ||2||
Gū. kakubho'rjunavṛkṣaḥ, sakṣaudro madhusahitaḥ ||2||

div.ab: atha marīcyādihimastṛṣṇādau - marīcaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca kākodumbarapallavāḥ || 3 || nīlotpalaṃ himastajjastṛṣṇāchardinivāraṇaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha marīcādisaṃjñako himaḥ | atra kākodumbarikā ’kaṭumbarī’śabdavācyā, ‘kaṭvarī’śabdavācyā ca | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījamiti vyavahārāt | tajja iti marīcādidravyairjātaḥ | eke marīcacūrṇaṃ manāk prakṣepe'pyāhuḥ tīkṣṇatvāt || 3 ||
Gū. madhuyaṣṭī madhukaṃ, kākodumbarīpallavaḥ kaṭumbarapallavaḥ ||3||

div.ab: vātapittādau nīlotpalādihimaḥ | nīlotpalaṃ balā drākṣā madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ tathā || 4 || uśīraṃ padmakaṃ caiva kāśmarī ca parūṣakam | eṣa śītakaṣāyaśca vātapittajvarāñjayet || 5 || sapralāpabhramacchardimohatṛṣṇānivāraṇaḥ |

Dī. atha nīlotpalādijaṃ himamāha, nīlotpalamiti | nīlotpalamatra vikhyātaṃ, taccendīvarasaṃjñam | balā prasiddhā | madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, loke mahuāśabdavācyam | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, uśīraṃ tṛṇabhedaṃ sugandhamūlam, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣam | kāśmarī kambhārī, tasyāḥ phalāni, parūṣakaṃ prasiddham | śītakaṣāyo himakaṣāyaḥ kathitaḥ pralāpo'sambaddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ, moho mūrcchābhedaḥ || 4 || 5 ||

Gū. nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, balā prasiddhā, madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, padmakaṃ paḍmakāṣṭhaṃ, kāśmarī gambhārī, parūṣakaṃ giripīluḥ | śītakaṣāyaḥ vātapittajvarādīn jayet | pralopo'narthakaṃ vaca ityamaraḥ | bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva | moho mūrcchā || 4 || 5 ||
guḍūcīhimaḥ jīrṇajvare - amṛtāyā himaḥ peyo jīrṇajvaraharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6 || vāsāyāśca himaḥ kāsaṃ raktapittajvarāñjayet |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīmamṛtāṭarūṣakasaṃjñakau himāvāha - amṛtāyā iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyā vallī grāhyā | atrāpare madhu prakṣipanti tantrāntare darśanāt | tathāhi “amṛtāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ tu śītaṃ samyak paladvayam | madhupādayutaṃ pītaṃ jīrṇajvaraharaṃ param” iti | aparaṃ ca vāsā aṭarūṣakaḥ, sa cātra pañcāṅgo vyavahārāt || 6 ||
Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī tasyā himaṃ jīrṇajvaraṃ pakṣādūrdhvaṃ sthitaḥ | atha vāsāhima: raktapitte | vāsāyāśca himaḥ kāsaraktapittajvarāñjayet, sugamam ||6||

div.ab: atha dhānyādihimo'ntardāhādau - prātaḥ saśarkaraḥ peyo himo dhānyākasaṃbhavaḥ || 7 || antardāhaṃ tathā tṛṣṇāṃ jayetsrotoviśodhanaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. prātariti | eṣa dhānyākahimo'ntardāhādau praśastaḥ, dhānyākaṃ kustumburu | srotoviśodhana iti mūtramārgasya śuddhikaraḥ mūtrakṛcchrādihara ityarthaḥ || 7 ||
Gū. srotoviśodhanaḥ srotaḥśuddhikaraḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 7 ||

div.ab: atha dhānyākādirhimaḥ raktapittādau - dhānyākadhātrīvāsānāṃ drākṣāparpaṭayorhimaḥ || 8 || raktapittajvaraṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ śoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe himakalpanā nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. dhānyāketi | ayaṃ dhānyākādisaṃjñako himo raktapittādikān hantīti | atra dhātrī āmalakīphalam, vāsā aṭarūṣakastasya mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ, parpaṭaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ | etatsakalaṃ samaṃ tulitaṃ saṃgṛhya himakaṣāyaḥ kartavyaḥ | atrāpi śarkarāprakṣepamāhuḥ pūrvayogānusārāt | śoṣaṃ mukhaśoṣaṃ, kṣayabhedo vā, eke yogadvayamāhuḥ ||8||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe himakalpanādhyāyaścaturthaḥ || 4 ||
Gū. dhātrī āmalakī, parpaṭaḥ kamupatraḥ raktapittaṃ mukhāde raktasrāvaḥ, śoṣaṃ, yadvā śoṣaḥ kṣayabhedaḥ nāśayet || 8 ||
iti śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne himakalpanādhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

div.head: atha kalkakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | athedānīṃ kalkakalpanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ - dravyamārdraṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ vā sajalaṃ bhavet | prakṣepāvāpakalkāste tanmānaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 1 ||
kalke madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ deyaṃ dviguṇamātrayā | sitāguḍaṃ samaṃ dadyāddravā deyāścaturguṇāḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: Dī. dravyamityādi | iyamanena prakāreṇa kalkaparibhāṣā kathyate | dravyaṃ vyādhivihitam | ārdraṃ sadya uddhṛtam | pakṣāntarakalkavidhau śuṣkamapi dravyaṃ jalena piṣṭaṃ kalkasaṃjñakaṃ bhavati | te prakṣepāvāpakalkā iti paryāyaśabdavācakaiḥ kathitāḥ | tanmānakalkaparimāṇaṃ karṣamitaṃ sārdhaṭaṃkadvayaṃ, etacca bhakṣaṇe mānamanuktānām | athātra prakṣepadravyāṇyāha -kalke madhughṛtamityādi | kalke pūrvoktaṃ madhughṛtatailaṃ dviguṇamātrayā deyam | dviguṇatā kalkādityarthaḥ | sitā guḍaśca samaṃ samamapi kalkācca dravā iti avaśiṣṭajalakṣīrādyāścaturguṇā deyāḥ kalkādapītyarthaḥ | kalkaḥ prakṣepasaṃjñaḥ proktaḥ | tasmāt draveṣu prakṣepako yojya iti tātparyārthaḥ | yathāgre vakṣyamāṇāḥ pippalīvardhamānādayo dṛśyante ata eva karṣaparimāṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ, viśeṣatastu doṣādyanurūpataḥ pramāṇāḥ boddhavyā: || 1 || 2 ||

Gū. atha kalkakalpanā | ārdraṃ dravyamauṣadhaṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ jalapiṣṭaṃ bhavet | tanmānaṃ karṣasaṃmitaṃ bhavet | te nāmataḥ prakṣepa āvāpakalkā bhavanti | kalke madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ dviguṇamātrayā deyaṃ kvāthato dviguṇamātrayeti pūrvoktaiḥ sitāguḍasamaṃ dravā jaladugdhādyāḥ caturguṇā iti || 1 || 2 ||

vardhamānapippalyaḥ | sa‘sa’kalka ityartha:| yathā - trivṛddhyā pañcavṛddhyā vā saptavṛddhyāthavā kaṇāḥ | pibetpiṣṭvā daśadinaṃ tāstathaivāpakarṣayet ||3|| evaṃ viṃśaddinaiḥ siddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānakam | anena pāṇḍuvātāsrakāsaśvāsārucijvarāḥ || 4 || udarārśaḥkṣayaśleṣmavātā naśyantyurograhāḥ |

Dī. sa yatheti śiṣyavākyena tadvidhiṃ darśayati granthakāraḥ trivṛddhyetyādinā | ayaṃ pippalīvardhamānaprayogo vidhīyate| vṛddhistu tāvad yāvaddaśadinamiti | tāstathaivāpakarṣayediti tāḥ pippalyaḥ tathaiveti vṛddhi- yuktyāpakarṣayet hrāsayet yāvaddaśadinamiti | evaṃ viṃśatidinaiḥ kṛtvā pippalīvardhamānaprayogaḥ siddho bhavati | etena kimuktaṃ bhavati tribhistribhiḥ parivṛddhiḥ kṛtā yāvaddaśadināni, vṛddhistu pratidinameva, tatastisra- stisro'pakarṣayed yāvattisraḥ pippalya eva tiṣṭhanti, evaṃ pañcavṛddhirapakarṣaśca tathā saptavṛddhirapakarṣaśca | athaveti grahaṇena daśapippalīnāṃ vṛddhirapakarṣaśca boddhavyaḥ anyato darśanāt | tadyathā “tribhiratha parivṛddhaṃ pañcabhiḥ saptabhirvā daśabhiratha vivṛddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānam | iti pibati pumān yastasya na śvāsakāsajvarajaṭharagadārśovātaraktakṣayāḥ syuḥ iti” | piṣṭvā ityatrāpi kṣīrapiṣṭā iti manyante kecit || 3 || 4 ||

Gū. sa yathā sugamam | pippalīvardhamānaṃ pāṇḍujvarādau | trivṛddhyā pañcavṛddhyā vā kaṇāḥ pippalyaḥ piṣṭvā kalkavidhānena caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā pibeddaśadinaṃ punardaśadinaṃ apakarṣayettato hrāsayet evaṃ viśaddinaiḥ siddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānasiddhaṃ bhavati tena vyādhayo naśyantīti yojanā ||3||4 ||
atha nimbakalko vraṇacchardyādau - lepānnimbadalaiḥ kalko vraṇaśodhanaropaṇaḥ || 5 || bhakṣaṇācchardikuṣṭhāni pittaśleṣmakṛmīñjayet |

ab.seg: Dī. lepāditi | nimbapatrāṇi śilāpiṣṭāni kṛtvā vraṇeṣu lepaḥ kāryaḥ | peṣaṇamatra jalena, lepaparimāṇa- tvādārdramahiṣacarmotsedham | vyavahāratastu vraṇānukāri kuryāt | nātra niyatapramāṇam | kāryāntaramāha - bhakṣaṇāditi | nimbapatrakalkabhakṣaṇādapi kuṣṭhādayo vinaśyantīti prabhāvāt | nimba iti nimbakalkaḥ || 5 ||
Gū. nimbadalaiḥ patraiḥ kṛtaḥ kalkaḥ pūraṇādvraṇaśodhano ropaṇo bhavati bhakṣaṇāt chardyādīn jayet | anubhūtaṃ chardyām ||5||
atha mahānimbakalko gṛdhrasyām - mahānimbajaṭākalko gṛdhrasīnāśanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 ||
Dī. aparamapi yogamāha mahānimbeti | mahānimbaḥ kārmukaḥ, ‘vakāini’ iti loke | tasya jaṭā mūlam | gṛdhrasī vātaroge paṭhitā, rāndhanīti loke prasiddhā || 6 ||
Gū. mahānimbaḥ‘bakāyana’ hi.bhā. kārmukaḥ, tasya jaṭākalka: bhakṣitaḥ gṛdhrasī ‘rīcaṇa’ vātanāśakaḥ || 6 ||
atha rasonakalkaḥ vātarogaviṣamajvarādau - śuddhaḥ kalko rasonasya tilatailena miśrita: | vātarogāñjayettīvrānviṣamajvaranāśanaḥ || 7 ||

Dī. anyadapyāha - śuddha iti | rasonaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ | śuddha iti tvagādirahitaḥ | tilatailena miśrita iti rasonakalkādviguṇitena tilatailena saṃplāvya bhakṣayedityarthaḥ | vātarogān gṛdhrasyarditapakṣāghātaprabhṛtīn tīvraniti- dustarān, viṣamajvarāḥ satatakādayaḥ || 7 ||
Gū. rasonaṃ laśunaṃ, tasya kalkaḥ śuddhaḥ dravyāntararahitaḥ tilatailena miśritaḥ vātarogāñjayet | viṣamajvare tilatailarahito deyaḥ || 7 ||
atha dvitīyarasonakalko vātavyādhau - pakvakandarasonasya gulikā nistuṣīkṛtāḥ | pāṭayitvā ca madhyasthaṃ dūrīkuryāttadaṅkuram || 8 ||
tadugragandhanāśāya rātrau takre vinikṣipet | apanīya ca tanmadhyācchilāyāṃ peṣayettataḥ || 9 ||
tanmadhye pañcamāṃśena cūrṇameṣāṃ vinikṣipet | sauvarcalaṃ yavānīṃ ca bharjitaṃ hiṅgu saindhavam || 10||
kaṭutrikaṃ jīrakaṃ ca samabhāgāni cūrṇayet | ekīkṛtya tataḥ sarvaṃ kalkaṃ karṣapramāṇataḥ || 11 ||
khādedagnibalāpekṣī ṛtudoṣādyapekṣayā | anupānaṃ tataḥ kuryāderaṇḍaśṛtamanvaham || 12 ||
sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ vātamarditaṃ cāpatantrakam | apasmāramathonmādamūrustambhaṃ ca gṛdhrasīm || 13 ||
uraḥpṛṣṭhakaṭīpārśvakukṣipīḍāṃ krimīñjayet | ajīrṇamātapaṃ roṣamatinīraṃ payo guḍam || 14 ||
rasonamaśnanpuruṣastyajedetannirantaram | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathāmlaṃ ca rasaṃ seveta nityaśaḥ || 15 ||

Dī. idānīṃ dvitīyarasonakalkaṃ darśayitumāha - pakveti | bṛhatsaṃjñako'yaṃ rasonakalko yadyapi sugamastathāpi keṣāṃcitsubodhārthaṃ kiṃcidvyācaṣṭe, pakvakandarasonasyetyādi | pakvaṃ kālāntareṇa pariṇataṃ, gulikāḥ kanda- syāvayavaviśeṣāḥ, pothīti śabdavācyāḥ | nistuṣīkṛtā iti nakhaiḥ saṃcholitāḥ paścāt pāṭayitvā dvidhā vidārya, tadaṅkuramiti rasonagulikamadhyasthaharitavarṇāṅkuram tanmadhyāditi takramadhyāt apanīya samādāyetyarthaḥ | atra rasonakalke uktadravyāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ pañcamāṃśena kṛtvā kṣipet | pañcamāṃśamiti rasonakalkāt, tena rasonakalkaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayaṃ, dravyacūrṇaṃ bhāgaikamiti, bharjitaṃ hiṅgvantrotkledavyavacchedārtham | tathāhi “yogeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛdbhavet” iti | evaṃ sarvatra | kaṭutrikaṃ śuṇṭhīmarīcapippalyaḥ, kalkakarṣapramāṇata iti rasonadravyacūrṇamilitaṃ kalkaṃ na tu kevalaṃ karṣapramāṇam | ata eva doṣāgnibalāpekṣīti vacanenātra mānābhāvaḥ sūcitaḥ | eraṇḍamūlakvathitamatrānupānamuktaparimāṇaṃ pratyahameva kuryāt | ekāṅgajamiti pakṣaghātaḥ | apatantrakaṃ vātaroge paṭhitalakṣaṇam | pīḍāśabdaḥ ura.prabhṛtibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambaddhaḥ, tena uraḥpīḍā pṛṣṭhapīḍā pārśvapīḍā kaṭipīḍā kukṣipīḍā ityarthaḥ | nanu sarvāṅgagrahaṇenaiva sarve vātavikārāḥ prāptāḥ tatkathaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam ? ucyate - sarvāṅgeṇa sarvaśarīraprakupito vāto'bhihitaḥ avayavāśritaḥ, tasmāt sarvāṅgaprakupitam ekadeśaprakupitaṃ cānilaṃ nāśayediti na doṣaḥ | asyābhyāsādeva tyājyamāha ajīrṇamityādi | nirantaraṃ sarvakālaṃ, ajīrṇamannādijanitam | ātapaṃ ca gharmasevāṃ, roṣaṃ krodhaṃ, atinīramatyambupānaṃ, payaḥ kṣīraṃ, guḍaṃ prasiddhaṃ | eke guḍopalakṣitatvāt sarvekṣuvikārāstyājyā iti vadanti | sevyamāha madyamityādi | madyaṃ surāsavaprabhṛtikaṃ, māṃsaṃ jāṅgalikaṃ guṇaprādhānyāt | amlamamlarasaṃ, tacca mātuluṅgādikaṃ, rasaṃ māsajanitaṃ prasahāmetyarthaḥ | nityaśaḥ pratidinam || 8-15 ||
Gū. eraṇḍajaṭākvāthaḥ palamātraṃ dravyam | payo mahiṣīpayaḥ tasya vātakartṛkatvāt na gopayaḥ, tasya pathyavarge likhitatvāt, roṣaṃ krodham, atinīraṃ bahujalaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat ||8-15 ||
pippalyādikalka ūrustambhe - pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ bhallātakaphalāni ca | etatkalkaśca sakṣaudra ūrustambhanivāraṇaḥ ||16 ||

Dī. idānīmūrustambhe kalkasvarūpaṃ yogamāha, eteṣāṃ kalka iti | etatkalkaḥ | pippalīpippalīmūle vikhyāte, bhallātakaphalānyatra nirasthīni yojyāni, kutrāpyeṣāṃ pippalyādīnāṃ kvātho'pi pracarati | tathāhi “pippalīṃ pippalīmūlaṃ bhallātakaśṛtaṃ pibet | kalko vā samadhurdeya ūrustambhavināśanaḥ” iti || 16 ||
Gū. sakṣaudraḥ madhusahitaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 16 ||
atha viṣṇukrāntākalkaḥ pariṇāmaśūle - viṣṇukrāntājaṭākalkaḥ sitākṣaudraghṛtairyutaḥ | pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ nāśayetsaptabhirdinaiḥ || 17 ||

Dī. pariṇāmaśūle'parājitākalkamāha - viṣṇukrānteti | viṣṇukrāntā aparājitā pratītā, śatāvarī vāasamīcīnamidaṃ viṣṇukrāntā bhinnā śatāvarī ca bhinnā| | sitādayo'pyatra pūrvaparimāṇena prakṣiptāḥ | saptadinairiti yogasyāsya dṛṣṭaphalatvaṃ darśayati | pariṇāmaśūlaṃ paktiśūlaṃ, tacca śūlaroge spaṣṭameva || 17 ||
Gū. viṣṇukrāntā aparājitā śvetapuṣpī vā nīlī vā tāṃ keciddhanvantarā āhuḥ, tasyā jaṭākalkaḥ sitādibhiryuktaḥ pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ nāśayet “anne jīryati yacchūlaṃ tadevaṃ pariṇāmajam” || 17 ||
aparamapi pariṇāmaśūlārthaṃ prayogamāha - śuṇṭhītilaguḍaiḥ kalko dugdhena saha yojayet | pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlamāmavātaṃ ca nāśayet || 18 ||

Dī. śuṇṭhīti | atrāsya kartavyavidhau śuṇṭhītilābhyāṃ kalkaḥ kāryaḥ | guḍamatra dvayoḥ santulitaṃ caturguṇena kṣīreṇa saha sādhayitvā bhakṣayediti bhāvaḥ | cakārādayamapi saptadinābhyantare dṛṣṭaphalaḥ | uktamanyatrādi “nāgaratilaguḍakalkaṃ payasā saṃsādhya yaḥ pumānadyāt | ugraṃ pariṇāmaśūlaṃ tasyāpaityapi ca saptarātreṇa” iti || 18 ||
Gū. atha śuṇṭhīkalkaḥ pariṇāmaśūle tathāmavāte | sugamam || 18 ||
athāpāmārgakalkaḥ raktārśasi - apāmārgasya bījānāṃ kalkastaṇḍulavāriṇā | pīto raktārśasāṃ nāśaṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ ||19||

Dī. atha raktārśasāṃ prayogaṃ darśayannāha - apāmārgasyeti | apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ | taṇḍulavāri taṇḍulakṣālanajalaṃ, tacca puṭapāke darśitaṃ, anena caturguṇenāpāmārgasya bījānāṃ kalka: peyaḥ, na tu tena mānena peṣitaḥ, peṣaṇārthaṃ tvaparimitaṃ jalam, etadeva yojyam | nāsti saṃśaya iti dṛṣṭaphalatvenāsya prabhāvātiśayo varṇitaḥ || 19 ||
Gū. taṇḍulajalena || 19 ||
atha badarīmūlakalkaḥ raktātīsāre - badarīmūlakalkena tilakalkaśca yojitaḥ | madhukṣārayutaḥ kuryādraktātīsāranāśanaḥ ||20||

Dī. idānīṃ raktātīsāre badarīmūlakalkamāha - badarīmūlakalkena tilakalkaśceti | kalkadvayagrahaṇena samaṃ melayitvā kalkaḥ kāryaḥ, ityasmadīyasampradāyastena dvayoḥ sāmyena karṣaikaṃ, peṣaṇārthaṃ jalamatrānuktatvāt | madhukṣārau coktaparimāṇena prakṣepe yojyau | kecinmadhukṣīrayuta iti paṭhanti | tatra kṣīraṃ chāgodbhavaṃ vyādhivihitatvāt | ayameva pakṣo vyāvahāriko dṛśyate | guṇenāpyuktam “ājaṃ śoṣajvare śvāsaraktapittātisārajit” iti || 20 ||
Gū. badarī laghuḥ tasyā jaṭā tatkalka: | kṣīraṃ gavyamājaṃ vā || 20 ||
raktakṣaye lākṣākalkaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakarasopetāṃ lākṣāṃ karṣadvayaṃ pibet | raktakṣayamuroghātaṃ kṣayarogaṃ ca nāśayet || 21 ||

Dī. atha raktapitte kūṣmāṇḍayogamāha - kūṣmāṇḍaka iti | kūṣmāṇḍakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya phalasvarasenaiva karṣamātrāṃ lākṣāṃ piṣṭvā tenaiva caturguṇena saha pibet | caturguṇatātra palamānaṃ eṣa vidhiḥ pānāditi vākye darśitaḥ | lākṣā'laktakasya jananī | atrāpi madhuprakṣepaṃ kurvanti vṛddhāḥ, kutaḥ ? pūrvānuyogāvṛteḥ || 21 ||
Gū. lākṣāyogaḥ raktakṣaye - lākṣāṃ pippalajāṃ badarijāṃ vā || 21 ||
atha taṇḍulīyakalkaḥ raktapradare - taṇḍulīyajaṭākalkaḥ sakṣaudraḥ sarasāñjanaḥ taṇḍulodakasaṃpīto raktapradaranāśanaḥ || 22 ||

Dī. raktapradare'pyāha - taṇḍulīyeti | taṇḍulīyaḥ śākaviśeṣaḥ ‘caurāi’ iti śabdavācyaḥ, tasya jaṭā mūlaṃ, kartavyatāsya taṇḍulīyajaṭā rasāñjanaṃ ca sāmyena karṣaparimitaṃ grāhyam | tadanu jalena saṃpiṣya madhuyuktaścaturguṇena taṇḍulajalena saha pātavyaḥ | taṇḍulajalaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam | rasāñjanaṃ svanāmakhyātam | tacca dārvīkvāthasamu- dbhavamiti prasiddham | raktapradaraḥ strīroge paṭhitaḥ ||22||
Gū. taṇḍulīyaḥcaurāī hi. bhā. | meghanādaḥ, tasya jaṭākalkaḥ sakṣaudraḥ, rasāñjanaṃrasota hi.bhā.| prasiddhaṃ, taṇḍulodakaṃ taṇḍulaprakṣālanajalaṃ, pradaraḥ yonyā raktādisrāvaḥ || 22 ||
athāṅkoṭakakalko'tīsārādau - aṅkoṭamūlakalkaśca sakṣaudrastaṇḍulāmbunā | atīsāraharaḥ proktastathā viṣaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 ||
vandhyākarkoṭikāmūlaṃ pāṭalāyā jaṭā'thavā | ghṛtena bilvamūlaṃ vā dvividhaṃ nāśayedviṣam ||24||

div.ab: Dī. atha viṣaharaṇārthaṃ yogavarānāha - aṅkoṭamūleti | aṅkoṭo vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya mūlam | kṣaudramatra prakṣepe sādhu | taṇḍulāmbuneti caturguṇena, caturguṇatā ca kalkadravyāt | viṣo'tra sthāvaraḥ | viṣanimittaṃ tu jalenaiva peya iti sampradāyaḥ | aparāṇyāha - bandhyeti | etadyogatrayaṃ ghṛtena saha peyam | viṣaṃ nāśayati iti, tacca dvividhaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamātmakam | kecidvandhyākarkoṭakīmūlakalkena nasyamāhuḥ | tathāhi - ‘vandhyākarkoṭakīmūlaṃ chāgīmūtreṇa bhāvitam | nasyaṃ kāñjikasaṃpiṣṭaṃ viṣopahatacetasaḥ’ iti | evaṃ bilvamūlamañjanārtham iti vadantyeke || 23 || 24 ||
Gū. aṃkoṭo bṛhattasya jaṭākalkaḥ mūlakalkaḥ, sthāvarajaṅgamaviṣam || 23 || 24 ||

ab.seg: athābhayādikalkaḥ pācanādau - abhayāsaindhavakaṇāśuṇṭhīkalkastridoṣahā | pathyāsaindhavaśuṇṭhībhiḥ kalko dīpanapācanaḥ ||25||

Dī. athaikena ślokena yogadvayamāha - abhayeti | abhayādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ samatulitānāṃ militvā karṣeṇa kalkastridoṣajidbhavati | abhayā harītakī, kaṇā pippalī | aparaḥ | pathyādibhirdravyaiḥ kalko dīpanapācano bhavati| atrāpi samatā dravyāṇāṃ, bhakṣaṇamānaṃ tu pūrvavat | dīpanamagneḥ, pācanamāmādīnām ||25||
Gū. abhayā harītakī, kaṇā pippalī || 25 ||

div.ab: atha trivṛtādikalkaḥ kṛmiroge - trivṛtpalāśabījāni pārasīkayamānikā | kampillakaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca guḍaśca samabhāgikam ||26|| takreṇa kalkameteṣāṃ pibet krimigaṇāpaham |

ab.seg: Dī. kṛmiroge kalkamāha - trivṛditi | trivṛdādīnāṃ saguḍānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ sāmānyena militānāṃ karṣapramāṇena kalkaṃ kṛtvā caturguṇena takreṇa sahāloḍya pibet | etacca kṛmisamūhānuddharatīti | trivṛt ni:sṛtā, palāśabījāni prasiddhāni | pārasīkayamāniketi pārasyadeśabhavā pārasī khurāsānīśabdavācyā, kampillakorecanakaḥ, loke ‘kavīlā’ śabdena vikhyātaḥ | ayaṃ yogaḥ koṣṭhagatakṛmināśanārthamuktaḥ | eke trivṛdādīnāṃ guḍaḥ sama iti vadanti tena guḍasyaiko bhāgaḥ śeṣadravyāṇāṃ bhāgaikamityarthaḥ | satyam | tanmate tu guḍaṃ prathamato bhakṣayitvā paścāttrivṛdādīnāṃ kalkaṃ takreṇa saha pibediti | tathāca tantrāntare prayogāntaramapi dṛśyate | tadyathā “pārasīkayamānī pītā paryuṣitavāriṇā prātaḥ | guḍapūrvā kṛmijālaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ pātayatyāśu || 26 ||

Gū. trivṛt niḥsṛtā‘niśotha’ hi. bhā. | , palāśabījānipalāśapāparā, hi. bhā. | prasiddhāni, pārasīkayamānikā‘khurāsānīajavāyana’ hi.bhā. | prasiddhā ‘ajavāyaṇi’ gurjaradeśe prasiddhā, kāmpillakaṃ‘kavīlā’ hi. bhā. | raktāṅgakaḥ, viḍaṅgaḥ krimighnaḥ | sugamamanyat || 26 ||

div.ab: raktārśasi tilakalkaḥ | navanītatilaiḥ kalko jetā raktārśasāṃ smṛtaḥ ||27|| navanītasitānāgakeśairaścāpi tadvidhaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha raktārśasāmapiyogadvayamāha navanīteti | atroktaparimāṇena tilakalko dviguṇitena navanītena saṃplāvya bhakṣyaḥ | asau raktārśasāṃ jetā kathita ityarthaḥ | raktārśasāmiti bahuvacanatvenānyeṣāmapyarśasāṃ praśastaḥ | aparo'pi navanītasitānāgakeśaraiśca yuktyā kalkastadvidho'yaṃ bhavati | tadvidha iti raktārśasāṃ hantā ityarthaḥ | navanītatyāgenāpi yogo'yaṃ pracarati | tena sitā śarkarā nāgakeśaraśca sāmyena māṣāṣṭakaṃ pratyahaṃ bhakṣyaṃ, prayogāt || 27 ||

div.ab: saṃgrahaṇyāṃ śuṇṭhīkalkaḥ | pīto masūrayūṣeṇa kalkaḥ śuṇṭhīśalāṭuja: ||28 || jayetsaṃgrahaṇīṃ tadvattakreṇa bṛhatībhavaḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kalkakalpanā nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha grahaṇyāṃ yogadvayaṃ darśayannāha - pīta iti | śuṇṭhīśalāṭujaḥ kalka uktaparimāṇena kṛtaścaturguṇena masūrayūṣeṇa saha pibet | śalāṭu bilvaphalaṃ, masūrayūṣavidhistu kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kathita eva | aparo'pi bṛhatībhavo bṛhatkaṃṭakārikāmūlakalka iti nāmnā prathitaḥ | atrāpi caturguṇaṃ takraṃ kalkājjñātavyam | tadvaditi grahaṇīnāśakaraḥ || 28 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kalkakalpanādhyāyaḥ pañcamaḥ || 5 ||

div.ab: Gū. grahaṇyāṃ masūrakalkaḥ, masūrayūṣeṇa masūramaṇḍena pīta: śuṇṭhīlāṭujaḥ kalkaḥ saṃgrahaṇīṃ jayet | tadvattakreṇa bṛhatībhava: bṛhatkaṇṭakārīphalakalka: ‘āme phale śalāṭu: syādi’tyamara: | apakva ityartha:| sugamam ||28|| iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kalkakalpanādhyāya: ||

div.head: atha cūrṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | atyantaśuṣkaṃ yaddravyaṃ supiṣṭaṃ vastragālitam | tatsyāccūrṇaṃ rajaḥ kṣodastanmātrā karṣasaṃmitā || 1 ||

Dī. idānīṃ cūrṇakalpanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | prathamatastatsvarūpamāha - atyantaśuṣkamiti | sūryāṃśubhiḥ śoṣitadravāṃśaṃ yaddravyamiti | puṣpaphalapatratvaṅmūlaniryāsādisaṃjñam | supiṣṭamityādi supiṣṭamityatiśayena cūrṇitaṃ śilāyāmiti śeṣaḥ | vastragālitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, tattu cūrṇaṃ rajaḥ kṣoda iti paryāyanāmabhyāṃ saṃjñitam | tanmātreti bhakṣaṇārthaṃ mānaṃ karṣasaṃmitaṃ jñeyamityanuktaprayogeṣu || 1 ||

Gū. atha cūrṇakalpanā | yadatyantaśuṣkaṃ dravyaṃ cūrṇauṣadhaṃ saṃpiṣṭaṃ vastragālitaṃ vastrapūtaṃ taccūrṇaṃ syāttadeva rajaḥ kṣoda ityādīni cūrṇanāmāni bhavanti | tanmātrā bhakṣaṇamātrā karṣasaṃmitā balavāṃścet, alpabale ekaṭaṅkādvardhitavyā | cūrṇādīnāmanupānakam || 1 ||
cūrṇe guḍādimānakalpanā | idānīmaviśeṣokteṣu śarkarāguḍayormānapūrvakaṃ prakṣepavidhimāha - cūrṇe guḍaḥ samo deyaḥ śarkarā dviguṇā bhavet | cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛdbhavet ||2||
liheccūrṇaṃ dravaiḥ sarvairghṛtādyairdviguṇonmitaiḥ | pibeccaturguṇaireva cūrṇamāloḍitaṃ dravaiḥ ||3||

div.ab: Dī. cūrṇa iti | guḍasāmyaṃ cūrṇāṃśāt, śarkarāpi dviguṇitā cūrṇaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | cūrṇeṣviti bahuvacanatvena guṭikālehādiṣvapi bhājataṃ hiṅgu boddhavyam | sarvairityato ghṛtādyairiti yat punargrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tattoyakṣīramadyamūtrādīnāṃ vyavacchedārtham | yata etaiḥ saha cūrṇasya pānamuktametasyāgre, lehastu madhughṛtatailadīnāṃ praśastaḥ | pibedityādicaturguṇitātra cūrṇabhāgāt, dravairiti toyakṣīramadyamūtrādibhiḥ ||2||3||

ab.seg: atha cūrṇādīnāmanupānamātrāṃ darśayannāha - cūrṇāvalehaguṭikākalkānāmanupānakam | vātapittakaphātaṅke tridvyekapalamāharet || 4 ||
yathā tailaṃ jale kṣiptaṃ kṣaṇenaiva prasarpati | anupānabalādaṅge tathā sarpati bheṣajam || 5 ||

div.ab: Dī. cūrṇāvaleheti | anupānamiti anu paścāt pānam | auṣadhabhakṣaṇopari yatpītaṃ tadanupānamityarthaḥ | “vātapittakaphātaṅke tridvyekapalamāharet” ityanukramo jñeyaḥ | ātaṅko rogaḥ tena vātātaṅke tripalaṃ, pittātaṅke dvipalaṃ, kaphātaṅke palaikamiti tātparyārthaḥ | anukteṣvanupāneṣu jalānupānaṃ praśastam | tathāhi - ‘sarveṣāmanupānaṃ syānmāhendraṃ toyamuttamam’ iti | suśrute'pi - “sarvānupāneṣu varaṃ vadanti medhyaṃ yadantaḥśucibhājanastham | lokasya janmaprabhṛtipraśastaṃ toyātmakāḥ sarvarasāḥ pradiṣṭāḥ” iti | athānupānasya prayojanaṃ nirdeṣṭumāha - yatheti | bhiṣajā saṃskṛtaṃ dravyaṃ tathā aṅgeṣu prasarpati, kutaḥ ? anupānabalādanupānaśaktitaḥ | yatheti dṛṣṭāntamāha - tailamityādi sugamam || 4 || 5 ||
Gū. pittakaphātaṅke pittādīnāṃ tridvyekapalaṃ haret pitte tripalaṃ, vāte dvipalaṃ, kapha ekapalaṃ | draveṇa nimbādidraveṇa || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg: atha cūrṇārthaṃ bhāvanāparimāṇamāha - draveṇa yāvatā samyakcūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ plutaṃ bhavet | bhāvanāyāḥ pramāṇaṃ tu cūrṇe proktaṃ bhiṣagvarai: || 6 ||

Dī. draveṇeti | sāmānyena sarvaṃ toyādikam | anyadapi yaddravīkṛtaṃ tadapi grāhyaṃ na doṣaḥ | plutamiti plāvitaṃ, yathā manthasvarasasvarūpaṃ tadvaditi bhiṣagvarairityanena yuktyā kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ || 6 ||
Gū. yāvatplutaṃ vyāptaṃ bhavet tadbhāvanāpramāṇam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 6 ||

div.ab: athāmalakyādicūrṇaṃ jvarādau - āmalaṃ citrakaṃ pathyā pippalī saindhavastathā | cūrṇito'yaṃ gaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvajvaravināśanaḥ || 7 || bhedī rucikaraḥ śleṣmajetā dīpanapācanaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. sa yathetyanena cūrṇāni darśayati granthakāraḥ | āmalamiti āmalādiko'yaṃ gaṇaḥ sarvajvaravināśano bhavati | āmalamityāmalakaphalaṃ, pathyā harītakī, etat sakalaṃ sāmyamanuktatvāt | sarvajvaramityaṣṭavidhaṃ vyavahāratastu viṣamajvareṣu prāyaśaḥ pracarati | bhedī rucikaraḥ ityādipadadvayaṃ kecit paṭhanti || 7 ||
Gū. āmalakaṃ,pathyā harītakī, śeṣaṃ sugamam ||7||

div.ab: atha pippalīcūrṇaṃ jvare - madhunā pippalīcūrṇaṃ lihetkāsajvarāpaham || 8 || hikkāśvāsaharaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ plīhaghnaṃ bālakocitam |

ab.seg: Dī. madhunā iti | ayaṃ madhupippalīyogaḥ kāsajvarādīn hanti | viśeṣeṇa bālānāmucitaḥ | bālaketi sāmānyena traividhyaṃ sūcayati | tadyathā āṣoḍaśādbālaḥ sa trividhaḥ kṣīrapaḥ, kṣīrānnādaḥ, annāda iti ||8||
Gū. pippalīcūrṇaṃ māṣamātraṃ madhunā lihet na tu karṣamātraṃ tīkṣṇadravyatvāt || 8 ||
mehādikeṣu triphalācūrṇam - ekā harītakī yojyā dvau ca yojyau bibhītikau ||9 ||
catvāryāmalakānyevaṃ triphalaiṣāṃ prakīrtitā | triphalā mehaśothaghnī nāśayedviṣamajvarān || 10 ||
dīpanī śleṣmapittaghnī kuṣṭhahantrī rasāyanī | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ saṃyuktā saiva netrāmayāñjayet || 11 ||

Dī. atha triphalācūrṇamāha - eketi | uktaparimāṇena mehādikān hantīti | yadā saiva triphalā sarpi- rmadhubhyāmavalehitā tadā netrāmayān jayediti | avalehastu sāyamupayojyaḥ | tathāhyuktam ‘ūrdhvajatrugarogaghnī sāyaṃ syādavalehikā’iti | kīdṛśamuktaparimāṇaṃ tadāha - ekā harītakītyādi | etadgaṇanāparimāṇaṃ triphalāyāḥ kathitaṃ na tu tulanāyāṃ viṣamamānaṃ, yataḥ guṇakasaṃkhyāmānenaiva samatvamasyāḥ, kutaḥ ? dvikārṣikī harītakīti vākyānurodhāt | tathāhi - ‘navādiguṇasampannaṃ tathaikatvaṃ dvikarṣatā | harītakyāḥ phale yatra trayaṃ tat śreṣṭhamucyate’ iti | navādiguṇo'pi prasaṅgato likhyate | yathā “navā snigdhā ghanā vṛttā gurvī kṣiptā tathā'mbhasi | nimajjedyā praśastatvādguṇakṛt sā prakīrtitā” iti | vibhītakamapi karṣākṣaparyāyanāmabhyāṃ kathitamiti prasiddhiḥ | uktaṃ nighaṇṭau ‘vibhītakaḥ karṣaphalo vāsanto'kṣaḥ kalidrumaḥ’ iti tena dve bibhītakaphale kathite | āmalamapi kolasaṃjñaṃ vadanti, kolastvardhakarṣasya paryāyanāmeti | tena catvāryāmalakāni bhavanti | etena triphalāyāstulanā sāmyamapi darśitam | gaṇanāyāṃ ca viṣamatvamiti, na tu tasyā bhāgeṣu viṣamatā, yato dṛśyate hi vṛddhavaidyānāṃ vyavahāro'yameva | yadyapi triphalā dvitīyāpyasti tathāpi sarvatraivāviśeṣoktau triphalāśabdena harītakyādikameva gṛhyate | yaduktam “drākṣākāśmaryakharjūraphalānīti phalatrikā | iyaṃ proktā ca dvitīyā triphalā carakādibhiḥ” iti || 9-11 ||

Gū. ekā harītakī, dvau bibhītakau, catvāri āmalakānyevaṃ triphalā syāt | anye tvevamāhuḥ ekā ekabhāgā haratikī, dvau vibhāgau vibhītakaṃ, āmalakaṃ catvāri bhāgāni, tathāca vacanaṃ - ‘bhāgamekaṃ harītakyā dvaubhāgau ca vibhītakāt | āmalakyāstrayo bhāgāḥ sahaikatra prayojayet’ iti | anye suśrutavāgbhaṭādayo bhāgapramāṇaṃ necchanti | tathāca ‘harītakī cāmalakaṃ bibhītakādibhistrayam| triphaleyaṃ smṛtā sadbhirāyurvedaviśāradaiḥ’iti | māne'nukte sāmyaṃ syādityukte: samabhāgā triphalā'tra suśrutādimate kecidbhāgamāhuḥ | ataḥ akṣadvayaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhūnimbo dṛśyate, śārṅgadhareṇa yuktabhāgavṛdvyā triphalā likhitā kevalaṃ triphalācūrṇakvāthaviṣayānupānaguṇaviṣayāṇyanyathā navāyasacūrṇādau virodhaḥ syāt, yataḥ kevalatriphalākvāthe cūrṇe ca bhāgavṛddhiḥ dṛśyate | tathāca “pathyāstisro bibhītakyaḥ ṣaḍ dhātryo dvādaśeti ca | prasthārdhasalile kvāthamaṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣita”miti, netraroge ekā harītakyādicūrṇamātraiva ato na virodhaḥ | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ netrabhayahāri sarpirghṛtaṃ madhu ca ato dvayam, atulyaṃ gṛhyate tulyayormadhusarpiṣorviruddhatvāt | atha ca anyairlikhitaṃ havirmadhubhyāṃ samābhyāmiti triphalāprayoge likhitam | iti triphalācūrṇam || 1-11 ||

div.ab: atha tryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ dīpanādau - pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī tribhistryūṣaṇamucyate | dīpanaṃ śleṣmamedoghnaṃ kuṣṭhapīnasanāśanam || 12 || jayedarocakaṃ sāmaṃ mehagulmagalāmayān|

ab.seg: Dī. atha tryūṣaṇacūrṇamāha - pippalīti | idamapi trikaṭukaparyāyanāmnā kathitaṃ, trayāṇāṃ sāmyamityanuktatvāt | sāmamityarocakaṃ doṣaṃ vā | mehagulmagalāmayāniti mehāmayān gulmāmayān galāmayān || 12 ||
Gū. sugamam || 12 ||
atha pañcakolamarucyādau - pippalīcavyaviśvāhnāpippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 13 ||
pañjakolamiti khyātaṃ rucyaṃ dīpanapācanam | ānāhaplīhagulmaghnaṃ śūlaśleṣmodarāpaham || 14 ||

div.ab: Dī. pañcakolamapyāha - pippalīti | atra cavyaṃ gajapippalīmūlaṃ, viśvāhvā śuṇṭhī, pippalīmūlaṃ pippalījaṭā, citrakaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ | atrāpi pañcānāṃ samatvam | rucyaṃ rucikaraṃ, dīpanamagneḥ, pācanamāmādīnām, ānāha udarāpūraḥ | (ūṣakādigaṇaḥnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | -‘ūṣakaṃūṣa: kṣāramṛttikā | saindhavaṃ hiṅgu kāśīsadvayagugguluḥ | śilājatu tutthakaṃ ca ūṣakādirudāhṛtaḥ | ūṣakādiḥ kaphaṃ hanti gaṇo medoviśodhanaḥ | aśmarīśarkarāmūtraśūlaghnaḥ kaphagulmanut’ iti | ayamapi pāṭhaḥ kvacit) || 13 || 14 ||
Gū. sugamam || 13 || 14 ||
idānīṃ trigandhacāturjātakacūrṇamāha - trigandhamelātvakpatraiścaturjātaṃ sakeśaraiḥ | trigandhaṃ sacaturjātaṃ rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghu pittakṛt ||15|| varṇyaṃ rucikaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaśleṣmāmayāñjayet |

ab.seg: Dī. trigandhamiti | elātvakpatraiḥ kṛtvā trigandhaṃ kathitaṃ, cāturjātaṃ tu sakeśarairelātvakpatraireva proktam, elā sūkṣmailā, tvak guḍatvak, patraṃ patrakaṃ, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaram | rūkṣoṣṇamiti vīryataḥ laghupākitvāt | varṇyaṃ kāntikaram| tīkṣṇaṃ marīcādivat || 15 ||
Gū. atha trisugandham | elā tvakpatrajam‘tejapatra’ hi.bhā. etaistribhistrigandhamucyate | caturjātakaṃ sakeśarairetaiścaturjātaṃ keśaram | spaṣṭamanyat || 15 ||

div.ab: atha jīvanīyagaṇaḥ - kākolī kṣīrakākolī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||16|| medā cānyā mahāmedā jīvantī madhukaṃ tathā | mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī jīvanīyo gaṇastvayam || 17 || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ svādurgarbhasaṃdhānakṛdguruḥ | stanyakṛdbṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ snigdhaḥ śītastṛṣāpahaḥ ||18|| raktapittaṃ kṣayaṃ śoṣaṃ jvaradāhanilāñjayet |

ab.seg: Dī. jīvanīyagaṇamāha - kākolītyādi | atra jīvanīyagaṇe kākolī kṣīrakākolī ca svanāmataḥ prasiddhā | kiñcidanayorjñāpanārthaṃ lakṣaṇamapyāha tadyathā - kākolī madhurā carvaṇataḥ kṣīraprāyā varṇataḥ śuklā ca | kṣīrakālolī atyantakṣīrayuktā | etaddvayaṃ viṭapaviśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇottaretīva prasiddham | jīvakarṣabhakāviti | jīvakaśca ṛṣabhakaścaitau, jīvako madhurarasaḥ hrasvaviṭapaḥ kūrcaśīrṣakaḥ, ṛṣabhako'pi hrasvavṛkṣaḥ sahasrachidro viṣāṇīti | tatheti grahaṇena etaddvayamapi dakṣiṇadeśe pracarati medā cānyā mahāmedā iti medā svalpaparṇī | medagandholpavṛkṣasaṃjñakaḥvṛkṣeti bhramamātram kandasvarūpeṇānyatra pratipādanāt | mede kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakāviti rājñāmapi durlabhāḥ, uttarāpathe tvasandigdha eva | , sa ca kāṣṭhaviśeṣo nakhacchedyo deśāntarādavagantavyaḥ | mahāmedā'ṣṭacchidrānvitā kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, sa ca dakṣiṇottarapathe parvateṣu prasiddhaḥ | tatra devamaṇiriti prasiddhaḥ | jīvantī śākaviśeṣaḥ | sā cottarāpathe parvateṣu, vandā vṛkṣaśākhāsu tatraivotpadyate | madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭīti jalajātā vallīviśeṣaḥ, madhurā bhakṣaṇataśca, asau vikhyātā sarvatraiva, mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī ceti dravyayugmaṃ nijanāmnā prasiddham | mudgavatparṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā mudgaparṇī | evaṃ māṣaparṇīti sāpi kṣudrā vanasambhavā | mārjāramodinīti māṣaparṇī ca kṛṣṇanālā hayapucchikākārā parvatodbhavāparvatetyupalakṣaṇam tena samabhūmāvapyudbhavati madhurā ca | ebhirayaṃ jīvanīyagaṇasaṃjñaḥ svādurmadhurarasaḥ | garbhasandhānakṛditi vandhyāgarbhakaraḥ prabhāvāt, stanyakṛditi kṣīravṛddhikaraḥ, bṛṃhaṇo dhātuvṛddhikaraḥ, vṛṣyaḥ śukravṛddhikaraḥ || || 16-18 ||

Gū. ayaṃ jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kāśmīrādau prasiddhaḥ | kākolyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇamāha granthāntarāt - ”pīvarīsannibhaḥ kandaḥ śuṣkasāraṃ sugandhikam | kākolī kṣīrakākolī ardhordhaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet || īṣacchuklā tu kākolī kṣīravatpāṇḍurā parā | jīvakarṣabhakau śvetau hemādriśikharodbhavau || jīvakaḥ kūrcikākāra ṛṣabho vṛṣaśṛṅgavat || śuṣkārdrakanibhaṃ kandaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraśītalam | mahāmedeti vikhyātā durgandho bheda ucyate” || jīvantī doḍīśākaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, mudgaparṇī mugonī, māṣaparṇī māṣonī || 16-18 ||
athāṣṭakavargaḥ - dve mede dve ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||19||
ṛddhivṛddhī ca taiḥ sarvairaṣṭavarga udāhṛtaḥ | aṣṭavargo budhaiḥ prokto jīvanīyasamo guṇaiḥ ||20||

div.ab: Dī. athāṣṭavargamapyāha - dve mede iti| asau guṇaiḥ kṛtvā jīvanīyagaṇasāmya: sa cāṣṭabhirdravyairmilitaḥ | tadyathā - “dve mede dve ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā |” dvau ca ṛddhivṛddhī ca dve, atra ṛddhivṛddhī tu nāmnā prasiddhe | tayościhnamiti yasya gṛhe ṛddhivṛddhī staḥ tasya vasuvṛddhirbhavatīti prasiddhiḥ | ayaṃ ca suśrutagaṇasaṃgrahe jīvanīyāṣṭakasaṃjñaḥ | carakayoge tat pūrvoktaṃ jīvanīyadaśakamiti || 19 || 20 ||

Gū. dve mede medā, mahāmedā, dve kākolyau, kākolī kṣīrakākolī, jīvakaṛṣabhakau etau dvau eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jīvanīyagaṇa uktam | ṛddhivṛddhilakṣaṇamāha - ‘śvetalomānvitaṃ kandaṃ latājātaṃ sachidrakam | ṛddhirvṛddhiḥ sā vijñeyā vikhyātā koṣayāmale | bhūmigranthisamā ṛddhirvāmavartaphalaṃ tathā | vṛddhistu dakṣiṇāvartā phalālakṣyākuyā kṛtā| eṣāmabhāve auṣadhāntaramāhaaṣṭavargapratinidhiḥ - medāmahāmedā'bhāve śatāvarī, jīvakarṣabhakābhāve bhūtikūṣmāṇḍamūlaṃ, kākolīdvayābhāve aśvagandhā, ṛddhivṛddhyabhāve ca vārāhīkanda (bhā. mū. bha 1) ‘medā'bhāve aśvagandhā, mahāmede ca śārivā | jīvakarṣabhakābhāve guḍūcī vaṃśalocanā || ṛddhyabhāve balā deyā vṛddhyabhāve mahābalā ityapi matāntaram || - “medo jīvaśca kākolī ṛddhirdvandve'pi cā'sati | yaṣṭī vidāryaśvagandhā vārāhaśca kramātkṣipet || vārāhyāśca tathā'bhāve carmakārākulāmatā | vārāhīkanda evātra carmakārāluko mataḥ || anūpe sa bhaveddeśe vārāha iva lomavān | vārāhīkandasaṃjñastu paścime gṛṣṭisaṃjñaka” ayam aṣṭakavargo guṇairjīrvanīyasamaḥ stanyagarbhasandhānādikārakaḥ ||19||20||

ab.seg: atha lavaṇapañcakaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādau - sindhu sauvarcalaṃ caiva biḍaṃ sāmudrikaṃ gaḍam | ekadvitricatuṣpañcalavaṇāni kramādviduḥ || 21 ||
teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syādanukte tatprayojayet | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ jñeyaṃ lavaṇapañcakam || 22 ||
madhuraṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ balāpaham| vīryoṣṇaṃ dīpanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaphapittavivardhanam || 23 ||
