Dī. lavaṇapañcakamāha - sindhviti | ayaṃ lavaṇapañcakasaṃjñako gaṇaḥ sindhu saindhavaṃ tacca sindhūdbhavamityarthaḥ | sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham | tadeva nirgandhaṃ kācalavaṇamityucyate | biḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ, tacca prasāraṇīṃ kalkamuktalavaṇasaṃyogādagnidāhena nirvṛtaṃ biḍamiti khyātam | sāmudrikamiti dakṣiṇasamudrasamīpe bhavaṃ sāmudrikaṃ, tacca gaḍalavaṇākāraṃ vimalataraṃ jñeyam | gaḍaṃ tacca romakaṃ, tacca śākambharīdeśotpannam | ekadvitricatuḥpañceti lavaṇakramo vyastasamastagrahaṇārthaṃ sūcita: yathā “dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam” ityādivacanāt | trilavaṇaṃ saindhavasauvarcalaviḍamityarthaḥ | evamanyadapi bodhyam | teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syādityanenānuktameṣu mukhyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tacca saindhavaṃ yojyamiti bhāvaḥ | ( nanunāsti ’kha pustake | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ lavaṇapañcakasaṃjñaṃ punaḥ kimarthaṃ kṛtam | ucyate - ādau saindhavamante romakasya ca grahaṇaṃ tantrāntare'pi niyataṃ madhye kvacidviparītamiti | tathāca suśrute “saindhavasāmudrabiḍasauvarcalaromakāṇi pañca mukhyāni” iti matadvayābhiprāyeṇa punargrahaṇaṃ na doṣaḥ | pūrvamataṃ tu carake pratītam | madhuraṃ paripākāt, suśrute tu yathāpūrvaṃ svādūni | svāduratra guṇaḥ | yataḥ raseṣu guṇasaṃjñā iti kecit | apare tu lavaṇeṣu madhuratvamanurasajñakamāmananti | sṛṣṭaviṇmūtramiti sraṃsakaṃ, sūkṣmamiti romakūpādipraveśakatvāt, tīkṣṇaṃ marīcādivat || 21-23 ||

Gū. sindhu saindhavaṃ, sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham, biḍalavaṇaṃ kācalavaṇamāhuḥ | sāmudraṃ samudralavaṇaṃ gaḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ kṣāralavaṇaṃ tadevametāni ekadvitricatuṣpañcalavaṇāni kramādevaṃ vidurṛṣaya iti śeṣaḥ | ekādikathanaṃ tu eka- dvitricatuḥpañcalavaṇādikṣepaṇārtham | cūrṇādau teṣu saindhavaṃ mukhyaṃ tadanukte'pi kṣipet | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ jñeyaṃ lavaṇapañcakamiti punaḥ pañcalavaṇābhidhānaṃ rogādau pañcalavaṇabhakṣaṇārthametaduktam | madhuraṃ madhurapākaḥ na tu | madhurarasaḥ | yataḥ miṣṭaḥ madhuramiti pākakrame likhitaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ pravartanaśīlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ srotaḥpraveśi kaphavardhanaṃ madhurapākāt pittavardhanaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇatvāt || 21-23 ||
atha kṣārayogaṃ darśayannāha - svarjikā yāvaśūkaśca kṣārayugmamudāhṛtam | jñeyau vahnisamau kṣārau svarjikāyāvaśūkajau || 24||
kṣārāścānye'pi gulmārśograhaṇīrukchidaḥ sarāḥ | pācanāḥ kṛmipuṃstvaghnāḥ śarkarāśmarināśanāḥ ||25||

div.ab: Dī. svarjiketi | tatra svarjikā prasiddhā, ‘sājī’ śabdavācyā | yāvaśūko yavakṣāraḥ | vahnisamau uṣṇavīryatamau | yāvaśūkaśceti cakārāṭṭaṅkaṇakṣāramapi kṣāratritayagrahaṇena yojyam | yathā ‘kṣāratrīṇi rasendraśuddhamamṛtam’ ityādivacanāt | anye kṣārāśceti | anye muṣkakapāṭalāpāmārgagojihvikākadalīsudhāprabhṛtayaḥ | gulmārśo grahaṇīrukchidā iti | atra rukśabdo gulmādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate | tena gulmaruk arśorukgrahaṇīrugiti | sarāḥ sraṃsakāḥ, kṛmighnāḥ puṃstvaghnāśca pustvaṃ vīryam || 24 || 25 ||

Gū. atha kṣārakathanam | svarjikā sarjīkṣāraḥ, yāvaśūko yavakṣāraḥ etau dvau kṣārau svarjikā yāvaśūkajau vahnisamau agnitulyau | anye ṭaṅkaṇena saha kṣāratrayamāhuḥ | anye'pi arkasehuṇḍacitrasaubhāñjanamūlakadalyapāmārgādijāste gulmādichidaḥ te kṣārakarmaṇi cūrṇādau ca yojanīyāḥ || 24 || 25 ||

ab.seg: sudarśanacūrṇam triphalā rajanīyugmaṃ kaṇṭakārīyugaṃ śaṭhī | trikaṭu granthikaṃ mūrvā guḍūcī dhanvayāsakaḥ || 26 ||
kaṭukā parpaṭo mustaṃ trāyamāṇā ca vālakam | nimba: puṣkaramūlaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭī ca vatsakam || 27 ||
yamānīndrayavo bhārṅgī śigrubījaṃ surāṣṭrakam | vacā tvakpadmakośīraṃ candanātiviṣābalāḥ || 28 ||
śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī viḍaṅgaṃ tagaraṃ tathā | citrako devadāruśca cavyaṃ patraṃ paṭolajam || 29 ||
jīvakarṣabhakau caiva lavaṅgaṃ vaṃśalocanā | puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kākolī patrakaṃ jātipatrakam || 30 ||
tālīsapatraṃ ca tathā samabhāgāni cūrṇayet | sarvacūrṇasya cārdhāṃśaṃ kairātaṃ nikṣipetsudhīḥ || 31 ||
etatsudarśanaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ doṣatrayāpaham | jvarāṃśca nikhilānhanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||32||
pṛthagdvandvāgantujāṃśca dhātusthānviṣamajvarān | saṃnipātodbhavāṃścāpi mānasānapi nāśayet || 33 ||
śītajvaraikāhikādīnmohaṃ tandrāṃ bhramaṃ tṛṣām | śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ ca hṛdrogaṃ hanti kāmalām||34||
trikapṛṣṭhakaṭījānupārśvaśūlanivāraṇam | śītāmbunā pibeddhīmānsarvajvaranivṛttaye ||35||
sudarśanaṃ yathā cakraṃ dānavānāṃ vināśanam | tadvajjvarāṇāṃ sarveṣāmidaṃ cūrṇaṃ praṇāśanam ||36||

Dī. idānīṃ sudarśanacūrṇaṃ nidarśayannāha - triphaleti | rajanīyugmamiti haridrādvayam | kaṇṭakārīyugamiti laghukaṇṭakārī bṛhatkaṇṭakārī ca | śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, trāyamaṇā svanāmakhyātā | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, śigrubījaṃ śobhāñjanaṃ, śvetamaricamiti prasiddham | surāṣṭrakaṃ mṛttikāviśeṣaḥ | phaṭakarīti loke | kecit surāṣṭrakamityasya sthāne śvadaṃṣṭrakamiti paṭhanti | tatra śvadaṃṣṭrako gokṣuraḥ, tvak varāṅgaja iti loke | candanaṃ śvetaṃ, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, śāliparṇī, pṛṣṭhaparṇī kavaradvayaśabdavācyam | tagaraṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ paṭolapatraṃ, jīvakarṣabhakau nijanāmnā prasiddhau, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ, tālīsapatraṃ prasiddhaṃ, bhūmyāmalakī āmalīviṭapaviśeṣaḥ śeṣaṃ subodham | etat sakalaṃ śāṇamātraṃ gṛhītvā cūrṇaṃ kartavyam | kairāto bhūnimbaḥ, tacca samastacūrṇasya dvau bhāgau kairātacūrṇasya caiko bhāga iti | kecit sarvacūrṇasya cārdhāṃśamityanena sarvacūrṇasyaiko bhāgaḥ bhūnimbasya bhāgaika iti vyākhyānayanti | aparaṃ tu ardhāṃśamityanenārdhasya aṃśaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ tena samamiti vyākhyānayanti ca | aṃśaścaturthāṃśa iti prasiddhaḥ | etenāṣṭamāṃśaṃ kairātamityarthaḥ | etadvyākhyānadvayamasaṅgatam | kutaḥ ? sarvajanāsammatatvāt doṣatrayāpahamiti prakupitadoṣatrayaṃ, vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā | nikhilānityaṣṭadhā | nanu pṛthag dvandvāgantujāṃśceti yat punargrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadvyarthaṃ akhilānityanenaiva labhyate ? ucyate paunaruktyaṃ tu jvarāṇāṃ yat tadasya jvaranāśanatve viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | ata eva nātra kāpi vicāraṇeti grahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, tadvā sarvajvareṣvayaṃ prāyaśaḥ pracarati nānyeṣu | tena punarjvaragrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ na doṣaḥ | aikāhikādīniti | ādiśabdāt tṛtīyakacāturthakādayaḥ | śūlaśabdastrikādikaṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyate | tatra trikaṃ vātasthānam | yathā sudarśanaṃ viṣṇucakraṃ dānavavināśanaṃ bhavati, tathā sarvajvarāṇāmayamapi nāśanaḥ, tasmātsudarśana iti saṃjñā ||26-36 ||

Gū. atha jvare sudarśanacūrṇam | triphalā harītakyāmalakavibhītakānīti auṣadhatrayaṃ, pratyekabhāgamekaṃ trayāṇāṃ phalānāṃ samāhārastriphaleti uktatvāt | rajanīyugmaṃ haridrā dāruharidreti dvayaṃ pratyekabhāgamekaṃ, kaṇṭakārīyugmaṃ bṛhatīdvayaṃ, pratyekaṃ bhāgamekaṃ, saṭhī karcūraḥ, trikaṭu śuṇṭhī maricaṃ pippalī pratyekabhāgaṃ, granthiḥ pippalīmūlaṃ, mūrvā‘moraharī’ hi.bhā.| moraṭā, gaḍūcī amṛtā, dhanvayāsakaṃ yavāsā, kaṭukī prasiddhā, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, mustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, trāyamāṇā prasiddhā, bālakam udīcyaṃ, nimbaḥ nimbatvak, puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, madhuyaṣṭī madhukaṃ, vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, yavānī ajamodā, indrayavaḥ kuṭajabījaṃ, bhāraṅgī śigrubījaṃ, śobhāñjanaṃ tasya bījaṃ, surāṣṭrajā sphaṭikā vā vacā, tvak taja, padmakāṣṭhaṃ, uśīraṃ, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, ativiṣāatīsa| prasiddhā, balā prasiddhā, śāliparṇī śālipatrī, pṛṣṭhaparṇī sañjīvanī, viḍaṅgaṃ, tagaraṃ, citrakaṃ, devadāru, cavyaṃ, paṭolapatraṃ paṭolajaṃ, jīvakarṣabhakāvaṣṭavargoktau, tadabhāve lavaṅgavaṃśalocanau, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalam | kākolī aṣṭavargoktā tadabhāve patrajaṃ, jātipatraṃ tālīsapatram, etāni samabhāgāni sarvacūrṇasyārdhabhāgaṃ kairātaṃ bhūnimbaṃ etatsudarśanaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ doṣatrayādināśakaṃ tathā nānāvidhān jvarānhanyāt | sugamamanyat || 26-36 ||
atha jvare pippalīcūrṇam | kāsaśvāsajvaraharī triphalā pippalīyutā | cūrṇitā madhunā līḍhā bhedinī cāgnibodhinī||37||
Dī. athāparāṇi cūrṇānyāha - kāseti | atra triphalā samatulitā grāhyā | pippalīyuteti | pippalī ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, madhvatrāvalehayogyaṃ cūrṇamānaṃ tu doṣabalāpekṣayā || 37 ||

Gū. triphalā harītakyāmalakavibhītakāni bhāgatrayaṃ, pippalībhāgaikā evaṃbhūtā cūrṇitā madhunāloḍya triphalā kāsaśvāsajvaraharā bhavati | yadvā bhāgavṛddhyā triphalā, ekā harītakī, dvau vibhītakau, catvāri āmalakāni evaṃbhūtā triphalā pippalīyutā pippalī triphalātulyā kāsādijvaraharā bhavati | kevalatriphalācūrṇasya bhāgavṛddhirna bahuguṇayuktatvāt || 37 ||
kaṭphalaṃ mustakaṃ tiktā śaṭhī śṛṅgī ca pauṣkaram | cūrṇameṣāṃ ca madhunā śṛṅgaberarasena vā || 38 ||
lehyaṃ jvaraharaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ kāsaśvāsārucīrjayet | vāyuśūlaṃ tathā chardiṃ kṣayaṃ caiva vyapohati || 39 ||

div.ab: Dī. kaṭphalamiti | ayaṃ kaṭphalādisaṃjñakaścūrṇagaṇaḥ | tatra tiktā kaṭurohiṇī, śṛṃgī karkaṭākhyā, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlam | tadabhāve kuṣṭhaṃ grāhyam | śṛṅgaberaraseneti ārdrakarasena caturguṇena saha pānamuktaṃ vyavahārānna tu lehyam | lehamasya madhunā dviguṇenetyarthaḥ | vāyuśūlamiti grahaṇaṃ vātajanitaśūlam | eke vāyuśūlamiti paṭhanti tatra gudāgatavātapīḍāmityarthaḥ | nanu vātādeva sakalaśūlasyopapattiriti, yataḥ ‘na vātena vinā śūlam’ ityādivacanaṃ, tat kathamatra pṛthag vātaśūlagrahaṇam ? ucyate vāyuśūlaṃ vātaprāyaṃ śūlaṃ na pittakaphādiprāyaṃ, yasmāt ‘śūlānyaṣṭau budhā jaguḥ’ iti || 38 || 39 ||

Gū. atha kaṭphalādicūrṇaṃ jvarādau - kaṭphalaṃ kāphalaṃ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, mustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, tiktā kaṭukī, saṭhī karcūra:, śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhunā śṛṃgaberamārdrakaṃ tadrasena ca lihejvparaharaṃ syāt || 38 || 39 ||

ab.seg: atha bṛhatkaṭphalādicūrṇa - kaṭphalaṃbīpikāyāṃ nā'sti| pauṣkaraṃ śṛṅgī mustā trikaṭukaṃ śaṭhī | samastānyekaśo vāpi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||40||
ārdrakasvarasakṣaudrairlihyātkaphavināśanam | śūlānilārucicchardikāsaśvāsakṣayāpaham || 41 ||
kaṭphalaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kṛṣṇā śṛṅgī ca madhunā saha | śvāsakāsajvaraharaḥ śreṣṭho lehaḥ kaphāntakṛt || 42 ||
Gū. trikaṭukaṃ trikaṭusamastāni militvaikaśa: bhinnaṃ vā cūrṇaṃ tulyaṃ melayet | ārdrakasvarasaistathā kṣaudrairlehayet kaphādināśakaṃ bhavati || 40-42 ||
śṛṅgīcūrṇam | śṛṅgīṃ prativiṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ cūrṇitāṃ madhunā lihet | śiśoḥ kāsajvaracchardiśāntyai vā kevalāṃ viṣām ||43||

Dī. śṛṃgīmiti | etat śṛṃgyādicūrṇaṃ bālaroge'tīva praśastam | śṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā, prativiṣā śuklakanta, kṛṣṇā pippalī | vetyanena yogāntaramāha - kevalāṃ viṣamiti | evamativiṣāṃ madhunā sahāvalihya bālo jvarebhyo vimuktaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tathāca tantrāntare “śṛṃgīṃ sakṛṣṇātiviṣāṃ vicūrṇya lehaṃ vidadhyānmadhunā śiśūnām | kāsajvaracchardibhirarditānāṃ samākṣikaṃ cātiviṣāmathaikām’ iti | bālānāmatīsāre'pi mustānvito'yaṃ yogaḥ pracarati | caturbhujīti tatra cauhaṣaditi‘caudī’ pā | śabdavācyaḥ | tathāhi ‘ghanakṛṣṇāruṇāśṛṅgīcūrṇaṃ kṣaudreṇa saṃyutam | śiśorjvarātisāraghnaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ vamiṃ jayet iti || 43 ||
Gū. śṛṃgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, prativiṣā ativiṣā, kṛṣṇā pippalī, eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhunā lihet śiśurbālastasya kāsādiśāntyai kevalamekāṃ viṣām ativiṣāṃ madhunā lihet | iti śṛṅgīcūrṇaṃ bālajvarādau ||43||

div.ab: yavakṣārādicūrṇam - (yavakṣāraprakṣiptam| viṣāśṛṅgīmāgadhīpauṣkarodbhavam | cūrṇaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ līḍhaṃ pañcakāsāñjayecchiśoḥ ||44||)

ab.seg: atīsāre śuṇṭhyādicūrṇamāha - śuṇṭhīprativiṣāhiṅgumustākuṭajacitrakaiḥ | cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pītamāmātīsāranāśanam || 45 ||
Dī. śuṇṭhīti | hiṅgvatra bharjitaṃ deyam | kuṭajamatrendrayavaṃ pācanatvāt | uṣṇāmbuneti caturguṇitoṣṇapānīyena sahāloḍya tridoṣeṇa tu phāṇṭavadviplāvya pibet cūrṇakalpanāyāṃ kathitatvāt || 44-45 ||
Gū. atha śuṇṭhyādicūrṇamāmātīsārādau | prativiṣā ativiṣā || 45 ||

div.ab: atha harītakyādicūrṇamāmātīsārādau - harītakī prativiṣā sindhu sauvarcalaṃ vacā | hiṅgu ceti kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā ||46|| āmātīsāraśamanaṃ grāhi cāgniprabodhanam |

ab.seg: Dī. aparamapyāha - harītakīti | sindhu saindhavaṃ hiṅgvatra bharjitaṃ deyam | pānamānaṃ tu pūrvavat| ayaṃ yogo grahaṇyāmapi praśastaḥ | eke harītakītyāgenāpi yogamenaṃ kurvanti | taduktamatraiva paribhāṣādhyāye ‘vyādheranuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ gaṇoktamapi tat tyajet’ ityādivacanāt||46 ||

div.ab: laghugaṅgādharacūrṇam | mustamindrayavaṃ bilvaṃ lodhraṃ mocarasaṃ tathā || 47 || dhātakīṃ cūrṇayettakraguḍābhyāṃ pāyayetsudhīḥ | sarvātīsāraśamanaṃ niruṇaddhi pravāhikām || 48 || laghugaṅgādharaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ saṃgrāhakaṃ param |

Dī. idānīṃ gaṅgādharasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇadvayamāha mustamityādi | etallaghugaṅgādharaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ saṃgrāhakaṃ paraṃ vikhyātam | atra bilvaṃ bilvapeśikā, mocarasaḥ śālmalīniryāsaḥ, dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni | atra takropalakṣitatvāt mathitamapi grāhyam | anyato darśanādvā ‘mathitaguḍasāmprayuktam’ iti | nanu mathitatakrayoḥ ko bhedaḥ ? ucyate ‘sajala gorasaṃ gholaṃ mastu taccārdhavārikam | takraṃ tribhāgabhinnaṃ tu kevalaṃ mathitaṃ smṛtam’ iti | kalpanā cāsya mustādicūrṇaṃ kārṣikaṃ mathitacaturguṇena guḍakarṣavimādatena saha pītam | pakvātīsāre yogo'yam ||47||48||
Gū. pravāhikāṃ niruṇaddhi rodhayet ||47 ||48||

atha bṛhadgaṅgādharacūrṇam - mustāralukaśuṇṭhībhirdhātakīlodhravālakaiḥ || 49 || bilvamocarasābhyāṃ ca pāṭhendrayavavatsakaiḥ | āmrabījaṃ prativiṣā lajjāluriti cūrṇitam || 50 || kṣaudrataṇḍulapānīyaiḥ pītairyāti pravāhikā | sarvātisāragrahaṇī praśamaṃ yāti vegataḥ || 51 || vṛddhagaṅgādharaṃ cūrṇaṃ saridvegasya rodhakamge'pi bandhakam” pā.| |

Dī. anyadapi | musteti | atrāraluko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ | vatsakaḥ kuṭajatvak | āmrabījamiti āmraphalāsthimajjā, lajjāluvikhyātā | atrāpi dviguṇitena kṣaudreṇa vimṛdya caturguṇena taṇḍulajalena peyam | saridvegasya rodhakamiti nadīpravāhāvarodhakatvenotkṛṣṭaprabhāvayuktaḥ, ata eva gaṅgādharasaṃjñā ||49||51||

ab.seg: Gū. mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, aralukaḥ syonākaḥ, dhātakī vṛkṣastasya puṣpāṇi, lodhraḥ prasiddhaḥ, vālakaṃ udīcyaṃ, lajjāluḥ lajjāvantī | spaṣṭamanyat || 49-51 ||
athājamodādicūrṇamatīsāre - ajamodā mocarasaṃ saśṛṃgaberaṃ sadhātakī kumumam | godadhimathitayuktaṃ gaṃgāmapi vāhinīṃ rudhyāt ||52||

div.ab: Gū. ajamodā, mocarasaḥ, śṛṅgaberaṃ - śuṇṭhī, dhātakī, godadhimathitaṃ ghola ucyate | gaṅgāmapi vāhinīṃ vahanaśīlāṃ pravāhiṇīṃ rundhyāt || 52 || 53 ||

ab.seg: maricādicūrṇaṃ - takreṇa yaḥ pibennityaṃ cūrṇaṃ maricasaṃbhavam | citrasauvarcalopetaṃ grahaṇī tasya naśyati | udaraplīhamandāgnigulmārśonāśanaṃ bhavet || 53 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha grahaṇyāṃ prayogānāha - takreṇeti | idaṃ maricādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyāṃ praśastam | maricacitrakasauvarcalaṃ samacūrṇaṃ sārdhaśāṇadvayaṃ caturguṇena takreṇa saha pibet | nityamityanena sevyamidaṃ mahārogopayuktatvāt ||52||53||

ab.seg: atha kapitthāṣṭakaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau - aṣṭau bhāgāḥ kapitthasya ṣaḍbhāgā śarkarā matā | dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ dhātakī tathā ||54||
ajamodā pippalī ca pratyekaṃ syustribhāgikāḥ | maricaṃ jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ granthikaṃ vālakaṃ tathā || 55 ||
sauvarcalaṃ yamānī ca cāturjātaṃ sacitrakam | nāgaraṃ caikabhāgāḥ syu: pratyekaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇitam||56||
kapitthāṣṭakasaṃjñaṃ syāccūrṇametadgalāmayān | atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca vyapohati || 57 ||

Dī. idānīṃ kapitthakāṣṭakaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - aṣṭāviti | dāḍimamatrāmlam, ‘anāradānā? śabdavācyam | tintiḍīkaṃ svanāmaprasiddham | amlaphalamityeke | śrīphalaṃ bilvam | atrāpi tintiḍīkasthāne vṛkṣāmlamiti, granthikasthāne ca tintiḍīkamiti kecit | cāturjātakamiti tvakpatrailaṃ sakeśaramityarthaḥ | kartavyavidhāvapi kapitthaphalamaṣṭabhāgikamekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, dravyaṃ tu ekabhāgasaṃjñitam | śarkarā ṣaḍbhāgā, dāḍimādini pippalīparyantāni pratyekaṃ tribhāgikaṃ, maricādināgarāntaṃ bhāgaikaṃ satyekamiti bhāvaḥ | etena kimuktam ? kapitthaṃ karṣāṣṭakaṃ, sitā ṣaṭkarṣapramitā, dāḍimādiṣaṭdravyamaṣṭādaśakarṣamitaṃ, maricāditrayodaśadravyāṇi trayoda- śakarṣāṇītyarthaḥ | asya khāṇḍavasaṃjñā tantrāntare | kutaḥ ? “lavaṇāmlasitāyuktaṃ cūrṇaṃ syāt khāṇḍavaṃ matam” ityā- divacanāt | kapitthāṣṭakasaṃjñayā'sya rūḍhiḥ ||54-57||

Gū. pitthasyāṣṭau bhāgāḥ palāni vā karṣāṇi vā ṭaṅkāni vā bhāgaśabdena palādīnāṃ abhidhānāt| śarkarā sitā ṣaḍbhāgā ṣaṭpalādikā, dāḍimādyāḥ ṣaṭ, pratyekaṃ tribhāgikā syādetaccūrṇitaṃ kapitthāṣṭhakaṃ syāt tacca galāmayādikān vyapohatīti spaṣṭārtha: | atra kapitthāṣṭake kecitprakārāntareṇa bhāgamanicchanti tadarthaṃ śataślokyāṃ bopadevamatamāha - “dhānyājājīyamānī rucakajalacaturjātaviśvoṣaṇāgnigranthyekāṃśaṃ tribhāgaṃ kara- kakaṇamadādīpyavṛkṣāmlabilvam | śvetāṣaṭkaṃ kapitthāṣṭakamidamaruciṃ gulmayakṣmātisāraṃ sāgnīsādaṃ grahaṇiga- lagadaśvāsakāsānnihanti”| asya vyākhyānaṃ ca dhānyādigranthikāntaṃ trayodaśauṣadhamekāṃśaṃ pratyekamekakarṣaṃ, karakādivilvāntaṃ ṣoḍaśauṣadhaṃ tribhāgaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣatrayamātraṃ, karakaṃ dāḍimaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, madā dhātakī, dīpyo ajamodaḥ, vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ, bilvaphalaṃ, śvetā śarkarā, tasyāḥ ṣaṭkaṃ pūrvavat ṣaṭkarṣāḥ kapitthaṃ dadhiphalaṃ śeṣaṃ spaṣṭaṃ pūrvavat | aṣṭau karṣā atra kapitthāṣṭake ye'nye bhāgaprakāramicchanti, tatra sūktiśūnyatvāt tyaktā iti bopadevamataṃ, vaṅgasenādinibandhakārapāṭhe na kecidbhāgaprakārāntaramāhustadapi likhyate | taduktaṃ vaṅgasene “yamānīpippalīmūlacaturjātakanāgaraiḥ | mīracāgnijalājājīdhānyasauvarcalaiḥ samaiḥ || vṛkṣāmladhā- takīkṛṣṇābilvadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ | triguṇaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ kapitthāṣṭaguṇīkṛtaiḥ|| cūrṇo'tīsāragrahaṇīkṣayagulmagalā- mayān | kāsaśvāsāgnimāṃdyārśaḥpīnasārocakān jayet” iti | yavānyādisauvarcalāntaiḥ samaiḥ pratyekamekabhāgaiḥ vṛkṣāmlādidīpyakāntaistriguṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ tribhāgaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ kapitthāṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛtaiḥ kapitthāṣṭabhāgairiti pūrvokta evārtha ityeke | bopadevenāpyaṣṭau vyākhyātatvāt| cūrṇa iti prastutatvāt puṃliṅge | tathāca śataślokyāṃ cūrṇastulyasito balāgnirucibhyaśceti cāturjātādicūrṇe likhitaṃ anya evaṃ vyākhyānayanti ‘yavānyāditrayodaśauṣadhayaḥ samāḥ’ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkakamātrāstrayodaśaṭaṅkā etai: tintiḍīkādyaiḥ ṣaḍbhistriguṇaistrayodaśebhyastriguṇairekonacatvāriṃśaṭaṅkaiḥ ṣaṅguṇasitaistrayodaśebhya evāṣṭasaptatiṭaṅkaiḥ’ | asminpakṣe sarvato dviguṇā sitā bhavati yathā lumbādau ardhāṃśāṃ keciccharkarāṃ melayanti || 54-57 ||
dāḍimāṣṭakam | dāḍimī dvipalā grāhyā khaṇḍāddaśapalani ca | trigandhasya palaṃ caikaṃ trikaṭu syātpalatrayam || 58 ||
etadekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ syāddāḍimāṣṭakam | rucikṛddīpanaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ grāhi kāsajvarāpaham || 59 ||

div.ab: Dī. dāḍimīti | ayaṃ laghugurubhedena dāḍimāṣṭhakasaṃjñako yogo'tīsārādīnāṃ praśastaḥ | khaṇḍāddaśapalānīti saṃmilitacūrṇāt paladvayanyūnā dviguṇā śarkarā jñeyā tīkṣṇatvāt | trigandhasya palamekaṃ militasyetyarthaḥ| tryūṣaṇasyāpi palatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ palamityarthaḥ | khaṇḍāddaśapalāni cetyatra sthāne khaṇḍādaṣṭapalāni ceti kecit paṭhanti| tanmate cūrṇasamaṃ khaṇḍamiti vyādhivihitatvāt, ayaṃ pakṣaḥ pracarati | sāmyārthaṃ trigandhasya pratyekaṃ palaṃ grāhyam| dāḍimāṣṭhaketyaṣṭamaṃ dravyamatra dāḍimaṃ tena dāḍimāṣṭakaṃ proktam || 58 || 59 ||

Gū. atha dāḍimāṣṭakam | dāḍimādamladāḍimāt dve pale, khaṇḍātsitāyā aṣṭapalāni, trigandhasyailātva- kpatrakāṇāmekaṃ palaṃ samuditasya trigandhasya palaṃ, trikaṭu śuṇṭhīmaricapippalyaḥ eṣāṃ palatrayaṃ, pratyekametadekīkṛtaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakaṃ bhavati | dāḍimādīni aṣṭau dravyāṇi yatra taddāḍimāṣṭakam | spaṣṭamanyat ||58 || 59 ||

atha bṛhaddāḍimāṣṭakam atīsārādau - dāḍimasya palānyaṣṭau śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakam | pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ yamānī maricaṃ tathā || 60|| dhānyakaṃ jīrakaṃ śuṇṭhī pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitam | karṣamātrā tugākṣīrī tvakpatrailāśca keśaram || 61 || pratyekaṃ kolamātrāḥ syustaccūrṇaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakam | atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca galagraham || 62 || mandāgniṃ pīnasaṃ kāsaṃ cūrṇametadvyapohati |

ab.seg: Dī. dvitīyaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakamāha - dāḍimasyeti | etadvṛddhadāḍimāṣṭakasaṃjñaṃ cūrṇamatīsārādīn hanti | atra tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā tadabhāve tavakṣīraṃ grāhyam | tavakṣīraṃ karcūrakṛtaḥ prakāraḥ | sā karṣapramāṇā tvak varāṅgam, patram patrakam, elā sūkṣmailā, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaram, etaccatuṣṭayaṃ kolamātram | kolaṃ karṣārdhaṃ, tena saṃmilitaṃ ṭaṅkāṣṭakamityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam | galagrahaṃ galarogam | asyāṣṭakasaṃjñā palāṣṭakena boddhavyā na tu dravyasaṃkhyaya ||60-62||

Gū. tugākṣīrī vāṃśī tadādau karṣamātrā, kolaḥ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ syāt | dāḍimamaṣṭau aṣṭapalāni yatra taddāḍimāṣṭakaṃ atra bhāgāniruktiḥ, auṣadhabahutvātpūrvam adharaṃ bhāgālpatvāt pūrvaṃ laghudāḍimāṣṭakaṃ tato'tīsārādikaṃ vyapohati ||60-62||

div.ab: pippalyādicūrṇam | (pippalī bṛhatī vyāghrī yavakṣārakaliṅgakāḥ ||63|| citrakaṃ sārivā pāṭhā śaṭhī lavaṇapañcakam | taccūrṇaṃ pāyayeddadhnā surayoṣṇāmbunāpi vā || 64 || mārutagrahaṇīdoṣaśamanaṃ paramaṃ hitam |)

atha lavaṅgādicūrṇam arocakādau - lavaṅgaṃ śuddhakarpūramelātvaṅnāgakeśaram || 65 || jātīphalamuśīraṃ ca nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam | kṛṣṇāgarustugākṣīrī māṃsī nīlotpalaṃ kaṇā ||66|| candanaṃ tagaraṃ vālaṃ kaṅkolaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | samabhāgāni sarvāṇi sarvemyo'rdhā sitā bhavet ||67|| lavaṅgādyamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ rājārhaṃ vahnidīpanam | ropaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ balapradam || 68 || hṛdrogaṃ kaṇṭharogaṃ ca kāsaṃ hikvāṃ ca pīnasam | yakṣmāṇaṃ tamakaṃ śvāsamatīsāramuraḥkṣatam || 69 || pramehārucigulmādīngrahaṇīmapi nāśayet |

ab.seg: Dī. atha lavaṅgādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - lavaṅgamiti | śuddhakarpūramiti śuddhaṃ ca tat karpūraṃ ceti, pakvakarpūramityarthaḥ | atilaghutvāt| tathāhi - “pakvastu dvividhaḥ prokto sadalo nirdalastathā | dṛḍhaśca pītavarṇaśca viśeṣāllaghutāṃ gataḥ” iti| kecittu śuddhaśabdena jātyutkṛṣṭaṃ gṛhṇanti, tacca īśāvāsa iti saṃgītam | tathāhyuktam - “īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāśraya iti tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣavaraiḥ” | svarūpeṇā'pi - “īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñastu pāṇḍuraḥ | śvetapotāśrayaśceti” sarve | guṇenāpi “rasavīryavipākataḥ | prabhāveṇāpi te proktāḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ guṇādhikāḥ | prakṛṣṭhatvenāpi - “tatrāpi yo na ca kṣudraḥ sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ” iti | kṛṣṇajīrakamiti pāścātyaṃ khurāsānīti loke | kṛṣṇāguru agurviti prasiddham | tugākṣīrī vāṃśī māṃsī jaṭākhyā | nīlotpalopalakṣitatvāt padmabījaṃ grāhyaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, tagaraṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, vālaṃ vālakaṃ, kaṅkolaphaladravyaṃ nijanāmaprasiddhaṃ, tacca dvividhaṃ marīcakaṅkolaṃ kṣīrakaṅkolaṃ ceti | etat sakalaṃ dravyaṃ samabhāgaṃ cūrṇayitavyaṃ, sarvebhyaḥ sitārdhā bhavet | tena sakalacūrṇasya bhāgaikaṃ, sitāyāśca bhāgaikaṃ, taccūrṇasamānā ca sitetyarthaḥ | eke sitārdhā bhavedityanena saṃmitacūrṇasya dvau bhāgau sitāyā eko bhāga iti vyākhyānayanti, etadasaṅgataṃ vyavahārāt | rājārhamiti prabhuyogyam atisugandhatvāt bahulaguṇakaratvācca | ropaṇaṃ śarīrasthirakaraṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ ca, tarpaṇaṃ dhātūnāṃ tṛptijanakaṃ, vṛṣyaṃ śukravṛddhikāri, balamojastatpradamityarthaḥ | tamakaḥ śvāsabhedaḥ, uraḥkṣataṃ kṣayaroge paṭhitam | asyāgre karpūrādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ kecit paṭhanti | tacca bahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate, kṣepako'yam iti manyamānairasmābhirna likhitaḥ | karpūrādiḥnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | kvacillikhitaḥ “sakarpūraṃ ca kaṅkolaṃ jātīphaladalaṃ samam | lavaṅganāgamaricakṛṣṇāśuṇṭhīvivardhitam | cūrṇaṃ sitāsamaṃ grāhyaṃ rocanaṃ kṣayakāsanut | vaisvaryaśvāsagulmārśaḥkaṇṭhāmayabhayāpaham | prayuktaṃ cānnapāneṣu bhiṣajā rogiṇāṃ hitat” | iti karpūrādyaṃ cūrṇam | atha laghulavaṅgādicūrṇaṃ tantrāntare - “lavaṅgajātīphalapippalīnāṃ bhāgān prakalpyākṣasamānaśeṣān | palārdhamekaṃ maricasya datvā palāni catvāri mahauṣadhasya || sitāsamaṃ cūrṇamidaṃ prasahya rogānimānāśu balānnihanti | kāsajvarārocakagulmamehaśvāsāgnimāndyaṃ grahaṇīvikārān” iti | laghulavaṅgādicūrṇam || 63-69 ||

Gū. śuddhakarpūraḥ nirmalabhīmasena, tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, agaru, vālam udīcyaṃ, kaṅkolaṃ maricakaṃkolaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 63-69 ||
atha jātīphalādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau - jātī phalalavaṅgailāpatratvaṅnāgakeśaraiḥ ||70||
karpūracandanatilaistvakkṣīrītagarāmalaiḥ | tālīsapippalīpathyāsthūlajīrakacitrakaiḥ ||71||
śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgamaricaiḥ samabhāgavicūrṇitaiḥ | yāvantyetāni sarvāṇi kuryādbhaṅgāṃ ca tāvatīm ||72||
sarvacūrṇasamā deyā śarkarā ca bhiṣagvaraiḥ | karṣamātraṃ tataḥ khādenmadhunā plāvitaṃ sudhīḥ ||73||
asya prabhāvādgrahaṇīkāsaśvāsārucikṣayāḥ | vātaśleṣmapratiśyāyāḥ praśamaṃ yānti vegataḥ ||74||

Dī. idānīṃ jātīphalādyaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - jātīphaleti | atra candanaṃ śvetaṃ cūrṇatvāt | tilairiti kṛṣṇatilāḥ nistuṣā grāhyāḥ | tvakkṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, (āmalamāmalakaphalaṃnāsti ‘kha’ pustake | , pathyā harītakī, sthūlajīrakaḥ kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ etatsakalaṃ samabhāgaṃ gṛhītvā cūrṇitam) asya bhāgamekaṃ bhaṅgāyā bhāgaikamiti tena sakalacūrṇasamānā bhaṅgā deyā iti | bhaṅgā'tra bharjitā deyā vyavahārāt | sarvacūrṇasamā deyā śarkarā ceti tena dvayo: samā śarkaretyarthaḥ| etat siddhaṃ yathocitamātraṃ madhunā plāvya bhakṣyaṃ, nātra karṣamānaṃ niyataṃ yataḥ - “mātrāyā nāstyavasthānam” ityādivacanāt ||70-74 ||
Gū. elā sūkṣmā, patraṃ patrajatvak‘taja’ hi.m?. | kṛṣṇā agaru, tvakkṣīrī vāṃśī, tagaram, āmalakaṃ, tālīsaṃ, pathyā harītakī, sthūlajīrakaṃ śvetajīrakam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 70-74 ||
atha mahākhāṇḍavacūrṇamarucyādau - maricaṃ nāgapuṣpāṇi tālīsaṃ lavaṇāni ca | pratyekamekabhāgāḥ syuḥ pippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 75 ||
tvakvaṇā tintiḍīkaṃ ca jīrakaṃ ca dvibhāgikam | dhānyāmlavetasau viśvaṃ bhadrailā badarāṇi ca || 76 ||
ajamodā jaladharaḥ pratyekaṃ syustribhāgikāḥ | sarvauṣadhicaturthāṃśaṃ dāḍimasya phalaṃ bhavet || 77 ||
dravyemyo nikhilebhyaśca sitā deyārdhamātrayā | mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñaṃ syāccūrṇametatsurocanam || 78 ||
agnidīptikaraṃ hṛdyaṃ kāsātīsāranāśanam | hṛdrogakaṇṭhajaṭharamukharogapraṇāśanam || 79 ||
viṣūcikāṃ tathādhmānamarśogulmakṛmīnapi | chardiṃ pañcavidhāṃ śvāsaṃ cūrṇametadvyapohati ||80||

Dī. atha mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇamāha - maricamiti | nāgapuṣpāṇīti nāgakeśaram | lavaṇānīti bahuvacanatvena pañcalavaṇāni grāhyāṇi, tāni ca ‘sindhusauvarcalopetaṃ biḍaṃ sāmudrakaṃ gaḍam’ iti | asmatsaṃpradāye lavaṇānītyanena saindhavameva grāhyaṃ nānyat svajātyutkṛṣṭatvena bahuvacanagrahaṇam | tvak tajaśabdavācyam | atra maricādilavaṇāntaṃ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaikaṃ; pippalīmūlādijīrakāntaṃ pratyekam ṭaṅkadvimitaṃ; amlavetasaṃ svanāmaprasiddham, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, bhadrailā bṛhadelā, badarāṇi badaraphalāni, ajamodā'tra yamānī | evaṃ sarvatrāntaḥparimārjane, bahi:parimārjane tu ajamodā ajamodaiva | tathāhi “antaḥsaṃmārjane prāyaścājamodā yamānikā | bahiḥsaṃmārjane yojyā tvajamodaiva niścitam” iti | yatrājamodāyamānyau stastatra yamānyeva dviguṇā antaḥparimārjane | jaladharo mustam | dhānyādi jaladharāntaṃ pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkatrayamiti; etatsakalacūrṇasya caturthāṃśaṃ dāḍimaphalaṃ tena māṣādhikadaśaṭaṅkamityarthaḥ | dāḍimaphalamatrāmlaṃ yalloke ‘anāradānā’ śabdavācyam| khāṇḍavatvātsamastadravyebhyaḥ sitā śarkarā ardhabhāgikā deyā, tena sakalacūrṇasāmyamityarthaḥ | sakalacūrṇasāmyaṃ kiyatpramāṇaṃ ? ṭaṅkādhikakuḍavamānamiti bhāvaḥ | mahākhāṇḍavamiti ‘lavaṇāmlasitāyuktaḥ khāṇḍavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram iti | nanu “cūrṇe guḍaḥ samo deyaḥ śarkarā dviguṇā bhavet” iti niyamena kathamatra cūrṇasamatulitā sitā ? ucyate, ayamapi yogo'gnimāndye pradhānatamaḥ, agnisādo hi prāyeṇa śleṣmādhikaḥ syāt śleṣmaṇi ca madhuro bahutaro na yukta ityadoṣaḥ | yadvā ‘dviguṇamānamanukteṣu yaduktaṃ tattathaiva ca’ iti ||75-80||

Gū. nāgapuṣpāṇi nāgakeśaraṃ,lavaṇāni pañca lavaṇāni bahuvacanāt | etāni pratyekabhāgāni pañcalavaṇānāmapi pratyekabhāgam | tvak taja:, kaṇā pippalī, dhānyaṃ prasiddham, amlavetasaḥ tasya cukraṃ vā raso vā gṛhyate, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, bhadrailā bṛhadelā, badaraṃ laghubadaraṃ, jaladharo mustam | mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñametat surocanaṃ suṣṭhu rucikaraṃ arocakādhikāritvāt tathāgnimāndyādiharaṃ khāṇḍavo dvividhaḥ eko lehyaḥ aparaścūrṇasaṃjñaḥ | yathā coktam “āme hyamlapalaṃ caiva khaṇḍapakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam | elāmaricasaṃyuktaṃ jñātavyaḥ sa ca khāṇḍavaḥ” | anye tvevamāhuḥ -“kapitthatintiḍīkabījakarpūrakadāḍimaiḥ | tathāmalakayuktaiśca saṣaḍbhi: khāṇḍava: smṛtaḥ”| pūrvoktastu avalehyaḥ | tathācoktam “āmlamadhuraiḥ spaṣṭaḥ, kaṣāyalavaṇauṣaṇaḥ atiktakhāṇḍavaḥ kolakapitthādyapakvaṃ hi” iti || 75-80 ||
atha nārāyaṇacūrṇamudarādau - citrakaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ jīrakaṃ hapuṣā vacā | yamānī pippalīmūlaṃ śatapuṣpā'jagandhikā || 81 ||
ajamodā śaṭhī dhānyaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ sthūlajīrakam | hemāhvā pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam || 82 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ ceti samāṃśāni viśālā syāddvibhāgikā | trivṛttribhāgā vijñeyā dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ bhavet||83||
caturbhāgā śātalā syātsarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet | pācanasnehanādyaiśca snigdhakoṣṭhasya rogiṇaḥ || 84 ||
dadyāccūrṇaṃ virekāya sarvarogapraṇāśanam | hṛdroge pāṇḍuroge ca kāse śvāse bhagandare ||85||
mandāgnau ca jvare kuṣṭhe grahaṇyāṃ ca galagrahe | dadyādyuktānupānena tathādhmāne surādibhiḥ || 86 ||
gulme badaranīreṇa viḍbhede dadhimastunā | uṣṇāmbubhirajīrṇe ca vṛkṣāmlaiḥ parikartiṣu || 87 ||
uṣṭrīdugdhenodareṣu tathā takreṇa vā gavām | prasannayā vātaroge dāḍimāmbubhirarśasi || 88 ||
dvividhe ca viṣe dadyātghṛtena viṣanāśanam | cūrṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāma duṣṭarogagaṇāpaham || 89 ||

Dī. idānīṃ nārāyaṇacūrṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - citramiti | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam | havuṣeti svanāmataḥ prasiddham | kecittu ‘ruu’ śabdavācyaṃ vadanti | kṣārāviti dvau kṣāro tena svarjikā yavakṣāraśceti | lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddham | kuṣṭhaṃ ceti samāṃśānīti | viśālendravāruṇī sā dvibhāgikā ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, trivṛnniśothaḥ dvibhāgā, atrāpi dravyaikabhāgāpekṣayā, dantī ca prasiddhā tasyā bhāgatrayaṃ, dravyaikamānādapi boddhavyam | śātalā carmakaṣā iti loke śehuṇḍabheda iti trisaṭenāpi yavatiktakaśabdena likhitaḥ | sa ca dravyaikabhāgāpekṣayā caturbhāgaḥ | pācanasnehādyairiti | pācanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pācanaṃ vyādhivihitaṃ, snehanaṃ ghṛtapānādikam | ādiśabdāt svedādikaṃ ca, etena kṛtapūrvaiḥ pācanādyaiḥ kṛtvā snigdhakoṣṭhasya rogiṇa etaccūrṇaṃ virekāya dadyādityarthaḥ | tathāhi -“vātodaraṃ balavataḥ pūrvaṃ snehairupācaret | snigdhāya sveditāṅgāya dadyāt snehavirecanam” iti | nanviha “vivarjayet snehapānamajīrṇī codarī jvarī” iti vacanāt sneho niṣiddhaḥ, “naite svedyā nodarī nātisārī” ityanena svedasyāpi niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ | tatkathaṃ svedasnuhopadeśaḥ ? ucyate, svatantrayoḥ snehasvedayorniṣedho boddhavyaḥ, na tu śodhanāṅgabhūtayostayoḥ anyathā doṣaharaṇasya duṣkaratvāt | dadyādyuktānupāneneti | yuktānupānamatraiva kathyate tadyathā - ādhmāne surādibhiriti | ādigrahaṇādāsavāriṣṭasīdhumādhvīkādibhiḥ | gulme badaranīreṇeti badarakvāthenetyarthaḥ | viḍbhaṅge dadhimastuneti dadhi ca mastu ca yadvā dadhno mastu nānājātikaṃ, yata: mastu saptavidhaṃ bhavet | tadyathā - ‘svādvamlamatyamlakamandajātaṃ tathāmṛtakṣīrabhavaṃ saraśca | asāramevaṃvidhasaptadhā'smin varge smṛtaṃ mastuguṇāstathaiva’ iti | prasaṃgato'syārthaṃ prakaṭayannāha - svādvamlamityādi sthādu dadhi amlaṃ dadhi atyamlaṃ dadhi rasajātam atyamlaṃ dadhi manyajātaṃ dadhi ebhyo jatimityarthaḥ | tathā'mṛtakṣīrabhavamiti | vinaṣṭadugdhajātaṃ sara iti dadhna upari ghano bhāgaḥ snehabahulaḥ sara iti prasiddha: | asāraṃ sārarahitam uddhṛtasnehasya dadhno vinirmitamityarthaḥ | iti saptavidhaṃ mastu darśitam | anye kūrcikā dadhitakrabhedena mastu dvividhamiti paṭhanti, uṣṇāmbunā saha peyamiti vyavahāraḥ | uṣṇāmbubhiriti bahuvacanatvenāṣṭamāṃśāvaśeṣādikaṃ grāhyam | tacca yathādoṣānurūpamiti yojyam | vṛkṣāmlairiti asya kvāthenetyarthaḥ | parikartiṣviti | gude parikartanamiva vedanāvṛddhiriti parikartikā kathyate | uṣṭrīdugdhena gavāṃ takreṇa vā | udareṣu iti sarvodareṣvityarthaḥ | prasannayā vātaroge iti | prasannā surāmaṇḍaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tathā coktaṃ ‘prasannā syāt surāmaṇḍastasmāt kādambarī ghanā | jagalastadadhaḥ prokto jagalānmadako ghanaḥ || vakkaso hṛtasāraḥ syāt surābījaṃ tu kiṇvakam’ iti guṇenāpi prasannāmāha - ‘gulmārśaśchardyarocakavātanut’ iti rāsnayā vātarogeṣviti vā pāṭhaḥ | tatra rāsnākvāthena sahetyarthaḥ | dāḍimāmbubhirarśasīti | dāḍimaphalasvarasaiḥ kvacitphalarasairvā | dvividhe viṣe iti sthāvarajaṅgamātmake | viṣṇusaṃhitāyāmuktaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ yadvā viṣṇuvīryatulyaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ yathā viṣṇutejasā daityagaṇāḥ palāyante tathaivāsya prabhāveṇa duṣṭā rogagaṇā naśyantīti tātparyārthaḥ ||81-89||

Gū. triphalā harītakīvibhītakamāmalakaṃ pratyekamekabhāgaṃ, vyoṣaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalya:, pratyekamekabhāgaṃ; hapuṣā‘hāḍavera’ hi.bhā.| vigandhikā, ajagandhikā‘vāvarī’ hi.bhā.| vanatulasī, śaṭhī karcūraṃ, sthūlajīrakaṃ sthūlakaṇā, hemāhvā coṣaṃ pauṣkaramūlaṃ, kṣārau dvau svarjīyavakṣārau, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddham, etāni samāṃśāni pratyekamekabhāgaṃ viśālā indravāruṇī tasyā jaṭācūrṇaṃ dvibhāgaṃ trivṛt niśothaḥ dvibhāgā dantī dātyeṇī tasyā bhāgatrayaṃ, śātalā pītasehuṇḍastadabhāve sehuṇḍajaṭā tvagvā patrāṇi vā tasyāścaturbhāgā etān dvitricaturguṇān; citrakādicūrṇāni manyante kecidanyauṣadhāni manyante tatsarvaṃ saṃpradāyato jñeyam | pācanaṃ pācanakvāthaṃ dhānyatrikādi āragvadhādi vā | snehanaṃ ghṛtapānādi tadādyaiḥ snigdhakoṣṭhatya rogiṇaḥ virekāya cūrṇaṃ dadyāt | sarvarogapraṇāśanaṃ hṛdrogādau dadyāt vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkam | taiḥ parikartiṣu gude kartanavat pīḍā | suprasannā madirābhedaḥ, nārāyaṇaṃ nārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ tadvadroganāśakatvāt || 81-89 ||

div.ab: atha hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇamajīrṇodarādau - hapuṣā triphalā caiva trāyamāṇā ca pippalī | hemakṣīrī trivṛccaiva śātalā kaṭukā vacā || 90 || nīlinī saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | uṣṇodakena mūtreṇa dāḍimatriphalārasaiḥ || 91 || tathā māṃsarasenāpi yathāyogyaṃ pibennaraḥ | ajīrṇe plīhni gulmeṣu śophārśoviṣamāgniṣu ||92|| halīmakāmalāpāṇḍukuṣṭhādhmānodareṣvapi |

ab.seg: Dī. atha hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - hapuṣeti | hapuṣā svanāmākhyātā sā ca jambuvadviṭapaviśeṣaḥ, trāyamāṇā lokataḥ prasiddhā hemakṣīrī svarṇakṣīrī, kaṃkuṣṭhabheda ityarthaḥ | coka iti loke | trivṛnniśothaḥ, śātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ sauvarcalaṃ sauvarcalasamamanyadvetyato yaduktaṃ “na kālalavaṇe gandhaḥ sauvarcalasamo guṇai:” iti | mūtreṇeti gomūtreṇa śreṣṭhatvāt | dāḍimatriphalārasairiti kvathitaiḥ | māṃsarasaḥ pralehaśabdavācyaḥ | yathāyogyamiti vyādhyanurūpam| viṣamāgniṣviti viṣamatīkṣṇamandādiṣvapi halīmaṃ halīmakam || 90-92 ||
Gū. hapuṣā vigandhikā, trāyamāṇā hemakṣīrī, trivṛt, śātalā, sehuṇḍaḥ, kuṭakī, nīlapuṣpī aparājitā, kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ sauvarcalam, uṣṇodakādyaiḥ pibet | halīmaṃ halīmakaṃ, spaṣṭaṃ cānyat || 90-92 ||

div.ab: atha pañcasamaṃ cūrṇaṃ śūlādau - śuṇṭhī harītakī kṛṣṇā trivṛtsauvarcalaṃ tathā ||93|| samabhāgāni sarvāṇi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet | jñeyaṃ pañcasamaṃ cūrṇametacchūlaharaṃ param || 94 || ādhmānajaṭharārśoghnamāmavātaharaṃ smṛtam |
Dī. ādhmānādau pañcasamacūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - śuṇṭhīti | atra kṛṣṇā pippalī, trivṛnniśothaḥ, śeṣaṃ subodham || 93 || 94 ||
Gū. sugamam || 93 || 94 ||

atha nārācacūrṇamādhmānaśūlādau - karṣamātrā bhavetkṛṣṇā trivṛtā syātpalonmitā ||95|| khaṇḍātpalaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ cūrṇamekatra kārayet| karṣonmitaṃ lihedetatkṣaudreṇādhmānanāśanam ||96 || gāḍhaviṭkodarakaphānpittaśūlaṃ ca nāśayet |

Dī. idānīṃ nārācakaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ vivarṇayannāha - karṣamātreti | karṣamātramiti bhakṣaṇārthaṃ, kṣaudraṃ tu yāvadavalehaḥ syāt tāvanmātram | etacca prātareva bhakṣyaṃ virekārthatvāt tathā hyuktaṃ - “khaṇḍaṃ palaṃ trivṛtā samamupakulyā karṣacūrṇitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ | prāgbhojane ca madhunā biḍālapadakaṃ lihet prājñaḥ’ iti gāḍhaviṭkamatibaddhapurīṣamiti || || 95 || 96 ||
Gū. kṛṣṇā pippalī, trivṛt niḥsṛtā | spaṣṭamanyat || 95 || 96 ||

atha lavaṇatritayādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ yakṛtplīhaśūlādau - lavaṇatritayaṃ kṣārau śatapuṣpādvayaṃ vacā ||97|| ajamodā'jagandhā ca hapuṣā jīrakadvayam | maricaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalī gajapippalī ||98 || hiṅguśca hiṅgupatrī ca śaṭhī pāṭhopakuñcikā | śuṇṭhī citrakacavyāni viḍaṅgaṃ cāmlavetasam ||99|| dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca trivṛddantī śatāvarī | indravāruṇikā bhārṅgī devadāru yamānikā || 100|| kustumburustumburūṇi pauṣkaraṃ badarāṇi ca | śivā ceti samāṃśāni cūrṇamekatra kārayet|| 101|| bhāvabhedārdrakarasairbījapūrarasaistathā | tatpibetsarpiṣā jīrṇemadyenoṣṇodakena vā || 102 || kolāmbhasā vā takreṇa dugdhenauṣṭreṇa mastunā | yakṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭīśūlagudakukṣihṛdāmayam ||103|| arśoviṣṭambhamandāgnigulmaplīhodarāṇi‘aṣṭhīlā’ pā.| ca | hikkādhmānaśvāsakāsāñjayedetānna saṃśayaḥ ||104 || etairevauṣadhaiḥ samyagghṛtaṃ vā sādhayetsudhīḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha trilavaṇādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - lavaṇatritayamiti | ayaṃ trilavaṇādyo yogaścūrṇasaṃjñakaḥ | anenaiva ghṛtamapi sādhayet| sudhīriti snehayuktyā vipacedityarthaḥ | atra trilavaṇaṃ ca saindhavasauvarcalaviḍasaṃjñaṃ kṣārāviti dvaukṣārau tena svarjikākṣāro yavakṣāraśca | śatapuṣpādvayamiti laghusthūlabhedena | ekā ‘saupha’ iti prasiddhā | aparā ‘sovā’ śabdavācyā, ajagandhā varvarikā, hapuṣā nijanāmakhyātā, jīrakadvayamiti pītakṛṣṇabhedena pratītam, kustumburu dhānyakaṃ, tumburu svanāmaprasiddhaṃ, pauṣkaraṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ, hiṅgupatrī, viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ patrāṇi hiṅgugandhasadṛśāni bhavanti | sā dvividhā ekā cāruṇapatrikā tanvī aparā veṇupatrikā hiṃgulaphalā | upakuñcikā jīrakabhedaḥ ‘karauṃjī śabdavācya: | badarāṇi badaraphalāni, śivā harītakī śeṣaṃ subodham | etat sakalaṃ samabhāgena ślakṣṇacūrṇīkṛtaṃ cārdrakarasairbījapūrarasaiśca pratyekaṃ bhāvayet; rasairiti bahuvacanatvena saptavārān bhāvayediti bhāvaḥ | tathācoktaṃ -‘bījapūrārdrakarasenāsakṛdbhāvitam’ iti | ghṛtasādhane tu caturguṇo raso deyaḥ | snehaparimāṇāt caturguṇatā ca pratyekaṃ | tatpibet sarpiṣā jīrṇe iti | anne jīrṇe sati pibedityarthaḥ | anyarogotpattibhayāt | tathāhi - ‘auṣadhaśeṣe bhuktaṃ pītaṃ tathauṣadhaṃ saśeṣe'nne | na karoti gadopaśamaṃ prakopayatyanyarogāṃśca’ iti | kolāmbhasā badarakvāthena | ‘vā’ grahaṇāt kulatthayūṣeṇa kṣāraniścyotanena dāḍimarasena doṣāpekṣayā pibediti tātparyārtha: | yakṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭīśūlamiti | yakṛtśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhaśūlaṃ kaṭiśūlaṃ ceti gudakukṣihṛdāmayamiti | āmayo gudādibhiḥ saha pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate ||97-104||

Gū. lavaṇatritayaṃ saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍalavaṇaṃ, kṣārau dvau sarjīyavakṣārau, śatapuṣpā dvayamsovā, sauṃphaśabdavācyau| | ajagandhā bākucī, hapuṣā prasiddhā, jīrakadvayaṃ śvetakṛṣṇajīrakam | pippalī gajapippalī, tadabhāve pippalī, hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, hiṅgupatrīḥ‘hiṅgoṭa’ hi.bhā.| , śaṭhī karcūra: pāṭhāpāḍhā | prasiddhā, upakuñcikākalauṃjī | kalavañjīkā, amlavetasaḥ cukraṃ vā raso vā, dāḍimam amlatintiḍīkaṃ, trivṛt niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, śatāvarī, indravāruṇī prasiddhā tasyā jaṭā, kustumbururdhānyakaṃ, tumburuḥ śūlaghnaḥ, pauṣkaramūlaṃ, badarāṇi, śivā harītakī, kolāmbhasā badarajalena, mastunā dadhijalena | spaṣṭamanyat || 97-104 ||
atha śūlādau tumburādicūrṇam | tumburūṇi trilavaṇaṃ yamānī puṣkarāhvayam || 105 ||
yavakṣārābhayāhiṅguviḍaṅgāni samāni ca | trivṛttribhāgā vijñeyā sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet||106||
pibeduṣṇena toyena yavakvāthena vā pibet | jayetsarvāṇi śūlāni gulmādhmānodarāṇi ca ||107||

Dī. atha tumburādicūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - tumburūṇīti ayaṃ tumburādiko yogaḥ aṣṭavidhaśūleṣu praśastaḥ | tatra tumburūṇi phalaviśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ, trilavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍaṃ, puṣkarāhvayaṃ puṣkaramūlam, tadabhāve kuṣṭaṃ, abhayā harītakī, hiṃgvatra bharjitam, etatsakalaṃ samabhāgaṃ, trivṛt tribhāgiketi ekadravyabhāgāpekṣayā, yavakvātheneti yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ || 105-107 ||

Gū. saiṃdhavasauvarcalabiḍeti lavaṇāni, yamānī, puṣkaraṃ, puṣkaramūlaṃ, yavakṣāraḥ, abhayā harītakī, hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, viḍaṅgaṃ etāni samāni pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkamātrāṇi sarvoṣadhāni; trivṛt niḥsṛtā bhāgatrayaṃ ādyauṣadhāt | apare sarvāndhātṛguṇānāhuḥ | tathāca bopadevaśataślokyāṃ ‘dīpyastumburupauṣkaraṃ trilavaṇaṃ kṣārābhayā jaṃtujit vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu tatastṛvṛttrirudarādyarśograhe buddhimān | vyākhyātaṃ ca trivṛttriguṇaḥ, tataḥ dīpyādicūrṇāt - dīpyāditi samāṃśāt| tathāca vṛndepi “tumburūṇi trilavaṇaṃ pāṭhā kṛṣṇā mahauṣadham | etāni svarjikākṣāro yavakṣārābhayā niśiḥ || lavaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ hiṅgu samānyekatra cūrṇayet | trivṛttriguṇitaṃ cūrṇametaduṣṇāmbunā pibet | śūlaṃ nivārayatyeṣa ādhmānamudarāṇi ca ||” vṛndāt bṛhattumburādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ śūlādau ||105-107 ||
atha citrakādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau - citrakaṃ nāgaraṃ hiṅgu pippalī pippalījaṭā | cavyājamodā maricaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 108 ||
svarjikā ca yavakṣāraḥ sindhu sauvarcalaṃ biḍam | sāmudrakaṃ romakaṃ ca kolamātrāṇi kārayet ||109||
ekīkṛtyākhilaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhāvayenmātuluṅgajaiḥ | rasairdāḍimajairvāpi śoṣayedātapena ca || 110||
etaccūrṇaṃ jayedgulmaṃ grahaṇīmāmajāṃ rujam | agniṃ ca kurute dīptaṃ rucikṛtkaphanāśanam || 111 ||

Dī. citrakādyaṃ cūrṇamāha – citrakamiti | atra nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, pippalī, pippalījaṭā pippalī mūlaṃ,citrakādi maricāntaṃ dravyaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, svarjikādiromakāntaṃ kolamātraṃ, pratyekamityarthaḥ | kolaṃ karṣārdhasaṃjñaṃ romakaṃ gaḍa- lavaṇam | etatsarvaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya mātuluṅgadāḍimaphalodbhavaiḥ rasaiḥ pṛthagbhāvayet, mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | vāgrahaṇā- detaccūrṇaṃ mātuluṅgadāḍimarasenāplāvya guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ granthāntaradarśanācca | tathāhi “citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam | vyoṣaṃ hiṃgvajamodaṃ ca cavyaṃ caikatra cūrṇayet | guṭikā mātuluṅgasya dāḍimasya rasena vā | kṛtā vipācayantyāmaṃ dīpayantyāśu cānalam” iti||108-111||
Gū. hiṅgu bharjitaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat ||108-111||

div.ab: atha vaḍavānalacūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau - saindhavaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalī cavyacitrakam | śuṇṭhī harītakī ceti kramavṛddhāni cūrṇayet ||112|| vaḍavānalanāmaiccūrṇaṃ syādagnidīpanam |

ab.seg: Dī. atha vaḍavānalacūrṇamāha - saindhavamiti | cavyamiti viṭapaviśeṣo nijanāmapraptītaḥ tasya phalaṃ gajapippalī iti| kramavṛddhyā vṛddhiṃ kṛtvā yojyaṃ, vṛddhistu ādidravyādbhavati | tadyathā saindhavamekabhāgaṃ, pippalīmūlaṃ dvibhāgikaṃ, pippalī tribhāgā, cavyaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayaṃ, citrakaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ śuṇṭhī ṣaḍbhāgā harītakī saptabhāgeti kramavṛddhiḥ | atyantāgnikaratvāt vaḍavānalasaṃjñam || || 112 ||
Gū. kamavṛddhāni - saindhavam ekaṃ, pippalīmūlaṃ dvayaṃ, pippalī catvāri, cavyamaṣṭau, citrakaṃ ṣoḍaśa, śuṇṭhī dvātriṃśat, harītakī catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ, evameva kramavṛddham ||112||

div.ab: atha ajamodādyaṃ cūrṇam āmavātaśothādau - ajamodā viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ devadāru ca || 113 || citrakaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ śatapuṣpā ca pippalī | maricaṃ ceti karṣāṃśaṃ pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||114|| karṣāstu pañca pathyāyā daśa syurvṛddhadārukāt | nāgarācca daśaiva syuḥ sarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet ||115|| pibetkoṣṇajalenaiva cūrṇaṃ śvayathunāśanam | āmavātarujaṃ hanti saṃdhipīḍāṃ ca gṛdhrasīm ||116|| kaṭipṛṣṭhagudasthāṃ ca jaṅghayośca rujāṃ jayet | tūnīpratūnīviśvācīkaphavātāmayāñjayet || 117 || samena vā guḍenāsya vaṭakānkārayedbhiṣak |

ab.seg: Dī. atha ajamodādyaṃ cūrṇamapi darśayannāha - ajamodeti | ayamajamodādisaṃjñako yogaścūrṇarūpo guṭikārūpaśca | ajamodādimaricāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣamātram | pathyā harītakī tasyāstvak pañcakarṣamitā, vṛddhadārakaṃ daśakarṣaṃ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī caiva daśakarṣānvitā etat sakalaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ucitamātrayā koṣṇajalena pānaṃ boddhavyam | athavā pakṣāntaramapi | idameva cūrṇaṃ guḍamiśritaṃ guḍasamānaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣayet | guḍasāmyamatracūrṇatvāt | atrāpi koṣṇajalānupānaṃ boddhavyam| kaṭipṛṣṭhagudasthāṃ ceti | atra rujāmityanvayaḥ | jaṅghayorubhayoḥ atrāpi rujāṃ | tūnīpratūṇīvātaroge paṭhitā viśvācī ca || 113-117 ||

Gū. ajamodādipratyekaṃ karṣāṃśaṃ, pathyā harītakī pañcakarṣāḥ, vṛddhadāruḥ‘vidhārā’ hi.bhā.| prasiddhaḥ etasmāddaśakarṣāḥ syuḥ, śuṇṭhī nāgaraśuṇṭhī tasmācca daśakarṣāḥ syu:, etāni sarvāṇi ekatra cūrṇayet | etaccūrṇam ajamodādikaṃ koṣṇajalena pibet śothādināśakaṃ bhavati | samena guḍena vā asya vaṭakān kārayet || 113-117 ||
śvāsādau śuṇṭhyādicūrṇam | (śuṇṭhī sauvarcalaṃprakṣiptam | hiṅgu dāḍimaṃ cāmlavetasam ||118||
cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā peyaṃ śvāsahṛdrogaśāntaye |) atha hiṃgvādicūrṇaṃ śūlādau - hiṅgu pāṭhā'bhayā dhānyaṃ dāḍimaṃ citrakaḥ śaṭhī ||119||
ajamodā trikaṭukaṃ hapuṣā cāmlavetasam | ajagandhā tintiḍīkaṃ jīrakaṃ pauṣkaraṃ vacā ||120||
cavyaṃ kṣāradvayaṃ pañca lavaṇāni vicūrṇayet | prāgbhojanasya madhye vā cūrṇametatprayojayet ||121||
pibedvā jīrṇamadyena takreṇoṣṇodakena vā | gulme vātakaphodbhūte hṛdgrahe'ṣṭhīlikāsu‘viḍgrahe’ pā.| ca ||122 ||
hṛdbastipārśvaśūleṣu śūle ca gudayonije | mūtrakṛcchre tathānāhe pāṇḍuroge'rucau tathā ||123||
hikvāyāṃ yakṛti plīhni śvāse kāse galagrahe | grahaṇyarśovikāreṣu cūrṇametatpraśasyate || 124 ||
bhāvitaṃ mātuluṅgasya bahuśaḥ svarasena vā | kuryācca guṭikā bahvīrvātaśleṣmāmayāpahāḥ || 125 ||

Dī. adhunā hiṃgvādyaṃ cūrṇamāha - hiṃgviti | atra hiṅgu bharjitaṃ yojyaṃ, pāṭhā prasiddhā tasyā mūlam, abhayā harītakī, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni, hapuṣā jambuvadviṭapaviśeṣo vikhyātaḥ, ajagandhā barbarikā, tintiḍīkamamlaphalaṃ prasiddhaṃ, puṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ, kṣāradvayamiti yavakṣāraḥ svarjikākṣāraḥ | pañcalavaṇāni saindhavaprabhṛtikāni | prāgbhojanasyeti prātaḥkāle madhye vā bhojanamiśram | jīrṇamadyeneti jīrṇaṃ purātanaṃ guṇādhikatvāt | tathāhi ‘navaṃ madyamabhiṣyandi gudadoṣakaraṃ param | jīrṇaṃ ca sarvadoṣaghnaṃ laghutvaṃ ca kaphāpaham’ iti | kalpanāntaramāha | athavā etaccūrṇaṃ mātuluṅgasya rasena vā bahuśo bhāvayitvā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ | tāśca vātaśleṣmāmayāpahā bhavanti | bahuśa iti saptavārān | bahvīriti dviśāṇapramitāḥ ||118-125 ||

Gū. hiṅgu bharjitaṃ, pāṭhā, abhayā harītakī, dhānyaṃ prasiddhaṃ, dāḍimaṃ, citrakaṃ, śaṭhī karcūra:, ajamodā, trikaṭu, hapuṣā prasiddhā, amlavetasya raso vā cukraṃ vā, ajagandhā‘vāvarī’ hi.bhā.| vanatulasī, tintiḍīkaṃ, pauruṣaṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ; vacā, cavyaṃ, kṣāradvayaṃ sarjī iti dvayaṃ, yavakṣāraṃ, pañcalavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ śākambharīyaṃ sauvarcala sāmudraṃ biḍaṃ iti| sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ madyādinā pibet | keṣu gulmādiṣu etaccūrṇaṃ praśasyate | mātuluṅgasya svarasena vā guṭikāṃ kuryāt || 118-125 ||

div.ab: atha yamānīkhāṇḍavacūrṇamarocakādau - yamānī dāḍimaṃ śuṇṭhī tintinīkāmlavetasau | badarāmlaṃ ca kurvīta catuḥśāṇamitāni ca || 126 || sārdhadviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ pippalī daśaśāṇikā | tvaksauvarcaladhānyākaṃ jīrakaṃ dvidviśāṇakam ||127 || catuḥṣaṣṭimitaiḥ śāṇai śarkarāmatra yojayet | cūrṇitaṃ sarvamekatra yamānīkhāṇḍavābhidham|| 128|| cūrṇaṃ jayetpāṇḍurogaṃ hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ jvaram | chardiśoṣātisārāṃśca plīhānāhavibandhatām||129|| aruciṃ śūlamandāgnimarśojihvāgalāmayān |

ab.seg: Dī. atha yamānīkhāṇḍavasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇamāha - yamānīti | yamānī prasiddhā, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni, tintiḍīkaṃ prasiddhaṃ, badarāmlamiti badaraṃ prasiddham, amlaṃ vṛkṣāmlaṃ vṛkṣabhedaḥ sa ca phalāmlaḥ, yadvā badarāmlamamlabadaraṃ khāṇḍavatvāt, catuḥśāṇamitānīti pratyekaṃ sārdhadviśāṇaṃ | maricamiti tena daśamāṣakamityarthaḥ | tvagā- dijīrakāntaṃ pratyekaṃ dviśāṇaṃ tvak sauvarcaladhānyakamityasya sthāne “kṛmighnamakṣaṃ dhānyatvak” iti paṭhanti tatrāpi akṣaṃ sauvarcalaṃ khāṇḍavābhidhamiti prasiddheḥ | yataḥ “lavaṇāmlasitāyukta: khāṇḍavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ” iti | śoṣo mukhaśoṣaḥ kṣayabhedo vā, ānāha udarāpūraḥ, vibandho vātādīnāmapravṛttiḥ, jihvāgalāmayāniti jihvāmayān, galāmayānityartha:||126-129 ||

Gū. yamānyādīni catuḥśāṇamitāni, maricaṃ sārdhadviśāṇam ardhaṭaṅkopari dviṭaṅkaṃ, pippalī daśaśāṇā, tvagādikaṃ dvidviśāṇakam | atra śarkarāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭimitaśāṇairyojayet | etat yamānīkhāṇḍavābhidhaṃ pāṇḍurogādīn jayet| dāḍimam amlaṃ madhuraṃ vā, sauvarcalaṃ prasiddham, amlavetasya svarasaṃ vā, cukraṃ karṣamātraṃ, pippalīnām ekaṃ śataṃ, maricasya dve śate, guṇanayanāttvanyasaṃkhyayā atra śarkarāyāścatvāri phalāni, palamatra ṣoḍaśaṭaṅkānām, anyathā catuḥṣaṣṭimitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ śarkarāmatra yojayedityanena virodhaḥ syāt | kecitkhāṇḍave lavaṇaṃ madhurayoge sādhu svabhāvāt, lavaṇaṃ nikṣipediti vadanti || atha pṛthvīkādyaṃ cūrṇam arocakādau granthāntarāt - “pṛthvīkā jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca tathaiva ca | citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā | maricaṃ dīpyakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāmlaṃ cāmlavetasam || ajamodājagandhā ca dadhitthaṃ ceti kārṣikān | pradeyaṃ cātiśuddhāyāḥ śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakaṃ || cūrṇametatprasādaṃ syāt paramaṃ rucivardhanaṃ | tīvrakāsāmayārśāṃsi śūlaṃ kāsaṃ vamiṃ jvaraṃ || nihanti dīpayatyagniṃ balavarṇapradaṃ paraṃ | vātānulomanaṃ hṛdyaṃ kaṇṭhajihvāviśodhanam” iti | pṛthvīkā sūkṣmailā, ajagandhā vāvarī, dadhitthaṃ kapitthaṃ | idamapi khāṇḍavaṃ cūrṇam || 126-129 ||

div.ab: atha tālīsādicūrṇam arocakādau - tālīsaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī vaṃśarocanam ||130|| ekadvitricatuḥpañcakarṣairbhāgānprakalpayet | elātvacostu karṣārdhaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāgamācaret || 131|| dvātriṃśatkarṣatulitā pradeyā śarkarā budhaiḥ | tālīsādyamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ rocanaṃ pācanaṃ smṛtam|| 132|| kāsaśvāsajvaraharaṃ chardyatīsāranāśanam | śoṣādhmānaharaṃ plīhāgrahaṇīpāṇḍurogajit || 133|| paktvā vā śarkarāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣipetsyādguṭikā tataḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. tālīsādikamapyāha - tālīsamiti | tālīsaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, vaṃśarocanaṃ vaṃśakṣīrī, etaddravyapañcakamādi- dravyāt karṣaikaikena vardhitaṃ grāhyam | tena tālīsaṃ karṣaikaṃ, maricaṃ karṣadvayaṃ, śuṇṭhī karṣatrayā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā, vaṃśa- rocanaṃ pañcakarṣam, elātvacostu karṣārdhamiti | elā kṣudrailā, tvag varāṅgaṃ karṣārdhamiti śāṇadvayamityarthaḥ | pratyekamiti pṛthagityarthaḥ | śarkarā'tra dvātriṃśat karṣatulitā deyā, etena sakalacūrṇāddviguṇā śarkarā bhavati tīkṣṇatvāt | veti grahaṇena pakṣāntaramāha - samajale śarkarāṃ paktvā tatra cūrṇaṃ prakṣipya guṭikā kāryā laghutaratvāt tathāhi - “kalpayedguṭikāścaitaccūrṇāt paktvā sitopalām | guṭikā hyagnisaṃyogāccūrṇāllaghutarāḥ smṛtā? iti | etadapi vāṃśīṃ vinā pracarati | tathāca tantrāntare - “tālīśaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalyekāṃśakottarā | tvagelārdhāṃśakaṃ dadyāt śarkarā kuḍakaṃ bhavet” ityādi | anyatrāpi “tālīsamaricanāgaraṃ kṛṣṇāḥ karṣottarāḥ kramastvagele cārdhāṃśe kuḍavaṃ sitā guṭikā vipācya kṛtāḥ” iti kecidvadanti | pitte vaṃśarocanā deyeti | tathāhyuktam - “’pittayukte bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ vaṃśarocanayānvitam” iti granthāntaradarśanāt | taduktaṃ - “vāṃśīpippaliśuṇṭhīnāṃ tālīsoṣaṇayostathā | bhāgavṛddhiḥ kramādantyā tvagele cāpi sārdhake || kṛṣṇā tvaṣṭaguṇā cātra pradeyā sitaśarkarā” ityādi ||130-133||

Gū. tālīsam ekakarṣaṃ, maricaṃ dvikarṣaṃ, śuṇḍī trikarṣā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā, vāṃśī rocanā pañcakarṣā, evaṃ bhāgānprakalpayet, elā laghvelā, tvak tajaḥ, etayoḥ pratyekaṃ karṣārdhaṃ śarkarāyā dvātriṃśatkarṣāḥ | śarkarāṃ paktvā cūrṇe nikṣipet | tato guṭikā syāt | idaṃ tālīsādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ rocanaṃ pācanaṃ tathā kāsādiharam ||130-133 ||
atha sitopalādicūrṇaṃ kāsakṣayapittadāhādau - sitopalā ṣoḍaśa syādaṣṭau syādvaṃśarocanā ||134||
pippalī syāccatuṣkarṣā syādelā ca dvikārṣikī | ekaḥ karṣastvacaḥ kāryaścūrṇayetsarvamekataḥ ||135||
sitopalādikaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhusarpiryutaṃ lihet | śvāsakāsakṣayaharaṃ hastapādāṅgadāhajit ||136 ||
mandāgniṃ suptajihvatvaṃ pārśvaśūlamarocakam | jvaramūrdhvagataṃ raktaṃ pittamāśu vyapohati ||137||

Dī. atha sitopalādicūrṇamāha - sitopaleti | sitopalā śarkarābhedaḥ | ṣoḍaśeti ṣoḍaśakarṣamitā | vaṃśarocanā aṣṭau syāditi aṣṭakarṣamitā, agrimakarṣagrahaṇāt | antyāt dviguṇitatvānmānanirdeśo'yam | tathācoktaṃ -“sitopalā tugākṣīrī pippalībahulā tvacaḥ | antyādūrdhvaṃ dviguṇita lehayenmadhusarpiṣā||” iti | bahulā kṣudrailā, madhu sarpiścātra lehavat parimitaṃ | hastapādāṅgadāhajiditi | tena hastadāhaṃ, pādadāhaṃ, aṅgadāhamiti suptajihvatvamiti jihvāroge paṭhitam || 134-137 ||

Gū. sitopalā prasiddhā, aṣṭau karṣāḥ vaṃśarocanā, pippalī catuḥkarṣā syāt, elā dvikārṣikī, tvacaḥ ekakarṣaḥ, evaṃ ṣoḍaśakarṣaṃ syāt| etatsitopalādicūrṇaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ lihet ścāsādikān vyapohati ||134-137||
atha lavaṇabhāskaracūrṇaṃ grahaṇīgulmādau - sāmudralavaṇaṃ kāryamaṣṭakarṣamitaṃ budhaiḥ | pañca sauvarcalaṃ grāhyaṃ niḍaṃ saindhavadhānyakāt || 138||
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ kṛṣṇajīrakapatrakam | nāgakeśaratālīsamamlavetasakaṃ tathā || 139 ||
dvikarṣamātrāṇyetāni pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | maricaṃ jīrakaṃ viśvamekaikaṃ karṣamātrakam || 140 ||
dāḍimaṃ syāccatuṣkarṣaṃ tvagele cārdhakārṣike | etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhāskarābhidham ||141 ||
śāṇapramāṇaṃ deyaṃ tu mastutakrasurāsavaiḥ | vātaśleṣmabhavaṃ gulmaṃ plīhānamudaraṃ kṣayam‘kṣataṃ’ pā. | || 142||
arśāṃsi grahaṇīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vibandha‘vividhaṃ’ pā. | ca bhagandaram | śophaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsakāsāvāmavātaṃ ca hṛdrujam || 143||
mandāgniṃ nāśayedetaddīpanaṃ pācanaṃ param | sarvalokahitārthāya bhāskareṇoditaṃ purā ||144||

Dī. idānīṃ lavaṇabhāskaraṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - sāmudralavaṇamiti | dakṣiṇasamudrasamīpe bhavaṃ sāmudraṃ lavaṇaṃ tacca samaṭīśabdavācyam aṣṭakarṣaṃ paladvayam, pañca sauvarcalaṃ grāhyamiti sauvarcalalavaṇaṃ pañcakarṣaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | biḍalavaṇādyamlavetasāntaṃ dviguṇakarṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, biḍaṃ kṛtrimaṃ lavaṇaṃ tacca prasāriṇī kalka- bhaktalavaṇasaṃyogādagnidāhena nivṛttamityeke, sindhubhavaṃ saindhavaṃ, kṛṣṇajīrakaṃ pāścātyaṃ,tacca khurāsānaśabdavācyaṃ, maricādiviśvāntaṃ dravyatrayaṃ karṣaṃ pratyekamityarthaḥ | jīrakamatra śuklaṃ , viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, dāḍimaṃ syāccatuḥkarṣamiti dāḍi- maphalabījāni grāhyāṇi tacca anāradānāśabdavācyaṃ, catuḥkarṣaṃ palaparimitaṃ | tvagele cārdhakārṣika iti militvā karṣamātramityartha: | bhakṣaṇe ca śāṇapramāṇaṃ ṭaṅkamātraṃ deyaṃ, tīkṣṇatvāt | tat punaḥ iti grahaṇenādhikamātramapi praca- rati doṣādīnāṃ balātiśayatvāt| mastutakrasurāsavairiti | mastu dadhno'dhastoyaviśeṣaḥ | ‘dadhnastu yadadhastoyaṃ tanmastu parikīrtitam |’ takramiti tribhāgabhinnaṃ, surāsavau prasiddhau, surā lohitavarṇā, piṣṭakiṇvakalkena kiñcit kaluṣā āśu kriyante ye te āsavāḥ, bhāskareṇa bhāskarācāryeṇa uditaṃ kathitaṃ purā pūrvapauruṣeyagranthānāmādāvityarthaḥ | na tu ṛṣipraṇītebhya iti kecit || 138-144 ||

Gū. sāmudralavaṇaṃ budhaiḥ aṣṭakarṣaṃ kāryaṃ, pañcakarṣaṃ saptaircalaṃ, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ tadādyamlavetasakāntaṃ daśauṣadhaṃ pratyekaṃ dvidvikarṣaṃ, āmlavetasasya rasaṃ vā cukraṃ vā grāhyaṃ, maricaṃ jīrakaṃ, viśvam etatpratyekaṃ karṣamātraṃ, jīrakaṃ śvetaṃ, viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī, dāḍimaṃ catuḥkarṣaṃ, tvagelā ca ardhakārṣikaṃ pratyekaṃ dvidviṭaṅkaṃ | etaccūrṇakṛtaṃ lavaṇabhāskaraṃ bhavati śāṇapramāṇaṃ ṭaṅkapramāṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ deyaṃ, ārśādīni ca nāśayati | idaṃ bhāskareṇa sūryeṇa uditam ||138-144||

div.ab: atha elādicūrṇaṃ chardiroge - elāpriyaṅgumustāni kolamajjā ca pippalī | śrīcandanaṃ tathā lājā lavaṅgaṃ nāgakeśaram || 145|| etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ lihet | vātapittakaphodbhūtāṃ chardiṃ hantyativegataḥ ||146 || vyāghrīcūrṇam | (vyāghrījīrakadhātrīṇāṃprakṣiptam | cūrṇaṃ madhuyutaṃ lihet | ūrdhvavātamahāśvāsatamakairmucyate kṣaṇāt ||147||)

ab.seg: Dī. elādicūrṇamāha - elā priyaṅgumustānīti | elā sūkṣmailā, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, kolamajjā badaraphalāsthimadhyagatadravyaviśeṣaḥ, śrīcandanaṃ śvetacandanaṃ, lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavā | etatsakalaṃ samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya vastrapūtaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuryāt | bhakṣaṇamānamasya doṣāgnibalāpekṣayā kāryam | sitākṣaudrayutamitītyarthaḥ | (sitānāsti ‘kha’ pustake | śarkarā sā dhānyacūrṇasamā grāhyā, madhumānaṃ ca yāvadavalehatvaṃ syāt tāvaddeyamityarthaḥ) | ativegata iti vacanenāsya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam ||145-147 ||

div.ab: Gū. kolaṃ badaraṃ tanmajjā, śrīcandanaṃ malayajaṃ lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyajāṃ sarvasamaṃ sitā sitopalā || 145 -147 ||

ab.seg: atha pañcanimbacūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhādau - mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvacaṃ nimbātsamāharet | sūkṣmacūrṇamidaṃ kuryātpalapañcadaśonmitam || 148||
lohabhasmaharītakyau cakramardakacitrakau | bhallātakaṃ viḍaṅgāni śarkarāmalakaṃ niśā || 149 ||
pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī bākucī kṛtamālakaḥ | gokṣuraśca palonmānamekaikaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 150 ||
sarvamekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgarājena bhāvayet | aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭena khadirāsanavāriṇā || 151 ||
bhāvayitvā ca saṃśoṣya karṣamātraṃ tataḥ pibet | khadirāsanatoyena sarpiṣā payasāthavā || 152 ||
māsena sarvakuṣṭhāni vinihanti rasāyanam | pañcanimbamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvarogapraṇāśanam ||153||

Dī. adhunā pañcanimbacūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - mūlamiti | mūlamityādinā nimbavṛkṣasya pañcāṅgaṃ kathitaṃ; mūlaṃ jaṭā patraṃ palāśaṃ phalamāmabījaṃ puṣpaṃ kusumaṃ tvak challī | samāharediti samyak prakāreṇa āharediti yaduktaṃ tat kālaviśeṣaṃ sūcayati | tathāhi “puṣpakāle ca puṣpāṇi phalakāle phalāni ca | saṃcūrṇya picumardasya tvaṅmūlāni dalāni ca” iti| eke mūlasthāne sāramiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tatra sāraṃ madhyabhāgasthitaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣam, uktamanyatrāpi “kāle tvagdalasārabījakusumairnimbasya tulyāṃśakaiḥ” ityādi | pañcadaśonmitaṃ phalamiti sakalapañcāṅgaṃ pañcadaśapalaparimitaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | tena pratyekaṃ tripalamitaṃ bhavati | lohabhasmeti mṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, cakramardakaḥ prapunnāṭabījāni, āmalamāmalakīphalaṃ, niśā haridrā, kṛtamālako rājavṛkṣaḥ etallohabhasmādigokṣurakāntaṃ pṛthak palamānaṃ grāhyam, tena nimbacūrṇasamaṃ bhavati | etat sakalaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ dravyaṃ bhṛṅgarājarasena bhāvitaṃ kṛtvā paścādaṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣeṇa khadirakvāthena tat paścādasanakvāthena ca bhāvyam, asanaḥ pītamāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, paścāt saṃśoṣya karṣaparimāṇamitaṃ vakṣyamāṇānupānena saha pibedityarthaḥ | anupānānyāha - khadirāsanatoyeneti | khadirakāṣṭhakvathitena asanakāṣṭhakvathitena vetyarthaḥ | athavā sarpiṣā payasā ca atra doṣāpekṣā boddhavyā | rasāyanamiti jarāvyādhināśakatvena rasāyanaṃ kathitaṃ| paccanimbamiti nimbasambandhipuṣpādipañcakameva nimbapañcakaṃ kathitaṃ | tathāhi “nimbapatraṃ tathā puṣpaṃ tvaṅmūlaṃ phalamucyate | pañcanimbamiti khyātaṃ nāmataḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ” iti | sarvarogapraṇāśanamiti | sarvarogā bhagandarapramukhāḥ | tathāhyuktam - “bhagaṃdaraḥ ślīpadavātaraktajaḍāndhanāḍīvraṇaśīrṣarogān | sarvān pramehān pradarāṃśca sarvān daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ mūlaviṣaṃ nihanti || sthūlodaraḥ siṃhakṛśodaraḥ syāt suśliṣṭasandhirmadhunopayogāt | sadopayogādapiye daśanti sarpādayo yāṃti vināśamāśu || jīvecciraṃ vyādhijarāvimuktaḥ śubhetaraścaṃdrasamānakāntiḥ” iti ||148-153 ||

Gū. nimbānmūlādikaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ samāharet| idaṃ paścadaśonmitaiḥ palaiścūrṇaṃ kuryāt| ekam ekapalalohabhasmādikam ekaikaṃ palonmitaṃ kārayet | cakramardaḥ‘panabāḍa’ hi.bhā. | prapunnāṭaḥ, śarkarā sitopalā, niśā haridrā, bākucī kṛmighnaḥ, kṛtamālaḥ āragvadhaḥ, khadiraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya sāraḥ, asanaḥvijayasāra’ hi.bhā.| pītamāraḥ eṣāṃ kvāthena bhāvayet vāratrayaṃ vā sapta vā punaḥ saṃśoṣya karṣaṃ khadirāsanaṃ pibet || 148-153||
śatāvarīcūrṇam - śatāvarī gokṣuraśca bījaṃ ca kapikacchujam | gāṅgerukī cātibalā bījamikṣurakodbhavam || 154 ||
cūrṇitaṃ sarvamekatra godugdhena pibenniśi | na tṛptiṃ yāti nārībhirnaraścūrṇaprabhāvataḥ ||155||
aśvagandhādicūrṇam - aśvagandhā daśapalā tanmātro vṛddhadāruka: | cūrṇīkṛtyobhayaṃ vidvānghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||156||
karṣaikaṃ payasā pītvā nārībhirnaiva tṛpyati | agatvā pramadāṃ bhūyādvalīpalitavarjitaḥ ||157||

Dī. idānīṃ vājīkaraṇacūrṇadvayamāha - śatāvarītyādi | kapikacchujaṃ | bījamiti vānarībījaṃ, gāṃgerukīti nāgabalā “guḍasakarīti” śabdavācyā, atibalā bṛhadvalā, bījamikṣurakodbhavamiti ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣa: “tālamakhānā” iti loke, etat sarvaṃ cūrṇīkṛtamuktamānaparimitaṃ ca caturguṇena godugdhena saha pibet | niśi rātrau | vājīkaraṇamiti vājīvātyarthamaithunasāmarthyāt bājīkaraṇaṃ, kiṃ vā vāja śukraṃ tadasyāstīti vājī avājī vājī kriyate yena puruṣastadvājīkaraṇaṃ | taduktam “yena nārīṣu sāmarthyaṃ vājīvallabhate naraḥ | yena vātyadhikaṃ bījaṃ vājīkaraṇameva tat” iti | tattu trividhaṃ pravartakaṃ janakaṃ pravartakajanakaṃ ca | uktaṃ ca tantrāntare - “śukravṛddhikaraṃ kiñcit kiñcit śukrapravartakam| cyutivṛddhikaraṃ kiñcit trividhaṃ vṛṣyamucyate” iti | vṛṣyaṃ tu vājīkaraṇasaṃjñam | tathāca yuvatisparśādi cyutikaraṃ, kṣīrādi vṛddhikaraṃ, māṣo janakaḥ pravartakaśca | dvitīyavājīkaraṇacūrṇaṃ subodhaṃ kecinnātra paṭhanti || 154-157 ||
Gū. athāśvagandhādicūrṇaṃ puṣṭau sugamaṃ vṛddhadāruka: prasiddha:|| 154-157||

div.ab: musalīcūrṇam - (musalīkandacūrṇaṃprakṣiptam | tu guḍūcīsattvasaṃyutam | vānarīgokṣurābhyāṃ ca śālmalīśarkarāmalaiḥ ||158 || āloḍya ghṛtadugdhena pāyayetkāmavardhanam |)

navāyasacūrṇam - citrakastriphalā mustaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ tryūṣaṇāni ca ||159|| samabhāgāni kāryāṇi nava bhāgā hatāyasaḥ | etadekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhusarpiryutaṃ lihet ||160|| gomūtramathavā takramanupāne praśasyate | pāṇḍurogaṃ jayatyugraṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca bhagandaram ||161|| śothakuṣṭhodarārśāṃsi mandāgnimaruciṃ kṛmīn |

ab.seg: Dī. atha navāyasaṃ cūrṇamāha - citraka iti | citrakaścitrakajaṭāstvak, triphalā harītakyādi, tryūṣaṇaṃ kaṭutrikaṃ etaccitrakāditryūṣaṇāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ samamātraṃ, navabhāgā hatāyasa iti hatāyaso mṛtalohasya eka- dravyabhāgāpekṣayā navabhāgā grāhyā:, tenaikatra militānāṃ citrakādīnāṃ cūrṇena samamayaścūrṇamityarthaḥ | madhusarpiṣī cātra lehaparimāṇavadgrāhye || 158-161 ||
Gū. citrakaḥ, triphalā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, viḍaṅgaṃ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu etāni pratyekaṃ śāṇamātrāṇi hatāyasaṃ mṛtalohaṃ sarvatulyaṃ madhusarpirghṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ lihet | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 158-161 ||

div.ab: ākārakarabhādicūrṇaṃ stambhanādau - ākārakarabhaḥ śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ kuṅkamaṃ kaṇā ||162|| jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca candanaṃ ceti kārṣikān | cūrṇāni mānataḥ kuryādahiphenaṃ palonmitam|| 163|| sarvamekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ māṣaikaṃ madhunā lihet | śukrastambhakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ puṃsāmānandakārakam ||164|| nārīṇāṃ prītijananaṃ seveta niśi kāmukaḥ || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe cūrṇakalpanā nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. athākārakarabhādicūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - ākārakarabha iti | ‘akarakarahā’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ, kaṃkolaṃ vikhyātaṃ kaṇā pippalī, candanaṃ śvetam, etatsarvaṃ karṣonmitaṃ pratyekamiti | ahiphenaṃ palonmitamiti ahiphenam āphūśabdavācyam ‘aphīma’ iti loke, palonmitaṃ palapramāṇam, tena pūrvacūrṇabhāgadvayaṃ ahiphenasya bhāgaikamityarthaḥ | śarkarārahitatvāt kutracit sitāsahitamapi pracarati, tatra ahiphenaṃ pūrvadravyacūrṇasāmyaṃ | taduktaṃ “jātīphalārkakarahāṭalavaṅgaśuṇṭhīkaṃkolakuṃkumakaṇāharicandanāni | etaiḥ samānamahiphenamanena tulyāṃ sitāṃ nidhāya madhunā vaṭakaṃ vidadhyāt || māṣadvayonmitamamuṃ niśi bhakṣayitvā miṣṭaṃ payastadanu māhiṣamāśu pītvā | kurvantu kāmukajanā na tu bindupātaṃ cetāṃsi tāni cakitāni kalāvatīnām” iti || 162-164 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe cūrṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ || 6 ||

Gū. ākārakarabhaḥ ākallakaḥ, śuṇṭhī, kaṃkolaṃ, kuṅkumaṃ keśaram, kaṇā pippalī, jātiphalaṃ, lavaṅgaṃ, candanaṃ ceti, kaṅkolaṃ kecit śītalacīnīti kecitpūgam ityāhuḥ | kārṣikānpratyekaṃ kārṣikān | ahiphenaṃ palonmitaṃ karṣacatuṣṭayaṃ tat śuddhaṃ kṛtvā deyaṃ | tasya śodhanam ārdrakadraveṇa sehuṇḍapatradraveṇa vā nimbadraveṇa vā nimbūkadraveṇa bhāvanābhiḥ saptabhirvā śodhayitvā śoṣayitvā deyam || 162-164 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne cūrṇādhyāyaḥ || 6||

div.head: atha guṭikādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | vaṭakāścātha kathyante tannāma guṭikā vaṭī | modako vaṭikā piṇḍī guḍo vartistathocyate ||1||
lehavatsādhyate vahnau guḍo vā śarkarā tathā | guggulurvā kṣipettatra cūrṇaṃ tannirmitā vaṭī ||2||
kuryādavahnisiddhena kvacidguggulunā vaṭīm | draveṇa madhunā vāpi guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||3||

Dī. idānīṃ guṭikāḥ kathyante - vaṭakāśceti | atheti cūrṇakalpanānantaraṃ vaṭakā guṭikādisaṃjñāḥ ata eva tannāma guṭikāvaṭīprabhṛtayo jñātavyāḥ | tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavācakāḥ śabdā yathā tannāmeti tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavākyaṃ guṭikādikamityarthaḥ | atha teṣāṃ kartavyavidhimāha - lehavatsādhyata iti | yathāvalehārthaṃ guḍādikaṃ sādhyate tathaivā'tra guḍaḥ, śarkarā, guggulurvāpi paktavya:, pāke sati cūrṇaṃ prakṣipya vaṭakādīn kuryāditi bhāva: | pakṣāntaramāha - kvaciditi | na sarvatra avahnisiddhena kuṭṭitena guggulunā vaṭakāḥ kāryāḥ guḍādikenāpi kvaciditi saṃcārādvā, athavā draveṇa toyakṣīrādinā madhunā kṣaudreṇāpi saṃplāvya guṭikāṃ kārayet budhaḥ paṇḍitaḥ atrāpi vahniṃ vineti sambandhaḥ ||1-3 ||
Gū. atha guṭikādhikāraḥ || 1-3 ||

div.ab: sitā caturguṇā deyā vaṭīṣu dviguṇo guḍaḥ | cūrṇāccūrṇasamaḥ kāryo guggulurmadhu tatsamam || 4 || dravaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ modakeṣu bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīmanukteṣu guḍaśarkarādīnāṃ mānamāha - siteti | sitā śarkarā caturguṇā deyā cūrṇādityarthaḥ | guḍo'tra dviguṇaḥ, atrā'pi cūrṇabhāgāditi bhāvaḥ | (gugguluścanāsti ‘kha’ pustake | cūrṇasamaḥ cūrṇabhāgasamāna ityarthaḥ | madhu tatsamamiti madhu kṣaudraṃ tatsamaṃ cūrṇasamaṃ dravyaṃ kṣīratoyādikaṃ dviguṇaṃ cūrṇabhāgādityarthaḥ) | cūrṇamatra sakaladravyāṇāṃ bhiṣagvarairiti grahaṇena svabuddhyā vā yathāyogyamavacārayediti sāṃpradāyikāḥ || 4 ||
karṣapramāṇaṃ tanmānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayujyate || 5 ||

Dī. atha bhakṣaṇamānamanuktānāṃ darśayannāha - karṣapramāṇamiti | karṣapramāṇaṃ karṣamātraṃ tanmānamiti tat teṣāṃ vaṭakādīnāṃ mānaṃ parimāṇaṃ | balamiti dehabalaṃ doṣabalaṃ vyādhibalaṃ ca | balagrahaṇena karṣamānamatra sāmānyaṃ sūcitam | ata eva dṛṣṭvā vicāryetyarthaḥ | vicāraṇātra bālavṛddhānāmeva madhyānāṃ tu karṣamātraiva || 5 ||

div.ab: atha śrībāhuśālo guḍaḥ arśādau - sa yathā - indravāruṇikā mustaṃ śuṇṭhī dantī harītakī | trivṛcchaṭhī viḍaṅgāni gokṣuraścitrakastathā || 6 || tejohvā ca dvikarṣāṇi pṛthagdravyāṇi kārayet | sūraṇasya palānyaṣṭau vṛddhadāru catuṣpalam ||7|| catuṣpalaṃ syādbhallātaḥ kvāthayetsarvamekataḥ | jaladroṇe caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyātkvāthamuttamam || 8 || kvāthyadravyāttriguṇitaṃ guḍaṃ kṣiptvā punaḥ pacet | samyakpakvaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā cūrṇametatpradāpayet ||9|| citrakatrivṛtādantītejohvā: palikāḥ pṛthak | pṛthaktripalikāḥ kāryā vyoṣailāmalakatvacaḥ‘maricaṃ’ pā.| ||10|| nikṣipenmadhu śīte ca tasminprasthapramāṇataḥ | evaṃ siddho bhavecchrīmānbāhuśālaguḍā'bhidhaḥ ||11|| jayedarśāṃsi sarvāṇi gulmaṃ vātodaraṃ tathā | āḍhyavātapratiśyāyaṃ mahāntaṃ kṣayapīnasam ||12|| halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ pramehaṃ ca rasāyanam |

ab.seg: Dī. sa yatheti vacanaṃ guṭikāsamūhapratipādanārthamabhihitamācāryeṇa | tatrādau śrībāhuśālo nāma guḍastaṃ darśayannāha - indravāruṇiketi | ayaṃ bāhuśālaguḍo'rśovyādhau śastaḥ, tathendravāruṇikā cirbhaṭī tasyā mūlaṃ, dantī viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi mūlaṃ; trivṛnniśothamūlameva, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, tejohvā'tra cavyaṃ yatra ca tejohvā cavikā tatra tejohvā jyotiṣmatī evaṃ sarvatra | ( etatsarvaṃ‘nāsti ‘kha’ pustake | pratyekaṃ dvikarṣaparimitaṃ bhavati | śūraṇasya palānyaṣṭāviti sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasyāṣṭau palāni bhavanti; vṛddhadāru catuṣpalamiti niśothabhedaḥ tasya catuṣpalāni, bhallātamiti bhallātakaphalāni tāni catuṣpalamitāni bhavanti) etatsakalaṃ pānīyadroṇe saṃkvāthya caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyāt| jaladroṇamiti caturāḍhakaparimitaṃ jalaṃ tena ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatadvayapalāni jalaparimāṇaṃ bhavati | u- ttamamiti vastragālitādikaṃ tenottamatā kvathitasyetyarthaḥ | caturthāṃśamityāḍhakamātraṃ kvāthyadravyāt triguṇitaṃ guḍa- miti guḍamatra jīrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, kvāthyadravyāditi indravāruṇikāditejohvāntāt triguṇitaṃ tribhāgam etaduḍaṃ pāda- śeṣakāthe kṣiptvā punaḥ pacedyāvat sāndro bhavati | atra cūrṇamāha - citraketyādi | citrakaścitrakajaṭā, trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, tejohvā cavī etaddravyacatuṣṭayaṃ palapramāṇam, anyadapyāha - vyoṣailāmalakatvaca ityādi | vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tvak guḍatvak idamapi dravyaṣaṭkaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ | śrībāhuśālo guḍa evaṃ siddho bhavati | bāhuśāla ācāryaviśeṣastena nirmito guḍaḥ vaṭakasaṃjña ityarthaḥ | āḍhyavāta ūrustambhabhedaḥ | mahāntaṃ prabalamityarthaḥ | rasāyana iti prabhāvāt | tadyathā “yajjarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tadrasāyanam” iti || 6-12 ||

Gū. sa yathā sugamam | tejohvātejabala | tumburuḥ, kvāthāṃśadravyam indravāruṇikādyā tasmātriguṇaṃ guḍaṃ saṃpakve citrakādīni dāpayet | trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, tejohvā tumburuḥ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, elā sūkṣmā; maricaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ trikaṭumadhye grahaṇāt “ekamapyauṣadhaṃ yasmin yoge yatpunarucyate | mānato dviguṇaṃ jñeyam” ityuktatvāt | dviguṇaṃ maricakaṃ yadvā maricakaṅkolaṃ, tvakdālacīnī | prasiddhaṃ, madhu prasthapramitaṃ prasthamānam, evaṃ prasiddhaḥ śrībāhuśālaguḍaḥ bāhuśālo nāma kaścit, tadarthaṃ praṇītatvāt bāhuśālaḥ śrīmān śrīkaratvāt spaṣṭamanyat | nanu ādau jvaraghnī guṭikā kathaṃ noktā rogagaṇanāyāṃ jvarasyaiva prādhānyāt ? ucyate ? asya rasāyanatvāt jvarādivyādhināśakatvaṃ samāgataṃ, “yajjarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tadrasāyana”mityukteḥ | vyādhimātragrahaṇe jvarasyā'pi grahaṇāt | yadvā arśorogasyāpi jvarādivyādhisaṃjñakatvādādāvabhidhānaṃ kramābhāvādvyatikramābhidhānam || 6-12 ||
atha maricādiguṭikā kāsādau - maricaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātpippalī karṣasaṃmitā || 13 ||
ardhakarṣo yavakṣāraḥ karṣayugmaṃ ca dāḍimam | etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ yuñjyādaṣṭakarṣaguḍena hi ||14||
śāṇapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā vaktreṇa dhārayet | asyā: prabhāvātsarve'pi kāsā yāntyeva saṃkṣayam ||15||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ maricādiguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - maricamiti | asyā maricādikāyā vaṭikāyāḥ prabhāvādacintyaśaktiḥ | sarve kāsā iti pañcaprakārāḥ | atra dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni karṣayugmamiti karṣadvayaṃ vakre dhārayediti, atra vakradhāraṇādidamauṣadhaṃ dhūmarūpamityāhureke, cakreṇa tu svasaṃgrahe bhakṣaṇacūrṇadvayaṃ vakre dhārayediti prastāve likhitaṃ vaidyaprasārake'pi ||

ab.seg: śvāsakāsādau guḍavaṭikā | guḍaśuṇṭhīśivāmustairguṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe | śvāsakāseṣu sarveṣu bibhītaṃ vāpi kevalam ||16||
Dī. ( guṭikāsvarūpabhakṣaṇamasyoktam, etadabhiprāyeṇātra likhitaṃ | guḍaśuṇṭhīti spaṣṭam) ||13-16||

div.ab: āmalakyādiguṭikā tṛṣṇādau - āmalaṃ kamalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lājāśca vaṭarohakaḥ | etaccūrṇasya madhunā guṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe ||17|| tṛṣṇā pravṛddhāṃ hantyeṣā mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇam |

ab.seg: Dī. athāmalakyādiguṭikāmāha - āmalamiti | āmalamāmalakaphalaṃ kamalamutpalaṃ tadabhāve kamalabījāni grāhyāṇi, lājāḥ bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavāḥ, vaṭarohaka iti vaṭavṛkṣaprarohaḥ sa ca vaṭarohaśabdavācya:, madhvatra guṭikākaraṇamānaṃ paribhāṣoktam, dhārayenmukha iti | etena yathā yathā guṭikā dravati tathā tathā śīlanīyā punarimāṃ sahasaivābhyavaharediti dṛṣṭaparicayaḥ | pravṛddhāmiti kairapi yogairanivāryām | mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇamiti dāruṇaṃ duḥkhakaramasādhyamityarthaḥ || 17 ||
Gū. āmalam āmalakaṃ, kamalaṃ kamalapatraṃ phalaṃ vā, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, lājā dhānyajā, vaṭarohakaṃ vaṭārohaḥ, kuṣṭhā'bhāve drākṣā vā deyā kuṣṭhasyātīvoṣṇatvāt ||17 ||

div.ab: atha jvare sañjīvanīvaṭī tridoṣe ca - viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇā pathyāmalabibhītakam ||18|| vacā guḍūcī bhallātaṃ sadviṣaṃ cātra yojayet | etāni samabhāgāni gomūtreṇaiva peṣayet||19|| guñjābhā guṭikā kāryā dadyādārdrakajai rasaiḥ | ekāmajīrṇagulmeṣu dve viṣūcyāṃ pradāpayet ||20|| tisraśca sarpadaṣṭe tu catasraḥ sāṃnipātike | vaṭī saṃjīvanī nāmnā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||2 1||

ab.seg: Dī. atha sañjīvanīguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - viḍaṅgamiti | atra nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, pathyā harītakī, āmalamāmalakaphalaṃ, bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, sadviṣamiti śuddhaṃ viṣaṃ eteṣāṃ samānamātrā boddhavyā | gomūtramatra guṭikārdhaparimitaṃ | guñjābhā guñjāparimāṇā vaṭī kāryā, ārdrakaraso'trānupānaṃ, ajīrṇagulmayorekaikāvaṭī deyā, visūcyāṃ dve vaṭyau, sarpadaṣṭe tisro guṭikāḥ, sannipāte catasra iti nāmnā kṛtvā sañjīvanī kathitā yato'syāḥ prabhāvānmānavo yadā mumūrṣustadā jīvatīti | vicāraṇātra na kāryā, “avicintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ” iti vacanāt ||18-21 ||
Gū. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, pathyā harītakī, āmalakaṃ, bibhītakam akṣa:; bhallātakaṃ prasiddhaṃ | tadabhāve bākucirdeyā, sadviṣam uttamaṃ viṣaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 18-21 ||

div.ab: atha vyoṣādiguṭikā pīnasādau - vyoṣāmlavetasaṃ cavyaṃ tālīsaṃ citrakaṃ tathā | jīrakaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgikam || 22 || trisugandhaṃ triśāṇaṃ syādguḍaḥ syātkarṣaviṃśatiḥ | vyoṣādiguṭikā seyaṃ pīnasaśvāsakāsajit ||23|| rucisvarakarī khyātā pratiśyāyapraṇāśinī |

Dī. idānīṃ vyoṣādiguṭikāmāha - vyoṣeti | vyoṣamatra trikaṭukam, amlavetasaḥ prasiddhaḥ, cavyaṃ loke cāvaśabdavācyaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, tintiḍīkamityamlaphaladravyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ triśāṇamiti | elā-tvak-patrakaṃ, tacca militaṃ trikaṃ na tu pratyekaṃ, vyoṣādi tintiḍīkāntaṃ dravyaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣamātramityarthaḥ | guḍaḥ syāt karṣaviṃśatiriti | guḍo'tra purātano grāhyaḥ | karṣaviṃśatiriti pañcapalāni tena sakaladravyāddviguṇito guḍa ityarthaḥ, tathāhi - ‘vyoṣacitrakatālīsatintiḍīkāmlavetasam | sa cavyājājitulyāṃśamelātvakpatrapādikam | vyoṣādikamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ purāṇaguḍasaṃyutam’ iti ||22||23||
Gū. vyoṣa trikaṭu; amlo'mlavetastasya cukraṃ vā rasaṃ vā deyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ tvak-tvaja-elā etat triśāṇam pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 22 || 23 ||
atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā āmādau - āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīmajīrṇe guḍapippalīm ||24|| kṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ dadyādarśaḥsu saguḍābhayām |

ab.seg: Dī. atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikāṃ vyācaṣṭe - āmeṣviti | guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā iti ko'rthaḥ ? guḍena saha catvāro yogāḥ kathitā ityarthaḥ | tadyathā āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīmityeko yogaḥ, āmeṣu āmadoṣeṣu saguḍāmityatra guḍadvaiguṇyam evaṃ yogacatuṣṭayeṣu boddhavyam; ajīrṇe guḍapippalīmiti dvitīyaḥ, ajīrṇe viṣṭabdike, kṛcchre jīrakaguḍaṃ dadyāditi tṛtīyo yogaḥ, kṛcchre matrakṛcchre; arśaḥsu ca saguḍābhayāmiti caturtho yoga iti || 24 ||

Gū. āmeṣu āmarogeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadyāt | vaṭīṃ tulyaguḍāṃ kṛtvā ajīrṇe ṣaḍvidhājīrṇe guḍapippalīṃ dadyāt; kṛcchre mūtrakṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ jīraṃ śvetajīrakam; arśaḥsu guḍābhayāṃ guḍayuktām abhayāṃ harītakīm ||24||

div.ab: atha vṛddhadārumodakaḥ - vṛddhadārukabhallātaśuṇṭhīcūrṇena yojitaḥ || 25 || modakaḥ saguḍo hanyātṣaḍvidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujam |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ vṛddhadārukamodakamāha - vṛddhādāruketi vṛddhadāruko vikhyātaḥ tadabhāve niśothā grāhyā yato'syā bhedo vṛddhadāraka iti | eteṣāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇa samamātramāhuḥ | saguḍa ityatra modakatvena guḍo dviguṇito jñeyaḥ | kecittu nādriyante yatastatra catuḥsamagrahaṇena sama eva guḍo yujyate sāmyenā'pi kiñciddravaṃ datvā agnau modakāḥ kāryāḥ | rujamiti pīḍām || 25 ||
Gū. vṛddhadārukaḥ prasiddhaḥ, bhallātakaḥ pratiddhaḥ, tadasahane raktacandanaṃ deyam | ayaṃ modakaḥ ṣahidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujāṃ hanyāt || 25 ||

div.ab: atha sūraṇapiṇḍī arśoroge - śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇasya bhāgāndvātriṃśadāharet || 26|| bhāgānṣoḍaśa citrasya śuṇṭhyā bhāgacatuṣṭayam | dvau bhāgau maricasyāpi sarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet || 27 || guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryādarśasāṃ nāśanīṃ parām |

Dī. atha sūraṇapiṇḍīmāha - śuṣkasūraṇeti | sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa ca śuṣkaḥ kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ, dvātriṃśadbhāgāḥ pañcadvayabhāgāḥ sūraṇasyetyarthaḥ | citrakasya citrakamūlasya tvacaḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgāḥ, śuṭhyāścatvāro bhāgāḥ, maricasya dvau bhāgau guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryāditi sakaladravyadviguṇitenetyarthaḥ | arśasāmiti bahuvacanatvena ṣaḍvidhatvamityarthaḥ | parāmityanena viśiṣṭatvamasyā darśitam || 26 || 27 ||
Gū. citrasya citrakasya | spaṣṭamanyat||26||27||

ab.seg: sūraṇavaṭakāḥ | sūraṇo vṛddhadāruśca bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak || 28 ||
muśalīcitrakau jñeyāvaṣṭabhāgamitau pṛthak | śivā bibhītakī dhātrī viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kaṇā ||29||
bhallātaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ tālīsaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | caturbhāgapramāṇāni tvagelā maricaṃ tathā ||30||
dvibhāgamātrāṇi pṛthaktatastvekatra cūrṇayet | dviguṇena guḍenātha vaṭakānkārayedbudhaḥ || 31||
prabalāgnikarā ete tathārśonāśanāḥ parāḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajāṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ kṣayāmayam ||32||
plīhānaṃ ślīpadaṃ śothaṃ pramehaṃ ca bhagandaram | nihānyu: palitaṃ vṛdhyāstathā medhyā rasāyanā: ||33||

Dī. atha sūraṇavaṭakānāha sūraṇa iti| sūraṇa: śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇaṃ tacca ṣoḍaśakarṣapramāṇaṃ, vṛddhadāruko'pyevaṃ, muśalī tālamūlī, loke mūśarīśabdavācyā, sāṣṭakarṣamiti bhavati, citrakajaṭācūrṇamapyevameva, śivāditālīsāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ catuḥkarṣamitam | tatra śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, kaṇā pippalī, bhallāta: bhallātakaphalāni, tālīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tvagelāmaricamapi dvikarṣamātraṃ pratyekaṃ | tenaiva cūrṇayedityanena cūrṇoktavidhinā cūrṇayedityarthaḥ | dviguṇena guḍeneti sakalacūrṇadravyāt guḍo dviguṇito grāhyaḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajāmiti vātajāṃ kaphajāṃ (vātakaphajāṃ vā, kṣayāmayaṃ kṣayarogaṃ, palitaṃ vārdhakyaṃ vṛddhyā eke vṛddhyeti sthāne vṛṣyeti paṭhanti) vyākhyānayanti ca medhyā iti | buddhipradāḥ rasāyanā iti jarāvyādhividhvaṃsakāḥ || 28-33 ||
Gū. arśoroge (sūraṇavaṭakānāha - ) śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, tvak tajaḥ || 28-33 ||

div.ab: maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ kāmalādau - triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau | dāru mākṣikadhātuśca dārvī mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam || 34 || pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi sarvadviguṇitaṃ tathā | maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayecchuddhaṃ gomūtre'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet || 35 || paktvā ca vaṭakānkṛtvā dadyāttakrānupānataḥ | kāmalāpāṇḍumehārśaḥśothakuṣṭhakaphāmayān ||36 || ūrustambhamajīrṇaṃ ca plīhānaṃ nāśayedapi |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ maṇḍūravaṭakānāha - triphaleti | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, dārvī dāruharidrā, eke ‘dārumākṣikadhātustvag dārvyā mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam’ iti paṭhanti tatra dāruharidrāyāstvageva grāhyā śreṣṭhatvāt, kāṣṭhaṃ tvagabhāve gṛhyate, na tu tvakśabdena guḍatvak grāhyā; yatastantrāntare caturdaśadravyaṃ militaṃ | sarvadviguṇitaṃ tatheti maṇḍūramityanena saṃbadhyate | samānamilitāt sakaladravyacūrṇāt maṇḍūracūrṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | maṇḍūraṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ, lohamalamityarthaḥ | yadvā purāṇamaṇḍūramiti vikhyātaṃ guṇādhikyāt | tathāhi ‘śatotthamuttamaṃ kiṭṭaṃ madhyaṃ cāśītivārṣikam | adhamaṃ ṣaṣṭivārṣīyaṃ tato hīnaṃ viṣopamaṃ’ iti | kecit lohakiṭṭāt pṛthak pārthivadravyaṃ maṇḍūramiti vadanti (śuddhamiti maṇḍūramityarthaḥ | ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇitaṃ śuddham’ iti vacanāt| atra cūrṇamañjanasadṛśaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ etādṛśameva śreṣṭhaṃ bhavati) śuddhamiti dhmāyanena saptadhā gomūtre nirvāpaṇādinā śuddhiḥ, ata evoktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘nirvāpitaṃ hi gomūtre maṇḍūraṃ grāhyamiṣyate’ iti | kartavyatāsya maṇḍūracūrṇameva pṛthaggomūtre paktavyam āsannapāke ca tasmin triphalādicūrṇaprakṣepaḥ yataḥ cūrṇānāṃ pāko nāstīti (atrārthenāsti ‘kha’ pustake | kvacit ślokaḥ ‘prāyo na pākaścūrṇānāṃ bhūricūrṇasya tena hi | āsannapāke prakṣepaḥ svalpasya pākamāgate’ | pākalakṣaṇamapi prasaṅgato likhyate yathā - ‘rāgo gandhaḥ śubhaḥ pāke vartiḥ syādgāḍhapīḍanāt’ iti | aṣṭaguṇe gomūtre iti mūtraṃ tu maṇḍūrādaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavati | tathāhi ‘grāhyaṃ tvaṣṭaguṇaṃ mūtraṃ śuddhamaṇḍūracūrṇataḥ’ iti | eke ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayet sarvaṃ gomūtre'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet’ tatra sakaladravyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ grāhyam iti paṭhanti, etadasaṅgatam, ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu na dṛṣṭatvāt | kaphāmayāniti kṣayakāsaprabhṛtīn || 34-36 ||

Gū. triphalā, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru:, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhā nirvamanā māritā ca deyā, maṇḍūraṃ mṛtaṃ purātanaṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ sarvato'ṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ datvā pacet | takreṇa ca deyam ||34-36||

div.ab: dhātugatajvarādau pippalīmodakaḥ - (kṣaudrāddviguṇitaṃprakṣiptam | tasyā: pippalyā: | kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ, cāturjātaṃ cūrṇādhikāroktam | sarpirghṛtāddviguṇapippalī || 37 || sitā dviguṇitā tasyāḥ kṣīraṃ deyaṃ caturguṇam | cāturjātaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ paktvā kuryācca modakān ||38|| dhātusthāṃśca jvarānsarvān vāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍutām | dhātukṣayaṃ vahnimāndyaṃ pippalīmodako jayet ||39||)

ab.seg: atha candraprabhāgugguluḥ pramehādau - candraprabhā vacā mustaṃ bhūnimbāmṛtadārukam | haridrātiviṣā dārvī pippalīmūlacitrakau ||40||
dhānyakaṃ triphalā cavyaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī | vyoṣaṃ mākṣikadhātuśca dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam ||41||
etāni śāṇamātrāṇi pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | trivṛddantīpatrakaṃ ca tvagelā vaṃśarocanā ||42||
pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi kuryādetāni buddhimān | dvikarṣaṃ hatalohaṃ syāccatuṣkarṣā sitā bhavet ||43||
śilājatvaṣṭakarṣaṃ syādaṣṭau karṣāśca gugguloḥ | ebhirekatra saṃkṣuṇṇaiḥ kartavyā guṭikā śubhā ||44 ||
candraprabhādivikhyātā sarvarogapraṇāśinī | pramehānviṃśatiṃ kṛcchraṃ mūtrāghātaṃ tathāśmarīm ||45||
vibandhā''nāhaśūlāni mehanaṃ granthimarbudam | antravṛddhiṃ kaṭīśūlaṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ vicarcikām ||46||
aṇḍavṛddhiṃ tathā pāṇḍuṃ kāmalāṃ ca halīmakam | kuṣṭhānyarśāṃsi kaṇḍūṃ ca plīhodarabhagandaram ||47||
dantarogaṃ netrarogaṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam | puṃsāṃ śukragatān doṣān mandāgnimaruciṃ tathā || 48 ||
vāyuṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ hanyādbalyā vṛṣyā rasāyanī | candraprabhāyāṃ karṣastu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate || 49 ||

Dī. idānīṃ candraprabhāguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - candraprabhetyādi | candraprabhā karpūraḥ, eke candraprabhāśabdena śaṭhīṃ śatāvarīṃ vā kathayanti saṃjñāśabdatvāt | bhūnimbaḥ kairātaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, dārukaṃ devadāru, kvacidbhūnimbāmaradārukamiti pāṭho dṛṣṭaḥ | tatrāmaradāru devadrāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikam, dvau kṣārāviti svarjikākṣārayavakṣārau, lavaṇatrayamiti saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍam iti lavaṇatrayaṃ trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantīti dantīmūlatvak, tadabhāve dantībījānyapi manāg deyāni iti kasmiṃścit sampradāye na sarvatra | hatalohaṃ samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, śilājatu prasiddhaṃ, taccātra śuddhaṃ grāhyaṃ, śuddhirasyānyatroktā jñātavyā vistareṇa | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | mātrāpi caiteṣāṃ vyastā subodhā jñātavyā | candraprabhādivikhyāteti candraprabheyaṃ vaṭī ādivikhyātā pūrvaṃ prasiddhetyarthaḥ, candraprabhevetyarthaḥ | asyāḥ satatābhyāsāccandrasyeva prabhā kāntirbhavatīti, yadvā candraprabhā nāma dravyamādiryasyāḥ | sarvarogamityavaśiṣṭaṃ rogajātamuktarogasamūhāt, tamapi nāśayituṃ yogyā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vibandho vātādīnāmapravṛttiḥ, ānāha udarāpūraḥ, mehanamiti grahaṇenaivopadaṃśaśūkadoṣādayo'bhidhīyante, balyā balakarī, vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, rasāyanī jarāvyādhivināśinītyanena paunaruktyena prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvamasyā darśitaṃ | “candraprabhāyāṃ karṣastu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate’ iti pādadvayaṃ kṣepakamāmananti kecit ||40-49 ||

Gū. candraprabhā karpūraḥ, candravatprabhā yasyeti vyutpattyā, yadvā candraprabhā gandhālikākhyakarpūrabhedaḥ tathānvayavṛttyā| ‘pathye gandhālikā gandhavadhū: pṛthupalāśikā | śaṭhī sagandhacaṇḍā syātsomabhā somasaṃbhavā’,amaradāru devadāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhaṃ māritaṃ ca, etāni pratyekaṃ śāṇamātrāṇi ṭaṅkamātrāṇi | trivṛt niḥsṛtāṃ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, patrakaṃ tajaḥ, elā, vaṃśalocanā, etāni pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi | hatalohaṃ mṛtalohaṃ dvikarṣaṃ, sitā sitopalā catuḥkarṣā, śilājatusatvam aṣṭakarṣāṇi, guggulurdaśakarṣaḥ evamekatrīkṛtaḥ candraprabhā bhavati | iyaṃ candraprabhāditvāt candraprabhāguṭikā | kecittu evaṃ vyākhyānayanti candravatprabhā yasyāsau candraprabho gugguluḥ sa tu ādau viḍaṅgamadhikṛtya likhitastathāpi candraprabhānāmnā candraprasādena prāptā, sā vaṅgasenādibhiḥ pramehādhikāre likhitā | tathāca ‘krimiripudahanavyoṣatriphalāmaradārucavyabhūnimbaṃ | māgadhimūlaṃ mustaṃ śaṭhī vacādhātumākṣike caiva’ ityādi || 40-49 ||

div.ab: atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikā gulmādau - yamānī jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ maricaṃ girikarṇikā | ajamodopakuñcī ca catuḥśāṇāḥ pṛthakpūthak ||50|| hiṅgu ṣaṭśāṇikaṃ kāryaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam | trivṛccāṣṭamitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ kalpayetsudhīḥ ||51|| dantī śaṭhī pauṣkaraṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ śivā | citro'mlavetasaḥ śuṇṭhī śāṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak ||52|| bījapūrarasenaiṣāṃ guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | ghṛtena payasā madyairamlairuṣṇodakena vā || 53 || pibetkāṅkāyanaproktāṃ guṭikāṃ gulmanāśinīm | madyena vātikaṃ gulmaṃ gokṣīreṇa ca paittikam ||54|| mūtreṇa kaphagulmaṃ ca daśamūlaistridoṣajam | uṣṭrīdugdhena nārīṇāṃ raktagulmaṃ vināśayet ||55|| hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ śūlaṃ krimīnarśāṃsi nāśayet |
