ab.seg: Dī. atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikāvivaraṇamāha - yamānīti | atra girikarṇikā ‘gaṇiyārī’ śabdavācyā, loke ‘isphanda’ iti prasiddhā, upakuñcī kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ, hiṃgvatra bharjitaṃ deyaṃ, kṣārāviti yavakṣāraḥ svarjikākṣāraśca, lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddhaṃ, trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ tadabhāve kuṣṭhameva, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimabījaṃ, śivātra harītakī, citraścitrakajaṭā eteṣām uktamānatulitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā guṭikākaraṇārthaparimitena bījapūrarasenāplāvya modakāḥ kāryāḥ | ghṛtādyanupānaṃ sāmānyamuktvā viśeṣānumānaṃ madyādikaṃ yaduktaṃ tadviśiṣṭaroganivṛttyartham iti na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | mūtramatra gomūtraṃ, daśamūlairiti kvathitadaśamūlajalaiḥ | kāṅkāyanaproktāmiti kāṅkāyanācāryeṇa proktāṃ kathitāṃ guṭikāmityarthaḥ | tantrāntare guṭikeyamarśovināśinī vihitā | tathāhi - ‘kāṅkāyanena śiṣyebhyaḥ śastrakṣārāgnibhirvinā | kathito vaṭako hyeṣa gudajānāṃ vināśanaḥ’ iti ||50-55||

Gū. girikarṇikā aparājitā, upakuñcī kalañjikā, dvau kṣārau svarjitayavakṣārau, trivṛditi niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, śivā harītakī, citraścitrakaḥ, amlo'mlavetasastasya cukraṃ vā raso vā, ṣoḍaśaśāṇaṃ | kāṅkāyano munistatproktāṃ guṭikāṃ, spaṣṭamanyat ||50-55||

div.ab: athaṃ yogarājaguggulurvātaroge āmavāte vā - nāgaraṃ pippalī cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau ||56|| mṛṣṭaṃ hiṅgvajamodā ca sarṣapo jīrakadvayam | reṇukendrayavāḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī || 57 || kaṭukātiviṣā bhārṅgī vacāmūrve tribhāgataḥ | pratyekaṃ śāṇakāni syurdravyāṇīmāni viṃśatiḥ ||58|| dravyebhyaḥ sakalebhyaśca triphalā dviguṇā bhavet | ebhiścūrṇīkṛtaiḥ sarvaiḥ samo deyaśca gugguluḥ || 59 || (vaṅgaṃ raupyaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca lohasārastathābhrakam | maṇḍūraṃ rasasindūraṃ pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitam ||60|| guḍapākasamaṃ kṛtvā imaṃ dadyādyathocitam| ekapiṇḍaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhārayedghṛtabhājane ||61|| guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrāstu kṛtvā grāhyā yathocitāḥ | gugguluryogarājo'yaṃ tridoṣaghno rasāyanaḥ || 62 || maithunāhārapānānāṃ tyāgo naivātra vidyate | sarvānvātāmayānkuṣṭhānarśāṃsi grahaṇīgadam || 63 || pramehaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca nābhiśūlaṃ bhagandaram | udāvartaṃ kṣayaṃ gulmamapasmāramurograham || 64 || mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsaṃ ca nāśayedaruciṃ tathā | retodoṣaharaḥ puṃsāṃ rajodoṣaharaḥ striyām || 65 || puṃsāmapatyajanako vandhyānāṃ garbhadastathā | rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukto vividhaṃ hanti mārutam ||66|| kāṅkolyādiśṛtātpittaṃ kaphamāragvadhādinā | dārvīśṛtena mehāṃśca gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutām || 67|| medovṛddhiṃ ca madhunā kuṣṭhaṃ nimbaśṛtena ca | chinnākvāthena vātāsraṃ śothaṃ śūlaṃ kaṇā‘mūlakajāt’ pā. | śṛtāt||68|| pāṭalākvāthasahito viṣaṃ mūṣakajaṃ jayet | triphalākvāthasahito netrārtiṃ hanti dāruṇām|| 69|| punarnavādikvāthena hanyātsarvodarāṇyapi |

ab.seg: Dī. atha yogarājagugguluvaṭakamāha - nāgaramiti | nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, hiṃgvajamodeti bhṛṣṭaṃ bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ utkledabhayāt, ( yataḥ ‘cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛdbhavetnāsti kha pustake | ’ iti ) | ajamodā'tra yamānī grāhyā, antaḥparimārjanatvāt, jīrakadvayamiti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena vihitaṃ, reṇukā prasiddhā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, śeṣaṃ prasiddham, etadviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ dravyagaṇaṃ viṃśatiśāṇatulitamityarthaḥ | pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkamitamāhuḥ | sakaladravyebhyastu triphalācūrṇaṃ dviguṇitaṃ deyam, tacca catvāriṃśat śāṇamitamityarthaḥ | triphalā'pyatra samamātrā boddhavyā gaṇanāyāṃ tulanāyāṃ vā sāmyatvamasyāḥ, sarvasamo guggulurdeya iti | tena ṣaṣṭiśāṇamito guggulurbhavati | ekapiṇḍamityādi vākyenāsya karaṇārthaṃ yāvat piṇḍībhūtaṃ syāt tāvatparimāṇena ghṛtaṃ grāhyamiti vṛddhānāṃ vyavahāro'sti | piṇḍamatra kuṭṭananirghātādinākuṭṭanaṃ ca lakṣasaṃkhyākanirghātairavicchedaṃ kāryamiti sampradāyaḥ | yāvat sikthatulyamāyāti tāvadvā'ṣṭapraharamavicchedamiti kecit | ghṛtaṃ kuṭṭanasamaya eva vāraṃ-vāraṃ dātavyam | , tata eva ghṛtabhājane dhārayet | atisnigdhatvāt | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrāstviti | yadyapi śāṇaparimitā guṭikā bhavati tathāpi bhakṣaṇavidhau yathocitā grāhyā, tena doṣādikaṃ vīkṣya deyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathāhyuktaṃ - ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne madhye tvaṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tattridhā’ iti | yadvā śodhanārthaṃ ca gugguloḥ karṣaḥ śamanārthe tu māṣacatuṣṭayamiti vyavahāraḥ | maithunāhārapānānāmityādi asyābhyāse maithunādayo na tyājyāḥ maithunaṃ strīsevā, eke maithunāhārapānābhyāṃ prayojanaṃ cātra vidyāditi paṭhanti | etat saṅgataṃ; tena maithunādayo bāhulyamātraṃ bhavantītyarthaḥ | kiṃtu ucyate yataḥ ‘kṣārāmlarasayūṣāktaṃ doṣadhātvavalocitam | bubhukṣito mātrapānamadyādguggulusevakaḥ’ ityādivacanāt ucitaṃ yathā maithunamapi| tathāhi - ‘seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtairhime | tryahādvasaṃtaśaradoḥ pakṣādvṛṣṭinidāghayoḥ || prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ śiśirāgame | śīte rātrau divā grīṣme prāvṛṭvarjitavarṣaṇe || vasante ca divā rātrau nā smaret śaradi smaram’ iti | asyānupānaviśeṣamāha - rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukta ityādi | rāsnādikvātha: kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kathitaḥ sa ca bṛhadrāsnādirlaghurvā kāṅkolyādicūrṇakalpanāyāṃ jñātavyaḥ, tacca jīvanīyādigaṇasaṃjñam, asya śṛtena kvāthenetyarthaḥ | āragvadhādineti āragvadhādigaṇakvāthenetyarthaḥ | ayamapi kvāthakalpanāyām uktaḥ | dārvīśṛteneti | dārvī dāruharidrā tasyāḥ śṛtena kvāthena | gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutāmiti atra ājaṃ vā mūtraṃ praśastaṃ vyavahārāt | madhunā kṣaudreṇa, nimbaśṛteneti nimbakvāthenetyarthaḥ | chinnā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthena | pāṭalā prasiddhā tasyā mūlatvak grāhyā, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ punarnavādikvāthaḥ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ prasiddhaḥ || 56-69 ||

Gū. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, tadādiviṃśatidravyāṇi śāṇamātrāṇi, sarvebhyastriphalā dviguṇā catvāriṃśat ṭaṅkamitā pratyekaṃ trayodaśaṭaṅkagugguluḥ sarvaiḥ samaḥ ṣaṣṭiṭaṅkamitaḥ cūrṇīkṛtya gugguluḥ kavakākhyaḥ ghṛtena saṃkuṭya guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ | śāṇamitaṃ bhakṣayet | kecit gugguluṃ vātaharadravyairdaśamūlādibhirutkvāthya vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā kṣipanti | tathāca ‘gandhavarṇarasopeto guggulurmātrayā punaḥ| bhaiṣajyaiḥ sahitaḥ kvāthyo yathā vyādhiharaḥ pṛthak || mātrāvaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā gālayet śuṣkavāsasā | athavā mardayet kvāthe yaduṣṇe sādhusādhite || mṛṇmaye hemapātre vā rājate sphāṭikepi vā’ | iti gugguluśodhanaṃ guggulukalpāt || 56-69 ||
atha kaiśoraguggulurvātaraktādau - triphalāyāstrayaḥ prasthāḥ prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet||70||
saṃkuṭya lohapātreṇa sārdhadroṇāmbunā pacet | jalamardhaśṛtaṃ jñātvā gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 71 ||
tataḥ kvāthe kṣipecchuddhaṃ gugguluṃ prasthasaṃmitam | punaḥ pacedayaḥpātre darvyā saṃgharṣayenmuhuḥ || 72 ||
sāndrībhūtaṃ tato jñātvā guḍapākasamākṛtim | cūrṇīkṛtya tatastatra dravyāṇīmāni nikṣipet || 73 ||
triphalā dvipalā jñeyā guḍūcī palikā matā| ṣaḍakṣaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ pnoktaṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ palārdhakam || 74 ||
dantī karṣamitā kāryā trivṛtkarṣamitā smṛtā | tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛtapātre vinikṣipet || 75 ||
guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa yuñjyāddoṣādyapekṣayā | anupāne bhiṣagdadyātkoṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo'thavā || 76 ||
mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtaṃ vāpi yuktiyuktamutāparam | jayetsarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni vātaraktaṃ tridoṣajam || 77 ||
sarvavraṇāni gulmāni pramehapiḍikāstathā | pramehodaramandāgnikāsaśvayathupāṇḍujān || 78 ||
hanti sarvāmayānnityamupayukto rasāyanaḥ | kaiśorakābhidhāno'yaṃ gugguluḥ kāntikārakaḥ ||79||
vāsādinā netragadāngulmādīnvaruṇādinā | kvāthena khadirasyāpi vraṇakuṣṭhāni nāśayet || 80 ||
amlaṃ tīkṣṇamajīrṇaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ‘vyavāyaṃ’ pā. | śramamātapam | madyaṃ roṣaṃ tyajetsamyagguṇārthī purasevakaḥ || 81 ||

Dī. adhunā kaiśoragugguluvaṭakānāha - triphalāyā ityādi | sammilitatrayasya traya eva prasthāḥ tena dvādaśakuḍavā ityarthaḥ | prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ prasthaikaṃ, eke ‘dviprasthamamṛtā bhavet’ iti paṭhanti | ayamapi pāṭhaḥ pracarati ādṛtatvāt granthāntaradarśanādvā | tathāca ‘dvātriṃśacchinnaruhāyāḥ phalāni deyāni yatnata’ iti| saṃkuṭyeti triphalāguḍūcīmityarthaḥ | droṇāmbunā pacediti etaddravyaṃ caturāḍhakaparimitena jalena sārdhaṃ paripacediti | kvāthavidhānena kvāthārdhāvaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ vastragālitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | aparakāryamāha - śuddhaṃ guggulumityādi | śuddhatā'sya niṣpātrāditvena saptarātraṃ ghṛtoṣitatvāt | yadvā śuddhaṃ jātyutkṛṣṭamityāmananti | yataḥ gugguloḥ pañca jātayaḥ, tadyathā ‘suvarṇavarṇaḥ prathamo dvitīyaḥ kusumadyutiḥ‘kumudāhvayaḥ’ pā.| | tṛtīyaḥ padmarāgastu caturthaścandranīlakaḥ || pañcamo mahiṣākṣaśca nāmataḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ’ iti | tatra mahiṣākṣaṃ vihitam | uktaṃ ca tantrāntare -‘varamahiṣalocanodarasannibhavarṇasya gugguloḥ prastham’ ityādi | ayaḥpātre lohapātre | darvyā saṅgharṣayenmuhuriti | darvī sañcālanakriyāyāṃ prasiddhaiva | muhuriti vāraṃvāraṃ, kutaḥ ? dagdhabhayāt guḍapākasamākṛtimiti yathā guḍapākaṃ tathā gugguloḥ pākamityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘guḍavadgugguloḥ pākaḥ sugandhastu viśeṣataḥ’ iti | lakṣaṇamapi guḍapākasya tantrāntare prathitaṃ tadyathā - ‘toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ | kṣiptastu niścalastiṣṭhet patitastu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ’ iti | aparakāryamāha - cūrṇīkṛtya tatastatreti | tata iti guḍapākādanantaraṃ tatra iti guggulupākadravye | triphalā dvipalā jñeyetyādi | saṃmilitatriphalāyā dvipalamitaṃ cūrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, guḍūcī palaparimitā | vyavahārastu guḍūcyāḥ satvamādāya kṣipediti manoharam | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tacca militvā ṣaḍakṣam, viḍaṅgacūrṇamapyardhapalaṃ, dantīmūlaṃ jayapālamūlaṃ karṣapramāṇam | kecittu dantībījānyatra kṣipanti | tacca sarvamataṃ | trivṛnniśothaḥ| tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtamityādinātra kartavyavidhirapi yogarājavadboddhavyaḥ | guṭikā iti | śāṇamātreti śāṇaparimitā guṭikāḥ kṛtvā doṣādyapekṣayā, na tu niyataśāṇamātrameva | doṣāpekṣayā yathā - kaphe niṣkaikaṃ, pitte dviniṣkaṃ vāyau triniṣkam iti | koṣṭhāpekṣayā yathā ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne, madhye tvaṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tattridhā’ iti | ṛtvapekṣayā yathā ‘prāvṛṭkāle ca grīṣme ca ghṛtayuktaṃ pradāpayet | śaratkāle vasante ca dāpayet triphalāyutam | hemante śiśire caiva gomūtreṇa samāyutam’ iti | anupāne tu koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo'thavetyādi | payaḥ kṣīraṃ, mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtamiti mañjiṣṭhādikvāthaṃ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kvathitaṃ, yuktiyuktamutāparamiti utāthavā aparamanupānaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ rogasātmyaṃ dadyāditi sambandhaḥ | tathāhi - ‘yasya rogasya yat sātmyaṃ dadyāt tadanupānakam’ iti | etaccāgre vakṣyamāṇamasti | vāsādinā netragadāniti vāsādinā vāsādikvāthena, varuṇādinā varuṇādikvāthena kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, gulmādīniti ādigrahaṇāt kṛcchrāśmarīprabhṛtīn, khadirasya kvātheneti khadiro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya mūlatvak| asyābhyāse tyājyamāha amlamityādi | amlamamlīkā mātuluṅgādi, tīkṣṇaṃ rājikādi, ajīrṇamannādijaṃ, vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma śramaṃ vahvāyāsakṛtakaṣṭaṃ karma, ātapaṃ dharmasevā, madyaṃ madyapānaṃ, roṣaṃ krodhaṃ, samyak tyajediti yato'mlādīni vātaraktaprakopīṇi bhavanti | eke amlaṃ tīkṣṇamityādi ślokaṃ na paṭhanti kṣepako'yamiti manyante | kaiśoragugguluriti kaiśoro bālakaḥ tasya rūpaṃ kaiśorakaṃ tenāsyābhyāse bālakasyeva rūpaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | ata eva kāntikārakaḥ kathitaḥ || 70-81 ||

Gū. triphalā trayaḥ prasthā iti | ekaṃ prasthaṃ harītakī, ekaṃ bibhītakaṃ, ekam āmalakam evaṃ trayaḥ; amṛtā guḍūcī prasthaikā saṃkuṭya lohapātre sārdhadroṇajale pacet, ardhajalaṃ gṛhītvā vastrapūtaṃ punaḥ pacet | darvyā muhuḥ saṃghaṭṭayet, sāndrībhūtaṃ guḍapākaṃ jñātvā imāni kṣipet | triphalārdhapalā jñeyā pratyekamardhapalā, guḍūcī palikā tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu ṣaḍakṣaṃ pratyekaṃ dvyakṣaṃ, viḍaṅgānām ardhapalaṃ, dantī karṣamitā, trivṛtkarṣamitā | tat piṇḍīkṛtvā ghṛtapātre kṣipet | śāṇikā guṭikā doṣāpekṣayā śuddhaṃ gugguluṃ tṛṇavālaśarkarādirahitaṃ, yadvā vātaraktādau auṣadhaṃ kvāthaśothitaṃ kṣipet | anupāne koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payaḥ dugdhaṃ mañjiṣṭhādirvā | spaṣṭamanyat | purasevakaḥ guggulubhakṣakaḥ guṇārthī amlādīn tyajet | ayaṃ gugguluḥ kaiśorakābhidhānaḥ kiśorāvasthāvadrūpakaraḥ syāt || 70-81 ||
atha triphalāguggulurbhagandarādau - tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ palonmitam | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikaṃ kṣodayetsarvamekataḥ || 82 ||
tatastu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā prayuñjyādvahnyapekṣayā | bhagandaraṃ gulmaśothāvarśāṃnti ca vināśayet || 83 ||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ triphalāgugguluvaṭakamāha - tripalamityādi | saṃmilitaphalatrikacūrṇaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, tena harītakī palamānaṃ, vibhītakaṃ palapramāṇaṃ, āmalakamapi palamānamiti kṛṣṇā pippalī tasyāścūrṇaṃ palapramitamiti | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikamiti | pañcapalapramāṇaṃ gugguluṃ saṃgṛhya ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya cūrṇena saha modakāḥ kāryāḥ, ata eva kṣodayedityuktaṃ ghṛtamatra vyavahāradarśanāt| vahnyapekṣayetyādinā bhakṣyamāṇasyeti boddhavyam | gulmaśothāviti gulmaśca śothaśca | eke ‘bhagandaraṃ gulmaśothamarśāṃsi ca vināśayet’ iti paṭhanti | tatra gulmena janitaṃ śothamiti ||82||83||
Gū. tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palaṃ harītakyādīnāṃ, kṛṣṇacūrṇa pippalīcūrṇaṃ palonmitaṃ, gugguluḥ pañcapalaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 82 || 83 ||

ab.seg: atha gokṣurādigugguluḥ pramehādau - aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palānyānīya gokṣurāt | vipacetṣaḍguṇe nīre kvātho grāhyo'rdhaśeṣitaḥ ||84||
tataḥ punaḥ pacettatra puraṃ saptapalaṃ kṣipet | guḍapākasamākāraṃ jñātvā tatra vinikṣipet|| 85 ||
trikaṭu triphalā mustaṃ cūrṇitaṃ palasaptakam | tata: piṇḍīkṛtasyāsya guṭikā mukhyojitā || 86 ||
hanyātpramehaṃ kṛcchraṃ ca pradaraṃ mūtraghātakam | vātāsraṃ vātarogāṃśca śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 87 ||

Dī. atha gokṣurādigugguluṃ darśayannāha - aṣṭāviṃśatīti | gokṣurāditi pañcāṅgagokṣurakasyāṣṭāviṃśatipalāni grāhyāṇi, tāni saṃkuṭya ṣaḍguṇe pānīye saṃkvāthyārdhāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ, ṣaḍguṇatā ca gokṣuraparimāṇāt ardhāvaśeṣo jalaparimāṇāt | tataḥ punaḥ pacedityādi punaḥ pacedityardhāvaśeṣitaḥ kvāthaḥ | tatrārdhāvaśeṣite puraṃ gugguluṃ saptapalaparimitam | guḍapākasamākāramiti | yathā guḍapāko bhavati tathāyamapi kartavyaḥ, tacca guḍapākalakṣaṇaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ | tatra vinikṣipediti tatra guggulupāke vinikṣipedvakṣyamāṇadravyāṇītyarthaḥ | tāni kāni ityatrāha - trikaṭutriphalāmustamiti | trikaṭu tryūṣaṇaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, etat sakalaṃ palasaptakaṃ grāhyaṃ, pratyekaṃ palamātramityarthaḥ | guṭikā mukhayojiteti | asya guṭikā śāṇamātrā prakalpya yathādoṣaṃ bhakṣaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vātarogān hanustambhākṣepakādīn || 84-87 ||

Gū. gokṣuram aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palānyānīya ṣaḍguṇe nīre vipacet ardhaśeṣaḥ kvātho grāhyaḥ | punaḥ saptapalaṃ puraṃ gugguluṃ datvā pacet trikaṭu triphalāmustaṃ etāni saptadravyāṇi saptapalāni pratyekaṃ palam | iti gokṣurādiḥ pramehādau || 84-87 ||

div.ab: atha triphalāmodakaḥ kuṣṭhādau - triphalāṣṭapalā kāryā bhallātaṃ ca catuṣpalam | vākucī pañcapalikā viḍaṅgānāṃ catuṣpalam || 88 || hatalohaṃ trivṛccaiva gugguluśca śilājatu | ekaikaṃ palamātraṃ syātpalārdhaṃ pauṣkaraṃ bhavet || 89 || citrakasya palārdhaṃ syāddviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ bhavet | nāgaraṃ pippalī mustā tvagelāpatrakuṅkumam ||90|| śāṇonmitaṃ syādekaikaṃ cūrṇayetsarvamekataḥ | tatastatprakṣipeccūrṇaṃ pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame ||91|| modakānpalikānkṛtvā prayuñjīta yathocitān | hanyāt sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni tridoṣaprabhavāmayān ||92|| bhagandaraplīhagulmāñjihvātālugalāmayān | śiro'kṣibhrugatānrogānhanyātpṛṣṭhagatānapi ||93 || prāgbhojanasya deyaṃ syādadhaḥ kāyasthite gade | bheṣajaṃ bhaktamadhye ca roge jaṭharasaṃsthite || bhojanasyopari grāhyamūrdhvajatrugadeṣu ca |

ab.seg: Dī. atha triphalāmodakamapyāha - triphaletyādi| sammilitaphalatrikamaṣṭapalaparimitaṃ bhavati | bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, hatalohamiti samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, ‘hatalohaṃ gugguluśca śilājatu trikatrikam’ iti pāṭhe trikatrikaṃ tripalamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhastvasaṅgata eva, kintu “hatalohaṃ trivṛccaiva gugguluśca śilājatu” iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | tatra trivṛnniśothaṃ, tena lohacūrṇādiśilājatuparyantaṃ palamātramāhuḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ palārdhaṃ grāhyaṃ, nāgarādikuṅkumāntaṃ dravyasaptakaṃ śāṇonmitaṃ, pratyekamiti bhāvaḥ | pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame iti tatsame sakala dravyasambhārasāmye tena saptaviṃśatipalānītyarthaḥ | yathocitāniti, yathā doṣāpekṣayā jihvātālugalāmayāni- tyanena jihvāmayān, tālvāmayān, galāmayān, ete mukharoge paṭhitāḥ, hanyāt pṛṣṭhāgatān rogānityarthaḥ | prāgbhojanasyeti prātaḥkāle; adhaḥkāyasthite gade iti gṛdhrasyādau; jaṭharasaṃsthite udarādau ūrdhvajatrugadeṣviti śirorogādiṣu bhojanasyopari sāyaṃkāle ||88-94||
Gū. pakvakhaṇḍaṃ pakvatāṃ prāpte khaṇḍe triphalā'ṣṭapalā pratyekamaṣṭapalā, tvak tajaḥ, elā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ; spaṣṭamanyat || iti triphalāmodakaḥ || 88-94 ||
atha kāñcanāragugguluḥ gaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthībhagandarādau - kāñcanāratvaco grāhyaṃ palānāṃ daśakaṃ budhaiḥ ||95||
triphalā ṣaṭpalā kāryā trikaṭu syātpalatrayam | palaikaṃ varuṇaṃ kuryādelātvakpatrakaṃ tathā || 96 ||
ekaikaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātsarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet | yāvaccūrṇamidaṃ sarvaṃ tāvanmātrastu gugguluḥ || 97 ||
saṃkuṇṭhya sarvamekatra piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayet | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa prātargrāhyā yathocitam ||98||
gaṇḍamālāṃ jayatyugrāmapacīmarbudāni ca | granthīnvraṇāṃśca gulmāṃśca kuṣṭhāni ca bhagandaram|| 99 ||
pradeyaścānupānārthaṃ kvātho muṇḍitakābhavaḥ | kvāthaḥkhadirasārasya pathyākvātho'tha koṣṇakam ||100||

Dī. atha kāñcanāragugguluṃ prakaṭayannāha - kāñcanāratvaca iti | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddha eva nijanāmnā, tasya tvak daśapalaparimitā grāhyā | triphaleti saṃmilitaphalatrikaṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ; trikaṭorapi militvā palatrayaṃ bhavati varuṇo'pi svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi tvageva grāhyā | elā tvak patrakamiti sugandhatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣamātraṃ deyaṃ, gugguluratra sakalacūrṇasamaḥ, tena trikarṣottarāṇi viṃśatipalāni bhavanti; piṇḍaṃ kṛtvetyādinā ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya snigdhabhāṇḍe dhārayediti saṃpradāyaḥ | yathocitamiti yathādoṣāpekṣayā anupānārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - kvātho muṇḍatikābhava iti | muṇḍatikā bhūkadambakaṃ kedāramuṇḍī iti loke, khadiraḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya sāro madhyabhāgasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | pathyā harītakī koṣṇamityuṣṇodakaṃ, yataḥ - ‘kaṃ śirombunoḥ’ iti kośaḥ || 95-100 ||

Gū. kāñcanāraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya tvacaḥ viṃśatipalaṃ, trikaṭu dvādaśapalaṃ samuditaṃ pratyekaṃ, śuṇṭhyādīnāṃ catuḥpalaṃ, triphalā ṣaṭpalā samuditā ca pratyekaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, varuṇaṃ palaikam, elā tvakpatrakam, ekaikaṃ karṣaṃ gugguluḥ sarvasamaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 95-100 ||

div.ab: atha māṣādimodakaḥ puṣṭau - nistuṣaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ syāttathā godhūmasaṃbhavam | nistuṣaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ ca śālitaṇḍulajaṃ tathā || 101 || sūkṣmaṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ palikānyupakalpayet | tata ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bharjayedgoghṛtena ca || 102 || ardhamātreṇa sarvebhyastataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ kṣipet | jalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dattvā pācayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 103 || tataḥ pakvaṃ samuddhṛtya vṛttānkurvīta modakān | bhuktvā sāyaṃ palaikaṃ ca pibetkṣīraṃ caturguṇam|| 104 || varjanīyau viśeṣeṇa kṣārāmlau dvau rasāvapi | kṛtvaivaṃ ramayennārīrbahvīrna kṣīyate naraḥ || 105 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe vaṭakakalpanā nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg: Dī. atha māṣādimodakamāha - nistuṣamityādi | māṣacūrṇaṃ nistuṣaṃ tuṣarahitaṃ grāhyaṃ, tatheti grahaṇādgodhūcūrṇamapi nistuṣamityarthaḥ | śālirdhānyaviśeṣaḥ sa ca ṣaṣṭiko grāhyaḥ tasya taṇḍulānkṛtvā tajjātaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ palikānīti bahuvacanena māṣacūrṇādipippalīcūrṇāntaṃ dravyaṃ pratyekaṃ palamātramāhuḥ kartavyavidhāvatra | tata ekīkṛtamityādi cūrṇādardhamātreṇa goghṛtena cūrṇaṃ manāgbharjayitvā tadanu sakalacūrṇasamānaṃ khaṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya khaṇḍādviguṇitena jalena saha paktvā palapramitā modakāḥ kāryāḥ | sāyaṃ sandhyāsamaye | pibet kṣīraṃ caturguṇamiti palapramāṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhakṣayitvā palacatuṣṭayaṃ kṣīramanupeyamityarthaḥ | kṣārāmlau dvau rasau viśeṣeṇa varjanīyau yatastau śukracyutikarau bhavataḥ, na kṣīyate nara iti śukrahānirna bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ || 101-105 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe guṭikākalpanādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 7 ||

Gū. nistuṣaṃ tvagrahitaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ, pippalīcūrṇam etāni palikāni palamānāni, sarvebhyo'rdhena goghṛtena bharjayet | tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā pācayet dviguṇaṃ khaṇḍāt tataḥ pakvamodakaṃ palamātraṃ khādet evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ bahvīrnārī ramayet kṣīyate na || || 101-105 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne guṭikādhikāraḥ || 7 ||

div.head: atha avalehādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | kvāthādīnāṃ punaḥ pākādghanatvaṃ sā rasakriyā | so'valehaśca lehaḥ syāttanmātrā syātpalonmitā ||1 ||

Dī. adhunāvalehānāṃ prathamatastatsvarūpaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha - kvāthādīnāmiti | kvāthādīnāmityādi grahaṇāt svarasaphāṇṭakalkādayo'bhidhīyante ghanatvamiti | sāndratvaṃ yāvadbhavati tāvatpākaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | pākastu kvāthādīnāṃ bhavati, yataḥ prathamataḥ kvāthavidhinā pākaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pākena lehaḥ syāditi | tanmātreti tasyā'valehabhakṣaṇārthaṃ mānaṃ palamitaṃ boddhavyaṃ, iti sāmānyamānaṃ bhakṣaṇe'bhihitam || 1 ||
sitā caturguṇā kāryā cūrṇācca dviguṇo guḍaḥ | dravaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyāditi sarvatra niścaya || 2 ||

Dī. idānīmanukte sitādīnāṃ parimāṇamāha -- anuktamānāvalehe sitā caturguṇā deyā | caturguṇatā'tra sakaladravyādityarthaḥ | guḍastu dviguṇa iti cūrṇadravyāt | dravaṃ toyakṣīrādikaṃ caturguṇam | atrāpi cūrṇāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvatra niścaya iti svatantre paratantre vā || 2 ||
athāvalehasya siddhilakṣaṇamāha - supakve tantumattvaṃ syādavaleho'psu majjati | kharatvaṃ pīḍite mudrāgandhavarṇarasodbhavaḥ || 3 ||

Dī. supakva iti | samyak pakve'valehe etādṛśaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, kīdṛśaṃ tadāha - tantumattvamityādi | darvyā sañcālanena tantusaṃyukta iva dṛśyate, tena mṛdyamāno'ṅguligrāhī bhavatītyarthaḥ | apsu majjatīti pānīyamadhye yadā kṣiptastadā nimagno bhavati | sthiratvamiti niścalatvam etena dravarahita ityarthaḥ | tathāhi - “toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ | kṣiptastu niścalastiṣṭhet patitastu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ” iti | pīḍite mudreti tasminnaṅgulyādipīḍite sati mudrādīnāmudbhavo bhavati, mudrā'tra nimnatā | yaduktaṃ “pīḍite tu yadāṅgulyā nimnatā tatra jāyate” iti | gandhavarṇarasodbhava iti sugandhopetaḥ surasopeta iti | yo'valeho bhavati sa supakva ityarthaḥ || 3 ||

Gū. kvāthādeḥ kaṣāyāderyatpunaḥ pakvāt sā rasakriyā ucyate avaleho lehaśca ucyate nāmataḥ tanmātrā palonmitā syāt | cūrṇāt sitā caturguṇā, guḍo dviguṇaḥ, evaṃ caturguṇamiti niścayaḥ | avalehe supakve tantumattvaṃ syāt, sparśena pīḍite svarasatve mudrā ca bhavati | gandhavarṇarasodbhavastadā siddhaṃ bhavet || 3 ||
idānīmanukteṣvanupānamāha - dugdhamikṣuraso yūṣaḥ pañcamūlīkaṣāyajam | vāsākātho yathāyogyamanupānaṃ praśasyate || 4 ||

Dī. dugdhamiti | dugdhamiti sāmānyagrahaṇena sarvāṇi kṣīrāṇi yathādoṣaṃ grāhyāṇi | ikṣurasagrahaṇena sarve ikṣuvikārā gṛhyante | pañcamūlī mahatī hrasvā vā yathā vyādhivihitā grāhyā | kaṣāyajamiti yūṣamityarthaḥ | tena pañcamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa kṛtvā yūṣaḥ so'nupānamiti bhāvaḥ | kaṣāyagrahaṇena svarasakvāthakalkādayo grāhyāḥ | vāsākvātha iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, yathāyogyamiti yad yasya doṣasya yogyaṃ tadyathāyogyam | etena doṣānurūpamiti vyādhyanusāraṃ kathitaḥ, tadyathā - vāte'mlamadhuralavaṇaprāyāḥ snigdhādayaḥ, pitte madhurakaṣāyatiktaprāyāḥ śītādayaḥ, kaphe tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyaprāyā rūkṣādayaḥ | mātrā yathā tathāhyuktam - “anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ kaphavyādhau palaṃ bhavet | paladvayaṃ tu pitte vānilaje ca palatrayam” iti | yadvā “gaṇḍūṣaṃ mātrayā deyaṃ mṛdau krūre tu pañca ca | anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā” iti | anupānamiti | anu paścātpānaṃ tat kutaḥ tadāha - “yathā jalagataṃ tailaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva sarpati | tathā bhaiṣajyamaṅgeṣu prasarpatyanupānataḥ” iti || 4 ||
Gū. avalehe dugdhādiryathāyogyamanupānam ||4||
atha kāsaśvāsādau kaṇṭakāryavalehaḥ - sa yathā - kaṇṭakārītulāṃ nīradroṇe paktvā kaṣāyakam | pādaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca tasmiṃścūrṇāni dāpayet || 5 ||
pṛthakpalani caitani guḍūcīcavyacitrakāḥ | mustaṃ karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca tryūṣaṇaṃ dhanvayāsakaḥ || 6 ||
bhārgī rāsnā śaṭhī caiva śarkarā palaviṃśatiḥ | pratyekaṃ ca palānyaṣṭau pradadyādghṛtatailayoḥ || 7 ||
paktvā lehatvamānīya śīte madhupalāṣṭakam | catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryāḥ pippalīnāṃ catuṣpalam || 8 ||
kṣiptvā nidadhyātsudṛḍhe mṛṇmaye bhājane śubhe | leho'yaṃ hanti hikvārtiśvāsakāsānaśeṣataḥ || 9 ||

Dī. sa yatheti taṃ darśayannāha - kaṇṭakārīti | laghukaṇṭakārikā sā samūlaphalaśākhā grāhyā | nīradroṇa iti caturāḍhakaparimite pānīye tryūṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palapramāṇamāhuḥ | dhanvayāsakaḥ durālabhā rāsnā, surabhī, śarkarā palaviṃśatiriti sugamam | ghṛtatailayoriti militvā ṣoḍaśapalāni | ghṛtamatra goghṛtam ājaṃ vā vyādhivihitatvāt tailaṃ kaṭutailamatra vadantyeke | yataḥ “kāse śvāse ca hikvāyāṃ kaṭutailaṃ prayojayet” iti | kvacidasya prayogo'pi dṛśyate “guḍaṃ kaṭukatailena miśrayitvā samaṃ lihet | trisaptāhaprayogeṇa śvāsaṃ nirmūlato jayet” iti | śīte madhupalāṣṭakamiti| madhukṣaudramaṣṭapalapramāṇaṃ śīte himasparśe vinikṣipedityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘uṣṇārtamuṣṇairuṣṇe ca tannihanti yathāviṣam’ iti vacanāt | aparāṇi dravyāṇyāha - catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryā ityādi | tvagākṣīrī vāṃśī | pippalī prasiddhā sudṛḍhe tvaticikkaṇe bhājane pātre śubhe abhagne maṅgalatvāt | ayaṃ lehaḥ kaṇṭakārī saṃjñaḥ | aśeṣata iti sampūrṇāriṣṭadarśanādapi āsaṃcayādityarthaḥ | etenāsya prāmāṇyaṃ darśitam || 5-9 ||

div.ab: atha cyavanaprāśaḥ kṣayakṣīṇādau - pāṭalā'raṇikāśmaryabilvāralukagokṣurāḥ | parṇyau bṛhatyau pippalyaḥ śṛṅgī drākṣāmṛtābhayāḥ||10|| balā bhūmyāmalī vāsā ṛddhirjīvantikā śaṭhī | jīvakarṣabhakau mustaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kākanāsikā || 11 || mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī vidārī ca punarnavā | kākolyau kamalaṃ bhede sūkṣmailāgarucandanam || 12|| ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitamauṣadham | ekīkṛtya mahatpātre pañcāmalaśatāni ca || 13 || paceddroṇajale kṣiptvā grāhyamaṣṭāvaśeṣitam | tatastu tānyāmalāni niṣkulīkṛtya vāsasā ||14|| dṛḍhahastena saṃpīḍya kṣiptvā tatra tato ghṛtam| palasaptamitaṃ tāni kiṃcidbhṛṣṭvālpavahninā || 15 || tatastatra kṣipetkvāthaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cārdhatulonmitam | lehavatsādhayitvā ca cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet ||16|| pippalī dvipalā deyā tugākṣīrī catuṣpalā | pratyekaṃ ca triśāṇaṃ syāttvagelāpatrakeśaram || 17 || tatastvekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣipetkṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalam | ityetaccyavanaproktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñitam || 18 || lehaṃ vahnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā khādetkṣīṇo rasāyanam | bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇā nārīkṣīṇāśca śoṣiṇaḥ || 19 || hṛdrogiṇaḥ svarakṣīṇā ye narāsteṣu yujyate | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ pipāsāṃ ca vātāsramuraso graham ||20|| vātapittaṃ śukradoṣaṃ mūtradoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | medhāṃ smṛtiṃ strīṣu harṣaṃ krāntiṃ varṇaprasannatām ||21|| asya prayogādāpnoti naro jīrṇavivarjitaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. adhunā cyavanaprāśāvalehamāha - pāṭaletyādi| pāṭalā prasiddhā, araṇiḥ agnimanthakaḥ, kāśyaryaḥ gāmbhārī, bilvaṃ prasiddham, aralukaḥ syonākaḥ, parṇyau dve tena śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī ceti, tacca dvayaṃ ‘kavarādvayaśabdavācyaṃ, bṛhatyāviti dve bṛhatyau kaṇṭakārīdvayamitityarthaḥ | śṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā, bhūmyāmalī tāmalakī, ṛddhī iti dvivacanatvena ṛddhivṛddhī grāhye, jīvantī śākaviśeṣaḥ jīvakarṣabhakāviti dvau tena jīvaka ṛṣabhakaśceti, kākanā- sikā ‘kauvāḍoḍīti’ loke, vidārī kandaviśeṣaḥ, kākolyāviti dravyadvayaṃ tena kākolī kṣīrakākolī ceti, kama- lamutpalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyaṃ, mede dve medā mahāmedā ca, agaruḥ kṛṣṇāgaruḥ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, sthūlacūrṇamiti udūkhale musalādibhiḥ kuṭṭitamityartha: | na tu vastragālituṃ, pañcāmalaśatāni ceti | āmalakaphalānāṃ guṭikāni pañcaśatāni atra gaṇanāmānam | evaṃ sarvatra palādimānābhāve yathā vakṣyamāṇavarge agastyaharītakyavalehe “harītakīśataṃ bhadram” ityādi | evaṃ bhallātakaguḍe “bhallātakasahasre dve” iti | yatra palādimānamuktaṃ tatra tu palādimānenaiva vyavahāraḥ | yathā pūrvoktā bāhuśālaguḍe “catuṣpalaṃ syādbhallātam” iti | pacediti hastaparipāṭīvyavahārāt, tadyathā akhaṇḍitāmalakaphalaṃ karpaṭe poṭṭalīṃ badhvā kvāthanīyaṃ tena tāni sugrahāṇi syu: | aṣṭāvaśeṣitamityatra yadgrahaṇaṃ tadvṛndaṭippaṇakāramatamālokya kṛtam | vṛnde tu “jñātvā gatarasaṃ dravyaṃ rasaṃ gṛhṇīta gālitam” ityasya vyākhyāyāṃ aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣeṇa dravyāṇāṃ gatarasatvaṃ syāt iti | kecittu grāhyaṃ pādāvaśeṣitamiti paṭhanti tatra suśrute vāgbhaṭe ca pādaśeṣe rase ityevoktam | niṣkulīkṛtyeti | niṣkulamiti kṣaumādigharṣaṇāt peṣaṇādvā tena asthitvagādirahitamityarthaḥ | saptapalaparimitena sarpiṣā tadbharjanaṃ kāryaṃ cakradattoktaṃ - “sitā matsyaṇḍikābhāve dhātryāśca mṛdubharjanaṃ | caturbhāge jale prāyo dravyaṃ gatarasaṃ bhavet” iti | khaṇḍasya kvāthamiti śīrāśabdavācyaṃ, khaṇḍenāpi kecidvyavaharanti | kṣaudramatra śītībhūte dadyāt cyavanaproktamiti cyavano nāma munistena proktaṃ kathitam, prāśyata iti prāśaḥ cyavanasya prāśa iti bhāvaḥ | kṣīṇo dhātukṣayo rasāyanamiti jarāvyādhināśanaṃ, naro jīrṇavivarjita iti naro'sya sevī puruṣaḥ jīrṇavivarjitaḥ jarārahito bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā ajīrṇavivarjī bhavati, tadapi rogamūlameva yataḥ “prāyeṇāhāravaiṣamyādajīrṇaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | tanmūlo rogasaṃghātastadvināśādvinaśyati” iti ||10-21||

Gū. pāṭalādikamauṣadhaṃ pratyekam ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitamauṣadhaṃ mahatpātre bṛhatpātre ekīkṛtya pañcāmalakaśatāni droṇajalaṃ kṣiptvā pacet | aṣṭāvaśeṣitaṃ prāhyaṃ, tatastasmāttānyāmalakāni niṣkulīkṛtya nistvacāni vāsasā dṛḍhahastena saṃmardya saptapalamitaṃ ghṛtaṃ datvā tāni kiñcidbhṛṣṭāni ardhatulonmitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca datvā kvāthaṃ pacet | lehavatsādhayitvā punaḥ imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | imāni pippalyādīni kṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣipet | pāṭalā pāṇḍurā, araṇi:, kāśmarī gambhārī, bilvaḥ śrīphalaḥ, araluḥ syonākaḥ, gokṣuraḥ trikaṇḍakaḥ, parṇyau śāliparṇī mudgaparṇī ca, bṛhatyau bṛhallaghukaṇṭhakārīdvayaṃ, pippalyaḥ, śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, drākṣā gostanī, amṛtā guḍūcī, abhayā harītakī, balā prasiddhā, bhūmyāmalakī prasiddhā, vāsā, ṛddhiḥ, jīvantī, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, jīvakarṣabhakau aṣṭavargoktau, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, puṣkaramūlaṃ kākanāsikā , viṣṇukrāntā, mudgaparṇī, māṣaparṇī, vidārīkandaḥ, punarnavā, kākolī, kamalaṃ, medā sūkṣmailā, agaru candanam etāni pratyekapalāni kvāthyadravyāṇi aṣṭavargavidhānāmabhāve jātimelanīyāni | spaṣṭamanyat | etaccyavanaṛṣiṇā proktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñaṃ bhavati || 10-21||

div.ab: atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehaḥ - niṣkulīkṛtya kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍātpalaśataṃ pacet ||22|| nikṣipya dviguṇaṃ nīramardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhyate | tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni pīḍayeddṛḍhavāsasā || 23 || ātape śoṣayetkiṃcicchūlāgrairbahuśo vyadhet | kṣiptvā tāmrakaṭāhe ca dadyādaṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtam || 24 || tena kiṃcidbharjayitvā pūrvoktaṃ tajjalaṃ kṣipet | khaṇḍātpalaśataṃ dattvā sarvamekatra pācayet || 25 || supakve pippalī śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ dvipalaṃ pṛthak | pṛthakpalārdhaṃ dhānyākaṃ patrailā maricaṃ tvacam || 26|| cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipettatra ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudramāvapet | khādedagnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā raktapittī kṣayī jvarī ||27 || śoṣatṛṣṇāvamicchardiśvāsakāsakṣatāturaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakāvaleho'yaṃ bālavṛddheṣu yujyate || 28 || uraḥsandhānakṛdvṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇo balakṛnmataḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehavivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - niṣkulīti | niṣkulīkṛtyeti tvaṅmajjādirahitāni kūṣmā- ṇḍaśakalāni saṃgṛhyetyarthaḥ | dviguṇaṃ nīramiti kūṣmāṇḍaparimāṇāt tena kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni tulāparimitāni dvitulāmitaṃ nīramiti ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvātharūpaṃ jalam | śūlāgrairiti kāṣṭhamayaśaṅkumukhaiḥ | bahuśo vyadhediti bahucchidrā- ṇi kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni kārayediti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ ca - hastapāṭyāṃ pūrvaṃ niṣkulīkṛtaṃ tadanu kṛtacchidraṃ paścāt saṃsvedya kṣaumeṇa veṣṭayitvā pīḍayet, ātape manāk saṃśoṣya piṣṭvā palaśataṃ gṛhītvā paktavyaṃ, tena kiñcidbharjayitveti kiṃcidatra yathāpākaṃ bharjayet | tathāhi “muktasarpiṣi kūṣmāṇḍe pāko gandhena mudrayet” iti | tajjalamityardhāvaśeṣitaṃ pūvāktaṃ kvātham | khaṇḍāt palaśatamiti śarkarāpalaśatam | ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudramāvapediti ghṛtamānādardhaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu kṣipediti bhāvaḥ | āvapediti grahaṇena śītībhūte tasmin paścāt melayedityarthaḥ | āturaśabda: śoṣādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate | bālavṛddheṣu yojayediti saumyatvāt dhātupoṣakatvācca vṛṣyaḥ śukravṛddhikaraḥ bṛṃhaṇo dhātuvṛddhikaraḥ balakṛdojaso vṛddhikara iti || || 22-28 ||

Gū. palaśataṃ niṣkulīkṛtakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāt dvitulānīre nikṣipya pacet ardhaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhyate tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni dṛḍhavāsasā pīḍayet | punaḥ kiñcidātape śoṣayet | punarbahuśūlāgrairvedhayet | punaḥ kaṭāhe kṣiptvā aṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt | tena ghṛtena kiñcit bharjayet pūrvoktaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet khaṇḍātpalaśataṃ datvā sarvamekatra kārayet | supakve pippalī-śuṇṭhī jīraṃ jīrakam eṣāṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ, dhānyākaṃ, patraja, elā, maricaṃ, tvak taja eṣāṃ pṛthak palārdhaṃ ghṛtārdha catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu | spaṣṭamanyat || 22-28 ||

div.ab: atha khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehaḥ arśoroge - yuktyā kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya sūraṇaṃ vipacetsudhīḥ ||29|| arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehamāha - yuktyeti | kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya yuktyā kartavyavidhinā ayamapi sūraṇā'valehaḥ kartavyaḥ | sudhīriti grahaṇena pūrvoktakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍe yaddravyaṃ yanmānaṃ yā kartavyatā tat sakalaṃ vicārya tenaiva prakāreṇa sūraṇāvalehaḥ sādhyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate || 29 ||
Gū. sugamam || 29 ||
atha agastyaharītakyavalehaḥ - harītakīśataṃ bhadraṃ yavānāmāḍhakaṃ tathā || 30||
palāni daśamūlasya viṃśatiṃ ca niyojayet | citrakaḥ pippalīmūlamapāmārgaḥ śaṭhī tathā || 31 ||
kapikacchuḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī bhārṅgī ca gajapippalī | balā puṣkaramūlaṃ ca pṛthagdvipalamātrayā || 32 ||
pacetpañcāḍhake nīre yavaiḥ svinnai: śṛtaṃ nayet | taccābhayāśataṃ dadyātkvāthe tasminvicakṣaṇaḥ || 36 ||
sarpistailāṣṭapalakaṃ kṣipedguḍatulāṃ tathā | paktvā lehatvamānīya siddhe śīte pṛthakpṛthak ||34||
kṣaudraṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ dadyātkuḍavamātrayā | harītakīdvayaṃ khādettena lehena nityaśaḥ || 35 ||
ayaṃ kāsaṃ jvaraṃ śvāsaṃ hikvārśo'rucipīnasān | grahaṇīṃ nāśayedeṣa valīpalitanāśanaḥ || 36 ||
balavarṇakaraḥ puṃsāmavaleho rasāyanam | vihito'gastyamuninā sarvarogapraṇāśanaḥ || 37 ||

Dī. athāgastyaharītakyavalehaṃ darśayannāha - harītakīśatamityādi | harītakīśataṃ harītakīguṭikāśataṃ na tu harītakīpalaśataṃ ‘saṃkhyā phalānāṃ śataśaḥ palānām’ iti vacanāt | bhadramiti śreṣṭhaṃ harītakīphalaśataṃ tena navādiguṇasahitamityarthaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘navā snigdhā ghanā vṛttā gurvī kṣiptā tathā'mbhasi | nimajjedyā praśa- statvādguṇakṛt sā prakīrtitā’ iti | yavānāmāḍhakamiti | yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ tasya catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni | kecittu ‘harītakīśataṃ bhadrayavānām āḍhakaṃ tathā’ iti paṭhanti, tatra bhadrayavā indrayavā iti vyākhyānayanti, etanna pracarati sarveṣāṃ saṃpradāyavirodhāt | tasmāddharītakīśataṃ bhadramiti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalamityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yavaiḥ svinnairiti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | yavasvinnatā ca caturbhāgāvaśeṣe jale eva bhavati tena caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭameva grāhyaṃ | tantrāntare'pyuktaṃ - ‘yavāḍhakaiḥ pañcabhiraṅghriśeṣaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet’ ityādi | paktvāvalehatvamānīyeti vyavahārāt | harītakīśatasya karpaṭe poṭṭalaṃ baddhvā kvathanaṃ paścādutsvinnaharītakīśatasya ghṛtatailayorbharjanaṃ taddṛḍhārthaṃ | yathā tantrāntare sarvārthasiddhaharītakyāṃ harītakībharjanamuktaṃ | tadanu kvāthe guḍatulāṃ loḍayitvā pākaḥ karyavyaḥ, avataraṇasamaye pippalīcūrṇaprakṣepaḥ | śītībhūte cāpare'hni madhudānamiti vṛddhānāṃ mataṃ; sugandhārthaṃ manāk cāturjāmiti kecit | taduktaṃ - ‘pippalīcūrṇakuḍavaṃ cāturjātāvacūrṇitam’ iti | sarpistailāṣṭakapalamiti yaduktaṃ tanmilitvā grāhyaṃ | ‘harītakīdvayaṃ khādet tena lehena nityaśa’ iti | yadyapi guḍasya bhakṣaṇamānaṃ noktaṃ tathāpi harītakīdvirūpagrahaṇena lehasya palamānaṃ bhavatyeva yathā tantrāntare bhārgīguḍe ‘bhakṣayedabhayādekāṃ lehasyārdhapalaṃ lihet’ iti | tenā'tra harītakībhakṣaṇavidhānādguḍapalaṃ bhakṣyamiti | anye tu gulmocchede harītikīnyāyādguḍaṃ dvipalamāhuḥ, etat sarvameva vyādherbalābalatvāt pracarati | agastyamunivihitatvenāsya siddhaphalatvamucyate || 30-37 ||

Gū. harītakīśataṃ bhadram uttamaṃ śataṃ gaṇanayā, yavānāmāḍhakaṃ yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalaṃ śāliparṇyādikaṃ daśauṣadhaṃ citrakādīni ca pṛthaṅmātrayā dvipalaṃ, apāmārgaḥ, śaṭhī karcūrakapikacchurvānarī tasyā bījaṃ, śaṅkhapuṣpakaṃ śvetapuṣpī, bhārgī, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, tadabhāve cavyaṃ vā, balā prasiddhā, puṣkaramūlaṃ etāni pañcāḍhake nīre pacet | khinnaiḥ pakvairyavaiḥ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet | tasminkvāthe abhayāśataṃ dadyāt pakvaṃ śuṣkaṃ punaḥ pacet yadvā paścādabhayāpākaḥ paktvā lehatvam ānīya sarpirghṛtam aṣṭapalikaṃ tilajaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu guḍaṃ catuḥpalaṃ pippalīcūrṇaṃ ca kuḍavaṃ | tena lehena siddhena harītakīdvayaṃ khādet balāpekṣayā ekaṃ vā ādau, kṣayādikaṃ haret | ayaṃ agastyamuninā'bhihita agastyāvalehaḥ || 30-37 ||

div.ab: arśādau kuṭajāvalehaḥ | kuṭajatvaktulāṃ droṇe jalasya vipacetsudhīḥ | kaṣāyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 38 || triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātra dattvā ca vipacetpunaḥ| sāndratvamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet|| 39 || rasāñjanaṃ mocarataṃ trikaṭu triphalāṃ tathā | lajjāluṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāṃ bilvamindrayavaṃ tvacām ||40|| bhallātakaṃ prativiṣāṃ viḍaṅgāni ca vālakam | pratyekaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ ghṛtasya kuḍavaṃ tathā || 41 | siddhaśīte tato dadyānmadhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā | jayedeṣo'valehastu sarvāṇyarśāṃsi vegata: || 42 || durnāmaprabhavānrogānatīsāramarocakam | grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca raktapittaṃ ca kāmalām ||43|| amlapittaṃ tathā śothaṃ kārśyaṃ caiva pravāhikām | anupāne prayoktavyamājaṃ takraṃ payo dadhi || 44 | ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vā jīrṇe ca pathyabhojī bhavennaraḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ kuṭajāvalehamāha - kuṭajatvagiti | kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak challī sā palaśataparimitā grāhyā | pādaśeṣamiti caturthāṃśaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā grāhyaṃ | kutracidetanna pracarati kintu pādaśeṣamiti pādasya caturthāṃśasya yaccheṣaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tadgrāhyam, etenāṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kathitam; tathāca tantrāntare - ‘kuṭajatvakpalaśataṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet | aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu kaṣāyamavatārayet | vastrapūtaṃ tataḥ kvāthaṃ pacellehatvamāgatam’ iti | triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātreti atra kvāthe guḍasya purātanasya triṃśatpalaṃ datvā punarvipacediti yāvat sāndratvaṃ bhavati | cūrṇārthamaparāṇi dravyāṇyāha - rasāñjanamiti rasāñjanaṃ pratītaṃ tacca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavamiti prasiddhiḥ, mocarasaṃ śālmalīveṣṭakam, indrayavaṃ tvacamiti indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ, tvak guḍatvak | durnāmaprabhavān rogāniti gulmodaraprabhṛtīn, anupāne prayoktavyamiti ājaṃ takraṃ, ājaṃ payaḥ, ājaṃ dadhi, ājaṃ ghṛtaṃ ceti | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ, takrādīnāmabhāvāt etatsakalamanupānaṃ yathāsātmyaṃ niṣevedityarthaḥ | jīrṇe ceti dravye parimite sati pathyabhojī bhavennara iti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ - ‘auṣadhaśeṣe bhukta’mityādivākyānurodhāt || 38-44 ||

div.ab: Gū. kuṭajaḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya tvak tulāṃ palaśataṃ jalasya droṇe vipacet | sāndratvaṃ ghanatvamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā imāni rasāñjanādīni pratyekaṃ palamānāni kṣipet | rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ, prativiṣā ativiṣā, bālakam udīcyaṃ, lajjāluḥ lajjāvatī, spaṣṭamanyat || 38 -44 ||

ab.seg: atīsārādau kuṭajāṣṭakāvalehamāha - kuṭajatvaktulāmārdrāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet || 45 ||
pādaśeṣa śṛtaṃ nītvā cūrṇānyetāni dāpayet | lajjālurdhātakī bilvaṃ pāṭhā mocarasastathā || 46 ||
mustaṃ prativiṣā caiva pratyekaṃ syātpalaṃ palam | tatastu vipacedbhūyo yāvaddarvīpralepanam || 47 ||
jalena chāgadugdhena pīto maṇḍena vā jayet | sarvātisārānghorāṃstu nānāvarṇānsavedanān || 48 ||
asṛgdaraṃ samastaṃ ca sarvārśāṃsi pravāhikām | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe'valehakalpanā nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

Dī. kuṭajeti | ayaṃ kuṭajāṣṭakāvaleho vyākhyāyāṃ sugama evāvagantavyaḥ | kartavyavidhistu pūrvavadroddhavyaḥ | darvīpralepanam ityavalehasya saṃsiddhilakṣaṇaṃ sūcitaṃ pūrvoktāvalehavidhau jñātavyam || 45-48 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śūrṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyama- khaṇḍe'valehakalpanādhyāyo'ṣṭamaḥ || 8 ||

Gū. atha kuṭajāṣṭakamatīsārādau - ārdrā kuṭajatvak tulāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet, pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | lajjālurlajjāvatī, dhātakī vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya puṣpāṇi, bilvaṃ, pāṭhā, mocarasaḥ, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, ativiṣā etāni pratyekaṃ palaṃ tato bhūyo vipacet yāvaddarvyāḥ pralepalepanaṃ bhavati liptvā tiṣṭhati darvī lohanirmitā| tato jalādibhiḥ pibet | spaṣṭamanyat ||45-48 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmavalehādhikāraḥ ||8 ||

div.head: atha tailādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha snehaparibhāṣā | kalkāccaturguṇīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ vā tailameva vā | caturguṇe drave sādhyaṃ tasya mātrā palonmitā ||1||
nikṣipya kvāthayettoyaṃ kvāthyadravyāccaturguṇam | pādaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhītvā ca snehaṃ tenaiva sādhayet ||2||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ snehakalpanāṃ darśayannāha - kalkāditi | anukte kalkātkalkayogadravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā caturguṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu dṛṣadi peṣitātkalkāt| dravamapi caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt dravaṃ toyādi | tasya mātrā palonmiteti | tasya saṃsiddhasnehasya pānārthaṃ palonmitā palapramāṇā mātrā jñeyā ityanukteṣu mānamidaṃ sāmānyaṃ | paribhāṣāyāmayamapi sāmānyasnehapākavidhau boddhavyaḥ, tathāhi - ‘kalkāccaturguṇaḥ snehaḥ snehātkvāthaścaturguṇaḥ | kvāthāccaturguṇaṃ vāri kvāthaḥ kvāthyasamo mataḥ’ iti | viśeṣo'pi kvacidvartate yathā tantrāntare vāsāghṛte balādye ghṛte vā tadyathā -“atrāpyaṣṭaguṇaistoyaiḥ kvathitaṃ kvāthadugdhayoḥ | pratyekaṃ dviguṇo bhāgo bhiṣak sarpiṣi nikṣipet” iti || 1 || 2||

Gū. atha sneheti | tatra tāvat prathamataḥ paribhāṣāmasya vyācaṣṭe | atha ghṛtādhikāraḥ | tatrādau ghṛtatailādisādhanamāha - tatkalketyādi | kalkāt dravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ caturguṇe dravye dugdhādau sādhyam agnidvārā kaṭāhādau paktvā siddhaṃ bhavati | tasya mātrā vātādirogaviṣaye mānamātrā palonmitā palapramāṇā | idānīṃ snehasādhane kvāthavidhānamāha - nikṣipyetyādi | kvāthadravyāccaturguṇaṃ toyaṃ jalaṃ nikṣipya kvāthayet| punaḥ pādaśiṣṭaṃ ca caturthāṃśāvaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā'nena kvāthena snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā sādhayet | kvāthaṃ kvāthayogyaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ yaddravyaṃ daśamūlādi tasmādisyarthaḥ || 1 || 2 ||
mṛdudravyādau kvathane jalapramāṇamāha - caturguṇaṃ mṛdudravye kaṭhine'ṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam | tathāca madhyame dravye dadyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ || 3 || atyantakaṭhine dravye nīraṃ ṣoḍaśikaṃ matam |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ dravyaviśeṣe kvāthanimittaṃ jalamānamāha - caturguṇamiti | atra caturguṇaprabhṛtikaṃ dravyaparimāṇāddhoddhavyam | yāvatparimāṇaṃ kvāthyaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tāvatparimāṇāccaturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | mṛdu kaṭhinaṃ kaṭhinataraṃ ca dravyaṃ tatraivānumānato'vagantavyam | tathāca madhyame dravye dadyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ paya iti | madhyame mṛdvādisaṃbhāre payaḥ pānīyaṃ yatra mṛdukaṭhinataradravyamekatra militvā kvāthyaṃ tatrāṣṭaguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyamiti sarvatra | tathāhi - ‘mṛdvādikvāthyasaṃghāte mānānukte cikitsakāḥ | madhyasyobhayabhāgitvādicchantyaṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam’ iti || 3 ||

Gū. mṛdudravye guḍūcyādau caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ, kaṭhine daśamūlādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ, tathāca madhyamadravye āragvadhādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | payo'tra jalaṃ | atyantakaṭhine padmakādau ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ mataṃ kathitaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhyate || 3 ||
atha matāntare parimāṇaviśeṣamāha - karṣāditaḥ palaṃ yāvatkṣipetṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam || 4 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ kuḍavaṃ yāvadbhavedaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | prasthāditaḥ kṣipennīraṃ khārī yāvaccaturguṇam || 5 ||
ambukvātharasairyatra pṛthaksnehasya sādhanam | kalkasyāṃśaṃ tatra dadyāccaturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṣṭamam || 6 ||
dugdhe dadhni rase nakre kalko deyo'ṣṭamāṃśakaḥ | kalkasya samyakpākārthaṃ toyamatra caturguṇam || 7 ||

div.ab: Dī. karṣādita iti | karṣādita ityādiparimāṇaṃ sāmānyadravyaviṣaye vartate anyathā svatantravirodhaḥ, yāva- tkvāthyadravyaṃ karṣādiparimāṇātpalaṃ bhavati tāvattatra ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ | ṣoḍaśikamatra kvāthyadravyaparimāṇāt, tatastu palādupari yāvatkuḍavaṃ kvāthyadravyaparimāṇaṃ bhavati tāvadatra toyaṃ pānīyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet, kvāthyadravyādityarthaḥ | atra kvāthaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ grāhyamiti sarvatra | prasthādita iti | prasthādiparimāṇāt yāvat khārī bhavati tāvadatra caturguṇaṃ nīraṃ pānīyaṃ prakṣipya saṃkvāthya ca pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | ādiśabdāt āḍhakadroṇaśūrpadroṇīprabhṛtayo grāhyāḥ | yadvā prasthasyādiḥ prasthādistasmāt tena śarāvamapi gṛhyate, śarāvādita ityarthaḥ || 4 || 5 ||aparamapyanuktamāha - ambukvātheti | yatra snehapāke pānīyāditrayāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ madhye yadā ekena pākaḥ syāt tadā kalkasya kalkadravyasya caturthāṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśam aṣṭamāṃśaṃ yathā'nukrameṇa deyam | anukramo yathā - yadi ambunā kevalena pākastarhi kalkadravyasya caturthāśaṃ deyam, snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | yadā kevalena kvāthenaiva pākastadā kalkadravyasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ deyam, atrāpi snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | yatra tu kevalasvarasenaiva sādhyate srehaḥ tatra kalkadravyasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyam | snehamānādityatrāpi sambandhaḥ ityanukramaḥ | aparamapi - dugdhe ityatrāpi ekadravyasādhyatā sūcyate tadā kalkadravyaṃ snehaparimāṇādaṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyamiti bhāvaḥ | kalkasyeti | yatra tu anyadravaiḥ kevalakalkenaiva sādhyate snehastadā caturguṇaṃ kalkadravyaṃ caturguṇaṃ toyaṃ nikṣipediti sarvatra | samyak pākārthaṃ boddhavyam | etena kimuktaṃ yadā kṣīrādibhiḥ pratyekena svakalkena pākastadā caturguṇaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | pānīyaṃ vinā pāko nāstīti sarvamatam || 6 || 7 ||

Gū. karṣādārabhya khārīparyantaṃ kvāthyadravye jalamānamāha - karṣāditaḥ yāvatpalaṃ pramāṇaṃ tāvat ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet| tadūrdhvaṃ palādūrdhvaṃ yāvatkuḍavaṃ kuḍavapramāṇaṃ tāvadaṣṭaguṇaṃ payo jalaṃ bhavet | prasthāditaḥ yāvat khārīpramāṇaṃ tāvaccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet | pūrvaṃ caturguṇādijalaṃ yallikhitaṃ tanmṛdudravyādiviṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ | karṣādita idaṃ tu mānaviṣayam ataḥ kecinmṛdvādito gṛhṇanti kecinmānato gṛhṇanti || 4 || 5|| ambvādibhiryatra snehamānaṃ tatra kalkapramāṇamāha - ‘tatrāmbupiṣṭamuktaṃ syājjalaṃ cātra caturguṇam’, yatra bhinnaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavati, tatra kalkasyāṃśaṃ caturguṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ kramāt ambupāke caturthāṃśaṃ raso māṃsarasastatpāke aṣṭamāṃśam | ukto'pyambvādau pāke dugdhādau aṣṭamāṃśa eva kalkapāka ityāha - kalkasya samyagiti | dugdhe tathā dadhni tathā takre pākānantaraṃ kalkaḥ aṣṭamāṃśakādayaḥ raso māṃsarasaḥ | yadvā raso dhattūrarasaḥ māṃsarasasya pūrvoktatvāt kalkasya samyak pākārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehādityarthaḥ || 6 || 7 ||

ab.seg: dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni bhavanti hi | tatra snehasamānyāhuryathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇam || 8 ||

Dī. idānīmanuktadravāṇāṃ mānamāha - davāṇīti | yatra snehapakvadravāṇi kṣīratakrarasamūtrakvāthāni anyānyapi pañcādīni pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti anuktamānānīti viṣayaḥ | tatra tāni dravāṇi snehasamāni pratyekamāhurācāryāḥ | yathā vakṣyamāṇatriphalāghṛte arvāk dravaṃ catvārastrayo vā tarhi snehaparimāṇāccaturguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekamityarthaḥ | eke yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇamiti paṭhanti tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | kutracit dravyāṇīti pāṭho dṛśyate so'saṅgata eva || 8 ||

Gū. dravyāṇīti | yatra pañcādhikāni dravyāṇi tatra sneheṣu kiyatparimitaṃ dravyaṃ deyaṃ tadāha - sneheṣu ghṛtatailādiṣu dravāṇi dugdhādīni yatra pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti tatra snehasamānaṃ bhavati na caturguṇānīti yāvat | yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇamityetasyāyamartha: | eko dravastatra pākena cāturguṇyaṃ, dvau dravau yatra tatra dvābhyāṃ cāturguṇyaṃ yaduktaṃ jaijjaṭe ‘ekadvitridravairdravyaiḥ kuryāt snehāccaturguṇaṃ | kṣīraṃ snehasamaṃ dadyāt caturbhiśca caturguṇam, iti | asyāyamarthaḥ yatraiko dravastatraikena cāturguṇyaṃ, evaṃ dvābhyāṃ, tribhirmilitvā cāturguṇyamityarthaḥ | yatra pañcādhikāni bhavanti tatra snehasamānīti pūrvārthaḥ| ‘tailasyārdhapramāṇena dadyādikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ | tathā māṃsarasaṃ cārdhaṃ datvā snehaṃ vipācayet’ snehasamānyāhurityasya truṭimāhurityarthaḥ ityanye | tadyathā - sakṛnmāṃsauṣadhirasaṃ mūtrasauvīrakādikaṃ | snehatulyaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ jalaṃ caiva caturguṇam || granthajñānārthamedvyavākhyāprasaṅgenoktam ||8||
kevalakvāthapāke vidhānamāha - dravyeṇa kevalenaiva snehapāko bhavedyadi | tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ syājjalaṃ cātra caturguṇam || 9||
kvāthena kevalenaiva pāko yatreritaḥ kvacit | kvāthyadravyasya kalko'pi tatra snehe prayujyate ||10||

div.ab: Dī. atha kevaladravyasya snehapākārthaṃ mānamāha - dravyeṇeti | atra dravyaṃ snehāccaturthāṃśaṃ kalkārthaṃ vāri tāvaddeyaṃ yāvat kalkaḥ syāt | yataḥ peṣaṇe jalasya parimāṇaṃ na syāt | jalaṃ cātra caturguṇamiti | atra kalke jalaṃ pānīyam | caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ snehamānādityarthaḥ | eke dravyamānāccaturguṇaṃ jalamiti vyākhyānayanti tanna manoharaṃ kalkadravyālpatvāt | aparamapyāha - kvātheneti | yatra snehe kvaciditi anukte kevalena kvāthena kṛtvā pākaḥ kathitaḥ tatra snehe kvāthyadravyasya kalka: kāryaḥ, kalkārthaṃ cātra caturguṇaṃ jalamiti tena yenaiva dravyeṇa kvāthaḥ kriyate tainaiva tatparimitena ca dravyeṇāyamapi kṛtvā'tra caturguṇena ca jalena saha sādhyaḥ | pūrvaṃ kvāthena sādhyaḥ paścātkalkenetyarthaḥ ||9||10||
Gū. kevalena kvāthena yadi snehapāko bhavet tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalko jalaṃ caturguṇakvātheneti | idaṃ padyaṃ pūrvaślokasyaikārthatvāt prakṣiptaṃ jñeyaṃ || 9 || 10 ||
kalkahīnastu yaḥ srehaḥ sa sādhyaḥ kevale drave |
Dī. kalkahīna iti | yaḥ sneho ghṛtaṃ tailādikaḥ kalkahīnaḥ kalkarahito bhavet saḥ kevale drave sādhyaḥ| dravamatra caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt ||
Gū. atha kevaladravasādhanamāha - kalkahīne snehe sādhanamāha - yaḥ kalkahīnaḥ snehaḥ sa kevale drave sādhyaḥ|
puṣpakalkastu yaḥ snehastatra toyaṃ caturguṇam || 11 || snehe snehāṣṭamāṃśaśca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ puṣpakalkasya parimāṇamāha puṣpakalka iti | yaḥ puṣpakalkasaṃjñaḥ snehaḥ tatra snehe toyaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ caturguṇatā ca snehāt snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | saḥ puṣpakalkaḥ snehāṣṭamāṃśo yojyata ityarthaḥ | snehasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ tena sāmyo yojya ityarthaḥ | puṣpāṇi yathā nāgakeśarakuṅkumalavaṅgadamanakasurapuṣpacampakotpalapuṇḍarīkaketakījātī-kusumbhaprabhṛtīni | eke puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyata ityasya sthāne'tra kalkaṃ prayujyate iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti tat patrakalkaṃ prakṣepamāhuḥ, tathāhi - ‘gandhaniryāsapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhaśīte'vatārite | prakṣepo gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalkaṃ tu tadviduḥ’ || 11 ||

Gū. puṣpakalkai: snehasādhanamāha - puṣpeti | yasminsnehe puṣpakalko dīyate sa puṣpakalkaḥ snehaḥ, tatra toyaṃ jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehātpuṣpakalkaḥ kiyatparimito dīyate ityatrāha - snehāṣṭamāṃśaśca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate iti || 11 ||
vartivatsnehakalkaḥ syādyadāṅgulyā vimarditaḥ ||12||
śabdahīno'gninikṣiptaḥ snehaḥ siddho bhavettadā| yadā phenodgamastaile phenaśāntiśca sarpiṣi ||13||
gandhavarṇarasotpattiḥ snehasiddhistadā bhavet | snehapākastridhā prokto mṛdurmadhyaḥ kharastathā ||14||
īṣatsarasakalkastu snehapāko mṛdurbhavet | madhyapākasya siddhiśca kalke nīrasakomalaḥ ||15||
īṣatkaṭhinakalkaśca snehapāko bhavetkharaḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapākaḥ syāddāhakṛnniṣprayojanaḥ || 16 ||

Dī. idānīṃ snehānāṃ saṃsiddhilakṣaṇānyāha - vartivaditi | yadā snehe paripācitaḥ kalkaḥ aṅgulyā vimardito vartisadṛśo bhavati tadā siddho jñeyaḥ | athavā sa eva kalkaḥ yadā'gnau nikṣiptaḥ śabdarahito bhavati tadā siddho jñātavyaḥ iti sāmānyam | aparamapi viśeṣamāha - yadā snehasya pākānte taile phenodgamo bhavati sarpiṣi ca phenaśāntirbhavati tadā siddhalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ | varṇagandharasotpattirapi snehasiddhiḥ syāt varṇādikamapi taile sarpiṣi ca jñātavyam | adhunā trividhasnehapākasya lakṣaṇamāha - īṣatsarasakalka iti | yadā kalke sāndratā kiñcidbhavati agnau nikṣipte sati caṭacaṭāśabdo bhavati tadā mṛdupāko jñeyaḥ, yadā nīraso kalko bhavati komalaśca nātikaṭhino nātimṛduriti tadā madhyapākaḥ, yadā kiñcit kaṭhinakalko jātaḥ nīrasaśca bhavati tadā kharapāka iti | eteṣāṃ parīkṣaṇamanumānato'vagantavyaṃ gurusakāśadarśanādvā | tadūrdhvaṃ kharapākādūrdhvaṃ yadā snehakalkaḥ kaṭhinataro bhavati tadā dagdho jñeyaḥ, sa ca sarvakarmasu niṣphalaḥ syāt dāhakaraśca bhavati ||12-16||

div.ab: Gū. idānīṃ snehasiddhalakṣaṇamāha - yadā snehakalkaḥ aṅgulyā vartitaḥ vartīkṛtaḥ vartivadbhavet agninikṣiptaḥ śabdahīnaśca bhavet tadā siddhaṃ vadet | yadā varṇagandharasotpattistadāpi snehasiddhirbhavet| iti ca lakṣaṇaṃ varṇastailapakvavarṇo raktādiḥ, gandhaḥ sugandhatvaṃ, rasotpattirmadhurādirasotpattiḥ, tadā svedanāllakṣyate | snehapākasya trividhatvamāha - eko mṛdu:, eko madhyaḥ, ekaḥ kharaḥ; evaṃ tridhā snehapākaḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - īṣatsarasakalkaḥ īṣajjalakalkaḥ mṛdusnehapākaḥ nīrasakomale kalke siddhaḥ pāko madhyapākaḥ nīrasakomale jalasahite ārdre īṣatkaṭhinakalkaḥ snehapākaḥ kharaḥ tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapāko dāhakṛnniṣprayojanaḥ, na kāryakārī ||12||16||

āmapākaśca nirvīryo vahnimāndyakaro guru: | nasyārthaṃ stanmṛdu: pāko madhyamaḥ sarvakarmasu ||17|| abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ prokto yuñjyādevaṃ yathohitam | ghṛtatailaguḍādīṃśca sādhayennaikavāsare ||18|| prakurvantyuṣitā hyete viśeṣādguṇasaṃcayam |

Dī. idrānīṃ tasya caturvidhapākasya guṇamāha - āmapākaśceti | āmapāko'paripākakalka: sneho nirvīryo bhavati, niḥśeṣeṇa vīryarahita ityarthaḥ | vahnimāndyakṛdbhakṣaṇayoge ca bhavati | nasyaviṣaye mṛdupākaḥ snehaḥ | madhyapākastu sarvakarmasu yujyate sarvakarma nasyābhyaṅgapānādikaṃ | kharapākasnehaḥ kevalābhyaṅge vihitaḥ nānyakarmasu | yathocitamiti yathāyogyaṃ yuṃjyādityarthaḥ | eke nasyābhyaṅge kharaḥ prokta iti paṭhanti, tanna sarvasaṃmatam, nasye tu saumyamāhuḥ | snehastu kimekāhenaiva sādhyaḥ uta dīrghadavasaiḥ tadviṣayamāha - ghṛteti | ghṛtataile prasiddhe guḍo'valehaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt īdṛśasambhārā ye cā'nye prayogāḥ te sarve ekasminneva vāsare na sādhyā: na pācanīyā ityarthaḥ | kutastadāha - prakurvanti ityādi | te snehādayastu yadā uṣitāḥ santi tadā guṇasañcayaṃ prakurvanti | ata eva bahudivasaiḥ kṛtvā sādhanīyā iti bhāvaḥ | tantrāntareṣu etadbahudravyasambhāraviṣayam, asmatsampradāye'pi svalpamapi snehaṃ kiñci- dvipācyāpare'hni siddho'vatāryaḥ guḍādikamapi cāpare'hni madhudānādikamuktaṃ kuryāt naivaṃ sarvamatavirodhaḥ || || 17 || 18 ||

Gū. āmapākastrividhapākāddhīnaḥ sajala evetyarthaḥ, sa vahnimāndyakaraḥ, tathā guruḥ | yeṣu mṛdvādayaḥ prayujyante, tānāha - nasyārthamiti | nasyārthaṃ mṛdupākaḥ sarvakarmasu, bhakṣaṇāvasthāyāṃ madhyamaḥ, abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ evaṃ yathocitaṃ yuñjyāt prayojayet, ghṛtatailādīn ekasminneva dine na sādhayet, kutaḥ ? uṣitā rātrau vāsitā viśeṣādguṇasañcayaṃ kurvanti || śārṅgadharānuktamapi tailasādhanam ātreyādāha - “sneho vārisamaṃ nītvā pācayet mṛduvahninā | pañcapallavakalkena dvātriṃśāṃśena saṃyutam || kiṃcitsarasagarbheṇa vastrapūtaṃ prakalpayet | itye- tadduṣṭagandhādidoṣastailādvimucyate || nirdoṣakaraṇādetatkṛtvā tailaṃ vipācayet” iti | granthāntare evaṃ śodhanaṃ - “tailaṃ kṛtvā kaṭāhe dṛḍhataravimale mandamandāgninā ca pakvaṃ niṣphenabhāvaṃ gatamiha hi yadā śaityabhāvaṃ tadaiva | muñjiṣṭhārātrilodhrairjaladharanalikaiḥ sāmalai: sākṣapathyaiḥ sūcīpuṣpāvarohairnayati satataṃ gandhayogaṃ jahāti” || mañjiṣṭhādyairmilitaiḥ agninīraiḥ pādāṃśakaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet, rātrirharidrā, jaladharo mustakaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā uttaradeśe prasiddhā tadabhāve tvak; sāmalai: sāmalakaiḥ, akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ, pathyā harītakī, sūcīpuṣpaṃ ketakī, avarohaḥ vaṭāvarohaḥ, cakārāt granthāntare caiva “tailasyendukalāṃśakena vikacā grāhyā tu mūrcchāvidhau ye cānye triphalādayastu rajanīhrīberalodhrānvitāḥ | sūcīpuṣpavaṭāvarohanalikādravyāstu pādāṃśikāḥ procyāstailajagandhadoṣaharaṇe kalkīkṛtāstadvidaiḥ? | vikacā mañjiṣṭhā, indukalāṃśena tailāt ṣoḍaśāṃśena grāhyāḥ, mūrcchāvidhau tailamūrcchāvidhau, ye cānye triphalādayaste militvā kalkīkṛtāḥ | payodo mustā, rajanī haridrā, hrībera udīcyaṃ, lodhraḥ prasiddhaḥ, sūcī- puṣpaṃ ketakī, vaṭāvarohaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā, tathāca - ‘madhye sāravihīnā ca sarasā kīṭavarjitā | nalikā sā bhavedbhadrā viparītā tu ninditā’ | kecinnalikāṃ tvacamāhuḥ | iti ghṛtatailasādhanaprakāraḥ || || 17 || 18 ||

atha ghṛtakalpanā sa yathā- pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ || 19 || sasaindhavaiśca palikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā tadghṛtaṃ plīhanāśanam || 20|| viṣamajvaramandāgniharaṃ rucikaraṃ param |

Dī. sa yathetyanena taṃ snehapākasamūhaṃ darśayati granthakāraḥ | tatrādau pūrvaṃ tāvadvṛtakalpanāṃ darśayannāha yatastailādviśiṣṭo ghṛtakalpaḥ pūrvācāryairdarśitaḥ tathaivātrāpi likhitaḥ | prathamataḥ kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtavyākhyānamāha - pippalīti | atra pippalyādikaṃ pañcadravyaṃ pañcakolasaṃjñaṃ boddhavyam, yatastantrāntare pañcakolaghṛtamasya nāma prasiddham, atra cavyamiti viṭapaviśeṣaḥ, yasya phalaṃ gajapippalīti śrutiḥ, palikairiti palapramāṇatā pratyekamāhuḥ | ata eva kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtamidam, caturguṇakṣīreṇa saha ṣaṭpalapramāṇaṣaḍdravyaiśca sādhitamityarthaḥ | atra caturguṇaṃ nīramapi deyam, samyakpākā- rthamityasmatsampradāyābhiprāyaḥ | ghṛtaprasthamiti | ṣoḍaśapalamitam ‘kṣīrasya caturguṇatātra ghṛtaparimāṇāt tatsiddhamiti siddhatā'sya paribhāṣoktavidhānāt ||19||20||

Gū. atha kṣīraṣaṭpalaghṛtam – tatrādau ghṛtādhikāraḥ pippalyādyaiḥ ṣaṭpalaiḥ kalkitairghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet tad ghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ bhavati pippalyādīnāṃ ṣaṭpalatvāt | plīhā dakṣiṇāṅge rogaviśeṣaḥ hṛdayādadhaḥ, viṣamajvaraharaṃ tathā rucikaraṃ, viṣamajvarāḥ saṃtatādayaḥ pañca || 19 || 20 ||

atha cāṃgerīghṛtaṃ atīsāragrahaṇyoḥ - pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī ||21|| śvadaṃṣṭrā nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ pāṭhā bilvaṃ yavānikā | dravyaiśca palikairetaiścatuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ghṛtam || 22 || ghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ deyaṃ cāṅgairīsvarasaṃ budhaiḥ | tathā caturguṇaṃ dattvā dadhi sarpirvipācayet ||23|| śanaiḥ śanairvipaktavyaṃ cāṅgerīghṛtamuttamam | tadghṛtaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ grahaṇyarśovikāranut || 24 || hantyānāhaṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām |

ab.seg: Dī. atha cāṅgerīghṛtamāha - pippalīti | atra hastipippalī gajapippalī, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣurakaḥ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, bilvamatra bilvaśalāṭu, palikairiti palapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, cāṅgerīsvarasamiti cāṅgerī prasiddhā, sācāmlarasā āmacāṅgerīti loke prasiddhā, tasyāḥ svarasamiti sadyorasaṃ, budhairiti grahaṇena sadyorasābhāve kvāthamapi deyam dadhi caturguṇaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ paktavyamiti mandapācanapācitamiti bhāvo dagdhabhayāt || 21-24 ||
Gū. hastipippalī gajapippalī, cāṃgerī‘khaṭṭīmīṭhī’ hi.bhā.| tatsvarasaḥ dadhi godadhi || 21-24 ||

div.ab: atha masūraghṛtam atīsārādau - masūrāṇāṃ palaśataṃ nīradroṇe vipācayet ||25|| pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā datvā bilvapalāṣṭakam | ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacettena sarvātīsāranāśanam ||26|| grahaṇīṃ bhinnaviṭkaṃ ca nāśayecca pravāhikām |

Dī. atha masūrādyaṃ ghṛtamapyāha - masūrāṇāmiti | masūro'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, nīradroṇe jaladroṇe catuḥṣaṣṭikuḍavaparimitaṃ bhavati | bilvaṃ palāṣṭakamitaṃ bhavati bilvaṃ bilvamajjā tacca kalkīkṛtaṃ jalena saha deyam, kartavyavidhāvapi masūrāḥ karpaṭabaddhāḥ kvāthyāḥ, mṛdvagninā ca sādhanaṃ kāryam ||25||26||
Gū. sugamam ||25||26||

ab.seg: atha kāmadevaghṛtaṃ raktapittādau - aśvagandhā‘aśvagandhā palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ matam | punarnavāśvatthaśuṇṭhīkāśmaryāstu phalānyapi || padmabījaṃ māṣabījaṃ daṣāddaśapalaṃ pṛthak | caturdroṇāmbhasā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ padmakaṃ raktacandanam | patrakaṃ pippalī drākṣā kapikacchuphalaṃ tathā || nīlotpalaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ sārive dve bale tathā | pṛthakvarṣasamā bhāgāḥ śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || rasaśca pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | ghṛtasya cāḍhakaṃ dattvā pācayenmṛdunāgninā || ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ paṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || vātaraktaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca kāmalām | śukrakṣayamurodāhaṃ kārśyamojaḥkṣayaṃ tathā || strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ garbhadaṃ śukradaṃ nṛṇām | kāmadevaghṛtaṃ nāma hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ rasāyanam’ || iti pāṭhāntaram | palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ smṛtam | śatāvarī vidārī ca śālaparṇī balāmṛtā || 27 ||
aśvatthasya ca śuṅgāni padmabījaṃ punarnavā | kāśmaryāśca phalaṃ caiva māṣabījaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 ||
pṛthagdaśapalānbhāgān caturdroṇe'mbhasi pacet | droṇe śeṣe rase tasmin paceccaiva ghṛtāḍhakam ||29||
mṛdvīkā padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī raktacandanam | patrakaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca ātmaguptāphalaṃ tathā || 30||
nīlotpalaṃ sārive dve jīvanīyo gaṇastathā | pṛthakvarṣasamānbhāgān śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || 31||
rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | caturguṇena payasā ghṛtāḍhakaṃ vipācayet || 32 ||
ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || 33 ||
mūtrakṛcchramurodāhaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca nāśayet | etatsarpiḥ prayoktavyaṃ bahvanta: puravāsinām || 34 ||
strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ durbalānāṃ ca dehinām | śreṣṭhaṃ balakaraṃ varṇyaṃ hṛdyaṃ puṣṭirasāyanam ||35||
ojastejaskaraṃ hṛdyamāyuṣyaṃ prāṇavardhanam| saṃvardhayati śukraṃ hi puruṣaṃ durbalendriyam || 36 ||
sarvarogavinirmuktau payaḥsikto yathā drumaḥ | kāmadeva iti khyātaṃ sarpiruktaṃ mahāguṇam || 37 ||

Dī. idānīṃ kāmadevaghṛtavivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - aśvagandheti | aśvagandhāmūlaṃ palaśataṃ grāhyam tadardho gokṣura iti pañcāśatpalaṃ; gokṣuro'tra pañcāṅgo grāhyaḥ, aparāṇi daśadravyāṇi daśapalamiti pratyekamāhuḥ, tāni kānītyatrāha -śatāvarītyādi sugamam | tatra tu aśvatthasya ca śuṅgānīti pippalaśuṅgāni siddhāni, kāśmarī gambhārī tasyāḥ phalāni, padmabījaṃ prasiddhaṃ ‘kamalagaṭā’ śabdavācyam, māṣabījamiti maṣāḥ pratītaḥ, etat sakalaṃ pānīyadroṇacatuṣṭaye saṃkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ vastragālitaṃ grāhyam | aparāṇyapi kalkayogyāni dravyāṇyāha - mṛdvīketyādi | mṛdvīkā drākṣā, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ tattu campakavadvṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchuḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalavācyam, tadabhāve kamalabījaṃ grāhyam | sārive dve iti kṛṣṇasārivā śuklasārive | te ‘aphoī’ śabdavācye; kṛṣṇasārivā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā, śuklasārivā jambūvatpatrā vratatiḥ, jīvanīyo gaṇa iti jīvanīyo jīvantīśākaviśeṣaḥ, tadādisaṃjñako jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ, tathāhi - ‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyukvākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ iti | tasyā'prasiddhatvāt tatsāmyaguṇadravyāṇi yojyāni iti vṛddhavaidyānāṃ sammatam, etāni mṛdvīkādīni dravyāṇi pṛthak karṣapramāṇāni grāhyāṇi, śarkarāyāḥ paladvayamiti | kecit siddhe'smin śarkarāyāḥ prakṣepamāhuḥ | rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmiti | pauṇḍrako vikhyātaḥ ikṣuviśeṣaḥ, ikṣuḥ sāmānyaḥ sa ca lohitekṣu prabhṛtiko yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ, nanu ikṣugrahaṇenaiva pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaprāptiḥ tatkathaṃ bhinnagrahaṇam ? ucyate - pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaṃ guṇaprābalyāt kṛtaṃ yataḥ ‘pauṇḍrakaḥ śītalaḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇo kaphakṛt saraḥ’ iti | tasmāt pauṇḍrako viśeṣeṇātra pācanīyaḥ | asya rasasyāḍhakaṃ pratyekaṃ dvirāḍhakagrahaṇāt ghṛtāḍhakamekam, godugdhaṃ caturāḍhakamiti ||27-37 ||

Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī, kāśmarī, gambhārī, padyabījaṃ kamalabījaṃ, māṣabījamannaṃ, jīvantīyagaṇaścūrṇoktaḥ, nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, sārive dve śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, dve bale balā nāgabalā, śarkarā sitā; pauṇḍrapauṃḍā | kekṣūṇāṃgāṇḍā (nnā) | rasaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat ||27-37 ||
apasmārādau pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ - triphalā dve niśe kauntī sārive dve priyaṅgukā | śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī devadārvyelavālukam || 38 ||
nataṃ viśālā dantī ca dāḍimaṃ nāgakeśaram | nīlotpalailā mañjiṣṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ kuṣṭhapadmakam || 39 ||
jātipuṣpaṃ candanaṃ ca tālīsaṃ bṛhatī tathā | etaiḥ karṣasamaiḥ kalkairjalaṃ dattvā caturguṇam || 40 ||
ghṛtaprasthaṃ paceddhīmānapasmāre jvare kṣaye | unmāde vātarakte ca kāse mandānale tathā || 41 ||
pratiśyāye kaṭīśūle tṛtīyakacaturthake | mūtrakṛcchre visarpe ca kaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmaye tathā || 42 ||
viṣadvaye prameheṣu sarvathaivopayujyate | vandhyānāṃ putradaṃ bhūtayakṣarakṣoharaṃ smṛtam || 43 ||

Dī. atha pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam āha - triphaleti | triphalātra harītakīprabhṛtiphalatrayam, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, kauntī reṇukā, sārive dve kṛṣṇaśuklabhedena, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī ceti kavarādvayaśabdavācyam, elavālukaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ tacca kuṣṭhagandhi ṣaṭphalasadṛśam; nataṃ tagarapādikā, viśālā indravāruṇī, dantī prasiddhā, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalaṃ bījāni ca, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyaṃ, elā bṛhatphalā, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ kusumāni, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmaprasiddham, bṛhatī bṛhatkaṇṭakārikā etāni karṣapramāṇāni pratyekaṃ | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | ghṛtaprasthamiti kuḍavacatuṣṭayapramitaṃ gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavati kevalapānīyaparipācanāt pānīyakalyāṇakamasya saṃjñārūḍhiḥ ||38-43||

Gū. kauntī reṇukā, elavālukaṃ prasiddhaṃ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dāḍimaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya bījāni, padmakaṃ jātipuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣpāṇi, kalkadravyāt caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet | tatpānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāmataḥ ||38-43||
amṛtāghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhādau - amṛtākvāthakalkābhyāṃ sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam | vātaraktaṃ jayatyāśu kuṣṭhaṃ jayati dustaram || 44 ||

Dī. amṛtādyaghṛtavivaraṇamapyāha - amṛteti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthakalkābhyāṃ kṛtvā sakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vipācya vātaraktādike deyam, tena kvāthaścaturguṇajalena siddhaḥ sa ca ghṛtāccaturguṇa iti paribhāṣāyāṃ pratītaḥ | kalkaṃ dṛṣadi peṣitaṃ tacca ghṛtāṃśaṃ tena kalkadravyaṃ ghṛtāccaturthāṃśaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | sakṣīramiti caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt| kecittu snehasamaṃ proktamiti paṭhanti etadapi saṅgataṃ na viruddhaṃ dravāntaratvāt | kalke'pi caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pācanīyamiti vyavahāraḥ | asya pānamāhurabhyaṅgaṃ ca || 44 ||
Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī, tasyāḥ kvāthaḥ kalkaśca, kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ ghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 44 ||
atha mahātiktakaghṛtaṃ vātaraktakuṣṭhādau - saptacchadaḥ prativiṣā śyāmākaḥ kaṭurohiṇī | pāṭhā mustamuśīraṃ ca triphalā parpaṭastathā || 45 ||
paṭolanimbamañjiṣṭhāḥ pippalī padmakaṃ śaṭhī | candanaṃ dhanvayāsaśca viśāle dve niśe tathā || 46 ||
guḍūcī sārive dve ca mūrvā vāsā śatāvarī | trāyantīndrayavāyaṣṭībhūnimbaścākṣabhāgikāḥ || 47 ||
ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyādghṛtādāmalakīrasaḥ | dviguṇaḥ sarpiṣaścātra jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 48 ||
tatsiddhaṃ pāyayetsarpirvātarakteṣu sarvathā | kuṣṭhāni raktapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi ca pāṇḍutām ||49||
hṛdrogagulmavīsarpapradaraṃ gaṇḍamālikām | kṣudrarogān jvarāṃścaiva mahātiktamidaṃ jayet ||50||

Dī. idānīṃ mahātiktakaghṛtamāha - saptacchada iti | saptacchadaḥ saptaparṇaśabdavācyaḥ sa ca śālmalīpatrasadṛśo yugmapatraḥ; prativiṣā ativiṣā śyāmāko rājavṛkṣastasya phalaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, viśāle dve itīndravāruṇīdvayaṃ, dve niśe iti haridrādvayaṃ, sārive dve iti śuklakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddham, akṣabhāgikāḥ karṣapramāṇāḥ, pratyekaṃ ghṛtaṃ caturguṇamiti pūrvadravyasambhārāt āmalakaphalasvaraso dviguṇo ghṛtaparimāṇāt svarasābhāve kvātho'pi deyaḥ na doṣaḥ, jalaṃ pānīyaṃ cāṣṭaguṇaṃ deyaṃ samyakpākārthaṃ sarpiṣo ghṛtaparimāṇāt, etatsiddhaṃ mahātiktakaṃ nāma ghṛtaṃ vātaraktādiṣu praśastam || 47-50 ||

Gū. saptacchadaḥ saptapuṭā, prativiṣā ativiṣā, śyāmāka āragvadhaḥ, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī, pāṭhā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ. paṭolaṃ‘paravala’ hi.bhā.| phalaśākastasya patrāṇi, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, śaṭhī karcūra:, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ; dhanvayāsako yavāsakaḥ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā ca, dve sārive śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā moraṭā, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, indrayavaḥ, yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, bhūnimbaḥ tiktakam | akṣabhāgikā: pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgāḥ | ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ sarvadravyebhyaścaturguṇaṃ | ghṛtāt dviguṇa āmalakīrasaḥ sarpiṣo ghṛtāt jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ sarvaṃ paktvā siddhaṃ kārayet | spaṣṭamanyat | mahātiktakaṃ siddhatvāt ||45-50||
atha kāsīsādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhe dadrūpāmāśira:sphoṭādau - kāsīsaṃ dve niśe mustaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām | kampillakaṃ gandhakaṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 51 ||
sikthakaṃ maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tutthakaṃ gaurasarṣapān | rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāsaṃ raktacandanam || 52 ||
irimedaṃ nimbapatraṃ karañjaṃ sārivāṃ vacām | mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhukaṃ māṃsīṃ śirīṣaṃ lodhrapadmakam ||53||
harītakīṃ prapunnāṭaṃ cūrṇayetkārṣikānpṛthak | tatastaccūrṇamāloḍya triṃśatpalamite ghṛte || 54 ||
sthāpayettāmrapātre ca gharme sapta dināvadhi | asyābhyaṅgena kuṣṭhāni dadrūpāmāvicarcikāḥ || 55 ||
śūkadoṣā visarpāśca visphoṭā vātaraktajāḥ | śira:sphoṭopadaṃśāśca nāḍīduṣṭavraṇāni ca || 56 ||
śotho bhagandaraścaiva lūtāḥ śāmyanti dehinām | śodhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva savarṇakaraṇaṃ ghṛtam || 57 ||

Dī. adhunā kāsīsādyaghṛtavivaraṇamāha - kāsīsamiti | kāsīsaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ bhasmavadalpabhṛt asya bhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaṃ, tacca kiñcit pītam, dve niśe dve haridre, kampillako rorīśabdavācyo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kampilletyapare, sikthakaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sindūraṃ prasiddhaṃ śrīvāsaṃ niryāsadravyaṃ rālaśabdavācyaṃ, irimedo viṭkhadira ojaśabdavācyaḥ karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ loke colā iti prasiddhaḥ | sārivā āsphotā ‘āphoī’ loke; māṃsī gandhamāṃsī jaṭāvadviṭapaḥ, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ cakramardabījāni, etāni pṛthak karṣapramitāni cūrṇīkṛtya triṃśatpalaparimite ghṛte āloḍya tāmrapātre | nidhāya gharme dhārayet yāvat sapta dināni bhavanti | etaccādravāgnisiddhaṃ sūryapākasaṃjñamiti boddhavyam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu kalkārhaṃ dravyaṃ kalkībhūtaṃ kṛtvā caturguṇena pānīyena saha ghṛtaṃ vipācya paścāt prakṣepayogyaṃ dravyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya tatra prakṣipyāloḍya gharme saptadinaṃ yāvaddhārayet evaṃ siddho bhavati | kalkārthaṃ dravyaṃ yathā - haridrāmustaraktacandanerimedanimbapatrakarañjasārivāvacāmañjiṣṭhā- madhumāṃsīśirīṣalodhrapadmakaharītakīprabhṛtikaṃ śeṣaṃ prakṣepārthaṃ jñeyam || 51-57 ||

Gū. kāsīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ prasiddhaṃ, śirīṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ‘panavāḍa’ hi.bhā.| cakramardastasya bījāni, etān pṛthak karṣamitān triṃśatpalamite ghṛte tāmrapātre gharme saptadinaṃ sthāpayet || 51-57 ||

div.ab: atha vraṇe jātyādighṛtaṃ- jatinimbapaṭolaṃ ca dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī | mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ sikthaṃ karañjośīrasārivāḥ || 58 || tutthaṃ va vipacetsamyakvalkairebhirghṛtaṃ budhaḥ | asya lepādvirohanti sūkṣmanāḍīvraṇā api || 59 || marmāśritāḥ kledinaśca gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ |

Dī. idānīṃ jātyādikaṃ ghṛtamāha - jātītyādi | jātīnimbapaṭolamityatra trayāṇāṃ patrāṇi grāhyāṇi tantrāntaradarśanāt | tathāca - ‘jātīnimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavā’ ityādi | dve niśe dve haridre, tena haridrā dāruharidrā, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī śabdavācyam, madhukaṃ yaṣṭhīmadhu, sikthakaṃ madanakaṃ, karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ tasya patrāṇi phalāni vā, uśīraṃ sugandhadravyam | sārivā āsphotā, tutthaṃ haritapāṣāṇavat kṛtrimaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ, etat sāmyamānaṃ sakaladravyād ghṛtaṃ caturguṇā sādhyam | atra kalkapācanārthaṃ caturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ deyam | eke sikthatutthayoḥ siddhe prakṣepamāhuḥ | tathāca - ‘prakṣepaṃ kārayeddhīmān siddhe sikthakatutthayoḥ’ ityādi | jātīkādyaṃ gaurādyaṃ ca tailamapi pacyate| tathāca cakraḥ - ‘gaurādyaṃ jātīkādyaṃ ca tailamevaṃ prasādhyate | tailaṃ sūkṣmānane duṣṭe vraṇe gambhīra eva ca’ iti || 58 || 59 ||

Gū. jātī mālatī tasyāḥ patrāṇi, nimbapatrāṇi, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu,sikthaṃ karañjamūlaṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, sārivā anantā, tutthaṃnīlāthothā prasiddhaṃ, ebhiḥ kalkairghṛtaṃ pacet kalkadravyāt ghṛtaṃ caturguṇam | asya lepāt sūkṣmā nāḍīvraṇā rohanti || 58 || 59 ||

atha bindughṛtaṃ jalodaravirecanādau- citrakaṃ śaṅkinī pathyā kampillastrivṛtāyugam ||60|| vṛddhadāruśca śamyāko dantī dantīphalaṃ tathā | kośātakī devadālī nīlinī girikarṇikā ||61|| sātalā pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ kaṭukī tathā | hemakṣīrī ca vipacetkalkairebhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ ||62|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ ṣaṭpale tu paladvayam | arkakṣīrasya matimāṃstatsiddhaṃ gulmakuṣṭhahṛt ||63|| hanti śūlamudāvartaṃ śothādhmānaṃ bhagandaram | śamayatyudarāṇyaṣṭau nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā || 64 || godugdhenoṣṭradugdhena kaulatthena śṛtena vā | uṣṇodakena vā pītvā binduvegairviricyate || 65 || etadbindughṛtaṃ nāma nābhilepādviricyate |

ab.seg: Dī. adhunā bindughṛtamāha - citrakamiti | atra citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, śaṅkhinī yavatiktā, śaṅkhapuṣpīśabdavācyā, kaṃpillaḥ kaṃvīlā vikhyātā ‘rorī’ śabdavācyamiti kecit | trivṛtāyugamiti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, ‘niśotha’ dvayaṃ, vṛddhadāru mahāśyāmo dīrghapatraḥ sa ca tridhārāśabdavācyaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālakaḥ, dantī loke ‘dantivanī’ti vācyā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ jayapālaśabdavācyaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, kośātakī ghoṣārī, devadālī vallīviśeṣaḥ | girikarṇikā ‘śophandaīśaphanda’ iti prasiddhaḥ | sātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, ‘ghaṭaghava’ iti loke | hemakṣīrī kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ keciccokaśabdavācyamiti vadanti | picūnmitairiti karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekamatra kalkārthaṃ toyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ vyavahārāt | tathāca - ‘snuhyarkapayasoratra pākārthamupapattitaḥ | caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam’ ityādi | snuhīkṣīraṃ sehuṇḍasya kṣīraṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ deyam, arkakṣīraṃ tu paladvayamiti vadanti kecit | asmatsaṃpradāye tu aṣṭapalaparimitaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ etatparimāṇaṃ tu arkakṣīramiti | nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā iti ‘binduḥ syāttarjanīparvadvayamagrārdhato mitaḥ’ iti vyavahārāt | ṣaḍaṣṭamāṣakā deyā binduvegairiti yāvatsaṃkhyān bindūn pibet tāvanmātreṇa viricyata ityarthaḥ | ‘nābhilepādviricyate’ ityanenāsya prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvaṃ darśitam || 60-65 ||

Gū. śaṅkhinī śaṅkhapuṣpī, pathyā harītakī, kampillaḥ, trivṛtāyugmaṃ niḥsṛtādvayaṃ śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, vṛddhadāruḥ prasiddhaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālaḥ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, dantīphalaṃ jayapālaṃ, kośātakī kaṭurgrāhyā, devadālī vaṃdālī, nīlinī nīlapuṣpī, girikarṇikā aparājitā, śvetapuṣpī parājitā, sātalā sehuṇḍaḥ, hemakṣīrī prasiddhā | picūnmitaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ snuhīkṣīre sehuṇḍadugdhe ṣaṭpale pacet, paladvaye arkakṣīrasya vipacet tatsiddhaṃ bindughṛtaṃ bhavati | binduprayogāt bindughṛtaṃ nāmnā prasiddham || || 60-65 ||
atha triphalāghṛtaṃ netraroge timirādau - triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ vāsārasodbhavam || 66 ||
bhṛṅgarājarasaprasthaṃ prasthamātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam | dattvā tatra ghṛtaprasthaṃ kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak || 67 ||
triphalā pippalī drākṣā candanaṃ saindhavaṃ balā | kākolī kṣīrakākolī bhedā maricanāgaram ||68||
śarkarā puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca punarnavā | niśāyugmaṃ ca madhukaṃ sarvairebhirvipācayet || 69 ||
naktāndhyaṃ nakulāndhyaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ pillaṃ tathaiva ca | netrasrāvaṃ ca paṭalaṃ timiraṃ kācakaṃ jayet || 70||
anye'pi praśamaṃ yānti netrarogāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | traiphalaṃ ghṛtametaddhi pāne nasyādiṣūcitam || 71 ||

Dī. idānīṃ triphalāghṛtavyākhyānamāha - triphaleti | triphalāyā rasaprasthamiti | svarasābhāve kvāthaḥ kalkaṃ vā pracarati | vāsārasodbhavaṃ prasthamiti vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ, ājaṃ payaśchāgīdugdham, eke ‘prasthamājaṃ payaḥ smṛta’mityasyāgre ‘guḍūcyāśca rasaprastham āmalātvagrasaṃ tathā | prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvairebhirghṛtaṃ pacet’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalkairiti vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ tadyathā - triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ kamalasāmānyatvena raktaṃ nīlaṃ vā; niśāyugmamiti haridrādvayaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, etat siddhaṃ bhojanāgre bhojanamadhye bhojanānte ca vihitam | tathāca tantrāntare - ‘ūrdhvapānamadhaḥpānaṃ madhyapānaṃ ca śasyate’ iti | śarkarāyāḥ siddhe prakṣepamāhureke | naktāndhyādayo netramṛge vikhyātāḥ || 66-71 ||

Gū. triphalārasaprasthamityatra harītakīsvarasaprasthaḥ, āmalakarasaprasthaḥ, pratyekaṃ triphalāprastho jalaṃ natu ṣaḍāḍhakamitaṃ, kaiśoraguggulvādau nirṇītatvāt | tīsaṭe spaṣṭameva likhitaṃ, - ‘pathyākṣāmalakījale payasi ca cchāge'tha vāsārase bhṛṅgasya svarase vipācitamiti proktaiśca kalkauṣadhaiḥ | kākolītriphalāmṛtotpalakaṇā hyuṣṇā- sitāṣaṣṭikāvyāghrībhiḥ saha netraruk praśamate sarpirmahātraiphalam’ iti || harītakyādīnāṃ svarasastu agnisaṃyogaṃ vinā kartavyaḥ | yadvā svarasaṃ prāpyāgnisaṃyogakaraṇādagnisaṃyogaḥ | svarasaḥ kvāthastatra prasthaṃ harītakī, caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaḥ, dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā svarasaḥ prasthamātraṃ gṛhyate evamanyeṣām | nanu samuditasya triphalāyāḥ svarasaḥ prasthaḥ, uktāyāṃ ca triphalāyāṃ āmalakīrasasya bhinnagrahaṇāt, tathāca vṛndavaṅgasenādayaḥ ‘triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ bhṛṅgarasasya ca | vṛṣasya ca rasaḥ prasthaṃ śatāvaryāśca tatsamam | ajākṣīraṃ guḍūcyāśca āmalakyā rasaṃ tathā | prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvairebhirghṛtaṃ pacet | atra guḍūcīsvarasata āmalakīsvaraso'dhikaḥ, śārṅgadhare tu nāsti tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ | ucyate, śārṅgadhareṇa tu tīsaṭamataṃ gṛhītamiti tasya na doṣaḥ || 66-71 ||
atha gaurādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vraṇe - dve haridre sthirā mūrvā sārivā candanadvayam | madhuparṇī ca madhukaṃ paḍmakeśarapadmakam || 72 ||
utpalośīramedābhistriphalāpañcavalkalaiḥ | kalkaiḥ karṣamitairetairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet || 73 ||
visarpalūtāvisphoṭaviṣakīṭavraṇāpaham | gaurādyamiti vikhyātaṃ sarpirviṣaharaṃ param || 74 ||

Dī. adhunā gaurādyaṃ ghṛtamāha - dve haridre iti | haridrā dāruharidrā, sthirā śāliparṇī, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, sārivā āsphotā, candanadvayamiti śvetaraktabhedena, madhuparṇī yaṣṭīmadhubhedaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | kecittu madhuyaṣṭyā eva bhāgadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ dviḥpāṭhāt | padmakaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, pañcavalkalairityasyāgre ‘jātīnimbapaṭolaṃ ca karañjaṃ tiktasikthakam’ iti paṭhanti tadvahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate| atrāpi kalkapākārthaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇamitaṃ deyam | paribhāṣāmatānusārataḥ gaurādikameti | gaurā haridrā || || 72-74 ||

Gū. dve haridre haridrā dāruharidrā ca, śāliparṇī, mūrvā moraṭā, sārivā anantā, candanadvayaiḥ raktacandanaḥ śvetacandanaḥ, madhuparṇī māṣaparṇī, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakeśaraṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭham, utpalaṃ raktakamalaṃ, uśīraṃ medā aṣṭavargoktā pañcavalkalaiḥ vaṭa-udumbara-śirīṣa-parkaṭī-vetasa eṣāṃ valkalaiḥ etaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pratyekaṃ jalapiṣṭaiḥ pacet | gaurā haridrā tadādyatvāt idaṃ gaurādighṛtaṃ spaṣṭamanyat || 72-74 ||

div.ab: atha mayūraghṛtaṃ śirorogādau - balāmadhukarāsnābhirdaśamūlaphalatrikaiḥ | pṛthagdvipalikairebhirdroṇanīreṇa pācayet || 75 || mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitam | pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamam ||76|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetsamyagjīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitaiḥ | tatsiddhaṃ śirasaḥ pīḍāṃ manyāpṛṣṭhagrahaṃ tathā || 77 || arditaṃ karṇanāsākṣijihvāgalarujo jayet | pāne nasye tathābhyaṅge karṇapūreṣu yujyate || 78 || hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu ca śasyate |

ab.seg: Dī. atha mayūrādyaṃ ghṛtamāha - balā iti | balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā surabhiḥ, daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | phalatrikaṃ harītakyādi pṛthak dvipalikairebhirityasya sthāne kecit triphalikairiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitaṃ mayūramekaṃ droṇanīreṇeti caturāḍhakamitena pānīyena pācayet, kintu vyavahārataḥ adhikaṃ jalaṃ deyam | yataḥ mayūreṇa saha dravyāṇāṃ kvāthavidhānaṃ bhavati | tathāca cakraḥ ‘daśamūladibhistulyo mayūra iha gṛhyate’ iti | evaṃ militvā yāvatkvāthaṃ bhavati tāvajjalaṃ deyam, tatra ‘kvāthyāccaturguṇaṃ vāri’ ityādi paribhāṣayā jalavyavastheti pūrvavyākhyāpracāraḥ | kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamamiti kvāthasamamityarthaḥ, eke ghṛtasamaṃ kṣīramiti manyante, tadapi saṅgataṃ dravāntaratvāt, jīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitairiti jīvanīyo madhuragaṇaḥ sa yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ | picūnmitaiḥ karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ jīvanīyastu kalparūpa ityāhuḥ | etad ghṛtaṃ pānābhyaṅganasyādiṣu yojyam | hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu iti | anyathā doṣakṛt syāt | tathāhyuktam ‘hemantakāle śiśire ca sevyaṃ vasantakāle ca mayūrasarpiḥ | uṣṇādvidāhī viṣabhakṣaṇācca varṣāśaradgrīṣmamukheṣvapathyam| āhārajātaṃ hi vihaṃgamasya kīṭāśca sarpāśca sarīsṛpāśca | pipīlikā matkuṇamakṣikāśca tenoṣṇakāleṣvahito mayūra: | tathaiva kāle jaladābhirāme visṛjya śukraṃ caṃ balaṃ ca barhī | kṛśatvamāyātyatidīnabhāvāt śaranmukhe tena vivarjanīyam’ iti || 75-78 ||

Gū. balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā, daśamūlaṃ, triphalā etaiḥ ṣoḍaśadravyai: dvipalikaiḥ droṇanīreṇa mayūraṃ kṣiptvā pācayet| pādaśeṣaṃ nayet tatsamaṃ rasasamaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet | ghṛtaprasthaṃ picūnmitaiḥ jīvanīyadravyagaṇaiḥ jīvanīyacūrṇoktaiḥ | kiṃbhūtaṃ mayūraṃ pakṣapitta-aṃtrayakṛtpādaṃ āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tadrahitaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 75-78 ||

div.ab: atha phalaghṛtaṃ vandhyādoṣe - triphalā madhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī || 79 || viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī mustaṃ viśālā kaṭphalaṃ vacā | dve mede dve ca kākolyau sārive dve priyaṅgukā ||80|| śatapuṣpā hiṅgu rāsnā candanaṃ raktacandanam| jātīpuṣpaṃ tugākṣīrī kamalaṃ śarkarā tathā || 81 || ajamodā ca dantī ca kalkairetaiśca kārṣikaiḥ | jīvadvatsaikavarṇāyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca goḥ kṣipet || 82 || caturguṇena payasā pacedāraṇyagomayaiḥ | sutithau puṣyanakṣatre mṛdbhāṇḍe tāmraje tathā || 83 || tataḥ pibecchubhadine nārī vā puruṣo'thavā | etatsarpirnaraḥ pītvā strīṣu nityaṃ vṛṣāyate || 84 || putrānutpādayeddhīmānvandhyāpi labhate sutam | anāyuṣaṃ vā janayedyā ca sūtā punaḥ sthitā ||85|| putraṃ prāpnoti sā nārī buddhimantaṃ śatāyuṣam | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma bhāradvājena bhāṣitam || 86 || anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ kṣipettatra cikitsakaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ bṛhatphalaghṛtamāha - triphaleti | viśālendravāruṇī, dve mede iti medā mahāmedā, dvau ca kākolyāviti kākolī kṣīrakākolī, sārive dve iti sārivā kṛṣṇasārivā ‘sāva’ iti loke, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ, rāsnā surabhī, jātī sumanā tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, kamalamutpalaṃ śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | eteṣāṃ pratyekaṃ karṣapramitānāṃ kalkamāhuḥ | jīvadvatsā ekavarṇā vā gaustasyā ghṛtamiti jīvadvatsāprahaṇamiti maṅgalatvāt| caturguṇena payaseti ghṛtaparimāṇāt| āraṇyagomayairiti mandapāvakapācanatvāt, anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlamiti kvacit paṭhyate | lakṣmaṇā śvetakaṇṭakārikā anye alpaviṭapamāhuḥ, tathāhi - ‘putrakā'kāraraktālpabindubhirlāñchitā sadā | lakṣmaṇā putrajananī bastagandhākṛtirbhavet | śaratkāle bhavati sā phalapuṣpā'nvitā sadā | gṛhṇīyāt puṣyamūlārke hastārke cābhimaṃtrya ca’ ityādi || 79-86 ||
Gū. madhukaṃ yaṣṭī|, viśālā indravāruṇī, jātīpuṣpaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ, tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanaṃ, śarkarā sitopalā, daṃtī jayapālamūlaṃ, payasā dugdhena | spaṣṭamanyat || 79-86 ||
atha laghuphalaghṛtaṃ yoniroge - triphalāṃ dve sahacare guḍūcīṃ sapunarnavām | śukanāsāṃ haridre dve rāsnāṃ medāṃ śatāvarīm ||87||
kalkīkṛtya ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetkṣīre caturguṇe | tatsiddhaṃ pāyayennārīṃ yoniśūlanipīḍitām|| 88 ||
pīḍitā calitā yā ca niḥsṛtā vivṛtā ca yā | pittayoniśca vibhrāntā ṣaṇḍhayoniśca yā smṛtā ||89||
prapadyante hi tāḥ sthānaṃ garbhaṃ gṛhṇanti cāsakṛt | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma yonidoṣaharaṃ param || 90 ||

Dī. atha laghuphalaghṛtamāha - triphalamiti | sahacare dve pītaraktabhedena (śukanāsānāsti ‘kha’ pustake | syonākaḥ, rāsnā surabhiḥ) śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ sugamam | etat sakalaṃ ghṛtacaturthāśaṃ grāhyaṃ, kalkaṃ kṛtvā kṣīracaturguṇena saha ghṛtaṃ sādhyam, atra kalkārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | caturguṇāt snehaparimāṇāt | etad ghṛtaṃ yonidoṣeṣu prāyaśaḥ pracarati palitācalitetyādayo yonigadaviśeṣāḥ kathitāḥ | te tu tatraiva boddhavyā: || 87-90 ||
