anyacca kāñcanārarasaiḥ samasūtakagandhayoḥ kajjalī hemapatrāṇi lepayet | samamātrayā svarṇasamamātrayā, spaṣṭamanyat || 10-13 ||

anyadapi svarṇamāraṇaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā sindūraṃ tayoḥ samayostulyayoścūrṇam arkadugdhaṃ dadyāt | dhamettato hemni dugdhakaiḥ samaiva bhāgato dadyāt dhamettato hemni gālite samaḥ hemasamaḥ kalkaḥ dīyeta tato dhamet | yathā kalko na tiṣṭhati evaṃ kṣāratrayaṃ dadyāt svarṇamṛtirbhavet || 14-16 ||

tathāca pārāvateti sugamam | anyacca granthāntarāt | daradaṃ hiṃgulaṃ svarṇatulyaṃ nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ mṛtanāgacūrṇaṃ vajrīkṣīreṇa marditam asya madhye suvarṇasya kalkaśca mriyate iti svarṇamāraṇam || 17-20 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ raupyamāraṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - bhāgaikaṃ tālakaṃ mardyaṃ jambenāmlena kenacit | tena bhāgatrayaṃ tārapatrāṇi parilepayet || 21 || dhṛtvā mūṣāpuṭe ruddhvā puṭet triṃśadvanopalaiḥ | samuddhṛtya punastālaṃ dattvā ruddhvā puṭe pacet || 22 || evaṃ caturdaśapuṭaistāraṃ bhasma prajāyate |

Dī. bhāgaikamiti | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ bhāgaikaṃ tārapatrabhāgādityarthaḥ, jambena jambīrakarasena amlagrahaṇaṃ madhurajambīraniṣedhārthaṃ, kenacidityanena kenāpyamlena vā kutaḥ jambīrābhāvāt tena cukrādikamapi grāhyam, tena tālakena saha bhāgatrayamiti tārapatrāṇi raupyapatrāṇi pralepayet bhāgatrayaṃ tālakaparimāṇāt puṭavidhānaṃ pūrvavat triṃśadvanopalairityanena mahāpuṭaṃ darśitam | evamityuktapuṭavidhānena caturdaśapuṭakaṃ boddhavyam || 21 || 22 ||

Gū. atha rajatotpattibhedānāha granthāntarāt - ‘tripurasya vadhārthāya nirnimeṣairvilocanaiḥ | nirīkṣayāmāsa śivaḥ krodhena paripūritaḥ || tatastūlkābhisamaye tasmāt kasmācca locanāt | tato rudraḥ samabhavadvaiśvānara iva jvalan || dvitīyasmāt paraṃ netrāddaśabindustu krāmukāt | tasmādrajatamudbhūtaṃ śukrakarmasu saṃsthitam’ iti | atha tadbhedāḥ - ‘sahajaṃ khanisaṃbhūtaṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca tridhā mataṃ | rajataṃ pūrvapūrvaṃ hi svaguṇairuttarottaraṃ | kṛtrimaṃ rasavādotthaṃ kiṃ vā rāmapadodbhavaṃ | ni:kalmaṣaṃ prabhāhīnaṃ dāhe cchede sitaṃ śubhaṃ | aśuddhaṃ sarvathā śodhyaṃ nāgaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaiḥ? iti | atha māraṇaṃ bhāgaikamiti | spaṣṭamanyat || 21 || 22 |

ab.seg: aparamapi tāramāraṇamāha - snuhīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ mākṣikaṃ tena lepayet || 23 ||
tālakasya prakāreṇa tārapatrāṇi buddhimān | puṭeccaturdaśapuṭaistāraṃ bhasma prajāyate ||24 ||

div.ab: Dī. snuhīkṣīreṇeti | pūrvoktaharitālavidhānavanmākṣikavidhānena kṛtvā caturdaśapuṭāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat tāraṃ raupyaṃ bhasma syāt | mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ snuhīkṣīreṇeti snuhī sehuṇḍabhedaḥ || 23 || 24 ||

Gū. anyacca | snuhīkṣīreṇa sehuṇḍadugdhena saṃpiṣṭamākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ mūtrādau śuddhaṃ tālakasya prakāreṇa bhāgaikatārapatrāṇi vibhāgaṃ trilepayet punaḥ mūṣāsaṃpuṭena ruddhvā caturdaśapuṭaiḥ puṭet | tāraṃ bhasma prajāyate | granthāntare pāradena māraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadapi likhyate tathāca ‘vidhāya piṣṭaṃ sūtena rajatasyātha melayet| | tālaṃ gandhaṃ samaṃ paścānmardayennimbukadravaiḥ | dvitripuṭairbhavedbhasma yojyametadrasādiṣu’ iti | atha guṇāḥ ‘rūpyaṃ śītaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ svādupākarasaṃ saraṃ | vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ snigdhaṃ lekhanaṃ vātapittajit | pramehādikarogāṃśca nāśayatyaciraṃ dhruvam || 23 || 24 ||

pītalohamāraṇamāha - arkakṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭo gandhakastena lepayet | samenārasya patrāṇi śuddhānyamladravairmuhuḥ || 25 || tato mūṣāpuṭe dhṛtvā puṭedgajapuṭena ca | evaṃ puṭadvayenaiva bhasmāraṃ bhavati dhruvam || 26 || āravatkāṃsyamapyevaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti niścitam | aparamapyāha - arkakṣīravadājaṃarkakṣīraṃ vaṭakṣīraṃ nirguṇḍī kṣīrikā tathā i. pā. | syātkṣīranirguṇḍikā tathā || 27 || tāmrarītidhvanivadhe samagandhakayogataḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. arkakṣīreṇeti | āraṃ pītalohaṃ tacca tāmrasaṃbhavaṃ vadantyeke, tena gandhakakalkena samenārasamānena śuddhānyamladravairmuhuriti pūrvam ārapatrāṇi amladravairjambīraprabhṛtikaiḥ muhuriti velātrayaṃ viśuddhāni kṛtvā paścādgandhakakalkena lepayedityabhiprāyaḥ | gajapuṭaṃ pūrvaṃ darśitameva evamityamunā prakāreṇa puṭadvayaṃ kāryam | āravadityādi | kāṃsyaṃ prasiddham | āravadityanena śodhanamāraṇe cāsya tadvadeveti boddhavyam | ekamiti grahaṇena ghoṣamapi āravaditi jñeyam | viśuddhau māraṇe ca | tathāhi ‘kāṃsyāraghoṣapatrāṇi tena kalkena lepayet | ruddhvā gajapuṭe paktvā śuddhimāyānti niścitam | tāmravacca mṛtiṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā sarvatra yojayet’ iti | ghoṣaṃ kāṃsyabhedaḥ ‘jasada’ iti loke || 25 ||

26 || arkakṣīravadityādi | arkakṣīraprakāravadajākṣīreṇa gandhakakalkaṃ kāryam | tathā'nena prakāreṇa nirguṇḍīsvarasena gandhakakalkaṃ kāryamiti prayogāntaram | tāmradīnāṃ vadhe māraṇe | tāmrārarītyāraṃ, dhvaniḥ kāṃsyaṃ, samagandhakayogata iti | dhātusamānagandhako grāhya ityabhiprāyaḥ || 27 ||
Gū. atha āramāraṇam | ārasya pītalohasya patrāṇi amladravairnimbukādyaiḥ śuddhe mūṣāpuṭe pacet || 25 ||
26 || nirguṇḍikā, tāmraṃ prasiddhaṃ, rītiḥ pittaliḥ, dhvaniḥ kāsyaṃ tadvadhe tanmāraṇe spaṣṭamanyat ||27 ||
samprati tāmramāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi kṛtvā saṃsvedayedbudhaḥ | vāsaratrayamamlena tataḥ khalve vinikṣipet || 28 ||
pādāṃśaṃ sūtakaṃ dattvā yāmamamlena mardayet | tata uddhṛtya patrāṇi lepayeddviguṇena ca || 29 ||
gandhakenāmlaghṛṣṭena tasya kuryācca golakam | tataḥ ṣiṣṭvā ca mīnākṣīṃ cāṅgerīṃ vā punarnavām ||30||
tatkalkena bahirgolaṃ lepayedaṅgulonmitam | dhṛtvā tadgolakaṃ bhāṇḍe śarāveṇa ca rodhayet ||31||
vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha vibhūtilavaṇāmbubhiḥ | dattvā bhāṇḍamukhe mudrāṃ tataścullyāṃ vipācayet||32||
kramavṛddhāgninā samyagyāvadyāmacatuṣṭayam | svāṅgaśītalamuddhṛtya mardayetsūraṇadravaiḥ || 33 ||
dinaikaṃ golakaṃ kuryādardhagandhena lepayet | saghṛtena tato mūṣāṃ puṭe gajapuṭe pacet || 34 ||
sāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | vāntiṃ bhrāntiṃ klamaṃ mūrcchāṃ na karoti kadācana ||35||

Dī. sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi iti | sūkṣmatvamatra kaṇṭakavedhisaṃjñam | saṃsvedayedbudha iti amlena kāñjikādinā vāsaratrayaṃ dinatritayaṃ yāvaddolāyantreṇa svedanaṃ kuryāditi bhāvaḥ | patrāṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | samyakgrahaṇaṃ tāmrasyātidoṣanivṛttiṃ sūcayati | yadyapi śuddhirasya pūrvaṃ kathitā, tathā'pi punaḥ śodhanamasya viṣanivṛttyarthaṃ kālimā'pagamārthaṃ ca vihitam, | yataḥ ‘na viṣaṃ‘na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhustāmraṃ tu viṣamucyate | eka eva viṣe tāmre tvaṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | bhramo mūrcchā vidāhaśca svedaḥ kledo vamistathā | aruciścittasaṃtāpa iti doṣā viṣopamāḥ | tasmāt śuddhaṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ tāmraṃ rogapraśāntaye ||’ i. pā. | viṣamityāhustāmrameva mahāviṣaṃ | viṣasya caikadoṣastu śulbadoṣo'ṣṭadhā mataḥ’| tadyathā - ‘viṣaṃ mūrcchā vidāhaśca chardiḥ kledanabhedane | santāpaścāruciścaiva śulbadoṣo viṣopamaḥ’ isi | kālimārahitamapi | ‘śukatuṇḍakiṃśukābhaṃ chede raktaṃ tathā mṛdusnigdham | tāmraṃ bhavati sakṛṣṇaṃ tacchuddhaṃ kālimārahitam’ ata evāmlena punaḥ śodhanamabhihitaṃ na doṣaḥ | budha iti tajjātyādiviśeṣajñaḥ | yatastat tāmraṃ dvividham | ekaṃ mlecchasaṃjñamaparaṃ nepālamiti | tathāhi - ‘mlecchaṃ nepālakaṃ tāmraṃ tayornepālamuttamam | nepālādanyadeśotthaṃ śulbaṃ mlecchamiti smṛtaṃ | sitakṛṣṇāruṇacchāyaṃ vāntibhedakaraṃ ca yat | kṣālanācca punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tāmraṃ mlecchamudāhṛtam | susnigdhaṃ mṛdulaṃ raktaṃ viśodhanakṣamaṃ guru | tridoṣaharaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣārāmlairnaiti vaikṛtim | tannepālakamityuktaṃ dehalohavidhāyakam | vāntibhrāntijvaraharaṃ kledabhedabhramāpaham’ iti | tata iti paścāt | pādāṃśaṃ sūtakamiti | sūtakaṃ pāradaṃ pādāṃśaṃ, tāmramānacaturthāśaṃ yāmaṃ praharamekaṃ yāvat amlena jambīranimbukaprabhūtirasena mardayet iti bhāvaḥ | punastenaivā'mlena ghṛṣṭena dviguṇagandhakena kṛtvā lepayet patrāṇīti śeṣaḥ | dviguṇatā rasaparimāṇāt | na tu tāmramānāt asmatsampradāye tu gandhakaṃ bahutaraṃ yojyaṃ tena tāmramānāddviguṇamityarthaḥ | anyatrā'pyuktam ‘tāmrapādena sūtena sārdhaṃ patraṃ pralepayet | tāmrāddviguṇagandhena hyamlapiṣṭena tat punaḥ | liptvā hyadhordhvagaṃ deyaṃ supiṣṭāṃ cāmlapatrikām | tat piṇḍaṃ bhāṇḍagarbhe tu ruddhvā cullyāṃ vipācayet ityādi | tasya kuryācca golakamiti tasya tāmramayadravyasya mīnākṣī ‘machechī’ śabdavācyā | cāṅgerī amlapatrikā prasiddhā tatkalkeneti trayāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vyastānāṃ militānāṃ vā kalkaṃ vadanti tajjñāḥ | aṅgulonmitamiti aṅgulotsedhaṃ trayāṇāmekasya vā aṅgulamatra madhyamāṅgulimadhyaparvasaṃjñam | rodhayedityanena vibhūtilavaṇāmbubhiḥ kṛtvā śarāvasandhau mudrāṃ kārayediti bhāvaḥ | bhāṇḍamukhe ca kārayet | vibhūtirgomayabhasma lavaṇamatra pāṃśulavaṇam | ambu pānīyaṃ kramavṛddhāgnineti mṛdumadhyakharā'gninā śeṣaṃ subodham | (athanāsti ‘kha’ pustake| ca māritasyā'sya śuddhyarthaṃ vidhimapyāha -‘svāṃgaśītalamuddhṛtyetyādi tattāmraṃ svāṅgaśītalaṃ saṃgṛhya paścāt sūraṇadravaiḥ kṛtvā dinamekaṃ saṃmardya paścādgolakaṃ kṛtvā saghṛtenārdhagandhakakalkena golakaṃ lepayitvā tadanu mūṣāntardhṛtvā nirodhya ca gajapuṭe pacet | anena tat kṣaṇena bhakṣaṇayogyaṃ bhavati ardhagandhakaṃ tāmraparimāṇāt | tena tāmraṃ bhāgadvayaṃ gandhakamekabhāgamityarthaḥ | ghṛtamapi gandhakasāmyaṃ bhavati) || 28-35 ||

Gū. atha tāmrādyutpattibhedamāraṇaguṇāḥ - ‘ulbaṃ yatkārtikeyasya patitaṃ dharaṇītale | tasmādetatsamudbhūtaṃ tāmramāhuḥ purāvidaḥ’ iti | atha bhedāḥ ‘dvāvarkau nepālamlecchau rase nepālamuttamaṃ | sitaṃ kṛṣṇāruṇacchāyaṃ mlecchakaṃ tvativāmi ca | susnigdhaṃ mṛdulaṃ śoṇaṃ nepālaṃ nirvikārakam | imaṃ rūkṣamatistabdhaṃ śvetaṃ vāpi ca vāsahaṃ | lohanāgayutaṃ ceti śrutvā tad doṣasaptakam | eko doṣo viṣe, tāmre tvaṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | bhramo mūrcchā vidāhaśca svedotkledanavāntayaḥ | aruciścittasaṃtāpaḥ pāne doṣā viṣopamāḥ | viṣavatsthāpitaṃ tāmraṃ yatnataḥ sādhyate hi tat’ iti | atha māraṇaṃ | mīnākṣī matsyagandhā cāṃgerī spaṣṭamanyat | anyacca ‘sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi paladvitayamātrayā | gomūtre svedayennityamekaviṃśativāsaraṃ || punaramle vinikṣipya sthāpayeddinasaptakaṃ | sūtatūryāṃśakaṃ datvā tattulyaṃ viḍacūrṇakaṃ || patrāṇi khalve nikṣipya mardayetsarvameva tat | dinasaptapramāṇena sarvatulyaṃ ca gandhakaṃ || kajjalīkṛtya patreṣu adha ūrdhvaṃ pradāpayet | haṃḍikāyāṃ śarāveṇa mudrayitvā vidhānataḥ || vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha pācayetpraharadvayaṃ | svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya bhakṣayedraktikādvayam || lavaṅgaṃ pippalīsārdhaṃ kapharogavināśanam | śvāsakāsaharaṃ tāmraṃ vātaghnaṃ vahnimāṃdyajit || atyantakapharogeṣu vāsā kṣudrā pibedanu’ iti granthāntarāttāmreśvaraḥ | ‘tāmraṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ satiktamamlaṃ ca pāke kaṭu sārakaṃ ca | pittāpahaṃ śleṣmaharaṃ ca śītaṃ tadropaṇaṃ syāllaghulekhanaṃ vā || pāṇḍurarśo jvaraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ kāsaśca kṣatasakṣayān’ | ‘pītaṃ samastapittaṃ śothakaphaṃ śūlamupākaroti | prāhuḥ pare bṛṃhaṇamalpametat’ iti tāmraguṇāḥ || 28-35 ||

div.ab: atha sīsakamāraṇamāha - tāmbūlīrasasaṃpiṣṭaśilālepātpunaḥ punaḥ || 36 || dvātriṃśadbhiḥ puṭairnāgo niruttho yāti bhasmatām |

ab.seg: Dī. tāmbūlīti | tāmbūlī tāmbūlavallī prasiddhā | nāgaḥ sīsakam | śilā manaḥśilā, sā caturthāṃśā sampra- dāyāt | punaḥ punariti | pratyekapuṭe manaḥśilayā pralipya puṭet | evaṃ dvātriṃśatpuṭāni prasiddhāni bhavanti | na tu pratyekapuṭe vāraṃvāraṃ pralepanam | pralepanaṃ tvekavāramekapuṭaṃ pratītyarthaḥ || 36 ||

Gū. atha nāgotpattibhedavivaraṇam ‘dṛṣṭvā bhogisutāṃ ramyāṃ vāsukirvyamucadyataḥ | vīryaṃ jātastato nāgaḥ sarvarogāpaho nṛṇāṃ || dravadrāvaṃ mahābhāraṃ chede kṛṣṇaṃ samujjvalaṃ | pūtigandhi bahiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śuddhaṃ sīsamato'nyathā’ iti | atha māraṇaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā tāmbūlarasasaṃpiṣṭanāgapatralepaḥ triṃśadbhiḥ puṭairbhogī nirutthaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti || 36 ||

div.ab: aśvatthaciñcātvakcūrṇaṃ caturthāṃśena nikṣipet || 37 || mṛtpātre drāvite nāge lohadarvyā pracālayet | yāmaikena bhavedbhasma tattulyāṃ ca manaḥśilām ||38|| kāñjikena dvayaṃ piṣṭvā pacedṛḍhapuṭena ca | svāṅgaśītaṃ punaḥ piṣṭvā śilayā kāñjikena ca ||39|| punaḥ puṭeccharāvābhyāmevaṃ ṣaṣṭipuṭairmṛtiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. aśvatthaciñcātvakcūrṇamiti | aśvatthaḥ, pippalaḥ, ciñcā amlikā, caturthāṃśaṃ bhasmataḥ sīsakaparimāṇāt, etena vāraṃvāraṃ bhasmanaḥ kṣepaṇamuktam, na tu ekavāraṃ, yato vakṣyamāṇavaṅgamāraṇe proktaṃ ‘kṣiptvā’ iti tadvadatrāpi | tena yāvannāgasya bhasma bhavati tāvat kṣāraṃ deyaṃ; paścānnāgabhasmanaḥ śilāṃ ca kāñjikena samaṃ piṣṭvā saha dṛḍhapuṭe gajapuṭasaṃjñake pacet | evaṃ ṣaṣṭipuṭaiḥ kṛtvā mṛtirbhavati | ṣaṣṭipuṭānyatra śilayaiva saha kāryāṇi na tu ciñcāśvatthayorbhasmanā, bhasmasaṃskārastvekadaiva ||37-39||

Gū. anyacca | aśvatthaḥ pippalaḥ, ciñcā amlikā, tasyostvakcūrṇam | anyacca ‘tribhiḥ kumbhipuṭairnāgo vāsārasavimarditaḥ | saśilo bhasmatāmeti tadrajaḥ sarvarogahṛt’ iti granthāntarāt | kumbhapuṭaiḥ gajapuṭaiḥ saśilaḥ manaḥśilayā sahitaḥ | iti nāgamāraṇam || 37-39 ||
idānīṃ vaṅgamāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - mṛtpātre drāvite baṅge ciñcāśvatthatvaco rajaḥ || 40 ||
kṣiptvā kṣiptvā caturthāṃśamayodarvyā pracālayet | tato dviyāmamātreṇa vaṅgabhasma prajāyate || 41 ||
atha bhasmasamaṃ tālaṃ kṣiptvāmlena pramardayet | tato gajapuṭe paktvā punaramlena mardayet || 42 ||
tālena daśamāṃśena yāmamekaṃ tataḥ puṭet | evaṃ daśapuṭaiḥ pakvo vaṅgastu mriyate dhruvam || 43 ||

Dī. mṛtpatreti | mṛtpātraṃ kharparaṃ, ciñcā amlikā, aśvatthaḥ pippalaḥ, rajaścūrṇamanayorvalkalasya kṣiptvā kṣiptvā iti vāraṃvāraṃ caturthāṃśamiti vaṅgaparimāṇāt, valkalacūrṇasya etat parimāṇamekavāraṃ kṣepaṇārthaṃ atastāvat kṣipedyāvadbhasma bhavati tena vaṅgaparimāṇasamaṃ valkalarajaḥ kāryamiti sampradāyaḥ | ayodarvyā lohamayadaṇḍena atheti paścāt kāryakarmāha - bhasmasamamityādi | tālaṃ haritālaṃ, tadvaṅgabhasma sāmyaṃ bhavati, tena kimuktaṃ ? vaṅgabhasma haritālaṃ ca samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya amlena kāñjikādinā vimardya tadgolakākāraṃ kṛtvā śarāvasampuṭe dhāryaṃ saṃpuṭanirodhaṃ ca kṛtvā gajapuṭe pacet tatpaścāttamuddhṛtya punardaśamāṃśena tālakena saha saṃmardyāmlarasaiḥ kṛtvā tataḥ puṭet| daśa evaṃ sampuṭavidhānavaditi śeṣaḥ | agnipuṭaṃ tu kiñcinnyūnamiti sampradāyaḥ evaṃ daśapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā vaṅgo mṛto bhavati || 40-43 ||

Gū. atha vaṅgaṃ | ‘miśrakaṃ khurakaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ vaṅgamucyate | khurakaṃ tu guṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ miśrakaṃ na rase hitaṃ || capalaṃ mṛdulaṃ snigdhaṃ drutadrāvaśca gauravaṃ | niḥśabdaṃ khuravaṅgaṃ syāt miśrakaṃ śyābhaśubhrakam’ iti | spaṣṭamanyat atha māraṇaṃ | ‘vaṅgo dāhakaraḥ śītaḥ kaphapīḍāmayān jayet | krimīnaṣṭādaśavidhān pramehānnātra saṃśayaḥ’ iti | keciddāhaharaḥ śīta’ iti paṭhanti tatra madanavinodapathyāpathyanighaṇṭvādau vaṅgasyoṣṇaguṇasya likhitatvāt| viśeṣatastālena mṛta uṣṇa eva bhavatīti | granthāntarāt vaṅgeśvaraḥ ‘śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ śuddhavaṅgaṃ drāvayitvaikataścaret | tālakaṃ tu dvayostulyaṃ śaṭhīdrāveṇa mardayet | śuṣkaṃ kācamaye pātre pacedyāmacatuṣṭayaṃ | turyāṃśaṃ tālakaṃ datvā punarvāratrayaṃ pacet | guñjārdhaṃ vātha guñjaikaṃ bala- mānena bhakṣayet | jayedvātaṃ kaphaśvāsaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāsaṃ bhagandaraṃ | vātaraktaṃ kṣayaṃ vāpi vahnimāṃdyaṃ tridoṣakaṃ | nāmnā vaṅgeśvaraḥ sūtaḥ sarvarogeṣu pūjitaḥ | pakṣāghātādivāteṣu prasūtyādau viśeṣataḥ’ iti vaṅgeśvaraḥ granthāntarāt | atha vaṅgaśodhanamāraṇānupānāśca viśeṣata ucyate ‘gomūtre prathamaṃ dadyāt takre dadyāddvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ kāñjike deyaṃ caturthaṃ kaṭutailake | śubhalagnena yogena śodhanaṃ kārayedbhiṣak | nirliptaṃ drāvitaṃ vaṅgaṃ sarvarogeṣu yojayet’ iti vaṅgaśodhanam | athamāraṇaṃ ‘cullyupari sthitaṃ pātraṃ pācayedyāmakadvayaṃ | gharṣaṇaṃ lohadaṇḍena cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | prathamaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ dīpyakaṃ ca dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ jīrakaṃ dvayaṃ caturthaṃ tiṃtiḍītvacam | evaṃ krameṇa cūrṇena vaṅgaṃ niścandrikaṃ bhavet | svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya bhasma candrasamaṃ sitaṃ | guñjāmātraṃ pradātavyaṃ vaṅgabhasma subhakṣitam | anupānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvyādhyanupānataḥ | dhātrīsvarasasaṃyuktaṃ pramehaṃ hanti dustaraṃ | śatāvarīrasenaiva mūtrakṛcchravināśanaṃ | bahumūtraharaṃ tattu pāribhadrarasena tu | rajanīcūrṇamadhukaṃ dhātrīphalarasena tu | catuḥprakāraṃ pradaraṃ nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ | pañcatiktakaṣāyeṇa pāyayetsarvakuṣṭhajit | śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaṃ kūṣṇāṃḍasya rasena tu | raktapittakṣayaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ hanti sudustaraṃ| kaṇṭakārīrasenaiva pātavyaṃ pañcakāsajit | mudgaṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudraṃ jāṃgalaṃ piśitaṃ rasam | uduṃbaraphalaṃ caiva tandulīyakavāstukaṃ | rambhāprasūtaṃ cāṅgerīmayakaṃ kadalīphalaṃ | navanītaṃ tathā kṣīramabhyaṅgasnānamācaret’ | iti vaṅgakalpaḥ || 40-43 ||
atha lohamāraṇamāha - śuddhaṃ lohabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ pātālagaruḍīrasaiḥ | mardayitvā puṭedvahnau dadyādevaṃ puṭatrayam || 44 ||
puṭatrayaṃ kumāryā ca kuṭhārakulattharasaiḥ | puṭaṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyādevaṃ tīkṣṇamṛtirbhavet || 45 ||

div.ab: Dī. śuddhamiti | śuddhaṃ śodhitaṃ jātyutkṛṣṭaṃ vā śodhanamasya pūrvaṃ kathitameva | jātibhedāḥ keṣāñcijjñāpanārthaṃ likhyante yathā - ‘devāḥ surasamājena mathyamāne mahodadhau | samutpannaṃ purā tasminnamṛtaṃ devajīvanam || pīyamānātsuraistasmādutthitāḥ kṣudrabindavaḥ | jñātvā tān bhūgatān bindūn yogamāsādya dhūrjaṭiḥ || lohapāṣāṇarūpeṇa kṛtvā tān vasudhātale | pāparogābhibhūtā ye mānavāste bhajantu tān || ityevaṃ śivaguptā ye sudhāyā bindavaḥ param | teṣāṃ mayā samāsena kathyate sādhanaṃ sphuṭam’ iti | atha jātibhedā yathā yadyapi nāgārjunamate aṣṭādaśa lohajātayaḥ santi tadyathā māṇḍūraṃ, māṇḍūkaṃ, sāraṃ, lohaṃ, madhyasāralohaṃ, sthūlasāralohaṃ, cakramardalohaṃ, bandhalohaṃ, vajrakalohaṃ, surāyasaṃ, kaliṅgaṃ, bhadralohaṃ, garalasthitalohaṃ, vajraṃ, pāṇḍiniravam, arbudakam, kāntaṃ, kuliśamiti tathāpyanyeṣāṃ mate tvaṣṭaiva śreṣṭhatamā | tathāhi ‘sāmānyāddviguṇaṃ sāraṃ tasmādaṣṭaguṇaṃ kaliḥ | kaleḥ śataguṇaṃ bhadraṃ bhadrādvajraṃ sahasradhā | vajrāt ṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ pāṇḍinirivāddaśabhirguṇaiḥ | tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ tasmādayasaḥ kāntakaṃ matam’ iti | eteṣāṃ vyañjanaṃ ca tantrāntarādeva likhyate lakṣaṇaviśeṣaṃ vinā śreṣṭhamaśreṣṭhaṃ na jñāyate tasmāllikhyate | yathā ‘kṣamābhṛcchikharākāraliṅgānyevāmlite sati | dṛśyante yatra sūkṣmāṇi sāraṃ ca tadudāhṛtam || yatra kṛṣṇāyase viṃśallakṣaṇāni sitāni ca | pallavālpakṛtīnyāhustadbudhāḥ kṛṣṇavajrakam || yatra kṛṣṇatarā bhūmirvartulāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ | rekhā syāddhemavarṇā ca tatpiṇḍī ca vidhīyate || kalistarasamāvarto yaduktaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ | kiṃcittatsthe jale kṣiptaṃ tailabindurna sarpati || api kenāpi kālena nirmalatvaṃ na muñcati | bhraśyate yanna kālena nirdravaṃ tadayo matam | yena parvatasāreṇa bhidyante śuṣkakāṣṭhavat | anyāni girisārāṇi tattīkṣṇaṃ kāntamucyate’ || kāntasya lakṣaṇamanya- trāpyuktam | ‘pātre yasmin praviśati jale tailabindurniṣikto hiṅgurgandhaṃ visṛjati nijaṃ tiktatāṃ nimbakalkaḥ | pāke dugdhaṃ bhavati śikharākārakaṃ naiti bhūmau kāntaṃ lohaṃ bhavati tadidaṃ lakṣaṇoktaṃ na cānyat ||’ iti tasmādeteṣāṃ madhye kāntalohaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ, yataḥ - ‘kiṭṭāddaśaguṇaṃ muṇḍaṃ muṇḍāttīkṣṇaṃ śatonmitam | tīkṣṇāllakṣaguṇaṃ kāntaṃ bhakṣaṇātkurute guṇam || tasmāt kāntaṃ sadā sevyaṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ nṛṇām’ iti | tacca kāntaṃ caturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathāhi ‘bhrāmakaṃ śakaṭaṃ caiva cumbakaṃ drāvakaṃ tathā | caturvidhaṃ bhavet kāntamekaikaṃ dviguṇaṃ matam’ iti | jātibhedāḥ saṃkṣepeṇoktāḥ | samprati māraṇavidhirapi teṣāṃ kathyate - lohabhavaṃ cūrṇamityādi | pātālagaruḍī pātālamūlī prasiddhā sā ca cchinnaruhā'kṛtistadbhedaśca tadabhāve chirahaṇṭaiva grāhyā puṭamatra jagapuṭam | kumārī prasiddhāsā ca vāri śabdavācyā dī. | kuṭhārakulattharasairiti| kuṭhāraḥsā ca kuraiyā śabdavācyo dravyaviśeṣaḥ | kuṭhāracchinnā kuṭajabheda ityanye tadabhāve jambūtvak gṛhṇantyapare; asmatsampradāye kuṭhāracchinnā loke tipānītiśabdavācyo dravyaviśeṣo grāhyaḥ | kulattho'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | puṭaṣaṭkamityanena pratyekaṃ puṭatrayaṃ pūrvavadboddhyam || 44 || 45 ||
Gū. atha lohamāraṇaṃ | pātālagaruḍī pātālamūlī kuṭhāraḥ anyacca daradaṃ hiṃgulaṃ tīkṣṇagatavallīcūrṇam ||||44 ||45||

anyaccetyaparamapi māraṇamāha - kṣipedvā daśamāṃśena daradaṃ tīkṣṇacūrṇataḥ | mardayetkanyakādrāvairyāmayugmaṃ tataḥ puṭet || 46 || evaṃ saptapuṭairmṛtyuṃ lohacūrṇamavāpnuyāt | rasaiḥ kuṭhāracchinnāyāḥ pātālagaruḍīrasaiḥ ||47 || stanyena cārkadugdhena tīkṣṇasyaivaṃ mṛtirbhavet |

Dī. kṣipediti | daradaṃ hiṅgulam | daśamāṃśaṃ daradaṃ lohacūrṇāt | kanyakā kumārī | puṭamatra gajapuṭavidhānaṃ yāmayugmamiti mardanaparimāṇam | evamityanena saptapuṭaiḥ kṛtvā siddhaṃ bhavati | athavā kuṭhāracchinnāyā rasaiḥ kṛtvā daradaṃ lohacarṇaṃ ca pūrvavat saṃmardya puṭet | anenāpi saptapuṭaiḥ siddhametat | athavā pātālagaruḍīrasaistadvadeva vā athavā stanyena pūrvavadyogaḥ kartavyaḥ | arkadugdhena tadvadeva pracāraḥ | etadyogacatuṣṭayaṃ daradasaṃbandhi bhavati | saptapuṭasaṃbandhi vā vijñeyam | atra kuṭhāracchinnā prasiddhā ‘tipānī’ śabdavācyetyapare, pātālagaruḍī chirahaṇṭaḥ stanyaṃ strībhavaṃ nānyat prayogāntaradarśanāt | tathāca ‘hiṅgulasya palān pañca nārīstanyena peṣayet | tena lohasya patrāṇi lepayet palapañcakam’ ityādi || 46 || 47 ||
Gū. anyacca | rasairiti | anyadapi sugamam ||46 || 47 ||

anyadapi māraṇamāha - sūtakāddviguṇaṃ gandhaṃ dattvā kuryācca kajjalīm ||48|| dvayoḥ samaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ mardayetkanyakādravaiḥ | yāmayugmaṃ tataḥ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tāmrasya pātrake ||49|| gharme dhṛtvā rubūkasya patrairācchādayedbudhaḥ | yāmārdhenoṣṇatāṃ bhūyāddhānyarāśau nyasettataḥ ||50|| dattvopari śarāvaṃ tu tridinānte samuddharet | piṣṭvā ca gālayedvastrādevaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet || 51 || evaṃ sarvāṇi lohāni svarṇādīnyapi mārayet | śilāgandhārkadugdhāktāḥ svarṇādyāḥ sarvadhātavaḥ||52|| mriyante dvādaśapuṭaiḥ satyaṃ guruvaco yathā |

ab.seg: Dī. sūtakāditi | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ, dvayoriti pāradagandhakayoḥ | kanyakā kumārī, yāmārdhenoṣṇatā bhūyādityanena taddravyapiṇḍaṃ ghaṭikācatuṣṭayaṃ yāvaddharme dhārayedityarthaḥ | tata iti paścāt | dattvopari śarāvamityanena taddravyapiṇḍaṃ pūrvam | eraṇḍapatrairveṣṭayitvā paścāttāmrasaṃpuṭe mṛṇmayasaṃpuṭe vā sannidhāya tadanu dhānyarāśau sthāpayedityarthaḥ | tathāhi - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ kṛtvā khalvena kajjalīm | dvayoḥ samaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ mardayet kanyakādravaiḥ|| yāmadvayāt samuddhṛtya tadgolaṃ tāmrapātrake | ācchādyairaṇḍapatraiśca yāmārdhenoṣṇatā bhavet’ ityādi | evamiti pūrvoktavidhinā sarvāṇi lohāni kāntatīkṣṇamuṇḍaprabhṛtīni svarṇādīni api anayā yuktyā ca mārayediti bhāvaḥ | ādiśabdagrahaṇāt raupyatāmrādayaḥ | aparamapi śilāgandhārkadugdhāktā ityādi sugamam | satyamityanena vāritaraṃ bhavedityarthaḥ | yathā guruvacastathā'tra boddhavyam | etena kimuktaṃ ? mṛtaṃ lohaṃ tu paścāt saṃskāritaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi - ‘ghṛtatulyaṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ lohapātragataṃ pacet | jīrṇe ghṛtaṃ samādāya yogavāheṣu yojayet | ityādi || 48-52||

Gū. atha lohakalpaḥ | ‘pātañjale tathā tantre lohā bahuvidhā matāḥ | duṣprāpyatvānniṣphalatvācca likhyate hi bhidā mayā| cārutvādbhadravajraṃ tu pāṇḍikāntādayo yathā | rūpairguṇaiśca kathyante te nāgārjunadeśataḥ || sāmānyāddviguṇaṃ proktaṃ tasmādaṣṭaguṇaṃ kaliḥ | kalerdaśaguṇa bhadraṃ bhadrādvajraṃ sahasradhā || vajrāt sahasraguṇitāt pāḍinī daśabhirguṇaiḥ | tataḥ koṭisahasratvādayaḥ kāntaṃ mahāphalam ||’ iti | tatra viśeṣa ucyate ‘kāñjījitaṃ tulāṅgaṃ syādājyavarṇamayo viduḥ | kāśatāḍaṃ kṛśāṅgaṃ ca śulāṃ gandho dudeśatam || paṃḍitaṃ dvividhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śuklañca samatārdrakaṃ | bhadrameraṇḍabījābhaṃ snuhīpatranibhaṃ tathā || vajraṃ damanapatrābhamīṣat svarṇacchavistathā | kāntaṃ mṛdutaraṃ tārarukmakānto sitākaraṃ || svāduryatra bhavennimbakalko rātridivoṣitaḥ | kāntaṃ taduttamaṃ yacca śilārūpeṇa vārtikaṃ || kahvoṇamuttamaṃ kāntamato'nyanmadhyamaṃ mataṃ | kṣudrāṃḍaṃ gurutāḍaṃ syātkaliṅgajamayo mataṃ || rukmārukmapratīkāśaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ mṛduphalaṃ mataṃ tattadā'karasaṃbhūtaṃ tattadrogavināśanaṃ || tena tasya parīkṣāyāṃ yāte madimadetakam’ iti | lohabhedāḥ| atha māraṇaṃ - ‘vajraṃ pañcādikaṃ teṣāṃ bhedā yājyatamaṃ śubhaṃ | prākpañcapalādūrdhvaṃ yāvadāṣoḍaśaṃ palam’ | atha lohaśodhanaṃ ‘triphalātriguṇaistoyaistriphalā ṣoḍaśaṃ palaṃ | tatkvāthe pādaśeṣe tu lohasya palapañcakaṃ || kṛtvā patrāṇi taptāni saptavāraṃ niṣecayet | evaṃ pralīyate doṣo girijo lohasaṃbhavaḥ’ iti | atha māraṇe puṭapraśaṃsā - ‘puṭairdoṣavināśaḥ syāt puṭādeva guṇodayaḥ | mriyate ca puṭāllohaṃ puṭāṃstasmātsamācaret || yathā yathā pradīyante puṭāśca bahavo'yasi | tathā tathā pravardhante guṇāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ | tāvallohaṃ puṭedvaidyo yāvaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ jale | tannistarellaghutvena nīre tarati haṃsavat || tāvanna cūrṇayedevaṃ yāvatkajjalisaṃnibhaṃ | karoti nihitaṃ netre naiva pīḍāṃ manāgapi || puṭe puṭe kvāthayitvā sthālīpākaṃ pradāpayet | puṭaikamantare vāpi kṣālanaṃ vyayabhītitaḥ’ iti | atha doṣabhedena puṭānāha - ‘pākaḥ phalāmbudaśamūlarasena vāyau pitte tu śītamadhuraistriphalairvidāryāḥ | tajjñaiḥ śatāvarijaṭāsvarasena deyaḥ śleṣmāṇake tu daśamūlarasārdrakeṇa || vātaśleṣmavikāreṣu śvayathau vividhātmake | varṣābhūśṛṅgaverābhyāṃ māṇakena viśeṣataḥ’ iti | māṇakaḥ māṇakandaḥ, ‘pittānile pittayute ca rakte drākṣāvidārīśatamūlikābhiḥ | kṣīrakākolī kākolyā ca madhūkapuṣpaiḥ kharjūrakeṇāpi tathaiva deyāḥ | atha vyādhibhedena puṭānāha - ‘jīrṇajvare guḍūcī kāse śvāse ca śasyate vyāghrī| yakṣmā'sṛk pittarujorvāsā śastā balā nāma || nāsāvraṇaśoṇitaśāṃtyarthaṃ svarasayavadūrvāyāḥ| kaṅkellicchallasalilaṃ śastaṃ pradareṣu sarveṣu || niculadalodbhavasalilaiḥ pravāhikāyāṃ ca śasyate sutarāṃ | grahaṇīṣu mustakānāṃ kuṭajakvāthātisāreṣu || mehe varāvare kṛcchre pāṣāṇabhedikātivane | varṣābhūnāgarayoḥ kvāthaḥ śvayathupraśāntyarthaṃ || gomūtraṃ triṣu śastam udarāpasmārapāṇḍurogeṣu | astreṣu māṇakaṃdo gulme rohītakaḥ kvāthaḥ || hikvāśvāse brāhmībhārgīsvarasena śastaśca | eraṇḍanāgarayoḥ kvāthaḥ sāme'tiśastaḥ || śūleṣu daśamūlena gomūtreṇa phalāmbunā | yakṛti plīhni dātavyo gṛhanyārkajaṃ payaḥ || devadāruviḍaṅgena palāśena kṛmau mataḥ | kuṣṭhesaṃpākaniṃbena saptaparṇāṭarūṣakaiḥ|| bhallātakena bākucyavṛndārkeṇāśanena ca | madhurekṣurasaṃpākaiḥ abhīrūvaruṇena ca | eraṇḍatṛṇapañcānāṃ mūlai śailūṣakena ca | triphalena ca kartavyo mūlastambhe tridoṣaje || aśmarīṣu ca sarvāsu mūtrāghāte viśeṣataḥ | vṛkṣakṣīrāmṛtā drākṣā abhīrūdaśamūlakaiḥ || vājigandhānvitairebhiḥ kṣayeṣu ca nigadyate | amlapitte śatā- varyāḥ puṭā deyāśca sarvataḥ’ | muṇḍikā śatamūlī ca citrāṅgakarikarṇakeśarājaistu | madhukaguḍūcīmārkavamuśalībhallā- takaiḥ kalpe, rasāyane nāgabalā hayagandhā gokarṇakavṛddhadārakāmalakī, vājīkaraṇe vihitā vānarīśatamūlikā kṣurikā jñātvaivaṃ | rogaviśeṣānebhirvāratrayaṃ puṭena sthālīpāke adhikataḥ puruṣasvabhāvaṃ buddhimān kathitamapi hemamauṣadhamucitamupādeyamanyadapi | ‘yaḥ kalpakāmaḥ kurute ca lohaṃ sa sarvaśaṅkāparivarjitāṅgaḥ | dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtireṣa nityaṃ jīvet pṛthivyāmamaropamānaḥ’ iti | lohakalpaḥ samāptaḥ || atha kiṭṭaṃ - ‘gomūtratriphalākvāthe taptaṃ śodhyaṃ trisaptadhā | svarṇādisarvalohānāṃ kiṭṭasya ca guṇāvaham’ iti lohādikiṭṭamāraṇam | atha svarṇādidhātubhakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ - ‘yavadvayaṃ prayoktavyaṃ hemaguñjāṣṭakā'vadhi | tāraṃ taddviguṇaṃ lohamanyattattriguṇātmakam’ || 48-52 ||

div.ab: athopadhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ, te ke upadhātavaḥ ? iti darśayannāha - mākṣikaṃ tutthakābhre ca nīlāñjanaśilālakāḥ ||53|| rasakaśceti vijñeyā ete saptopadhātavaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. mākṣikamiti | mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ | taddvividham ekaṃ svarṇamākṣikam aparaṃ tāramākṣikaṃ kāṃsyamākṣikamiti | tutthakaṃ prasiddham | abhram abhrakaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddham, śilā manaḥśilā, tālakaṃ haritālaṃ, rasakaṃ kharparakaḥ, sa ca tutthakabhedaḥ | ete saptopadhātavaḥ kathitāḥ || 53 ||

Gū. athopadhātuśodhanaṃ māraṇaṃ | mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, tutthaṃ tutthakam, abhram abhrakaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanam, manaḥśilā, ālakaḥ haritālakaḥ, rasakaḥ kharparam | ete sapta upadhātavo jñeyāḥ || 53 ||

div.ab: atha mākṣikaśodhanamāraṇam - mākṣikasya trayo bhāgā bhāgaikaṃ saindhavasya ca ||54|| mātuluṅgadravairvātha jambīrotthadravaiḥ pacet | cālayellohaje pātre yāvatpātraṃ tu lohitam ||55|| bhavettatastu saṃśuddhiṃ svarṇamākṣikamṛcchati | kulatthasya kaṣāyeṇa ghṛṣṭvā tailena vā puṭet || 56 || takreṇa vājamūtreṇa mriyate svarṇamākṣikam | karkoṭīmeṣaśṛṅgyutthairdravairjambīrajairdinam || 57 || bhāvayedātape tīvre vimalā śudhyati dhruvam |

ab.seg: Dī. idānī pratyekena śodhanamāraṇamāha - athetyādi | mākṣikasyeti spaṣṭam | karkoṭīti | vimalā svarṇa- mākṣikabhedaḥ, karkoṭī vandhyākarkoṭī grāhyā, meṣaśṛṅgī vallīsaṃjñā prasiddhā, etayordravaiḥ sadyorasaiḥ patrāṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | jambīrajairiti jambīraphalarasaiḥ dinamiti mardayet iti śeṣaḥ | tena pratyekarasena kṛtvā dinaikaṃ mardayedityarthaḥ | ātape tīvra iti tīvragharme | tīvragharmābhāve agnau śodhayedityapi sampradāyaḥ | uktaṃ ca ‘jambīrāṇāṃ rasaiḥ svinnaṃ meṣaśṛṅgīrase'thavā | rambhātoyena vā pācyaṃ ghasraṃ vimalaśodhanam’ iti || 54-57 ||

Gū. yāvat pātraṃ lohitaṃ raktaṃ bhavati tāvat pacet | tadā mākṣikaṃ śuddhimṛcchati śuddhiṃ prāpnoti | ṛ gatāvityasya ṛcchādeśe prayogaḥ | mākṣikaṃ kṛdbhūbhūtaṃ napuṃsakatvāt | atha māraṇaṃ | kulatthasyeti spaṣṭamanyat | atha tāramākṣikaśodhanamāraṇaṃ | karkoṭī vandhyākarkoṭī, meṣaśṛṃgī prasiddhā | atha māraṇaṃ svarṇamākṣikavat || 54-57 ||
atha tutthakaśodhanamāha -- viṣṭhayā mardayettutthaṃ mārjārakakapotayoḥ || 58 | daśāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dattvā pacenmṛdupuṭena tu | puṭaṃ dadhnā puṭaṃ kṣaudrairdeyaṃ tutthaviśuddhaye || 59 ||

div.ab: Dī. viṣṭhayā mardayet iti viṣṭhā purīṣam | mārjārakakapotayoriti mārjārako biḍālaḥ, kapotaḥ prasiddhaḥ anayoḥ purīṣaṃ tvanumānato grāhyam, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraṃ daśāṃśamiti tutthakaparimāṇāt | mṛdupuṭaṃ tu kukkuṭapuṭaprabhṛtikaṃ paścāddadhnā kṛtvā puṭamekaṃ deyam | tadanu kṣaudrairapi puṭamekaṃ dadyādityarthaḥ || 58 || 59 ||
Gū. atha tutthaśodhanaṃ viṣṭhayeti | granthāntare caivaṃ śodhanam - ‘ataḥ viṣṭhāsamaṃ tutthaṃ sakṣaudraṃ ṭaṃkaṇaṃ kṛtam | trivāraṃ puṭitaṃ śuddhaṃ vāntibhrāntivivarjanam’ ||58||59||
athābhrakaśodhanam - kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ dhamedvahnau tataḥ kṣīre vinikṣipet | bhinnapatraṃ tu tatkṛtvā taṇḍulīyāmlayordravaiḥ ||60| bhāvayedaṣṭayāmaṃ tadevaṃ śuddhyati cābhrakam |

ab.seg: Dī. adhunā abhrakaśodhanamāha - kṛṣṇeti | kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ vajrajātisaṃjñaṃ kathitam | yatastvabhrakaṃ tu caturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathāhi tantrāntarādutpattiprabhṛtikaṃ likhyate yathā ‘purā vadhāya vṛtrasya vajriṇā vajramuddhṛtam | visphuliṅgāstatastasya gaganaṃ parisarpitāḥ || nipeturmeghanirghoṣāt śikhareṣu mahībhṛtām | tebhya eva samutpannaṃ tattadgiriṣu cābhrakam || tadvajraṃ vajrajātatvādabhramabhraravodbhavāt | gaganacyutajātatvādūcire gaganaṃ surāḥ || tadbrāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrabhedāccaturvidhaṃ | krameṇaiva sitaṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇataḥ || pinākaṃ darduraṃ nāgaṃ vajraṃ ceti caturvidham| pinākādyāstrayo varjyā vajrajātiṃ samāharet || muñcatyagnau vinikṣiptaṃ pinākaṃ dalasaṃcayam | darduraṃ nihitaṃ hyagnau kurute darduradhvanim || nāgaṃ cāgnau vinikṣiptaṃ phūtkāraṃ ca vimuñcati | vajrābhrakaṃ tu vahnisthaṃ na kvacidvikṛtiṃ vrajet || tasmādvajrābhrakaṃ yojyaṃ vyādhivārdhakyamṛtyujit | tatra dakṣiṇaśaile'rkaśoṣādalpaguṇaṃ hi tat || alpasatvaṃ tadā dhatte abhre satvaṃ guṇapradam | atha cottaraśailotthaṃ bahusatvaṃ guṇādhikaṃ | śaṃsanti munayaḥ sarve prayoge kṛṣṇamabhrakam’ iti | śodhanaṃ cāha - taṇḍulīyāmlayoriti | taṇḍulīyocaurāīśabdavācya:| meghanādaḥ, amlaḥ kāñjikaṃ, tadabhāve jambīraprabhṛtikaṃ grāhyam | aṣṭayāmaṃ dvayordravyayostena pratyekaṃ caturyāmamityarthaḥ ||60||

Gū. kṛṣṇābhrakamiti | nanu granthāntare caturvidhamabhrakamuktaṃ, tadyathā - ‘pinākaṃ darduraṃ nāgaṃ vajraṃ ceti caturvidham | tat punnapuṃsakaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekaṃ tatra lakṣaṇaiḥ | vaṅgasenādāyastrividhamāhuḥ ‘vajraṃ bhekavapuḥ kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ ca trividhaṃ mataṃ | tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samādāya pācayetkāṃjike śubhe’ iti | etadvivṛṇoti trivikramaḥ | tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samādāyetyanena kṛṣṇatvasāmyādvajrakṛṣṇābhrayorgrahaṇaṃ | bhekavapuḥ haritapītādivarṇaṃ tyājyam | ataḥ śārṅgadhareṇa kṛṣṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ kṛtam ||60||

div.ab: atha māraṇam | kṛtvā dhānyābhrakaṃ tattu śoṣayitvātha mardayet || 61|| arkakṣīrairdinaṃ khalve cakrākāraṃ ca kārayet | veṣṭayedarkapatraiśca samyaggajapuṭe pacet || 62 || punarmardyaṃ punaḥ pācyaṃ saptavāraṃ prayatnataḥ | tato vaṭajaṭākvāthaistadvaddeyaṃ puṭatrayam || 63|| mriyate nātra saṃdehaḥ sarvayogeṣu yojayet | tulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ mṛtābhreṇa lohapātre vipācayet || 64 || ghṛte jīrṇe tadabhraṃ tu sarvayogeṣu yojayet | mṛtaṃ tvabhraṃ harenmṛtyuṃ jarāpalitanāśanam || 65 || anupānaiśca saṃyuktaṃ tattadrogaharaṃ param |

ab.seg: Dī. atha māraṇaṃ yathā - kṛtvā dhānyābhrakamityādi | dhānyābhrakavidhānaṃ tu tantrāntarādavagantavyaṃ | tadyathā -‘baddhvā dhānyayute vastre mardayet kāñjikaiḥ saha | ādāyā'dhogataṃ śuddhaṃ śuṣkaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ bhavet’ iti | athavā ‘cūrṇābhraṃ śālisaṃyuktaṃ baddhvā kambalake tathā trirātraṃ kāṃjike sthāpyaṃ tat klinnaṃ mardayeddṛḍham | kambalādgalitaṃ ślakṣṇo māraṇādau praśasyate iti | veṣṭayedarkapatraiścetyanena cakrākāraṃ dravyaṃ patrairveṣṭayitvā'gnau puṭet | samyagiti grahaṇena tat patraveṣṭitaṃ cakrākāraṃ dravyaṃ kharpare nidhāya, upari ca kharparaṃ datvā tadūrdhvādhaḥ āraṇyakopalāni ca dattvāgniṃ prajvālya gajapuṭe puṭediti tātparyārthaḥ | evaṃ saptavāraṃ yāvat puṭet | arkakṣīrairevetyarthaḥ | tataḥ paścādvaṭajaṭākvāthaiḥ kṛtvā puṭatrayameva deyam | atha mṛtābhrasyā'pi śuddhimāha - tulyamityādi sugamam | adhunā mṛtābhrasya guṇamapyāha - mṛtamiti | kecidamuṃ ślokaṃ na paṭhanti, bahusthāneṣvapracāratvāt || 61-65 ||
Gū. sugamam || 61-65 ||

div.ab: athānyaprakāro'bhrakamāraṇasya tamapi vyācaṣṭe - śuddhaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ mustaṃ śuṇṭhīṣaḍbhāgayojitam||66|| mardayetkāñjikenaiva dinaṃ citrakajai rasaiḥ | tato gajapuṭaṃ dadyāttasmāduddhṛtya mardayet || 67 || triphalāvāriṇā tadvatpuṭedevaṃ puṭaistribhiḥ | balāgomūtramusalītulasīsūraṇadravaiḥ || 68 || marditaṃ puṭitaṃ vahnau tritrivelaṃ vrajenmṛtim |

ab.seg: Dī. śuddhaṃ dhānyābhrakamiti | śuddhiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā | dhānyābhrakavidhānaṃ pūrvameva pradarśitam | mustaṃ śuṇṭhī ca ṣaḍbhāgayojitaṃ pratyekaṃ | ṣaḍbhāgatā'tra abhrakaparimāṇāt | kāñjikena mardanaṃ caikadinamityarthaḥ | triphalāvāriṇā triphalākvāthenetyarthaḥ | tadvat puṭediti gajapuṭavidhānena | evaṃ puṭaistribhiriti triphalākvāthena puṭatrayaṃ dadyā- dityabhiprāyaḥ | evamiti gajapuṭavidhānādinā balāprabhṛtīnāṃ pañcadravyāṇāṃ dravaiḥ kṛtvā pratyekena trivelaṃ marditaṃ pañcādvahnau puṭitaṃ cābhrakaṃ mṛtiṃ vrajedityarthaḥ | eke cātra yogatrayaṃ manyante tanmate tu mustaprabhṛti citrakāntaireko yogaḥ | kevalatriphalāyā dvitīyaḥ | balāprabhṛti sūraṇāntaistṛtīya iti || 66-68 ||
Gū. athānyaprakāraḥ | puṭe saṃpuṭe puṭatrayaṃ deyaṃ | balā prasiddhā | spaṣṭamanyat | ityabhrakamāraṇam || || 66-68 ||

div.ab: abhrasatvaprakāraḥ |kṣepakamidam| dhānyābhrakasya bhāgaikaṃ dvau bhāgau ṭaṅkaṇasya na | piṣṭvā tadandhamūṣāyāṃ ruddhvā tīvrāgninā pacet ||69|| svabhāvaśītalaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvayogeṣu yojayet |

atha nīlāñjanam - nīlāñjanaṃ cūrṇayitvā jambīradravabhāvitam || 70 || dinaikamātape śuddhaṃ bhavetkāryeṣu yojayet | evaṃ gairikakāsīsaṭaṅkaṇāni varāṭikā || 71|| taurī śaṅkhaṃ ca kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ śuddhimāyāti niścitam |

Dī. samprati nīlāñjanaśodhanavidhimāha - nīlāñjanamiti | nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddham | asya bhedaḥ sauvīrāñjanaṃ śvetakṛṣṇavarṇabhedāt | etasmādapi sīsakotpattirjāyate | jambīradravabhāvitamiti jambīraphalarasena bhāvitaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam | evamityādi | evaṃ nīlāñjanaśodhanaprakāreṇaiva gairikādayo viśodhyāḥ | gairikaṃ prasiddham | gairikaṃ svarṇagairikaṃ ca | kāsīsamiti | tacca dvividhaṃ | kāsīsaṃ puṣpakāsīsaṃ ca | kāsīsaṃ bhasmavadalpamṛt puṣpakāsīsaṃ tadbhedaḥ kiñcitpītaḥ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyakṣāraḥ, varāṭikā kapardikā, śeṣaṃ prasiddham | taurī sphaṭikā ‘phiṭkārī’ śabdavācyo mṛdbhedaḥ | kaṅguṣṭhaṃ suvarṇakṣīrī, asya bhedaḥ coka iti prasiddhaḥ | sa ca raktakṣīrasehuṇḍa iti pratīteḥ | niścitamityanenānyat śodhanamapi nāpekṣayet | yatastanttrāntareṣvapi nānāprakāreṇa śodhanamasti tasmādanenaivā'tra śodhanameteṣāṃ pratipāditam || 70 || 71 ||

Gū. atha gairikakāsīsaṭaṃkaṇavarāṭakāśaṅkhatorīśodhanaṃ sugabham | evaṃ nīlāñjanaprakāreṇa jambīrabhāvanayetyarthaḥ | gairikaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kāsīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kṣāraḥ, varāṭikā, śaṅkhaṃ, torī sphaṭikā, kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ cokaniryāsaḥ||70|| 71||
atha manaḥśilāśodhanam -- pacettryahamajāmūtrairdolāyantre manaḥśilām || 72 || bhāvayetsaptadhā pittairajāyāḥ śuddhimṛcchati |

ab.seg: Dī. atha mana:śilāśodhanamāha - pacediti | manaḥśilā prasiddhā | dolāyanttravidhānaṃ ca sampradāyato likhyate | manaḥśilāṃ kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā kadalīdalaiḥ saṃveṣṭya tadanu caturguṇena vastreṇa ca poṭṭalīṃ baddhvā mūtrapūrite bhāṇḍe vidhivat svedayet yāvaddinatrayaṃ bhavati | dinagrahaṇena rātrirapi gṛhyate | tenāhorātramapi svedayet ityabhiprāyaḥ eke tu dinatrayameva na tu rātrau svedanaṃ vihitam, yato rātrāvadṛḍhatve dagdhādibhayāt tathāhi - ‘sudṛḍhe kadalīpatre vastrakhaṇḍe caturguṇe | tanmadhye tān vinikṣipya badhnīyācca supoṭṭalīm | kṣārāmlamūtravargeṇa svedayecca dinatrayam | tathā svedaḥ prakartavyo majjayet poṭalī yathā | bhavenna ca talasparśā bhāṇḍasyāpi kadācana’ iti manyante | tato dolāyantrapramāṇamapi | ‘dravadravyeṇa bhāṇḍasya pūritārdhasya tasya ca | mukhe tiryakkṛte daṇḍe yaddravyaṃ sūtralambitam | svedayettanmadhyagataṃ dolāyanttramiti smṛtam’ iti | bhāvayet saptadhānāsti khapustake | pittairiti | tadanu sveditā manaḥśilā ajāyāḥ pittadravaiḥ kṛtvā saptadhā gharme bhāvayet| bhāvanārthadravastu yāvaddravyaṃ drāvitaṃ bhavati evaṃ śuddhimṛcchatīti | eke ‘kṣālayedāranāle vā sarvayogeṣu yojayet’ iti paṭhanti tathā vyākhyānayanti ca || 72 ||
Gū. pacettryahamiti | anye evamāhuḥ - ‘jayantīrasasaṃpiṣṭhā śilā śuddhyati gharmaṇā | viṣaghnī ca tridoṣaghnī sā śuddhā parikīrtitā ’|| 72 ||

div.ab: atha tālakaśuddhiḥ - tālakaṃ kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā sacūrṇaṃ kāñjike kṣipet ||73|| dolāyantreṇa yāmaikaṃ tataḥ kūṣmāṇḍajairdravai | tilataile pacedyāmaṃ yāmaṃ ca triphalājalaiḥ || 74 || evaṃ yantre caturyāmaṃ pācyaṃ śudhyati tālakam |

Dī. idānīṃ tālakaśodhanaṃ prakaṭayannāha - tālakamiti | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ sacūrṇakāñjike kṣipediti cūrṇaṃ kaṇikābhāvamityarthaḥ | kathaṃ ? yathā īṣaccūrṇayuktaṃ kāñjikaṃ bhāṇḍe kṣiptvā dolāyantravidhānena svedayet| dolāyantravidhistu pūrvaṃ darśita eva | tata ityanena yāmaikaṃ svedanaṃ sūcitam | kūṣmāṇḍajairdravairiti kūṣmāṇḍaphalasya sadyorasaiḥ kvāthairvā | triphalājalairiti | kvathitatriphalājalaiḥ kvathitatriphalātoyaiḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||73||74||

Gū. kaṇaśaḥ khaṇḍaśastālaṃ haritālacūrṇaṃ kalicūrṇasahitakāñjike kṣipet | dolāpātre yāmaṃ pacet haṇḍikāyāṃ kāṣṭhaṃ datvā kāṣṭhe lambamānāṃ poṭṭalikāṃ sthāpayet | idaṃ dolāyantraṃ | spaṣṭamanyat ||73||74||
atha rasakaśuddhiḥ -- naramūtraiśca gomūtraiḥ saptāhaṃ rasakaṃ pacet || 75 || dolāyantreṇa śuddhiḥ syāttataḥ kāryeṣu yojayet |

ab.seg: Dī. atha rasakaśodhanaṃ vyācaṣṭe - naramūtrairiti | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ, tacca tutthabhedaḥ | naramūtrairgomūtraiśca pṛthak pacet na tu militamūtradvayaiḥ | naramūtraṃ saptāhaṃ yāvat cet dolāyantreṇa athavā gomūtraiḥ ‘saptāhāt sveditaḥ śuddho rasako naravāriṇā’ ityādi vacanāt || 75 ||
Gū. rasakaṃ kharparamsaṃgavasarīti loke | || 75 ||
athedānīṃ samudāyena sattvanirgamaṃ prakaṭayannāha - lākṣā mīnā payaśchāgaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ mṛgaśṛṅgakam ||76||
piṇyākaṃ sarṣapāḥ śigrurguñjorṇāguḍasaindhavāḥ | yavāstiktā ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ yathālābhaṃ vicūrṇayet ||77||
ebhirvimiśritāḥ sarve dhātavo gāḍhavahninā | mūṣādhmātāḥ prajāyante muktasatvā na saṃśayaḥ ||78||

Dī. lākṣeti | lākṣā prasiddhā | śigrurśobhāñjanatvak mūlaṃ vā | guñjāphalāni, ūrṇā meṣaromāṇi, guḍasaindhave prasiddhe | yavatiktā sarpākṣī | yathālābhamiti vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā grāhyam | sarve dhātava iti dhātugrahaṇena upadhātava uparasāśca grāhyāḥ | yataḥ ‘yantropari svabhāge'sti rase tatsarvabhājane | kartavyaṃ tadguṇādhikyādrasajñairiti niścitam’ iti | gāḍhavahninā mūṣādhmātā iti | tena pātālayantreṇa vā yathāyogyaṃ satvanirgamaṃ kārayedityarthaḥ | tathāhi -‘sarvatulyaṃ ca dhānyāmlaṃ bhūnāgaṃ mṛttikā punaḥ | tathā pāṣāṇacūrṇāni kaṭhinoparasāśca ye | melayenmāhiṣaiḥ pañcadugdhādiśakṛdantakaiḥ| dṛḍhaṃ mardya vaṭīṃ kuryāt karṣamātraṃ ca śoṣayet | koṭīyantrairdhamedvahnāvaṅgāre khādirodbhavaiḥ | trivāraṃ dhmāpayedevaṃ satvaṃ patati nirmalam | asādhyānmocayet satvamabhrakādestu kā kathā’ koṭīyantraṃ prasiddhametat | pātālayantranalikāyantrayoḥ svarūpaṃ likhyate - nāla sāgaragolikā bhū- | mūṣāsatva. garta nalikāsampuṭayantrametat atrāgniḥ bhū bhū kṣīram ga. pātālayantram eteṣāṃ satvanirgamaḥ sampradāyato yathā gurusakāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vā kāryo na doṣaḥ || 76-78 ||

div.ab: Gū. atha satvanirgamaḥ | dhamanadravyāt lākṣādayaḥ pratyekamaṣṭamāṃśāḥ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ caturthāṃśamiti grathāntarāt | dhamanāddhātava iti nirukteḥ | abhrādisatvadravyāṇi tena nāgatāmrādidravyāṇi grāhyāṇi | mīnāḥ kṣudramatsyāḥ | yavattiktā sarpākṣī | yadvā yavaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tiktā kaṭukī || 76 -78 ||

atha ratnānāṃ śodhanamāraṇam - kulatthakodravakvāthairdolāyantre vipācayet | vyāghrīkandagataṃ vajraṃ tridinaṃ tadviśudhyati || 79 || taptaṃ taptaṃ tu tadvajraṃ kharamūtrairniṣecayet | punastapyaṃ punaḥ secyamevaṃ kuryāttrisaptadhā || 80 || matkuṇaistālakaṃ piṣṭvā yāvadbhavati golakam | tadgole nihitaṃ vajraṃ tadgolaṃ vahninā dhamet || 81 || siñcayedaśvamūtreṇa tadgole ca kṣipetpunaḥ | ruddhvā dhmātaṃ punaḥ secyamevaṃ kuryāttrisaptadhā ||82|| evaṃ ca mriyate vajraṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatra yojayet |

ab.seg: Dī. ratnānāṃ śodhanamāraṇamapyāha - tāvatpūrvaṃ vajrasya śodhanamāha - kulatthaketi | vajraṃ hīrakaṃ | taccaturvidhaṃ bhavati | tathāhi - ‘śvetaraktapītakṛṣṇāścaturdhā vajrajātayaḥ | rasāyane bhavedvipraḥ śubhraḥ siddhyaṣṭadāyakaḥ || kṣatriyo mṛtyujidrakto valīpalitarogahā | dhanaprado bhavedvaiśyaḥ pīto dehasya dārḍhyakṛt || kṛṣṇaḥ śūdro rujāṃ hantā vapustambhaṃ karoti ca | puṃstrīnapuṃsakāścaite lakṣaṇena tu lakṣayet|| suvṛttāḥ phalasaṃpūrṇāstejovanto bṛhattarāḥ | puruṣāste samākhyātā rekhābinduvivarjitā: || rekhābindusamāyuktāḥ ṣaḍasrāstāḥ striyaḥ smṛtāḥ | trikoṇadehadīrghaṃ ca tannapuṃsakameva ca || pūrvapūrvaṃ tu te śreṣṭhāḥ puruṣā rasabandhakāḥ | śarīrakāntijanakā bhogadā vajrayoṣitaḥ | napuṃsakāstvalpavīryā akāmā: satvavarjitāḥ | striyaḥ strīṇāṃ pradātavyāḥ klībe klībaṃ tathaiva ca || sarveṣāṃ sarvadā yojyāḥ puruṣā balavattarāḥ’ iti | anyatrā'pi ‘pañca doṣā guṇāḥ pañca chāyā caiva caturvidhā | śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva nigṛhyate || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ laghu tīkṣṇaṃ ca bṛhadaṣṭadalaṃ ca yat | jale tarati tadvajraṃ tadgrāhyaṃ rasakarmaṇi’ iti | etasya śodhanādikamapyāha - kulatthetyādi | kulattho'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | kodravo'pyannaviśeṣaḥ | kvāthena kṛtvā dolāyantre vipācayedityabhiprāyaḥ | taptamiti dolāyantrasveditaṃ tadvajraṃ paścādagnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā tadanu kharamūtre niṣecayet | evaṃ trisaptadhā kṛtvā mṛtaṃ vajraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | kecittu dolāyantre svedanam ahorātreṇaiva bhavati | tathāca tantrāntare ‘kulatthakodravakvāthe dolāyantreṇa pācayet | ahorātrāt samuddhṛtya hayamūtreṇa bhāvayet’ iti || 79-82 ||

Gū. athetyanantaraṃ śārṅgadharānuktamapi ratnasaṃkhyāmāha - tatra pañca navaratnāni bhavanti tānyāha - ‘pañcaratnāni mukhyāni uparatnacatuṣṭayaṃ | vajraṃ muktāphalaṃ caiva pravālaṃ mārkataṃ tathā | puṣparāgaṃ nīlavajraṃ gomedaṃ ca viḍūryakaṃ | navaratnāni caitāni śodhayenmārayedbhiṣak’ iti | vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, marakataḥ taddharitavarṇaṃ, puṣparāgaṃ campakahemavarṇābhaṃ, nīlaṃ indranīlaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ, vaiḍūryakaṃ vaidūryamaṇirbiḍālanetravarṇaṃ nīlapītavarṇam | atha vajraśodhanaṃ -vyāghrīkandaṃ guharīkandam iti śodhanam | atha māraṇaṃ | kharo gardabhaḥ | matkuṇaḥ khaṭvamallaḥ | anyadapi hiṃgviti | anyacca sugamam ||79-82||
athānyadapi vajramāraṇamāhvajrakamṛtirnaiva sugamā | kharadaṃṣṭrāmadhye bhavatyeva iti kecana | - hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyukte kvāthe kaulatthaje kṣipet || 83 ||
taptaṃ taptaṃ punarvajraṃ bhūryāccūrṇaṃ trisaptadhā | aparamapi vajramāraṇamāha - maṇḍūkaṃ kāṃsyaje pātre nigṛhya sthāpayetsudhīḥ ||84||
sa bhīto mūtrayettatra tanmūtre vajramāvapet | taptaṃ taptaṃ ca bahudhā vajrasyaivaṃ mṛtirbhavet || 85 ||

div.ab: Dī. hiṅgusaindhaveti | kulatthaṃ prasiddham | tadbhave kvāthe hiṅgusaindhavakalkena vajraṃ liptvā'gnau saṃtāpya kula- tthakvāthenaiva secayediti sampradāyaḥ || 83 || maṇḍūkamiti | maṇḍūkānāṃ mūtravidhānamatra subodhaṃ jñātavyam | tatrādau vajramagnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā tanmaṇḍūkamūtre āvapet | secayedityarthaḥ | taptaṃ ca bahudhā iti ko'rthaḥ saptavāraṃ yāvatkuryādityarthaḥ ||84||85||

idānīṃ vaikrāntamāraṇamāha - vaikrāntaṃ vajravacchodhyaṃ nīlaṃ vā lohitaṃ tathā | hayamūtreṇa tatsecyaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ dvisaptadhā || 86 || tatastu meṣadugdhasya pañcāṅge golakaṃ kṣipet | puṭenmūṣāpuṭe ruddhvā kuryādevaṃ ca saptadhā || 87 || vaikrāntaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti vajrasthāne niyojayet |

Dī. vaikrāntamiti | vajravacchodhyamiti | yathā, vajraṃ pūrvaṃ śodhitaṃ kulatthādikvāthena tathā vaikrāntamapi saṃśodhya paścānmārayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yato ‘vaikrāntaṃ vajrabhedaṃ syāt’ iti | keṣāṃcinmate caturvidhaṃ bhavati | vajram atra dvividhameva grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt hayamūtreṇa ghoṭakamūtreṇa | taptaṃ taptamiti ko'rthaḥ ? taptvāgnau saṃtāpya mūtre āvapedityarthaḥ | evaṃ caturdaśavāraṃ yāvat kuryāt | tataḥ paścāt | vaikrāntaṃ meṣadugdhaṃ tasya pañcāṅgaṃ tasya golakaṃ kṛtvā tatra vaikrāntaṃ melayitvā paścānmūṣāpuṭe saṃrudhyā'gnau pacet | meṣadugdhaṃ meṣadugdhikā tasyāḥ pañcāṅgamityarthaḥ, pañcāṅgaṃ tvakpatrapuṣpaphalamūlāni | evaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā bhasmatāṃ yāti | kecittu meṣadugdhasyetyasya sthāne ‘latāstvottara- vāruṇyā’ iti paṭhanti tasmāt pañcāṅgaṃ laghvindravāruṇyā grāhyam | granthāntaradarśanācca | (tathāhi ‘tataścottaravā- ruṇyā pañcāṅgaṃ golakaṃ kṣipet | ruddhvā mūṣāpuṭe paścātpaceduddhṛtya golakāt | kṣiptvā ruddhvā paceścaivaṃ saptadhā bhasmatāṃ nayet’ iti | vajrasthāne niyojayediti tadvaikrāntaṃ tasya kārye niyojayedityabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva vaikrāntaṃ vajravacchodhyamiti kathitam || 86 || 87 ||
Gū. atha vaikrāntamāraṇaṃ | vaikrāntaṃ vikṛtimāpannaṃ hīrakaṃ hīrakajātiviśeṣaḥ | kapha iti ratnaparīkṣakāḥ prāñcaḥ | meṣadugdhī prasiddhā || 86 || 87 ||

idānīṃ śeṣaratnaśodhanamāraṇamapyāha -- svedayeddolikāyantre jayantyāḥ svarasena ca || 88 || maṇimuktāpravālāni yāmaikaṃ śodhanaṃ bhavet | kumāryāstaṇḍulīyena stanyena ca niṣecayet ||89|| pratyekaṃ saptavelaṃ ca taptataptāni kṛtsnaśaḥ | mauktikāni pravālāni tathā ratnānyaśeṣataḥ || 90 || kṣaṇādvividhavarṇāni mriyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | uktamākṣikavanmuktāḥ pravālāni ca mārayet ||91|| vajravatsarvaratnāni śodhayenmārayettathā |

ab.seg: Dī. svedayediti | jayantī śākabhedaḥ | maṇimuktapravālānīti | maṇayo nānāvidhāste māṇikyapuṣpa- rāganīlamaṇivaidūryagārutmataprabhṛtayaḥ | muktā mauktikaṃ | te'pi bahudhā bhavanti | pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ tadapi bahuvidham, kumārī nārīśabdavācyā, taṇḍulīyo meghanādaḥcaurāīśabdavācyaḥ| , stanyaṃ kṣīraṃ, tena kimuktam | ratnādīni pūrvaṃ dolāyantre jayantyāḥ svarasena saṃsvedya yāmaikaṃ yāvat paścāt tadagnau saṃtaptaṃ kṛtvā kumāryādīnāmekatamarasena niṣiṃcayet | evaṃ saptadhā kṛtvā mṛtāni bhavantītyarthaḥ | mauktānīti bahuvacanatvenāṣṭaprakārāṇi teṣāmucyante | tadyathā - ‘meghānāmatha śaṅkhānāṃ varāhasya ca dantinaḥ | mīnajaṃ vaṃśajaṃ caiva phaṇijaṃ śuktijaṃ tathā | aṣṭau muktāphalānyeva sadā jāraṇakarmaṇi | guṇayuktāni gṛhyante doṣayuktāni varjayet’ | yataḥ - ‘sthūlaṃ vṛttaṃ guru snigdhaṃ raśmitārajalānvitam | śvetamāhlādakaṃ svacchaṃ muktāyāśca guṇā daśa’ iti | pravālānīti bahuvacanenā'trāpi jātiguṇadoṣādikaṃ sūcayati | tathāhi ‘atiriktaṃ ca dīptaṃ ca vidrumaṃ parimaṇḍalam | snigdhaṃ ca svaccharūpaṃ ca baddhaṃ śuddhaṃ samaṃ guru || aṅgārasadṛśaṃ piṇḍaṃ pravāle'mī guṇā daśa | gauraṃ raṅgajalākrāntaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vakraṃ sakoṭaraṃ || rukṣaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ laghu śvetaṃ pravālamaśubhaṃ tyajet | tathā ratnānyaśeṣata’ iti | aśeṣato'pi tajjñasakāśādavagantavyāni | teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇāni likhyante yathā - ‘padmarāgaṃ kuruvindaṃ sugandhaṃ nīlagandhakam | māṇikyaṃ caiva vijñeyaṃ brāhmaṇādikrameṇatu || nirdhūmaṃ jvaladaṅgāramindrago- pasamaprabham | guñjārāgapratīkāśaṃ māṇikyaṃ rasakarmaṇi || cāmpeyakasamo varṇairhemavarṇaḥ sunirmalaḥ | atidīpto bhavedyastu padmarāgaḥ sa ucyate | sthūlavṛddhamadhucchāyaṃ bhrājiṣṇu śvetamujjvalam || guru snigdhaṃ tathā proktaṃ rasarājasya karmaṇi | indranīlo mahānīlo nīlaśca kṛṣṇanīlakaḥ | ete nīlāstu catvāro brāhmaṇādikrameṇa tu | atasīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham|| yaḥkaroti payonīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ taducyate | biḍālanetrasaṃkāśaṃ nīlapītaṃ sunirmalam || calaṃ lasunamadhyasthaṃ vaidūryaṃ rasakarmaṇi | vijñeyo garuḍodgāraḥ kīrapakṣo dvitīyakaḥ || tṛtīyo vaṃśapatraśca caturtho dhūlidhūsaraḥ | khadyotadyutisaṃkāśo mayūrakaṃṭhasannibhaḥ || komalatvaṃ caturṇāṃ supraśastaṃ rasakarmaṇi, iti | kimuktaṃ bahunā ‘pañcadoṣā guṇāḥ pañca cchāyā caiva caturvidhā | śvetā pītā tathā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva nigṛhyate || sarve bhānunibhā dīptā doṣāḥ paṭalavarjitāḥ | nijairvarṇaiḥ samāyuktā utkṛṣṭā rasakarmaṇi’ iti | atha prayogāntaramāha -uktamākṣikavadityādi | pūrvoktasvarṇamākṣikaśodhanavidhānavat muktāpravālāni śodhayet sarvaratnāni ca vajraśodhanamāraṇavidhivat samprasādhayedityabhiprāyaḥ || 88-91 ||

Gū. atha śeṣaratnaśodhanamāraṇaṃ | jayantīsvarasena dolāyantre maṇikādīni svedayet | maṇiḥ sūryacandrakāntādimaṇiḥ | yadvā maṇiḥ | tathāca ‘bhramaraśikhikaṇṭhavarṇaśikhā samaprabho bhujaṅgānāṃ bhavati maṇiḥ kila mūrdhapriyo'narghyaguṇaḥ sa vijñeya’ iti | pravālaṃ vidrumam | atha māraṇaṃ tandulīyakaḥ meghanādaḥ śākaḥ, stanyena strīdugdhena uktamākṣikavat svarṇamākṣikavat māraṇaṃ jambīrarasādau || 88-91 ||
athedānīṃ śilājatuśodhanaprakāraṃ darśayannāha -- śilājatu samānīya grīṣmataptaśilācyutam ||92||
godugdhaistriphalākvāthairbhṛṅgadrāvaiśca mardayet | ātape dinamekaikaṃ tacchuddhaṃ śuddhatāṃ vrajet || 93 ||

div.ab: Dī. śilājatvityādi | jaturlākṣā tatprakāśavat śilābhyaḥ prasrutaṃ dravaviśeṣaṃ tat śilājatuśabdavācyam | tantrāntare'pi ‘māsi śukre śucau caiva śilāḥ sūryāṃśutāpitāḥ | catuḥprakāśaṃ svarasaṃ śilābhyaḥ prasravanti hi | śilājatviti vikhyātaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam’ iti | nanu rūkṣakaṭhinānāṃ śilānāṃ kathaṃ snigdhadravaḥ svarasaḥ saṃbhavati ? | satyam | atra śilopalakṣitatvāt tattaddhātava eva prasravanti | tathācoktam ‘śailasya dhātoḥ svarasaṃ śilābhyaḥ sūryapratāpājjatusaṃprakāśam | kṛṣṇaṃ bhavenmūtrasamānagandhi tadeva ramyaṃ tu śilājatu syāt’ iti | matāntare'pi ‘hemādyāḥ sūryasaṃtaptāḥ sravanti giridhātavaḥ| jatvābhaṃ mṛdu mṛtsnācchaṃ yanmalaṃ tacchilājatu’ iti | iti tantrāntare'pi prasiddhametat| tadyathā ‘taptādīnāṃ tu lohānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanyatamānvayam | jñeyaṃ svagandhataścāpi ṣaḍyoniprathitaṃ kṣitau’ iti | yataḥ lohādbhavati tadyasmācchilājatu jatuprabhaṃ | tasya lohasya yadvīryaṃ rasaṃ vāpi bibharti tat’ iti | prasaṅgato'pi catuṣṭayaṃ yathā - ‘hemno vai rajatāt tāmrāt tathā syādayasādapi | gomūtragandhi sarveṣāṃ yathāpūrvamanuttamam’ iti | anyatrāpyuktam ‘trapusīsāyasādīni pradhānānyuttarottaram | yathā tathā prayoge'pi śreṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti | caturṇāmapi mukhyānāṃ prasravaṃ śilājatu catuṣṭayamatra guṇakhyāpanāya cānyayonivāraṇāya ca bhavatīti| samānīyeti atra samyag grahaṇaṃ śreṣṭhagrahaṇanimittamavagantavyam | kathamasya śreṣṭhatvamityatrāha kaścit - ‘teṣu kṛṣṇaṃ malaṃ snigdhaṃ laghu ni:śarkaraṃ bhavet| gomūtragandhavaccāpi tat pradhānaṃ pracakṣate’ iti | grīṣmataḥ praśilācyutamiti yadyapyanyasmin kāle śilājatuprasravaṃ dṛśyate tathāpi grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitābhyaḥ śilābhyo guṇavattaraṃ bhavati | godugdhairityādibahuvacanāntaiḥ kṛtvā bahuvāraṃ bhāvayedityabhiprāyaḥ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ ‘ghamarā’ iti loke | atra bhāvyasamānakvathanīyaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyam | kvathanīyadravyamaṣṭaguṇe jale niṣkvāthya caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe kaṣāye bhāvayet | tacchuddhaṃ śuddhatāṃ vajrediti | nanu pūrvaṃ yacchuddhaṃ syāt tat kathaṃ paścācchuddhatāṃ vrajedityatra śuddhaśabdadvayaṃ ca kimartham ? ucyate, pūrvaṃ śilājatupiṇḍaṃ dhūpādinā saṃśodhya paścādanena vidhinā śodhayedityadoṣaḥ | tathāhi - ‘duṣṭauṣadhikīṭapataṅgadaṃśasaṃtālikādoṣanivāraṇārtham | lohāḍhakau nimbaguḍūcisarpiryavairyathāvat paridhūpayecca’ iti | pūrvaśodhitameveti sarvasaṃmatam || 92 || 93 ||

Gū. atha śilājatuśodhanaṃ | grīṣme grīṣmakāle taptaśilācyutaṃ śilājatu samānīya yathā bhūmau na patati godugdhādibhirmardayet śuddhyatīti | atha bhūmipati tasya śodhanaṃ mukhyam | uttamaśilājatupāṣāṇaṃ sūkṣmakhaṇḍaprakalpitaṃ kṛtam atyuṣṇapānīye nikṣipya yāmaikaṃ sthāpayet | mardayitvā tannīraṃ vastragālitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, mṛtpātre sthāpayitvā ātape dhārayet | granthāntare lohapātre niṣkāsanamuktaṃ | catvāri pātrāṇyasitāyasānītyuktatvāt | uparisthe yat ghanaṃ tat anyapātre kṣipet | tatra jalaṃ datvā tasmādanyasmin evaṃ dvimāsābhyāṃ jveṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāṃ niḥsārayet tato vahnikṣiptau liṅgopamaṃ liṅgākāraṃ bhavet tadā kāryakṣamaṃ kāryasādhakaṃ bhūyāditi parīkṣā | spaṣṭamanyat || 92 || 93 ||

athānyakaraṇaprakāramāha -- mukhyāṃ śilājatuśilāṃ sūkṣmakhaṇḍaprakalpitām | nikṣipyātyuṣṇapānīye yāmaikaṃ sthāpayetsudhīḥ || 94 || mardayitvā tato nīraṃ gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam | sthāpayitvā ca mṛtpātre dhārayedātape budhaḥ || 95 || uparisthaṃ dhanaṃ yatsyāttatkṣipedanyapātrake | dhārayedātape tasmāduparisthaṃ ghanaṃ nayet || 96 || evaṃ punaḥ punarnītvā dvimāsābhyāṃ śilājatu | bhūyātkāryakṣamaṃ vahnau kṣiptaṃ liṅgopamaṃ bhavet || 97 || nirdhūmaṃ ca tataḥ śuddhaṃ sarvakarmasu yojayet | adhaḥsthitaṃ ca yaccheṣaṃ tasminnīraṃ vinikṣipet || 98 || vimardya dhārayeddharme pūrvavaccaiva tannayet |

ab.seg: Dī. mukhyāṃ śilājatuśilamiti | mukhyā pūrvaṃ darśitā tajjātiṣu śreṣṭhā | śilājatuśilāmiti śilājatoḥ śilāvat saghanapiṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya paścāt pūrvoktavidhinā saṃśoṣya tadanu sūkṣmakhaṇḍaṃ yathā syāt prakalpyātyuṣṇapānīyaṃ prakṣipya yāmaikaṃ yāvat sthāpayet | tatastapyate sudhīriti sadvaidyaḥ | sudhīriti grahaṇamatra sukaraṇavidhānārthaṃ | yato'sya karaṇaṃ kālādikamapekṣate | yathoktam ‘athoṣṇakāle ravitāpayukte vyabhre vivāte samabhūmibhāge | pātreṣu kṛṣṇāyasanirmiteṣu vidhānavaddrāvayituṃ pacettu’ | katham ? yathā ‘śilājatu śreṣṭhamavāpya pātre prakṣipya tasmādviguṇaṃ ca toyam | uṣṇaṃ tadartha bhṛśamatra dattvā viśoṣayet tanmṛditaṃ yathāvat || tatastu yatkṛṣṇamupaiti cordhvaṃ vilīyamānaṃ raviraśmitaptam | tat kācapātre'nyatame vidhāya tatrāparaṃ koṣṇajalaṃ kṣipettu || punaśca tasmādaparantu pātrādasmācca pātrādaparantu bhūyaḥ | punastato'rdhvaṃ tu nidhāya kṛṣṇaṃ yaduddhṛtaṃ tat punarāharecca || yadā viśuddhaṃ jalamacchamardya pracchannabhāvān malayettu tasmāt | tadā tyajet tacchrimalaṃ śilājatu syājjalamaśuddhamevamiti bhūyāt | kāryakṣamamiti anena prakāreṇa yacchilājatu snehaṃ śuddhaṃ (kṛtaṃnāsti khapustake tat sarvakāryeṣu yojayedityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi - ‘śuddhaṃ bhāvitayuktaṃ tu vidhinānena mānavaḥ | śilājatu prayuñjānaḥ sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate’ iti | vahnau kṣiptamiti evaṃ saṃskāritasyā'sya śreṣṭhatvaṃ tadā syād yadā'gnau kṣipte sati nirdhūmaṃ bhavati | liṅgopamaṃ ca bhavati | tathāhi - ‘vahnau kṣiptaṃ tu nirdhūmaṃ yacca liṅgopamaṃ bhavet | śuddhaṃ yojyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ hārītādyairmaharṣibhiḥ’ || 94-58 ||

div.ab: atha maṇḍūrakaraṇam - akṣāṅgārairdhametkiṭṭaṃ lohajaṃ tadgavāṃ jalaiḥ || 99 || secayettaptataptaṃ ca saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | cūrṇayitvā tataḥ kvāthairdviguṇaistriphalābhavai: ||100|| āloḍya bharjayedvahnau maṇḍūraṃ jāyate varam |

Dī. atha maṇḍūrakaraṇavidhānamāha - akṣeti | akṣāṅgārairiti bahuvacanatvenānyakāṣṭhodbhavairapi dhamediti na doṣaḥ | kiṭṭaṃ lohamalaṃ tadbahuvārṣikaṃ grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt| tathāhi - ‘śatotthamuttamaṃ kiṭṭaṃ madhyaṃ cāśītivārṣikam | adhamaṃ ṣaṣṭivarṣīyaṃ tato hīnaṃ viṣopamam’ iti | lohajamiti sāmānyalohagrahaṇena muṇḍādisamastalohasaṃbhavaṃ tadguṇamapi ca jñātavyaṃ | yataḥ - ‘yāni lohāni tat saṃjñālakṣaṇāni guṇāni ca | maṇḍūraṃ tadguṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yallohamapi yadguṇam | ata eva ‘kiṭṭāddaśaguṇaṃ muṇḍaṃ muṇḍāt tīkṣṇaṃ śatonmitam’ ityādi | anyacca - ‘ye guṇā mārite muṇḍe te guṇā muṇḍakiṭṭake | tasmāt sarvatra maṇḍūraṃ rogaśāntau niyojayet’ iti | gavāṃjalairgomūtraiḥ | tathāca nirvāpya bahumūtre secayediti | evaṃ saptavāraṃ kuryāt | punaḥ punariti grahaṇenā'tra saptavāraṃ niyataṃ, kiṃtu yāvat śīryate tāvannirvāpayedityabhiprāyaḥ | tathācoktaṃ ‘lohakiṭṭaṃ susaṃtaptaṃ yāvat tat śīryate svayaṃ | tacchīrṇaṃ grāhayet teṣāṃ maṇḍūraṃ tu prayojayet’ iti | evaṃ saptavāraṃ kuryāt triphalākvāthasya dviguṇitā'tra | maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayet varamiti śreṣṭhaṃ | śreṣṭhatā'syāñjanasādṛśyāt bhavati ||99 ||100||
Gū. aṅgārairbibhītakāṅgāraistriphalākvāthairmaṇḍūradviguṇaḥ || 99 || 100 ||

atha kṣārakalpanāṃ darśayitumāha -- kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇyagnau pradīpayet || 101|| nītvā tadbhasma mṛtpātre kṣiptvā nīre caturguṇe | vimardya dhārayedrātrau prātaracchaṃ jalaṃ nayet || 102 || tannīraṃ kvāthayedvahnau yāvatsarvaṃ viśuṣyati | tataḥ pātrātsamullikhya kṣāro grāhyaḥ sitaprabhaḥ || 103|| cūrṇābhaḥ pratisāryaḥ syātpeyaḥ syātkvāthavatsthitaḥ | iti kṣāradvayaṃ dhīmānyuktakāryeṣu yojayet || 104 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracittāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe dhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ab.seg: Dī. kṣīravṛkṣasyeti | kṣīravṛkṣo'tra muṣkakaḥ kathitaḥ; sa ca parvatajaḥ morava iti loke | kecit sāmā- nyagrahaṇenaivānye kṣīravṛkṣā api gṛhyante ityāhuḥ | tadyathā - ‘kuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrabibhītakāragvadha- bilvakā'rkasnuhyapāmārgapāṭalānaktamālavṛkṣakadalīcitrakapūtīkendravṛkṣāsphotāśvamārakasaptacchadāgnimanthaguñjāśca-tasraḥ kośātakī samūlaphalapatraśākhā dahet’ iti | kāṣṭhānīti bahuvacanenātra kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhānāṃ bahūn khaṇḍān kṛtvā pāṭya dahedityabhiprāyaḥ | tathā tantrāntare ‘taṃ cikīrṣuḥ śaradi girisānujaṃ śucirupoṣya praśaste'hani praśastadeśajātamanupahatamadhyamavayasaṃ mahāntamasitamuṣkakamadhivāsyāparedyuḥ pāṭayitvā khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpyāvapāṭya nivātadeśe nicitaṃ kṛtvā tilanālairādīpayet | athopaśānte'gnau tadbhasma pṛthag gṛhṇīyāt’ iti | cūrṇābhaḥ pratisārya iti pratisāryaḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ | yaḥ kvāthavat sthitaḥ peyaḥ sa pānīya iti saṃjñaḥ | evaṃ kṣārasya dvaividhyaṃ bhavati | iti yuktakāryeṣu yuktavyādhiṣu yathāyogyaṃ yojayedityarthaḥ | yuktavyādhiṣu yathā tatra pratisāraṇīyaḥ | kuṣṭhakiṭibhadadrumaṇḍalakilāsabhagandarārbudārśoduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīlatilakālakanyacchavyaṅgamaśakabāhyavidradhikṛmi-viṣādiṣūcyate | saptasu ca mukharogeṣūpajihvā'dhijihvopakuśadantavaidarbheṣu tisṛṣu ca rohiṇīṣvete- ṣvanuśastravidhānamuktam| pānīyastu gulmodaragarāgniśūlājīrṇānāha śarkarāśmaryābhyantaravidradhiḥ kṛmiviṣārśaḥ - sūpayujyate iti | pānīyaḥ pānārhaḥ kṣārodakamityarthaḥ | ye cānye'pi pākyasvarjikāyavakṣārā yathāyogyaṃ vaktavyā- steṣāṃ cūrṇavaṭakāvalehādiṣu prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ | dhīmāniti | grahaṇaṃ kṣārakarmaṇi caturo bhiṣak tathā prayateta na yathā kṣāro'guṇo bhavati | tadyathā ‘naivātitīkṣṇe na mṛduḥ śuklaḥ ślakṣṇo'tha picchilaḥ | abhiṣyandī śivaḥ śīghraḥ kṣāro hyaṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ’ iti | doṣāścāsya yathā - ‘atyauṣṇyamatipaicchilyamatitīkṣṇavisarpitā | atyarthaṃ mārdavaṃ śaityama- tyarthaṃ sāndrameva ca | nyūnauṣadhavipakvatvaṃ kṣāradoṣā nava smṛtāḥ’ iti || 101-104 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe śodhanamāraṇakalpanaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||

Gū. atha kṣārakalpanā | kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhāni apāmārgaciṃcākadalīpalāśasehuṇḍacitrakaśigrūkaṇṭakārīprabhṛtīni | pradīpayet jvālayet, acchaṃ nirmalaṃ jalaṃ lohapātre kvāthayet| yastu cūrṇābhaḥ kṣāraḥ sa pratisāryaḥ, masakādau prayojyaḥ, yastu kvāthavat dravarūpaḥ sthitaḥ, sa gulmādau peyaḥ ityuktaṃ kṣāradvayaṃ | cūrṇalakṣaṇaṃ yuktakāryeṣu gulmādau cārayet| tathāca vāgbhaṭaḥ - ‘peyokṣārāgnisādāśmagulmodarajarādiṣu | yojyaḥ sākṣo masaścitrabāhyārśaḥkuṣṭhasuptiṣu’ || 101-104 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dhātuśodhanamāraṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

div.head: atha rasakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ athedānīṃ rasapraśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ tacchodhanamāraṇādikamāha - pāradaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ jetā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ | sudine‘sujñena’ gū.dī. sammata: | sādhitaḥ kuryātsaṃsiddhiṃ dehalohayoḥ || 1||

Dī. pārada iti | bhavasindhoḥ pāraṃ dadātīti pāradaḥ | ata eva rasapraśaṃsāyāmuktam ‘tejo mṛgāṅkamauleḥ soḍhaṃ svenaiva tejasāṃ puñjaiḥ | ajarāmaratvavitaraṇakalpataruṃ taṃ raseśvaraṃ vande’ | aparamapi - ‘aṇimādyaṣṭaguṇairvibhūtidoṣaṃ na saṃsāramapārapāradaḥ | muktvaikaṃ rasarājaṃ konyo'thāste jarāpaho hyaparaḥ’ iti | īdṛk pāradaḥ sudine sādhitaḥ | sa ca dehalohayoḥ siddhiṃ kuryāditi tātparyārthaḥ | dehasiddhirvyādhiharatvena | śarīrārogyatā lohasiddhiśca svarṇarajataśodhanakaraṇādikaḥ | punaḥ kīdṛśo rasaḥ | sarvarogāṇāṃ jetā | sarve ca te rogāḥ śarīramano'bhipannā jvaramadamūrcchādayaḥ, teṣāṃ jetā vināśakara ityarthaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūto rasaḥ ? puṣṭikara iti | puṣṭirdhātupoṣaṇaṃ tāṃ karoti iti puṣṭikaraḥ | ata eva poṣaṇādvājīkaraṇaśaktyāyamapi vikhyātaḥ | sudine iti | śobhanadivase jyotiḥśāstroktasaumyatithinakṣatrādiyukte dine ityarthaḥ | tathācoktam - ‘natvā guruṃ bhairavakanyakābaṭuṃ dvīpānanaṃ siddhamamuṣya rakṣitam | anta: sunīlaṃ bahirujjvalaṃ rasaṃ niveśayet khalvatale śubhe dine’| anyatrāpyuktam - ‘vijane pavanādivarjite vā deśe saumyadine dinādikāle | balimatra vidhāya pūjanaṃ ca tadanuvidhiḥ pratimantritaṃ vidhijñaiḥ’ iti | sādhita iti parimāṇādikena saṃskāritaḥ | tadyathā - ‘raso grāhyaḥ sunakṣatre palānāṃ śatamātrakaṃ | pañcāśatpa- ñcaviṃśadvā daśapañcaikameva vā | palānnyūnaṃ na kartavyaṃ rasasaṃskāramuttamam | tasmāt sūtaviśuddhyarthaṃ sahāyairnipuṇairyutaḥ | sarvopaskaramādāya rasakarma samārabhet’ ityādi | saṃsiddhimiti | aihikīmāmuṣmikīṃ ca | uktaṃ ca yataḥ - ‘baddhaḥ khecaratāṃ padaṃ nayeddharate vyādhisamūhaṃ mūrcchitaḥ | jārito janmajarāvināśanaḥ krāmito rañjito bhaktimuktidaḥ || yadi pañcatvagataṃ hi sūtakaṃ bhakṣitaṃ syādamaratvakārakam | jalaukāranibaddhaḥ sarvajo grathito manmatharasadāyakaḥ | bhasmākā- ragataṃ girīśajam asitaṃ bhūcarabhūtisiddhidaṃ | pārāpāramapārapāradaṃ tasmāt kaḥ karuṇākaro'paraḥ’ iti | deha- lohayoriti | dehaṃ śarīraṃ tasya siddhirjarāvyādhirāhityaṃ lohaṃ suvarṇādi tasya siddhiḥ saṃskāratvamatra vistarabhayānna likhitam || 1 ||
Gū. atha rasakalpanā | pāradaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ jvarādīnāṃ jetā | tathā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ | sujñena tatsādhakena sādhitaḥ tadā dehalohayoḥ siddhaṃ kuryāt || 1 ||
idānīṃ rasarājasya paryāyanāmānyāha - rasendraḥ pāradaḥ sūto harajaḥ sūtako rasaḥ | budhaistasyeti‘mukundaśce’ti gū.dī. sammata: | nāmani jñeyāni rasakarmasu || 2 ||

Dī. rasendreti | rasendretyādirasāntāni pāradasya nāmāni rasakarmasu jñeyāni | kaiḥ budhaiḥ | tasyeti rasasya, iti grahaṇena saṃkṣepanāmānyabhihitāni | anyānyapi santi vistareṇa | tathāhi - ‘raso mahārasaḥ sūtastrinetraśca trilocanaḥ | harabījaścalaścaiva bījendro'tha rasāyanaḥ | pāradaśca suvarṇākhyo mahāvahnistathaiva ca ||lokeśa: khecaro divyaḥ saubhāgyaḥ paramā'mṛtaḥ | śaśihemanidhiścaiva ananto jñānameva ca || sūkṣmaḥ śāntaḥ prabhuścaiva kalikāntakaraḥ smṛtaḥ | etāni rasanāmāni tathānyāni śive yathā’ iti || 2 ||

Gū. atha pāradanāmānyāha - rasendraḥ rasānāmindra adhyakṣaḥ, rasendraḥ pāradaḥ | rogādisamudrātpāradānātpāradaḥ sūtaḥ | svarṇādisiddhiprasavāt sūtaḥ | harajaḥ harāt jāta iti harajaḥ | sūtakaḥ sūta eva sūtakaḥ svārthe kaḥ | rasyata āsvādyate ṣaḍrasatvādrasaḥ | mukundaḥ mukunmokṣaṃ dadātīti mukundaḥ | auṇādikatvādaḥ ||2||

div.ab: tāmratārāranāgāśca hemavaṅgau ca tīkṣṇakam | kāṃsyakaṃ kāntalohaṃ ca dhātavo nava ye smṛtāḥ ||3|| sūryādīnāṃ grahāṇāṃ te kathitā nāmabhiḥ kramāt |

ab.seg: Dī. pūrvaṃ dehalohayoriti yallohagrahaṇaṃ, teṣāṃ lohānāṃ navagrahanāmāṅkitatvena navasaṃkhyākathanamāha - tāmreti | tāmrādayo navasaṃkhyā dhātavo matāste sūryādīnāṃ navagrahāṇāṃ nāmabhiḥ kṛtvā kramāt kathitāḥ | etena kim uktam - tāmramādityasaṃjñaṃ, tāraṃ raupyaṃ somasaṃjñam, āraṃ pītalohaṃ tanmaṅgalasaṃjñaṃ, nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ tadbudhasaṃjñaṃ, hemaṃ suvarṇaṃ tadbṛhaspatisaṃjñaṃ, vaṅgaṃ śukrasaṃjñaṃ, tīkṣṇakamayastacchanisaṃjñaṃ, kāṃsyaṃ rāhusaṃjñaṃ, vṛttalohaṃ ketusaṃjñamiti kramaḥ | ete dhātavo navagrahanāmabhirboddhavyā: || 3 ||
Gū. atha tāmrādidhātūnāṃ sūryādīnāmadhiṣṭhānamāha - sugamam | āraḥ pittaliḥ, nāgaḥ sīsakaḥ, hema svarṇaṃ, vaṅgaṃ raṅgaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇalohaṃ, kāntalohaṃ vṛtaloham || 3 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ rasaśodhanakarmāha - rājīrasonamūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ kṣiptvā vibandhayet || 4 || vastreṇa dolikāyantre svedayetkāñjikaistryaham | dinaikaṃ mardayetsūtaṃ kumārīsaṃbhavairdravaiḥ || 5 || tathā citrakajaiḥ kvāthairmardayedekavāsaram | kākamācīrasaistadvaddinamekaṃ ca mardayet || 6 || triphalāyāstathā kvāthai raso mardyaḥ prayatnataḥ | tatastebhyaḥ pṛthakkuryātsūtaṃ prakṣālya kāñjikaiḥ || 7 || tataḥ kṣiptvā rasaṃ khalve rasādardhaṃ ca saindhavam | mardayennimbukarasairdinamekamanāratam || 8 || tato rājī rasonaśca mukhyaśca navasādaraḥ | etai rasasamaistadvatsūto mardyastuṣāmbunā || 9 || tataḥ saṃśoṣya cakrābhaṃ kṛtvā liptvā ca hiṅgunā | dvisthālīsaṃpuṭe dhṛtvā pūrayellavaṇena ca || 10 || adhaḥ sthālīṃ tato mudrāṃ dadyādṛḍhatarāṃ budhaḥ | viśoṣyāgniṃ vidhāyādho niṣiñcedambunopari || 11 || tatastu kuryāttīvrāgniṃ tadadhaḥ praharatrayam | evaṃ nipātayedūrdhvaṃ raso doṣavivarjitaḥ || 12 || athordhvapiṭharīmadhye lagno grāhyo rasottamaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. rājīti | rājīrasonetyādinā prathamataḥ svedanasaṃskāravidhirārabhyate | yato santi bhūyāṃsaḥ saṃskārāḥ, te ke ityatrāha - ‘saṃsvedanaṃ mardanamūrcchane ca utthāpanaṃ pātanabodhane ca | niyāmanaṃ dīpanameva cāṣṭau pūrve kṛtāḥ karmaṇi sūtakasya’ iti | anyatrāpyuktam - ‘aṣṭau ca rasasaṃskārā dravye rāsāyane samāḥ | ete prathamaṃ kāryāḥ syuḥ paścāt sarvatra yojayet’ | rasāditi rasaśodhanakarma yatpūrvamuktaṃ tatkarmaśabdaḥ upaskārādīn praśaṃsayati | yataḥ - ‘sarvopaskaramādāya rasakarma samārabhet’ ityādivacanam | tathāhi - ‘upaskaraṃ na yo vetti tasya siddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet’ ityapi | tasmādupa- skarāṇi katipayāni likhyante | tadyathā - tulābhājanaṃ tacca dvividhaṃ tulā ghaṇṭakaṃ ceti; khalvabhājanaṃ tacca trividhaṃ pāṣāṇakhalvaṃ, lohakhalaṃ, tāmrakhalvaṃ ca; kaṇḍanī sā ca dvividhā śilākaṇḍanī, pāṣāṇakaṇḍanī ca; vicitrakha- rparāṇi tāmrādīnāṃ bhājanāni mṛṇmayāni ca; koṣṭhikā sā ca trividhā jālakoṣṭhikā kharparakoṣṭhikā bhūmikoṣṭhikā ceti; bhasrikā sā ca trividhā carmabhastrikā, karparabhastrikā, mukhabhastrikā ceti, nalikā sā ca dvividhā nalikā, vakranalikā ceti | nalikā lohamayī vakranalikā mṛṇmayī, mūṣā sā ca dvividhā pakvā apakvā ca, apakvāyā bhedo vajramūṣāyāḥ kumbhakāreṇa sumṛttikayā kṛtā sā pakvamūṣā; tayorbhedā yathā mūṣā, gostanā, andhamūṣā, nalikāmūṣā, sampuṭīmūṣā, ḍholīmūṣā, iṣṭikāmūṣā, kṣāramūṣā, saindhavādilavaṇamūṣā kharparamūṣā, kokilākhyamūṣā, hematāratāmralohasīsakamūṣādayaḥ | saṇḍiśaśca taddvividhaḥ patrasaṇḍiśaḥ, kākamukhasaṇḍiśaśceti | hastakuṭṭakanirghā- tādayaḥ sarvāṇi suvarṇakāropaskarāṇi ca | puṭaṃ taccaturvidhaṃ tuṣapuṭaṃ, karīṣapuṭam, upalapuṭaṃ, khadirādikāṣṭhapuṭaṃ ceti | yantrāṇi ca tadyathā - śilāyantraṃ, pāṣāṇayantraṃ, bhūdharayantraṃ, vaṃśanalikāyantraṃ, gajadantabhājanayantraṃ, dolāyantraṃ, adhaḥpātanayantram, ūrdhvapātanayantraṃ, niyāmakayantraṃ, ḍamarukayantraṃ, kaṭāhayantraṃ, kāṃsyabhājanayantraṃ, pātālayantraṃ, tulāyantraṃ, kacchapayantraṃ, cakrayantraṃ, cākīyantraṃ, vālukāyantram, agnisomayantraṃ, gandhakaṭahikāyantraṃ, mūṣāyantraṃ, bāṇayantraṃ, garuḍayantraṃ, sāraṇayantraṃ, jālikāyantraṃ, cāraṇayantrādīni anyānyapi yathāyogyaṃ bhavanti | tatra tatra eva jñātavyāni | tatra teṣvādau svedanavidhimāha - ‘rājīrasonamūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ kṣiptvā vibandhayet’ ityādivyākhyānaṃ sampradāyato likhyate | yathā rājīkādikalkena mūṣāṃ kṛtvā tatra rasaṃ melayitvā upari kadalīdalairveṣṭayitvā tadupari caturguṇena vastreṇa poṭṭalikāṃ baddhvā kāñjikādipūrite bhāṇḍe dolāyantravidhānena svedayet | yāvaddinatrayaṃ bhavati | dinagrahaṇena rātrirapi gṛhyate tenāhorātraṃ svedayedityabhiprāya:, etadapi vidhānaṃ tantrāntare coktaṃ tadyathā - ‘rājikā lavaṇaṃ hiṅgu citrakaṃ vyoṣasaṃyutam | sūtapādamitaṃ sarvaṃ svarjikākṣārasaṃyutam || śigrapatrarasenaiva piṣṭvā kuṇḍalikākṛtam | kuryādbhūrjadale samyagathavā kadalīdale || supakve ca dṛḍhevā'pi vastrakhaṇḍe caturguṇe | rasaṃ madhye vinikṣipya badhnīyāttu supoṭṭalīm || kṣārāmlamūtravargeṇa svedayecca dinatrayam | tathā svedaḥ prakartavyo majjitā poṭṭalī yathā || bhavenna ca talasparśo bhāṇḍasyā'pi kadācana’ iti | dolāyanttrapramāṇam | ‘dravadravyeṇa bhāṇḍasya pūrito'rdhasya tasya ca | mukhe tiryakkṛte daṇḍe rasaṃ sūtreṇa lambitam | taṃ svedayenmadhyagataṃ dolāyantramiti smṛtam|’ atha pratyekasaṃskārānte mardanamuktaṃ tatkarma darśayannāha - dinaikaṃ mardayet sūtaṃ kumārīsambhavairdravairityādi | eteṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ dravaiḥ kṛtvā khalve sūtaṃ mardayet, tena pratyekarasena kṛtvā dinaikaṃ mardayedityarthaḥ | kumārī prasiddhā, citrakaṃ citrakajaṭā, kākamācī loke ‘kāmaiyā’śabdavācyā, triphalā harītakyādikam ebhiryantrapūrvakaṃ saṃmardya paścāt kāñjikaiḥ prakṣālya śodhayedityarthaḥ| kāñjikairiti bahuvacanatvena jalena takreṇa vā kṣālanīyam | tathāca - tantrāntare-‘bhavedekaikasaṃskāraprānteṣu dṛḍhamardanam | marditaṃ sthāpayeddharme yāvacchuṣkataro bhavet | takreṇa kāñjikenātha śuktenoṣṇodakena vā | tataḥ sarvaṃ samānīya kṣālayediti buddhimān || tathā yantraṃ prakurvīta yathā na kṣīyate rasaḥ’ iti | atha svedanasaṃskāramabhidhāya samprati mardanasaṃskāraṃ darśayannāha - tataḥ kṣiptvā rasaṃ khalve rasādardhaṃ ca saindhavamityādi | tata iti | svedanapūrvakamardanānantara tadrasaṃ khalve kṣiptvā mardayediti | kaiḥ kṛtvā ? vakṣyamāṇasaindhavapramukhadravyaiḥ, etanmardanaṃ taptakhalve'bhihitamiti sampradāyaḥ | tathāhi ‘yuktaṃ sūtasya sarvasya taptakhalve vimardanam | ajāśakṛttuṣāgniṃ tu bhūgarbhe tritayaṃ kṣipet || tasyopari sthitaṃ khalvaṃ taptakhalvamidaṃ bhavet’ iti | ‘athavā tīvragharme ca kārayecca pramardanam’ iti sampradāyaḥ | anāratamiti anālasyaṃ yathā bhavati tathā mardayediti bhāvaḥ | anāratagrahaṇenāpi anyavihitadravyairapi mardanīyaṃ na doṣo granthāntare darśanāt | tathāhi ‘kṣārāmlairlavaṇairmūtrairviṣairupaviṣaistathā | divyauṣadhisamūhena mardayeddivasatrayam’ | anuktamānānāṃ mardanārthadravyāṇāṃ ca parimāṇaṃ granthāntarādavagantavyam | tadyathā - ‘pāradasya kalāṃśena bheṣajena pramardayet | dravyeṇa yāvatā sarvaṃ plutaṃ bhavati mardane’ iti | idānīṃ mardanasaṃskārādanantaraṃ mūrcchanasaṃskāravidhimāha - tato rājī rasonaścetyādi | tata iti mardanasaṃskārādanantaram | rājī rājikā, rasonaḥ lasuna iti prasiddhaḥ, mukhyaśca navasādara iti| navasādaraśculikālavaṇa: mukhya: śreṣṭho grāhya ityarthaḥ | tasya śreṣṭhatā paigāmīśabdavācyā prasiddhā | tadvaditi | mardanoktaprakāreṇa mardyaṃ tuṣāmbuneti | kāñjikena kṛtvā kṣālanaṃ svedanaṃ ca pūrvavat kāryaṃ, rasasyotthāpanārthaṃ yato mūrcchanānantaramutthāpanamapi kāryamiti sarvatra | tathāhi - ‘utthitaḥ kāñjikasvedāt pātayet khalvasaṃyutam’ iti saṃpradāyaḥ | yathā - ‘dolāsvedaṃ prakurvīta madhukṣārāmlamūtrakaiḥ | utthāpya mūrcchayet paścāt trivāraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ’ iti | athavā ‘tataḥ khalvena taptena amlenotthāpayedrasam | kṣārā mukhakarāḥ sarve sarve hyamlāḥ prabodhakāḥ’ iti || mūrcchanotthāpanavidhimabhidhāya samprati pātanānyāha - tataḥ saṃśoṣya cakrābhamityādi | tata iti mūrcchanotthāpanānantaram | saṃśoṣyeti | eke saṃśoṣyetyanena mūrcchitameva rasaṃ cakrābhaṃ kṛtvā pātayediti vyākhyānayanti tanna saṃmataṃ bahusampradāyeṣu, mūrcchitasyotthāpanaṃ kṛtvā paścāduktadravyaiḥ saha piṣṭikāṃ kṛtvā cakrikāṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | anyatrāpyuktam | ‘bhāgāstrayo rasasyārkacūrṇa- pādāṃśasaṃyutam | datvā'mlaṃ mardayet - tāvadyāvat piṣṭiḥ prajāyate | yadā na jāyate piṣṭiḥ - kiñcittutthaṃ tadā kṣipet’ iti sarvatra | piṣṭikṛtarasacakrī hiṅgunā liptvā dhāryā | hiṅgumānamapi ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ pāradaparimāṇāt, dvisthālīsampuṭa iti | vikhyātaṃ lavaṇapūraṇaṃ sampradāyadarśanādboddhavyam | dṛḍhatarāṃ mudrāmiti mudrā'tra sāmpradāyikī kāryā yathā gurusakāśādvā dṛṣṭvā | tathā athavā sadbuddhīnāṃ jñāpanārthaṃ sadābhyastā mudrā'tra likhyante tathāca ‘valmīkamṛttikāpārapūraṇaṃ lohakiṭṭakam | śvetapāṣāṇakaṃ caiva tatsarvaṃ cūrṇayet samam || sarvatulyaṃ viṣaṃ dagdhaṃ sarvaṃ toyairvimardayet | mūṣādisampuṭaṃ kuryāt sarvasandhipralepane’ | athavā ‘tuṣaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ, bhāgaikaṃ vastrakhaṇḍakaṃ | mṛdaścaturguṇo bhāgo jalaṃ datvā pramardayet || narakeśaṃ śaṇaṃ kiñcit datvā tāvat prakuṭṭayet | yāvat sikthasamābhāsaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ jāyate tadā || yathā na śuṣkatāṃ yāti tathā yantraṃ samācaret | evaṃ saptadinādūrdhvaṃ mṛdaṃ yoge prayojayet || kūpikādivilepārthaṃ yantrārthaṃ ca bhiṣak kramāt’ | aparamapi | ‘harītakīṭaṅkaṇaparṇacūrṇaṃ kharī guḍaṃ pāṃśu paṭuṃ samāṃśam| valmīkamṛt sarvasamā tadardhaṃ vastraṃ tathā gomayakaṃ ca sarvam || jalena mardyaṃ madanopamaṃ tad yantrādisandhau viniveśanīyam’ iti | aparāṇyapi - ‘lohakiṭṭaṃ tuṣaṃ dagdhaṃ śukticūrṇaṃ ca karkarā | etāni samabhāgāni tāvadbhāgena mṛttikā | karpaṭena samāyuktā sā hi vajropamā bhavet | dagdhatuṣasyaikabhāgo mṛdbhāgatrayameva ca | karpaṭaṃ śaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vajramṛtsneti yojayet | iṣṭakācūrṇabhāgaikaṃ samabhāgā tu mṛttikā || mūṣābandhaḥ prakartavyo dhamanādvajratāṃ vrajet | bhāgaikaṃ lohakiṭṭasya tuṣadagdhadvayaṃ tathā || mṛdbhāgatrayasaṃyuktaṃ kiñcit kupyaṃ pradāpayet | ekatra kuṭṭayet sarvaṃ mṛttikāvajravadbha- yet || niṣiñcedambunopari’ iti | upari ambunā niṣiñcediti ko'rthaḥ ? tatsthālīsampuṭayantraṃ cullyāṃ nidhāyāgniṃ prajvālya tadupari śītaṃ jalaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kṣipedityabhiprāyaḥ | sajalavastrakhaṇḍamapi tadupari dhāryamiti sampradāyaḥ | anyatrāpyuktam - ‘saṃruddhya bhāṇḍadvayagarbhamadhye piṣṭiṃ tataḥ sampuṭamavraṇaṃ tam | niveśya cullyāṃ tu śanaiḥ pradīpapramāṇamasyādyatale vidadhyāt || agniṃ śirasyasya jalārdramekaṃ vastraṃ kṣipedalpamanuṣṇameva’ iti | doṣavivarjita iti yadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ doṣarahitaḥ pāradaḥ ebhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saṃskāropāyaireva bhavatītyasyābhiprāyaḥ | tasmāt pañcaiva saṃskārā anenā'tra svīkṛtāḥ | ke te doṣāḥ ? tathāhi - ‘malaṃ viṣaṃ vahnigurutvacāpalaṃ naisargikaṃ doṣamuśanti tajjñāḥ | upādhikau dvau trapunāgasambhavau rasendrarāje kathayanti vaidyāḥ’| nanu pātanatrayeṇaiva nāgavaṅgakṛtadoṣo vinaṣṭo bhavati nānyaiḥ, tathāhi - ’miśritau cedrase nāgavaṅgau vikrayahetunā | syāt tābhyāṃ kṛtrimo doṣastanmuktiḥ pātanatrayāt’ iti| tatkathamatra pañcabhireva sarvadoṣavivarjito bhavati ? satyam, ūrdhvapātanāntargatamadhastiryakpātanamastīti tasyābhiprāyaḥ, tatpātanadvayaṃ tantrāntarādavagantavyam | athavā ‘athordhvapiṭharīmadhye lagno grāhyo rasottamaḥ’ ityatrā'thagrahaṇenāvaśiṣṭasaṃskārāṇi sūcyante tāni ca pātanabodhananiyāmakānītyadoṣaḥ || atha keṣāṃcijjñāpanārthaṃ prasaṅgataḥ pātanatrayamāha - ūrdhvapātanamatraiva kathitam | adhaḥpātanaṃ tiryakpātanaṃ ca darśayannāha - tathāca tantrāntare -‘kaṭāhaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtvā tasyādho lepayedrasam | dviguṇena ca gandhena jārayedbradhnakādayaḥ || vastrāntāni mṛdā liptvā jalaṃ sthālyupari nyaset | sthālīkaṭāhayoḥ sandhiṃ lepayet sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdā || kaṭāhopari kartavyamupalāgnipradīpanam | jalamadhye raso yāti śuddhaṃ tiṣṭhati bradhnake || śulbādraso rasāt tāmraṃ pātanīyaṃ pṛthak kṛtam | sasūtabhāṇḍavadanepyanyanmilati bhāṇḍakam | tathā sandhirdvayoḥ kāryā pātanatrayayantrake | jalasthāne kāñjikaṃ ca dāpayennātra saṃśayaḥ’ iti | tiryakpātanamapyāha - tathāhi ‘ghaṭe rasaṃ vinikṣipya sajalaṃ ghaṭamanyakam | tiryaṅmukhaṃ dvayoḥ kuryāt tanmukhaṃ rodhayet sudhīḥ || rasādho jvālayedagniṃ yāvat sūto jalaṃ viśet | tiryakpātanamityuktaṃ siddhairnāgārjunādibhiḥ’ iti | athāparāṇyapi prasaṅgato likhyante tathāhi - ‘sthūlasaindhavapoṭṭalyāṃ kāryaṃ mūṣāpuṭadvayam | sthāpayitvā rasaṃ tatra navasāraṃ kalāṃśakam | sandhiṃ nirudhya yatnena veṣṭayet karpaṭaṃ mṛdā | sthāpayedbhūdhare yantre vahniṃ kuryāddinatrayam | yantrāduddhṛtya sūto'sau svedayet tadanantaram | bījapūraphalaṃ vātha vṛntaṃ santyajya kārayet || saindhavena samaṃ sūtaṃ tasya madhyaṃ vinikṣipet | svedayeddolikāyantre hyamlavarge dinatrayam || evaṃ hyagnisaho jāto rasendraḥ sarvakarmasu’ iti niyāmakam | atha bodhanamāha - ‘atha sūtaṃ samuddhṛtya kācakūpye vinikṣipet | śuktāmlenātha sampūrya dvāre mudrāṃ pradāpayet || sthāpayedbhūdhare yantre svedayeddinasaptakam | svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya kaṣāyaiḥ svedayet punaḥ || karkoṭīkañcukīvahnisarpākṣyambujamādravaiḥ | dinatrayaṃ sāranālaiḥ svedyaścāñcalyaśāntaye’ iti bodhanam | atha dīpanamāha - ‘lavaṇaṃ rājikāhiṅgukanyākṣāracatuṣṭayam | tryūṣaṇaṃ lasunaṃ caiva mātuluṅgarasaplutam || piṇḍamadhye rasaṃ kṛtvā svedayet saptadhā punaḥ | anudgārī bhavettena grāsājīrṇe'pi jīryati || anenaiva bhavecchuddhaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ’ | athavā - ‘kīratuṇḍagaruḍī ṛṣicchaṭā kanyakā kumārikā ca vāyasī | āsurī ca vijayā jayā tathā vahnidīpanakarāśca sūtake’ ityaṣṭau saṃskārāḥ saṃkṣepeṇoktāḥcatu:prasthe pārade gandhakanavasādarayordvitrivārākṛṣṭamatitīkṣṇaṃ tejāpasaṃjñaṃ pañcapañca tolakaṃ datvā darvyā cālayedūrdhvagataṃ malaṃ bhūyobhūstyajedevaṃ vinaiṣa saṃskārairlaghunopāyena śudhyati| || 4-12 ||

Gū. atha rasaśodhanaṃ | rājikā, rasono lasunaḥ, etayormūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ pāradaṃ vibandhayet | iti svedanam | atha mardanaṃ | dinaikaṃ mardayet khalve iti | kākamācī prasiddhā | ayānyairmardanaṃ mūrcchanaṃ vā ityūrdhvapātanam || || 4-12 ||

div.ab: atha gandhakaśodhanam - lohapātre vinikṣipya ghṛtamagnau pratāpayet || 13 || tapte ghṛte tatsamānaṃ kṣipedgandhakajaṃ rajaḥ | vidrutaṃ gandhakaṃ jñātvā dugdhamadhye vini:kṣipet || 14|| evaṃ gandhakaśuddhiḥ syātsarvakāryeṣu yojayet |

Dī. idānīṃ gandhakaśodhanaṃ darśayannāha - lohapātre iti | gandhakajaṃ raja iti | gandhājjāto gandhakaḥ| tadyathā ‘śvetadvīpe purā devyāḥ krīḍantyāḥ prasṛtaṃ rajaḥ | kṣīrārṇave tu snātāyā dukūlaṃ rajasā'nvitam || dhautaṃ yanmathitaṃ vastraṃ gandhavadgandhakaṃ smṛtam | caturdhā gandhakaḥ prokto rakta: pīto'sitaḥ sitaḥ ||rakto hemakriyāsūkta: pītaścaiva rasāyane | vraṇādilepane śvetaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sudurlabhaḥ | evaṃ gandhakaśuddhiḥ syāt sarvakarmasu yojayet’ iti | evamiti grahaṇena śodhanāntaramapi darśitaṃ tadgranthāntarādavagantavyam | yathā ‘kṣīreṇa bhāṇḍamāpūrya vastreṇāveṣṭya tanmukham | vastramadhye kṣipedgandhaṃ mukhaṃ yatnāt pidhāpayet || śarāveṇa tato vahniṃ prajvālyordhvamavasthitam | bhāṇḍake nipatedyāvat gandhastāvat samindhayet || kṛśānau tu svayaṃ nīte gandhakaṃ tu samuddharet’ iti || 13 || 14 ||
idānīṃ daradaśodhanamapyāha - meṣīkṣīreṇa daradamamlavargaiśca bhāvitam || 15 || saptavāraṃ prayatnena śuddhimāyāti niścitam |

ab.seg: Dī. meṣīkṣīreṇeti | meṣī avi: | amlavargaiśceti | ‘jambīramātuluṅgādyairamlavargagaṇo mataḥ’ iti | amlavargaiścetyatra cakāragrahaṇenānyacchodhanamamumīyate | tathāca - ‘śuddha: syāddaradaḥ saptakṛtvo lākṣāmbubhāvitaḥ | maladoṣādikaṃ nāsti sarvakāryeṣu yojayet’ iti | asya jātyādikaṃ ca likhyate keṣāñcit subodhāryam | yathā ‘rasagandhakasambhūtaṃ hiṅgulaṃ procyate budhaiḥ | tasmātsūtaṃ ca yadgrāhyaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam || daradastrividho jñeyaścarmāraḥ śukatuṇḍakaḥ | haṃsapādastṛtīyaḥ syāt guṇavānuttarottaram || haṃsapādaṃ ca tatrādyaṃ tārakarmaṇi yojayet | taddhemakiṭṭasadṛśaṃ tadanyastīkṣṇamāraṇe || carmāraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ syāt sapītaḥ śukatuṇḍakaḥ | satvapāte ca tatproktaṃ śodhyamaurabhradugdhake’ || tathāca - ‘japākusumasaṃkāśo haṃsapādo mahottamaḥ | rasāyane sarvalohamāraṇe rasarañjane’ iti || 15 ||
atha daradādrasākṛṣṭirbhavati tāmapi darśayannāha - nimbūrasairnimbapatrarasairvā yāmamātrakam || 16 ||
piṣṭvā daradamūrdhvaṃ ca pātayetsūtayuktivat | tataḥ śuddharasaṃ tasmānnītvā kāryeṣu yojayet ||17 ||

div.ab: Dī. nimbūrasairiti | nimbūrasanimbapatrarasamānaṃ bhāvanāyuktivadboddhavyam | kecittu nimbūrasaiḥ nimbapa- trarasairityasya sthāne jambīraiḥ pāribhadrarasairiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca granthāntaradarśanāt | tathāhi - ‘pāri- bhadrarasaiḥ peṣyaṃ hiṅgulaṃ yāmamātrakam | jambīrāṇāṃ dravairvā'tha pātyaṃ pātanayantrake’ iti | atra pāribhadraḥ ‘phalahadā’ śabdavācyo na tu nimbakaṇṭakapālāśa ityapare | pātayet sūtayuktivaditi sūtayuktiḥ pūrvaṃ kathitā sā tu pātanayantrādhikṛtā bhavati || 16 || 17 ||

Gū. atha daradāt pāradānniṣkāsanaṃ | daradaṃ hiṅgulaḥ, daradaṃ ūrdhvaṃ pātayet ḍamaruyantreḍamaruyantretyupalakṣaṇam, tena daradāddviguṇavastrakhaṇḍai: golakaṃ kṛtvā prajvālya vastranirdhūmaṃ haṇḍikayā pidhāya sthālyāṃ rakṣet | tata: śītībhūtāyāṃ haṃḍikāyāmudghāṭya pāradaṃ gṛhṇīyāditi sugamaḥ prakāraḥ | sūtavat | smaṣṭamanyat ||16 || 17 ||

athoddhṛtasya sukhakaraṇam - kālakūṭo vatsanābhaḥ śṛṅgakaśca pradīpaka: | hālāhalo brahmaputro hāridraḥ saktukastathā ||18 || saurāṣṭrika iti proktā viṣabhedā amī nava | arkasehuṇḍadhattūralāṅgalīkaravīrakam || 19 || guñjāhiphenāvityetāḥ saptopaviṣajātayaḥ | etairvimarditaḥ sūtaśchinnapakṣaḥ prajāyate || 20|| mukhaṃ ca jāyate tasya dhātūṃśca grasate kṣaṇāt |

ab.seg: Dī. atha rasamukhakaraṇamāha - kālakūṭa iti | kālakūṭaprabhṛtikaṃ viṣabhedaṃ tatparīkṣakasakāśādavagantavyam | kiñcillakṣaṇamapi likhyate yathā - ‘ghanaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca kaṭhinaṃ bhinnāñjanasamaprabham | kandākāraṃ samākhyātaṃ kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣaṃ || vatsanābhaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ ca kiñcidrūkṣaṃ ghanaṃ tathā | ghanaṃ guru ca nibiḍaṃ śṛṅgākāraṃ ca śṛṅgikaṃ || pradīpanaṃ śikhiśikhākāraṃ ca gurucikkaṇam | cakrākāraṃ bhavedvakraṃ nīlaṃ hālāhalaṃ mataṃ || brahmaputraḥ pāṇḍuraḥ syāt haridrābhaṃ haridrakam | citramutpalakandābhaṃ saktukaṃ saktuvadbhavet || saurāṣṭrikaṃ śaṅkhavarṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ viṣalakṣaṇam’ iti | eteṣāṃ madhye ekadvitrisakalāni yathālābhaṃ saṃgṛhya rasasya ṣoḍaśāṃśena kṛtvā mardanīyāni | ṣoḍaśāṃśatā'tra ekasyaivetyarthaḥ | upaviṣeṣu lāṅgalīkakaravīrakamahiphenamiti | ahiphenaṃ viṣamatsyasamudbhavamiti jñeyam | tathāhi - ‘samudre caiva jāyante viṣamatsyāścaturvidhāḥ | tebhyaḥ phenaṃ samutpannamahiphenaṃ caturvidham || kecidvadanti sarpāṇāṃ phenaṃ syādahiphenakam |’ yathā - ‘dhāraṇaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca raktavarṇaṃ ca jārakam | sāraṇaṃ pītavarṇaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca māraṇam || viṣavaddhyuttamaṃ phenaṃ yujyate rasakarmaṇi’ iti | kecittu khākhasajaṃ kṣīraviśeṣamiti manyante tadabhāvāt | evaṃ sarvatra śeṣaṃ sugamam | mānamapyeteṣāṃ pūrvavat || 18-20 ||

Gū. amī kālakūṭādayo nava viṣabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ kathitāḥ | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ viṣaparīkṣakebhyo jñeyam | atha upaviṣāṇyāha - lāṅgalī kalihārī, karavīrakaḥ aśvamārajaṭārasaḥ, ahiphenam āphūkam, etāḥ sapta upaviṣajātayaḥ | etairmarditaḥ sūtaḥ chinnapakṣaḥ jāyate mukhaṃ dhātugrasanaśīlaṃ ato dhātūn tvarayā grasate || kālakūṭādīnāṃ dravaiḥ sapta sapta dinaṃ mardanaṃ prakṣālanaṃ ca || || 18-20 ||
anyadapi mukhakaraṇamāha - athavā kaṭukakṣārau rājī lavaṇapañcakam || 21 ||
rasono navasāraśca śigruścaikatra cūrṇitaiḥ | samāṃśaiḥ pāradādetairjambīreṇa draveṇa vā || 22 ||
nimbutoyaiḥ kāñjikairvā soṣṇakhalve vimardayet | ahorātratrayeṇa syādrase dhātucaraṃ mukham || 23 ||
