div.ab: atha madanakāmadevo vājīkaraṇe - tāraṃ vajraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ sūtakagandhakam || 259 || lohaṃ kramavivṛddhāni kuryādetāni mātrayā | vimardya kanyakādrāvairnyasetkācamaye ghaṭe || 260 || vimudrāṃ piṭharīmadhye dhārayetsaindhavāvṛte | piṭharīṃ mudrayetsamyak tataścullyāṃ niveśayet||261 || vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryāddinaikaṃ tata uddharet | svāṅgaśītaṃ ca saṃcūrṇya bhāvayedarkadugdhakaiḥ || 262 || aśvagandhā ca kākolī vānarī muśalīkṣurā‘kṣuka:’ pā. | | tritrivelaṃ rasairāsāṃ śatāvaryāśca bhāvayet || 263 || padmakandakaserūṇāṃ rasaiḥ kāśasya bhāvayet | kastūrī vyoṣakarpūrakaṅkolailālavaṅgakam || 264 || pūrvacūrṇādaṣṭamāṃśametaccūrṇaṃ vimiśrayet | sarvai: samāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dattvā śāṇonmitāṃ pibet ||265 || godugdhadvipalenaiva madhurāhārasevakaḥ | asya prabhāvātsaundaryaṃ balaṃ tejo'bhivardhate ||266|| taruṇī ramayedvahvīḥ śukrahānirna jāyate |

ab.seg: Dī. atha madanakāmadevarasamāha - tāramityādi | tāraṃ raupyaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, tadabhāve vaikrāntaṃ grāhyamiti vyavahārāt | sūtakaḥ pāradaḥ lohaṃ sārasaṃjñam | atra kramavṛddhistu pūrvadravyāduttaravṛddhirboddhavyā, asmatsampradāye tu rajatādīni dravyāṇi atra mṛtāni deyānīti vyavahāro'pi dṛśyate | kanyakā kaumārī | vimudrāmiti kācakupīmiti śeṣaḥ | saindhavacūrṇaṃ ca kācakupīmubhayato deyam | siddharasasyabhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - arkadugdhamarkabhavaṃ kṣīraṃ, kālolī prasiddhā, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī kandaviśeṣaḥ, ikṣukaḥ kokilākṣaḥ tālamūlī, padmakandaḥ kamalakandaḥ kaseruko'pi vikhyātaḥ kāśatṛṇasaṃjñaḥ prasiddhaḥ | paścāccūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - kastūrītyādi | kastūrī mṛganābhijā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, pūrvacūrṇādbhāvanābhiḥ pratipāditadravyādaṣṭamāṃśaṃ dadyāt | tena pūrvacūrṇaṃ saptabhāgaṃ kastūrīpramukhaṃ caikabhāgamiti ||259-266 ||

Gū. tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ vajraṃ hīrakam abhrakaṃ vā, suvarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, gandhakaṃ, sūtakaṃ śuddhaṃ, tīkṣṇam etāni kramavṛddhāni tāraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, vajraṃ dvibhāgaṃ, suvarṇaṃ tribhāgaṃ, tāmraṃ caturbhāgaṃ, sūtaṃ saptabhāgaṃ, lohamaṣṭabhāgam evam arkadugdhairmardya kācakupyāṃ vālukāyantre pācayet | tato'śvagandhādibhirmardya bhakṣayet | arkadugdhaṃ yadyapi bhāvanādravye likhitaṃ tathāpi kumāryā sahaiva deyam arkadugdhasya bhakṣaṇānucitatvāt | vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī, ikṣurā tālamūlī, spaṣṭamanyat || 259-266 ||

div.ab: vājīkaraṇe kandarpasundararasamāha - sūto vajramahirmuktā tāraṃ hemāsitābhrakam ||267|| rasaiḥ karṣāṃśakānetānmardayedirimedajaiḥ | pravālacūrṇaṃ gandhaṃ ca dvidvikarṣaṃ vimiśrayet ||268|| tato'śvagandhāsvarasairvimardya mṛgaśṛṅgake | kṣiptvā mṛdupuṭe paktvā bhāvayeddhātakrīrasaiḥ ||269|| kākolī madhukaṃ māṃsī balātrayabiseṅgude | drākṣāpippalavandākaṃ varī parṇīcatuṣṭayam || 270 || parūṣakaṃ kaseruśca madhūkaṃ vānarī tathā | bhāvayitvā rasaireṣāṃ śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet||271|| elātvakpatrakaṃ vāṃśī lavaṅgāgarukeśaram | mustaṃ mṛgamadaḥ kṛṣṇā jalaṃ candraśca miśrayet ||272|| etaccūrṇaiḥ śāṇamitai rasaṃ kandarpasundaram | khādecchāṇamitaṃ rātrau sitā dhātrī vidārikā ||273|| etāsāṃ karṣacūrṇena sarpiṣkarṣeṇa saṃyutam | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibetsusthitamānasaḥ ||274|| ramaṇī ramayedbahvīrna hāniṃ kvāpi gacchati |

ab.seg: Dī. sūta ityādi | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaṃ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, hema suvarṇam, asitābhrakaṃ kṛṣṇābhrakam etatsarvamapi māritaṃ grāhyamityatra vyavahāraḥ | eteṣāṃ mānamapi karṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekam | irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ, sa ca loke ‘reoja’ śabdavācya tasya tvak grāhyā | aparadravyadvayamapi melanārthaṃ dvidvikarṣaṃ pratyekaṃ deyam | tacca pravālacūrṇaṃ vidrumacūrṇaṃ, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ, mṛgaśṛṅgake mṛgaśṛṅgasampuṭe tadauṣadhaṃ dhāryamityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛdusampuṭaṃ ca laghugajapuṭamityarthaḥ | paścādbhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni, kākolī svanāmakhyātā, madhukaṃ madhukayaṣṭī, māṃsī jaṭākhyaṃ sugandhadravyam | balātrayaṃ prasiddham tacca balā atibalā nāgabaleti, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhasīṇḍaśavdavācyaṃ loke, iṅgudaṃ vṛkṣeṅgudaṃ, drākṣā prasiddhā, pippalavandākamiti pippalavṛkṣasya vandā, vandā ca viṭapalagno gulmaviśeṣaḥ, eke pippalavandākaṃ dravyadvayaṃ varṇayanti tatra pippalaḥ pippalatvak vandāvṛkṣaḥ vandā prasiddhā apare pippalīvandākamiti vyākhyānayanti, vāṇaḥ sahacaraḥ eke vāṇasthāne varīti paṭhanti, parṇīcatuṣṭayamiti | māṣaparṇī mudgaparṇī, śālaparṇī, pṛṣṭhiparṇī, ceti, parūṣakaṃ phālasāśabdavācyaṃ kaserukaṃ prasiddham | madhūkaṃ bhadhūkavṛkṣapuṣpāṇi, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, eteṣāṃ svarasena pratyekaṃ bhāvayedityarthaḥ | atha cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - elātvakpatrakamityādi | vāṃśī tvakkṣīrī vaṃśarocanā iti prasiddhā, agaru prasiddham, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, mṛgamadaḥ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ etatsakalaṃ śāṇamitaṃ ṭaṅkapramāṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ rātrau niśāmukhe | anupānamāha - dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet, kathambhūtam ? sitādīnāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ melayitvā karṣamātraṃ saṃgṛhya karṣamānena ca ghṛtena saha saṃmardya tanmiśritam | sitā matsyaṇḍī, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārī vidārīkandaḥ, sukhitamānasaḥ svasthaḥ, na tu āturaḥ, tasya vihitatvāt na hāniṃ kvāpi gacchatīti sa puruṣaḥ | vīryahāniṃ na prāpnoti ityarthaḥ || 267-274 ||

Gū. atha kandarpasundaro rasaḥ | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ vā abhrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaḥ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ hema svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, sitābhrakaṃ, śvetābhrakaṃ māritam, etān karṣāṃśikān pratyekān irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ tena mardayet | pravālo vidrumaḥ dvikarṣo gandhako dvikarṣaḥ | aśvagandhāsvarasairmardyaḥ, mṛgaśṛṅgake kṛtvā mṛdupuṭe pacet | tato dhātakīrasairbhāvayet| parūṣakaphalaviśeṣaḥ kaseruḥ prasiddhaḥ, madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaḥ, vānarī kapikacchūḥ eṣāṃ rasairbhāvayitvā śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet | elādikaiḥ pratyekaṃ śāṇamitairmiśrayet | punaḥ kandarpasundaraṃ śāṇamitaṃ rātrau, sitā dhātrī vidārikā eteṣāṃ karṣacūrṇena yutaṃ sarpiḥ karṣeṇa saṃyutaṃ khādet | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet | susthiramānasaḥ ramaṇī ramayet | elā kṣudrailā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, vāṃśī rocanā, lavaṅgam, agaru, kesaraṃ mustaṃ, mṛgamadaṃ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ, sitā prasiddhā, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārīkandaṃ, sarpirghṛtaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 267-274 ||
atha loharasāyanam - śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ dvibhāgaṃ śuddhagandhakam ||275||
kṣipetkajjalikāṃ kuryāttatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ rajaḥ | kṣiptvā kajjalikātulyaṃ praharaikaṃ vimardayet ||276||
tataḥ kanyādravairgharme tridinaṃ parimardayet | tataḥ saṃjāyate tasya soṣṇo dhūmodgamo mahān ||277||
atyantaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātre nidhāpayet | madhye dhānyakuśūlasya tridinaṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ || 278 ||
uddhṛtya tasmātkhalve ca kṣiptvā gharme nidhāya ca | rasaiḥ kuṭhāracchinnāyāstrivelaṃ paribhāvayet || 279 ||
saṃśoṣya gharme kvāthaiśca bhāvayettrikaṭostridhā | vāsāmṛtācitrakāṇārasairbhāvyaṃ kramāttridhā ||280||
lohapātre tataḥ kṣiptvā bhāvayettriphalājalaiḥ | nirguṇḍīdāḍimatvagbhirbisabhṛṅgakuraṇṭakaiḥ || 281 ||
palāśakadalīdrāvairbījakasya śṛtena ca | nīlikālambuṣādrāvairbabbūlaphalikārasaiḥ || 282 ||
bhāvayettritrivelaṃ ca tato nāgabalārasaiḥ | śatāvarīgokṣurubhiḥ pātālagaruḍīdravaiḥ || 283 ||
tritrivelaṃ yathālābhaṃ bhāvayedebhirauṣadhaiḥ | tataḥ prātarlihetkṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ kolamātrakam||284||
palamātraṃ varākvāthaṃ pibedasyānupānakam| māsatrayaṃ śīlitaṃ syādvalīpalitanāśanam ||285||
mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsau ca pāṇḍutāṃ kaphamārutau | pippalīmadhusaṃyuktaṃ hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ ||286 ||
vātāsraṃ mūtradoṣāṃśca grahaṇīṃ gudajāṃ rujam | aṇḍavṛddhiṃ jayedetacchinnāsattvamadhuplutam || 287 ||
balavarṇakaraṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | jayetsarvāmayānkālādidaṃ loharasāyanam || 288 ||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tilatailaṃ ca māṣānnaṃ rājikāṃ tathā | madyamamlarasaṃ caiva tyajellohasya sevakaḥ ||289||

Dī. atha loharasāyanamāha - śuddhaṃ rasendrabhāgaikam ityādi | śuddhaṃ saṃskāritaṃ, rasendraḥ pāradaḥ tasyaiko bhāgaḥ, śuddhagandhakasya dvau bhāgau, gandhakaśuddhiśca pūrvaṃ kathitaiva | tatra kajjalikāyāṃ tīkṣṇabhavaṃ raja iti | lohacūrṇaṃ śuddhaṃ mṛtasāracūrṇam ityeke | tacca pūrvakajjalikāsāmyaṃ grāhyam | praharaikaṃ mardanaṃ kevalaṃ kajjalikā lohacūrṇayoreva kathitaṃ na tu svarasādinā, vakṣyamāṇasvarasaireva tridinaṃ yāvadityabhiprāyaḥ | gharma iti kharatarasūryāṃśutāpite ata eva tasya soṣṇo mahān dhūmodgamo bhavati iti | tenaivaṃ lohamṛtiḥ syādityeke | svamate tu dhānyakuśūloṣitaṃ trirātraṃ yāvadbhavati paścād yaduddharet tatkālameva gharme dhāraṇena mṛtiḥ syāt | atyantapiṇḍitamityanena eraṇḍapatraveṣṭanādikamabhipretam | paścātkāryamāha - rasairityādi | kuṭhāracchinnā loke tipānīśabdavācyā | kurejā ityapare | trivelamityanenāparadravyāṇāmapi saṃbandhaḥ | tenaikaikarasena trivelaṃ bhāvayedityarthaḥ | gharme ca pratyekaṃ śoṣaṇamapi vihitam | trikaṭoḥ tryūṣaṇasya ‘śuṇṭhīmaricapippalyastrikaṭusttryūṣaṇaṃ smṛtam’ iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī | lohapātre tat kṣiptveti pūrvaṃ mṛtpātre dhāryamiti prāptam | pāṣāṇakhalve vā triphalājalaiḥ triphalākvāthaiḥ triphalāharītakyādi dāḍimatvak valkalaṃ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, palāśakadalīdrāvairiti palāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya drāvaḥ svaniryāsaḥ, kadalīdrāvaḥ kadalīkandaniryāsaḥ, vījako vijayasāro vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya śṛtena kvāthena, nīlikā nīlī, alambuṣā muṇḍī, babbūlaphalikā babbūlavṛkṣasya phalānītyarthaḥ, nāgabalā gāṅgerukī, śatāvarī, gokṣurakau prasiddhau, pātālagaruḍī chirahaṇṭiśabdavācyā | anupāne varākvāthaṃ triphalākvātham, chinnāsatvaṃ guḍūcīsatvaṃ | śeṣaṃ subodham ||275-289||

Gū. śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, dvibhāgaṃ gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ tayoḥ kajjalikāṃ kṛtvā tatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatulyaṃ kanyādrāvairmardayet, tato golakaṃ kṛtvā eraṇḍapatrairveṣṭayitvā tāmrasampuṭe dhānyarāśau sthāpayet tataḥ kuṭhāra- chinnādyairbhāvayet | kuṭhārachinnā, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhṛṅgo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, nīlikā aparājitā, alambuṣā muṇḍī, varī śatāvarī || 275-289 ||

jaipālaśodhanam - (jaipālaṃprakṣiptam | rahitaṃ tvagaṅkurarasajñābhirmale māhiṣe nikṣiptaṃ tryahamuṣṇatoyavimalaṃ khalve savāso'rditam liptaṃ nūtanakharpareṣu vigatasnehaṃ rajaḥsaṃnibhaṃ nimbūkāmbuvibhāvitaṃ ca bahuśaḥ śuddhaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ bhavet ||290||

div.ab: viṣaśodhanam | viṣaṃ tu khaṇḍaśa: kṛtvā vastrakhaṇḍena bandhayet | gomūtramadhye nikṣipya sthāpayedātape tryaham ||291|| gomūtraṃ ca pradātavyaṃ nūtanaṃ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥ | tryahe'tīte samuddhṛtya śoṣayenmṛdu peṣayet ||292|| śuddhyatyevaṃ viṣaṃ tacca yogyaṃ bhavati cārtijit | khaṇḍīkṛtya viṣaṃ vastraparibaddhaṃ tu dolayā || 293 || ajāpayasi saṃsvinnaṃ yāmataḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt | ajādugdhābhāvatastu gavyakṣīreṇa śodhayet ||294|| ) iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe rasakalpanā nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | samāpto'yaṃ madhyamakhaṇḍaḥ ||

ab.seg: Dī. vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsu prasiddhāḥ sumatiduravabodhāste mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ | tadapi gurusakāśādyacchrutaṃ tadvyalekhi hyaḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe saṃsiddharasādhyāyo dvādaśaḥ || 12 ||
Gū. iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne rasakarma nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

div.head: atha snehādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Dī. atha uttarakhaṇḍaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ madhyamakhaṇḍānte rasāyanavājīkaraṇārthaṃ rasā uktāḥ, te cāviśuddhaśarīre na svakāryakaraṇakṣamāḥ; uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ | vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ’ ( vā. u. 39-4) iti | ’tasmāccharīraśuddhyarthaṃ pañcakarmāṇi yojayet | tāni ca snehasvedābhyāṃ vinā na saṃbhavanti, uktaṃ ca - ’snehasvedāvanabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkamivāyāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate (vā. sū. 18-59) iti tasmāt snehā'dhyāyameva prathamaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ --
atha snehapānavidhiḥ |

Dī. snehasya ghṛtādeḥ pānasya vidhirvidhānaṃ, sa ca vidhiścarake yathā sapraśna uktastamāha - ?sāṃkhyaiḥ saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum | jagaddhitārthaṃ papraccha vahniveśaḥ svasaṃśayam || kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak | kālānupāne kaḥ kasya katidhā ca vicāraṇāḥ || kati mātrāḥ kathaṃ mānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate | kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ || snehyāḥ ke ke ca na snehyāḥ, snigdhā'tisnigdhalakṣaṇam | kiṃ pānātprathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiṃ ca hitāhitam || ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ | śodhane śamane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate || nareṣu keṣu vidhinā kena yojyā vicāraṇāḥ | snehasyāpyamitajñāna ! jñānamicchāmi veditum? (ca. sū. 13,1-6) iti | ’tatra saṃkhyānamadhīyante vindate vā te sāṃkhyāḥ, taiḥ; kiṃviśiṣṭaiḥ ? saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaiḥ, saṃkhyātā saṃkhyā yaiste saṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyāḥ | jñātajñeyā ityarthaḥ | taiḥ saha āsīnam, uta cāsaṃkhyātasaṃkhyeyaṃ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasum iti pāṭhaḥ. | etaduktaṃ bhavati - sākhyaiḥ sahāsīnaṃ punarvasuṃ saṃkhyāvikārakāyāṃ kathāyāṃ vartamānaṃ tatkālānurūpam agniveśo'pi svasaṃśayaṃ pṛṣṭavān | dvikarmako'yam | tatra ’ kati snehāḥ ? etasyottaramāha -
snehaścaturvidhaḥ prokto ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā vasā | majjā ca -

Dī. sa snehaḥ catuḥprakāraḥ, ghṛtādibhedāt | tatra ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ śreṣṭhatvāt; tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ; vasā-’śuddhamāṃsasya yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā iti | majjā iti majjā mastakamajjā asthimajjā vā | tathāca - ’sthūlā'sthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate’ iti | taduktaṃ carake - ’tilāḥ priyālābhiṣukau bibhītakaścitrābhayairaṇḍamadhūkasarṣapāḥ | kusumbhabilvārukamūlakātasī nikocakākṣoṭakarañjaśigrujāḥ || snehāśayāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāstathā syurjaṅgamā matsyamṛgāḥ sapakṣiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ dadhi kṣīraghṛtāmiṣaṃ vasā sneheṣu majjā ca tathopadiśyate’ iti | abhayā harītakī, citrā dantī iti || ( ca. sū. 13,8)

Gū. athottarakhaṇḍaḥ procyate | atha pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tailaṃ, vasā, majjā, iti caturvidhaḥ snehaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhasneheṣu ghṛtasya mukhyatvādādāvabhidhānaṃ, tatastailaṃ tilasaṃbhūtaṃ, tato vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, (tato) majjā, asthimadhyasnehaḥ | nanu pañcakarmādau vamanaṃ tadyathā – ‘vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhamanuvāsanam | jñeyaṃ pañcavidhaṃ karma vidhānaṃ tasya kathyate’ iti | tatkathaṃ snehapānamādau ucyate ? ( satyam, snehapānaṃ vinā vamanādisaṃśodhanānāṃ hānikaratvāt ) pañcakarmādau snehapānaṃ, tataḥ svedaḥ, tato vamanaṃ, tato recanam; ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||

ab.seg: kaḥ kāla ’ etasya uttaramāha -- taṃ pibenmartyaḥ kiṃcidabhyudite ravau || 1 ||
Dī. ’ śītakāle divā snehamuṣṇakāle pibenniśi ’ iti || 1 ||
Gū. taṃ caturvidhaṃ snehaṃ kiṃcidabhyudite ravau pibet || 1 ||

div.ab: ‘kiṃyonayaḥ’ etasyottaramāha - sthāvaro jaṃgamaścaiva dviyoniḥ sneha ucyate |

Dī. tatra sthāvarāścaturvidhāḥ, vanaspatayaḥ, vṛkṣāḥ, vīrudhaḥ, oṣadhaya iti | jaṃgamāḥ khalvapi caturvidhāḥ – jarāyujā-ṇḍaja-svedajo-dbhijjāḥ eteṣāṃ svarūpamanyato jñātavyam | tathāca carake – ’snehānāṃ dvividhā saumya yoniḥ sthāvarajaṅgamā’ (ca. sū. 13,7) iti |
Gū. sthāvarajaṅgamabhedena snehasya dvividhatvamāha | sugamam ||

ab.seg: varāvaratvamāha - tilatailaṃ sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ghṛtaṃ varam || 2 ||
Dī. tailaghṛtayorvaratvaṃ ca saṃskārasyānuvartanāditi | uktaṃca - ’tailaṃ saṃyogasaṃskārātsarvarogāpahaṃ matam’ iti | atraivodāharaṇaṃ candanādyaṃ tailam | tat ghṛtamapi śāstre vyavahārārtham || 2 ||

div.ab: militasnehanāmānyāha - dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhistairyamakastrivṛto mahān |
Dī. yo dvābhyāṃ snehābhyāṃ milito yogaḥ sa yamakaḥ kathitaḥ | yastribhiḥ snehairmilitaḥ sa trivṛtaḥ | yaścaturbhiḥ snehaiḥ saṃyutaḥ sa mahānkathita ityabhiprāyaḥ |
Gū. yamakādisnehabhedānāha - dvābhyāṃ ghṛtatailābhyāṃ yamakaḥ | tribhirghṛtatailavasābhistrivṛtaḥ | caturbhirghṛtatailavasāmajjābhirmahānityarthaḥ ||
snehasātmye kālāvadhimāha -- pibetryahaṃ caturahaṃ pañcāhaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ tathā || 3 || sāptarātrātparaṃ snehaḥ sātmībhavati sevitaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. kutracitsnehaḥ sevitaḥ san tryahātparaṃ sātmyībhavati | kvacit caturahaṃ, pañcāhaṃ, ṣaḍahaṃ ca | saptāhātparamiti saptadinaṃ yāvat | iyam aharādimaryādā koṣṭhasya mṛdumadhyakṛtā jñeyā, paraṃ saptarātrādūrdhvaṃ sevitaḥ sātmībhavati | sātmībhūtasya snehasya guṇāḥ vāgbhaṭe – ’sātmībhūto hi kurute na malānāmudīraṇam’ iti | carake tu - ’snehanasya prakarṣau tu saptarātratrirātrakau ( ca. sū. 13,49) iti | vāgbhaṭe tu - ’tryahamacchaṃ mṛdukoṣṭhe krūre saptadinaṃ pibet’ iti ( vā. sū. 16,29) ihatyavirodhaḥ? maivaṃ - sarveṣāṃ viṣayabhedāt, mṛdu-mṛdutara-madhya-madhyatara-krūra-krūratara-koṣṭhaviṣayāṇi vacanāni jñātavyāni || 3 ||
Gū. pibet ghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ, tailaṃ caturahaṃ, vasā pañcāhaṃ, majjā ṣaḍaham evaṃ krameṇa snehaḥ kadā sātmībhavatītyāha - sneho ghṛtādiḥ sevitaḥ saptarātrātparaṃ sātmībhavati || 3 ||

div.ab: atha snehapānamātrāviṣayamāha - doṣakālāgnivayasāṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayojayet || 4 || hīnāṃ ca madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ snehasya buddhimān |

ab.seg: Dī. mātrālakṣaṇamagre vakṣyamāṇam | doṣāstrividhāścaturvidhā vā teṣāṃ balam utkṛṣṭa-madhyā-lpādibhedena jñeyam | kālāḥ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇāstrividhāḥ eṣāṃ balaṃ hīnamadhyātimātrasvarūpaṃ, bheṣajagrahaṇakālaṃ vā | agnirapi sama-viṣama-manda-tīkṣṇamedena caturvidhaḥ asya balaṃ pācakāpācakarūpam | vayo'pi bāla-madhyottarabhedena trividhaṃ tasyāpi balaṃ svaśaktisāmarthyam | buddhimāniti sadvaidya iti śeṣaḥ | tathāhi - ’yathādoṣaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāvyādhiṃ yathābalaṃ | snehapakvamapakvaṃ vā pākaṃ yuñjyāccikitsakaḥ’ iti | doṣādīnapekṣya snehasya hīnādimātrāṃ prayojayet, hīnatarāmapi prayojayet | uktaṃca - hīnamadhyottamā mātrā tāstābhyaśca hṛsīyasīm | kalpayedvīkṣya doṣādīn prāgeva tu kanīyasīm || ( vā. sū 16|17) ‘ajñātakoṣṭhe hi bahu kuryājjīvitasaṃśayam’ iti || 4 ||
Gū. taṃ doṣādīnāṃ balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭvā buddhimānpaṇḍitaḥ snehasya hīnāṃ madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ prayojayet | yasmindoṣe, yasminkāle, yasminnagnau yasminvayasi yaducitaṃ tat deyam || 4 ||

div.ab: amātrādisevitasya snehasya doṣamāha - amātrayā tathā'kāle mithyāhāravihārataḥ || 5 || snehaḥ karoti śophārśastandrānidrāvisaṃjñatāḥ |

Dī. sneho'mātrayā ( mātrā hrasvādiparimāṇāstābhyo'nyathā ) viṣamapramāṇena | akāle asamaye | tathā mithyā'hāravihārato vā sevitaḥ śophādīn karoti | mithyā'hāro yathā – ‘ akāle cātisātmyaṃ vā asātmyaṃ yacca bhojanam | viṣamāśanaṃ ca yadbhuktaṃ mithyāhāraḥ sa kathyate ’ iti | mithyāvihāro malaparityāgastrīsevādiṣu anyathā viharaṇam | visaṃjñatā mūrcchābhedaḥ | ( asyāgre - prakuryāllaṅghanaṃ tatra svedaṃ jñātvā virecanam || 6 || iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca) || 5 || 6 ||
Gū. amātrayā grahaṇe doṣamāha - amātrayā tathā'kāle tathā mithyā''hārataḥ snehaḥ śophādīn karoti || 5 || 6 ||

ab.seg: idānīṃ snehapānamātrāmāha - deyā dīptāgnaye mātrā snehasya palasaṃmitā | madhyamāya trikarṣā syājjaghanyāya dvikārṣikī || 7 ||

Dī. dīptāgnaye iti pradīptakoṣṭhapuruṣāyetyarthaḥ | jaghanyasaṃjñādoṣaviśeṣeṣu manyante tadapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | mātrā evaṃ madhyamāya trikārṣikī syāt ,jaghanyāya hīnabalānalāya dvikārṣikī | eke prabalamadhyajaghanyasaṃjñā doṣaviṣeṣu manyante tadapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | uktaṃ ca --’uttamasya palaṃ mātrā tribhiścākṣaiśca madhyamā | jaghanyasya palārdhena snehakvāthauṣadheṣu ca’ iti || 7 ||
Gū. dīptāgnyādiṣu kīdṛśī mātrā deyā tāmāha | madhyamāya madhyamāgnaye, jaghanyāya alpāgnaye || 7 ||

div.ab: atha vikalpāntaravihitāṃ mātrāṃ darśayannāha - athavā snehamātrāḥ syustisro'nyāḥ sarvasaṃmatāḥ | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatyahni tu madhyamā || 8 || jīryatyalpā dinārdhena sā vijñeyā sukhāvahā |

ab.seg: Dī. athaveti prakāreṇa kālabhedena ityarthaḥ | anyāḥ palādibhyo'nyāḥ vilakṣaṇāḥ, vailakṣaṇyatvādasaṃmatatvamityata āha - sarvasaṃmatā iti | carakavāgbhaṭādisaṃmatā | uktaṃca carake -‘ahorātramahaḥ kṛtsnamardhāhaṃ ca pratīkṣyate | pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati | iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ ( ca. sū 13, 27 | 28) iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ’ dvābhyāṃ caturbhiraṣṭābhiryāmairjīryanti yāḥ kramāt | hasvamadhyottamā mātrā ’ (vā. sū 16,17) iti | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatīti | nanvahorātragrahaṇaṃ sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādakaraṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ ? ahani dvayornāḍikayoranantaraṃ pītasya snehasya pare'hni ghaṭikādvayānantaraṃ pākaḥ sacāhorātragrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate | ahorātragrahaṇam aṣṭau praharapramāṇakālaparaṃ jñeyam | evaṃ paramacatureṇa vāgbhaṭenāṣṭau praharādipramāṇamevoktaṃ tadvadatrāpyahorātramaṣṭau praharaparaṃ jñeyam | evamuttaratrā'pi vyākhyeyam | seti | sā alpā hrasvā sukhāvahā jñātavyā | sukhakāriṇītyarthaḥ | śīghrapākatvāt || 8 ||

Gū. alpāṃ mātrāmāha - athavā pakṣāntare | anyāstisraḥ snehamātrā āha - mahatī ahorātreṇa pacyate sā palapramāṇā, madhyamā trikarṣā yā sā ahni yāmacatuṣṭayena jīryati, alpā dvikārṣikī dinārdhena yāmadvayena jīryati sā sukhāvahā vijñeyā || 8 ||
alpādīnāṃ guṇānāha - alpā syāddīpanī vṛṣyā svalpadoṣeṣu pūjitā || 9 ||
madhyamā snehanī jñeyā bṛṃhaṇī bhramahāriṇī | jyeṣṭhā kuṣṭhaviṣonmādagrahāpasmāranāśinī || 10 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha tāsāṃ viṣayamāha - alpā mātrā snehasya dīpanī bhavati agnidīptikarītyarthaḥ | vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, svalpadoṣeṣu hīnabaleṣu doṣeṣu vā pūjitā | kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | svalpadoṣe svalparogeṣu vā iti svalpanidānenālpasaṃcite | madhyamā catuḥpraharairyā pākaṃ prāpnoti sā madhyamā | sā snehanī rūkṣāṇāṃ | bṛṃhaṇī sarvadhātūnām | bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthasaṃvittiḥ | vastudarśanam | jyeṣṭheti | jyeṣṭhā uttamā kuṣṭhādihāriṇī bhavati | carake tu hrasvādimātrāṇāṃ viṣayaguṇāścoktā yathā - ’ye tu vṛddhāśca bālāśca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ | riktakoṣṭhatvamahitaṃ yeṣāṃ mandāgnayaśca ye || jvarātīsāra- kāsāśca yeṣāṃ cirasamutthitāḥ | snehamātrāṃ pibeyuste hrasvā ye cāvarā bale || parihāre sukhā caiṣā mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī | vṛṣyā balyā nirābādhā ciraṃ cāpyanuvartate ||’ (ca. sū. 13,36 - 38) atra vṛddhādayaḥ kleśāsahiṣṇutvāt hrasvasnehamātrārhāḥ | sukhocitā iti na kumāraviśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃtu pṛthageva sukhasātmyā abhimatāḥ | riktakoṣṭhatvamahitamiti | vātaprakṛtivikārāṇām ahitaṃ ye cāvarā bale alpabalā ityarthaḥ | parihārasukheti vyāyāmamuccairvacanamityādike parihāre sati sukhamiyamādhatte ato hrasvā'pi mātrā parihāre sati sukhamādadhyāt | tatra madhyamottamayornitarāṃ parihāraḥ kartavyaḥ | ityevaṃ ’yato’ nirdeśa iti kaścit | anyastu vyācaṣṭe - parihāraviṣaye sukheyamakriyamāṇāpi parihāre na doṣāvahetyarthaḥ | ’prabhūtasnehasātmyā ye kṣutpipāsāsahā narāḥ | pāvakaścottamabalo yeṣāṃ ye cottamā bale || gulminaḥ sarpadaṣṭāśca visarpopahatāśca ye | unmattāḥ kṛcchramūtrāśca gāḍhavarcasa eva ca || pibeyuruttamāṃ mātrāṃ tasyāḥ pāne guṇān śṛṇu | vikārān śamayatyeṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā | doṣānukarṣiṇī mātrā sarvamārgānusāriṇī | balyā punarnavakarī śarīrendriyacetasām || ityuttamā | madhyamāmāha -aruṣkasphoṭapiṭikākaṇḍūpāmābhirarditāḥ | kuṣṭhinaśca pramīṭhāśca vātaśoṇitikāśca ye | nātibahvāśinaścaiva mṛdukoṣṭhāstathaiva ca | pibeyurmadhyamāṃ mātrāṃ madhyamāścāpi ye bale || mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśā na cātibaladāyinī | sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate ||’ iti (ca.sū 13|29-35) | arūṃṣyevārūṃṣyā | arūṃṣikā śirorogaviśeṣaḥ | arditāḥ pīḍitāḥ | pramīṭhā atyarthaṃ pramehapīḍitāḥ | tasyā guṇānāha - mātraiṣā mandavibhraṃśeti | mandā alpā vibhraṃśāḥ balahānyādayo yasyāṃ sā | yadā āturādidoṣābhāvāt vibhraṃśo notpadyate tadā sukhena snehayati | śodhanārthe yujyate ityanenaitatkathayati uttamā mātrā śamanāya | tathāca carake -- ’vikārān śamayatyeṣā śīghraṃ samyak prayojitā’ iti | hrasvāt bṛṃhaṇārthā | uktaṃca ’mātrā snehanabṛṃhaṇī’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|38)| asyārthaḥ - snehanabṛṃhaṇakarmakāriṇī iyaṃ bhuvanakāmānāṃ virecanakāmānāṃ ca prayujyate | iti mātrāvivaraṇam || 9 || 10 ||
Gū. sugamam || 9 || 10 ||

ab.seg: atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa snehaviṣayamāha - kevalaṃ paittike sarpirvātike lavaṇānvitam | peyaṃ bahukaphe cāpi vyoṣakṣārasamanvitam || 11 ||

Dī. kevalaṃ prakṣeparahitaṃ paittike vyādhau lavaṇamatra saindhavaṃ, vyādhivihitaṃ cānyadapi lavaṇaṃ grāhyam | bahukaphe kaphaprāye vyādhau vyoṣādiyutaṃ hitaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāraṃ yavakṣārādi || 11 ||

Gū. doṣe anupānaviśeṣamāha - kevalamiti | paittike kevalamanupānena rahitam | vātike lavaṇānvitam | bahukaphe vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, tadyutam | vātaṃ vihāya pittābhidhānaṃ ghṛtasyādau gṛhītatvātpittaśamakatvācca lavaṇādayo māṣamitā deyāḥ || 11 ||
yeṣāṃ sarpirdīyate tānāha - rūkṣakṣataviṣārtānāṃ vātapittavikāriṇām | hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāṃ ca sarpiṣpānaṃ praśasyate || 12 ||

Dī. hitaṃ | rūkṣādibhistribhirārtāḥ rūkṣaṃ rūkṣaguṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rūkṣaguṇo vāyuśca vātaprakṛtīnāmityeke | kṣatam uraḥkṣataṃ, tena ārtaḥ | viṣaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca tena ārtaḥ pīḍitaḥ vātapittavikāriṇāmiti | vātapitte atra pṛthak milite vā | tathā hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāmiti | medhā granthākarṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ, smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇam | anubandhātmikābuddhiriti yāvat | carake tu -- ‘vātapittaprakṛtayo vātapittavikāriṇaḥ | cakṣuḥkāmāḥ kṣatakṣīṇā vṛddhā bālāstathā'balāḥ || āyuḥprakarṣakāmāśca --balavarṇasvarārthinaḥ | puṣṭikāmāḥ prajākāmāḥ saukumāryārthinaśca ye || dīptyojaḥsmṛtimedhā'gnibuddhī- ndriyabalārthinaḥ | pibeyuḥ sarpirārtāśca dāhaśastraviṣāgnibhiḥ ||’ (ca. sū 13|39-41) iti | dīptiḥ prabhā | ojastu hṛdi tiṣṭhati yat śuddham īṣat lolitapītakam | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘tatra dhīsmṛtimedhāgnikāṅkṣiṇāṃ śasyate ghṛtam’ iti (vā.sū. 16|8) | ‘medhā'gnirityatra’ ’medhādikāṅkṣiṇām’ iti samyakpāṭhaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt -- ’śastaṃ dhīsmṛtimedhāgnibalāyuḥśukra-cakṣuṣām | bālavṛddhaprajākāntisaukumāryasvarārthinām || kṣatakṣīṇaparīsarpaśastrāgniglapitātmanām | vātapittaviṣonmādaśoṣālakṣmījvarāpaham || snehānāmuttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param | sahasravīryaṃ vidhibhirghṛtaṃ karmasahasrakṛt’ iti || 12 ||
Gū. sugamam || 12 ||
tailayogyānāha -- kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhāḥ pravṛdhdakaphamedasaḥ | pibeyustailasātmyā ye tailaṃ dārḍhyārthinastu ye || 13||

Dī. tailasya viṣayamāha - kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhādayastailaṃ pibeyuḥ | kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ koṣṭhāntaḥ kṛmayaḥ | analāviddhāḥ vātavyādhibhirvyāptaśarīrāḥ | dārḍhyārthinaḥ dṛḍhaśarīrākāṅkṣiṇaḥ | tailaṃ tilasnehaḥ | carake tu - pravṛddhaśleṣmamedaskāścalasthūlagalodarāḥ| vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ye || balaṃ tanutvaṃ laghutāṃ sthiratāṃ dṛḍhagātratām | snigdhaślakṣṇatanutvaktvaṃ ye ca kāṅkṣanti dehinaḥ || kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāstathā nāḍībhirarditāḥ | pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāśca ye’ iti (ca.sū.13|42-44)| tanutvaṃ-kṛśatvaṃ, laghutā-lāghavaṃ, sthiratā-niścalatā, dārḍhyaṃ-kāṭhinyam iti || 13 ||
Gū. kṛmayaḥ koṣṭhe yeṣāṃ te kṛmikoṣṭhāḥ | anilāviṣṭā vāyuyuktāḥ pravṛddhakaphamedaso dīptāgnayaḥ ye tailasātmyāste tailaṃ pibeyuḥ || 13 ||
vasāyogyānāha - vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ śuṣkaretoraktā mahārujaḥ | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā vasāyogyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14||

Dī. atha vasāviṣayamāha - vyāyāmeti | evaṃvidhā narāḥ puruṣāḥ vasāyogyāḥ | vyāyāmena durbalaśarīrāḥ, śuṣkaṃ retaḥ śukraṃ, raktaṃ rudhiraṃ ca yeṣāṃ te tathā | ata eva carake - ’saṃśuṣkaretorudhirā (ca. sū.13|45) ityuktam | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā iti mahāgnistīkṣṇāgnirbhasmako vā | mahāmārutaḥ balavān mārutaḥ | sa cānyo'nyasaṃcāralakṣaṇairjñeyaḥ | uktaṃca carake -- ’balavān māruto yeṣāṃ khāni cāvṛtya tiṣṭhati’ iti (ca. sū 13|46) | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘vātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti | mahāprāṇā mahābalāḥ | uktaṃca carake - mahaccāgnibalaṃ yeṣām iti (ca. sū. 13|47) | athavā prāṇo vāyuḥ | suśrute ca - ’agniḥ somo vāyuḥ sattvarajastamaḥ pañcendriyāṇi bhūtātmeti prāṇāḥ’ | kleśakṣamatvaṃ ca mahābalena | ata evoktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -- ‘rūkṣakleśakṣamātyagnivātāvṛtapatheṣu ca’ iti ( vā. sū.16|10) || 14 ||

Gū. evaṃbhūtā narā vasāyogyā bhavanti iti yojyaṃ | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ, vyāyāmo mallādiyuddhadhanurākarṣaṇādiḥ, tatkarṣitāḥ | kṣīṇāḥ, śuṣkaṃ kṣīṇaṃ reto vīryaṃ raktaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te śuṣkaretoraktāḥ | punaḥ mahārujaḥ vyathāvantaḥ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtāḥ ? mahānagnirmāruto vāyuḥ prāṇāḥ balaṃ ca yeṣāṃ te mahāgnimārutaprāṇāḥ || 14 ||
majjāyogyānāha -- krūrāśayāḥ kleśasahā vātārtā dīptavahnayaḥ | majjānaṃ ca pibeyuste sarpirvā sarvato hitam || 15 ||

Dī. majjāviṣayamāha -- krūreti | krūrāśayāḥ krūrakoṣṭhāḥ, kleśasahāḥ ghasmarāḥ, vātārtāḥ vātarogiṇaḥ, dīptavahnayastīkṣṇāgnayaḥ | majjāyā alābhe sarpiḥprayogamāha - sarpirvā sarvato hitamiti | sarvataḥ sarvasnehaviṣaye sarvavyādhau ca, sarpirghṛtaṃ hitaṃ pathyam | etacca majjālābhe jñeyam || 15 ||
Gū. krūrāśayādinarā majjānaṃ pibeyuḥ | krūra āśayaḥ koṣṭho yeṣāṃ te krūrāśayāḥ | punaḥ kleśasahāḥ duḥkhasahāḥ | punaḥ vātārtāḥ | punaḥ dīptavahnayaḥ ||15||

div.ab: snehapānakālaḥ | śītakāle divā snehamuṣṇakāle pibenniśi | vātapittādhike rātrau vātaśleṣmādhike divā ||1 6||

ab.seg: Dī. ātyayike vyādhau snehasya kālamāha -- śīteti | vātapittādhike iti | atra vātasya yogavāhitvāt pittādhikaśca gṛhyate | evaṃ vātaśleṣmādhika ityatrāpi vyākhyeyam | pittaśleṣmādhikastu nokto'pyatra sādhāraṇaḥ śīta eva kāle pibediti draṣṭavyam | rātrāviti sāyam || 16 ||
Gū. śītakālādau snehaḥ kadā peya ityāha -- śītakāle iti | sugamam || 16 ||
atha tailaghṛtayorviśiṣṭakarma darśayannāha — nasyābhyañjanagaṇḍūṣamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇaiḥ | tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yuñjīta dṛṣṭvā doṣabalābalam || 17 ||

Dī. doṣaśabdo'tra śarīradūṣaṇāddoṣāḥ vātādayaḥ, dhātavo rasādyāḥ,, malāśca grāhyāḥ | teṣāṃ balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samyagvicārya tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yatra tailasātmyaṃ doṣabalaṃ tatra tailameva yujyāt | yatra ghṛtasātmyaṃ tatra ghṛtameveti tattatsātmyānāṃ tattadyuñjīta || 17 ||

Gū. nasyādau ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā yojyaṃ tadāha -- nasyeti | nasā peyaṃ nasyam, abhyañjanaṃ mardanaṃ, gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaḥ, mūrdhā mastakaṃ, karṇaṃ śrotram, akṣi netram | tattarpaṇe āpyāyane ghṛtaṃ vā tailaṃ vā yojyam || 17 ||
idānīṃ snehānāmanupānānyāha - ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ taile yūṣaḥ praśasyate | vasāmajjñoḥ pibenmaṇḍamanupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 18 ||

Dī. ghṛte iti | anu paścāt niyataṃ pānam anupānaṃ ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣamanupānam | vasāmajjñoḥ maṇḍamanupānam | kecinmaṇḍaśabdenātra strotoviśodhanatvāt dadhimaṇḍamāhuḥ, tanna - yato bhaktamaṇḍo'pi mṛdūkaroti srotāṃsi | uktaṃca - ‘maṇḍo vātānulomanaḥ, tṛḍglānimedodoṣaghnaḥ, pācano, dhātusāmyakṛt’ iti | sukhāvahamiti | sukham āvahati karoti tatsukhāvaham, samyak pākādikaraṇāt | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘anupānaṃ karotyūrjāṃ tṛptiṃ vyāptiṃ dṛḍhāṅgatām | annasaṃghātaśaithilyavikḷptijaraṇāni ca’ iti | anyacca - ’jīrṇājīrṇaviśaṅkāyāṃ punaruṣṇodakaṃ pibet | tenodgāre viśuddhiḥ syāttataśca laghutā ruciḥ ||’ ( vā. sū.16|23) iti | etaduṣṇodakaṃ sāmānyena sarvasnehe'pi hitam | uktaṃca - ’uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ca snehānāmatha śasyate | ṛte bhallātakasnehāttatra toyaṃ tu śītalam’ iti || 18 ||
Gū. ghṛtapānādau anupānamāha - ghṛte iti | ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyam | taile yūṣaḥ | vasāmajjādiṣu maṇḍaṃ bhaktādibhūtaṃ tadanupānaṃ, anupāne sukhāvaham || 18 ||
sānnasnehasya viṣayamāha - snehadviṣaḥ śiśūnvṛddhānsukumārān kṛśānapi | udyākāmānuṣṇakāle saha bhaktena pāyayet || 19 ||

Dī. sānnasnehasya viṣayamāha - sneheti | snehadviṣaḥ snehārucayaḥ ‘uṣṇakāmān’ ityatra ‘tṛṣṇālukān’ iti paṭhanti kecit | sahabhakteneti | bhaktamodanaḥ cakāro'tra luptodayaḥ tena carakoktāścaturviṃśatisnehavicāraṇā grāhyāḥ, tā yathā - ‘odanaśca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi | yavāgūḥ sūpaśāke ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaṃ khaḍaḥ || śaktavastilapiṣṭaṃ ca madyaṃ lehāstathaiva ca | bhakṣyamabhyañjanaṃ bastistathaivottarabastayaḥ || gaṇḍūṣaḥ karṇatailaṃ ca nasyaṃ mūrdhākṣitarpaṇam | caturviṃśatirityetāḥ snehasya pravicāraṇāḥ ||’ iti (ca. sū. 13|21-23) vāgbhaṭoktāścatuḥṣaṣṭivicāraṇāścātraiva grāhyāḥ, tā yathā - ‘rasabhedaikakatvābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭirvicāraṇā’ iti | (vā. sū. 16| 15) nanu - ’acchapeyastu yaḥ sneho na tāmāhurvicāraṇām (ca. sū. 13|24) iti carakavacanātkathaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidhā iti virodhaḥ ? maivaṃ nādyaḥ, peyo vicāraṇā ityasyāyamarthaḥ - acchapeyasnehaḥ sā na vicāraṇā, sātmyartuvyādhyādiṣu vicāraṇāstyeva | uktaṃca carake - ’rasaiścopahitaḥ snehaḥ samāsavyāsayogibhiḥ | ṣaḍbhistriṣaṣṭidhā saṃkhyā prāpnotyekaśca kevalaḥ || evametāścatuḥṣaṣṭisnehānāṃ pravicāraṇāḥ | sātmyartuvyādhipuruṣānprayojyā jānatā bhavet ’ iti | ( ca. sū.13|23-26) puruṣagrahaṇena deśasātmyamavaruddhaṃ, yato deśamapekṣya puruṣasya tatsātmyaṃ, tathā puruṣagrahaṇena prakṛtibalavayaḥśarīraprabhṛtayo'varuddhvā iti || 19 ||

Gū. yeṣāṃ snehaṃ pāyayettānāha - sneha iti | uṣṇakāle grīṣmādau etān bhaktena saha snehaṃ pāyayet | snehaṃ dviṣantīti snehadviṣaḥ tān atiprītau śiśūn , bālān , vṛddhān , sukumārān , kṛśādīn , tṛṣṇāturāṃścāpi| || 19 ||
idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanamāha - sarpiṣmatī bahutilā yavāgūḥ svalpataṇḍulā | sukhoṣṇā sevyamānā tu sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī ||20||
śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe dohanasthe ghṛte tu gām | dugdhvā kṣīraṃ ṣibeduṣṇaṃ sadyaḥ snehanamucyate || 21 ||

div.ab: Dī. rūkṣāṇāṃ sadyaḥ snehanayogadvayamāha - sarpiṣmatīti | sarpiṣmatī bahughṛtā | sadya iti tasminneva divase tvarayā snehanaṃ karoti | sadyograhaṇaṃ stutiparamityanye tryaheṇa snehayatītyarthaḥ | ata evoktaṃ sevyamāneneti | aparamapi - śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe iti | dohanasthe dohanabhāṇḍe sthite ghṛte | kiṃbhūte ? śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe śarkarāmiśrite | tadbhāṇḍe gāṃ dugdhvā rūkṣaḥ puruṣaḥ taddugdhaṃ sadyaḥ svalpakālena snehamucyate iti || 20 || 21 ||

Gū. idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanamāha - sarpiṣmatīti | evaṃbhūtā yavāgūḥ sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī bhavati | kiṃbhūtā ? sarpiṣmatī, punaḥ bahutilā svalpataṇḍulā, punaḥ sukhoṣṇā | kṣīramapi sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati | tadāha śarkarācūrṇasaṃbhṛṣṭe bharjite dohanasthe gāṃ dugdhvā kṣīramuṣṇaṃ pibet sadyaḥ snehanaṃ bhavati || 20 || 21 ||

ab.seg: atha snehājīrṇe cikitsāmāha — mithyācārādbahutvādvā yasya sneho na jīryati | viṣṭabhya vāpi jīryeta vāriṇoṣṇena vāmayet ||22||

Dī. atha snehājīrṇe cikitsāmāha — mithyeti | mithyācaraṇāduṣṇodakādīnām | amithyācārastu vāgbhaṭenoktaḥ -’uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhavyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān|| pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥ svapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca || yānyahāni pibettāni tāvantyanyānyapi tyajet | iti | (vā. sū. 16|25-27) bahutvātsamānādhikyādvā | athavā viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā jīryati tamapi vāmayedityarthaḥ | asyāgre kecitpaṭhanti - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punardadyāt laghukoṣṭhāya dehinaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭho bahuṣu pustakeṣu na dṛśyate vaidyasaṃpradāye tu - ’tataḥ snehaṃ punardadyāt’ iti dināntare jātabale deyamiti || 22 ||

Gū. mithyācārāderyasya sneho na jīryati tatpratīkāramāha - mithyeti | mithyācārānmithyācaraṇāt, bahutvātsnehādhikyādvā yasya sneho na jīryati viṣṭabhya viṣṭambhaṃ kṛtvā vā jīryati tam uṣṇavāriṇā vāmayet || 22 ||
snehājīrṇe anyadapi pratīkāramāha -- srehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāṃ pibeduṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | tenodgāre bhavecchuddho bhaktaṃ prati rucistathā || 23 ||

Dī. sneheti | ‘snehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāmapi uṣṇodakaṃ pibet kimuta jīrṇe ityanena sarvāsvapyavasthāsu uṣṇodakamanupāne praśastamityabhiprāyaḥ | phalamāha - teneti | tena uṣṇodakena udgāraśuddhiḥ ruciśca bhaktaṃprati jāyate, bhojane rucirjāyate ityapi | tantrāntare tu - ’syuḥ pacyamāne tṛṭdāhabhramasādāruciklamāḥ | pariṣicyādbhiruṣṇābhirjīrṇe snehe tato naram ’ iti || 23 ||
Gū. sneheti | sugamam || 23 ||

div.ab: snehopadravabhūtāyāstṛṣṇāyāścikitsāmāha - snehena paittikasyāgniryadā tīkṣṇatarīkṛtaḥ | tadāsyodīrayettṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ tasya vāmayet || 24 || śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayecca pipāsā tena śāmyati |

ab.seg: Dī. sneheneti | paittikasya pittaprakṛteḥ puruṣasya tīkṣṇatarīkṛta iti atyarthaṃ tīkṣṇatvaṃ prāptaḥ | tadā tasmin kāle asya puruṣasya tṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ kaṭhinām udīrayet utpādayet tadā vāmayet uṣṇāmbu pītvā snehamiti śeṣaḥ | uktaṃca - ’snehapītasya cettṛṣṇā pibeduṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | evaṃ cānupaśāmyantyāṃ snehamuṣṇāmbunā vamet (suśru. ci. 31/24) iti | uddharet vāmayedityarthaḥ | ’ ca ’ śabdaḥ prakārāntare | śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayet tena hetunā pipāsā śāmyati || 24 ||
Gū. snehe pittaprakopāt pratīkāramāha - sreheneti | paittikasya pittapradhānapuṃsaḥ || 24 ||

div.ab: atha snehā'yogyānāha - ajīrṇī varjayetsnehamudarī taruṇajvarī || 25 || durbalo'rocakī sthūlo mūrcchārto madapīḍitaḥ | dattabastirviraktaśca vāntastṛṣṇāśramānvitaḥ || 26 || akālaprasravā nārī durdine ca vivarjayet |

Dī. ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī snehaṃ varjayet na pibet | tathā jīrṇajvarī āmajvarī | durbalo balahīnaḥ | arocakī arocakārtaḥ | sthūlo meduraḥ | madapīḍitaḥ madātyayī | dattabastiḥ yasya bastikarma kṛtam | viriktaḥ kṛtavirekaḥ kṛtavāntiśca | tṛṣṇāyuktaḥ śramayuktaśca | akālaprasavā nārīti | garbhapātasrāvābhyāṃ yuktā strī | ṣoḍaśavarṣādarvāgapi prasavo'kālaprasava ityeke | durdinaṃ meghacchanne'hni durdinam | cakārādvāgbhaṭoktāḥ - ‘snehyā natvatimandāgnitīkṣṇāgnisthūladurbalāḥ | ūrustambhātisārāmagalarogagarodaraiḥ || mūrcchāchardyaruciśleṣmatṛṣṇāmadyaiśca pīḍitāḥ | apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane’ iti ( vā. sū. 16|6, 7) || 25 || 26 ||

ab.seg: Gū. yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tānāha - ajīrṇīti | ajīrṇī ajīrṇavān snehaṃ varjayet, tathā udarī udararogavān taruṇajvarī arocakarogayuktaḥ | durdinaṃ ’meghacchanne'hni durdinam |’ spaṣṭamanyat || 25 ||
yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ praśastaṃ tānāha - svedyasaṃśodhyamadyastrīvyāyāmāsaktamānasāḥ || 27 ||
vṛddhā bālāḥ kṛśā rūkṣāḥ kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaretasaḥ | vātārtāstimirārtā ye teṣāṃ snehanamuttamam || 28 ||

div.ab: Dī. snehyānāha - svedyeti | svedyādīnāṃ snehanam uttamam | ete snehārhāḥ, svedyāḥ svedārhāḥ, saṃśodhyā vamanavirecanārhāḥ | madyādiṣu āsaktaṃ mānasaṃ cittaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā | tathā kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ, kṣīṇaretasaḥ kṣīṇaśukrāḥ, vātārtā iti vātenārtāḥ pīḍitāḥ, timirārtāḥ taimirikāḥ iti || 27 || 28 ||

Gū. svedyeti | evaṃbhūtā ye teṣāṃ snehapānam uttamam | kiṃbhūtāḥ ? svedyāḥ svedanārhāḥ, śodhyā vamanādiśodhanocitāḥ | madyastrīvyāyāmasaktāḥ anuraktāḥ cintakāstu cintanaparāśca | kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaraktāḥ kṣīṇavīryāḥ || 27 || 28 ||
samyak snigdhasya lakṣaṇamāha - vātānulomyaṃ dīpto'gnirvarcaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam | mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā glāniḥ snehodvego'tha lāghavam ||29|| vimalendriyatā samyak snigdhe

ab.seg: Dī. vātānulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya anulomatā, agnirjaṭharāgnirdīptaḥ | varcaḥ purīṣaṃ snigdhaṃ cikkaṇam asaṃhataṃ śithilaṃ mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā ca bhavati | glānirojaḥkṣayaḥ snehodvegaḥ snehapāne dveṣaḥ, lāghavaṃ śarīralaghutā | vimalendriyateti - cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ vimalatvaṃ svasvaviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam | etairlakṣaṇaiḥ samyaksnigdho jñeyaḥ || 29 ||

Gū. snehe pīte samyaksnigdhalakṣaṇamāha - vātānulomyamiti | samyaksnigdhe vātānulomyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | vātānulomyaṃ vātasya samyakpravṛttiḥ, agnirdīptaḥ, varcaḥ purīṣaṃ, snigdhaḥ sacikkaṇam, asaṃhatam amilitam | mṛdvaṅgatā komalāṅgatā, snigdhāṅgatā sacikkaṇāṅgatā, aglāniḥ aklamaḥ, snehāvegaḥ snehopadravābhāvaḥ | lāghavaṃ dehasya, vimalendriyatā nirmalendriyatā || 29 ||

div.ab: rūkṣe lakṣaṇamāha – ---- rūkṣe viparyayaḥ |

Dī. rūkṣe viparyayaśca bhavati | sa cāsnigdhalakṣaṇasya | uktaṃca carake - ’purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ rūkṣaṃ vāyurapraguṇo mṛduḥ | paktā kharatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ ca gātrasyāsnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|55) vāyuratra guṇaḥ mṛduḥ paktā agnimāndyam | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ’rūkṣaṃ purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ pakvānnaṃ na vipacyate | uro vidahyate vāyuḥ koṣṭhādupari dhāvati || nirbalo durbalaścāpi rūkṣo bhavati mānavaḥ’ iti ||
Gū. rūkṣe tu etadviparyayaḥ ||
atisnigdhalakṣaṇamāha -- bhaktadveṣo mukhasrāvo gude dāhaḥ pravāhikā ||30|| tandrātīsārapāṇḍutvaṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya lakṣaṇam |

ab.seg: Dī. bhaktadveṣa iti | bhṛśasnigdhasyātisnigdhasya bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇam | tatra bhaktadveṣo bhojanānākāṅkṣā | mukhasrāvaḥ hṛllāsaḥ, gude dāhaḥ | ’gude pākaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ | tandrā prāg vyākhyātā | atīsaraṇamatīsāraḥ | pāṇḍutvaṃ śarīrasya | carake tu - pāṇḍutā gauravaṃ jāḍyaṃ purīṣasyāvipakvatā | atyutkleśo'rucistandrī syādatisnigdhalakṣaṇam’ iti | (ca. sū. 13|57) sadanaṃ aṅgānāṃ jāḍyaṃ jaḍībhāvaḥ kāyasya, purīṣasyāvipākatā'samatā, atyutkleśo hṛllāsaḥ, nidrārtasya viṣayāgrahaṇaṃ tandrīti || 30 ||

Gū. atisnigdhapāne lakṣaṇamāha - bhakteti | bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya atisnehapītasya, idaṃ bhaktadveṣādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojyam | bhakte dveṣaḥ bhaktāruciḥ, mukhasrāvaḥ mukhasyāsamantāt srāvaḥ lālāsravaṇaṃ, gude dāhaḥ | pravāhikā atīsārabhedaḥ, tandrā īṣanmudritanetratvam, atīsaraṇaṃ, pāṇḍutvaṃ pītavarṇatā || 30 ||
athahīnātisnigdhasyopakramamāha - rūkṣasya snehanaṃ snehairatisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇam || 31 ||
Dī. athahīnātisnigdhasyopakramamāha - rūkṣasyeti | rūkṣasya puruṣasya snehaiḥ sadyaḥsnehanakāribhistailaghṛtādibhiḥ snehanaṃ kāryaṃ, atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam || 31 ||
Gū. rūkṣasya snigdharūkṣaṇamiti | pratīkāramāha - rūkṣasya snehanaiḥ snehanam | atisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇai rūkṣaṇam || 31 ||

div.ab: rūkṣayogamāha - śyāmākacaṇakādyaiśca takrapiṇyākasaktubhiḥ |

Dī. rūkṣayogamāha - śyāmāketi | śyāmākādibhī rūkṣaṇaṃ kāryam | ādigrahaṇāt vāgbhaṭoktaṃ sarvaṃ grāhyam | yathā – ‘kṣuttṛṣṇollekhanasvedarūkṣapānānnabheṣajam | takrāriṣṭakhaloddālayavaśyāmākakodravam || pippalī triphalā kṣaudraṃ pathyā gomūtragugguluḥ | yathāsvaṃ pratirogaṃ ca snehavyāpadi sādhanam’ iti || kecit ’śyāmākacaṇakādyaiḥ’ ityatra ‘śyāmākakoradūṣānnaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti | piṇyākaṃ niḥsnehatilakalkam ||
Gū. kaiḥ ? takrapiṇyākādyaiḥ snehanam | śyāmākacaṇakādyai rūkṣai rūkṣaṇam | śyāmākaḥ dhānyaviśeṣaḥ | (sāva) piṇyākastilakalkaḥ ||
atha snehasevino lakṣaṇamāha - dīptāgniḥ śuddhakoṣṭhaśca puṣṭadhāturdṛḍhendriyaḥ || 32 || nirjaro balavarṇāḍhyaḥ snehasevī bhavennaraḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha snehasevino lakṣaṇamāha - dīpteti | snehasevī naraḥ dīptāgniḥ syāt | agniratra jaṭharāgniḥ | śuddhakoṣṭha iti madhyakoṣṭhakrūrakoṣṭhādirahitaḥ | puṣṭadhātuḥ rasādipuṣṭadhātuḥ | dṛḍhendriyaḥ cakṣurādīndriyabalayuktaḥ’ | nirjaraḥ, balavarṇāḍhyaḥ, varṇāḍhyaśca, surūpaśca | vāgbhaṭe tu – ’dīptāntarāgniḥ pariśuddhakoṣṭhaḥ pratyagradhāturbalavarṇayuktaḥ | dṛḍhendriyo mandajaraḥ śatāyuḥ snehopasevī puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ iti (vā. sū. 16|46) || 32 ||
Gū. snehasevī yādṛśo bhavati tādṛśamāha - dīpteti | nirjaraḥ jarārahitaḥ | balavarṇayuktaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 32 ||
snehasevāyāṃ varjyānyāha - snehe vyāyāmasaṃśītavegāghātaprajāgarān || 33 ||

divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

Dī. snehasevāyāṃ varjyānyāha - snehe snehapāne | vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajananakarma | saṃśītamiti atyarthaśītavātādikaṃ | vegāghātamiti vegānāṃ mūtrapurīṣotsargecchānām āghātam avarodhaṃ vegadhāraṇamityarthaḥ | prajāgaramiti rātrijāgaraṇam | abhiṣyandi śleṣmaprakopi dadhyādikamityarthaḥ | rūkṣānnamiti śyāmākacaṇakādikam | etacca sāmānyasnehapānaviṣaye yatra ca atisnigdhatā bhavati tatra rūkṣānnaṃ vihitameva | tatpūrvameva || 33 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehapānādhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ || 1 ||

Gū. snehapāne yanniṣiddhaṃ tadāha - snehe iti | snehe snehapāne, vyāyāmādīn vivarjayet | saṃśītam atiśītalaṃ, vegāghātaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣādirodham | divāsvapnamabhiṣyandivirodhi | rūkṣāścāṇakādi | spaṣṭamanyat || 33 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi snehapānaṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

div.head: atha svedavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Dī. atha snehādhyāyānantaraṃ svedavidhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte -
atha svedavidhiḥ

Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | snehavidhikathanānantaraṃ svedavidhiḥ | svedasya vidhirvidhānam | uktaṃca prāk - ’ snehasvedāvanabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ | dāruśuṣkamivānāme śarīraṃ tasya dīryate’ iti | carake'pri snehapūrvaprayuktena svedamāvarjite'nile | purīṣamūtraretāṃsi na sajjanti kadācana’ iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - śuṣkānyapi hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ | śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvatām’ iti | tena yuktaṃ snehānantaraṃ svedā'bhidhānam |
Gū. snehapānānantaraṃ svedasya vihitatvāt ||

ab.seg: tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ svedasaṃkhyāmāha - svedaścaturvidhaḥ proktastāpoṣmasvedasaṃjñakau | upanāho dravaḥ svedaḥ sarve vātārtihāriṇaḥ || 1 ||
svedau tāpoṣmajau prāyaḥ śleṣmaghnau samudīritau | upanāhastu vātaghnaḥ pittasaṅge dravo hitaḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: Dī. sveda iti | svidyate'neneti vyutpattyā svedo'gniḥ, tasya vidhiḥ karmacāturī | caturvidhatvamāha - ekastāpasaṃjñaḥ svedaḥ| dvitīyastūṣmāsaṃjñaḥ| tṛtīya upanāhaḥ upanāho nibandhanamiti pralepena | asya bhedaḥ sālvaṇa iti | caturtho dravasveda iti | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ anyatrāpyuktaṃ ca ’kṣāmaḥsaikatapārṣṇikāsyavasanaiḥ svedo'thavāṃgārakairlepairvātaharaiḥ sahāmlalavaṇaiḥ snehaiḥ sukhomlairbhavet | evaṃ taptapayombuvātaśamanakvāthādisekādibhistaptaistoyaniṣecanāhatamahābāṣpaiḥ sitādyaiḥ kramā’diti | eṣveva caturṣu yathākramaṃ carakoktasaṃkarasvedādyavarodhaḥ | śaṃkarādisvedā yathā ’śaṃkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko'vagāhanaṃ | jetākoṣmaghanaḥ karṣaḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhireva ca | kūpo dolaka ityete svedayanti trayodaśa itiśaṃkaraḥ sukhakaraḥ | tasyābhidhānamagre praśastatvāt | eteṣāṃ svedānāṃ vaidyānāṃ vijñānārthaṃ svarūpamuktaṃ carake - ‘ tatra vastrāntaritaiḥ piṇḍairyathoktairupasvedanaṃ śaṅkarasveda’ iti | tasyoṣmasvede'ntarbhāvaḥ | vastrāntaritatvamavastrāntaritatvañca sukumārāsukumāraviṣayaṃ jñeyam | prastaramāha - ‘ śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāṃ , veśavāra-pāyasa-kṛśaro-tkarikādīnāṃ vā prastare kauśeyā-'vikottarapracchade vā, pañcāṅgulorubukādīnāṃ vā , kauśeyāvikottarārkapatrapracchanne vā svabhyaktagātrasya śayānasyopasvedanaṃ prastarasvedanaṃ iti vidyāt ’ | ayaṃ coṣmasveda eva | śūka-śimbi-dhānya-pulākānāmiti bhāvaḥ | anyatrāpyuktaṃ - ‘ pulākamatrametāvaddravyāṇāmiha ṣaṭśatam | svabuddhyaiva sahasrāṇi koṭīrvā samprakalpayet’ iti | athavā ‘pulāka’ śabdaḥ svinnavacanaḥ , śūkaśimbidhānyānāṃ svinnānāṃ prastare ityarthaḥ | anye tu pulākā gavedhukākārā deśāntare prasiddhāḥ | iti vyākhyānayanti | tadayuktaṃ śūkaśimbidhānyeṣvevāntarbhāvāt | tāsāṃ ca na svedavattāyogyatā pratipattuṃ śakyā , doṣaviśeṣāharaṇāt | kauśeyāvikottarapracchannadeśe-kauśeyāvikābhyāṃ vā upari pracchanne prastare ityarthaḥ | uttaracchadagrahaṇādadhastādapi pracchado'stīti gamyate | iti prastarasvedaḥ ||2|| nāḍīsvedamāha - ‘ svedanadravyāṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ mūlapatraphalabhaṅgādīnāṃ mṛgaśakunipiśitaśirasādīnām uṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ yathā'mlalavaṇaṃ snehopahitānāṃ mūtrādīnāṃ kumbhyāṃ voṣmamanu dhamantyāmutkvathitānāṃ nāḍyā vaṃśadalakarañjārkapatrāṇāmanyatamakṛtayā gajāgrahastasaṃsthānayā vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā vā svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgrapariṇāhasrotasā sarvato vātaharapatrasaṃvṛtacchidrayā dvistrirvā vinamitayā vātaharasnehābhyaktagātrasya voṣmamupāharet , bāṣpo'hyanṛjugāmī vihitacaṇḍavegastvacamavidahan sukhaṃ svedayatīti nāḍīsvedaḥ ’ | bhaṅgāḥ pallavāḥ | svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgamūlāgra-pariṇāhasrotaseti | vyāyāmadīrghayā vyāyāmārdhadīrghayā ceti | pramāṇaniyame ko hetuḥ ? brūmaḥ – vyādhyāturabalāpekṣayā , uttamabalavyādhāvāture ca vyāyāmadīrghā karttavyā , madhyabalaṃ hi vyādhimāturaṃ cāvekṣyamāṇena vyāyāmādhyardhadīrghayā dūragatvena vihitacaṇḍavegatā bhāvayet iti | iti nāḍīsvedaḥ bāṣpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ ||3|| pariṣekasvedamāha - ‘ vātikottaravātikānāṃ punarmūlaphalādīnāmutkvāthaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ kumbhīrvarṣaṇikāḥ praṇāḍīrvā pūrayitvā yathārthasiddhasnehābhyaktagātravastrāvacchannaṃ pariṣecayet iti pariṣekasvedaḥ’ dravasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | iti pariṣekasvedaḥ ||4|| avagāhasvedamāha - ‘ vātaharotkvāthakṣīraghṛtapiśitarasonasalilakoṣṭakāvagāhastu yathokta evāvagāho jñeyaḥ’ | utkvāthairiti utkṛṣṭakvāthairityarthaḥ | dravyāccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaḥ kṛta utkṛṣṭaḥ kvātho bhavati ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ | ityavagāhasvedaḥ | jetākasvedamāha – atha jetākaṃ cikīrṣurbhūmiṃ parīkṣyeta – tatra pūrvasyāṃ diśi uttarasyāṃ vā guṇavati praśastabhūmibhāge deśe kṛṣmamṛttike suvarṇavarṇamṛttike vā nadīparivāpaḥ vāpīpuṣkariṇyādīnāṃ jalāśayānāmanyatamasya kūle dakṣiṇe paścime vā sutīrthe samavibhaktabhūmibhāgadeśe saptāṣṭau vā'ratnīḥ parikramodakān prāṅmukhodaṅmukhaṃ vā'bhimukhatīrthaṃ vā kūṭāgāraṃ kārayet | utsedhavistārasampannaṃ anekavātāyanamasya kūṭāgārasyāntaḥ samantato'bhivistārotsedhāṃ piḍikāṃ kārayet ākapāṭāt | madhye cāsya kūṭāgārasya catuḥkiṣkumātraṃ dvipuruṣapramāṇaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ kandukasaṃsthānaṃ bahusūkṣmacchidramaṅgārakoṣṭakastambhaṃ sapidhānaṃ kārayet | taṃ ca khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | sa yadā jānīyāt dagdhāni kāṣṭhāni vigatadhūmāni avataptaṃ kevalamagninā tadagnigṛhaṃ svedayogyena yoṣmaṇā yuktamiti | tatra cainaṃ vātaharābhyaṅgābhyaktagātraṃ vastrācchannaṃ praveśayet | praveśayaṃścānuśiṣyet - ‘ saumya ! praviśārogyakalyāṇāya vā ’ iti praviśya caināṃ piṇḍikāmadhiruhya pārśvābhyāṃ yathāsukhaṃ śayīthāḥ | na ca te svedamūrchāparītenā'pi satā piṇḍikaiṣā prayoktavyā āprāṇocchvāsāt | bhraśyamāno hi yataḥ piṇḍikāvaśāt dvāramavadhiṃ gacchan svedamūrchāparītatayā sadyaḥ prāṇān jahyāt , tasmāt piṇḍikāṃ na kathañcana muñcethāḥ | sa yadā jānīyādvigatābhiṣyandamātmānaṃ samyak prastutasvedapicchaṃ sarvasrotovinirmuktaṃ laghubhūtamapagataṃ vibandhastambhagauravasuptivedanamiti | tatastāṃ piṭikāmanusaran dvāraṃ prapadyeta niṣkramya ca na sahasā cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthaṃ śītodakamanupraviśet | vyapagatasaṃtāpaklamaḥ sumuhūrtāt sukhoṣṇena vāriṇā yathānyāyaṃ pariṣikto'śnīyāt ’ iti jetākaḥ | ayaṃ cāgārakoṣṭastambho jetāka ucyate ‘bhūgṛheṣu sa jetākeṣu ’ iti vacanāt | taṃ khādirāṇāmāśvakarṇikānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet | iti jetākasvedaḥ sa ūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti jetākasvedaḥ ||6|| athāśmaghanasvedamāha - ‘ śayanasya pramāṇenā'śmamayīṃ śilāṃ tāpayitvā'nilaghnaistu dārubhiḥ sampradīpitaiḥ vyapohya sarvānaṅgārān prokṣya coṣṇavāriṇā śilāmatha kurvīta kauśeyā'vikasaṃstarām , kauśeyaprāvārādyaiḥ susaṃvṛttaḥ ityukto'śmaghanasvedaḥ ’ iti || ghanāṃ sthūlāṃ | nanu śilā yā sā'śmamayyeva punaraśmamayīmiti viśeṣaṇamanarthakam ? ucyate – sannahyārthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitāni tenāśmaśabdaḥ kāṭhinye vartate iti | kaucavo mṛgaromamayīralikā, ajinaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgacarma, kauśeyaṃ traśaraṃ prāvāraḥ paṭṭikā ādigrahaṇātkambalorṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam | iti aśmaghanasvedaḥ, tāpasvede'ntarbhūtaḥ | ityaśmaghanasvedaḥ ||7|| atha karpūsvedaḥ pracakṣyate - ‘ khānayecchayanasyādhaḥ karpūsthānavibhāgavit | dīptairvidhūmairaṅgāraistāṃ karpūṃ pūrayennaraḥ | tatropariṣṭācchayane svapan svidyati nā sukham ’ iti karpūsveda ūṣmasvedabhedaḥ | iti karpūsvedaḥ ||8|| atha kuṭīsvedamāha - ‘ anatyutsedhavistarāṃ vṛttākārāmalocanām | ghanamitiṃ kuṭiṃ kṛtvā kuṣṭhādyaiḥ sampralepayet | kuṭīmadhye bhiṣak śayyāṃ svāstīrṇāṃ copakalpayet | prāvārājinakauśeyakuthakambalagauṇakaiḥ | hasantikābhiraṅgārapūrṇābhistāṃ ca sarvataḥ | āroheta parīvāryābhyaktaḥ svidyati nā sukham ’ iti || parivārya pariveṣṭya | iti kuṭīsvede svedabhedaḥ | iti kuṭīsvedaḥ ||9|| bhūsvedamāha - ‘ya evāśmaghanasvede vidhirbhūmau sa eva tu | praśastāyāṃ nivātāyāṃ samāyāmupadiśyate’ iti | ayamapyuṣṇasvedabhedaḥ | iti bhūsvedaḥ ||10|| atha kumbhīsvedamāha – kumbhīṃ vātaharakvāthapūrṇāṃ bhūmau nikhānayet | ardhamātraṃ tribhāgaṃ vā śayanaṃ tatra copari || sthāpayedāsanaṃ vā'pi nātisāndraparicchadam | atha kuṃbhyāṃ bhiṣak dadyātsutaptānāyaso guḍān || pāṣāṇān voṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati nā sukham | suvṛttāṅgaḥ svabhyaktaḥ snehairanilanāśanaiḥ || athavāpyūṣmaṇā tena tatsthaḥ svidyati pūrvavat ’ iti | ayamapyūṣmasvedāntarbhūtaḥ | iti kumbhīsvedaḥ | kūpasvedamāha - ‘ kūpaṃ śayanavistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ vāpi vaidyataḥ | deśe nivāte śakte ca sumṛṣṭaṃ kārayettataḥ || hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ karīṣairdagdhapūritam ’ iti kūpasvedaḥ | ayaṃ coṣmasvedabheda eva kūpasvedaḥ ||12|| atha holākasvedamāha - ‘vītikāṃ tu karīṣāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ pradīpayet | śayanāntaḥ pramāṇena śayyāmupari tatra ca | sudagdhāyāṃ vidhūmāyāṃ yathoktāmupakalpayet | svavacchannāṃ svayaṃ tasyāṃ svoktaḥ svidyati mānavaḥ || holākasveda ityeṣa sukhaḥ prokto maharṣiṇā’ iti | vītikā kumārikā holāsañjñitaḥ svedaḥ holāsvedaḥ | iti holāsvedaḥ | iti carakoktāstrayodaśasvedāste caturṣu svedādiṣvantarbhūtāḥ | ’rū. ’ | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti | pittayukte vāte dravasvedo hitaḥ pittasaṃge'tra svedasaṃghāto vihitaḥ | vātakaphayorevaṃ svedaśaṃkaraḥ | yaduktaṃ carake - vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyata iti | alpe pittasaṃsarge vāte dravasvedaḥ | sacoṣṇatvāt prabalau vātakaphau hanti | hīnapittaṃ tu dravatvena saukṣmyatvāt | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘ svedastāpopanāhoṣmadravabhedāścaturvidhāḥ ’ iti ||1||2||

Gū. svedaścaturvidhaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | caturvidhatvamāha – tāpoṣmau etau dvau svedasaṃjñitau bhavataḥ | upanāho dravaśca etau dvau , evaṃ catvāraḥ sarvato vātaharāḥ vātahāriṇo bhavanti | caturvidhasvedasya vātanāśakatve'pi viśeṣamāha – svedāviti | topoṣmajau svedau śleṣmaghnau samudīritau kathitau | upanāhaḥ svedaḥ vātaghnaḥ pittasaṃyoge dravo dravaḥ svedyamatipittasaṅge vā tau | tathāca suśrutaḥ - ‘tatra tāpoṣmasvedau viśeṣataḥ śleṣmaghnau, upanāhasvedo vātaghnaḥ | anyatarasmin pittasaṃsṛṣṭe dravasvedaḥ’ iti | anyatarasaṃsṛṣṭe vātamiśrite pitte dravaḥ svedo'bhihitaḥ iti suśrutā'bhiprāyaḥ | kevalapitte tu sarva eva svedā niṣiddhāḥ | kiṃtu śītalajalāvagāha eva praśastaḥ tathā coktaṃ - ‘pariṣekāvagāheṣu vyañjanānāṃ ca sevanam | śasyate śiśiraṃ toyaṃ tṛṣṇāpittoṣmaśāntaye’ iti ||1||2||

ab.seg: atha trividhasvedasya viśeṣamāha - mahābale mahāvyādhau śīte svedo mahānsmṛtaḥ | durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhye madhyatamo mataḥ || 3 ||

Dī. mahābalapuruṣe mahāvyādhau ca kapholbaṇavātavikārādau | śīte śītale śītārditapuruṣe vā mahān svedo vihitaḥ | durbale puruṣe pittaprāye vā durbalaḥ svedo dravaprāyo vihitaḥ | madhye madhyamabalapuruṣe vātaprāye vā madhyaḥ madhyamaḥ sveda upanāhaprāyo vihitaḥ | tathācoktaṃ -‘tāpopanāhadravabāṣpapūrvāḥ svedāstato'ntyaḥ prathamau kaphe staḥ | vāyau dvitīyaḥ pavanaṃ kaphe ca pittopasṛṣṭe vihitastṛtīyaḥ ’ iti || 3 ||
atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa svedaviśeṣamāha – balāse rūkṣaṇasvedo rūkṣasnigdhaṃ kaphānile | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ raveḥ karān ||4||
niyuddhaṃ mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇaṃ kṣudhaḥ | cintāvyāyāmabhārāṃśca sevetāmayamuktaye ||5||

div.ab: Dī. balāse kaphe |rūkṣasvedaṃ vālukāvastrakapālāṃgārādinimittaṃ | kaphānile iti kaphānilasaṃsarge rūkṣasnigdhamiti | tacca śālvaṇaprabhṛtikaṃ | kaphamedovṛte vāte iti | medo hi sarvaśarīrāṇāmudarastham aṇvasthiṣu ca | tathāhi ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjātvabhyantarasthitā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyate ’ iti | anena sakaphenāvṛte vāyau koṣṇagehādikaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | koṣṇagehamaṅgārādibhiḥ saṃtaptamityarthaḥ | raveḥ karān sūryakiraṇān | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddhaṃ | guruprāvaraṇamiti pravarājinakauśeyapraveṇīkuthakaprabhṛtikaṃ | kruddhaṃ kopaṃ pittajanakaṃ cintācittabhrāṃtikaraṃ vidhānaṃ medonāśakaratvāt | vyāyāmamiti śarīrāyāsajananam | viyuddhādivyatiriktaṃ karma etān āmayamuktaye kaphamedovṛtavātajanitarogaśāntyai seveta ātura iti śeṣaḥ | cintāsthāne bhayamiti kecit | tenāpi manaḥsaṃtāpatvāt krodhavat | tathāhi ‘vyāyāmoṣṇagṛhakṣudgurubalakrodhamānabhayasamarāḥ | upanāhasūryatāpau daśāgniguṇavarjitāḥ svedāḥ’ | bhayaṃ tu yathā unmādakāraṇamapi tanmādyakaṃ syāt | yathā dṛśyate yatsvedanaṃ calitasya sandheḥ punarghaṭṭanena tena samyagavasthānaṃ tadvadihāpi jñeyam ||4||5||

Gū. yādṛśe vāyau yādṛśaḥ svedo vihitaḥ tatprakāramāha – balāse iti | balāse kaphe | rūkṣaṇaḥ svedo vālukādibhirhitaḥ | kaphānile rūkṣasnigdhaṃ | kaphānile kaphavāte | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ saṃseveta | raveḥ karān kiraṇān seveta | niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddham | mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇam | kopaṃ balādidhāraṇaṃ śītādīnāṃ śamanaṃ , cintāvyāyāmabharāṃśca seveta | āmayamuktaye roganāśāya ||4||5||

ab.seg: prāksvedyāḥ - yeṣāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bastiścāpi hi dehinām | śodhanīyāśca ye kecitpūrvaṃ svedyāśca te matāḥ ||6||

Dī. atha krameṇa ye pūrvaṃ svedyāstānāha - yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyamiti nasyaṃ dātavyaṃ te nasyātmakasvedyā ityarthaḥ | na tu nasyaṃ vidhāya paścāt svedyā iti bhāvaḥ | yeṣāṃ dehināṃ bastiranuvāsananirūhākhyā dātavyā teṣāmapi pūrvaṃ svedakarma kāryaṃ, ye kiṃcicchodhanīyāḥ vamanavirekādiyogyāste'pi pūrvaṃ svedyā ityartha: | paramārthatastu virecane vidhātavye sati tryahaṃ snehapānaṃ paramam | vamane punarekāhoparame svedaḥ | yadāha kaścitsudāntasenaḥ - ekāhaṃ dinamanyacca kaphanut kleśyatakṣarairiti (?) || 6 ||
Gū. pūrvaṃ ye svedyāstānāha - yeṣāmiti | bhagandarī aśmaryāturaśca ete trayaḥ pūrvaṃ svedyāḥ || 6 ||
paścātsvedyāḥ - paścātsvedyā gate śalye mūḍhagarbhagade tathā | kāle prajātā'kāle vā paścātsvedyā nitambinī ||7||

Dī. idānīṃ ye paścāt svedyāstānāha - mūḍhagarbhādyupadrava ityeke | mūḍhagarbhagate tathetyapīti pāṭhaḥ kaścit | arthādraktasrāvādyupadravarahitāḥ paścāt svedyā ityarthaḥ | kāle prasavasamaye prajātakāle samyagjātasamaye | nitambinī strī | tantrāntare'pi ’paścātsvedyā hṛte śalye mūḍhagarbhā'nupadravā | samyakprajātakāle ca paścāt svedyā vijānateti’ | (cakradatte) ||7 ||

Gū. ye paścātsvedyāstānāha - paścāditi | gate śalye tathā mūḍhagarbhagade paścātsvedyāḥ | kāle prajātā navamamāsādagre prasūtā | akāle navamamāsādadhaḥ prasūtā vā nitambinī strī paścātprasavāt svedyā ||7||

kāladvayasvedyānāha -- svedyā: pūrvaṃ trayaḥ’traya’ iti padaṃ plīhādīnāṃ labdhe tritve tridoṣajanyatvaparaṃ jñeyam | arśasa iti arśorogī ’arśa āditvādac’ plīhabhagandaryarśasastathā | aśmaryaścāturo jantuḥ samaye śastrakarmaṇaḥ || 8 ||

Dī. athobhayataḥ śodhyāstānāha | plīhabhagandarārśasāṃ traya eva doṣāḥ | traya evopadravā vāte cāpi vātādidoṣajanitā ityarthaḥ | tathetigrahaṇānnaite pūrvaṃ svedyā: kiṃtu paścāt svedyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathā – coktaṃ - ’svedyāḥ punarayathādāhanāntaramuṣṇāmbutaptakaṭāhopaveśanarūpam’ | evamanyadapi yathāyogyaṃ boddhavyaṃ | janturāturaḥ śastrakarmaṇaḥ śastravidhānasya samaye kāle plīhabhagandarādīnityarthaḥ | śastrakarmaṇaḥ paścātpūrvaṃ caite svedyā ityabhiprāyaḥ || 8 ||

div.ab: svedakālaḥ - savānsvedān nivāte ca jīrṇāhāre ca kārayet |

Dī. atha svedakālāvasthāṃ darśayitumāha | sarvāniti tāpoṣṇopanāhadravasaṃjñān nivāte vātarahitasthāne jīrṇāhāre sati ca | jīrṇāhāralakṣaṇaṃ coktam | tathāhi - ‘udgāraśuddhirutsāho vegotsargo yatheritā | laghutā kṣutpipāsā ca jīrṇāhārasya lakṣaṇami’ti | prāyeṇa tu viṣṭavdhe'jīrṇepi svedo vihitaḥ | uktaṃ hi - ’viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kārya’miti vacanāt ||
Gū. svedān kārayedityāha - sarvāniti | nivāte nirvātasthāne | tathā''hāre jīrṇe paripakve sati sarvān caturvidhān svedānkārayet ||
svedaphalam - svedāddhātusthitā doṣāḥ snehaklinnasya dehinaḥ ||9|| dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatvā yānti virekatām |

ab.seg: Dī. atha svedāddoṣasya yena vidhyapagamastamāhala - doṣā vātādayaḥ | dhātusthitā iti | rasādidhātugatāḥ snehaklinnasya dehina iti | snehasvedābhyaktaśarīrasya puruṣasya | yataḥ snehasvedapūrvakameva śodhanaṃ | dravatvaṃ prāpyeti doṣa eva yataḥ | ye mārgeṣu līnā svasthānasthā vā dhātusaṃsthā api vā te samyaksvedairyojitāḥ saṃtaḥ dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatāḥ paścācchodhanaiḥ kṛtvā śāntiṃ yāntītyabhiprāyaḥ | tathācoktaṃ ’snehāt klinnā dhātusaṃsthāśca doṣāḥ svasthānasthā ye ca mārgeṣu līnāḥ | samyaksvedairyojitāste dravatvaṃ nītā: koṣṭhaṃ śodhane yānti śāntim’ iti || 9 ||

Gū. svedāddoṣaḥ kathaṃ yātītyāha - svedāditi | svedādvālukādisvedāt | tathā snehasvinnasya tailāvagāhanādyaiḥ svinnasya dehinaḥ puruṣasya dhātusthitā doṣāḥ koṣṭhāntargatvā dravatvaṃ prāpya virekatāṃ yāntīti yojanā || 9 ||

div.ab: sveditasya rakṣā | svidyamānaśarīrasya hṛdayaṃnanu hṛdayadṛṣṭayoḥ prāk rakṣaṇamuktaṃ, iha tu mṛdusve- do'bhihita iti viruddham? maivam, carake tūttaratantre śūlādau svedo vihitaḥ sa tu saṃmilitākṣairbāhye kriyate, na dṛṣṭau | carake'pyayameva pāṭho likhitaḥ | tadagre ca madhyamaṃ akṣṇau śeṣamaṅgāvayavamiṣṭataḥ svedayet | ru. śītalaiḥ spṛśet || 10 || snehābhyaktaśarīrasya śītairācchādya cakṣuṣī |

ab.seg: Dī. atha sveditasyāśvāsanārthaṃ viṣayamāha -- svidyamānaśarīrasya snehābhyaktaśarīrasyeti pādadvayasyetyayamabhiprāyaḥ - anena pūrvaṃ snehābhyaktaśarīrasya paścāt sveditasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | yataḥ sarvasvedeṣvapi snehābhyaṅgo vihita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathācoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena | nānābhyaktenāpi ca snigdhadehe svedo yojyaḥ svedavidbhiḥ kathaṃcit | dṛṣṭaṃ loke kāṣṭhamasnigdhamāśu tāpādbhayaṃ sveda- yogairgṛhītamiti | śītairācchādya cakṣuṣī iti | sarvāṃgeṣu svede kriyamāṇe cakṣūrakṣaṇārthamuktaṃ śītairiti padmāpatrādibhiḥ | asyāgre ’hṛdayaṃ vṛṣaṇau dṛṣṭiṃ svedayenmṛdu naiva ve’ti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | atra cakṣuṣī ityupalakṣaṇatvāt hṛdayādirakṣaṇameva kāryamityanenaiva gṛhītārthatvāt || 10||

Gū. doṣavireke jāte tatsthāpanārthaṃ cikitsitamāha - svidyamānaśarīrasyeti | bālukādeḥ svinnasya vireke sati hṛdayaṃ śītalaiḥ candanādibhiḥ spṛśet | snehābhyaktaśarīrasya snehasvinnasya śītaiḥ kamalakadalīpatrādyaiḥ cakṣuṣī ācchādya virekāt upācaret ityuttarakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ || 10 ||

div.ab: asvedārhāḥ - ajīrṇī durbalo mehī kṣatakṣīṇaḥ pipāsitaḥ ||11|| atisārī raktapittī pāṇḍurogī tathodarī | madārto garbhiṇī caiva nahi svedyā vijānatā || 12|| etānapi mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyānupācaret |

Dī. atha ye'pi rogiṇo'svedyāstānāha - ajīrṇītyādi | ete rogiṇo na svedyāḥ | yataḥ svedādapi teṣāṃ dehanāśo bhavati, kadācinna bhavati tadā eteṣāṃ vikārā api sādhyatvaṃ yāntīti bhāvaḥ | ata eva vijānatā puruṣeṇeti grahaṇam | tathāhi - ’svedāddoṣā yānti dehāvināśaṃ saṃsādhyatvaṃ yāṃti caiṣāṃ vikārāḥ’ iti bhāvaḥ | ajīrṇīti ajīrṇe bhakta iti sāmānyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa viṣṭabdhājīrṇī svedo vihitaḥ viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ kāryamiti vacanāt | yaduktamanyatrāpi - ‘svedaiḥ sādhyo durbalo'jīrṇabhaktaḥ syātāṃ cedvau svedanīyau tatastā’viti | śeṣaṃ subodhaṃcarake tu - ’kaṣāyamadyanityānāṃ garbhiṇyā raktapittinām| pittināṃ sātisārāṇāṃ rūkṣāṇāṃ madhumehināṃ | vida-gdhabhraṣṭabadhnānāṃ viṣamadyavikāriṇām | santāpānnaṣṭasaṃjñānāṃ sthūlānāṃ pittamehinām | tṛṣyatāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ ca kruddhānāṃ śocatāmapi | kāmalyudariṇāṃ caiva kṣatānāmāḍhyarogiṇāṃ | durvalātiviśuṣkāṇāmupakṣīṇaujasāṃ tathā | bhiṣakutaimirikāṇāṃ ca na svedamavatārayet’ iti | atra ’kaṣāya’śabdena kaṣāyamadyaṃ kaṣāyadravyakṛtamathavā kaṣāyaṃ madhu grāhyam | tasya ca kaṣāyavarge madhuravarge ca pāṭhāt | tasya ca svedāyogyatvāt | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’pītadugdhadadhisnehamadhūnī’tyādi | etānityādi etānajīrṇyādīn svedasādhyān ātyayike rogotpattau mṛdu svedayet | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ’mṛdu vātyāyike gade’ iti| | || 11 || 12 ||

ab.seg: kecidatrārdhaṃ paṭhanti- ’mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta tathā hṛnmuṣkadṛṣṭiṣu || 13 ||

Gū. yeṣāṃ svedo nocitastānāha - ajīrṇīti | etānapi mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyānupācaret | ajīrṇo ajīrṇavān, durbalaḥ, mehī pramehavān, kṣatakṣīṇaḥ uraḥkṣatakṣīṇaḥ, mado madyajanitarogī | etānapi svedasādhyānupācaret | keṣu ? mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta ityāha | hṛt hṛdayam, muṣko'ṇḍakoṣaḥ | dṛṣṭirnetram || 13 ||
svedātiyogajā rogāḥ - atisvedātsandhipīḍā dāhatṛṣṇā klamo bhramaḥ | pittāsṛkpiḍakākopastatra śītairupācaret || 14 ||

Dī. atha svedasyātiyogastena doṣamāha - piḍakākoṭha iti sphoṭādīnām | athavā piḍakākoṭha iti pāṭhaḥ | koṭho varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃkāśaḥ tatra śītairupācarediti | pānābhyañjane cātra śītāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā vidhijñena iti śeṣaḥ | yaduktam ‘atisvinnamathāśvāsya śītāmbuvamanaṃ hita’miti | carake tu uktaḥ - ‘uktastasyātiśaye graiṣmikaḥ sarvaśo vidhiḥ | sotisvinnasya kartavyo madhurasnigdhaśītalam’ iti || 14 ||

Gū. atisvedāt kiṃ bhavatītyāha - atisvedāditi | atisvedātsaṃdhipīḍādayo bhavanti | klamaḥ glāniḥ, bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva | pittāsṛk pittaraktam | piṃḍakā sphoṭikā | tatra śītairupācaredityanvayaḥ | tathācoktaṃ - ‘svinne'tyarthaṃ saṃdhipīḍāvidāhaḥ sphoṭotpattiḥ pittaraktaprakopaḥ | mūrcchā bhrāṃtirdāhatṛṣṇe klamaśca kuryāttūrṇaṃ tatra śītaṃ vidhānam’ iti || 14 ||
tāpasvedaḥ - teṣu tāpābhidhaḥ svedo vālukāvastrapāṇibhiḥ | kapālakandukāṅgārairyathāyogyaḥ prayujyate || 15 ||

Dī. idānīṃ yatpūrvaṃ cāturvidhyamuktaṃ tadyogadvāreṇa prakaṭayannāha - teṣu pūrvoktatāpādisvedeṣu | tāpābhidhastāpasvedaḥ | kapāla: kharparaḥ vālukādayo'tra vahnisaṃtaptā jñeyāḥ | yathāyogya iti | yathādoṣāpekṣayā yathāsthānasthitavyādhyanurūpa ityarthaḥ | ayaṃ tāpasvedo'bhihitaḥ || 15 ||

Gū. atha tāpādisvedānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - teṣviti | teṣu caturvidhasvedeṣu tāpādayaḥ svedā vālukādibhiryathāyogyaṃ prajāyante utpadyante | vālukā sikatā vastraṃ cīram, pāṇibhirhastaiḥ, kapālaḥ kharparaḥ, kandukaḥ vastrakandukaḥ, yadvā bahucchidro gṛhamadhye racitaḥ kandusaṃjñaḥ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -’bahucchidro gṛhāntasthaḥ kandurjetāka ucyate’ iti | tasya nirmāṇaṃ carake likhitam - ‘aṅgāraiḥ khadirādyaiśca nirdhūmairvālukātaptaṃ kṛtvā evaṃ pātrāntaritaiḥ svedaḥ aṅgārasya mṛtpātre sthāpayitvā svedaḥ kartavyaḥ’ iti || 15 ||
ūṣmasvedaḥ - ūṣmasvedaḥ prayoktavyo lohapiṇḍeṣṭakāśmabhiḥ | ataptairamlasiktaiśca kāye naktakaveṣṭite || 16 ||
athavā vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ | uṣṇairghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve chidraṃ vidhāya ca || 17 ||
vimudryāsyaṃ trikhaṇḍāṃ ca dhātujāṃ kāṣṭhavaṃśajām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ nalīṃ yuñjyādvihastikām ||18||
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ svabhyaktaṃ guruprāvaraṇāvṛtam | hastiśuṇḍikayā nāḍyāṃ svedayedvātarogiṇam || 19||
puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ vā bhūmimutkīrya khādiraiḥ | kāṣṭhairdagdhvā tathābhyukṣya kṣīradhānyāmlavāribhiḥ ||20||
vātaghnapatrairācchādya śayānaṃ svedayennaram | evaṃ māṣādibhiḥ svinnaiḥ śayānaṃ svedamācaret ||21||

Dī. athoṣmasvedavivakṣāyāṃ yogadvāreṇa taptarūpamāha - kāye naktakaveṣṭite iti | naktakāḥ vātaharavaṭapallavādayaḥ | tairveṣṭitaṃ śarīraṃ kṛtvā paścādvihitasvedadravyeṇa svedayediti bhāvaḥ | anyadapyāha - athaveti | vātanirnāśadravyāṇi daśamūlaprabhṛtīni | teṣāṃ kvāthaṃ svarasaṃ ca yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ca grāhyaṃ pārśve chidraṃ vidhāyeti ghaṭapārśve nāḍikāmukhapramāṇaṃ randhraṃ kārayet | vimudryāsyamiti| ghaṭamukhaṃ mudrayedityarthaḥ | nāḍikāghaṭasaṃdhimapi mudrayediti saṃpradāyaḥ | nāḍīsvarūpamāha -trikhaṇḍamityādi | trikhaṇḍāṃ mṛdumadhyaprabalasvedaviṣayatvātkhaṇḍatrayayuktāmityarthaḥ | dhātujāmiti suvarṇādidhātunirmitam | athavāpyabhāve kāṣṭhajāmiti vaṃśādikāṣṭhaghaṭitām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāmiti ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥ kuṇḍalākṛtimuttaralagnaṃ nāḍikāmukhamiti bhāvaḥ | kiṃcidvimañcaghaṭalagnamukhaṃ bhavatīti gopucchākārānukārābhidhānatvāt saṃpradāyaviṣayaḥ | tena laghumukhaṃ ghaṭalagnaṃ kārayet | bṛhanmukhamāturalagnamiti bhāvaḥ | dvihastakāmiti dvihastaparimāṇaṃ trikhaṇḍānāmityarthaḥ | guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlīprabhṛtikam | hastiśuṇḍikayetyuktamapi nāḍyākāraṃ draḍhayati na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | athavā hastiśuṇḍiketi nāmnā'sya svedasya saṃjñā vihitā | hastiśuṇḍiko'yaṃ sveda iti tātparyārthaḥ | anyoṣmasvedavidhānamāha - puruṣāyāmamātrāmiti | puruṣapramāṇaṃ yathā syāt| āyāmañca dīrghavistārayoḥ khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhairiti | khadiro raktasāraḥ | dagdhveti bhūgartasthānamiti śeṣaḥ | tatra kāṣṭhajvalanaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | tatheti paścāt kṣīrādibhiḥ kṛtvābhyukṣyeti | na tu kāṣṭhāṅgārāṇi tatratyopanīya kṣīradhānyāmlaprabhṛtīnāmekatamena kṛtvā tadeva sevayediti bhāvaḥ | dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaviśeṣam | tadabhāve takraṃ grāhyamiti vyavahārāt| paścātkāryamāha - vātaghnapatrairityādi | tatra vātaghnapatraireraṇḍaprabhṛtikaiḥ | tacchayanaṃ bhūgartanirmitarūpam | tatpatrairācchādya tatra vātārtapuruṣaṃ saṃviśya svedayedityabhiprāyaḥ | evamityanenaiva prakāreṇa svinnairmāṣādibhirapi śayanasvedamāvaraṇīyam | etaduktaṃ bhavati | māṣakvāthajalenāpi bhūgartasyeti siṃcanam | athavā svinnabāṣpaiḥ bāṣpaparisvinnaṃ vātārtamadhaḥsthaṃ svedayedityeke || 16-21 ||

Gū. athoṣṇasvedaḥ - lohapiṇḍikeṣṭakādibhiḥ taptai: amlasaṃsiktaiḥ, punaḥ kāye dehe, rallakaveṣṭitairyaḥ svedaḥ sa uṣṇasvedaḥ | athavā pakṣāntare | vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ ghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve tiryak chidraṃ kṛtvā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ vimudrya tasminpārśve chidre dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | kiṃbhūtāṃ nāḍīṃ ? trikhaṇḍāṃ trigranthivaṃśajām | kāṣṭhajāṃ, dhātujāṃ dvihastikāṃ nāḍīṃ yuñjyāt | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ veti vikalpaḥ | sukhopaviṣṭaṃ sukhena sthitam | svabhyaktaṃ kṛtatailābhyaṅgam | punaḥ guruprāvaraṇaṃ tūlādyairāvṛtam | anayā hastiśuṇḍikādhārayā nāḍyā vātarogiṇaṃ svedayet | apara uṣṇasvedaprakāraḥ - puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ puruṣapramāṇamātrāṃ bhūmimutkīrya khanayitvā khādiraiḥ kāṣṭhairdagdhvā tathā'mlamūtrādibhirabhyukṣyābhiṣiṃcya vātaghnapatrairācchādya śayānaṃ svedayet || 16-21 ||

div.ab: upanāhasvedamāha - athopanāhasvedaṃ ca kuryādvātaharauṣadhaiḥ | pradihya dehaṃ vātārtaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ || 22 || amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiḥ | upagrāmyānūpamāṃsairjīvanīyagaṇena ca || 23 || dadhi-sauvīraka-kṣīrairvīratarvādinā tathā | kulattha-māṣa-godhūmairatasī-tila-sarṣapaiḥ || 24 || śataṣuṣpā-devadāru-śephālī-sthūlajīrakaiḥ | eraṇḍamūlaṃ bījaiśca rāsnāmūlakaśigrubhiḥ || 25 || miśi-kṛṣṇā-kuṭheraiśca lavaṇairamlasaṃyutaiḥ | prasāriṇyaśvagandhābhyāṃ balābhirdaśamūlakaiḥ || 26 || guḍūcī-vānarībījairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtaiḥ | kṣuṇṇaiḥ svinnaiśca vastreṇa baddhaiḥ saṃsvedayennaram ||27|| mahāśālvaṇasaṃjño'yaṃ yogaḥ sarvānilārtihṛt |

ab.seg: Dī. athopanāhasvedavidhānamāha | upanāhaḥ koṣṇabahalālepaḥ bandhanamityeke | vātaharauṣadhairiti kākolyādigaṇādyathālābhaṃ grāhyamiti vyavahāraḥ | kṣīramāṃsarasānvitairiti kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ tadabhāve ājaṃ sāmānyatvācca yathāyogyaṃ deyamiti | māṃsamatra grāmyānūpasaṃbhavaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasya rasaṃ māṃsarasamityarthaḥ | amlapiṣṭairiti amlaiḥ kāñjikādibhiḥ | salavaṇairiti lavaṇo'tra saindhavaṃ | snehasaṃyutairiti sneho'tra caturvidho deyo yathāyogyasaṃbhavāt | ayamapi śālvaṇasaṃjñaḥ | aparamapyupanāhavidhānamāha | grāmyānūpamāṃsādivānarībījaparyantadravye yathālābhaprāptaiḥ kṣuṇṇai: sūkṣmakuṭṭitaiḥ svinnaiḥ kathitaiḥ tadanu vastreṇa baddhvā poṭṭalikākāraiḥ saṃsvedayet | naramiti vātārtaṃ puruṣam | ayaṃ mahāśālvaṇasaṃjñayogaḥ prasiddha eva | yaduktam - ‘ānūpagrāmyamāṃsādyaiḥ svedaḥ śālvaṇako mata’ iti | grāmyāḥ aśvāśvataragokharorabhramedaḥpucchakaprabhṛtaya: | ānūpavargastu | pañcavidha:| tadyathā kūlacarāḥ, pallavāḥ, kośasthāḥ, pādinaḥ, matsyāśceti | tatra kūle caranti, te yathā - ‘tatrebha-mahiṣa-nyaṅku-ruru-rohita-śūkarāḥ | khaṅgi-gokarṇa-camarāḥ - sṛmarāḥ kālapucchakaḥ | kodrakāramaledyāśca paśavaḥ kūlacāriṇaḥ’ | plavā yathā - ’haṃsa-sārasa-kādamba-krauñca-kāraṇḍava-plavāḥ| balākā-baka-cakrāhvajīvajīvāmbukukkuṭā: | utkrośa-puṇḍarīkākṣa-śaśarīmaṇituṇḍikāḥ | kākatuṇḍadhanānāvamadgupuṣkaraśāyikāḥ | kāvākṣimallikāśvetavarāhādyāḥ plavā smṛtāḥ’ | kośasthā yathā - ‘śaṅkhaḥ śaṅkhāṇakaḥ śuktirbhallūkaśambukādayaḥ | kośasthāśca - udrakumbhīraśiśumārakumbhīrakāḥ | nakrakūrma-bhallūkādyāḥ pādinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ’ | matsyā yathā-‘gomatsyo marulaḥ kṛṣṇamatsyako bahulo rasaḥ | rājī cilici-mādyāśca matsyāḥ proktāḥ samāsataḥ’ iti | ityānūpamāṃsavargaḥ | eteṣāṃ svarūpamatra vistarabhayānna likhitaṃ | jīvanīyagaṇena veti | taduktaṃ suśrute – kākolīkṣīrakākolījīvakarṣabhakau | mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇīmedāmahāmedācchinnaruhākarkaṭa-śṛṅgītugākṣīrīṛddhivṛddhimṛdvīkājīvantyo madhukaṃ ceti jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ | dadhisauvīrakakṣīrairiti | sauvīrakaḥ kāñjikabhedaḥ | vīratarvādinā tatheti | vīratarvādigaṇaḥ suśrute'vagantavyaḥ | vīratarusahacaradarbhavṛkṣādanīguṇḍānalakuśakāśāśmabhedakāgnimanthamoraṭavasukavasirabhallakakundurūke-ndīvarakapotavaṅkāśvadaṃṣṭrā ceti| śephālīsthūlajīrakairiti | śephālī nirguṇḍī ‘saṃbhārū’ iti loke | sthūlajīrakaḥ kṛṣṇajīraka:| eraṇḍasya mūlaṃ bījaṃ, ca grāhyaṃ | miśiḥ śatapuṣpā | kuṭherakaḥ khanāmaprasiddhaḥ | lavaṇairiti bahuvacanenātra pañcalavaṇāni yathāyogyaṃ deyāni | aparāṇyapi pāṃśukṣāraprabhṛtīni grāhyāṇi na doṣaḥ | amlasaṃyutairiti amloṣṇavargo hito grāhyaḥ | balābhiriti bahuvacanādbalācatuṣṭayeṣu yathālābhamiti yojyam | daśamūlaḥ prasiddhaḥ sa ca daśadravyairmilitaḥ | tadyathā - ’śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā | tathā gokṣurakaścaiva laghumūlamiti smṛtam | bilvo'gnimanthaḥ syonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalāstathā | jñeyaṃ mahatvaṃ mūlaṃ ca daśamūlamubhe smṛta’miti | vānarībījairiti kapikacchūbījaiḥ | etairdravyairvyastairvā yogā boddhavyāḥ bhinnatṛtīyāntapadatvāt | śeṣaṃ subodham || 22-27 ||

Gū. athopanāhasvedaḥ - vātaharauṣadhairdaśamūlādibhirupanāhaṃ svedaṃ kuryāt | kiṃ kṛtvā ? vātārtadehaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ pradihya pralepaṃ kṛtvā | uta amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiśca pradihya | atha mahāśālvaṇasvedavidhānamāha - grāmyāḥ chāgorabhrādayaḥ, anūpā matsyacakravākādayaḥ | jīvanīyagaṇaścūrṇoktaḥ | sauvīraṃ kāñjikam | kṣārairyavakṣārasvarjīṭaṅkaṇaiḥ | vīratarvādiśca pūrvoktaḥ | atasī prasiddhā, śephālī nirguṇḍī, miśiḥ śatapuṣpā, kuṭheraḥ vāvarī | lavaṇaiḥ saindhavādyaiḥ | pañcabhiramlairdāḍimādyaiḥ | vānarī kapikacchū: | etairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtairānītaiḥ, kṣuṇṇaiḥ kuṭṭitaiḥ, svinnaiḥ sveditaiḥ, punarvastreṇa baddhaiḥ svedayet || || 22-27 ||

div.ab: dravasvedavidhi: | dravasvedastu vātaghno dravyakvāthena pūritam || 28 || kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ vā'pi sūpaviṣṭo'vagāhayet |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ dravasvedavidhimāha - dravasveda iti | pittasaṃge dravo hita iti pūrvoktatvāt | vātaghnadravyakvātheneti vātaghnadravyaṃ kākolyādigaṇapramukhaṃ tacca pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ | kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ ca | dvividhamiti dravasvedaṃ | vā grahaṇāt carmadroṇīprabhṛtikamapi yathālābhaṃ dravasvedavidhau grāhyam || 28 ||
Gū. vātaghnaṃ daśamūlādyaṃ dravyam | tatkvāthena pūrite kaṭāhe tāmrādikoṣṭhake vā sūpaviṣṭaḥ sukhena sthitaḥ avagāhayet || 28 ||
idānīṃ dravasya parimāṇamāha - nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmagnaḥ kvāthasya dhārayā || 29 ||
koṣṇayā skandhayoḥ siktastiṣṭhet snigdhatanurnaraḥ | evaṃ tailena, dugdhena, sarpiṣā svedayennaram || 30 ||

div.ab: Dī. ’nābherityādi | yāvannāmerūrdhvaṃ sūpaviṣṭaḥ puruṣo magno bhavati tāvat kvāthādikaṃ dhārayet yojayedityarthaḥ | ityevaṃ kaṭāhāvagāha iva parimāṇam | koṣṭhe tūtthitaḥ puruṣo yāvat skandhayorupari sikto magnaḥ tāvattiṣṭhedityabhiprāyaḥ | snigdhatanutā sarvasvede'pi boddhavyā evamuktaprakāreṇaiva tailādināpi yathāyogyaṃ svedayedinanu snigdhasyaiva svedādhikārātpunaḥ snigdhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? ucyate - punargrahaṇaṃ tatsamayasnigdhatādyotanārtham | ru. tyarthaḥ || 29 || 30 ||

Gū. tasya vidhānamāha - snigdhatanuḥ kṛtatailābhyaṅgaḥ | koṣṇayā dhārayā sthitaḥ skandhayoḥ siktaḥ | kvāthena dhārayā nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmagnastāvattiṣṭhet | evaṃ tailena dugdhena sarpiṣā ghṛtena vā svedayet | ayaṃ dravasvedaḥ || 29 || 30 || avagāhanakālaniyamaḥ |
ekāntaro dvyantaro vā snehayukto'vagāhane |

Dī. athāvagāhanakālaniyamamāha - athāvagāhane yathādau snehayuktaḥ snehāvagāhastadā ekāntara ekadyantara: dvyantaro dvidināntaro vā kartavya iti vyavasthāviṣayaḥ | na tu sarvāvagāhane niyamanamidaṃ | nanvatra kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ, tantrāntare tu na kṛtaḥ, tathā pūrvamuktaṃ - nābherūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaṃ kvāthatailādidhāraṇam | tantrāntare tu anyathā | vaidyālaṃkāre - ’kaṭāhe mṛṇmaye pātre kiṃvā pāṣāṇasaṃbhave | ākaṇṭhamagno nivaset praharaṃ prātareva vā || romānteṣvanukūpeṣu sthitvā mātrā śatatrayam | tataḥ praviśati snehaiścaturbhirgacchati tvacam | pañcabhiśca bhajedraktaṃ ṣaḍbhirmāṃsaṃ prapadyate | medaḥ - sthānaṃ saptaśatairaṣṭabhiścāsthiṣu vrajet || navabhiryāti majjānaṃ tato mātrāṃ na kārayet | tatastu rogānsaṃgṛhya vātapittakaphodbhavān || srotasāṃ mārdavakaraḥ kaphavātavināśanaḥ | dhātūnāṃ puṣṭijanano balavarṇakaraḥ paraḥ || vātarogānaśeṣāṃśca jayedeṣa viśeṣataḥ’ iti | anyatrāpi kaṇṭhaparyantadhāraṇamuktaṃ yathā - droṇīkāṣṭhasya tailena sukhoṣṇena prapūrayet | tatra sthitvā yathā mātrā kaṇṭhaparyantamāhanum || sukhinaḥ sukumārasya sukhārthī śramapīḍitaḥ | gāhayet ghaṭikāsārdhaṃ tailadroṇyāṃ ca yatnataḥ || tato niḥsṛtya hastābhyāṃ khaṭvāyāṃ carmake punaḥ | sukhena mardanaṃ kṛtvā yāvattailaṃ viśudhyati || udvartanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsnānaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam || tvaci kāntikaraṃ sadyaḥ pāruṣyaṃ na vinaśyati || balapuṣṭikaraṃ sadyo vātarogaṃ ca nāśayet | anye ca tvagbhavā rogā mandānalasamudbhavāḥ || yasya śuṣyati sarvāṅgaṃ gatiryasya tu vihvalā | tasya droṇyāṃ ca taileṣu gāhayedghaṭikātrayam || kṣīṇendriyāḥ kṣīṇaśukrā jvarakṣīṇāśca ye narāḥ | vātārtau vṛṣaṇau yeṣāmantravṛddhiśca dāruṇā || paṅgulaḥ pīṭhasarpī ca gṛdhrasī vātaśūlavān | kalāyakhañjakaṃ tūnīṃ pratūnīṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || etatsarvān nihantyāśu channābhramiva mārutam’ iti | tenātra śārṅgadharoktaṃ kālaniyamavacanaṃ sukumārādiviṣayam | tathā nābherūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulagrahaṇaṃ hṛdayarakṣārthaṃ, tantrāntaroktaṃ dāruṇavātarogagrastaviṣayaṃ | kaṇṭhaparyantāvagāhanaṃ tu sukumārādiviṣayam | ata evoktaṃ carake - ‘padmotpalapalāśairvā svedyaḥ saṃvṛttya cakṣuṣī | muktāvalībhiḥ śuddhābhiḥ śītalairbhojanairapi || jalārdraiḥ sajalairhastaiḥ svidyato hṛdayaṃ spṛśet’ iti | netrahṛdayarakṣārthaviṣayamidaṃ śārṅgadharavacanaṃ jñeyam ||
Gū. yathāyogyam ekāntare dvyantare vā'vagāho yuktaḥ ||
avagāhanaphalam - sirāmukhai romakūpairdhamanībhiśca tarpayet || 31 || śarīre balamādhatte yuktaḥ sneho'vagāhane |

ab.seg: Dī. atha samyaksnehāvagāhane phalamāha - avagāhane yuktaḥ sneha ekāntarādividhinā samyak prayuktaśīlaḥ | tādṛśa eva śirādistarpayan san śarīre balamādhatte tarpayan dhātūniti śeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ -‘mātrābhistriścatuḥpaccaṣaṭsaptāṣṭabhirāvrajet | rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjādhātūn yathākrama’miti | mātrāyāśca prasaṃgato lakṣaṇaṃ saṃkhyā ca likhyate | yathā – sphajāūnaḥ - karāvartaṃ kuryāttāṃ sphoṭikāyutām | eṣā mātrā bhavedekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ | saṃkhyā yathā - ‘vedanopaśamaḥ pañcaśatasaptaśatāni vā | sahasraṃ vāpi mātrāṇāṃ kuryāddoṣabalābala’mityādi | śirāmukhai romakūpairiti | śirāṇāṃ mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhānīti bhāvaḥ | sirāśca doṣādivahā iti granthakāraḥ sandhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣādhātuvahāḥ śirā iti | tāśca sthūlasūkṣmabhedenāpi dvidhā bhavanti tāsāṃ nābhimūlatvādadhastiryak ca prasaraḥ | tathāhyuktam - ’yāvantyastu sirāḥ kāye saṃbhavanti śarīriṇām | nābhipravṛddhāḥ sarvāstāḥ pratanvanti samantata’ iti | dhamanībhiśceti | dhmānādanilāpūraṇāddhamanyo rasavahāścaturviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | etāścāpi nābhiprabhavā abhihitāḥ | cakārāttāsāmapi mukhāni romakūpapratibaddhāni jñātavyāni | yataḥ ye svedamabhivahanti rasaṃ cābhitarpayantyantarbahiśca | taireva cābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhālepanavīryāṇyantaḥ śarīramabhipratipadyanta iti ||31 ||
Gū. tasya phalamāha - sirāmukhairlomakūpairlomavivarairdhamanībhirnāḍībhiśca tarpayet | tadā śarīre balam ādhatte || 31 ||
dhātuvardhanamāha - jalasiktasya vardhante yathāmūle'ṅkurāstaroḥ || 32 ||
tathā dhātuvivṛddhirhi snehasiktasya jāyate | nātaḥ parataraḥ kaścidupāyo vātanāśanaḥ || 33 ||
śītaśūlādyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe | dīptāgnau mārdave jāte svedanādviratirmatā || 34 ||

Dī. atha snehāvagāhanādvāyuvṛddhau satyāṃ taddṛṣṭāntenāsya prādhānyamāha | mūle pānīyasiktasya vṛkṣasya yathāṅkurāḥ pallavādirūpā vardhante tadvadatrāpi dhātuvṛddhau boddhavyaṃ | nātaḥ para iti | asmāt snehāvagāhanāt aparo vātanāśako yogo na pradhāna iti bhāvaḥ | atha svedakarmaṇo virativiṣayamāha - śītaśīlādyuparame iti | śūlaśāntau satyāṃ śūlaśabdena vātādijanito vedanāsamūho boddhavyaḥ | stambho gauravaṃ cāṃgānāṃ tayornirgraho nāśaḥ | tasmiñjāte sati dīptāgnau sati | mārdavamapi aṅgānāṃ mṛdutā tasminnapi jāte sati viratirviśrāmaḥ; tena ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ svedaguṇo'vagantavyaḥ | tathā hyuktam - ’agnau dīpte mārdavaṃ tvakprasādaṃ bhaktaśraddhāṃ srotasāṃ nirmalatvam | kuryātsvedastandranidre ca hanyāt sandhīnbandhāṃśceṣṭayedāśu yukta’ iti | sauṣadhasvedātiyogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ’pittāsrakopatṛṇmūrcchāsvarāṅgasadanabhramāḥ | sandhipīḍājvaraḥ śyāvaraktamaṇḍaladarśanam | svedātiyogācchardiśca tatra stambhanamauṣadham’ iti || 32-34 ||
Gū. svedanātkadā nivṛttirbhavati ? ityatrāha - śīta iti | śītaśūlādīnāmuparame nivṛtte sati stambhagauravayornigrahe sati, mārdave mṛdutve sati dehasyaiva tadā svedanādviratirnivṛttirmatā || 32-34 ||
susvinnasya paścāt karma darśayati - samyak svinnaṃ vimṛditaṃ snānamuṣṇāmbubhiḥ śanaiḥ | bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet ||35||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedavidhirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

Dī. vimṛditamiti | snehāvagāhānantaraṃ sukhamardanam, uṣṇāmbubhiruṣṇodakaiḥ snānam, anabhiṣyandi bhojayet | jāṭharāgne: saṃdīpanārthaṃ vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma | kecit - ’vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet’ ityatra - ‘sarvatrācāramācaret’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | tatra ācāraḥ snehācaraṇaṃ, tacca vāgbhaṭe'pyuktam - ‘uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān | pravātayānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitīḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhaḥsvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 35 ||
iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 ||

Gū. svedānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha - samyak svinnaṃ samyak sveditam | punaḥ vimṛditaṃ kṛtābhyaṅgam | paścācchannairuṣṇāmbunā kuryāditi pūrvakriyāsambandha: | anabhiṣyandi sroto rodhi bhojayet | vyāyāmaṃ śramādyaṃ na kārayet | suśrute caturvidhaḥ navasvedaḥ kathitaḥ | cakārādvāgbhaṭādau trayodaśavidhaḥ | granthajñāpanārthaṃ tadapi likhyate | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ’śaṅkaraḥ prastaro nāḍī pariṣeko'vagāhanam | jetāko'śmaghanaḥ karpū: kuṭī, kumbhī tathāca bhūḥ || kūpo lohākaraścaite svedāścaiva trayodaśa’ iti | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe darśitam || 35 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedādhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

div.head: atha vamanavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athedānīṃ kṛtasnehasvedasya śodhanādhikāraḥ | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhā'sthisaṃsthāḥ | doṣāḥ svedaiste dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyak śuddhibhirnirhriyante’ iti | atra śuddhibhiriti bahuvacanagrahaṇātpañcakarmaṇāṃ grahaṇam | tenā'trādau sthānānurodhātprāk vacanaṃ paścādvirecanādīti | ata evāha -

ab.seg: vamanapradhāno vidhiḥ vamanavidhiḥ śodhanaprakāraḥ | ata evāha - śaratkāle vasante ca prāvṛṭkāle ca dehinām | vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva kārayetkuśalo bhiṣak || 1 ||

Dī. ūrdhvabhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ vamanam, adhobhāgadoṣanirharaṇaṃ virecanam | cakārādvastinasyādayaḥ | vamanādīnāṃ kālamāha - śaratkāle ityādi | śaratkālādiśabdaistatsamīpasādhāraṇakāla upalakṣyate | uktaṃca - ’śrāvaṇe kārtike caiva māsi sādhāraṇe kramāt | grīṣmavarṣāhimacitān vāyvādīnāśu nirharet’ iti | kuśalo bhiṣagiti | doṣadeśakālasātmyaprakṛtivayovahridhātumalaviśeṣajñāne śodhane ca kuśala: iti || 1 ||
