Dī. yasya snehaḥ sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaḥ viṣṭhāsahitaḥ pratyeti niḥsarati | kathaṃ ? upadravaṃ vinā upadravo'tra ūṣacoṣādiḥ | ata eva kecidevaṃ paṭhanti - ‘ūṣacoṣau vinā śīghraṃ sa samyaganuvāsitam’ iti | ūṣaḥ prādeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣo vedanāviśeṣaḥ pipāsetyapare | suśrute'pyayameva pāṭhaḥ iti bhānumatī | śīghramiti yāmādūrdhvam || 31 ||
Gū. samyaganuvāsitasya lakṣaṇamāha - sānila ityādi | sānilaḥ savātaḥ sapurīṣaśca yasya snehaḥ pratyeti gacchati upadravaṃ vinā samyaganuvāsito bhavatītyarthaḥ || 31 ||
snehāgate vidhimāha - jīrṇānnastvatha sāyāhne snehe pratyāgate punaḥ | laghvannaṃ bhojayet kāmaṃ dīptāgnistu naro yadi ||32||
Dī. srehe pratyāgate sati sadya iti jñeyaṃ, dīptāgniḥ sa naraḥ yadi tathā kāmaṃ bhojayet | sāyāhne pratyāgate laghvannaṃ bhojayet iti viṣamavibhāgaḥ | kecidapare'hni bhojayedityāhuḥ || 32 ||
anuvāsanavyāpattau pratīkāramāha - anuvāsitāya dātavyamitare'hni sukhodakam | dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā snehavyāpattināśanam ||33||

Dī. itare'hni aparadine sukhodakam uṣṇodakam | athavā dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā tadapi koṣṇaṃ dadyāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhāṭe - ‘prātarnāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ kevalameva ca’ iti | asyāgre kecitpaṭhanti - ‘ekāntaropayogena dhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | tanmate tu ekāntarānuvāsanaṃ, dhānyaśuṇṭhīkkātha: paradine prātaḥ deya iti | dhānyanāgarasiddhaṃ ca toyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā iti cakraḥ | koṣṇodakaṃ ca pittottare deyam | uktañca cakre - ‘kvāthārdhamātrayā prātardhānyaśuṇṭhījalaṃ pibet | pittottare kaduṣṇāmbu tāvanmātraṃ pibedatha | tenāsya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti || 33 ||

Gū. snehānuvāsanānantaraṃ snehavyāpattiharaṇavidhānamāha - anuvāsitāya kṛtānuvāsanāya | itare'hni tadagrimadine sukhodakaṃ deyam | tatsnehavyāpattināśanaṃ bhavati | snehasya vā kācidvyāpattirvikriyārūpā || 33 ||

div.ab: athoktaprakāramupasaṃharan bastidānasaṃkhyāmāha - anena vidhinā sapta cāṣṭau vātha navā'pi vā | vidheyā bastayasteṣāmantarā tu nirūhaṇam || 34|| (dattastuprakṣiptamidam | prathamo bastiḥ snehayet bastivaṃkṣaṇaiḥ | samyagdatto dvitīyastu mūrdhasthamanilaṃ jayet ||35|| balaṃ varṇaṃ ca janayettṛtīyastu prayojitaḥ | caturthapañcamau dattau snehayetāṃ rasāsṛjī || 36 || ṣaṣṭho māṃsaṃ snehayati saptamo meda eva ca | aṣṭamo navamaścāpi majjānaṃ ca yathākramam || 37 || evaṃ śukragatāndoṣāndviguṇaḥ sādhu sādhayet | aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakānbastīnāṃ yo niṣevate || 38 || sa kuñjarabalo'pyaśvaṃ jayettulyo'maraprabhaḥ | rūkṣāya bahuvātāya snehabastiṃ dine dine || 39 || dadyādvaidyastathānyeṣāmanyāṃ bādhāmapāharet | sneho'lpamātro rūkṣāṇāṃ dīrghakālamanatyayaḥ ||40|| tathā nirūhaḥ snigdhānāmalpamātraḥ praśasyate |)

ab.seg: Dī. anena pūrvoktavidhineti | pūrvoktaprakāreṇa ṣaṭ, sapta, aṣṭau, nava bastayaḥ krameṇa vidheyāḥ yojyāḥ | kramo yathā kaphaje vikāre ṣaṭ, vāgrahaṇāt ekaḥ trayo vā prāptāḥ | pittātmake ca sapta aṣṭau vā | cakārātpañcagrahaṇaprāptiḥ | vāte nava iti vāgrahaṇādekādaśaprāptiḥ | nanu tantrāntare -‘rūkṣasya bahuvātasya dvau trīn vāpyanuvāsanam | datvā snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścānnirūhayet’ ityanena virodhaḥ tatkathamatra ṣaṭsaptādisaṃkhyā ? satyam, rūkṣasya bahuvātasya yadi mṛdukoṣṭhatvaṃ tadā dvau vā trayo vā snehabastayaḥ | ata eva ‘snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā’ iti kṛtavān | na tu snigdhatanutā dvitrisnehabastidānasya carake vihitatvāt | yathā - ‘ekaṃ tathā trīn kaphaje vikāre pittātmake pañca ca sapta vā'pi | vāte'pi caikādaśadhā punarvā bastīnayugmān kuśalo vidadhyāt’ iti | ucyate -ayugmadānaṃ svatantrānuvāsanaviṣayam na tu nirūhāṅgānuvāsanaviṣayaṃ | nirūhāṅgānuvāsane carakeṇā'pi yugmadānaṃ darśitam | yathā -‘trīn pañca vā caturo vā bastīn datvottaranirūhaṇaṃ vinā punaḥ snehadānena yugmān tathā kuryāditi darśayati nirūhāntaritaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | viṣayasaṃkhyopādānaṃ dvicaturādibasterapi madhyaviṣayaṃ parigrahārtham’ iti| rūkṣasyetyādividhānaṃ tu kṣīṇaviṣayabhedādavirodhaḥ | teṣāmantarā tu nirūhaṇamiti teṣāṃ snehanabastīnām antarā nirūhaṇaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ vā naikamevātra śīlayet | snehāt pittakaphotkleśau syātāṃ na pavanādbhayam| tasmānnirūho'nuvāso nirūhyaścānuvāsitaḥ| naivaṃ pittakaphotkkeśau syātāṃ ca pavanādbhayam’ ||34-40||

Gū. vātādau kiyanto bastayo deyāstatpramāṇamāha - anena vidhinā pūrvoktavidhinā ṣaḍvā sapta vā aṣṭa vā nava vā etatpramāṇā bastayo deyāḥ | teṣāṃ bastīnāmantarā nirūhaṇaṃ vidheyam | vāgbhaṭe triṃśadbastayaḥ kathitāḥ | tathāca - ‘prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni tu | sānvāsakāni karmaiva bastayastriṃśadīritāḥ’ iti || 34-40 ||

div.ab: nivṛtte'nuvāsane snehe punarapi anuvāsanamāha - athavā yasya tatkālaṃ sneho niryāti kevalaḥ ||41|| tasyānyo'lpataro deyo na hi snihyatyatiṣṭhati | aśuddhasya malonmiśra: sneho naiti yadā punaḥ ||42|| tadā śaithilyamādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaśca jāyate | pakvāśaye gurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyānnirūhaṇam || 43 || tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairyuktā phalavartirhitā tathā | yathānulomanaṃ vāyurmalaṃ snehaśca jāyate || 44 || yathā virecanaṃ dadyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate | yasya nopadravaṃ kuryātsnehabastiraniḥsṛtaḥ || 45 || sarvo'lpo vā vṛte raukṣyādupekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā |

ab.seg: Dī. athavā anuvāsanasnehaḥ yasya puruṣasya tatkālaṃ śīghrameva niryāti tasya puruṣasyānyo'lpataro'nuvāsanasneho deyaḥ | kuta ityata āha - atiṣṭhati ityādi | atiṣṭhati snehena hi snihyati | alpatara iti pūrvadattāt | tantrāntare tu - ‘yasyānuvāsano dattaḥ sakṛdantaḥkṣayaṃ vrajet | atyuṣṇo vā'titīkṣṇo vā vāyunā vā prapīḍitaḥ || savāte caikamātro vā gurutvādvā subheṣajaḥ | tasyānyo'lpataro deyo nahi strihyatyatiṣṭhati’ iti | atra vāyunā iti koṣṭhasthena vātena ityarthaḥ | savāta iti | anucchvāsya vihitabandhādinā bastipuṭakasthitavāyusahite tu snehe mukhakaṣāyatā jṛmbhā vātarujastāstā vepathurviṣamajvara iti | atha ca snehānirgame'pi vidhānamāha - aśuddhasyeti | akṛtaśodhanasya puruṣasyetyarthaḥ | ata eva malonmiśraḥ sneha iti | tathāhi ‘snehabastirvidheyastu nāviśuddhasya dehinaḥ | snehavīryaṃ tathā datte dehenānuvisarpatī’ti | yadā naiti na pratyāgacchati sneha iti sambandhaḥ na tadā śithilāṅgādayo bhavanti | śithilasthāne sadanamiti pāṭhāntaram | tatra dadyānnirūhaṇamiti | tīkṣṇamiti nirūhamityasya viśeṣaṇam athavā tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ sadyuktyā phalavartirapyatra vihitā | pāṭhāntaro'pi ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairyuktā phalavartirhitā'thaveti’ phalavartistu vakṣyamāṇottarabastau draṣṭavyā | eke ‘tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ siddhaṃ vāpyanuvāsanami’ti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | ‘yadyanulomanavāyuḥ malaṃ snehaśca jāyate | tadā virecanaṃ dadyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate |’ tīkṣṇaṃ virecanaṃ nasyaṃ ca tīkṣṇamityarthaḥ | athāniḥsṛto'pi bastirna vikārāya bhavatītyata āha - nopadravāmiti upadravo'tra rogaḥ sa ca mukhakaṣāyatvādikaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘upadravābhibhūteṣu snehe bastikaṣāyatā | jṛmbhāvātarujastāstā vepathurviṣamajvara’ iti | raukṣyāditi | śarīraraukṣyādasnigdhaḥ yato rūkṣaṃ śarīraṃ bhāvayettenopakṣīṇaḥ sa khalu snehaḥ tattenopadravaṃ karoti | ata evopekṣita ityuktaṃ | upekṣya iti | tanniḥsaraṇāya pratikriyāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | ‘anāyātaṃ tvahorātrāt snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | snehabastāvanāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate’ ||41-45||

Gū. athavā yasya puruṣasya snehastatkālaṃ niryāti na tiṣṭhati tasya anyo'nyatarastasmādanyo bastirdeyaḥ | sneho vā bastyantare | yadā sneho naiti tadā kiṃ kartavyamityāha - aśuddhasya vamanādiśuddhirahitasya malonmiśraḥ snehaḥ yadā na yāti tathā śaithilyam ādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaśca jāyate utpadyate tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha | tatra nirūhaṇaṃ dadyāt | anyadapi tatra dīyate tadāha | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhayuktaphalavarttirhitā yathā vāyuḥ anulomanam anulomanatvaṃ vāyuryāti malaṃ snehaśca jāyate tathā kāryamiti tathā virecanaṃ dadyāt | tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca tatra śasyate | snehabastiryatra upadravaṃ na kuryāttatra kiṃ vidhātavyamityāha - aniḥsṛtaḥ aniṣkāsitaḥ | snehabastiryasya upadravaṃ śvāsaśūlādikaṃ na kuryāt sarvaḥ alpaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ rokṣyādvijānatā sa upekṣyaḥ ciraṃ sthāpyaḥ || 41-45 ||
ahorātrādaniḥsṛte pratīkāramāha -- anāyātaṃ tvahorātre snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | snehabastāvanāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate || 46 ||

Dī. anāyātaṃ aniḥsṛtaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanaiḥ śodhanabastibhirharet | kecit śodhanairityatra sopadravamiti paṭhanti | tatropadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ | anyaḥ snehaḥ snehabastirna vidhīyate | snehābhibhavāt śodhanabastistu deyaḥ | anāyātamityasya ślokasyāgre adhikaṃ paṭhanti yathā - ‘kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ tu pāyayeccāmlasaṃyutam | auṣṇyāttaikṣṇyāt saratvācca bastiḥ so'syānulomayet gomūtreṇa tṛvṛtpathyākalkaṃ vātrānulomanam |’ ityādi pāṭho bahupustakeṣvadṛṣṭaḥ, tasmādasmābhirapi na vyākhyātaḥ | ‘nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyata’ ityatra ‘tābhyāṃ sekaḥ praśasyata’ iti kecitpāṭhaṃ paṭhanti || 46 ||
Gū. ahorātre yadā snehaṃ na yāti tadā kiṃ kuryāt ? ityāha - ahorātre'nāyātaṃ snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | asnehabastau snehe anāyāte tadā tābhyāṃ sneho vidhīyate viśeṣeṇa sthāpyate || 46 ||

div.ab: athānuvāsanārthaṃ guḍūcyāditailamāha - guḍūcyeraṇḍapūtīkabhārṅgīvṛṣakarohiṣam || 47 || śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palonmitām | yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthānprasṛtonmitān || 48 || caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca | pacettailāḍhakaṃ peṣyairjīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 49 || anuvāsanametaddhi sarvavātavikāranut |

ab.seg: Dī. guḍūcyādīni kākanāsāntāni pratyekaṃ palonmitāni grāhyāṇi | tatra guḍūcī chinnaruhā, eraṇḍaḥ pañcāṅgulaḥ, pūtīkaḥ pūtikarañjaḥ, bhārṅgī dvijā, vṛṣo vāsakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ sugandhitṛṇaṃ, śatāvarī nārāyaṇī, sahacaraḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ, kākanāsā prasiddhā iti | yavādīni prasiddhāni prasṛtonmitāni paladvayamitāni pratyekaṃ grāhyāṇi | tailāḍhakaṃ kṛṣṇatilasnehaḥ āḍhakamitaḥ peṣyai: jīvanīyaiḥ pūrvoktakalkīkṛtaiḥ pratyekaṃ palonmitaiḥ iti | jīvanīyagaṇo yathā - ‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyuk kākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ || iti || 47-49 ||

Gū. athānuvāsanatailamāha - pūtīkaḥ karañja:, vṛṣakaḥ āṭarūṣakaḥ, rohiṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sahacaraḥ pītavāsā, kākanāsā kākajaṅghā, etāḥ palamitāḥ pratyekaṃ | yavādīn prasṛtonmitān paladvayonmitān | kolaṃ badaraṃ, jīvanīyairjīvanīyagaṇadravyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet | etadanuvāsanatailam || 47-49 ||

idānīṃ snehavyāpatcikitsāmāha ṣaṭsaptativyāpadastu‘ata ūrdhvaṃ vyāpado vakṣyāma: - tatra netracalitaṃ (1) vivartitaṃ (2) pārśvāvapīḍitaṃ (3,) atyutkṣiptam (4) avasannaṃ (5) tiryakkṣiptam (6) iti ṣaṭ praṇidhānadoṣāḥ, atisthūlaṃ (7) karkaśam (8) avanatam (9) aṇu (10) bhinnaṃ (11) sannikṛṣṭa-(12) viprakṛṣṭakarṇikaṃ (13) sūkṣmā- (14) tichidraṃ (15) atidīrgham (16) atihrasvaṃ (17) ityekādaśa netradoṣāḥ | bahalatā (18) alpatā (19) sacchidratā (20) prastīrṇatā (21) durbaddhatā (22) iti pañca bastidoṣāḥ | atipīḍitatā (23) śithilapīḍitatā (24) bhūyobhūyo'vapīḍanaṃ (25) kālātikramaḥ (26) iti catvāraḥ pīḍanadoṣāḥ | āmatā (27) hīnatā (28) atimātratā (29) atiśītatā (30) atyuṣṇatā (31) atitīkṣṇatā (32) atimṛdutā (33) atisnigdhatā (34) atirūkṣatā (35) atisāndratā (36) atidravatā (37) ityekādaśa dravyadoṣāḥ | (38) avāk- (39) śīrṣo-(40)cchīrṣa-nyubjo-(41) ttāna (42)saṅkucita (43) dehasthitatā-dakṣiṇā(44)pārśvaśāyina: pradānam, iti sapta śayyādoṣāḥ | evametāścatuścatvāriṃśat (44) vyāpado vaidyanimittāḥ | āturanimittā: pañcadaśa (15) āturopadravacikitsite vakṣyante (59)| snehastvaṣṭābhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pratihato na pratyāgacchati, tribhirdoṣaiḥ (1) aśanābhibhūto, (2) malavyāmiśro, (3) dūrānupraviṣṭo, (4) asvinnasya, (5) anuṣṇo, (6) alpaṃ bhuktavato, (7) alpaśceti (8) vaidyāturanimittā bhavanti (68) | 1 ayogastūbhayo-2 rādhmānaṃ, 3 parikartikā, 4 parisrāvaḥ, 5 pravāhikā, 6 hṛdayopasaraṇaṃ, 7 aṅgapragraho, 8 atiyogo jīvādānaṃ iti nava vyāpado vaidyanimittā bhavanti | (76) || suśru. ci. a. 36 jāyante bastikarmaṇā | dūṣitāt samudāyena tāścikitsyāstu suśrutāteṣāṃ cikitsā coktā suśrute - atha netre vicalite tathā caiva vivartite | gude kṣataṃ rujā vā syāttatra sadyaḥ kṣatakriyāḥ || atyutkṣipte'vasanne ca netre pāyau bhavedrujā | vidhiratrā'pi pittaghnaḥ kāryaḥ snehaiśca secanam || tiryakpraṇihite netre tathā pārśvāvapīḍite | mukhasyāvaraṇādbastirna samyakpratipadyate || ṛju netraṃ vidheyaṃ syāttatra samyagvijānatā | atisthūle karkaśe ca netre cāvanate tathā || gude bhavet kṣataṃ rukca sādhanaṃ pūrvavatsmṛtam | āsannakarṇike netre bhinne'ṇau vāpyapārthakaḥ || avaseko bhavedbastestasmāddoṣān vivarjayet | prakṛṣṭakarṇike raktaṃ gudamarmaprapīḍanāt || kṣaratyatrā'pi pittaghno vidhirbastiśca picchilaḥ | pratyāgacchaṃstataḥ kuryādrogān bastivighātajān || dīrghe mahāsrotasi ca jñeyamatyavapīḍavat | prastīrṇe bahale cāpi bastau durbaddhadoṣavat || bastāvalpe'lpatā vā'pi dravyasyā'lpaguṇā matāḥ | durbaddhe cāṇubhinne ca vijñeyaṃ bhinnanetravat || atiprapīḍito bastiḥ prayātyāmāśayaṃ tataḥ | vāterito nāsikābhyāṃ mukhato vā prapadyate || tatra tūrṇaṃ galāpīḍaṃ kuryāccāpyavadhūnanam | śiraḥkāyavirekau ca tīkṣṇau sekāṃśca śītalān || śanaiḥ prapīḍito bastiḥ pakvādhānaṃ na gacchati | na ca sampādayatyarthāṃstasmādyuktaṃ prapīḍayet || bhūyo bhūyo'vapīḍena vāyurantaḥ prapīḍyate | tenādhmānaṃ rujaścogrā yathāsvaṃ tatra bastayaḥ || kālātikramaṇātkleśo vyādhiścābhipravardhate| tatra vyādhibalaghnaṃ tu bhūyo vastiṃ nidhāpayet || gudopadehaśophau tu sneho'pakva: karoti hi | tatra saṃśodhano bastirhitaṃ cāpi virecanam || hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau matau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || mūrcchāṃ dāhamatīsāraṃ pittaṃ cātyuṣṇatīkṣṇakau | mṛduśītāvubhau vātavibandhādhmānakārakau || tatra hīnādiṣu hitaḥ pratyanīkaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ| tatra sāndre tanuṃ basti tanau sāndraṃ ca dāpayet|| snigdho'tijāḍyakṛdrūkṣastambhādhmānakṛducyate | basti rūkṣamatisnigdhe snigdhaṃ rūkṣe ca dāpayet || atipīḍitavaddoṣān vidhiṃ cāpyavaśīrṣake |ucchīryake samunnāhaṃ bastiḥ kuryācca mehanam || tatrottaro hito bastiḥ sukhinnasya sukhāvahaḥ | nyubjasya bastirnāpnoti pakvādhānaṃ vimārgagaḥ || hṛdgudaṃ bādhate cātra vāyuḥ koṣṭhamathāpi ca | uttānasyāvṛte mārge bastirnāntaḥ prapadyate || netrasaṃvejanabhrānto vāyuścāntaḥ prakupyati | dehe saṅkucite dattaḥ sakthnorapyubhayastathā || na samyaganilāviṣṭo bastiḥ pratyeti dehinaḥ | sthitasya bastirdattastu kṣipramāyātyavāṅmukhaḥ || na cāśayaṃ tarpayati tasmānnārthakaro hi saḥ | nāpnoti bastirdattastu kṛtsnaṃ pakvāśayaṃ punaḥ || dakṣiṇāśritapārśvasya vāmapārśvānugo yataḥ | nyubjādīnāṃ pradānaṃ ca basternaiva praśasyate || paścādanilakopo'tra yathāsvaṃ tatra kārayet | vyāpadaḥ snehabastestu vakṣyante taccikitsite || ayogādyāstu vakṣyāmi vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ | anuṣṇo'lpauṣadho hīno bastirnaiti prayojitaḥ || viṣṭambhādhmānaśūlaiśca tamayogaṃ pracakṣate | tatra tīkṣṇā hito bastistīkṣṇaṃ cāpi virecanam || saśeṣānne'thavā bhukte bahudoṣe ca yojitaḥ | atyāśitasyātibahurbastirmandoṣṇa eva ca || anuṣṇalavaṇasneho hyatimātro'thavā punaḥ | tathā bahupurīṣaśca kṣipramādhmāpayennaram || hṛtkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭheṣu śūlaṃ tatrātidāruṇam | tatra tīkṣṇataro bastirhitaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇo rūkṣo bastiḥ prayojitaḥ | sapittaṃ kopayedvāyuṃ kuryācca parikartikām || nābhibastigudaṃ tatra chinattīvātidehinaḥ | picchābastirhitastasya snehaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ || atyamlalavaṇastīkṣṇaḥ parisrāvāya kalpate | daurbalyamaṅgasādaśca jāyate tatra dehinaḥ || parisravettataḥ pittaṃ dāhaṃ sañjanayedgude | picchābastirhitastatra bastiḥ kṣīraghṛtena ca || pravāhikā bhavettīkṣṇānnirūhāt sānuvāsanam | sadāhaśūlaṃ kṛcchreṇa kaphāsṛgupaveśyate || picchābastirhitastatra payasā caiva bhojanam | sarpirmadhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇo nirūho vā savāte cānuvāsanaḥ | hṛdayasyopasaraṇaṃ kurute cāṅgapīḍanam || doṣaistatra rujāstāstā mado mūrcchāṅgagauravam | sarvadoṣaharaṃ bastiṃ śodhanaṃ tatra dāpayet || rūkṣasya bahuvātasya tathā duḥśayitasya ca | bastiraṅgagrahaṃ kuryādrūkṣo mṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ || tatrāṅgasādaḥ prastambho jumbhodveṣṭanavepakāḥ | parvabhedaśca tatreṣṭā: svedābhyañjanabastayaḥ || atyuṣṇatīkṣṇo'tibahurdatto'tisveditasya ca | alpadoṣasya vā bastiratiyogāya kalpate || virecanātiyogena samānaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam | picchābastiprayogaśca tatra śītaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || atiyogātparaṃ yatra jīvādānaṃ viriktavat | deyastatra hitaścāpi picchābastiḥ saśoṇitaḥ || navaitā vyāpado yāstu nirūhaṃ pratyudāhṛtāḥ | snehabastiṣvapi hitā vijñeyāḥ kuśalairiha || ityuktā vyāpadaḥ sarvāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ | bhiṣajā ca tathā kāryaṃ yathaitā na bhavanti hi || iti ||50||

Dī. bastivyāpadaśca suśrutāccikitsyā ityata āha - asyāgre kecidadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā - snehapītasya vātasya viriktasya sṛtāsṛjaḥ | nirūḍhasya ca kāyāgnirmando bhavati dehinaḥ || sa cālpairlaghubhiścānnairupayuktairvivardhate | kāṣṭhairaṇubhiralpaiśca saṃdhukṣita ivānalaḥ || yukte'gnau jīvati ciraṃ rogī syādvikṛtiṃ gate | śānte pañcatvamāyāti dehī tasmādbalo'nalaḥ’ || iti | etadarthaṃ cikitsāpi - ‘prātaruṣṇodakaṃ deyaṃ dhānyanāgarasādhitam | tenā'sya dīpyate vahnirbhaktākāṃkṣā ca jāyate’ iti | snehapītasya ityādipāṭhaḥ kṣepaka iti kṛtvā asmābhirapi nātra vyākhyātaḥ ||50||
Gū. bastikarmaṇaḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ vyāpadaḥ rogā jāyante utpadyante | tāḥ vyāpadaḥ suśrutāt cikitsyāḥ | kiṃbhūtādbastikarmaṇaḥ | dūṣitāt taddoṣairduṣṭā bastikriyāyāḥ ||50||

div.ab: anuvāsane pānādipathyamāha - pānāhāravihāraśca parihāraśca kṛtsnaśaḥ | snehapānasamāḥ kāryā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 51 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehabastividhirnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

Dī. snehapānasamā iti | ye pānā'hāravihārādaya: snehapānaviṣaye pūrvaṃ darśitāḥ, te'pyatra kramaśa: kāryāḥ | tenā'tra vicāraṇā na kāryā | āgamoktatvāt | pānādayo'pyatra tatratyā avagantavyāḥ | asyāgre paṭhanti, kecit - ‘aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakaṃ bastīnāṃ yo niṣevate | yathoktena vidhānena parihārakrameṇa ca || sa kuñjarabalo'śvatya javatulyo'maraprabhaḥ | nītivākyaśrutidharaḥ sahasrāyurnaro bhavet’ iti | anyadapi - ‘mūlasekādyathā vṛkṣa: snigdhaśca navapallava: | tathā bastipradānātsyānnara: kāntibalādimān’ iti || 51 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttare khaṇḍe bastividhiradhyāya: ||

ab.seg: Gū. pathyasaṃgrahamāha - pānāhāreti | sugamam || anuvāsananiruktimāha suśrutāt -‘anuvasannapi na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ nāpi na dūṣyate, anudivasaṃ vā dīyate ityanuvāsanam’|| 51 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi anuvāsana- bastyadhikāraḥ || 5 ||

div.head: atha nirūhabastividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha ṣaṣṭho'dhpāyaḥ | atha (pāriśeṣyāt) nirūhabastividhimāha - tatra tadbhedānāha - nirūhabastirbahudhā bhidyate kāraṇāntarai: | taireva tasya nāmāni kṛtāti muniṣuṅgavaiḥ ||1||
nirūhasyāparaṃ nāma proktamāsthāpanaṃ budhai: | svasthānasthāpanāddoṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam || 2 ||

div.ab: Dī. yo nirūhabasti: pūrvaṃ saṃgṛhīta:| so'pyatra kāraṇāntarai: kṛtvā bahudhā bhidyate kathyata ityartha: | kāraṇāntarāṇi vakṣyamāṇadoṣahara-saṃśamana-śodhana-lekhana-bṛṃhaṇāni picchila-yāpana-vaitaraṇabastiprabhūtīniboddhavyāni | taireva kāraṇāntaraireva tasyā nirūhabaste: nāmāni munipuṅgavai: ṛṣiśreṣṭhai: kṛtāni kathitāni ityabhiprāyaḥ, doṣaharabastirityādīni tasya viśeṣanāmānyāha -nirūhasyeti | budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ nirūhasya nāma āsthānaṃ proktaṃ, āsthāpayati vaya: iti āsthāpanaṃ paramutkṛṣṭam utkṛṣṭatvaṃ ca vayaḥsthāpanenaiva | athavā doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanādāsthāpanaṃ, tacca kṣīreṇa kvāthaiśca kriyate| uktaṃ ca - ‘snehairyo dīyate sa syādanuvāsananāmaka:| eke ‘svasthāpanaṃ sthāpanāddoṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam’ iti nāma paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | suśrute'pi -‘sadoṣanirharaṇāccharīrarohaṇādvā nirūha iti so'sthāpana iti nāma | asyāmapi niruktau sa eva | yathā vaya:sthāpanādvā'yu:sthāpanādvā''sthāpanaṃ, tataśca sarvadoṣanirharaṇānnirūha iti vamanādikam ||1||2||
Gū. atha nirūhaṇabastividhi: | nirūhasya nāmāntaramāha - sa doṣanirharaṇādvā nirūha:, tasya nirūhasya aparam āsthāpitaṃ nāma budhai: doṣadhātūnāṃ svasthāne sthāpanādvā nāma matam ||1||2||

ab.seg: atha doṣādyapekṣayā mātrāmāha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ ca prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prasthamuddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ ca kuḍavāstraya: ||3||

Dī. nirūhsya nirūhasaṃjñasyāsthāpanasya paramamutkṛṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ pādottaraṃ prasthaṃ sapādaprasthaṃ madhyaṃ prasthaṃ uddiṣṭham | traya: kuḍavā: hīnaṃ mānam | uktaṃ ca pārāśare - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prastha: pādottara: para:| madhyaprasthastu nirdiṣṭo vijñeyā: kuḍavāstraya:’ iti| uttamādimānaṃ ca doṣabalāpekṣayā'vagantavyam | nanu carakādāvanyathā paṭhitaṃ tadyathā - ‘ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi nirūhasyopakalpanam | dvādaśaprastutasyādau tato'nyānupakalpayet’ iti | tatkathamatra viṃśatipalānyuttamamātrāyāṃ pratipāditāni ? | satyam, dvādaśaprasṛtamāno nirūha: pañcāṅgamāno yuktyā darśita: | tathāhi - ‘madhusnehanakalkākhyakaṣāyā vāpyata: kramāt | trīṇi, ṣaṭ, dve, daśa, trīṇi palānyanilarogiṇām || pitte catvāri catvāri tri pañca ca catuṣṭayam | ṣaṭ, trīṇi, dve, daśa, trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | anyacca – ‘datvākṣaṃ saidhavasyādau madhuna: prasṛtidvayam| vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam || ekībhūte tata: snnehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet | saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catu:prasṛtasaṃmitam || vitarecca tathā'vāpamante dviprasṛtonmitam | vastrapūtaṃ tathoṣṇāmbukumbhībāṣpena tāpita: | evaṃ prakalpito bastirdvādaśaprasṛto bhavet || na dhāvatyauṣadhaṃ prāṇairna tiṣṭhatyavalipya ca| na karoti ca sīmāntaṃ sa nirūha: suyojita’ iti | etenotkṛṣṭadoṣabale dvādaśaprasṛtamāna: madhyabale viṃśatipalānītyadoṣa: | sāmānyaviśeṣakathanādadoṣa: | svakīyamate sāmānyaḥ paramate viśeṣa ityadoṣaḥ | yadvā śodhanasaṃśamanalekhanaprabhṛtīnāṃ bastīnāṃ viṣayatvena viṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ caturviṃśatiprabhṛtikaṃ mānamupadiśanti tadanumānato jñātavyaṃ granthagauravabhayānna likhitamityadoṣa: ||3||
Gū. nirūhapramāṇamāha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ pādottaraṃ vaṃkṣaṇādhikaṃ prasthaṃ mataṃ, prasthaṃ madhyamaṃ mataṃ, trayaḥ kuḍavā hīnaṃ matam || 3 ||
athānāsthāpanīyānāha - atisnigdhotkliṣṭadoṣau kṣatoraska: kṛśastathā | ādhmānacchardihikkārśa: kāsaśvāsaprapīḍitaḥ || 4 ||
gudaśophātisārārto viṣūcīkuṣṭhasaṃyutaḥ | garbhiṇī madhumehī ca nāsthāpyaśca jalodarī || 5 ||

div.ab: Gū. yeṣāṃ na vihitaṃ tānāha - vaya:sthāpanādāyuḥ sthāpanādvā sthāpanam āsthāpanaśabdena nirūhaṇamucyate’ tannirūhaṇakarma atisnigdhādīnāṃ na vidhīyate | utkliṣṭadoṣo vamanonmukhadoṣaḥ, kṣatamuro yasyāsau kṣatoraska:, kṛśo durbalaḥ, spaṣṭamanyat || 4 || 5 ||

Gū. ete nāsthāpyāḥ, cakārādanuvāsyāśca na | uktaṃca - ‘bhayonmādastathā śoṣājīrṇārucipramehinaḥ| mūrcchākuṣṭhodarasthaulyaśvāsakāsakṣayāturāḥ || śothabhramamadacchardiyutā bastyamalācalāḥ | nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāśca vātarogādṛte narāḥ’ iti | kuṣṭhaśabdenātra mahākuṣṭhaṃ grāhyaṃ na kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ tasya vihitatvāt | pramehagrahaṇāt sarvaprameheṣu hitam | evaṃ jalodaragrahaṇena anyodareṣu hitam | uktaṃ ca - ‘udarī ca pramehī ca kuṣṭhī sthūlaśca mānavaḥ | avaśyaṃ sthāpanīyāste nānuvāsyāsta eva‘kathaṃcana’ pā. | ca’ iti || 4 || 5 ||

ab.seg: atha nirūhyānāha - vātavyādhāvudāvarte vātāsṛgviṣamajvare | mūrcchātṛṣṇodarānāhamūtrakṛcchrāśmarīṣu ca ||6||
vṛddhāsṛgdaramandāgniprameheṣu nirūhaṇam | śūle'mlapitte hṛdroge yojayedvidhivadbudha: || 7 ||

div.ab: Dī. vātavyādhāviti | vātavyādhyādiṣu nirūhaṇam āsthāpanasaṃjñaṃ yojayet | vātavyādhiḥ ākṣepakādi:, udāvarta udarāpūra:, vātāsṛk vātaraktaṃ, viṣamajvara: ekāhikādi:, udaramatra jalodaravyatiriktaṃ sarvodaraṃ grāhyam | eke - ‘mūtrakṛcchrodarānāhamūtradoṣāśmarīṣu ca’ iti paṭhanti | tatra mūtradoṣaṃ mūtrāghātamapi jñeyam | athavā mūtragrahaṇena strīṇāmapi mūtraretorajodoṣā api gṛhyante | yaduktaṃ – ‘mūtraretorajodoṣān asṛgdaragrahaṇaṃ premeheṣu ityatrāpi madhumehavyatirekeṇānye pramehā grāhyā:| tasya niṣiddhatvāt | vidhivadityanena tantrāntaroktavidhānaṃ boddhavyam | tadyathā - ‘nātyucchritaṃ nāpyatinīcapādaṃ sapādapīṭhaṃ śayanaṃ praśastam | pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇopapannaṃ prākśīrṣakaṃ śuklapaṭottarīyam || prakṣipya bastau mathitaṃ khajena subaddhapucchāsya ca nirvalīkam | āṅguṣṭhamadhyena mukhaṃ pidhāya netrāgrasaṃsthāmapanīya vartim | tailāktagātraṃ kṛtamūtraviṭkaṃ nātikṣudhārtaṃ śayane manuṣyam || samethaveṣannataśairase vā nātyucchrite svāstaraṇopapanne | savyena pārśvena sukhaṃ śayānaṃ kṛtvā jayedasya bhujopanāham || niṣkuñcya savyetaradasya sakthiṃ vāmaṃ prasārya praṇayecca bastim | snnigdhe gude netracaturthabhāgaṃ snnigdhairjanairjānu ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśam || akampanā'vepanalāghavādīn pāṇyaṅgulīścāpi nidarśayanti | prapīḍya caikagrahaṇena datte netraṃ śanaireva tato'pakarṣayet || tiryakpraṇītena tu yātidhārā gude vraṇa: syāccalite ca netre | datta: śanairnāśayameti basti: kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvatyatipīḍitastu’ ityādi ||6||7||
Gū. yeṣāṃ nirūhaṇaṃ vihitaṃ tānāha - vātavyādhau vātaroge, udāvarte udāvartaroge tathāsṛgdararogādau nirūhaṇaṃ yojayet | jalodare niṣedhaḥ nānyasmin udare || 6 || 7||

yena prakāreṇa nirūhaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhasvinnamabhojitam | madhyāhne gṛhamadhye ca yathāyogyaṃ nirūhayet || 8 || snnehabastividhānena budhaḥ kuryānnirūhaṇam | jāte nirūhe ca tato bhavedutkaṭakāsanaḥ || 9 || tiṣṭhenmuhūrtamātraṃ tu nirūhāgamanecchayā | anāyātaṃ muhūrtaṃ tu nirūhaṃ śodhanairharet ||10|| nirūhaireva matimānkṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavaiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. evaṃvidhaṃ nirūhayet | utsaṣṭetyādi | utsaṣṭaṃ parityaktaṃ vātamūtrapurīṣaṃ yena | snigdhaṃ kṛtasnehanaṃ | svinnaṃ sveditam | abhojitamakṛtabhojanaṃ | madhyāhneti tasyocitakālatvakhyāpanārtham | gṛhamadhye iti | vātātaparajodoṣādinirāsārtham | snehabastividhānaṃ pūrvamevānuvāsanādhyāye uktam | budhagrahaṇaṃ nirūhadāne'tikuśalatvakhyāpanārtham | nirūhadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ityata āha - jāte iti | anāyate nirūhaṃ śodhanairnirūhairharet | śodhananirūhāḥ kṣārādibhiḥ kartavyāḥ | utkaṭakāsanaḥ ūrdhvajānusthitaḥ muhūrtaṃ ghaṭikādvayaparyantam | yadā muhūrtādupari anāyātaṃ nirūhaṃ syāt, tadā śodhanairnirūhaiḥ kṛtvā āharetkṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavairnirūhaṇairiti saṃbandhaḥ || anāyātasya vyāpattiruktā cakradatte - ‘aśuddhaśca malonmiśraḥ sreho naiti yadā punaḥ | tadāṅge sadanādhmānaśūlā: śvāsaśca jāyate || pakvāśayagurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyānnirūhaṇam | tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairevaṃ siddhaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam’ iti || 8-10 ||

Gū. evam utsṛṣṭānilamūtrādilakṣaṇaṃ nirūhayet | yathāyogyaṃ yathāvihitam utsṛṣṭaḥ niḥsṛtaḥ anilo vāyurviṭ purīṣaṃ, mūtraṃ ca yasya tam | snigdhaṃ snehitaṃ, svinnaṃ sveditam, abhojitam akṛtāhāraṃ, madhyāhne madhyāhnakāle gṛhamadhye gṛhābhyantare | nirūhaṇaṃ kena vidhinā kuryādityāha -pūrvokto yaḥ snehabastistadvidhānena budhaḥ nirūhaṇaṃ kuryāt | nirūhe jāte utkaṭakāsanaḥ utkaṭaṃ bhavet | punaḥ nirūhāgamanecchayā muhūrtamātraṃ tiṣṭhet | muhūrtāt anāyāntaṃ nirūhaṃ tataḥ śodhanairnirūhai: kṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavaireva śodhayet || 8-10 ||
atha sunirūḍhalakṣaṇamāha - yasya krameṇa gacchanti viṭpittakaphavāyavaḥ | lāghavaṃ copajāyeta sunirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||11 ||

Dī. yasya krameṇa tantrāntarokte'gnimūtrapittakaphavāyavaḥ gacchanti lāghavaṃ copajāyate sunirūhaṃ tamādiśet | uktaṃ ca dṛḍhabalena - ‘prasṛṣṭaviṇmūtrasamīraṇatvaṃ rucyagnivṛdhyāśayalāghavāni | rogopaśāṃtiḥ prakṛtisthatā ca balaṃ ca tatsyātsunirūḍhaliṅgam’ iti | sunirūḍhamityādinā caikadvitriprabhṛtinirūhadānaviṣayamuktam | uktaṃ ca - ‘eko'pakarṣatyanilaṃ svamārgātpittaṃ dvitīyastu kaphaṃ tṛtīya’ ityādi || 11 ||
atha durnirūhalakṣaṇamāha -- yasya syādvastiralpālpavego hīnamalānilaḥ | mūrcchārtijāḍyārujimān durnirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||12||

Dī. alpālpavega iti | bastidānena svalpadravānāmantaḥ praveśananiṣayaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘dattaḥ śanairnāśayameti bastiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ pradhāvatyatipīḍitastu’ iti | etena tūrṇamavalambitamiti | hīnamala iti hīnamalo bastirityarthaḥ | na purīṣādinirgamaḥ | yataḥ - ‘alpālpavego viḍvātahīno hīnanirūhaṇaḥ | mūrcchācchardikaphaprāyo mahāvego'tiśabditaḥ’ iti | mūrcchārtijāḍyārucimān iti | mūrcchāsthāne mūtrārtiriti pāṭhāntaram | jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā kaphaprāyetyabhiprāyaḥ | kecida- trāsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdānalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti | tadyathā - ‘viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ snigdhatā vyādhinigrahaḥ | āsthāpanasnehabastyoḥ samyagdāne tu lakṣaṇam’ iti || viviktatā manastuṣṭiḥ | sugamamanyat || 12 ||

Gū. durnirūhalakṣaṇamāha - āsthāpanasnehabastyo: samyagdāne lakṣaṇamāha - viviktatā ekāntatā, manastuṣṭiḥ manasaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ, snigdhatā sacikkaṇatā, vyādhinigrahaḥ roganāśaḥ | āsthāpitaṃ nirūhaṇaṃ | snehabastiḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tayoḥ samyagdāne idaṃ lakṣaṇam ||12||
nirūhasya bastidānavaddeyatāmāha - anena vidhinā yuñjyānnirūhaṃ bastidānavat | dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathocitam || 13||

Dī. anena pūrvoktena vidhinā nirūha bastidānavat bastidānatulyaṃ, vāgrahaṇāt prathamam ekaṃ, paścāddvitīyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturthaṃ ca | etena bastipuṭakaṃ kathitamiti bhāvaḥ | caturthaṃ vā yathocitamiti | yathārhamiti | nanu tṛtīyādhikapuṭamaniṣiddham | yathā - ‘snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane nirūho dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte | trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ’ iti | naivaṃ, niṣedho bahupuruṣaviṣayatayā prāyikaḥ, caturthapuṭadānaṃ tu kasminnapi krūrakoṣṭhe balīyasi bahudoṣe puruṣe, tataḥ kuto virodhaḥ | kecidatrāmuṃ ślokaṃ paṭhanti - sasneha ekaḥ pavane, pitte dvau payasā saha | kaṣāyakaṭumūtrāḍhyā:‘rūkṣādyā’ pā. kaphe koṣṇāstrayo hitāḥ || asyārthaḥ pūrvameva pratipakṣe darśitaḥ tenātra kairapi paṭhitaḥ || 13 ||

Gū. anena vidhinā bastidānavit nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt | nirūhasya dvitīyādiyojanavidhimāha - ekaṃ nirūhaṃ dvitīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ nirūhaṃ vā yathocitaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yuñjyāt | tatra nirūhayojane doṣakramamāha - pavane vāte ekaḥ nirūhaḥ sasneha eva | dvau nirūho pitte payasā dugdhena saha | kaṣāyakaṭurūkṣādyāḥ kaphe trayaḥ koṣṇāḥ || 13 ||
atha bhojanakramamāha - pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ kramāt | nirūhaṃ bhojayitvā ca tatastamanuvāsayet || 14 ||

Dī. pittādīnāmatra kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ saha bhojanaṃ kāryam | kramāditi anukrameṇaiva | anukramo yathā - pittāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ kṣīrodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścādanuvāsayet, bṛṃhaṇārthamiti bhāvaḥ | śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣodanaṃ bhojayitvā paścādanuvāsanaṃ deyam | anilāviṣṭaṃ māṃsarasaudanaṃ bhojayitvā anuvāsayediti padārthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ’pratyāgate koṣṇajalāvasiktaḥ śālyannamadyāttanunā rasena | jīrṇe ca sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto'nuvāsya: paribṛṃhaṇārtham’ iti || 14 ||
Gū. pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayet kramāt kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ | pittāviṣṭaṃ kṣīraiḥ, śleṣmāviṣṭaṃ yūṣaiḥ, anilāviṣṭaṃ rasaiḥ | evaṃ nirūhaṃ yojayitvā paścādanuvāsanaṃ kārayet || 14 ||
idānīṃ bālavṛddhayormṛdubastimāha - sukumārasya vṛddhasya bālasya ca mṛdurhitaḥ | bastistīkṣṇaḥ prayuktastu teṣāṃ hanyādbalāyuṣī ||15||

Dī. sukumārādīnāṃ mṛdurbastirhitaḥ | ’tu’ punaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ bastiḥ prayuktaḥ teṣāṃ balāyuṣī hanyāt | tantrāntare viśeṣaḥ | ‘viśeṣātsukumārāṇāṃ hīna eva kramo hitaḥ | mṛdurbastiḥ prayoktavyo viśeṣādbālavṛddhayoḥ’ iti || 15 ||
Gū. kīdṛśaṃ nirūhaṃ yuñjyāt ? tadāha - sukumārādermṛdurbastirhitaḥ | tīkṣṇabastisteṣāṃ balāyuṣī ||15||
idānīṃ bastīnāṃ dānakramamāha - dadyādutkleśanaṃ pūrvaṃ madhye doṣaharaṃ tataḥ | paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ ca dadyādbastiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16 ||
Dī. utkleśanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ, doṣaharaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ, saṃśamanaṃ doṣāṇāṃ samīkaraṇācchamanam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||16||

Gū. ādau madhye ante ca kīdṛśaṃ basti yuñjyāt ? tadāha - utkleśanaṃ dadyāt ukleśanaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ, madhye doṣaharaṃ vātādidoṣaśamanaṃ, paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ samasthāpakaṃ upaśamakaramityarthaḥ || 16 ||
atha teṣāṃ svarūpāṇyāha -- utkleśanabastiḥ | eraṇḍabījaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī saindhavaṃ vacā | hapuṣā phalakalkaṃ ca bastirutkleśanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17||
Dī. ayamutkleśanasaṃjño bastiḥ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||17 ||
Gū. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā || 17 ||
atha doṣaharabastimāha - śatāhvā madhukaṃ bilvaṃ kauṭajaṃ phalameva ca | sakāñjikaḥ sagomūtro bastirdoṣaharo mataḥ || 18||
Gū. madhukaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, kauṭajaṃ phalam indrayavaḥ ||18||
atha teṣāṃ doṣaharamāha -- priyaṅgu madhukaṃ mustaṃ tathaiva ca rasāñjanam | sakṣīraḥ śasyate bastirdoṣāṇāṃ śamanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||19||
Dī. ayaṃ doṣasaṃśamano bastiḥ | priyaṅguḥ kāntā, rasāñjanamatra kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravaviśeṣaḥ | tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ yojyam || 19 ||
śodhanabastimāha - śodhanadravyani:kvāthaistatkalkaiḥ snehsaindhavaiḥ | yuktyā khajena mathitā bastaya: śodhanā: smṛtā: ||20||

Dī. śodhanadravyāṇi nikumbhādīni prasiddhāni | tāni nikumbha-triphalā-gavakṣīra-snuk-śaṃkhinī-nīlinī-tilvakāni, śamyāka-kampillaka-hemadugdhā-dugdhaṃ ca virecanāni ityādīni | ‘khajena’ ityatra ‘kṣaṇena’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ || 20 ||
lekhanabastimāha - triphalākkāthagomūtrakṣaudrakṣārasamāyutāḥ | uṣakādipratīvāpā bastayo lekhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||21||
Dī. uṣakādiḥ prāguktaḥ | yathā - oṣakādisaindhavaśilājatukāsīsadvayahiṃgūni truṭakaśceti | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 21 ||
Gū. athe lekhanabastayaḥ - kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ | uṣakādirgaṇaḥ suśrute | lekhanā medorogādikṛśīkaraṇāt || 21 ||
atha bṛṃhaṇabastīnāha - bṛṃhaṇadravyaniṣkvāthā: kalkairmadhurakairyutāḥ | sarpirmāṃsarasopetā bastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 ||
Dī. bṛṃhaṇāni kākolī-kṣīrakākolī-jīvakarṣabhaka-medā-mahāmedāprabhṛtīni madhurakairiti | drākṣā-kharjūra-vātāmadīni || śeṣaṃ subodham || 22 ||
Gū. bṛṃhaṇā bastayaḥ matāḥ kathitāḥ || 22 ||

div.ab: picchilabastimāha - badaryai-rāvatī-śelu-śālmalī-dhanvanāgarāḥ | kṣīrasiddhāḥ kṣaudrayuktā nāmrā picchilasaṃjñitāḥ | ajorabhraiṇarudhirairyuktā deyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 23 || mātrā picchilabastīnāṃ palairdvādaśabhirmatā |

ab.seg: Dī. badarī prasiddhā (kolam), airāvatī nāgabalā iti bhānumatī, śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvanāgaro dhanvadeśajo nāgaramustam | dhanvanāgarasthāne ‘dhanvanākurāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ, dhanvayāsakāṃkurāḥ || ajaḥ chāga:, urabhro meṣa:, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | eke suśrutādhyāyino'tra paṭhanti - ‘varāhamahiṣorabhrabaiḍālaiṇeyakaukkuṭam | sadyaskamasṛgājaṃ vā deyaṃ picchilabastiṣu’ iti | tathā vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣepako'yamiti manyamānatvāt na samyak likhitaḥ | mātrāpicchilabastīnāmiti | dvādaśapalairevātra pūrmoktā hīnamātrā niyatā viśeṣagrahaṇāt ||23||

Gū. atha picchilabastayaḥ - badarī kolam, airāvatī nāgaraṅgaphalaṃ, śelu gundriṇī, śālmalī prasiddhā, dhanvo yavāsaka:, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī | ajā barkarī, urabhra ūrṇāmeṣaḥ, eṇo mṛgaḥ tadrudhireṇa deyaḥ | tatpramāṇaṃ dvādaśapalam || 23 ||

div.ab: atha nirūhārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇapūrvakaṃ vidhānamāha - dattvādau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtidvayam || 24 || vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam | ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet ||25|| saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam | kṣiptvā vimathya dadyācca nirūhaṃ kulaśo bhiṣak ||26|| vāte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyātsnehasya ṣaṭpalam | pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyātpalatrayam || 27 || kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipetsnehaṃ catuṣpalam |

ab.seg: Dī. atra saindhavaparimāṇaṃ tūttamamātrāyāṃ na gaṇitam ata eva ‘ādau’ iti grahaṇaṃ kṛtam | uttamamātrā viṃśatipalaireva | pūrvamuktaṃ yathā - ‘nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ tu prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prasthamuddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ tu kuḍavāstraya’ iti | cakradatte tu - ‘dattvākṣaṃ saindhavasyādau madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam | vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam || ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet | saṃmūrcchitaiḥ kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam || kṣiptvā vimathya dadyācca nirūhaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak | vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyātsnehasya ṣaṭpalam || pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyātpalatrayam | kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipet snehaṃ catuḥpalam || vitarecca yathāvāpamante dviprasṛtonmitam | evaṃ prakalpito bastirdvādaśaprasṛto bhavet’ iti | etadapi pañcāṅgamānayuktyā samīcīnaṃ darśitam | tathāhi -‘madhusnehana-kalkākhyakaṣāyāvāpataḥ kramāt | trīṇi ṣaṭ dve daśatrīṇi palānyanilarogiṇām | pittaṃ catvāri catvari tripañca ca catuṣṭayam || ṣaṭ trīṇi dve daśa trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam’ iti | vātādīnāṃ kevalamadhusnehayorviśeṣamānamāha - vāte catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudram ityādi | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 24-27 ||

Gū. atha nirūhaḥ | saindhavasya akṣaṃ dadyāt | madhunā prasṛtidvayaṃ catu:palaṃ snehasya tailāde: prasṛtitrayaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ kalakasya dravyasya prasṛtiḥ dvipalam | saṃmūrcchite paripakve kaṣāye catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam aṣṭapalaṃ kṣiptvā vimathya nirūhaṃ dadyāt, vāte kṣaudraṃ catuḥpalaṃ snehaṃ catuḥpalam evaṃ vibhajya deyam | iti nirūhaṇamātrāvidhi: || 24-27 ||
madhutailikasaṃjñaṃ bastividhānamāha - eraṇḍakkāthatulyāṃśaṃ madhutailaṃ palāṃśakam || 28 ||
śatapuṣpāpalārdhena saindhavārdhena saṃyutam | madhutailakasaṃjño'yaṃ basti: khajaviloḍita: || 29 ||
medogulmakṛmiplīhamalodāvartanāśana:| balavarṇakaraścaiva vṛṣyo dīpanabṛṃhaṇaḥ || 30 ||

Dī. madhutailaṃ palāṃśakamityasya sthāne madhutailapalāṣṭakamityeke paṭhanti | tanna, uktaṃ ca tantrāntare - ‘madhutaile same syātāṃ kvāthaścairaṇḍamūlajaḥ | palārthaṃ śatapuṣpāyāstato'rdhaṃ saindhavasya ca | palenaikena saṃyuktaṃ khajena tu viloḍita: | deya: sukhoṣṇo bhiṣajā madhutailasaṃkara’ iti | malodāvartanāśane ityatra udarodāvartanāśana iti pāṭha: | ayameva tantrāntare ardhamātrikanirūha: kathita: sa tu tatraiva jñātavya: ||28-30||
Gū. śatapuṣpā palārdhena yojyā saindhavārdhena ca saṃyutaṃ | madhutailakasaṃjño'yaṃ bastirmedogulmādiharaḥ | khajaviloḍita iti khajo manthānaviśeṣa:, tena viloḍita: mathitaḥ || 28-30||
atha yāpanabastimāha - kṣaudrā-jya-kṣīra-tailānāṃ prasṛtaṃ prasṛtaṃ bhavet | hapuṣāsaindhavākṣāṃśo basti: syāddīpanaḥ para: || 31 ||
Dī. hapuṣā vipuṣā || 31 ||
Gū. atha yāpanabastimāha - kṣaudrādīnāṃ prasṛtirdvipalaṃ, hapuṣā prasiddhā, saindhavaṃ ca etayorakṣāṃśau dvau dvau akṣau karṣau ||31 ||
atha yuktarathabastimāha - eraṇḍamūlaniṣkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam | eṣa yuktaratho basti: savacāpippallīphalaḥ || 32 ||

Dī. kvāthādīnāṃ pariramāṇaṃ tu madhutailikabastivajjñeyam | tasyāntaḥpātitvāt | ‘yaduktaṃ madhutailaṃ ca kkāthaṃ sarasasaindhavam | phalapippalīsaṃyukto bastiryuktaratha: smṛta:’ iti | atrā'pi pūrvoktameva | phalamatra madanaphalam | iti yuktarathaḥ || 32 ||
Gū. atha yuktarathabasti: - phalo madanaphalaḥ, eṣa yuktaratho nāma bastiḥ || 32 ||
atha siddhabastimāha - pañcamūlasya niṣkvāthastailaṃ māgadhikā madhu | sasaindhava: samadhukaḥ siddhabastiriti smṛta: || 33 ||
Dī. sugamam || iti siddhabastinirūha: ||33||
Gū. pañcamūlaṃ bṛhadbilvādi:, tasya niṣkvātha:, tailaṃ tilatailaṃ, māgadhikā pippalī, madhu kṣaudraṃ, saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ, madhuko madhukasāra iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ ||33||
pathyāpathyamāha - snānamuṣṇodakaiḥ kuryāt divā svapnamajīrṇatām | varjayedaparaṃ sarvam, ācaretsnehabastivat || 34 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nirūhabasti- vidhiradhyāya: samāpta: || 6 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha tyājyānyāha - snehabastivaditi | snehabastividhau yadācaritaṃ tatsarvam ācaret | tattatraiva jñātavyam || 34 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe bastinirūhakalpanādhyāya: samāpta: ||

ab.seg: Gū. bastau sevyaṃ niṣedhaṃ ca - uṣṇodakena snānaṃ kuryāt iti vihitam | tathā snehabastau yadvihitaṃ tadācaret | divā svāpam ajīrṇatāṃ ca varjayet || 34 ||
iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāṭīkāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe pañcakarmaṇi nirūhabastividhiradhyāya: ṣaṣṭha:|| 6||

div.head: atha uttarabastividhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | pāriśeṣyāduttarabastimāha - ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bastimuttarasaṃjñitam | dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ netraṃ madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam || 1 || mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ chidraṃ sarṣapasannibham |

ab.seg: Dī. ataḥ paraṃ bastinirūhayoranantaram uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi iti | uttarabastinetrasvarūpamāha - madhye ca kṛtakarṇikamiti | madhye ṣaḍaṅgulopari karṇikā mekhalākārā mudrikā | ata eva mūtramārge ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ netraṃ praveśayedityuktamagre | yantracchidraṃ tu mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kāryaṃ sarṣapākāram | yantre chidramāha - chidraṃ sarṣapasannibhaṃ nirgamacchidramityartha: | kecit ‘sarṣapanirgamam’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti | siddhārthakapraveśāgramiti tantrāntare | nanu kvacidapi caturdaśāṃgulamapi paṭhitaṃ tadyathā - ‘caturdaśāṅgulaṃ netraṃ tatra kāryaṃ vijānatā | mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ kartavyaṃ chidrameva ca’ iti | tatkathamatra dvādaśāṃgulam ? ucyate, karṇikārthaṃ tu netraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulameva sarvasaṃmatam | śeṣaṃ tu carmapuṭakasya samīcīnagrathanārthaṃ kathitamityadoṣaḥ | carakādau tu dvādaśāṃgulamevoktatvāt, athavā - ‘meḍhrāyāmasamaṃ kecidicchanti khalu tadvida’ ityādi matamālocya carakamatameva śārṅgadhareṇa svīkṛtamityalaṃ vistareṇa || 1 ||

Gū. ataḥ param uttarasaṃjñitaṃ bastiṃ pravakṣyāmi pūrvaṃ vidhānamāha - dvādaśāṃgulikaṃ netraṃ nālikā lakṣaṇaṃ madhye kṛtakarṇikaṃ kamalapatrakarṇikāvanmadhyabhāgaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ sthūlaṃ punaḥ chidre sarṣapanirgamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā chidram || 1 ||

div.ab: snehamātrāmāha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmadho mātrā dvikārṣikā || 2 || tadūrdhvaṃ palamātrā ca snehasyoktā bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmadhaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣādadho'rvāk caturviṃśatiparyantaṃ mātrā snehasya dvikārṣikī | tadūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśādūrdhvaṃ palamātrā | bhiṣagvarairiti grahaṇena doṣadeśadehakālānalādyapekṣya nyūnādhikā'pi mātrā yojyā sampradāyadarśanāt | ata evoktaṃ -‘pañcaviṃśativarṣonamadho mātrā dvikārṣikī’ iti kvacitpāṭho'pi || 2 ||
Gū. vayo'numānena pramāṇamāha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇām adhovayasāṃ snehasya tailāderdvikārṣikī palārdhamānamātrā, tadūrdhvaṃ pañcaviṃśaterūrdhvaṃ snehasya palamānā mātrā || 2 ||

div.ab: athottarabastervidhānamāha - athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ || 3 || sthitasya jānumātre ca pīṭhe'nviṣya śalākayā | snigdhayā meḍhramārge ca tato netraṃ niyojayet || 4 || śanaiḥ śanairghṛtābhyaktaṃ meḍhrarandhre'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ | tato'vapīḍayedbastiṃ śanairnetraṃ ca nirharet || 5 || tataḥ pratyāgate snehe snehabastikramo hitaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | āsthāpanaṃ kaṣāyabastiḥ, kaṣāyairdīyamānatvāt | nirūhamevāsthāpanakamityeke | kasya ? snānabhojanaiḥ tṛptasya, bhojanagrahaṇena ghṛtakṣīramāṃsādīnāṃ grahaṇam | uktaṃ ca - ‘athāntaramupasnigdhaṃ svinnaṃ praśithilāśayam | yavānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pītavantaṃ yathābalam’ ityādi | jānumātre pīṭhe iti jānuparimāṇe āsane | uccatayā boddhavyam | uktaṃ ca -‘niṣaṇṇamājānusame pīṭhe’ ityādi | anviṣya śalākayā iti meḍhramārgaṃ śalākayā anviṣya anveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā | kiṃviśiṣṭayā śalākayā snigdhayā ślakṣṇayā | athavā ghṛtābhyañjanena vā | tato netraṃ niyojayet iti | netraṃ nalikā uttarabastisaṃjñasya |‘athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ’ asyāgre - ‘svabhyaktabastiśīrṣasya tailenoṣṇena yuktitaḥ | tataḥ samaṃ sthāpayitvā nālamasya praharṣitam’ ityeke paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, prācīnapustake na dṛṣṭaḥ | atha yantrapīḍanamāha - netraṃ yantraṃ ghṛtābhyaktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ meḍhrarandhre meḍhramārge praveśayedvaidya iti śeṣaḥ | ata evoktaṃ prāk ‘madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam’ iti | tena karṇikāparyantaṃ sasnigdhaṃ meḍhramārge praveśayedityarthaḥ | tato'nantaraṃ praveśānantaraṃ bastiṃ snehādisaṃbhṛtaṃ carmapuṭakaṃ śanairyathāsyādavapīḍyate yathā'ntaḥ sneho'ntaḥ praviṣṭo bhavati | netraṃ ca harediti | punaḥ śanairyathā syāttathā netraṃ haret mūtramārgādityarthaḥ | snehe pratyāgate snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ | ‘snehabastikramo hita’ ityasya sthāne -‘aparāhṇe vicakṣaṇaḥ | payasā bhojayedenaṃ yūṣairmāṃsarasena vā’ iti kecit, tadapi yuktaṃ tantrāntarasaṃvādāt | ‘snehakramo hita’ iti tatra granthakarturayamāśayaḥ - tatra samyagdattasya liṅgāni bhavanti, vyāpadaśca tāḥ | tatratyopakramaśca kartavyaḥ | uktaṃ ca - ‘samyagdattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca | basteruttarasaṃjñasya samānaḥ snehabastinā’ iti ||3-5 ||

Gū. athottarabastidāne yogyamāha - athānantaram āsthāpane tu nirūhaṇena śuddhasya punaḥ snānabhojanaistaptasya punaḥ jānumātre pīṭhe sthitasya iṣṭaśalākayā snigdhayā kṛtaṃ netramārgaṃ | tataḥ netram uttarabastinalikāṃ yojayet | śanaiḥ śanairghṛtābhyaktaṃ ghṛtavyāptaṃ netraṃ meḍhrarandhre ṣaṭ aṅgulāni yojyaṃ, bastinā pīḍayet | punaḥ śanairnetraṃ nirharet niṣkāsayet | tataḥ snehe pratyāgate ayaṃ snehabastikramaḥ hitaḥ kathitaḥ || 3-5 ||
puṃsāmuttarabastinetramuktvā strīṇāmuttarabastimāha - strīṇāṃ kaniṣṭhikāsthūlanetraṃ kuryāddaśāṃgulam || 6 ||
mudgapraveśayogyaṃ ca yonyantaścaturaṅgulam | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca sūkṣmaṃ netraṃ niyojayet || 7 ||

div.ab: Dī. kaniṣṭhikā striya eva | daśāṅgulamiti | dairghyeṇa mudgapraveśaṃ randhramiti śeṣaḥ | tena mudgavāhinalikācchidramityarthaḥ | yonyantaścaturaṅgulamiti | tacca netramatyarthamārge caturaṅgulapramāṇamantaḥ praveśayedityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca - mūtrasrotaḥparīṇāhamudgavāhidaśāṅgulam | tāsāmatyarthamārge tu nidadhyāccaturaṅgulam’ iti | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca iti | strīṇāmatra mūtramārge jñeyam | tatra dvyaṅgulanetraṃ praveśayediti bhāvaḥ | tacca sūkṣmanetraṃ kāryaṃ yathā puruṣameḍhramārgārthaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛttābhaṃ kathitaṃ tadvadatrā'pi jñeyam || 6 || 7 ||
Gū. atha strīṇāṃ bastidāne vidhimāha -- strīṇāmiti sugamam || 6 || 7 ||

ab.seg: bālānāmapi netraparimāṇamāha - mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu bālānāṃ tvekamaṅgulam | śanairniṣkampamādheyaṃ sūkṣmanetraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 ||

Dī. mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu iti padaṃ pūrveṇa saṃbandhanīyam | bālānāmapi vā mūtrakṛcchravikāre'pi bālaḥ ‘ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyanto bālaḥ’ ekamaṅgulaṃ netreṇa saṃbandhanīyam | sūkṣmanetramityanena mālatīpuṣpavṛttākāratvāt sūkṣmatvaṃ jñeyam || 8 ||
Gū. atha bālānāṃ bastidānapramāṇamāha - mūtrakṛcchreti sugamam || 8 ||
athāpatyamūtramārgayorviṣayatvāt snehaparimāṇamāha - yonimārgeṣu nārīṇāṃ snehamātrā dvipālikī | mūtramārge palonmānā bālānāṃ ca dvikārṣikī ||9||
Dī. yonyādimārgatrayaṃ strīṇāmeva | kiṃ tu punarbālānāṃ dvikarṣapramāṇā iti || 9 ||
Gū. strīṇāṃ bālānāṃ ca snehamātrāpramāṇamāha - dvipālikī dvipalapramāṇā | bālānāṃ dvikārṣikī dvikarṣamānā || 9 ||

div.ab: atha strīṇāmuttarabastiḥ kathaṃ yojyaḥ ? ityāha - uttānāyai striyai dadyādūrdhvajānvai vicakṣaṇaḥ | apratyāgacchati bhiṣagbastāvuttarasaṃjñite || 10 || bhūyo bastiṃ nidadhyācca saṃyuktaiḥ śodhanairgaṇaiḥ | phalavartiṃ nidadhyādvā yonimārge dṛḍhāṃ bhiṣak || 11|| sūtrairvinirmitāṃ snigdhāṃ śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | dahyamāne tathā bastau dadyādbastiṃ viśāradaḥ || 12 || kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa payasā śītalena vā | bastiḥ śukrarujaḥ puṃsāṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam|| 13|| hanyāduttarabastistu nocito mehināṃ kkacit |

ab.seg: Dī. vicakṣaṇasthāne samāhita iti vā pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ | asyāgre - ‘anena vidhinā dadyāt bastīn trīn caturo'pi vā’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | anirgame punarbastirdeya ityata āha - uttarasaṃjñite bastau pratyāgacchati sati bhūyaḥ punarapi bastimuttarasaṃjñaṃ nidadhyāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ ? śodhanairgaṇaiḥ saṃyuktam | śodhanagaṇo virecanagaṇaḥ | vā athavā phalavartiṃ nidadhyāt | kva ? yonimārge apatyamārge | kiṃbhūtāṃ ? dṛḍhām aśithilām | ata eva sūtrairvinirmitām | tathā snigdhāṃ tathā śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | śodhanadravyakṛtāmityarthaḥ | vartistu agre vakṣyamāṇā jñātavyā | asyāgre kecidadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā -- ‘payobastiṃ nidadhyāttu proktaṃ gulmacikitsitam | praveśayedvā matimān bastidvāre ca peṣaṇī || pīḍayedvāpyadho nābherbastinā pariveṣṭitaḥ | āragvadhasya patreṣu nirguṇḍyā: svarasasya ca || kuryādgomūtrapiṣṭeṣu vartiṃ cā'pi sasaindhavām | mudgailāsarṣapasamāṃ pravibhajya payāṃsi ca || basterāgamanārthāya tannidadhyācchalākayā |’ ityādipāṭho bahupustakeṣvadarśanānna vyākhyātaḥ | atha bastidāhacikitsāmāha - dravyasyānirgamādbastau mūtrāśaye dahyamāne sati viśārado vaidyakaśāstrakriyākuśalaḥ kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa bastiṃ dadyāt | vā athavā śītalena payasā bastiṃ dadyāt | kṣīravṛkṣā vaṭodumbarādayaḥ | eke kṣīravṛkṣaṃ rājādanamāhuḥ | rāyaṇīti loke | payo'tra pānīyamāhuḥ | śītaleti | śītaladravyamadhukādiyuktatvena śītalena ityarthaḥ | yaduktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘śarkarāmadhumiśreṇa śītena madhukāmbunā | dahyamāne bhiṣak bastau pāyau bastiṃ pradāpayet’ iti | athānantaraṃ basteḥ prabhāvapūrvakaṃ niṣedhamāha - puṃsāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vasādyāśritā rujaḥ rogān strīṇāmārtavajā rujaḥ asṛgdarādayaḥ hanyāt | mehināṃ pramehiṇāṃ nocitaḥ na yuktaḥ | pramehasya bastigatatve'pi nocitatvam | yathānuvāsanaṃ kuṣṭhapramehināṃ niṣiddham | kecinmehaśabdena madhumehamāhuḥ || 10-13 ||

Gū. uttānāyai bhiṣak dadyāditi saṃbandhaḥ | tathā dadyāt yathā snehaḥ pratyāgacchati | bhūyaḥ punaḥ kṛcchre viśeṣavyādhau śodhanairgaṇaiḥ eraṇḍatailādibhirbastiṃ nidadhyāt | yonimārge bastyabhāve phalavartikāṃ nidadhyāt | phalānām eraṇḍabījādīnāṃ vartiryadvā phalasadṛśī vartiḥ phalanāmnī vāsoghanadravyasaṃyutasya sūtreṇa vinirmitāṃ punaḥ snigdhām evaṃbhūtā vartiṃ dadyāt | vartyā dahyamāne bastau mūtrākāśe kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa udumbarādi punaḥ payasā śītalena bastiḥ puṃsāṃ śukradoṣajā rujaḥ strīṇām ārtavajā rujaḥ uttarabastirhanyāt | mehinaḥ kvacit na ucitaḥ || 10-13 ||

div.ab: uttarabasteḥ snehabastisamānāyāḥ guṇadoṣānāha - samyagdattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca || 14 || basteruttarasaṃjñasya samānaṃ snehabastinā |

ab.seg: Dī. uttarasaṃjñasya uttarabasteḥ snehabastinā'nuvāsanena samāni liṅgāni lakṣaṇāni tathā vyāpadaḥ hīnātimithyāyogajaḥ kramaśca upakramaśca samānaḥ snehabastinā tulya ityarthaḥ | tantrāntare tu — ‘duṣṭaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitaṃ cāṅganānāmasṛgdaraṃ tasya nāśaṃ ca puṣpam | mūtrāghātaṃ mūtradoṣān pravṛddhān yonerdoṣān tatparāyāśca saṃgam | śukrāghātaṃ śarkarāmaśmarīṃ ca śūlaṃ bastau vaṃkṣaṇe mehane ca | ghorānanyānbastijāṃścāpi rogān mohādṛte uttaro hanti bastiḥ’ iti || 14 ||
Gū. samyagdattalakṣaṇamāha - śamanaṃ śukratvaśamanaṃ bhavati | pramehalakṣaṇaṃ śamanaṃ bhavati || 14 ||
atha pūrvoddiṣṭāṃ phalavartimāha - ghṛtābhyakte gude kṣepyā ślakṣṇā svāṅguṣṭhasannibhā ||15||
malapravartanī vartiḥ phalavartiśca sā smṛtā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

div.ab: Dī. ślakṣṇā komalā, svāṃguṣṭhasannibhā āturāṃguṣṭhatulyā sthūlatayā | malaṃ mūtrapurīṣādikam | malaśabdena strīṇāmapi rajodoṣādikam | apatyamārge deyā īdṛśī phalavartiḥ smṛtā kathitā || 15 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ cottarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhiradhyāyaḥ ||

Gū. phalavartimāha - tatpramāṇā sā phalavartiḥ, malapravartanī bhavati | phalānāṃ vā nirmitā || 15 || iti śrīkāśirāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ pañcakarmaṇi uttarabastividhi- radhyāyaḥ saptamaḥ ||

div.head: atha nasyavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha nasyavidhiḥ | nasyasya niruktimāha - nasyaṃ tatkathyate nīrairnāsāgrāhyaṃ yadauṣadham | nāvanaṃ nasyakarmeti tasya nāmadvayaṃ matam || 1 ||

Dī. atha pañcakarmapāriśeṣyānnasyavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - nasyeti | auṣadhaṃ kvāthasvarasasnehādi, nasyamiti nāsayā dīyate iti nasyam | tasya nasyasya nāmadvayaṃ coktam, nāvanamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ nasyamiti || 1||
Gū. atha nasyavidhiḥ | tatra nasyalakṣaṇaṃ dhīrairyat nāsāgrāhyamauṣadhaṃ tat nasyaṃ kathyate | nāvanaṃ nasyakarma ceti tasya nāmadvayam || 1 ||
nasyabhedānāha - nasyabhedo dvidhā prokto recanaḥ snehanastathā | recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ matam || 2 ||

Dī. nāsikayā dīyate yattat nasyaṃ tasya bhedo dviprakāraḥ, eko recanaḥ dvitīyaḥ snehanaḥ, recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇam, upakramyasya dvitvāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘upakramyasya hi dvitvāddvidhaivopakramo mataḥ | ekaḥ saṃtarpaṇastatra dvitīyaścāpatarpaṇaḥ’ iti | nanu vāgbhaṭena trividhaṃ nasyaṃ saviṣayamuktaṃ tadyathā - ‘virecanaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ jāḍyaṃ spandagalāmaye | śophagaṇḍakrimigranthiku- ṣṭhāpasmārapīnase || bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātaje śūle sūryāvarte svarakṣaye | nāsā'syaśoṣe vāksaṃge kṛcchrabodhe'vabāhuke | śamanaṃ nīlikāvyaṅgakeśadoṣākṣirājiṣu || yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehairyathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ | kalkakvāthādibhiścādyaṃ madhupaṭvāsavairapi || bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhanvamāṃsottharasāsṛksvapurairapi | śamanaṃ yojayetpūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti, tatkathamatra dvividhaṃ coktam ? ucyate - śamanasya bṛṃhaṇe'ntarbhāvāt | uktaṃ ca - ‘śamanaṃ yojayetpūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena ca’ iti | ata eva raviguptādau pañcabhedāste yathā - ‘nasyaṃ śirovirekaśca pratimarśo'vapīḍanam | jñeyaṃ pradhamanaṃ caitannasyakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | dṛḍhabale tu dhūmo'dhiko'sti na ca śirovireka iti | tadyathā - ‘nāvanaṃ cāvapīḍaśca dhmāpanaṃ dhūma eva ca | pratimarśaśca vijñeyo nastakarma tu pañcadhā’ iti | kāśmīrāstu ṣaṭprakāraṃ paṭhanti yathā - ‘avapīḍaṃ pradhamanaṃ nasyaṃ recanatarpaṇam | pratimarśaśca dhūmaśca nasyakarma tu ṣaḍvidham’ iti | te'pyatraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ| te tu granthakṛtā evāgre spaṣṭatayoktāḥ | yathā - śirorecane pradhamanāvapīḍanasaṃjñāvantarbhūtau, te tu karṣaṇatvātkarṣaṇe'ntarbhūtau, pratimarṣamarṣau tu bṛṃhaṇentarbhūtau, evaṃ dhūmo'pi śodhanaśamanatvāt yathā svāntarbhāvanīya iti susthitametat ||2||
Gū. recanasnehananasyabhedadvayamāha - recanastathā snehana iti dvidhā nasyabhedaḥ proktaḥ kathitaḥ | tatra yadvirecanaṃ vātakaphādīnāṃ chedanaṃ yat snehanaṃ tat bṛṃhaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaram || 2 ||
nasyakarmakālamāha - kaphapittāniladhvaṃse pūrvamadhyāparāhṇake | dine tu gṛhyate nasyaṃ rātrāvapyutkaṭe gade || 3 ||

Dī. kaphapittānilānāṃ dhvaṃse vṛddhilakṣaṇe kope, ‘sraṃsudhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane’ ityasya rūpaṃ | kutra kopa ityata āha - dinasya pūrvamadhyāhne'parāhṇake, tenā'yamarthaḥ siddhaḥ - dinasya pūrvāhṇe kaphakope, dinasya madhyāhne pittakope, dinasyāparāhṇe vātakope iti | athavā utkaṭe gade rātrāvapi nasyaṃ deyamiti | uktaṃ ca - ‘yathā doṣodaye kāle rogiṇe nāvanaṃ bhiṣag’ | iti ata eva svasthāsvasthaviṣayasambandhena kālā darśitāstantrāntare tadyathā - ‘śaraddhemantayoḥ svasthe pūrvāhṇe saṃprayojayet | varṣāsu śītaje grīṣme sāyaṃ madhyaṃdine tathā’ iti ||3||

Gū. nasyadāne nasyakālamāha - kaphapittavātadhvaṃse kaphapittavātanāśau krameṇa dinasya pūrvamadhyaparāhṇeke nasyaṃ gṛhyate | kaphanāśārthaṃ dinasya pūrvabhāge, pittanāśārthaṃ dinasya madhyabhāge, vātanāśārthaṃ dinasyāparabhāge | utkaṭe gade rātrāvapi nasyaṃ gṛhyate || 3 ||

div.ab: nasyaṃ yasminkāle tyājyaṃ yaiśca tyājyaṃ tānāha - nasyaṃ tyajedbhojanānte durdine cāpatarpite | tathā navapratiśyāyī garbhiṇī garadūṣitaḥ || 4 || ajīrṇī dattabastiśca pītasnehodakāsavaḥ | kruddhaḥ śokābhibhūtaśca tṛṣārto vṛddhabālakau || 5 || vegāvarodhī snātaśca snātukāmaśca varjavet |

Dī. durdine meghacchanne'hni, apatarpite asantarpite puruṣe | saṃtarpaṇaṃ dhātuvṛddhikaraṇārthaṃ tena dhātubalo nasyena vidheyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | cakārādvāgbhaṭoktāste yathā - ‘yojayennatu nāvanam | toyamadyagarasnehapītānāṃ pātumicchatām || bhuktabhaktaśiraḥsnātasnātukāmasrutāsṛjām | navapīnasavegārtasūtikāśvāsakāsinām || śuddhānāṃ dattabastīnāṃ tathā'nārtavadurdine| anyatrātyayikādvyādheḥ’ iti | navapratiśyāyīti navatvaṃ dvividhanidānabhedena | ekaṃ sadyojanakaṃ dvitīyaṃ doṣacayapūrvakam | tatrādyo yathā - ‘nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ | saṃdhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam’ iti | dvitīyo yathā -‘cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakupyamānā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaistataḥ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi’ iti | tena sadyonidānajanakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so'pi navaḥ pratiśyāya iti kecit | anye tvevamāhuḥ - ‘āmapakvabhedena pratiśyāyasya navapurāṇatve kathite | tenāpi yaḥ āmasaṃjñakaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ so'pi taruṇatvena nasyaviṣaye tyājyaḥ na tu pakva iti bhāvaḥ | garaṃ kṛtrimaṃ viṣaṃ tena vyāptaḥ | kevalaviṣaprāpte'vapīḍasyoktatvāt | uktaṃ ca -‘cetovikāraviṣābhipannānāṃ cūrṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅguladvimukhayā nāḍyā deyam’ | anyacca - ‘viṣābhighātasaṃ- nyāsamūrcchāmohāpatantrake | mahāpasmāraśokārticintākrodhāmayādiṣu || mānaseṣu ca rogeṣu mūḍhavyākulacetasaḥ | saṃjñāprabodhahetvarthamavapīḍaṃ pradāpayet iti | bālavṛddhayorapi utkaṭadoṣeṣu nasyaṃ deyam, ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānām’ ityādivakṣyamāṇatvāt | snātaḥ śirasnāta:, snātukāmaśca ityanena pūrvaṃ vidhāya paścātsnānaṃ kuryādityeke vyākhyānayanti || 4 || 5 ||

Gū. yasminkālai nasyaṃ tyājyaṃ tadāha - durdine meghacchanne'hni durdinam | apatarpaṇe laṅghane, navapratiśyāyī navapratiśyāyavān | garadūṣitaḥ viṣadūṣitaḥ | pītasnehodakāsavaḥ pītaṃ sneham udakam āsavaṃ madyaṃ yena saḥ | vegāvarodhī mūtrapurīṣakāvarodhī | spaṣṭamanyat || 4 || 5 ||
nasyārhānarhānāha -- aṣṭavarṣasya bālasya nasyakarma samācaret || 6 || aśītivarṣādūrdhvaṃ ca nāvanaṃ naiva dīyate |

ab.seg: Dī. atha bālavṛddhayornasyagrahaṇāgrahaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha - aṣṭavarṣādūrdhvaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | aṣṭavarṣādupari nasyakarma kuryāt | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘na nasyamūnasaptābde nātītāśītivatsare’ iti | aṣṭavarṣādarvāgapi doṣodrekādātyayike vyādhau bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ deyam | uktaṃ ca - ‘bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyata’ iti | evaṃ vṛddhasyā'śītivarṣasyāpi jñeyam || 6 ||
Gū. yasya nasyaṃ deyaṃ tadapyāha - nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ | sugamam || 6 ||

div.ab: atha vairecanaṃ nasyamāha - atha vairecanaṃ nasyaṃ grāhyaṃ tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ || 7 || tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhairvā snehaiḥ kvāthai rasaistathā |

ab.seg: Dī. tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ sarṣapādijaiḥ tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhaiḥ snehairvā | tīkṣṇadravyāṇi maricapippalīśṛṅgaveraśobhāñjanādīni, taiḥ ye siddhā ye snehāḥ kvāthāśca iti || 7 ||
Gū. atha virecanasya vidhānamāha – sugamam ||7||

div.ab: virecanasya mātrāmāha - nāsikārandhrayoraṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraśca bindavaḥ || 8 || pratyekaṃ recane yojyā mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā |

ab.seg: Dī. nāsikārandhrayoriti | dvayorapi nāsāpuṭayornasyaṃ yojanīyam | aṣṭāvityādi | mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā iti | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyamātrā | recanasya ṣaṭbindavaḥ madhyamā | catvāraḥ antyā mātrā hīnamātrā iti | uktaṃ ca - ‘catvāro bindavaḥ ṣaṭ vā tathāṣṭau vā yathābalam | śirovirecane yojyā ūrdhvajatruvikāriṇām’ iti | bindulakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt | yāvatpatatyasau bindurdaśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te || marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrāstā eva ca kramāt | bindudvayonāḥ kalkādeḥ’ iti || 8 ||

Gū. virecanasya pramāṇamāha - nāsikārandhrayoḥ chidrayoḥ dvayoḥ aṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraśca bindavaḥ mukhyamadhyāntyātmamātrayā recane yojyāḥ | aṣṭau bindavaḥ mukhyā mātrā | ṣaṭ madhyā mātrā | catvāro bindavaḥ antyā kaniṣṭhā mātrā || 8 ||

div.ab: nasyārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha - nasyakarmaṇi dātavyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ tīkṣṇamauṣadham || 9 || hiṅgu syādyavamātraṃ tu māṣaikaṃ saindhavaṃ matam | kṣīraṃ caivāṣṭaśāṇaṃ syātpānīyaṃ ca trikārṣikam ||10|| kārṣikaṃ madhuraṃ dravyaṃ nasyakarmaṇi yojayet |
Dī. tīkṣṇamiti | maricapippalīhiṃguśṛṅgavera-śobhāñjanatṛvṛtādikam | madhuraṃ dravyaṃ sitāprabhṛtikam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||9|| 10||
Gū. nasyakarmaṇi auṣadhapramāṇamāha - nasyakarmaṇīti spaṣṭam || 9 || 10 ||
atha śirovirecanabhedānāha - bhavapīḍapradhamanau dvau bhedāvaparau smṛtau || 11 || śirovirecanasyātra tau tu deyaṃ yathāyatham |

ab.seg: Dī. atha śirovirecanasya yau dvau avapīḍapradhamanasaṃjñau tāvāha - yathāyathaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathāmātraṃ vā deyau | tayorvidhānaṃ cāgre vakṣyamāṇaṃ jñeyam || 11 ||
Gū. virecanasya dvau bhedāvaparāvapyāha - avapīḍaḥ, pradhamanam, etau dvau virecanasya bhedau tau śirovirecanasthāne deyau || 11 ||

div.ab: athāvapīḍapradhamanayoḥ svarūpamāha - kalkīkṛtādauṣadhādyaḥ pīḍito niḥsṛto rasaḥ || 12|| so'vapīḍaḥ samuddiṣṭastīkṣṇadravyasamudbhavaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgulā dvivaktrā yā nāḍī cūrṇaṃ tathā dhamet ||13|| tīkṣṇaṃ kolamitaṃ vakravātaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hi tat |

Dī. kalkīkṛtādauṣadhādyaḥ raso niḥsṛtaḥ so'vapīḍaḥ, kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? pīḍitaḥ āturanāsāpuṭe iti śeṣaḥ | pradhamanaṃ tat, yat dvivakrā nāḍī ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇā tayā cūrṇaṃ pradhamet | kiṃbhūtam ? tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇadravyakṛtam | kolaṃ kolamātram | vakravātairiti vaidyamukhotthaiḥ kṛtvā pradhamedityarthaḥ || 12 || 13 ||
Gū. avapīḍalakṣaṇamāha - kalkīkṛtāditi sugamam || 12 || 13 ||

ab.seg: ūrdhvajatrugate roge kaphaje svarasaṃkṣaye || 14 ||
arocake pratiśyāye śiraḥśūle ca pīnase | śophā'pasmārakuṣṭheṣu nasyaṃ vairecanaṃ hitam || 15 ||

div.ab: Dī. ūrdhvajatrugate virecanaṃ hitamiti | te ca grīvāgalādirogā dṛḍhabale'pi - ‘stambhāntāḥ suptirudrādyāḥ śleṣmikā ye śirogadāḥ | śirovirecanaṃ teṣu nasyakarma praśasyate’ iti | kapharoge iti | kāsaśvāsādyāḥ | pratiśyāye nāsāsrāve pīnase purāṇe iti ratnaprabhākāraḥ | cakradatte'pi -‘śirovirecanaṃ dadyāt rogeṣveteṣu buddhimān | gaurave śirasaḥ śūle jāḍye spande galāmaye || śophagaṇḍakṛmigranthikuṣṭhāpasmārapīnase’ iti | anyatrā'pyuktaṃ - ‘śirovirecanamapi śleṣmaṇā'bhivyāptatālugalaśirasāṃ tathā'rocakaśirogauravaśūlapīnasārdhāvabhedakakṛmipratiśyāyā-pasmārāghrāṇājñāneṣu cordhvajatrugadeṣu śirovirecanadravyasiddhena snehena’ iti || 14 || 15 ||
atha bṛṃhaṇanasyaviṣayamāha - bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyaṃ snehena śasyate |
Dī. snehena nasyamiti | bṛṃhaṇākhyam | yadā recananasyadāne pratipāditarogairabhibhūtānāṃ bhīruprabhṛtīnāṃ recanaṃ dātavyaṃ tadā snehakṛtaśirovirecanaṃ deyamityapi dvitīyo'rthaḥ sāmpradāyikaḥ ||
yeṣu avapīḍanaṃ yujyate tānāha - galaroge sannipāte nidrāyāṃ viṣamajvare || 16 || manovikāre kṛmiṣu yujyate cāvapīḍanam |

ab.seg: Dī. avapīḍananasyasya viṣayamāha - manovikāre iti | madamūrcchā'pasmārasaṃnyāsonmādabhūtonmādādiṣu | kṛmiśabdenātra kṛmijā rogā api grāhyāḥ ||16||
Gū. sugamam || 16 ||

div.ab: yeṣu pradhamanaṃ yujyate tānāha -- atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu visaṃjñeṣu ca dīyate || 17 || cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ dhīraistaddhi tīkṣṇataraṃ yataḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. pradhamananasyaviṣayamāha - atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu cetovikāraviṣābhipanneṣvityarthaḥ | evaṃvidheṣvanyeṣvapi visaṃjñeṣu madāpasmārādiṣu | yatastīkṣṇataram atyantatīkṣṇadravyakṛtaṃ | dhīrairiti vaidyaiḥ | dhīratvaṃ dṛḍhaśāstrābhyāsakarmatvena jñeyam | tīkṣṇadravyato yathā -- ’pippalyaḥ śigrubījāni viḍaṅgamaricāni ca | avapīḍaḥ praśasto'yaṃ garacetovikāriṇām’ iti || 17 ||
Gū. atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu mūrcchāpasmārādivisaṃjñeṣu saṃnyāsādiṣu || 17 ||

div.ab: idānīmavapīḍanapradhamanayoḥ katipayayogānāha - guḍādinasyam | nasyaṃ syādguḍaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ -
Dī. guḍaśuṇṭhībhyāmeko yogaḥ |

ab.seg: pippalyādinasyam | pippalyāḥ saindhavena vā || 18 ||
jalapiṣṭena tenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ | manyāhanugalodbhūtā naśyanti bhujapṛṣṭhajāḥ || 19 ||

div.ab: Dī. pippalīsaindhavābhyāṃ dvitīyaḥ | tena nasyenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ naśyanti | gadaśabdo'tra pratyekamabhisambadhyate | tathā manyāhanugalodbhūtā rogā iti śeṣaḥ | bhujapṛṣṭhajā iti | bhujajāśca bāhukāsaśoṣādayaḥ, pṛṣṭhajāḥ kubjabahirāmādayaḥ | kecidvirecanabhedameva yogadvayamicchanti tadbhedādavapīḍapradhamanayoruktatvāt || 18 || 19 ||
Gū. atitīkṣṇataraṃ virecanamāha - nasyamiti sugamam || 18 || 19 ||
madhūkasārādinasyam - madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ | nasyaṃ koṣṇajale piṣṭaṃ dadyātsaṃjñāprabodhanam ||20|| apasmāre tathonmāde saṃnipāte'patantrake |

ab.seg: Dī. madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāmeko yogaḥ | madhūko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, tasya sāraṃ madhyasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣam | vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ kṛtvā paraḥ sakaladravyakṛto vā eka eva yogo vyavahārāt | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 20 ||
Gū. madhūkasāraḥ guḍapuṣpaḥ || 20 ||

div.ab: tandrāyāṃ saindhavādinasyam - saindhavaṃ śvetamaricaṃ sarṣapāḥ kuṣṭhameva ca || 21 || bastamūtreṇa piṣṭāni nasyaṃ tandrānivāraṇam |

ab.seg: Dī. tandrāyāṃ nasyamāha - śvetamaricamatra śigrubījaṃ tatsaṃjñatvāt | bastaḥ chāgaḥ | piṣṭānīti pūrvoktadravyāṇi iti śeṣaḥ | teṣāṃ tandrānivāraṇaṃ bhavati ||21 ||
Gū. atha tandrāyāṃ nasyam - śvetamaricaṃ prasiddham, yadvā śigrubījam | bastamūtreṇa || 21 ||
maricādinasyam - rohitamatsyapittena bhāvitaṃ saindhavaṃ vacā || 22 ||
maricaṃ pippalī śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ laśunaṃ puram | kaṭphalaṃ ceti taccūrṇaṃ deyaṃ pradhamanaṃ budhaiḥ || 23 ||

div.ab: Dī. pradhamanamāha - kaṭphalaṃ vacā ca samatvena pūrvaṃ maricacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādrohitamatsyapittena bhāvanā deyā, paścāccūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ deyam | budhairityanena paribhāṣoktarītyā pracārayedityabhiprāyaḥ || 22 || 23 ||
Gū. pradhamananasyamāha - kaṅkolaṃ, maricaṃ, puro gugguluḥ, kaṭphalam etatpradhamanacūrṇaṃ tandrādau deyamiti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||22|| 23||

iti virecananasyakalpanā | atha bṛṃhaṇanasyakalpanāmāha – atha bṛṃhaṇanasyasya kalpanā kathyate'dhunā | marśaśca pratimarśaśca dvau bhedau snehanī matau || 24 || marśasya tarpaṇī mātrā mukhyā śāṇaiḥ smṛtā'ṣṭabhiḥ | madhyamā ca catuḥśāṇairhīnā śāṇamitā smṛtā ||25|| ekaikasmiṃstu mātreyaṃ deyā nāsāpuṭe budhaiḥ | marśasya dvitrivelaṃ vā vīkṣya doṣabalābalam || 26 || ekāntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ vā nasyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tryahaṃ pañcāhamathavā saptāhaṃ vā suyantritam || 27 || marśe śirovireke ca vyāpado vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ | doṣotkleśātkṣayāccaiva vijñeyāstā yathākramam ||28|| doṣotkleśanimittāsu yuñjyādvamanaśodhanam | atha kṣayanimittāsu yathāsvaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam || 29 || śironāsākṣirogeṣu sūryāvartārdhabhedake | dantaroge bale hīne manyābahvaṃsaje gade || 30 || mukhaśoṣe karṇanāde vātapittagade tathā | akālapalite caiva keśaśmaśruprapātane || 31 || yujyate bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ snehairvā madhuradravaiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha virecananasyasya vidhānādikamabhidhāya saṃprati bṛṃhaṇanasyasya bhedaprabhṛtikaṃ darśayannāha - sugamam | tasya bhedānāha - marśaśceti | snehane bṛṃhaṇākhye nasye dvau bhedāviti | ekaḥ marśaḥ, dvitīyaḥ pratimarśaḥ | atha marśasya bhedamātrādikamāha - marśasya tarpaṇasnehasya yā mātrā sā aṣṭabhiḥ śāṇairmukhyā smṛtā | madhyamā caturbhiḥ śāṇairhīnā śāṇapramāṇā | cakradatte - ‘nasyasya snaihikasyātha deyāstvaṣṭau tu bindavaḥ | pratyekaśo nastakayornṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ || śuktiśca pāṇiśuktiśca deyā'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ’ iti | binduparimāṇamuktaṃ vāgbhaṭe -‘pradeśinyaṅgulīparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt | yāvatpatatyasau bindurdaśāṣṭau ṣaṭkrameṇa te | marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrāstā eva ca kramāt | bindurdvayonāḥ kalpādeḥ’ iti | suśrute'pi nasyapramāṇaṃ tu ‘aṣṭau bindavaḥ pradeśinīparvadvayaparisrāvo binduḥ, eṣātra prathamā mātrā, dvitīyātra śuktiḥ, tṛtīyā pāṇiśuktiḥ etāstisro mātrā yathābalaṃ prayojyā bhavanti’ iti | śuktiparimāṇaṃ tu ‘dvātriṃśadbiṃdavaścāpi śuktirityabhidhīyate | dve śuktī pāṇiśuktiśca deyā'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ’ iti | snehanasyaṃ na gilet kiṃtu tyajedeva | tathāhi suśrutaḥ - ‘snehanasyaṃ na copagiletkathaṃcit’ iti | athaitatparimāṇamekavāraṃ bahuvāraṃ vā deyamiti śaṅkāyāṃ samādhānamāha - ekaiketi | marśasya iyaṃ mātrā pūrvoktā ekaikasminnāsāpuṭe deyā | etenaikavāraviṣayaṃ darśitam | yaduktaṃ - pratyekaśo nastakayornṛṇāmiti viniścayaḥ’ iti |‘vā’ athavā doṣabalābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvivāraṃ trivāraṃ vā saiva mātrā deyā iti || nasyadānakālamaryādāmāha -- ekāntaramiti | vicakṣaṇo vaidyaḥ | ekāntaram ekadivasāntaraṃ vā prayojya saptāhaṃ yāvat paramadānena sātmībhavati | atrā'pi punaḥpunariti śeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘saptāhaṃ tu paraṃ deyaṃ miśritasya punaḥpunaḥ’ iti | vāgrahaṇena navamadivasādupari sātmyaṃ bhavati ityuktatvāt | tathāhi - ‘paraṃ navāhamūrdhvaṃ tu navāhātsātmyatāṃ vrajet’ iti || marśe doṣotkleśādvyāpado bhavanti ityata āha - marśe iti | atha tayościkitsāmāha - doṣotkleśa iti | vamanaśodhanamiti śirovirecanādirūpaṃ nasyam | yathāsvamiti yathādoṣaṃ | bṛṃhaṇamiti snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ | bṛṃhaṇanasya viṣayamāha - śira iti | śirorogādiṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ yujyate || 24-31 ||

Gū. atha bṛṃhaṇanasya kalpanā - atheti sugamam | snehavyāpat cikitsāmāha - marśe śirovireke iti | vividhā vyāpādastadrogāḥ smṛtāḥ | taddoṣotkleśakṣayāt dhātukṣayāt jñeyāḥ | doṣotkleśeṣu kiṃ kartavyaṃ ? tadāha yuñjyādvamanaśodhanamiti yeṣu bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ dīyate tānāha - manyā grīvā, aṃsaḥ skandhaḥ, tadgade | snehairghṛtādyairmadhuraiḥ bṛṃhaṇaṃ yojyam || 24-31 ||
kuṅkumanasyam| saśarkaraṃ paya:piṣṭaṃ bhṛṣṭamājyena kuṅkumam || 32 ||
nasyaprayogato hanyādvātaraktabhavā rujaḥ | bhrūśaṅkhākṣiśiraḥkarṇasūryāvartārdhabhedakān || 33 ||

div.ab: Dī. kuṃkumanasyamāha - śarkarā sitopalā, kuṃkumaṃ keśaraṃ kāśmīrajam | ājyena ghṛtena kṛtvā ghṛtena bharjayitvā saśarkaramiti samānaśarkaram | tadanu kṣīreṇa piṣṭvā nasyaṃ deyam | tadghṛtaṃ nasyaprayogataḥ bhrūśaḍkhādirujaḥ hanyāt iti || 32 || 33 ||
Gū. sa yathā - saśarkaraṃ sitāsahitaṃ payaḥ dugdham, ājyena ghṛtena kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ piṣṭvā tannasyaprayogataḥ vātaraktādirujaḥ hanyāt || 32 || 33 ||

ab.seg: anyabṛṃhaṇanasyamāha - nasyaṃ syādaṇutailena tathā nārāyaṇena vā | māṣādinā vā sarpirbhistattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ || 34 ||

Dī. athā'parāṇi bṛṃhaṇanasyādīnyāha - aṇutaileneti | aṇutailena nasyaṃ vātaraktabhavā rujo hanyādityatra saṃbandhaḥ | ‘gavāṃ śakṛt kvāthavipakvamuttamaṃ hitaṃ ca tailaṃ timireṣu nasyataḥ | ghṛtaṃ tathā kevalameva paittike tathāṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgucchayo’riti | aṇutailaṃ tu vātavyādhicitsoktamanyatra jñātavyaṃ | keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthaṃ yathā ‘tilapīḍanopakaraṇakāṣṭhānyāhṛtyānalpakālatailaparipītā-nyaṇūni kāṇḍaśaḥ parikalpyātikuṭya ca mahākaṭāhe pānīyenāsrāvya kvāthayet | tataḥ snehamastudṛṣatsarakapāṇyoranyatareṇādāya vātaghnauṣadhapratīvāpaṃ snehapākakalkena vipacet |vāgbhaṭe tu - ‘jīvantī-jala-devarārujalada-tvak-sevyagopīhimam | dārvītvak-madhuka-plavā-guruvarī puṇḍrāhva- bilvotpalam|| dhāvanyau surabhiḥ sthire kṛmiharaṃ patraṃ truṭiṃ śeṇukam | kiñjalkaṃ kamalādbalāṃ śataguṇe divye'mbhasi kvāthayet || tailādrasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśoṣya tena tailaṃ pacet salilakena daśaiva vārān | pāke kṣipecca daśame samabhāgadugdhaṃ vaidyā mahāguṇamuśantyaṇutailametat’ iti varṇitam | etadaṇutailamupadiśanti vātarogeṣviti’ | nārāyaṇena taileneti śeṣaḥ | māṣādineti | atrā'pi tailena sambandhaḥ | nārāyaṇatailaṃ māṣatailaṃ ca vātavyādhicikitsoktaṃ jñātavyaṃ tattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ sarpirbhiriti | yāni yāni dravyāṇi vātaraktahṛnnābhicakṣuḥśiraḥkarṇarogāṇāṃ vihitāni taistairdravyai- reva sādhitāni sarpīṃṣi tatra tatra yojyānītyabhiprāyaḥ || 34 ||
Gū. anyadapyāha - aṇutailena atasītailena | sarpirbhirghṛtaiḥ tadroganāśakairauṣadhaiḥ sādhitaṃ tasya bṛṃhaṇaṃ syāt || 34 ||
doṣeṣu snehavyavasthā | tailaṃ kaphe syādvāte ca kevale pavane vasām | dadyānnasyaṃ sadā pitte sarpirmajjānameva ca || 35 ||

Dī. atha catuḥsnehasya doṣaviśeṣeṇopādeyatvamāha - tailaṃ kaphe syādvāte ceti | atra savāte iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, kevale vāte svatantre atrāṇutailameva pradhānaṃ | yaduktaṃ ‘caturvidhastu snehasya vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | śleṣmasthānavirodhitvātteṣu tailaṃ viśiṣyata’ iti || 35 ||
Gū. rogabhedena tailādīnāṃ nasyabhedamāha - tailamati | sugamam || 35 ||
māṣādinasyam | māṣā'tmaguptārāsnābhirbalārubukarohiṣaiḥ | kṛto'śvagandhayā kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 36 ||
koṣṇo nasyaprayogeṇa pakṣāghātaṃ sakampanam | jayedarditavātaṃ ca manyāstambhāpabāhukau || 37 ||

div.ab: Dī. athāparamapi yogamāha - ātmaguptā kapikacchū: rāsnā surabhī balā sāmaśabdavācyā rubuka eraṇḍaḥ | rohiṣo gandhatṛṇaḥ aśvagandhayā saha militvā kvāthaḥ hiṅgusaindhavayoḥ prakṣepaḥ | tadvyavahārato hiṅgu raktikādvayaṃ saindhavaṃ māṣaikaṃ prakṣepaḥ | jayedarditavātaṃ ceti cakāragrahaṇāt karṇanādarujāyāṃ praśasta iti prasiddhiḥ | yaduktaṃ - ‘māṣabalāśūkaśimbīkattṛṇarāsnorubūkāśvagandhānāṃ | kvātho nasyanipīto rāmaṭhalavaṇānvitaḥ koṣṇaḥ | apaharati pakṣāghātaṃ manyāstambhaṃ sakarṇarujam | durjayamarditavātaṃ saptāhājjayati cāvaśya’miti | iti marśavidhiḥ || 36 || 37 ||

Gū. atha pakṣavātārditādau nasyam - māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchūḥ, balā prasiddhā, rubukaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, rohiṣaḥ kattṛṇaḥ, aśvagandhā hayagandhā koṣṇaḥ kkātha: sakampanaṃ kampavātaṃ hanyāt || 36 || 37 ||

atha pratimarśamāha - pratimarśasya mātrā tu dvidvibindumitā matā | pratyekaśo nastakayoḥ sneheneti viniścitam || 38 || snehe granthidvayaṃ yāvannimagnā coddhṛtā tataḥ | tarjanīyaṃ sravedbinduṃ sā mātrā bindusaṃjñitā ||39|| evaṃvidhairbindusaṃjñairaṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sa deyo marśanasye tu pratimarśo dvibindukaḥ ||40|| samayāḥ pratimarśasya budhaiḥ proktāścaturdaśa | prabhāte dantakāṣṭhānte gṛhānnirgamane tathā ||41|| vyāyāmādhvavyavāyānte viṇmūtrānte'ñjane kṛte | kavalānte bhojanānte divāsuptotthite tathā || 42|| vamanānte tathā sāyaṃ pratimarśaḥ prayujyate | īṣaducchikkanātsneho yadā vaktraṃ prapadyate || 43 || nasye niṣiktaṃ taṃ vidyātpratimarśaṃ pramāṇataḥ | ucchindanna pibeccaitanniṣṭhīvenmukhamāgatam || 44 || kṣīṇe tṛṣṇāsyaśoṣārte bāle vṛddhe ca yujyate | pratimarśena śāmyanti rogāścaivordhvajatrujāḥ ||45|| valīpalitanāśaśca balamindriyajaṃ bhavet |

ab.seg: Dī. ‘pratyekaśo nastakayorupaiti vadanaṃ yathā | tathaitairvihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram | etaiḥ padārthairvirahitaḥ sneho yadā bhavati tadāntaḥ na prāpnoti iti bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kenāpyatra paṭhitaḥ || 38-45 ||

Gū. atha pratimarśamāha - pratimarśasya nasyamātrā dvitribindumitā kathitā | pratyekaśo nāsikayoḥ snehena ghṛtena | bindumātrāmāha - evaṃvidhairbindusaṃjñairaṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sneheti sugamaṃ | pratimarśanasyasamayamāha - eṣu caturdaśasamayeṣu pratimarśe nasyaṃ prayujyate | dhamanasya niṣiktalakṣaṇamāha - īṣaducchikkanāt īṣat chikkanāt yadā snehaḥ vaktraṃ mukhaṃ prapadyate nasye niṣiktaṃ dattaṃ pratimāṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ tatastadā taṃ ucchiṣṭaṃ vidyāt | tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha - ucchiṣṭaṃ na pibetpratimarśam | anyeṣu keṣu yujyate tānapyāha - kṣīṇe dhātukṣīṇe tathā tṛṣṇā āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tacchoṣārte bāle tathā vṛddhe ca yujyate pratimarśena ete śāmyanti tathā ūrdhvatrujā grīvāmūlordhvajāḥ śāmyanti tathā valīpalito yujyate valī tvakśaithilye palitaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ tathā indriyajaṃ balaṃ bhavet || 38-45 ||

div.ab: atha palite nasyam | bibhītanimbakambhārī śivā śeluśca kākinī ||46|| ekaikatailanasyena palitaṃ naśyati dhruvam |

ab.seg: Gū. bibhītaṃ bibhītakamajjānaṃ nimbaṃ nimbabījaṃ kambhārī prasiddhā, tasyā bījaṃ, śivā harītakī majjā, śeluḥ śākhoṭakamajjā, kākinī kikaībījam eṣām ekaikatailalasyena palitaṃ naśyati || 46 ||
atha nasyagrahaṇe nasyavidhimāha -- atha nasyavidhiṃ vakṣye nasyagrahaṇahetave || 47 ||
deśe vātarajomukte kṛtadantanigharṣaṇam | viśuddhaṃ dhūmapānena svinnabhālagalaṃ tathā || 48 ||
uttānaśāyinaṃ kiṃcitpralambaśirasaṃ naram | āstīrṇahastapādaṃ ca vastrācchāditalocanam || 49 ||
samunnamitanāsāgraṃ vaidyo nasyena yojayet | koṣṇamacchinnadhāraṃ ca hematārādiśuktibhiḥ || 50 ||
śuktyā vā yatra yuktyā vā plotairvā nasyamācaret | nasyeṣvāsicyamāneṣu śiro naiva prakampayet || 51 ||
na kupyenna prabhāṣeta nocchidenna hasettathā | etairhi vihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate || 52 ||
tataḥ kāsapratiśyāyaśiro'kṣigadasaṃbhavaḥ | śṛṅgāṭakamabhiplāvya sthāpayenna gileddravam || 53 ||

Gū. vātarajomukte deśe sthāne kṛtadantanigharṣaṇaṃ kṛtadantadhāvanaṃ, dhūmapānena viśuddhaṃ, tathā svinnabhālagalaṃ dhūmapānena | yadvā sveditabhālagalaṃ tathā uttānaśāyinaṃ naraṃ nasyena yojayet | plotaṃ plotakaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat | nasyaniṣikte kathaṃ niṣṭhīvedityāha - nocchidenna kiṃcitkṣodayet | etaiḥ kopādibhiḥ vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ nasyaḥ antarmadhye na prapadyate tataḥ kāsādayaśca bhavantītyāha - pratiśyāyo nāsāsrāvaḥ | tataḥ koṣādeḥ śṛṅgāṭakādisthāpane śikṣitamāha - śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāsāvaṃśaṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ āplāvya nasyaṃ draveṇāplutya na sthāpayet | dravaṃ na gilet, spaṣṭamanyat || 47-53 ||

div.ab: atha nasyadhāraṇārthaṃ mātrāsaṃkhyāmāha - pañca sapta daśaiva syurmātrā nasyasya dhāraṇe |
Dī. pañcasaptādisaṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ doṣādibalābalaviṣayam | mātrāpramāṇaṃ tu vāgbhaṭe -‘yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā’ iti ||

ab.seg: nasyadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ityata āha - upaviśyātha niṣṭhīvennāsāvaktragataṃ dravam || 54 ||
vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ niṣṭhīvetsaṃmukhe na hi | nīte nasye manastāpaṃ rajaḥ krodhaṃ ca saṃtyajet ||55||
śayīta nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca prottāno vākśataṃ naraḥ | tathā vairecanaścānte dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ || 56 ||

Dī. athaśabda ānantarye | nasyānantaraṃ nāsādidravam upaviśya niṣṭhīvet | kābhyāṃ ? vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ | kathaṃ ? sammukhaṃ nahi niṣṭhīvet | tiryak niṣṭhīvanāt samyagdravanirgamo bhavati ityarthaḥ | niṣṭhīvanānantaraṃ kartavyamāha - nīte iti | krodhaṃ ceti | caśabdastantrāntaroktagrahaṇārthaḥ | uktaṃca - ‘rajodhūmamanastāpasnānakrodhādivarjayet’ iti | vākśataṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇaśatamātram | vairecananasyānte iti śirovirecanasyottarakālaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ iti | dhūmaḥ snigdhādiragre vakṣyamāṇaḥ, kavalaḥ prāguktalakṣaṇaḥ hitaḥ pathyastasmātkartavya ityarthaḥ || 54-56 ||
Gū. nasye nīte yatkartavyaṃ tadāha - rajo dhūli: | yathā dhūmapraveśo na bhavet | sa pītanasya uttānaḥ san vākśataṃ bhavet | virecananasyānte dhūmaḥ kavalaśca hitaḥ deyaḥ || 54-56 ||
atha nasye kati lakṣaṇāni bhavanti ? ityāha - nasye trīṇyupadiṣṭāni lakṣaṇāni prayogataḥ | śuddhihīnātiyogāni viśeṣācchāstracintakaiḥ ||57||
Dī. prayogata iti nasyaprayogāt | śāstracintakaiḥ śāstraṃ vaidyakaśāstraṃ tasya cintakāḥ vicārakā iti || 57 ||
Gū. śuddhyādibhedena nasye lakṣaṇamāha - nasye iti | spaṣṭam || 57 ||
nasyaśuddhilakṣaṇamāha - lāghavaṃ manasaḥ śuddhiḥ srotasāṃ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ | cittendriyaprasādaśca śirasaḥ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 ||

Dī. lāghavamiti śarīrasya | śarīragrahaṇenaiva śirograhaṇe labdhe punaḥ śirograhaṇaṃ dehasyordhvamūlādapi lāghavapratipādanārtham | manasaḥ śuddhiḥ manaso hlādakatvāt manasaḥ śuddhiḥ | tathā srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ srotāṃsi prāṇadhātumalāmbho'nnavāhināṃ śuddhatā | tathā cittendriyaprasādaśca manasaḥ indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ prasannatā | tathā vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ vyādhayo nasyasādhyā rogāḥ | tantrāntare tu - ‘prasannadṛṣṭirdṛḍhadantakeśaḥ śaśāṅkavakraḥ palitairvihīnaḥ | pikābhikaṇṭhaḥ kamalāsya gandho nasyopasevī bhavatīha martyaḥ’ iti | anyatrāpyuktam - ‘indriyāṇāṃ ca vaimalyaṃ kuryādāsyasugandhatām | hanudantaśirogrīvātrikabāhūrasāṃ balam || valīpalitakhālityaṃ vyaṅgānāmapyasaṃbhavam iti || 58 ||

Gū. śuddhimāha - lāghavaṃ śirasaḥ manasaḥ śuddhirmūrcchādyasrāvatvaṃ srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ, cittaprasādaśca śirasaḥ śirorogādināśaḥ | prasannatvaṃ śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ idaṃ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 ||
atha hīnaśuddherlakṣaṇamāha - kaṇḍūpadehau gurutā srotasāṃ kaphasaṃsravaḥ | mūrdhni hīnaviśuddhestu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 59 ||

Dī. atha hīnaśuddherlakṣaṇānyāha - hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇaṃ | kiṃ tat | kaṇḍūpadehāviti mukhanāsikādīnām upadehaḥ śleṣmaṇābhiliptamiva mukhaṃ bhavatīti | gurutā cātra śirasaḥ | srotasāṃ kaphādivahānāṃ kaphasaṃsrava iti pracuraśleṣmasaṃbhava iti tātparyārthaḥ || 59 ||
Gū. hīnaviśuddheḥ śirasi lakṣaṇamāha - upadeho liptatā, gurutā gurutvam, srotasāṃ nāsādīnām | kaphasaṃsrāvaḥ | hīnaśuddheḥ alpaśuddheḥ || 59 ||
atiśayaśuddhasya lakṣaṇamāha - mastuluṅgāgamo vātavṛddhirindriyavibhramaḥ | śūnyatā śirasaścāpi mūrdhni gāḍhaṃ virecite ||60||

Dī. ativirecitalakṣaṇamāha - mūrdhni śirasi | ativirecite sati mastuluṅgāgamādayo bhavanti | mastuluṅgaṃ mastiṣkam, vātavṛddhirityatra vātaduṣṭiriti vā pāṭhaḥ | indriyavibhramaḥ indriyanāśaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā mastakaśūnyatā | ‘śūnyatā manasaścā'pi’ iti pāṭhāntaram || 60 ||
Gū. mastuluṅgāgamo mastikābhyantarāt luṅgo mātuluṅgaḥ tajjalasadṛśo niḥsāraḥ vātavṛddhiḥ, indriyavibhramaḥ, śirasaḥ śūnyatā, idaṃ gāḍhavirecitaśiraso lakṣaṇām ||60 ||
hīnātiśuddhau cikitsāmāha - hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnamācaret | samyak viśuddhe śirasi sarpirnasye niṣecayet ||61||
Dī. hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnaṃ kramādācarediti jñeyam | hīnaśuddhe śirasi kaphaghnam, atiśuddhe vātaghnaṃ, samyakśuddhe śirasi, nasyena samyak śuddhe sarpiryojayedityarthaḥ || 61 ||
Gū. hīnātiśuddhyādau kriyāmāha - kaphavātaghnaṃ nasyamācaret || 61 ||

div.ab: atisnigdhalakṣaṇacikitsāmāha - kaphaprasekaḥ śiraso gurutendriyavibhramaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ tadatisnigdhe tatra rūkṣaṃ pradāpayet || 62 || bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi tasyācārikamādiśet |

ab.seg: Dī. atisnigdhe etallakṣaṇam | tatkim ? kaphaprasekādi kaphaprasekaḥ srāvaḥ, śirasaḥ gurutā śirojāḍyam, indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ vibhramaḥ | rūkṣam annaṃ pradāpayet | anabhiṣyandi srotasāṃ yallepakaraṃ na bhavati etamācārikam ādiśet | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘uṣṇodakopacārī syādbrahmacārī kṣapāśayaḥ | na vegarodhī vyāyāmakrodhaśokahimātapān || pravātapānayānādhvabhāṣyābhyāsanasaṃsthitiḥ | nīcātyuccopadhānāhasvapnadhūmarajāṃsi ca’ iti || 62 ||

Gū. atisnigdhe lakṣaṇamāha - indriyavibhramaḥ bhrāntitvam ayathārthaśaktiḥ, atisnigdhe idaṃ lakṣaṇam | tatra rūkṣamavacārayet | nasye'varukṣaṃ dāpayet | nasye bhojanācāramāha - anabhiṣyandi mahiṣīdadhyādi nasyācārikaṃ nasye ye śiṣṭā ācaranti tadācaret || 62 ||

div.ab: prakaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhaścānuvāsanam | etāni pañca karmāṇi kathitāni munīśvaraiḥ ||63|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhi- rnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
Dī. tāni kāni vamanadīni || 63 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhirnāmā- ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

Gū. pañcakarmasaṃkhyāmāha - recanaṃ virekaḥ, nirūhaṃ nirūhaṇabastiḥ | anuvāsanabastiḥ | nanu bastikarma ekavidhaṃ bhavati tatkathaṃ dvividham ? ucyate - anuvāsanasya nirūhasya ca pṛthakkaraṇāt || 63 || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūrtha- dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasya- varṇanīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha dhūmapānavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha dhūmapānavidhiḥ | dhūmasaṃkhyā - dhūmastuanyatra trividhaḥ proktaḥ | tathāhi carake - ‘prāyogikaḥ snehikaḥ doṣavairecanika:’ iti | tatra prāyogike kāsaharaṃ, vairecanike vāmanīyamantarbhāvyam | vāgbhaṭe'pi snigdho madhyastīkṣṇaśceti | atrā'pi snigdhe śamanavraṇadhūpanabṛṃhaṇānāmantarbhāvaḥ | tīkṣṇe recanavāmayoriti virodhaparihāraḥ || ṣaḍvidhaḥ proktaḥ śamano bṛṃhaṇastathā | recanaḥ kāsahā caiva vāmano ghrāṇadhūpanaḥ || 1 || śamanasya tu paryāyau madhya: prāyogikastathā | bṛṃhaṇasyāpi paryāyau snehiko mṛdureva ca || 2 || recanasyāpi paryāyau śodhanastīkṣṇa eva ca |
