Dī. tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - yathā nasyena cordhvajatruroganāśastathā dhūmenā'pi | uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu viśeṣānnasyamiṣyate | jatrūrdhvaṃ kaphavātotthavikārāṇāmajanmane || ucchedāya ca vātānāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ sadātmavān’ iti | tena nasyādhyāyānantaraṃ dhūmapānādhyāyaḥ || atha evaṃ karmapariśeṣāt śuddhikaratvena nasyānte dhūmapānavidhirārabhyate | tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ dhūmasaṃkhyāmāha - ṣoḍhā dhūmapānaprakāraḥ | tatra śamana iti | duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanam | aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca | vyādhiśamananena prastutavyādhiśamanam | aprastutavyādheranudīraṇaṃ | taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe – ‘na śodhayati yaddoṣān śamānnodīrayatyapi śamīkaroti ca kruddhān tatsaṃśamanamucyata’ iti | doṣaśabdo'tra doṣeṣu doṣakāryavyādhiṣvapi vartate kārye kāraṇopacārāt | bṛṃhaṇa iti | bṛṃhaṇo balakaraḥ | dhātuvṛddhikara ityanye | tadāśrayatvāddoṣo balaṃ recana iti | śiro virecayatīti recanaḥ | kāsaheti kāsanivāraṇāya yo dīyate sa kāsahā kathitaḥ | vāmana iti | vāmayatīti vāmanaḥ | atha ghrāṇadhūpana iti | nāsikayā pīto dhūmo ghrāṇadhūpanasaṃjñaḥ | eke ghrāṇadhūpanasthāne vraṇadhūpana iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | etatsaṃgatam | atha teṣāṃ keṣāṃcitsaṃjñāntarāṇi darśayannāha - ekārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante | prayogaḥ svasthasya satatopayogaḥ | tatra sādhuprāyogikāḥ snehā yatra bhavantīti snehikaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

Gū. tasya ṣaḍvidhatvamāha - śamanādibhedena ṣaḍvidho dhūma: proktaḥ kathitaḥ | śamanabṛṃhaṇarecanaparyāyānāha - śamano doṣaśamanastasya paryāyau dvau ekaḥ madhyaḥ madhyanāmā aparaḥ prāyogikaḥ prāyogikanāmā | bṛṃhaṇasya dvau paryāyau ekaḥ snehanaḥ eko mṛdu: | recanasyā'pi dvau paryāyau ekaḥ śodhanaḥ aparastīkṣṇaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg: yeṣāṃ dhūmo na vihitastānāha - adhūmārhāśca khalvete śrānto bhītaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||3||
dattabastirviriktaśca rātrau jāgaritastathā | pipāsitaśca dāhārtastāluśoṣī tathodarī || 4 ||
śiro'bhitāpī timirī chardyādhmānaprapīḍitaḥ | kṣatoraskaḥ pramehārtaḥ pāṇḍurogī ca garbhiṇī ||5||
rūkṣaḥ kṣīṇo'bhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsavaḥ | bhuktānnadadhimatsyaśca bālo vṛddhaḥ kṛśastathā || 6 ||

Dī. idānīṃ ye dhūmapāneṣu nārhāstānāha - adhū mārhāśca khalvete iti | ete vakṣyamāṇāḥ śrāntādayaḥ te tu na dhūmayogyā ityādi | śrānto bhārādinā | bhīto bhayayuktaḥ | duḥkhito ghanabandhanādinā | dattabastiriti kṛtabastiḥ | bastigrahaṇenānuvāsanāsthāpananirūhabastayo gṛhyante | virikta iti viśeṣeṇa recitaḥ | rātrau jāgarita iti | rātrijāgaraṇena vātavṛddhiḥ syāt | śiro'bhitāpo śirorogapīḍitaḥ | timirīti mandadṛṣṭiḥ | chardyādhmānaprapīḍita iti | chardipīḍitaḥ, ādhmānapīḍitaśca, ādhmāna udarāpūraḥ | kṣatoraska iti uraḥkṣatī | pramehārta iti pramehapīḍitaḥ | rūkṣo vātaprakṛtyā | athavā rūkṣā'hāreṇa janitavāyunā pīḍitaḥ | kṣīṇa iti kṣīṇadhātuḥ | abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsava iti | abhyavahṛtaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhakṣitaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ yena sa tathā | tatra kṣaudraṃ madhu ete dhūmapānaviṣaye na yogyā ityabhiprāyaḥ | tatheti grahaṇāt īdṛśā anye'pitantrāntaroktā viṣāśīraktapittīprabhṛtaya:| boddhavyāḥ || 3-6 ||

Gū. ekānte śrāntādayaḥ adhūmārhā dhūmayogyāḥ na | śrāntaḥ śramayukta:, bhīrurbhayayukta:, duḥkhitaḥ duḥkhārtaḥ, kenacit duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ dhananāśādibhiḥ | kṣatoraska iti | yasya abhyavahṛtaṃ bhakṣitaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣaudram āsavo madyaṃ yena saḥ abhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudrāsavaḥ pumān | tathā bhuktānnadadhimatsya: bhuktam annaṃ dadhi matsyāśca yena saḥ bālaḥ vṛddhaḥ tathā kṛśo durbalaḥ || 3-6 ||

akāle dhūmapāne doṣaṃ tatpratīkāraṃ cāha - akāle cātipītaśca dhūmaḥ kuryādupadravāntaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘raktapittāndhyabādhiryatṛṇmūrcchāmadamehakṛt’ iti | | tatreṣṭaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ nāvanāñjanatarpaṇam || 7 ||
sarpirikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā | madhurāmlau rasau vāpi śamanāya pradāpayet || 8 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha yogyapītasya dhūmapānasya doṣamāha - akāla iti | asya kālo virecanokto boddhavyaḥ | atipīta iti | vihitaparimāṇādibhyo'nyathā pītaḥ svamānādbahupīto vā | nāsādeyastathā dhūmo yāvatā vartyavasāda ityādi | upadravānatra dhūmopahitajanitān | te tu tṛṣṇādāhajvarakṣavathusadanāghrāṇarogādhmānādayaḥ | tatpratīkāramāha - tatreti | dhūmapānātiśayajanitopadraveṣu | iṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | nāsāgatadoṣadūrīkaraṇāt | yato ghreyamapyatra vettivetyupadravatvāt| añjanamapyatra tadvihitameva | yataḥ | rogopadravaḥ pītalohitatīkṣṇaistannirvarṇatvāt | tarpaṇaṃ santarpaṇaṃ | tṛṣṇādāhajvaropadravatvāt | yata: tṛṣṇādāhajvarādīnāṃ sparśadoṣeṇa sīdatīti | kriyāsu asamartho bhavatītyarthaḥ | ata eva tarpaṇamiti | aparāṇyāha - sārpirikṣurasamityeko yogaḥ | drākṣāṃ payo veti dvitīyaḥ | śarkarāmbu veti tṛtīyaḥ | madhurāmlau rasau vāpīti caturthaḥ | vamanāya pradāpayediti vamanaprābalyam | tantrāntaroktaṃ yathā ‘vamanātkoṣṭhaśuddhiḥ syāddhūmagandhaśca naśyati | vidhinā'nena śāmyanti sadanaṃ kṣavathujvarāḥ’ ityādi || 7 || 8 ||

Gū. tathā akāle asamaye pīto dhūmaḥ upadravān kuryāt | tatra dhūmopadrave kiṃ vihitaṃ, tatrāha - tatra dhūmopadrave sarpiṣaḥ pānam iṣṭam ucitaṃ nāvanaṃ nasyaṃ tathāñjanatarpaṇaṃ gaṇḍādikaṃ sarpirghṛtapānam ikṣurasaṃ pauṇḍrakādīnāṃ rasaṃ drākṣā gostanī payo dugdhaṃ gavyaṃ vā, śarkarāmbu vā sitodakaṃ vā, madhurāmlau rasau vā, śamanāya dāpayet, sarpiṣaḥ punaruktirviśeṣaghṛtaprayogārtham | drākṣādimadhudravye gṛhīte'pi punarmadhuragrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣayogārtham || 7 || 8 ||

dhūmaḥ kadā gṛhyate ko vā guṇa ityāha - dhūmastu dvādaśādvarṣādgṛhyate'śītikānna ca | kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyānmanyāhanuśirorujaḥ || 9 || vātaśleṣmavikārāṃśca hanyāddhūmaḥ suyojitaḥ | dhūmaprayogātpuruṣaḥ prasannendriyavāṅmanāḥ || 10 || dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśru: sugandhivadano bhavet |

Dī. atha dhūmasya vayobhedenopādeyatvamanupādeyatvamāha - dvādaśavarṣādupari arthādbālyāvasthāyāḥ dhūmapāno yojyaḥ | yāvadaśītivarṣāṇi bhavanti upari gṛhyate | aśītivarṣādupari dhūmapāno na vihita ityabhiprāyaḥ | etadviṣayaṃ prāyogikadhūmapāne svasthopayogitvena darśitam | yato'nyatra sarvairnibandhakārairapaṭhitatvāt | atha samyag yojitasya dhūmapānasya guṇamāha - dhūmaprayogāt iti | samyak pītaḥ | atha dhūmayogena phalamāha | indriyāṇi buddhīndriyāṇi | teṣāṃ prasannatā tadviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyamityarthaḥ | vākvacanaprāgalbhyaṃ manaḥ indriyatvenobhayātmakatvātpunargrahaṇam | dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśruriti | keśāḥ śiroruhāḥ śmaśru nāsādhogatauṣṭhoparilomaviśeṣaḥ | dvijā dantāḥ | sugandhivadano bhavedityasya sthāne sugandhiviśadānana iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 9 || 10 ||

Gū. dhūmo dvādaśādvarṣāt gṛhyate aśītikādvarṣānna gṛhyate tathā suyojito dhūmaḥ kāsādīn hanyāt | dhūmopayogāt kīdṛśaḥ puruṣo bhavedityāha - dṛḍhāḥ keśā dvijā dantāḥ śmaśruḥ mukhakeśāśca yasya saḥ || 9 || 10 ||

ab.seg: yayā nāḍyā dhūmo gṛhyate tadvidhānamāha - dhūmanāḍī bhavettatra trikhaṇḍā ca triparvikā || 11 ||
kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhā rājamāṣāgamāntarā | dhūmanāḍī bhaveddīrghā śamane rogiṇo'ṅgulaiḥ || 12 ||
catvāriṃśanmitaistadvaddvātriṃśadbhirmṛdau matā | tīkṣṇe caturviṃśatibhiḥ kāsaghnī ṣoḍaśonmitaiḥ ||13||
daśāṅgulairvāmanīye tathā syādvraṇanāḍikā | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūlā kulitthāgamarandhrakā || 14 ||

Dī. idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ netrasvarūpamāha - tatreti | dhūmapānaviṣaye dhūmanāḍī dhūmapānārthaṃ nāḍī netrābhidhānā | kathaṃbhūtā trikhaṇḍā | ata eva triparvikā kathitā | trigranthiyutetyādi | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhetyanena gopucchākārā kāryā | gopucchākāratvaṃ ca trikhaṇḍānāmiti bhāvaḥ | antare suṣiraṃ tu rājamāṣavadvartulānurūpaṃ kāryamityaryaḥ | eke antaranāḍikāyāḥ prānte rājamāṣasadṛśaṃ randhraṃ vadanti | mūlamukhaṃ tu rājamāṣāt kiṃcidadhikaṃ bhavati | kaniṣṭhikāpariṇāhākāratvāt | atha nāḍīsvarūpamabhidhāya saṃprati śamanādīnāmaṅgulabhedena nāḍīvibhedamāha | daśāṅgulairvāmanīyaḥ etatpañcaprakāraṃ mukhyapānatvena nāḍīviṣayatvādvihitam | ṣoḍhā saṃjñakamavaśiṣṭaṃ yat ghrāṇadhūpanam | tasya nāḍīsvarūpaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | ata eva nāḍībhedenaiva pañcaprakāraṃ pūrvamuktaṃ tadyathā - dhūmanāḍī | śamaneti śamanākhyadhūmapānayogyetyarthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtā | āturasya catvāriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā | nanu tantrāntare aṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitā nāḍī prāyogikābhidhāne śamanadhūmapāne praśastā tathāca ‘elādinā kuṣṭhanatoddhṛtena kṣaumaṃ vilipyāṅgulakāṣṭhamānam | prāyogike vartiriyaṃ tu netramaṣṭhāṅgulaṃ ṣaḍguṇitaṃ praśastam’ iti suśrutenoktam | apare tu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ prāyogike netramāhuḥ | taduktaṃ ‘sārddhaṃ tryaṃśayutaḥ pūrṇo hastaḥ prāyogikādiṣu’ iti | tatkathamatra catvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parimitaṃ netram ? ucyate | samalasya tu madhyaḥ | prāyogikasya tu dvau bhedau darśitau | tadbhedatvena nāḍībhedamapi jānīyānna doṣaḥ | athavā śleṣmaprakṛtau baddhadoṣe ca nare ṣaḍviṃśadaṅgulā mātrā | anyatra tvaṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaṃ tena virodhaḥ | svamate tvācāryeṇa viśeṣaṃ vicārya sāmapratipālanārthaṃ madhyabhāvaṃ netraparimāṇaṃ likhitamityadoṣaḥ | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaparimāṇeṣu kutracidvirodheṣu boddhavyam | mṛdāviti bṛṃhaṇākhye dhūmapāne dvātriṃśadaṅgulamitaṃ netraṃ bhavati | tīkṣṇa iti recanākhye dhūmapāne caturviṃśatyaṅgulamitaṃ netramatra | kāsaghne dhūmapāne ṣoḍaśāṅgulipramitaṃ | nāḍīviṣaye vāmanīye dhūmapāne daśāṅgulaṃ netramiti | pūrvamuktaṃ vraṇadhūpanārthaṃ nāḍīsvarūpamanyatrāha dhūmanimittam | īdṛśī nāḍikā netrākhyā bhavati | kādṛśī | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūleti | nāḍikā uttaramukhaṃ vraṇalagnārtham | kalāyasadṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtā | kulatthāgamarandhraketi | kulattho'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadgamanaśīlo randhraḥ suṣirastena saṃyuta ityarthaḥ | nāḍikārandhraṃ tu kulatthasadṛśaṃ kāryamiti bhāvaḥ || 11-14 ||

Gū. sāmānyato yā dhūmanāḍī bhavetsā trikhaṇḍā trīṇi khaṇḍāni dorakāni yasyāḥ sā, triparvikā trīṇi parvāṇi granthīryasyāḥ sā triparvikā kaniṣṭhikāṅgulī | tatparimāṇamāha - sthūlā punaḥ rājamāṣāgamā antare madhye rājamāṣaḥ tadgamaṃ chidram antare bhavati | idānīṃ śamanādau dhūmanāḍīpramāṇamāha - śamane śamanadhūmapāne yā nāḍī nalikā sā rogiṇāṃ catvāriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā matā | mṛdau mṛdudhūmapāne nāḍī sā dvātriṃśadaṅgulairdīrghā | tīkṣṇe tīkṣṇadhūmapāne caturviṃśairaṅgulairdīrghā | kāsaghne dhūmapāne yā nāḍikā sāpi daśāṅgulaireva dīrghā īdṛśī | sthūlamānamāha | kalāyo vartulakastat maṇḍalavatsthūlā punā randhre yathā kulatthāgamanaṃ bhavettadvat ||11-14 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ īṣikāvidhānamāha - atheṣikāṃ pralimpecca suślakṣṇāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām | dhūmadravyasya kalkena lepaścāṣṭāṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15|| kalkaṃ karṣamitaṃ liptvā chāyāśuṣkaṃ ca kārayet | īṣikāmapanīyātha snehāktāṃ vartimādarāt ||16|| aṅgārairdīpitāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā netrasya randhrake | vadanena pibeddhūmaṃ vadanenaiva saṃtyajet || 17 || nāsikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vametsudhīḥ | śarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā kalkamaṅgāradīpitam || 18 || chidre netraṃ niveśyātha vraṇaṃ tenaiva dhūpayet |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ vartividhānaṃ darśayitumāha - atha īṣikāṃ pralimpediti |cakradatte tu - ’oṣadhairvartikāṃ kṛtvā śaragarbhāntaśocitām’ iti śaragrahaṇaṃ, carake'pi -’piṣṭvā limpecchareṣīkāṃ vartiṃ yavajasannibhām’ iti dṛśyate | tasmādīṣikāṇāmalābhe jharakāṇḍena pibet || korthaḥ piṣṭairbheṣajaiḥ karpaṭāvayavaṃ pralikhya tena śarakāṇḍamaṅgulīsamamaṣṭāṅgulamānena veṣṭayitvā tataḥ pariśoṣya vartiḥ kāryā | avaśiṣṭaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ śarakāṇḍagrahaṇārthamuktam | snehakādiṣvapi vartikaraṇam | īṣikā kāśamucyate | ‘ṣāguri’ iti loke | atha kathaṃ vartiḥ prajvālya netre dhāryā tatprakāramāha | adalāditi | dalamatra patralepaṃ | īṣikāvartividhānaṃ ca prāyogike pradhānatamaṃ | ropaṇīyā vartiriyam | ṣaḍbhāgagodhūmena netramāvartyātmānaṃ praśasyata iti | kecit snehenābhyajyedagninā dagdhvā netre niveśya dhūmaḥ peyaḥ | yadā vadanena mukhena kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibet tadā mukhenaiva tannirgamaṃ kuryāt | nasikābhyāṃ pītamapi mukhenaivameva vamedityarthaḥ | nāsikābhyāmiti dvivacanena nāsikārandhradvayena sambandhaḥ | tata ityanena mukhapītenetarameva nāsikayā pītamityarthaḥ | tathāhi ‘mukhena taṃ vametpūrvaṃ nāsikāyāṃ punaḥ pibet’ iti | nanu tantrāntare nāsikāpītaṃ paścānmukhapītaṃ dhūmaṃ doṣakaraṃ bhavati tathāca - ‘mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva nastaḥ pītaṃ ca nastataḥ | yo vamennastato dhūmaṃ nastapītaṃ mukhena vā | sa netrakarṇanāsāsyasaṃśrayāt labhate gadān’ iti | tatkathamatra nasikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vamet sudhīriti grahaṇam | ucyate | sudhīrityudīraṇenā'tra virodhaparihāraḥ kṛtaḥ | yato dhūmapānabhedena rogaviśeṣe'pi kutracinmukhapītaṃ kutrāpi nāsikāpītaṃ vā | mukhanāsikāpītamiti | tathācoktaṃ -‘uraḥkaṇṭhāśraye roge mukhenaiva pibennaraḥ | śiraḥkaṇṭhākṣināsauṣṭhe nāsayā satataṃ pibet | tiryaktve tu mukhenaiva nāsayā na kathaṃcana | pragāḍhaṃ pānamicchanti dhūmasyāṃśena tadvida’ iti | kathaṃ pibedityapi darśanāt yathā tatra prāyogikaṃ trīṃsnīnucchvāsānādadyāt | prāṇena prīṇayet trīṃścaturoveti | ‘snehikaṃ mukhanāsābhyāṃ yāvadaśru pravartanam’ | nāsikābhyāṃ vairecanikamādoṣadarśanāt | mukhenaiva kāsaharaṃ śvāsaśuddhirlāghavaṃ śirasi samaḥ evaṃ vicārya mukhapītaṃ mukhenaiva vamet | nāsāpītaṃ ca nāsikayaiva | ubhābhyāṃ pītaṃ mukhenaiva vamedityadoṣaḥ | ata eva sudhīpadanirūpaṇamatra virodhaparihārāya boddhavyam | idānīṃ dhūmapānaviṣayatvena ghrāṇadhūpanamapyāha - kalkamatra nimbavacādīnāṃ vihitam | yataḥ ‘vraṇe nimbavacādīnāṃ dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyata’ iti | chidre iti śarāvasaṃpuṭarandhre | netramiti nāḍīviśeṣaḥ | sā dhūmapānārthe kathitaiva tadvadatrāpi jñeyam | vraṇadhūpanaṃ tu vedanāsrāvaśāntaye iti | athavā pūrvamuktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ vihitam | athavā - ‘śarāvasaṃpuṭayutaṃ vraṇadhūmaṃ nayedvraṇe | dhūmanetreṇa matimān vedanāsrāvaśāntaye’ iti || 15-18 ||

Gū. īṣikā śaratṛṇaviśeṣajanyā yā daśāṅgulānāṃ dhūmadravyakalkena limpet punaḥ śuṣke vartisnehoktaṃ kṛtvā īṣikām apanīya dūrīkṛtya netrasya nalikārandhre dhṛtvā dīpitāṃ kṛtvā vadanena dhūmaṃ pibet | vadanenaiva tyajet | tataḥ nāsikābhyām evaṃ kṛtvā vadanenaiva vamet | vraṇadhūmastu dīpanakalkaśarāve dhṛtvā chidre netraṃ niveśya vraṇaṃ dhūmayet ayaṃ dhūmapānavidhiḥ ||15-18||

div.ab: śamanadhūmādau yaddravyakalko dhūmārthaṃ deyastadāha - elādikalkaṃ śamane snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ mṛdau || 19 || recane tīkṣṇakalkaṃ ca kāsaghnaṃ kṣudrikoṣaṇam | vāmane snāyucarmādyaṃ dadyāddhūmasya pānakam || 20 || vraṇe nimbavacādyaṃ ca dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyate |

Dī. atha pūrvamuktaṃ śamanādidhūmabhedaṃ ṣaṭprakāraṃ tadarthaṃ katipayāni dravyāṇyāha - śamane prāyogike elādikalkaṃ dhūmapānārthamāhuḥ | elādigaṇamatra suśrutoktaṃ tadyathā -‘elātagarakuṣṭhamāṃsījaladhāmakāṃ tvakpatranāgapuṣpapriyaṅguhareṇukāvyāghrīnakhaśukticaṇḍāghauṇeyaka-śrīveṣṭakacorakabālakaguggulusarjaturuṣkapuṇḍarīkāgaruspṛkkośīrabhadradārukuṅkumāni purāṇakesaraṃ ce’ti | tatra prāyogikanimittatvena kuṣṭha: tayoḥ parityāgaḥ kāryaḥ mastiṣkasrāvabhayāt | yaduktaṃ ‘natakuṣṭhe snāvayato dhūmavartiprayojite | mastuluṅgaprabhāvena tasmāttaṃ na prayojayet’ iti | mṛdāviti bṛṃhaṇākhye | snigdhamityeraṇḍādiphalamajjāprāyam | athavā snigdhamityanena samastadhūmavidhānaṃ sasnehaṃ kāryamiti pūrvoktatvāt | sārjarasamiti | sarjarasaprāyaṃ prāyogikamityarthaḥ | taduktaṃ -‘snigdhabhajjamadhūcchiṣṭasnehaguggulusarjakaiḥ | snehikā bastirebhistu netraṃ dvātriṃśadaṅgulam’ iti | recanatīkṣṇakalkamiti | recanamiti śodhanākhyadhūmapāne | tīkṣṇakalkamiti śirovirecanadravyakṛtavartirityartha: | śirovirecanairvartirnetraṃ hastamitamityuktatvāt | śirovirecanairityapāmārgabījādibhiḥ | hastamitamiti caturviśadaṅgulaṃ | kāsaghre kṣudrikoṣaṇamiti kāsaghne dhūmapāne | kṣudrikā kaṇṭakārikā | ūṣaṇamatra trikaṭukaṃ grāhyaṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt | tadyathā bṛhattryūṣaṇaṃ bṛhatī śṛṅgī ceṅgudītvagmanaḥśilā | eṣā kāsaharā vartirnetraṃ ṣoḍaśakāṃgulam’ iti | vāmane snāyucarmādyamiti | vāmane dhūmapāne | snāyucarmādyaṃ vartyai dadyādityarthaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt asthikhuravallūramapi gṛhyate | taduktaṃ ‘vāmanīye tu ballūrasnāyvasthikhuravarmabhiḥ| vartirdaśāṅgule netraṃ dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ iti | vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsamiti | eke dhūmasya pānakamityanena ghrāṇadhūpanasya vyākhyānaṃ kurvanti tatra dhūmasya ghrāṇadhūpanasya pānakamiti tadvihitadravyamityarthaḥ | iti na sarvamataṃ | ‘dhūmaḥ pañcavidho mata’ ityādivacanāt || 19 || 20 ||

Gū. śamane elādikalkaṃ deyam | elādirelādigaṇaḥ tatrailādinā kuṣṭhavarjeneti suśrutaḥ | tathā elādigaṇo vāgbhaṭe - ‘elāyugmarukkuṣṭhaphalinīmāṃsījaladhyāmakaṃ, spṛkkācorakacocapatrasugurusthauleyajātīrasāḥ | śaktivyāghrinakhomarahvamagaruḥ śrīvāsakaḥ kuṅkumaṃ, caṇḍāgugguludevadhūparavapunnāganāgāhvayāḥ | elādiko vātakaphau viṣaṃ ca viniyacchati | varṇaprasādanaḥ kaṇḍūpiḍakākoṣṭhanāśanaḥ’ | eṣā vartiḥ prāyogike prāyogikaṃ tu tri:triśvāsenādadīta viśeṣatastu prāyogikaṃ ghrāṇenādadīta mṛdau snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ snehaphalāsāradhūmocchiṣṭasarjarasagugguluprabhṛtibhiḥ srehamiśraiḥ sneheneti suśrutaḥ | kāsaghne kṣudrikoṣaṇaṃ kṣudrā kaṇṭakārī vyoṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā trikaṭukāsamardaka iṅgudītvagmanaḥśilā chinnaruhā karkaṭaśṛṅgīprabhṛtibhiḥ kāsaharaiśca kāsaghnairvāmanaiḥ snāyucarmādyaṃ dadyāt | snāyucarmakhuraṃ śṛṅgakakarāsthiśuṣkamatsyavallūrakamiśraprabhṛtibhirvāmanīyaiḥ iti suśrutaḥ | snāyunāḍī suśrute ‘dhūmaḥ pañcavidho bhavatī’tyuktaṃ tadyathā prāyogikaḥ snehano virecanaḥ kāsaghno vāmanīyaśceti śamanadhūmastu bhinnaprayoktastena śārṅgadhareṇa ṣaḍvidho likhitaḥ || 19 || 20 ||

ab.seg: bālagrahādau dhūmapānamāha - aparājito dhūpaḥ anye'pi dhūmā geheṣu kartavyā rogaśāntaye ||21||
mayūrapicchaṃ nimbasya patrāṇi bṛhatīphalam | maricaṃ hiṅgu māṃsī ca bījaṃ kārpāsasaṃbhavam ||22||
chāgaromāhinirmokaṃ viṣṭhā vaiḍālikī tathā | gajadantaśca taccūrṇaṃ kiṃciddhṛtavimiśritam ||23||
geheṣu dhūpanaṃ dattaṃ sarvānbālagrahāñjayet | piśācānrākṣasāñjitvā sarvajvaraharaṃ bhavet || 24 ||

Dī. athānye gṛhadhūmāḥ santi tānapi prasaṅgato darśayannāha - ayamaparājitasaṃjño dhūpaḥ prasiddha eva | tatra bṛhatīphalaṃ kaṇṭakārikāphalaṃ | māṃsī jaṭākhyā | ahinirmokaṃ sarpakañculikaṃ | viṣṭhā baiḍālikī mārjārapurīṣam | nanu tantrāntare māheśvaradhūpasaṃjño'yaṃ kathamatrāparājitasaṃjñaḥ | ucyate - tatra māheśvarasaṃjñatvena rudranirmālyābhidhānatvādadoṣaḥ | taduktaṃ - ‘rudrajaṭāgośṛṅgaviḍālaviṣṭhoragasya nirmokaḥ | madanaphalabhūtakeśīvaṃśatvag iti nirmālyam | yavamasūracandrakacchāgalaromāṇi sarṣapāḥ savacāḥ | hiṅgugajadvijamaricāḥ samabhāgā chāgamūtrasaṃpiṣṭāḥ | dhūpanavidhinā śamayantyete sarvajvarānniyatam | grahaḍākinīpiśācapretavikārāpaho dhūpa’ iti bahudravyoktakalpanādvā na doṣaḥ || 21-24 ||
Gū. mayūrapicchaṃ mayūrapakṣam | ahinirmokaṃ sarpakaṃcukam || 21-24 ||
dhūmapāne pathyaṃ, netradravyāṇyāha - parihārastu dhūmeṣu kāryo recananasyavat | netrāṇi dhātujānyāhurnalavaṃśādijānyapi || 25 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe dhūmapānavidhirnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha dhūmapānapariharaṃ netrārthaṃ dravyaṃ ca darśayannāha - dhūmeṣviti | ṣaḍvidhadhūmapānaviṣayeṣu parihārastyājyābhidhaḥ | sa ca virecananasyavat kāryaḥ | tattathaiva jñātavyam | athavā parihārastu dhūmeṣu kāryo recanavattatheti pāṭhāntaram | yathā virecanokte sati pravātasevāmbusnehāsaṃgamajīrṇatāmityādikaṃ seveta tathā dhūmapānake sati tatra vātasevādiparityāga ityabhiprāyaḥ | netrāṇīti | dhūmapānārthaṃ nāḍīyantrāṇi tānyanuktatvāddaśadhātujāni nalavaṃśādijānyapi boddhavyāni | dhātavo'tra suvarṇādyāḥ | ādigrahaṇādanyakāṣṭhadantaśṛṅgaghaṭitānītyarthaḥ || 25 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe dhūmapānādhyāyaḥ || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadipikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dhūmapāna- nāmādhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha gaṇḍūṣavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha gaṇḍūṣakavalapratisāraṇavidhiḥ | ūrṣvagatadoṣaharatvasāmānyāt dhūmapānamabhidhāya saṃpratigaṇḍūṣaṃ kavalaṃ pratisāraṇavidhimārabhyate || caturvidhaḥsuśrute - snehī, prasādī, saṃśodhanaropaṇāvityanyathā caturvidhatvamuktam | tathā tantrāntare vairecanasaṃśamanābhyāṃ ṣadvidhatvamuktaṃ tathāpyatra saṃśodhane vairecanasya prasādane śamanasyāntarbhāvānna virodhaḥ | syādgaṇḍūṣaḥ snaihikaḥ śamanastathā | śodhano ropaṇaścaiva kavalaścāpi tadvidhaḥ || 1 ||
snigdhaistu snaihiko vāte svāduśītaiḥ prasādanaḥ | pitte kaṭvamlalavaṇairuṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaḥ kaphe || 2 ||
kaṣāyatiktamadhuraiḥ kaduṣṇo ropaṇo vraṇe | catuṣprakāro gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaścāpi kīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
asaṃcārī mukhe pūrṇe gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaścaraḥ | tatra draveṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkena kavalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
dadyāddraveṣu cūrṇaṃ ca gaṇḍūṣe kolamātrakam | karṣapramāṇaḥ kalkaśca dīyate kavale budhaiḥ || 5 ||

Dī. kavalaścāpi tadvidha ityanena kavalo'pi snehakādicaturbhedaireva boddhavyaḥ | yathā catuḥprakāro gaṇḍūṣastathaiva kavalaścatuḥprakāro bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ | atha yaccatuḥprakāraṃ tatprakāravidhānamāha - snigdhaistu snaihikamityasya sthāne suśrute snigdhoṣṇaiḥ snaihike vāta iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | snaihike gaṇḍūṣakavalayorbhedaḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥ | svāduśītaḥ prasādanaḥ pitte praśastaḥ | svādurmadhuraḥ śītasparśādvīryādvānnasādano gaṇḍūṣaparyāyaḥ | sa cātra śamanabhedo jñeyaḥ | kadvamlalavaṇairiti saṃśodhanamiti gaṇḍūṣakavalataraparyāyavācakābhidhānaṃ kaphe praśastam | kaiḥ kaṭvāmlādibhiriti | uṣṇairityasya sthāne rūkṣairiti pāṭhāntaram | kaṣāyatiktamadhurairiti vraṇe mukhajanitapiḍakādirūpe | ropaṇo gaṇḍūṣasaṃjña: | kaṭvamla ityasya sthāne kaṭūṣṇa iti pāṭhaḥ pracarati | ebhiścatuḥprakāraiḥ kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ | na kevalaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaścāpīdṛśo'vagantavyaḥ | asyānte keciditi paṭhanti | ‘evaṃ snehaḥ payaḥkṣaudrarasamūtrāmlasaṃsmṛtaḥ | kaṣāyoṣṇodakābhyāṃ ca kavalā doṣato hitā’ iti | bahupustakeṣu na likhitaṃ | sarvoktenaiva kṛtārthatvāt | atha gaṇḍūṣakavalayorbhinnatvapratipādanārthaṃ vidhānamāha - pūrṇe mukhe saṃbhṛtamukhakuhare yo saṃcārī bhavati calanādirahitaḥ sa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ | tadviparītaḥ kavala iti | ata eva dravadravyeṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkena kavala ityarthaḥ | tathācoktaṃ cakradatte - ‘mukhaṃ saṃcāryate jānumātrā ca kavalena tu | asaṃcāryā tu yā mātrā gaṇḍūṣe sā prakīrtitā’ iti | ayameva pāṭhaḥ suśrute | gaṇḍūṣakavalayordravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha -gaṇḍūṣe gaṇḍūṣakaraṇavidhau cūrṇe vā | gaṇḍūṣe komalamātrakaṃ karṣapramāṇakalkam akavale dīyate budhaiḥ | gaṇḍūṣe gaṇḍūṣakaraṇavidhau cūrṇaṃ vyādhivihitadravyakṛtaṃ rajaḥ komalamātramiti karṣārdham | draveṣu toyakṣīrādiprabhṛtiṣu saṃsrāvya dadyādityarthaḥ | dravaparimāṇamuktaṃ yāvanmukhapūrṇaṃ bhavati tatparimāṇaṃ caikavāraṃ gaṇḍūṣānimittam | punaḥ punararthaṃ ca bahutaradravaṃ saṃgṛhya tadanusāreṇa cūrṇamapi saṃsrāvya deyam | evaṃ sarvaṃ prajñātavyam | tathācoktaṃ suśrute - ‘tāvacca dhārayitavyo'nanyamanasā saṃcārayitavyaśca | yāvaddoṣapratipūrṇagalakapolatvagnāsāsrotonayanapariplavaśca bhavati| tadā vimoktavya: | punaścānyo gṛhītavyam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 1-5 ||

Gū. caturvidhatvamāha - ekaḥ snehanaḥ dvitīyaḥ śamanaḥ tṛtīyaḥ śodhanaḥ caturtho ropaṇaḥ evaṃ caturvidhaḥ kavalaḥ | yairdravyairdoṣepu snaihikādayo bhavanti tatprakāramāha - vāte snigdhoṣṇairdravyaiḥ snaihikaḥ svādurmadhurastathā śītaḥ pitte taiḥ prasādanaḥ praśamano bhavati | kaṭvamlalavaṇairdravyaiḥ uṣṇaiḥ kaphe saṃśodhanaḥ | vraṇe kīdṛśo deyastadapyāha - kaṣāyatiktamadhurairdravyaiḥ kaṭūṣṇaḥ vraṇaropaṇa evaṃ caturvidhaścatuḥprakāro gaṇḍūṣaḥ kathitaḥ, kavalaścāpi tatprakārastadvidha eva, ato gaṇḍūṣakavalayorlakṣaṇamāha - tatra draveṇa pūrṇe mukhe asaṃcārī asaṃcaraṇaśīlo gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkataścaraścalanaśīlaḥ kavalaḥ mukha eva | gaṇḍūṣakalkayorauṣadhapramāṇamāha - gaṇḍūṣadravyāt draveṣu cūrṇaṃ kolamātrakaṃ deyaṃ kalāṣṭakadvayānāṃ kavale dravyātkalkaḥ karṣapramāṇaḥ | karṣaṣṭaṃkacatuṣṭayānām ||1-5||

div.ab: kasmin vayasi gaṇḍūṣo dhāryate kiyatparimitā gaṇḍūṣāḥ kāryā ityāha - dhāryante pañcamādvarṣādgaṇḍūṣakavalādayaḥ | gaṇḍūṣānsusthitaḥ kuryātsvinnabhālagalādikaḥ ||6|| manuṣyastrīṃstathā pañca sapta vā doṣanāśanāt | kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvacchedo doṣasya vā bhavet || 7 || netraghrāṇasrutiryāvattāvadgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam |

Dī. atha kīdṛśo gaṇḍūṣakavalayogyastamāha - pañcamādvarṣādupari bālyāvasthāyāmeva gaṇḍūṣakavalādayo dhāryante | ādigrahaṇātpratisāraṇasyā'tra saṃgrahaḥ | pañcamavarṣagrahaṇaṃ tantrāntare'pi darśitaṃ | tadyathā - ‘dhūmo dvādaśavarṣasya kavalaḥ pañcame hitaḥ’ iti | atha kiyatsaṃkhyābhirgaṇḍūṣaviṣayaḥ taṃ darśayannāha - gaṇḍūṣam antaḥsthitaṃ mukhamadhyasthitaṃ yasya sa tathā; punaḥ svinnā bhālagalādayo yasya sa tathā | bhālaḥ kapālaḥ, ādigrahaṇānnāsāsrotonayanādīnāṃ grahaṇam | īdṛśo rogī trivelaṃ pañcavāraṃ vā gaṇḍūṣaṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | athavā doṣanāśanānmaryādīkṛtyetyarthaḥ | kecinnibandhakārā ‘gaṇḍūṣānsusthita’ ityamuṃ ślokaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘kaphapūrṇāsyatā’ iti yāvat ślokaṃ ca na paṭhanti | kṣepakāviti manyamānatvāt | vakṣyamāṇo yathā ‘kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvacchedo doṣasya vā bhavet | netraghrāṇasrutiryāvattāvadgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam’ | asmākaṃ mate tu yuktārthatvena saṃgatāveva | bahupustakeṣu likhitadarśanāt || 6 || 7 ||

Gū. gaḍūṣakavalādayaḥ pañcamādvarṣādvayasaḥ | gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇapramāṇamāha - susthitaḥ manuṣyaḥ trīn tathā pañca sapta vā doṣanāśanāt gaṇḍūṣānkuryāt | susthitaḥ sukhena sthitaḥ, kiṃbhūtaḥ ? svinnabhālagalādikaḥ svinnaḥ prasvedayukto bhālo galādikaṃ ca yasya saḥ | anyadapi gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇe pramāṇamāha - netraghrāṇasrutistrāvo vā yāvat tāvadeva gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam idaṃ vā pramāṇam || 6 || 7 ||

vāte snaihikagaṇḍūṣamāha - tilakalkodakaṃ kṣīraṃ sneho vā snaihike hitaḥ ||8|| tilā nīlotpalaṃ sarpiḥ śarkarā kṣīrameva ca | sakṣaudro hanuvaktrastho gaṇḍūṣo dāhanāśanaḥ || 9 || vaiśadyaṃ janayatyāsye saṃdadhāti mukhavraṇān | dāhatṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ madhugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam || 10 || viṣakṣārāgnidagdhe ca sarpirdhāryaṃ payo'thavā | tailasaindhavagaṇḍūṣo dantacāle praśasyate || 11 || śoṣaṃ mukhasya vairasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ kāñjiko jayet | sindhutrikaṭurājībhirārdrakeṇa kaphe hitaḥ || 12 || triphalāmadhugaṇḍūṣaḥ kaphāsṛkpittanāśanaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ caturvidhayoḥ kavalagaṇḍūṣayoḥ katipayān yogānāha - snaihike gaṇḍūṣe tilakalkavastraniṣpīḍitamudakamiti | kṣīramatra sāmānyena goprabhṛtijanitaṃ | snehaścāpyevam | atha kṣārādidagdhavakrasya yogamāha | tiletyādiyogo vyastaḥ samastaśca yojyaḥ | yadāha kaścit - ‘gaṇḍūṣaḥ śarkarākṣaudrapiṣṭamāṃsapayastilaiḥ | vyastaiḥ samastairyojyastu mukhe kṣārāditāpita’ iti | ‘saṃdadhāti mukhe vraṇān’ ityasya sthāne ‘saṃnihanti mukhavraṇāni’ti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | dāhatṛṣṇādayo mukhasyeti viṣakṣārāgnidagdhe mukhe iti śeṣaḥ | dhāryamityanena gaṇḍūṣaviṣayam | aparāṇyāha - tailaṃ kāñjikayogaṃ saindhavaṃ vihāya kṣīradagdhe'pi pracarati | tathāhyuktaṃ ‘tāmbūlamadhyasthitacūrṇakena dagdhaṃ mukhaṃ yasya bhavet kathaṃcit | tailena gaṇḍūṣamasau vidadhyādamlāranālena punaḥ punarvā’ iti | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviśeṣajanitān pradarśayannāha | siṃdhutrikaṭurājībhirityanena kavalayogamāhuḥ | saindhavādayo vyastāḥ samastāśca yojyāḥ | yadyetevāṃ gaṇḍūṣastadā kalkaṃ kṛtvā paṭe visrāvya taddraveṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | triphaletyādiyogaḥ kvathito boddhavyaḥ | kalka iti kecit | kaphāsṛkpittaprakopamukhasthitamiti bhāvaḥ || 8-12 ||

Gū. snaihike gaṇḍūṣe tilakalkaḥ udakaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ sneho vā tailādikaḥ hitaḥ | vātaroge eva vātasya prayogāt | atha pitte gaṇḍūṣaḥ śamana evocyate nīlādīnāṃ hanuvakrastho gaṇḍūṣo dāhanāśano bhavati | dāho mukhadāhaḥ hanvāśritaṃ vaktraṃ tatrasthaḥ | atha mukhavraṇādau madhugaṇḍūṣaḥ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatvaṃ | nirmalateti yāvat āsye mukhe mukhavraṇān sphoṭānsaṃdadhāti saṃdhānaṃ karoti | spaṣṭamanyat | viṣādau gaṇḍūṣānāha - sarpirghṛtaṃ, payo dugdham | atha dantacāle gaṇḍūṣaḥ tileti spaṣṭaṃ | atha mukhaśoṣe śotheti sugamam | atha kaphe saṃśodhanaḥ rājī prasiddhā | atha kaphāsṛkpitte triphaleti | sugamam || 8-12 ||

div.ab: atha mukhapāke gaṇḍūṣaḥ - (pratisāraṇacūrṇam) dārvī guḍūcī triphalā drākṣā jātyāśca pallavāḥ ||13|| yavāsaśceti takkāthaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyutaḥ | śīto mukhe dhṛto hanyānmukhapākaṃ tridoṣajam ||14|| yasyauṣadhasya gaṇḍūṣastasya vai pratisāraṇam | kavalaścāpi tasyaiva jñeyo'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ || 15 || keśaraṃ mātuluṅgasya saindhavoṣaṇasaṃyutam | hanyātkavalato jāḍyamaruciṃ kaphavātajām ||16|| kalko'valehacūrṇaṃ ca trividhaṃ pratisāraṇam | aṅgulyagragṛhītaṃ ca yathāsvaṃ mukharogiṇam ||17|| kuṣṭhaṃ dārvī samaṅgā ca pāṭhā tiktā ca pītikā | tejanī mukhalodhre ca cūrṇaṃ syātpratisāraṇam ||18|| raktasnutiṃ dantapīḍāṃ śothaṃ dāhaṃ ca nāśayet |

ab.seg: Dī. aparamapi mukhapākayogamāha | dārvī dāruharidrā triphalā harītakīvibhītakāmalakasaṃjñā | jātī mālatī | yavāsa ityasya sthāne aṃbaṣṭhā ceti tatkvāthaḥ pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | anyato darśanāt | tathāhi - ‘jātīpatrāmṛtādrākṣāpāṭhādārvīphalatrikaiḥ | kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ śīto gaṇḍūṣo mukhapākanut’ iti | ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyuta iti | kvathitajalasya yatṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ tena samaṃ kṣaudramiti | athavā ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyuta iti pāṭhaḥ samīcīno jñeyaḥ | tena kkāthasya pañcabhāgāḥ ṣaṣṭho bhāgaḥ kṣaudrasyeti vyākhyānaṃ samīcīnam | mukhe dhṛta ityanena gaṇḍūṣaviṣaya: | ‘yasyauṣadhasya gaṇḍūṣaḥ tasyaiva pratisāraṇam | kavalaścāpi tasyaiva jñeyo'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ’ ayaṃ śloko bahupustakeṣu na likhitaḥ | kenacitsaṃlikhya svīkṛtaḥ | saṃgatoyamitimanyamānairasmābhirapi na tyājyaḥ yuktārthatvāt | atha kavalārthaṃ yogamāha - mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | tasya keśaraṃ madhyasthitāvayavaviśeṣaṃ loke catūrīnnāmakaṃ vācyaṃ | saindhavoṣaṇacūrṇe manāk deyam | uṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ | jāḍyamiti mukhasyeti | pūrvamuktaṃ pratisāraṇaviṣayaṃ tadidānīṃ darśayannāha | pratisāryate ghṛṣyate aneneti pratisāraṇam | nanu tantrāntare pratisāraṇaviṣayaṃ caturvidhaṃ tadyathā - ‘vibhajya bheṣajaṃ buddhyā kurvīta pratisāraṇaṃ | kalko rasakriyā kṣaudraṃ cūrṇaṃ ceti caturvidham | aṃgulyagrapraṇītaṃ tu yathāsvaṃ mukharogiṇām | tasya yogamayogaṃ ca kavalāktaṃ vibhāvayet’ | tatkathamatra trividham | ucyate | atrāvalehatvena rasakriyā: kṣaudrayostadantaḥ pracāraḥ | tenāvalehagrahaṇena dvayorapi grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇacūrṇaṃ darśayannāha - kuṣṭhaṃ ruk, dārvī dāruharidrāsamaṃ gāñjalikārikā, pāṭhā ambaṣṭhā, tiktā kaṭukī, pītikā haridrā tejanī cavikā iti cakraḥ | mūrvā iti kārtikaḥ | mustaṃ meghaḥ, lodhraṃ prasiddham | raktasrutiratra dantamūlagatadoṣasyaiva boddhavyā | śothadāhamapi mukhajanitameva || 13-18 ||

Gū. dārvī dāruharidrā jātī mālatīpatrāṇi vāsakaḥ kvāthāt ṣaṣṭhāṃśaḥ kṣaudraṃ madhu yasya gaṇḍūṣasyaiva pratisāraṇaṃ kavalaścetyāha yasyeti sugamaṃ | kavalo yathā mātuluṅgasya bījapūrasya keśaraṃ madhyasthaṃ saindhavaṃ maricam etatkavalo jāḍyaṃ mukhajaḍatām aruciṃ kaphavātajāṃ kaphavātajātāṃ | pratisāraṇaṃ trividhaṃ bhavatītyāha - kalkaḥ avalehaḥ tathā cūrṇaṃ trividhaṃ triprakāraṃ pratisāraṇaṃ bhavati mukharogiṇāṃ yathāsukhaṃ yathādoṣaṃ trividhaṃ pratisāraṇasaṃjñaṃ bhavati | kiṃbhūtam aṃgulyagragṛhītaṃ kalkādyaṃ pratisāraṇaṃ yathā kuṣṭhaṃ, dārvī, dāruharidrā, samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā, pāṭhā tiktā kaṭukī, pītikā haridrā, tejanī tejohvā, mustaṃ bhadramustaṃ, lodhram etatpratisāraṇaṃ cūrṇam aṅgulyagreṇa gharṣayet | raktasrāvādīn nāśayet || 13-18 ||

div.ab: hīnayogamāha - hīnayogātkaphotkleśo rasājñānārucī tathā ||19|| atiyogānmukhe pākaḥ śoṣastṛṣṇā klamo bhavet |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ hīnātiyogatvena gaṇḍūṣādīnāṃ doṣamāha - hīnayogāt kaphotkleśa iti | kaphādhikacetotkleśa upasthitavamanonmukhatā rasājñānāruciḥ | tatheti rasānāṃ madhurādīnām ajñānaṃ rasanendriyaviṣayahānirityabhiprāyaḥ | arucistrividhaḥ | aruciranannābhinandanam | bhaktadveṣa iti | tadyathā satyāṃ bubhukṣāyāmabhyavahārāsāmarthyamityaruciḥ | anabhilaṣitamapyannaṃ dīyamānamabhyavaharatītyannābhinandanam | annasya śravaṇasmaraṇadarśanasparśanairyatrodvejite sa bhaktadveṣa iti | atiyogāditi | gaṇḍūṣakavalādīnāmeva | eke hīnātiyogaviṣayaṃ śodhanākhyagaṇḍūṣaṃ mānayanti | tathācoktaṃ ‘śodhanīye viśeṣeṇa bhavatyetattu lakṣaṇam’ iti || 19 ||

Gū. gaṇḍūṣādīnāṃ hīnayogāt hīnamātrākaraṇāt kaphokleśaḥ kaphādhikyaṃ rasājñānārucī rasānāṃ madhurādīnām ajñānaṃ yathārthasvādalābhaḥ tathā arucirasāruci atrārucirvā ete bhavataḥ | atiyogāt gaṇḍūṣādīnāmatikaraṇāt mukhe pākaḥ śoṣastṛṣṇāklamo glāniḥ etadbhavet || 19 ||
śuddhagaṇḍūṣalakṣaṇamāha - vyādherapacayastuṣṭirvaiśadyaṃ vaktralāghavam || 20 ||
indriyāṇāṃ prasādaśca gaṇḍūṣe śuddhilakṣaṇam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe gaṇḍūṣādi- vidhirnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

Dī. atha samyak śīlitasya gaṇḍūṣasya śuddhilakṣaṇaṃ | vyādherapacayo vināśa: | tuṣṭiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ | vaiśadyaṃ mukhasyeti | indriyāṇāṃ śravaṇanayanaghrāṇarasanādīnāṃ prasādaḥ svaviṣayagrahaṇasāmarthyam | eke apacayasthāne apanayaḥ, gaṇḍūṣasthāne kavala iti paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ || 20 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe kavalādhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

Gū. gaṇḍūṣe satataṃ śuddhalakṣaṇaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ gaṇḍūṣalakṣaṇaṃ yadvā mukhaśuddhilakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ tallakṣaṇamityāha - vyādherapacayo nāśaḥ vyādheḥ mukhe kaphaliptatājyādeḥ tuṣṭisaṃtoṣaḥ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā vaktralāghavaṃ gurutānāśaḥ indriyāṇāṃ rasādīnāṃ prasādaḥ prasannatā etallakṣaṇaṃ bhavati || 20 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne gaṇḍūṣādividhi- radhyāya: || 10 ||

div.head: atha lepanādividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha kavalādīnāṃ vidhimabhidhāya saṃpratilepamūrddhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhimārabhyate | tatra tāvatpralepanāmānyāha - ālepasya ca nāmāni lipto lepaśca lepanam | doṣaghno viṣahā varṇyo mukhalepastridhā mataḥ || 1 ||
tripramāṇaścaturbhāgatribhāgā'rdhāṅgulonnata: | ārdro vyādhiharaḥ sa syācchuṣko dūṣayati cchavim ||2||

div.ab: Dī. tridhā mata ityanena eko doṣaghnaḥ dvitīyo viṣahā kathitaḥ aparastu varṇya iti tridhā saṃjño'sminmate'nyatrāpi prasiddha eva | sa eva varṇyo mukhalepaḥ kathitaḥ | na tu catvāro bhedāḥ vakṣyamāṇatvāt tripramāṇa iti teṣāṃ doṣaghnādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ traya eva parimāṇā yathā'nukrameṇa boddhavyāḥ | sa kathaṃbhūta: | caturbhāgavibhāgārdhāṅgulonnata iti | etena kimuktaṃ | doṣaghno lepaḥ aṅgulasya caturbhāgapramāṇenotsedhaḥ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | evaṃ viṣahālepastu tribhāgotsedhaḥ kāryaḥ | tribhāgatāṅgulasyeti saṃbandhaḥ | varṇyo lepaścārdhāṅgulonnata eva kuryāt | athārdraśuṣkayoḥ phalamāha | ārdro vyādhihara ityādi | sa pūrvokto lepo yāvadārdro bhavati tāvadvyādhiharo jñeyaḥ | yadā śuṣko bhavati tadā na vidūṣayati | chaviḥ chāyā sā ca varṇāprabhopalakṣitā | ‘ tathāca varṇaprabhāśritā yā ca chāyā sā parikīrtite’ti | nanu chāyāprabhayostu ko bhedaḥ | ucyate ‘varṇamātrapraticchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśinī | āsannāt lakṣyate chāyā prabhā dūrācca lakṣyate’ iti | na kevalaṃ varṇaprabhācchāyānāṃ lakṣaṇabhedaḥ | saṃkhyābhedopyastīti | tadyathā caturdhā varṇaḥ gauraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ gauraśyāma iti | prabhā ca saptavidhā raktā pītā sitā śyāmā haritā pāṇḍurā siteti | chāyāpi pañcavidhā snigdhā vimalā rūkṣā malinā saṃkṣiptā iti || 1 || 2 ||

Gū. atha mūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhiḥ | tatrādau lepaḥ lipto lepaḥ lepanaṃ tāni trīṇi ālepasya nāmāni bhavanti | nāmakathanaṃ saṃjñārthaṃ paryāyakathanārthaṃ ca | sa lepastridhā triprakāraḥ mataḥ kathitaḥ | ekaḥ doṣaghnaḥ śothādināśakaḥ | doṣaśabdenāpi rogā ucyante | dvitīyo viṣahā bhallātādiviṣanāśakaḥ| tṛtīyo varṇyaḥ mukhavyaṅgādivarṇakaraḥ | evaṃbhūto mukhalepaḥ mukhyo lepaḥ tridhā | mukhaśabdena mukhya ucyate | tathāca viśvaḥ ‘mukhaṃ ca vadane mukhye ādau dvārābhyupāyayoḥ’ iti | punaḥ lepastripramāṇaḥ trīṇi pramāṇāni yasya saḥ | tadvidhānamāha - caturbhāgaḥ aṅgulasya catvāro bhāgā yasya saḥ pūrṇāṅgula ityarthaḥ | sa tu doṣaghnaḥ | tribhāgaḥ trīṇi aṅgulāni yasya saḥ tribhāgaḥ sa tu viṣahā | ardhāṅgulottamaḥ ardham aṅgulapramāṇam unnata uccaḥ, sa tu varṇyaḥ varṇakaraḥ | sa ārdraḥ aśuṣkaḥ chaviṃ kāntiṃ dūṣayati || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg: doṣaghno lepo yathā - punarnavāṃ dāru śuṇṭhīṃ siddhārthaṃ śigrumeva ca | piṣṭvā caivāranālena pralepa: sarvaśothajit || 3 ||

Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ doṣaghno viṣahā varṇyo lepastridhā | tatra tāvaddoṣaghno lepo yathā | siddhārthaṃ sarṣapāḥ śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ āranālaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ tadabhāve'mlatakraṃ grāhyamiti sarvatra | ayaṃ lepaḥ sarvaśothajidityanena vātakaphaprāyaṃ śothaṃ viśeṣeṇa jayatīti pracaratīti | śotho'tra doṣajanitaḥ śopharogasaṃbhavaḥ | na tu vraṇaśothaḥ tatrāpyāgantujāpīti saṃbandhāt || 3 ||
Gū. punarnavā dāru devadāru śuṇṭhī siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaḥ śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ āranālena kāñjikena | tadabhāve gomūtreṇa vā lepaḥ kāryaḥ sa lepaḥ sarvaśothahṛdbhavati sarvaśothena ca viṣaśotha: || 3 ||

div.ab: atha dāhe lepaḥ vibhītaphalamajjāyā lepo dāhārtināśanaḥ |
Dī. athāparaḥ pittajadāhanāśano lepastamāha - atrāpi āranālena peṣaṇamiti saṃbandho jñeyaḥ ||
Gū. bibhītaphalaṃ bibhītakaphalaṃ tasya majjālepaḥ ||

ab.seg: atha daśāṅgalepo visarpaśothavraṇādau – (daśāṅgalepaḥ) śirīṣaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca tagaraṃ raktacandanam || 4 ||
elā māṃsī niśāyugmaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vālakameva ca | iti saṃcūrṇya lopo'yaṃ pañcamāṃśaghṛtapluta: || 5 ||
jalena kriyate sujñairdaśāṅga iti saṃjñitaḥ | visarpānviṣavisphoṭāñśothānduṣṭavraṇāñjayet ||6||

Dī. atha daśāṅgalepasaṃjñakaṃ lepamapyāha - atra śirīṣaḥ śirīṣavṛkṣatvak | eke pañcāṅgaśirīṣamatra yojayanti prayogāntaradarśanāt | tathāhi - ‘śirīṣapañcāṃgatuṣodakena kalkīkṛtaṃ caiva ghṛtena yuktam | nihanti visphoṭakamugrarūpaṃ sadāhapākasrutirāgayuktam’ iti | yatra tvaṅmūlapuṣpāṇi phalānyaṅgāni pañca veti | niśāyugmamiti haridrādvayaṃ | pañcamāṃśaghṛtapluta iti | sakaladravyāṇāṃ samabhāgamilitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tadanu jalena saṃpiṣya paścātpañcamāṃśena ghṛtena saṃplāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | pañcamāṃśamatra dravyaparimāṇāt || 4-6 ||
Gū. śirīṣaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayaṃ, vālakam udīcyaṃ, cūrṇātpañcamāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ daśāṅga iti daśa aṅgāni auṣadhāni yasya saḥ ghṛtaṃ tu prakṣepakadravyaṃ tadbhinnam || 4-6 ||
viṣaghno lepo yathā - ajādugdhatilairlepo navanītena saṃyutaḥ | śothamāruṣkaraṃ hanti lepo vā kṛṣṇamṛttikaiḥ ||7||
Dī. atha viṣahā lepamāha - āruṣkaro bhallātakaḥ tajjanitaḥ śotha iti || 7 ||
Gū. āruṣkaraṃ bhallātakajanitaṃ | spaṣṭhamanyat ||7||
atha kīṭaghnalepaḥ - lāṅgalyativiṣālābujālinīmūlabījakaiḥ | lepo dhānyāmbusaṃpiṣṭa: kīṭavisphoṭanāśanaḥ || 8 ||

Dī. aparamapyāha - lāṅgalī kalikārikā | ativiṣā ‘atīsa’ śabdavācyā | alābu kaṭutumbī jālinī ‘toraī’ śabdavācyā | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya bījāni | eke alābuprabhṛtīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ bījāni gṛhanti | dhānyāmbusaṃpiṣṭa iti | dhānyāmbu kāñjikabhedaḥ | kīṭavisphoṭaḥ saviṣakīṭadaṣṭajanitavisphoṭa ityarthaḥ | yathā lūtādayaḥ || 8 ||
Gū. lāṅgalī kalihārī, ativiṣā prasiddhā alābu tumbī jālinī kaṭutumbībījāni mūlakabījāni dhānyāmbu kāñjikam || 8 ||
varṇyo lepo yathā - raktacandanamañjiṣṭhālodhrakuṣṭhapriyaṅgavaḥ | vaṭāṅkurā masūrāśca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥ || 9 ||
mātuluṅgajaṭā sarpiḥ śilā gośakṛto rasaḥ | mukhakāntikaro lepaḥ piṭikāvyaṅgakālajit ||10||
lodhradhānyavacālepastāruṇyapiṭikāpahaḥ | tadvadgorocanāyuktaṃ maricaṃ mukhalepanam || 11 ||
siddhārthakavacālodhrasaindhavaiśca pralepanam | vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvagvā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā || 12||
lepaḥ sanavatīto vā śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī | arkakṣīraharidrābhyāṃ mardayitvā vilepanāt || 13 ||
mukhakārṣṇyaṃ śamaṃ yāti cirakālodbhavaṃ dhruvam | vaṭasya pāṇḍupatrāṇi mālatī raktacandanam || 14 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ kālīyakaṃ lodhramebhirlepaṃ prayojayet | tāruṇyapiṭikāvyaṅganīlikādivināśanam || 15 ||

Dī. atha viṣahā lepamabhidhāya samprati varṇyalepamāha - raktacandanādīni vyastāni samastāni saṃgṛhya jalenāpiṣya lepaḥ kārya iti saṃbandhaḥ | atra priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni | vaṭāṅkurā iti vaṭasyābhinavāḥ patramukulāḥ | masūro'nnaviśeṣaḥ | mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ tasya jaṭā mūlaṃ | śilā manaḥśilā | gośakṛto rasa iti | gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tasya rasa ityarthaḥ | dhānyaṃ dhānaśabdavācyam | tadvadatitāruṇyapiḍakāpahopyayaṃ lepo boddhavyaḥ | gorocanā prasiddhā siddhārthaka iti | atrāpi tāruṇyapiḍakāpaha iti saṃbandhaḥ | tena siddhārthādidravyacatuṣkairlepo yauvanapiḍakāpaho bhavatīti matāntarāt | arjuno vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ sa ca kauhāśabdavācyaḥ tasya tvak challī | mañjiṣṭhā prasiddhā | samākṣikā dhātumākṣikasaṃyuktā | sacārjunatvak mañjiṣṭhā vā | tena vikalpatvāt tvaca eko yogaḥ mañjiṣṭhāyā dvitīyo yogaḥ | aśvakhurajanitasya kajjalasya tṛtīya iti | eke śvetā aparājiteti vyākhyānayanti | eke arkakṣīramiti bhinnapadaṃ haridrābhyāmiti dvivacanatvena haridrā dāruharidrā yojyeti vyākhyānayanti | etatsarvatra na pracarati tenārkakṣīraharidrābhyāmeva yogaḥ sādhuḥ| vaṭasya vaṭavṛkṣasya pāṇḍupatrāṇīti | pariṇatatvātteṣu pāṇḍuratvaṃ tādṛśānītyarthaḥ | mālatī jātī tasyāḥ patrāṇi kālīyakam agurubhedaṃ pītasāramiti loke | kecidvaṭaśca pāṇḍupatrāṇītī paṭhanti tatra vaṭa ityanena vaṭavṛkṣasya patrāṇi pāṇḍuḥ paṭolastasyāpi patrāṇītyarthaḥ | etanna sarvamatam | aprasiddhatvāt || 9-15 ||

Gū. raktacandaneti sugamaṃ | vyaṅgalepaḥ vyaṅgaśchāyā | atha tāruṇyapiḍakādau - mātuluṅgo bījapūramūlaṃ, sarpirghṛtaṃ, śilā manaḥśilā gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaḥ kālaṃ kālimā | atha tāruṇyapiḍakādau - dhānyaṃ prasiddham | siddhārthakaṃ sarṣapāḥ ete trayo yogāḥ piḍakādau | atha vyaṅge-arjunatvak arjunavṛkṣatvak mākṣikaṃ madhu śveto yo'śvaḥ ghoṭakastat khurajanyā maṣī bhasma mukhaśyāmatāyāṃ punaḥ - mālatī jātī kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrā || 9-15 ||
athāruṃṣikāyāṃ lepaḥ - purāṇamatha piṇyākaṃ purīṣaṃ kukkuṭasya ca | mūtrapiṣṭa: pralepo'yaṃ śīghraṃ hanyādaruṃṣikām ||16||
khādirāriṣṭajambūnāṃ tvagbhirvā mūtrasaṃyutaiḥ | kuṭajatvaksaindhavaṃ ca lepo hanyādaruṃṣikām ||17||

div.ab: Dī. piṇyākaṃ tilakalkajanitaṃ khaliśabdavācyaṃ | tacca purātanaṃ varṣoṣitaṃ grāhyaṃ | kukkuṭaḥ tāmracūḍaḥ tasya purīṣaṃ | mūtramatra gavyam || 16 || 17 ||
Gū. priṇyākaṃ tilakhalaḥ anyaṃ ca ariṣṭo nimba: aruṃṣikā apiṭakāḥ || 16 || 17 ||

dāruṇe lepaḥ - priyālabījamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ | kāryo dāruṇake mūrdhni pralepo madhusaṃyutaḥ || 18 || dugdhena khākhasaṃ bījaṃ pralepāddāruṇaṃ jayet | āmrabījasya cūrṇaṃ tu śivācūrṇasamaṃ dvayam || 19 || dugdhapiṣṭha: pralepo'yaṃ dāruṇaṃ hanti dāruṇam |

Dī. priyālabījaṃ cirauñjīti prasiddham | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ | madhusaṃyuta ityanena priyālabījādiboddhavyam | jalena saṃpiṣya manāk madhunā saṃsrāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | dugdhamatra gavyaṃ | khākhasaṃ bījamiti dānaśabdavācyam | āmrabījasya cūrṇamiti | āmraphalamadhyasthitamajjāviśeṣaḥ | śivā harītakī | dāruṇaṃ rogaviśeṣaṃ | dvitīyaṃ dāruṇaṃ duḥsādhyamiti viśeṣaṇam || 18 || 19 ||
Gū. priyālabījaṃ cirauñjīti prasiddhaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ | khākhasaṃ śivā harītakī dāruṇe || 18 || 19 ||

athendralupte - rasastiktapaṭolasya patrāṇāṃ tadvilepanāt || 20 || indraluptaṃ śamaṃ yāti tribhireva dinairdhruvam | indraluptāpaho lepo madhunā bṛhatīrasaḥ || 21 || guñjāmūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi bhallātakaraso'pi vā | gokṣurastilapuṣpāṇi tulye ca madhusarpiṣī || 22 || śiraḥpralepanaṃ tena keśasaṃvardhanaṃ param | hastidantamaṣīṃ kṛtvā chāgīdugdhaṃ rasāñjanam ||29|| romāṇyanena jāyante lepātpāṇitaleṣvapi | yaṣṭīndīvaramṛdvīkātailājyakṣīralepanaiḥ || 24 || indraphalaṃ śamaṃ yāti keśāḥ syuḥ saghanā dṛḍhā: | catuṣpadānāṃ tvagromanakhaśrṛṅgāsthibhasmabhiḥ || 25 || tailena saha lepo'yaṃ romasaṃjananaḥ paraḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. tiktapaṭolaḥ kaṭukapaṭolaḥ tasya patrāṇāṃ rasa ityarthaḥ | tadvilepanāditi | tattasya rasasya lepanāt | tribhireva dinairityanenāsya viśiṣṭatvaṃ darśitam | nātra tridinaireva niyatapramāṇaṃ yato bahudinasevyo'yaṃ prayogaḥ | bṛhatīrasa iti pakkabṛhatīphalajanitarasasyaiko yogaḥ | guñjāyā mūlaṃ phalaṃ vā dvitīyo yogaḥ | atrā'pi madhupracāraḥ | bhallātakaphalaṃ tṛtīyo yogaḥ | eke bhallātakarasopi vetyasya sthāne'vikṣīreṇa saṃyutamiti paṭhanti | tena bheḍīdugdhena guñjāphalaṃ saṃghṛṣya lepaḥ kārya iti saṃgataḥ | saṃpradāye tu indraluptasthānaṃ prasthayitvā tadabhāve saṃghṛṣya paścāllepaḥ kārya iti sādhuḥ | uktamanyatrāpi - ‘bṛhatīphalarasasaṃpiṣṭaṃ guñjāphalamūlamindraluptasya | kanakavighṛṣṭasya tato dātavyaṃ prasthitasya sade’ti | gokṣuraḥ prasiddhaḥ | tilapuṣpāṇi vikhyātāni | tulye sāmye gokṣure satilapuṣpe ityarthaḥ | madhusarpiṣī ca | tulye'tra grāhye | maṣīkajjalaviśeṣaṃ hastidantaṃ dagdhvā kajjalaṃ kāryam | rasāñjanaṃ dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravyaviśeṣam | aparaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavam | tadabhāve dāruharidraiva grāhyā | ayaṃ lepaḥ keśavardhanārthamityāhuḥ | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī indīvaraṃ nīlotpalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījamapi grāhyam | padmabījaṃ gaṭāśabdavācyam| mṛdvīkā gostanī drākṣā | eke mṛdvīsthāne mūrveti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tailāni prasiddhāni | ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gopayaḥ | tilājyakṣīrasthāne tilājakṣīralepanairitipāṭhaḥ | tatrā'jakṣīramityarthaḥ tilājyakṣīramārkavairityapi pāṭhāntaraṃ saṃgatam | tathāhyuktaṃ ‘madhukendīvaramūrvātilājyagokṣīrabhṛṅgalepena | acirādbhavanti keśā ghanadṛḍhamūlāyatā mṛdava’ iti | catuṣpadāḥ go'śvāvyajebheṇakharoṣṭrādayaḥ | teṣāṃ tvak carma romanakhaśṛṅgāsthīni prasiddhāni | tena tvagādīnāṃ dagdhvā bhasma kāryaṃ tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavam || 20-25 ||

Gū. indraluptaṃ keśanāśalakṣaṇam | tiktapaṭolaṃ bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī bhallātakarasaḥ patrarasaḥ | indralupte - madhusarpirdvayaṃ tulyaṃ tulye auṣadhatulye keśaḥ saṃvardhate hastidantaṃ tanmaṣī bhasma rasāñjanaṃ kharparamañjanaṃ vā| pāṇitaleṣu hastatale'pi romāṇi jāyante | indralupte-yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī indīvaraṃ kamalaṃ mṛdvī drākṣā tailaṃ tilajam ājyaṃ goghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā | indralupte catuḥpādānāṃ tvak-roma-nakha-śṛṅga-asthi eṣāṃ bhasmāni tailena lepaḥ romasañjananaḥ indralupte || 20-25 ||

div.ab: palite lepāḥ indravāruṇikābījatailenābhyaṅgamācaret || 26 || pratyahaṃ tena jāyante kuntalā bhṛṅgasaṃnibhāḥ | ayorajo bhṛṅgarājastriphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā || 27 || sthitamikṣurase māsaṃ lepanātpalitaṃ jayet | dhātrīphalatrayaṃ pathye dve tathaikaṃ bibhītakam || 28 || pañcāmramajjā lohasya karṣaikaṃ ca pradīyate | piṣṭvā lohamaye bhāṇḍe sthāpayeduṣitaṃ niśi ||29|| lepo'yaṃ hanti nacirādakālapalitaṃ mahat | triphalā nīlikāpatraṃ lohaṃ bhṛṅgarajaḥ samam ||30|| avimūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ lepātkṛṣṇīkaraṃ smṛtam | triphalā lohacūrṇaṃ ca dāḍimatvagbisaṃ tathā ||31|| pratyekaṃ pañcapalikaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | bhṛṅgarājarasasyāpi prasthaṣaṭkaṃ pradāpayet || 32 || kṣisvā lohamaye pātre bhūmimadhye nidhāpayet | māsamekaṃ tataḥ kuryācchāgīdugdhena lepanam || 33 || kūrce śirasi rātrau ca saṃveṣṭyairaṇḍapatrakaiḥ | svapetprātastataḥ kuryātsnānaṃ tena ca jāyate || 34 || palitasya vināśaśca tribhirlepairna saṃśayaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ tadabhāve lohamalamityeke | ikṣurase ikṣurasapūrite bhāṇḍe māsamekaṃ yāvatsthitaṃ bhavati | ayaṃ kṛṣṇīkaraṇatvātpalitaṃ jayedityarthaḥ | kecidatra dhātrīphalādīnāmapi karṣāṇi grāhyāṇi | lohacūrṇakarṣaparimāṇadarśanāt | tena dhātrīphalānāṃ karṣadvayam | harītakī karṣadvayamitā | karṣaikaṃ bibhītakaphalam | āmrāsthimajjāḥ pañcakarṣā iti naitatsarvasaṃmatam| asmatsaṃpradāye tu dhātrīphaladvayameva grāhyam | evaṃ harītakīphaladvayam | ekaṃ vibhītakaphalam āmraphalānāṃ pañcasaṃkhyākaṃ majjā evaṃ pracarati | pralepo'tra jalena | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ | nīlikā nīlinī vikhyātā tasyāḥ patrāṇi lohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ samamiti sakalaṃ samamātram | ajāmūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭamityasya sthāne avimūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭam iti pāṭhaḥ | aviḥ bheḍī | dāḍimatvagityanena dāḍimaphalasya tvak valkalaṃ grāhyaṃ | bisamiti mṛṇālakamalanālamityarthaḥ | pratyekaṃ pañcapalikamityanena triphalāyāḥ pañcadaśapalāni grāhyāṇi | bhṛṅgarājarasasya ṣaṭprasthāḥ | teṣāṃ nava tilāni rasasyetyarthaḥ | etatsiddhaṃ yadā bhavati tadā ājadugdhena saha lepanaṃ deyamiti bhāvaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 26-34 ||

Gū. keśakalpe lepaḥ pātālayantreṇa tailena | kālā atiśyāmāḥ | keśakalpe - ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ bhṛṅgarājacūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikā taḍāgakardamaḥ etanmāsam ikṣurase sthitaṃ lepātpalitaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ jayet | keśakalpe-dhātrī āmalakī phalatrayaṃ pathye harītakyau dve ekaṃ vibhītakaṃ pañca āmrāṇāṃ majjā lohasya karṣaṃ piṣṭvā lohamaye bhāṇḍe sthāpayet | uṣitaṃ niśi sthāpitamacirāt śīghramevākālapalitaṃ svalpadinajanyaṃ keśaśauklyaṃ hanti | keśakalpe-nīlikāpatraṃ nīlapatraṃ bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ aviḥ bheḍaḥ tanmūtreṇa | kṛṣṇīkaraṃ śyāmakaraṃ | keśakalpe-bisaṃ kamalamūlaṃ spaṣṭamanyat || 26-34 ||
atha romaśātane - śaṅkhacūrṇasya bhāgā dvau haritālaṃ ca bhāgikam ||35||
manaḥśilā cārdhabhāgā svarjikā caikabhāgikā | lepo'yaṃ vāripiṣṭastu keśānutpāṭya dīyate || 36 ||
anayā lepayuktyā ca saptavelaṃ prayuktayā | nirmūlaṃ keśasthānaṃ syātkṣapaṇasya śiro yathā ||37||
tālakaṃ śāṇayugmaṃ syātṣaṭśāṇaṃ śaṅkhacūrṇakam| dviśāṇikaṃ palāśasya kṣāraṃ dattvā pramardayet || 38 ||
kadalīdaṇḍatoyena ravipatrarasena vā | asyāpi saptabhirlepai romṇāṃ śātanamuttamam || 39 ||
śvitre lepāḥ | suvarṇapuṣpī kāsīsaṃ viḍaṅgāni manaḥśilā | rocanā saindhavaṃ caiva lepanācchvitranāśanam || 40 ||
vāyasyeḍagajākuṣṭhakṛṣṇābhirguṭikā kṛtā | bastamūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭā pralepācchvitranāśinī || 41 ||
tālakaṃ śāṇamātraṃ syāccatuḥśāṇā ca bākucī | gomūtrapiṣṭaṃ taccūrṇaṃ lepanācchvitranāśanam || 42 ||
bākucī vetaso lākṣā kākodumvarikā kaṇā | rasāñjanamayaścūrṇaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāstadekataḥ || 43 ||
cūrṇayitvā gavāṃ pittaiḥ piṣṭvā ca guṭikā kṛtā | asyāḥ pralepācchvitrāṇi praṇaśyantyativegataḥ ||44||

Dī. atha romaśātanamāha - śaṅkhacūrṇamatra bharjitaṃ deyamiti saṃpradāyaḥ | haritālasyaiko bhāgaḥ manaḥśilā cārdhabhāgeti | tena ekabhāgāpekṣayārdhabhāgā | eke svarjikā caikabhāgikā iti vā pāṭhaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamaṃ | tālakaṃ haritālaṃ śāṇadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ | kadalīkandatoyena veti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | ravipatrarasena arkapatrasvarasena vā | ayamapi śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ pracarati | anyato darśanāt | tathāhi -‘palāśabhasmākṣitalasya cūrṇaṃ raṃbhāmbumiśrairupalipya bhūyaḥ | kandarpagehe mṛgalocanānāṃ romāṇi rohanti kadāpi naiva’ | asyāpi saptanirlepādityanena pūrvavatkāryaḥ || 35-39 ||
gū. - śaṅkhacūrṇasyeti sugamam | anyacca - ravirarkaḥ śāṇayugmaṃ ṭaṅkadvayaṃ tālakaṃ haritālaṃ palāśasya kṣāraṃ palāśabhasma || 35-39 ||

atha śvitranāśanāyāha - suvarṇapuṣpī sonīśabdavācyo viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tadabhāve bṛhadbalā grāhyā apare ca sthūlakaṃ gṛhṇanti | śīśaṃ sīsakaṃ | sīsakasthāne kāsīsamiti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | rocanā gorocanā prasiddhā | lepo'tra jalena | vāyasī kākamācī | eḍagajaḥ prapunnāṭaḥ tasya bījāni | kṛṣṇā pippalī | vatsa iti govatsaḥ | athavā chāgaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ | tālako haritālaḥ | bākucī somarājī tasyāḥ phalāni prasiddhāni śeṣaṃ sugamam | bākucī prasiddhā vetaso niculaḥ jalavetasa iti loke vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | lākṣā laktakajananī kākondumbarikā kaṭumariśabdavācyā | kaṇā pippalī| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddham | tadabhāve dāru haridrā grāhyā tatsaṃbhavatvāt | ayaścūrṇaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ | kṛṣṇāstilā iti | śvetatilaniṣedhārtham | gavāṃ pittairiti | goyakṛdekakhaṇḍaikadeśalagnaṃ dravarūpaṃ pittamiti vācyam | tadabhāve gomūtreṇa pracāraḥ iti sarvatra || 40-44 ||
Gū. atha śvitre anyacca - bākucī vāvacī kākodumbarikā kaṇā pippalī rasāñjanaṃ prasiddham | ayaścūrṇaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ gopittā'bhāve gomūtraṃ deyaṃ śvitre lepaḥ || 40-44||
atha sidhme lepaḥ - dhātrī sarjarasaścaiva yavakṣāraśca cūrṇitaḥ | sauvīreṇa pralepo'yaṃ prayojyaḥ sidhmanāśane || 45 ||
dārvī mūlabījāni tālakaṃ suradāru ca | tāmbūlapatraṃ sarvāṇi kārṣikāṇi pṛthakpṛthak ||49||
śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ śāṇamātraṃ sarvāṇyekatra kārayet | lepo'yaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭaḥ sidhmanāṃ nāśanaḥ paraḥ ||47||

Dī. atha sidhmaroge | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | sarjarasaḥ rālaḥ sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ | tacca godhūmajanitamityeke | tathāca ‘sauvīrakaṃ suvīrāmlaṃ jñeyaṃ godhūmasaṃbhavamiti’ | dhātrīrasaḥ sarjarasaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram | tatra raso rasāñjanamiti vyākhyānayanti kecit naitādṛśaḥ kiṃtu pūrveṇa pracāraḥ saṃgata eva | dārvī dārūharidrā | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadbījānīti | tālako haritālaḥ | suradāruḥ devadāruḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || || 45-47 ||
Gū. āmalakī sarjaraso rālaḥ sauvīreṇa kāñjikena lepaḥ sidhma śvetarogaḥ | anyacca dāruharidrā mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadbījāni tālakaṃ haritālaṃ suradāru devadāru spaṣṭamanyat | sidhmeṣu lepaḥ ||45-47||
atha netraroge lepaḥ- harītakī saindhavaṃ ca gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam | biḍālako jale piṣṭaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ || 48 ||
rasāñjanaṃ vyoṣayutaṃ saṃpiṣṭaṃ vaṭakīkṛtam | kaṇḍūpākānvitāṃ hanti lepādañjananāmikām||49||

div.ab: Dī. atha netraroge rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ | tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyam tadubhayoralābhe ca dāruharidrā grāhyeti sarvatra pracāraḥ| biḍālaka iti bahirlepasaṃjñaḥ | tenākṣṇorupari lepaḥ kārya iti tātparyārthaḥ | ayaṃ lepo'bhiṣyandādiroge prāyaśaḥ pracarati | rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tacca dvividhaṃ vyākhyātam | vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tacca śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñaṃ peṣaṇamatra jalenānuktatvāt || 48 || 49 ||

Gū. rasāñjanaṃ kharparaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ vā | biḍālako bahirlepaḥ dravyamagre vakṣyati anyacca rasāñjanaṃ prasiddha vyoṣaṃ trikaṭusaṃpiṣṭaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ etat lepādañjananāmikāṃ kaṇḍūpākānvitāṃ hanti | añjananāmikā netraroge paṭhitā || 48 || 49 ||

ab.seg: atha kaṇḍvādau lepaḥ | prapunnāṭasya bījāni bākucī sarṣapāstilāḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ niśādvayaṃ mustaṃ piṣṭvā takreṇa caikataḥ || 50 ||
pralepādasya naśyanti dadrūkanḍūvicarcikāḥ | hemakṣīrī viḍaṅgāni daradaṃ gandhakastathā || 51 ||
dadrughnaḥ kuṣṭhasindūre sarvāṇyekatra mardayet | dhattūranimbatāmbūlīpatrāṇāṃ svarasaiḥ pṛthak || 52 ||
asya pralepamātreṇa pāmādadrūvicarcikāḥ | kaṇḍūśca rasakaścaiva praśamaṃ yānti vegataḥ || 53 ||
dūrvā'bhayā saindhavaṃ ca cakramardaḥ kuṭherakaḥ | ebhistakrayuto lepaḥ kaṇḍūdadrūvināśanaḥ || 54 ||
dūrvāniśāyuto lepaḥ kaṇḍūpāmāvināśanaḥ | kṛmidadrūharaścaiva śītapittāpahaḥ smṛtaḥ || 55 ||
siddhārtharajanīkuṣṭhaprapunnāṭatilaiḥ saha | kaṭutailena saṃmiśraṃ dadrughnaṃ ca pralepanam || 56 ||

Dī. atha kaṇḍūdaduprabhṛtīnāṃ ca yogamāha - prapunnāṭaḥ cakramardakaḥ, tasya bījānyatra deyāni | bākucī somarājī prasiddhā tasyā api bījāni | niśādvayaṃ haridrādvayam | śeṣaṃ subodham | cakramardaḥ prasiddhaḥ, loke pamāḍaśabdavācyaḥ | abhayā harītakī | kuṭherako granthiparṇo nijanāmnā prasiddhaḥ | sa ca dvidhā ekaḥ kṣudraparṇaḥ, aparo vaṭapatra iti | niśā haridrā | atrāpi takrapiṣṭo boddhavyaḥ | siddhārthaḥ sarṣapaḥ | rajanī haridrā | prapunnāṭa eḍagajaḥ prasiddhaḥ | etatsakalaṃ jalenāpiṣya paścāt kaṭutailena saṃplāvyodvartanaṃ kāryamiti bhāvaḥ | eke siddhārtharajanīkalkairiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 50-56 ||

Gū. prapunnāṭaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tadbījāni, bākucī somarājī | siddhārthāḥ sarṣapāḥ, niśādvayaṃ haridrā dāruharidrā ca, mustaṃ bhadramustaṃ takreṇa ekataḥ piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ | vicarcikā kuṣṭharogaviśeṣaḥ | athapāmādau lepaḥ hemakṣīrī kharṇakṣīrī, viḍaṅgaṃ, daradaṃ hiṅgulaṃ, dadrughnaḥ prapunnāṭaḥ | etatsamaṃ dhattūrādīnāṃ rasena saṃmardya lepaḥ | rakaso'pi kṣudrakuṣṭabhedaḥ | anyacca - dūrvā, abhayā harītakī, cakramardaḥ dadrughnaḥ, kuṭherakaḥ udumbaraḥ, rāmatulasītyanye | spaṣṭamanyat | kaṇḍvādau -niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayam | kaṇḍūśītapittādau sugamam | iti kaṇḍvādau lepaḥ ||50-56||
atha vātavisarpādau lepāḥ - rāvā nīlotpalaṃ dāru candanaṃ madhukaṃ balā | ghṛtakṣīrayuto lepo vātavīsarpanāśanaḥ || 57 ||
mṛṇālaṃ candanaṃ lodhramuśīraṃ kamalotpalam | sārivāmalakī pathyā lepaḥ pittavisarpanut ||58||
triphalā padmakośīraṃ samaṅgā karavīrakam | nalamūlamanantā ca lepaḥ śleṣmavisarpahā || 59 ||

Dī. atha visarparoge | rāsnā surabhī, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalam, dāru devadāru, candanaṃ raktacandanam, madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, madhukaṃ, balā prasiddhā, loke śīsamaśabdavācyā | bālasthāne vacā iti pāṭhāntaraṃ na manoharam | prasiddhatvāt | ghṛtakṣīre'tra gosaṃbhave grāhye | mṛṇālaṃ kamalanālam | candanamatra raktam | uśīraṃ gandhamūlaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaḥ | kamalaṃ raktakamalam utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ | kecidutpalamiti kuṣṭhaṃ vyākhyānayanti | sārivā āsphotā sā ca gopavallīti prasiddhā | āmalakī dhātrīphalaṃ | pathyā harītakī | atrā'pi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | anuktatvājjaleneti sarvatra | triphalā harītakīprabhṛtikaṃ phalatrayam | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | padmākha iti loke | uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ | samaṅgā lajjālukā mañjiṣṭhā vā, karavīrako hayamārakaḥ | eke karavīrajamiti paṭhanti | tatra karavīrasya mūlaṃ grāhyam | anantā yavāsakaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 57-59 ||

Gū. dāru devadāru, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, balā prasiddhā vātavisarpe | mṛṇālaṃ bisaṃ kamalaṃ śvetam, utpalaṃ raktakamalaṃ, sārivā anantā pittavisarpe | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā karavīrakaṃ hayamāraḥ nalamūlaṃ, anantā yavāsā || 57-59 ||

div.ab: vātarakte pittarakte ca yogaḥ - māṃsī sarjaraso lodhraṃ madhukaṃ sahareṇukam | mūrvā nīlotpalaṃ padmaṃ śirīṣakusumaiḥ saha || 60 || pralepaḥ pittavātāsre śatadhautaghṛtaplutaḥ | āmalaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ tu piṣṭaṃ kāñjikavāribhiḥ || 61 || jayenmūrdhni pralepena raktaṃ nāsikayā sṛtam |

Dī. atha vātarakte pittarakte ca lepānāha - māṃsī jaṭākhyā, sarjaraso rālaśabdavācyaḥ | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | hareṇu dravyaviśeṣaṃ hareṇukā iti vācyam | tadabhāve nirguṇḍībījamiti sarvatra | pūrve corasnāyu moraharīti loke | padmamityatra raktakamalam | śatadhautaghṛtapluta iti | śatavāraṃ yāvat jalena prakṣālitaṃ ghṛtaṃ śatadhautasaṃjñam | āmalaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ piṣṭaṃ kāñjikavāribhiriti kāñjikatoyaiḥ| eke āmalakaṃ ghṛtasaṃsṛṣṭamiti paṭhanti | tatra pūrvaṃ ghṛtena āmalakaṃ manāk bharjayitvā paścāt kāñjikena saha saṃpeṣya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | kāñjikā'bhāve śītalajalamiti sarvatra | atha śiroroge - kuṣṭhaṃ kāñjikena saha saṃpeṣya lepaḥ kāryaḥ kāñjikābhāve śītalajalamiti sarvatra || 60 || 61 ||

Gū. māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, sarjarasaṃ rālaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, sahareṇuḥ reṇukā, mūrvā prasiddhā, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, padmaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, śirīṣapuṣpāṇi | pittarakte vātarakte ca lepaḥ āmalakaṃ kāñjikā'bhāve takram ||60||61||

ab.seg: śiroroge yogāḥ | kuṣṭhameraṇḍatailena lepātkāñjikapeṣitam || 62 ||
śiro'rtiṃ vātajāṃ hanyātpuṣpaṃ vā mucukundajam | devadāru nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ naladaṃ viśvabheṣajam || 63||
sakāñjikaḥ snehayukto lepo vātaśiro'rtinut | candanośīravaṣṭyāhvabalāvyāghranakhotpalaiḥ ||64||
kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pralepaḥ syādraktapittaśiro'rtijit | dhātrīkaseruhrīberapadmapadmakacandanaiḥ || 65 ||
dūrvośīranalānāṃ ca mūlaiḥ kuryātpralepanam | śiro'rtiṃ pittajāṃ hanyādraktapittarujaṃ tathā ||66||
hareṇunataśaileyamustailāgarudārubhiḥ | māṃsīrāsnārubūkaiśca koṣṇo lepaḥ kaphārtinut ||67||
śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhaprapunnāṭadevakāṣṭhaiḥ sarohiṣaiḥ | sukhoṣṇairmūtrapiṣṭaiśca lepaḥ śleṣmaśiro'rtinut ||68||
sārivākuṣṭhamadhukavacākṛṣṇotpalaistathā | lepaḥ sakāñjikasnehaḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedayoḥ || 69 ||
varī nīlotpalaṃ dūrvā tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ punarnavā | śaṅkhake'nantavāte ca lepaḥ sarvaśiro'rtijit ||70||

Dī. atha śiroroge | kuṣṭhaṃ tu kāñjikena saha kalkīkṛtya eraṇḍatailenāplāvya lepaḥ kāryaḥ | eraṇḍatailenetyasya sthāne eraṇḍamūleneti pāṭhāntaraṃ samīcīnam | vikalpena mucukundajaṃ puṣpam anenaiva vidhānena tatkāryakaraṃ bhavati | mucukundaḥ kundabhedaḥ prasiddha eva | tau tu śuklaraktapuṣpabhedena jñātavyau | natamatra tagaraṃ | naladaṃ māṃsī | uśīramiti kecit | viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī pūrvaṃ kāñjikena saha saṃpiṣya paścāt snehenāplāvya deyaḥ | sneho'trāpyeraṇḍasaṃbhavo jñeyaḥ | tadasaṃbhave tilatailamiti | candanaṃ raktacandanam | vyāghranakhaṃ nakhabhedaḥ | śuktikākāraṃ sugandhadravyaviśeṣaḥ | utpalaṃ kamalaviśeṣaḥ| kṣīramatra gavyam ājaṃ vā | dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ kaseruḥ prasiddhaḥ | hrīberaṃ vālakaṃ padmakaṃ | candanaṃ raktam | mūrvośīranālānāṃ trayāṇāṃ mūlāni | tatra mūrvā corasnāyuḥ | uśīraṃ gandhamūla tṛṇabhedaḥ | nalaṃ prathitaṃ | tacca suṣira... ..kāṇḍaśarākāram | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kṣīramityāhureke | saṃpradāyatastu anuktatvājjalamiti | hareṇuḥ reṇukāśabdavācyā | nataṃ tagaraṃ, śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpaṃ hvala iti loke, agaru prasiddhaṃ, māṃsījaṭeti sugandhadravyam | rāsnā surabhī, rubūkam eraṇḍaḥ tasyā'tra sneho grāhyaḥ | kaphārtinudityanena kaphajanitaśirorogapīḍāṃ nāśayedityarthaṃ | prapunnāṭaścakramardaḥ devakāṣṭhaṃ surakāṣṭhaṃ suradāru rohiṣaṃ gandhatṛṇaṃ vikhyātaṃ, mūtramatra gavyam | śeṣaṃ subodham | sārivā gopavallīsaṃjñā āsphotā iti loke | madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu | kṛṣṇotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ | tadabhāve kama- labījamiti | eke kṛṣṇotpalaśabdena rīṭhā(ariṣṭakaphalaṃ) śabdadravyaviśeṣaṃ vyākhyānayanti | tanna sarvamatam | lepaḥ sakāñjikaḥ sneha iti | kāñjikasnehābhyāṃ saha lepaḥ kārya ityabhiprāyaḥ | snehagrahaṇenātra sarpiḥsnehaṃ vā yathādoṣāpekṣayā deyam | uktaṃ cānyatra ‘varī nīlotpalaṃ mūrvā tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ punarnavā’ | varṣābhūḥ prasiddha eva | śaṅkhakamanantavātaṃ ca śiroroge paṭhitam || 62-70||

Gū. athavātaśirovyathāyāṃ lepaḥ - kuṣṭheti spaṣṭam | nataṃ tagaraṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ, naladam uśīraṃ, viśvabheṣajaṃ śuṇṭhī, snehaḥ eraṇḍatailaḥ pūrvoktatvāt | vātaśiroroge nakhaṃ nakhadravyaviśeṣaḥ, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, kṣīraṃ gavyam | pittaśiroroge dhātrī āmalakī, kaseru, hrīberaṃ vālakaṃ, padmaṃ kamalaṃ, padmaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, dūrvā, uśīraṃ prasiddhaṃ nalamūlam | pittaśiroroge tathā raktapitte lepaḥ-hareṇuḥ reṇukā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, śaileyaṃ, mustaṃ bhadramustam, elā, agaru, devadāru, māṃsī, rāsnā, rubūka eraṇḍaḥ | kaphaśiroruji prapunnāṭaḥ cakramardaḥ, devakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru, rohiṣaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha sūryāvartārdhabhede śleṣmaśiroroge | lepaḥ | sārivā anantamūlaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, kṛṣṇā pippalī, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, snehaḥ eraṇḍāditailam | atha śaṅkhake anantavātādau tathā sarvarogeṣu ca lepaḥ kathyate | varī śatāvarī | varā iti pāṭhe triphalā, kṛṣṇā pippalī || 62-70 ||

div.ab: athānyo lepavidhiḥ kathyate - atha lepavidhiścānyaḥ procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ | dvau tasya kathitau bhedau pralepākhyapradehakau ||71|| carmārdraṃ māhiṣaṃ yadvatpronnataṃ sā mitistayoḥ | śītastanurviśoṣī ca pralepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 72 || ārdro ghanastathoṣṇaḥ syātpradehaḥ śleṣmavātahā | romābhimukhamādeyau pralepākhyapradehakau || 73 || vīryaṃ samyagviśatyāśu romakūpaiḥ śirāmukhaiḥ | na rātrau lepanaṃ kuryācchuṣyamāṇaṃ na dhārayet ||74|| śuṣyamāṇamupekṣeta pradehaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati | (tamasādīpikāsammataḥ | pihito hyūṣmā romakūpamukhe sthitaḥ ||75|| vinā lepena niryāti rātrau no lepayedataḥ|) rātrāvapi pralepādividhiḥ kāryo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 76 || apakkaśothe gambhīre raktaśleṣmasamudbhave |

ab.seg: Dī. athānyo lepavidhistamapi darśayannāha - athānyo lepavidhiriti | vraṇaśoṣaprakaraṇe prācuryamasya | tasya lepavidheḥ dvau bhedāviti | pralepapradehākhyāvityarthaḥ | atha tayorlakṣaṇānyāha | eke viśoṣītyasya sthāne nirviśoṣīti paṭhanti | nirviśoṣī aviśoṣī apīḍayato vraṇaśothaḥ | viśoṣī pīḍayitavyaḥ | yato'nyetyācāryāḥ śītastanurityādilakṣaṇaṃ pradehasyeti vadanti | tatra tanuriti pattalaḥ ghano nibiḍaḥ saghana ityarthaḥ | eṣa uṣṇaḥ śīto veti viṣayaḥ | tatra vātabahule kapha bahule voṣṇaḥ pittaraktabahule śītaḥ, uṣṇādilakṣaṇaṃ pralepasyeti kecinmanyante | yataḥ pralepapradehayoranantaraṃ bhedaḥ | atha tanutvaṃ ghanabhāvaṃ capalasya guṇaḥ | tatra kiyatpramāṇotsedhaṃ tasyādṛśyamāha - tayorityatra pralepapradehayoḥ | kvacidapi prāyeṇa pradehastu mahiṣārdracarmocchrāyāpekṣayā sthūla iti manyante ghanābhidhānāt | tanutvaṃ dehaguṇaṃ manyante teṣāṃ mate kiṃcinnyūnaṃ pradehaḥ pralepasyaitatprativyavahāraḥ | idānīṃ tatpratilomābhilimpatvena phalamāha - tau tu romābhimukhaṃ yathāvasādau limpedityabhiprāyaḥ | yatastena samyagauṣadhamavatiṣṭhate | ata evātra praviśati ca vīryamauṣadhasyetyarthaḥ | kaiḥ kṛtvetyāha | romakūpairiti svedavāhibhiḥ śirāmukhaiḥ | etena romakūpāntargataṃ pralepayediti tātparyārthaḥ | atha lepaviśeṣamāha | na tu rātrau lepanaṃ kuryādityanena śaityamapi hitoṣmaṇastannirgamādvikārapravṛttiriti | tathācoktaṃ ‘tamasā pihito hyūṣmā romakūpamukhe sthitaḥ | vinā lepena niryāti rātrau nālepayedata’ iti | lepanamityanenātra pralepasya vidhiḥ sūcyate | nanu pradehasyāyato vā ślaiṣmikapākaśothe tu rātrau pradeha upayoktavyaḥ | tathā vidahyamāne śothe pradeha eva kṣate tu kalkopi rātrau dātavya iti | yathā pittaje śothe vātapittaje ca śatadhautaghṛtābhyaṅgādi dātavyamiti | tathāhi | ‘rātrāvapi pralepādividhiḥ kāryo vicakṣaṇaiḥ | apākiśothe gaṃbhīre raktaśleṣmasamudbhava’ iti | śuṣyamāṇaṃ na dhārayediti | śuṣyamāṇaṃ lepamiti śeṣaḥ | yataḥ śuṣko hyanarthako ruk jvaraśca bhavati | pradehaṃ tu pīḍanaṃ pratiśuṣyamāṇaṃ yāvadupekṣeta | pīḍanaṃ vraṇaviśeṣapīḍanadravyairmiśrakāthyāyokteryo vraṇaḥ pīḍanīyastaṃ pratītyarthaḥ | tasmādanyacchuṣyamāṇaṃ nopekṣetetyarthaḥ | asyāgre keciditi paṭhanti ‘na ca paryuṣitaṃ dadyāddattaṃ ca patitaṃ tathā | na cāpi mukhamālimpettena doṣaḥ prasicyate’ iti bahupustakeṣvadṛṣṭatvādasmābhirapi na likhitaḥ, natvasaṃgato'yaṃ ślokaḥ | granthāntareṣvapi likhitaḥ || 71-76 ||

Gū. athānantaraṃ sujñasaṃmataḥ anyo'pi lepavidhiḥ procyate tasya lepavidherdvau bhedau ekaḥ pralepakākhyaḥ | aparaḥ pradehakaḥ | pralepapradehayoḥ unnatatve pramāṇamāha - yadvadārdraṃ māhiṣaṃ carma pronnataṃ tāvatparimāṇaṃ tayoḥ sāmyamiti maryādā | ālepapradehayorguṇānāha - śītaḥ śītalaḥ śītavīryo vā, tanuḥ sūkṣmaḥ srotaḥpraveśī viśoṣī viśeṣeṇa śītalaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ pralepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ | ārdraḥ punaḥ uṣṇavīryaḥ uṣṇāni tāpite vā evaṃbhūtaḥ pradehaḥ śrleṣmavātahā bhavati | pralepapradehau kutra dīyete ityāha - pralepākhyapradehakau etau dvau abhimukhaṃ romasanmukhaṃ ādeyau yataḥ śirāmukhai romakūpaiḥ vīryaṃ samyagviśati | lepadhāraṇe niṣiddhamāha - rātrau lepanaṃ na kuryāt śuṣyamāṇaṃ ca na dhārayet | śuṣyamāṇamupekṣeta pradehaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati bhavati pradehaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ dehe pīḍayati | rātripratiṣedhe hetumāha -tamasā andhakāreṇāpihitaḥ ūṣmā romakūpe mukhe sthito bhavati punaḥ vinā lepanenaiva bahirniryāti tasmādrātrau na lepayet na lepaṃ kuryāt | yeṣāṃ rātrau lepaḥ kriyate tānāha - apākiśothe tathā gambhīre gambhīravraṇe tathā raktaśleṣmasamudbhave śothe rātrāvapi pralepādividhiḥ kāryaḥ | niṣedho nāsti || 71-76 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ vraṇaviṣayakramamāha - ādau śothaharo lepo dvitīyo raktasecanaḥ || 77 || tṛtīyaścopanāhaḥ syāccaturthaḥ pāṭanakramaḥ | pañcamaḥ śodhano bhūyātṣaṣṭho ropaṇa iṣyate || 78 || saptamo varṇakaraṇo vraṇasyaite kramānmatāḥ |

Dī. ādau śothaharo lepa ityasya sthāne ādau vimlāpanaṃ kuryāditi paṭhanti vimlāpanamityaṅgulyādimardanena śodhavilayanaṃ paramārthatastu naitatpāṭhāntaram | kiṃtu dvayorevaiko'bhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ vimlāpanaśabdo bahi: pramārjane śophavilapanakaralepapariṣekābhyaṅgasvedādau vartate | tenādau śothaharo lepa ityatra sādhuḥ dvitīya mavasecanamiti | vimlāpanānantaraṃ jalaukādibhī raktaviśrāpaṇam | vimlāpanaṃ vināpi raktamokṣaṇaṃ pracarati | apare tviti vadanti | avasecanaśabdo'tra vamanavirecanaśoṇitaviśrāvaṇādyantarbahiḥpramārjane vartate | na tu kevala eva raktaviśrāvaṇe | upanāho nibandhapācanopanāhamapi pācane vartate | caturtha: pāṭanakrama iti | pāṭanaṃ śastrādinā | pāṭanasthāne pācanamiti kecit | śodhanamavaropaṇaṃ vraṇasyetyarthaḥ | saptamo varṇakaraṇa iti | savarṇakaraṇaṃ māṃsajananaṃ vetyabhiprāyaḥ | ata eva tantrāntare saptamaṃ vaikṛtāpahamiti vacanāt || 77 || 78 ||
Gū. vraṇe śothaharādayaḥ saptopamāstānāha - ete śothaharādayaḥ sapta lepāḥ vraṇe śarīravraṇe kramādete kathitāḥ || 77 || 78 ||

ab.seg: idānīṃ sa yathetyanena vraṇasya saptaviṣayakramāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ yogānāha - bījapūrajaṭā hiṃsrā devadāru mahauṣadham || 79 ||
rāsnāgnimantho lepo'yaṃ vātaśothavināśanaḥ | madhukaṃ candanaṃ mūrvā nalamūlaṃ ca padmakam || 80 ||
uśīraṃ vālakaṃ padmaṃ pittaśothe pralepanam | kṛṣṇā purāṇapiṇyākaṃ śigrutvaksikatā śivā ||81||
mūtrapiṣṭa sukhoṣṇo'yaṃ pradehaḥ śleṣmaśothahā | dve niśe candane dve ca śivā dūrvā punarnavā || 82 ||
uśīraṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam | āgantuje raktaje ca śothe kuryātpralepanam ||83||
śaṇamūlakaśigrūṇāṃ phalāni tilasarṣapāḥ | savacaḥ kiṇvamatasī pradehaḥ pācanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||84||
dantī citrakamūlatvaksnuhyarkapayasī guḍaḥ | bhallātakāsthi kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ dāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||85||
ciribilvo'gniko dantī citrako hayamārakaḥ | kapotakaṅkagṛdhrāṇāṃ malaṃ lepena dāraṇam || 86 ||
svarjikāyāvaśūkādyā: kṣārā lepena dāraṇāḥ | hemakṣīryāṃstathā lepo vraṇe paramadāraṇaḥ || 87 ||
| tilasaindhavayaṣṭyāhvanimbapatraniśāyugaiḥ | trivṛddhṛtayutaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ pralepo vraṇaśodhanaḥ || 88 ||
nimbapatraghṛtakṣaudradārvīmadhukasaṃyutaḥ | tilaiśca saha saṃyukto lepaḥ śodhanaropaṇaḥ ||89||
karañjāriṣṭanirguṇḍī lepo hanyādvraṇakrimīn | laśunasyāthavā lepo hiṅgunimbabhavo'thavā ||90||
nimbapatraṃ tilā dantī trivṛtsaindhavamākṣikam | duṣṭavraṇapraśamano lepaḥ śodhanaropaṇaḥ || 91 ||

Dī. ayaṃ vimlāpanavāriṇā vātaśothapratyanīkatvātpralepa iti kāryaḥ | tena tathā kāryo yathā pīḍayitavyo vraṇaśotha ityabhiprāyaḥ | atra hiṃsrā bṛhadhiṃsrā, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rāsnā surabhī, agnimantho'raṇiḥ prasiddhaḥ, madhukādīnyatra prasiddhāni | candanamatra raktam | padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ padmākha iti loke | padmaṃ kamalaṃ | pittaśotha iti pittajanitavraṇaśothe | asyāgre keciditi paṭhanti | ‘śītalāśca gaṇāḥ sarve pralepaḥ pittaśothahṛt |’ iti suśrutoktaḥ | ayamapi saṃgataḥ | tatra śītalagaṇaḥ kākolyādiḥ | utpalādi nyagrodhādayaḥ suśrutoktā boddhavyāḥ | kṛṣṇā pippalī | eke kṛṣṇetyanena kṛṣṇamṛdityatra pracāraḥ sādhuriti vadanti | purāṇapiṇyākameti | purāṇaṃ varṣoṣitaṃ tilakalkajanitaṃ khaliśabdavācyaṃ śigru | śobhāñjanakaḥ tasya tvak chllī | sikatā vālukā | śivā harītakī | mūtramatra gavyam | pradeha iti pralepabhedaḥ | sa ca pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam eva | athāgaṃtuje rakte ca vraṇe vimlāpanasaṃjñakaṃ pralepamāha - dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ | candane dve ceti śvetaraktabhedena | śivā harītakī | rasāñjanaṃ kvāthasamudbhavam | eke kṛṣṇapāṣāṇavaddravyaviśeṣaṃ rasāñjanamāmananti | etaddvayoralābhe dviguṇaiva dāruharidrā deyā | śotho'tra vraṇaśothaḥ, pūrvamuktam upanāhamapi pācane vartate | tadviṣayatvātpācanamapyāha - śaṇaḥ paripāke sasvanaphalaḥ prasiddhaḥ | mūlakopi vikhyātaḥ, śigraḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ | eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ phalāni grāhyāṇītyarthaḥ| tilasarṣape prasiddhe, kiṇvaṃ tu surābījaṃ, tacca yadbahiḥ prakṣipyate | savaca ityasya sthāne saktava iti paṭhanti | tatra saktavaḥ śītavīryatvepi saṃyogaviṣeṇa prabhāvaviśeṣāt pācanāḥ | eke saktavaḥ kiṇvamatasīdravyāṇyuktāni pācanamiti paṭhanti | tatroṣṇadravyāṇi uṣṇavīryāṇi dravyāṇi tāni kuṣṭhāguruprabhṛtīni | etenānuktapācanadravyasaṃgraha uktaḥ pācanavraṇaśothasyetyabhiprāyaḥ | atha pūrvamuktaṃ caturthaḥ pāṭanaḥ krama: sa ca śastrasādhano bhavati | tadabhāvātpralepādibhirvidāraṇaṃ kāryam | tadvidhānamāha - dantī loke dātunīvācyaṃ | mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya mūlatvak | snuk snuhyarkayoḥ kṣīraṃ sruk sehuṇḍaḥ guḍaḥ pratītaḥ | kāsīsaṃ mṛdviśeṣaḥ bhasmavadalpamṛd | asya bhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaḥ sa ca kiṃcitpītaḥ dāraṇa iti pralepadvāreṇa pakkavraṇasya pāṭanavadvidāraṇo bhavati | aparamapi dāraṇamāha | cirabilvo vṛkṣakarañjaḥ virahula iti loke | āgnikaḥ kalikārikākandaḥ | anye bhallātakamāhuḥ | dantī ‘dātunī’vācyaṃ, citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ | hayamārakaḥ karavīraḥ | kapotakaṃkagṛdhrāṇāṃ malamiti | malaṃ purīṣaṃ kapoto vanavāsī pāṇḍukaśabdavācyaḥ kaṅkamalaṃ tu kākaḥ gṛdhro māṃsāśī pakṣiviśeṣaḥ | kapotakaṅkagṛdhrāṇāmiti bahuvacanatvenānyeṣāmapi purīṣeṇa dāraṇaṃ boddhavyam | yathā dṛśyate hi kukkuṭapārāvatādīnāṃ malena vidāraṇaṃ bhavati | ādigrahaṇādīdṛśānyapyanyāni deyāni | eke kṣāradravyāṇi ‘kṣāro vā dāraṇaṃ’ paripaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tatra kṣāradravyāṇi madhūkakuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrādīni | kṣāro veti | etairdravyai: saṃsiddhaḥ sa ca pratisāraṇīyasaṃjñaḥ kṣāraḥ paramiti kṛcchradāraṇamasya prabhāvāt | ata eva bālavṛddhādiṣvapi yojanīyaḥ | yataḥ dvividhaṃ hi pakvaśothadāraṇaṃ sukumāraṃ kṛcchraṃ ceti | tatra kapotapurīṣādi sukumāram | kṣuraḥ kṛcchra iti | idānīṃ dāraṇamabhidhāyānantaraṃ śodhanamāha | yaṣṭyāhvaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu niśāyugmaṃ haridrādvayaṃ trivṛnniśothaḥ ghṛtamatra gavyaṃ | peṣaṇamatra jalena boddhavyam | vraṇaśodhanaḥ duṣṭapūyasyetyarthaḥ | atha śodhanaropaṇānyāha - kṣaudraṃ madhu | dārvī dāruharidrā | śeṣaṃ sugamam | etadyogaṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā yojyaṃ | tena mākṣikasaindhavaṃ śodhane prāyaśo yojyaṃ | nimbapatraṃ tilāśca ropaṇe | trivṛddantī ca ropaṇe ceti vyavahāraḥ | duṣṭavraṇaṃ nāḍīvraṇaprabhṛtikam | ata eva nimbapatrādīnāṃ kalkarase vartimāhureke | śodhanaṃ punaraṣṭavidhaṃ vraṇasyeti | tadyathā | kaṣāyavartikalkaghṛtatailarasakriyācūrṇadhūpanabhedenāṣṭavidhaṃ matam || 79-91 ||

Gū. te yathā - hiṃsrā prasiddhā mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī agnimantho'raṇiḥ | vātaśothe madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, mūrvā prasiddhā, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | padmaṃ kamalam | pittaśothe kṛṣṇā pippalī purāṇī, śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tasya tvak valkalaṃ | sikatā vālukā śarkarā vā | śivā harītakī śleṣmaśothe dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā dve candane candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ śivā harītakī mūrvā prasiddhā | punarnavā varṣābhūḥ padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭham | rasāñjanaṃ dārvī kvāthodbhūtam āgantuje prahāraje śothe tathā raktaje pralepaḥ | śaṇādīnāṃ phalāni, śaṇaṃ, mūlakaṃ mūlakabījaṃ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanabījāni | saktavaḥ yavasaktavaḥ kiṭṭaṃ lohabhavam atasībījāni | pācano vraṇapācanapākakārī pradeho lepaḥ | dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, citrakaḥ tasya mūlatvak snuk sehuṇḍa, arkaḥ prasiddhaḥ tayoḥ payasi dugdhe kāsīsaṃ(piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ) ayaṃ dāraṇavidīrṇakaraḥ dāraṇe lepaḥ cirabilvaḥ karañjaḥ agniko bhallātaḥ dantī jayapālamūlam | citrakamūlaṃ, hayamāraḥ karavīraḥ kapotaḥ pāṇḍukaḥ, kaṅkapakṣī gṛdhraḥ, eṣāṃ malaṃ purīṣaṃ, pakvavraṇadāraṇe lepaḥ yaṣṭyāhvā madhuyaṣṭī niśā haridrā trivṛt niḥsṛtā eṣāṃ ghṛtayuto lepaḥ vraṇaśodhanaropaṇo lepaḥ | kṣaudraṃ madhu | dārvī dāruharidrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭī śodhanaropaṇe ariṣṭo nimbaḥ nirguṇḍī eṣāṃ lepaḥ laśunasyaikasya vā hiṅgunimbabhavo vā lepaḥ | vraṇe kṛmayaḥ ye kīṭāstān hanyāt | vraṇakṛmiṣu lepaḥ nimbeti sugamaṃ śodhanaropaṇe || 79-91 ||
athodaraśūlādau lepaḥ - madanasya phalaṃ tiktāṃ piṣṭvā kāñjikavāriṇā | koṣṇaṃ kuryānnābhilepaṃ śūlaśāntirbhavettataḥ || 92 ||
Dī. ayaṃ madanaphalādiyogaḥ kenāpi bhramatvādatra likhitaḥ | aprasaṃgatvāt | yadvā antargatavidradhijanitaśūlaśāntyarthaṃ kathita ityeke || 92 ||
Gū. madanasya phalaṃ, tiktā kaṭukī, koṣṇam īṣaduṣṇam || 92 ||
idānīṃ vraṇaropaṇakramadvāreṇa sarveṣāṃ vraṇajātīnāṃ śamanayogānāha tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ vidradhau - śigruśephālikairaṇḍayavagodhūmamudgakaiḥ | sukhoṣṇo bahalo lepaḥ prayojyo vātavidradhau ||93||
paittike sarpiṣā lājāmadhukaiḥ śarkarānvitaiḥ | pralimpetkṣīrapiṣṭairvā payasyośīracandanaiḥ || 94 ||
iṣṭikā sikatā lohakiṭṭaṃ gośakṛtā saha | sukhoṣṇa: syātpradeho'yaṃ mūtraiḥ syācchleṣmavidradhau ||95||
raktacandanamañjiṣṭhāniśāmadhukagairikaiḥ | kṣīreṇa vidradhau lepo raktāgantunimittaje || 96 ||

Dī. anena svedopanāhaśca kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | upanāhaḥ koṣṇabahulalepaḥ | tacca sarpiḥṣu pralepo boddhavyaḥ | svedastu śālvalasvedavatkāryaḥ | teṣu śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ | śephālikā nirguṇḍī | eraṇḍasya snehaḥ tadabhāve jaṭā | yavagodhūmamudgāścānnaviśeṣāḥ prasiddhāḥ | paittike iti pittajanitavidradhau sarpiṣā goghṛtena lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavā | tathā dvitīyo yogaḥ payasyośīracandanairiti | atrāpi kṣīrapiṣṭairiti sambandhaḥ | tatra payasyā kṣīravidārī tasyāḥ kandam, uśīraṃ sugandhamūlaṃ tṛṇaviśeṣam | candanaṃ raktaṃ pralepatvāt | iṣṭakā prasiddhā, sikatā vālukā, lohakiṭṭaṃ lohasiṅghāṇakam | gośakṛt gomayaṃ, mūtrairityatra gomūtraiḥ iṣṭakāsikatālohagośakṛttuṣapāṃśubhiriti pāṭhāntaraṃ tanna | lohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ tuṣayavagodhūmajanitaṃ tvagviśeṣaṃ vyavahāratastu yavagodhūmā eva deyāḥ | pāṃśubhirityanena mṛdgrāhyā | sā cātra pītā kṛṣṇā vā | eke tuṣapāṃśubhirityanena tuṣadagdhabhasmabhiriti vyākhyānayanti | niśā haridrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu kṣīraṃ gavyam | āgantujaḥ śastralaguḍādiprahārajanita: ||93-96||

Gū. atha vātavidradhau lepaḥ | śigruḥ śobhāñjanam, nirguṇḍī eraṇḍajaṭāyavagodhūmamudgaiḥ sukhoṣṇo bahulepanaḥ eṣāṃ lepaḥ vātasya yā vidradhiḥ vraṇamedaḥ vadha iti prasiddhaḥ iti vātavidradhau lepaḥ | paittikajanye vidradhau lepaḥ sarṣapāḥ siddhārthāḥ lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyāni madhukaṃ yaṣṭī, śarkarā sitopalā ityekaprakāraḥ kṣīrapiṣṭairdugdhapeṣitaiḥ | pittavidradhau iṣṭikāsikatāvālukālohakiṭṭaṃ gośakṛtpurīṣaṃ śleṣmavidradhau lepaḥ niśā haridrā madhukaṃ yaṣṭī gairikaraktāgantujavidradhau || 93-96 ||
atha galagaṇḍe - niculaḥ śigrubījāni daśamūlamathāpi vā | pradeho vātagaṇḍeṣu sukhoṣṇaḥ saṃpradīyate || 97 ||
devadāru viśālā ca kaphagaṇḍe pradehakaḥ | sarṣapāriṣṭapatrāṇi dagdhvā bhallātakaiḥ saha || 98 ||
chāgamūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭamapacīghnaṃ pralepanam | sarṣapāḥ śigrubījāni śaṇabījātasīyavā: || 99 ||
mūlakasya ca bījāni takreṇāmlena peṣayet | gaṇḍamālārbudaṃ gaṇḍaṃ lepenānena śāmyati ||100||

Dī. atha gaṇḍamālāyāṃ | niculo jalavetasaḥ | śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ tasya bījāni | etaddvayena eko yogaḥ | daśamūlena kṛtvā dvitīyaḥ | daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | daśadravyāṇi mūlairmilitaṃ daśamūlam | tadyathā ‘śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā | tathā gokṣurako bilvaḥ syonākaḥ pāṭalastathā | agnimanthaśca kumbhārī daśamūlamiti smṛta’miti | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ chāgamūtraṃ deyam | vyādhisādharmyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt | asyāgre ‘devadāru viśālaṃ ca kaphagaṇḍe pradehaka’ iti paṭhanti kecit | ‘vātagaṇḍe pradehārthamauṣadhaṃ yadudīritam’ ityasya sthāne ‘chāgamūtreṇa tatpiṣṭamapacīghnaṃ pralepanāt’ | vātagaṇḍe dravyaṃ niculaśigrubījāni daśamūlakaṃ | tadatrāpi yojyam | anayorbhedastu pradehapralepaviṣayatvāt | eko vātagaṇḍe pradehārthamauṣadham | yadudīritamityasya sthāne ‘sarṣapāriṣṭapatrāṇi dagdhabhallātakaiḥ saha’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | ayaṃ lepo granthiṣvapi yojyaḥ | sarṣapādayo vikhyātā eva || 97-100 ||

Gū. niculo jalavetasaḥ, śigrubījāniśobhāñjanabījāni, daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | vātagalagaṇḍe viśālā indravāruṇījaṭā | kaphagalagaṇḍe pradehako lepaḥ | athāpacyāṃ lepaḥ sarṣapādīni dagdhvā chāgamūtreṇa lepaḥ | apacīgaṇḍamālābhedaḥ | athā'rbudādau lepaḥ | atasī prasiddhā | spaṣṭamanyat || 97-100 ||
atha gṛdhrasyādiṣu lepaḥ - takṣayitvā kṣureṇāṅgaṃ kevalānilapīḍitam | tatra pradehaṃ dadyācca piṣṭaṃ guñjāphalaiḥ kṛtam ||101||
tenāpabāhujā pīḍā viśvācī gṛdhrasī tathā | anyāpi vātajā pīḍā praśamaṃ yāti vegataḥ ||102||

div.ab: Gū. apabāhuko viśvācī bāhurogo nidānoktaḥ | gṛdhrasī jaṅghārogaḥ | kecitkevalaviṣeṇaiva śītāṅgādau pradehaṃ kurvanti || 101 || 102 ||

ab.seg: atha ślīpade - dhattūrairaṇḍanirguṇḍīvarṣābhūśigrusarṣapaiḥ | pralepaḥ śrīpadaṃ hanti cirotthamapi dāruṇam || 103||
Dī. atha ślīpade | varṣābhūḥ punarnavāśavdavācyā | pralepo'tra gomūtreṇa vyavahārāt | tadabhāve jalena pracāraḥ || 103 ||
Gū. varṣābhūḥ punarnavā śigruḥ śobhāñjanaṃ sarṣapaṃ siddhārthaḥ | nirguṇḍī lepaḥ | ślīpado rogaḥ karakarṇādau bhavati | etairdhattūrādibhirlepaḥ || 103 ||
atha aṇḍavṛddhau lepaḥ | ajājīhapuṣākuṣṭhameraṇḍabadarānvitam | kāñjikena tu saṃpiṣṭaṃ kuraṇḍaghnaṃ pralepanam || 104 ||
Dī. atha kuraṇḍe | ajājī kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ | hapuṣaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ viṭapasaṃjñaṃ | hanuśabdavācyam vadantyeke badarānvitamiti badaraphalānvitaṃ | ayamapi lepo bradhnaroge praśastaḥ || 104 ||
Gū. ajājī hapuṣā badarī | kuraṇḍo'ṇḍavṛddhiḥ || 104 ||
athopadaṃśe - karavīrasya mūlena paripiṣṭena vāriṇā | asādhyāpi vrajatyastaṃ liṅgotthā rukpralepanāt ||105||
dahetkaṭāhe triphalāṃ sā maṣī madhusaṃyutā | upadaṃśe pralepo'yaṃ sadyo ropayati vraṇam || 106 ||
rasāñjanaṃ śirīṣeṇa pathyayā ca samanvitam | sakṣaudraṃ lepanaṃ yojyamupadaṃśagadāpaham || 107 ||

Dī. athopadaṃśe | etenopadaśādijanitavyathā astaṃ vrajanti nāśaṃ yāntītyarthaḥ | asau yogo'pi liṅgalepāt vīryastambhakaratvena darśitaḥ | drāvaṇayogo'pi kathitaḥ | kaṭāhe lohapātre triphalāharītakīprabhṛtikam | eke tāṃ maṣīmityasya sthāne samāṣāmiti vadanti vyākhyānayanti ca | yathācoktaṃ ‘samāṣāṃ triphalāṃ lohapātre mṛṣṭaṃ vicūrṇayet | hanti kṣaudreṇa lepo'sya liṅgadoṣānaśeṣataḥ | rasāñjanaṃ śirīṣeṇa pathyayā ca samanvitam | sakṣaudralepanaṃ yojyamupadaṃśagadāpaham’ | rasāñjanamatra dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidraiva | śirīṣeṇeti śirīṣavṛkṣasya tvacā pathyā harītakī tayā saha | śeṣaṃ subodham ||150-107||

Gū. karavīrāṃ hayamāraṃ tasya mūlaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭvā lepaḥ kāryaḥ liṅgotthā ruk upadaṃśaḥ | anyacca triphalābibhītakyāmalakaharītakyādikaṃ kaṭāhe dahenmadhunā lepaḥ | anyacca rasāñjanaṃ’ dārvī kvāthodbhavaṃ, śirīṣaṃ, harītakī, etadapi cūrṇitaṃ sakṣaudraṃ madhuyutaṃ vraṇān upadaṃśavraṇān sadyo ropayati | anyacca ciṃciṇī amlikā tasyāstvacā cūrṇaṃ madhuyuktamapi upadaṃśe ||105-107 ||

div.ab: athāgnidagdhe - agnidagdhe tugākṣīrīplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ | sāmṛtaiḥ sarpiṣā snigdhairālepaṃ kārayedbhiṣak || 108|| tindukītvakkaṣāyairvā ghṛtamiśraiḥ pralepayet | yavāndagdhvā maṣī kāryā tailena yutayā tayā ||109|| dadyātsarvāgnidagdheṣu pralepo vraṇaropaṇaḥ |

Dī. athāgnidagdhe | tugākṣīrī vāṃsī | plakṣaḥ kṣīravṛkṣaḥ pilukhani iti loke | sāmṛtairiti | amṛtā guḍūcī tayā saha | nanūṣṇavīryā guḍūcī dāhanivāraṇāya kathaṃ samarthā ? | ucyate guḍūcīvyavahārāduṣṇavīryā | sparśāt suśītalaiva | tarhi śītasparśakāñjikādau vidyamānaguḍūcyaiva carakagrāhyeti na vācyam | yataḥ svabhāvādiyaṃ śītasparśeṣu viśeṣeṇa dāhaśamana eva | eṣa bhaṭṭārakahariścandrābhiprāyaḥ | guḍūcyā dāhanirvāpakatvam, iti | cakrastu uṣṇavīryā grāhyāpi guḍūcī ācāryapāṭhānurodhena dravyāntarasaṃyogamahimnā na doṣaḥ | tindukaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya tvak challī tajjanitakaṣāyairiti | kaṣāyaśabdenātra pañcaprakāraṃ sūcayati | tadyathā | svarasakkāthaphāṇṭahimakalkasvarūpaṃ | ghṛtamiśrairiti pañcaprakāreṣvapi ghṛtapracāraḥ | dvitīyayogamāha -yavānityādi | yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, tān dagdhvā maṣī kajjalaṃ kāryaṃ, tilaiḥ tilatailaṃ | tayā maṣīkṛtayā | dagdhayavā maṣījanitapralepenetyarthaḥ | sarvāgnidagdheṣviti | caturvidheṣvagnidagdheṣvityarthaḥ | yataḥ pluṣṭaṃ durdagdhaṃ samyagdagdhamatidagdhamityeṣāṃ vistaronyatratathāhi suśrute - ‘tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate'timātraṃ tat pluṣṭam, yatra uttiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāścoṣadāharāgapākavedanāścirācca upaśāmyanti taddurdagdham; samyagdagdhamanavagāḍhaṃ tālaphalavarṇaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca; atidagdhe māṃsā'valambanaṃ, gātraviśleṣaḥ, sirāsnāyusandhyasthivyāpādanamatimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrcchāśca upadravā bhavanti; vraṇaśca asya cireṇa rohati rūḍhaśca vivarṇo bhavati’ iti su. sū 12 | jñātavyaḥ || 108 || 109 ||

Gū. tugākṣīryādyairlepaṃ kārayet | tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanā, plakṣaḥ pīlukhani, amṛtā guḍūcī | āmalakaṃ vā taṇḍulīyakaṃ, tvak tajaḥ, tayoḥ kaṣāyaiḥ | yadvā taṇḍulīyatvakkaṣāyairityekaṃ padam | anyacca yavāniti sugamam || 108 || 109 ||

idānīṃ lepaprakaraṇatvādanyānapi lepānāha tatrādau bhagasaṃkocaḥ - palāśodumbaraphalaistilatailasamanvitaiḥ || 110 || madhunā yonimālimpedgāḍhīkaraṇamuttamam | mākandaphalasaṃyuktamadhukarpūralepanāt || 111 || gate'pi yauvane strīṇāṃ yonirgāḍhā'tijāyate |

Dī. palāśodumbarau prasiddhau | tayoḥ phalāni | śeṣaṃ subodhaṃ | mākandaḥ sahakāraḥ tasya mūlaṃ jaṭā | āmrajaṭetyarthaḥ | madhuko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥidaṃ tvasaṅgatam | madhu mākṣikaṃ, karpūraṃ prasiddham etairlepanam | ityevābhiprāyo granthakartu: | , pūralepanādbahalalepanāttu bhagasaṅkocanaḥ || 110 || 111 ||
