Gū. palāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ udumbaraṃ yonidārḍhye mākandaṃ madhu karpūraṃ ca lepaḥ; yadvā mājūphalacūrṇena yonisaṃkocaḥ || 110 || 111 ||

ab.seg: atha liṅgavṛddhau yonisaṃkoce - maricaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tagaraṃ bṛhatīphalam || 112 ||
apāmārgastilāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ yavā māṣāśca sarṣapāḥ | aśvagandhā ca taccūrṇaṃ madhunā saha yojayet || 113||
asya saṃtatalepena mardanācca prajāyate | liṅgavṛddhiḥ stanotsedhaḥ saṃhatirbhujakarṇayoḥ || 114||
sitāśvagandhāsindhūtthachāgakṣīrairghṛtaṃ pacet | tallepānmardanālliṅgavṛddhiḥ saṃjāyate parā || 115 ||
indravāruṇikāpatrarasaiḥ sūtaṃ vimardayet | raktasya karavīrasya kāṣṭhena ca muhurmuhuḥ || 116 ||
talliptaliṅgasaṃyogādyonidrāvo'bhijāyate | tāmbūlapatracūrṇaṃ tu cūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhaśivābhavam || 117 ||
vāriṇā lepanaṃ kuryādgātradaurgandhyanāśanam | kulitthasaktavaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī candanajaṃ rajaḥ ||118||
saktavaścaṇakasyaiva tvakcaivaikatra kārayet | svedadaurgandhyanāśaśca jāyate'syāvadhūlanāt || 119||
vacā sauvarcalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rajanyau maricāni ca | etallepaprabhāveṇa vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 120 ||
Dī. liṅgalepamāhureke | ayaṃ ślokaḥ kṣepaka iti manyamānairasmābhirapi na svīkṛtaḥ | bahupustakeṣvadṛṣṭatvāt ||112-120||

Gū. kṛṣṇā pippalī, bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā, apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ sarṣapāḥ siddhārthakā:, spaṣṭamanyat | stanotsedhaḥ stanavṛddhiḥ tathā bhujakarṇayoḥ saṃhatirvṛddhiḥ | atha liṅgavṛddhau sitāśvagandhā śvetapuṣpā'śvagandhā sindhūtthacchāgakṣīraṃ ghṛtāccaturguṇam etairghṛtaṃ pacet liṅgavṛddhirbhavati | atha yonidrāve sūtaṃ pāradam indravāruṇikāpatrarasaiḥ raktakaravīrakāṣṭhena mardayet talliptaliṅgasaṃyogāt | atha gātradaurgandhye tāmbūlaṃ nāgavalliḥ tatpatracūrṇaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ śivā harītakī vāriṇā jalena lepaḥ gātradaurgandhyanāśanaṃ bhavati | atha svedadaurgandhye kulatthānāṃ saktavaḥ, kuṣṭhaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī candanajo rajaḥ cūrṇaṃ, caṇakasya bharjitasya saktavaḥ, tvak tajaḥ, asyāvadhūlanātsvedadaurgandhyanāśaḥ jāyate | atha vaśīkaraṇe rajanyau dve haridrā dāruharidrā ||112-120||

div.ab: atha mūrdhatailam - abhyaṅgapariṣekaśca picurbastiriti kramāt | mūrdhatailaṃ caturdhā syādbalavacca yathottaram || 121 || trayo'bhyaṅgādayaḥ pūrve prasiddhāḥ sarvataḥ smṛtāḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atha mūrdhatailasya vidhānamāha - abhyaṅgeti | abhyaṅgādicatuḥprakāraiḥ kṛtvā mūrdhatailamāhuḥ | tacca yathottaraṃ balavadboddhavyaṃ yo yasmāduttaro yathottaraḥ | tenābhyaṅgātpariṣeko balavattaro bhavati | pariṣekaḥ picuḥ picorbastiriti | abhyaṅgaścapaṭanamātraḥ śirasyeva | pariṣekodarādibhiḥ secanarūpaḥ picuḥ plotaḥ sa ca taile tūlapaṭalaṃ niṣicya śirasi deya iti picusaṃjñaḥ | bastiṃrvakṣyamāṇavidhānatvātpragaṭa eva || 121 ||

Gū. abhyaṅgaḥ mardanaṃ, pariṣekaḥ tailāvagāhanaṃ, picuḥ plotaḥ tūlavastrādi tailāktadhāraṇaṃ, basticarmajanyā tadvakṣyati mūrdhatailaṃ mastakadhāraṇatailaṃ caturdhā syādbhavet | tacca yathottaraṃ balavat balakāri mūrdhaprayogāt abhyaṅgaḥ pariṣekādervaktavyaḥ || 121 ||

div.ab: athābhyaṅgabastiprakāramāha - śirobastividhiścātra procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ ||122|| śirobastiścarmaṇaḥ syāddvimukho dvādaśāṅgulaḥ | śiraḥpramāṇaṃ taṃ badhvā mastake māṣapiṣṭakaiḥ || 126|| sandhirodhaṃ vidhāyāśu snehaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ prapūrayet | tāvaddhāryastu yāvatsyānnāsākarṇamukhasrutiḥ ||124|| vedanopaśamo vāpi mātrāṇāṃ vā sahasrakam | vinā bhojanamevātra śirobastiḥ praśasyate ||225|| prayojyastu śirobastiḥ pañcasaptāhameva vā | vimocya śiraso bastiṃ gṛhṇīyācca samantataḥ ||126|| ūrdhvakāyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇanīraiḥ snānaṃ ca kārayet | anena durjayā rogā vātajā yānti saṃkṣayam ||127|| śiraḥkampādayastena sarvakāleṣu yujyate |

ab.seg: Dī. atha caturbhedeṣu bastividhiradhunocyate | śirobastividhiriti śirobastiḥ kartavyavidhānaṃ śirasaścarmanirmitaḥ pātrākāro bastirityucyate | sujñasaṃmatetyanena svabuddhyā na likhitetyabhiprāyaḥ | tadidānīṃ basteḥ svarūpamāha - dvimukha iti ubhayato mukhaḥ| dvādaśāṅgula ityaunnatyena | śiraḥpramāṇamiti vistārabhedena | nanu tantrāntare śirobastipramāṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulotsedhaṃ darśitam | tathāhi - ‘āśiro vyāyataṃ carma prayojyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam’ iti tatkathaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamuktam | ucyate, taccarma tryaṅgulavastrapaṭṭena śirasi badhvā tadadho māṣakalkena lepayet | uparibhāgaṃ tvekāṅgulaparimitaṃ carma tailahīnaṃ kāryamiti vyavahāraḥ | tena dvādaśāṅgulaṃ carma tailena pūryate iti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ ‘carmādhastryaṅgulairhīnaṃ kṛtvordhvaṃ cāṅgulonmitam | ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ yaccheṣaṃ tattailena prapūrayet’ iti saṃpradāyoktatvāt | tasmādatrācāryeṇa tailapūraṇārthameva dvādaśāṅgulaṃ svīkṛtam | śeṣaṃ tu vyavahārato dṛṣṭvā caturaṅgulaṃ kāryamityadoṣaḥ | āśu ityanena tatkālameva tailanikṣepaṇaṃ kuryādyāvanmāṣapiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ na bhavatītyāśupadābhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ śuṣkeṇa māṣapiṣṭena tailakṣaraṇaṃ bhavati ārdreṇa tanna bhavatītyarthaḥ | snehairiti yathāvyādhi taistailaiḥ| atha kiyatkālaṃ bastidhāraṇaṃ tamāha - etadbastidhāraṇasaṃketatrayaṃ doṣakālādiviṣayaṃ | nāsākarṇamukhasrutirityanena tanmalasravaṇaṃ | kutaḥ śiraḥsthitaromakūpagatailaprabhāvāt | doṣasaṃvalanādvā | athavā vedanayā yāvadupaśamaḥ śītastāvacchirobastirdhārya ityarthaḥ | etaddvitayasya kadācidaniyatatvāt tṛtīyaṃ niyatakālamāha - mātrāṇāṃ vā sahasrakamiti yāvat sahasramātrāṇi bhavanti tāvadeva dhāryaḥ | vāgrahaṇenātrāpi pañcaśatamātrāṣṭaśataṃ vā doṣāpekṣayā'vagantavyā iti pracāraḥ | asyāgne keciditi paṭhanti ‘dhārayedarujaḥ śānte yāmaṃ yāmārdhameva vā iti | ayaṃ tantrāntarādatra kenacillikhitaḥ | na svamataṃ | pūrveṇaiva kṛtārthatvāt | asya vyākhyā - ā rujaḥ śānterdhārayedvāte pitte yāmaṃ, yāmārdhaṃ kaphe iti | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā vāgbhaṭe - ‘yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā'sya sā smṛtā’ iti | atha kasmin kāle śirobasti: kāryastamāha -vinā bhojanaṃ vinetyanena pūrvāhṇe'sya pracāraḥ samīcīnaḥ | atreti caturdhā mūrdhataile | tena kevalabastireva bhojanādau kāryaḥ | nābhyaṅgāditritayamityabhiprāyaḥ | atha yāvaddinaparyantaṃ bastiyogo vidheyaḥ tāvaddinasaṃkhyāṃ darśayitumāha - pañcāhaṃ saptāhaṃ yāvaddoṣādibalāpekṣayāvagantavyaṃ | pañcasaptadinagrahaṇamatra sāmānyam | vyavahārastvekadinamārabhya yāvadrogasaṃkṣayastāvaddinaparyantaṃ kārya ityasmadīyasaṃpradāyasyābhiprāyaḥ | atha kena prakāreṇa bastyapanayanaṃ tamāha | śiraso mastakāt basticarmapuṭakaṃ vimocya yatnena dūrīkṛtya samantataḥ parito gṛhṇīyāt tailamiti śeṣaḥ | arthātpūrvaṃ tadbhṛtatailaśeṣeṇāpi niyatabastiṃ vimocayediti bhāvaḥ | paścātkāryamāha - ūrdhvakāyamityādi | ūrdhvakāyaṃ mastakaṃ koṣṇanīrairitīṣaduṣṇaiḥ | nanūṣṇajalaiḥ śirapariṣeko na pathyatamaḥ | tathāca ‘uṣṇāmbunādha:kāyasya pariṣeko balāvahaḥ | tenaiva tūttamāṅgasya balahṛtkeśacakṣuṣāṃ’miti | tatkathamatra vihitam ? ucyate, atra koṣṇairityanena kiṃciduṣṇajalena sakṛdeva snānaṃ, na tu bahaloṣṇajalenetyarthaḥ | idānīṃ bastividhānena kṛte sati tadguṇaviśeṣamāha - anena bastividhānena durjayā vātajā rogāḥ śiraḥkampādayaḥ mahārogatvādvātajanitā durjayā eva | vātagrahaṇenaiva pittakaphagatā api rogā veditavyāḥ | tatpradhānatvāt | yataḥ ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet’ iti vacanāt | ata eva sarvakāleṣu yujyata iti | sarvakālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇaṃ | tena ṣaḍṛtuṣu śirobastiḥ kārya iti tātparyārthaḥ || 122-127 ||

Gū. pūrvaṃ ye uktā abhyaṅgādayaste suprasiddhā lokavihitāḥ | sujñasaṃmataḥ śirobastividhi: | atra procyate tatprakāramāha - śirobasti sugamam | ekaṃ sukhaṃ svalpam upari tailapātanārtham adhomukhaṃ mastakapramāṇam | vastre dhāraṇapramāṇamāha - yāvannāsānetramukhastrutiḥ jalasrāvaḥ syāt tāvadbastidhāraṇaṃ; vā pakṣāntare yāvadvedanenopaśamaḥ śirorogādināśanaṃ; tāvaddhāraṇaṃ; yāvanmātrāṇāṃ sahasraikaṃ tāvaddhāraṇaṃ; mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ ‘yā tu maṇḍalamāvṛtye’tyādi | atha bastidhāraṇakālamāha pañcāhaṃ pañcadinaṃ vā prayogaḥ śirobasteḥ | uktakriyāmāha - sugamam | atha bastidāne ke rogā yāntītyāha - aneneti sugamam | iti bastikarma || 122-127 ||

div.ab: pūrvamuktaṃ lepamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇaṃ tadidānīṃ karṇapūraṇamāha - svedayetkarṇadeśaṃ tu kiñcinnuḥ pārśvaśāyinaḥ ||128|| mūtraiḥ snehai rasaiḥ koṣṇaistataḥ śrotraṃ prapūrayet | karṇaṃ ca pūritaṃ rakṣecchataṃ pañca śatāni vā || 129 || sahasraṃ vāpi mātrāṇāṃ śrotrakaṇṭhaśirogade | svajānunaḥ karāvartaṃ kuryācchoṭikayā yutam || 130|| eṣā mātrā bhavedekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ || rasādyai: pūraṇaṃ karṇe bhojanātprākpraśasyate ||131|| tailādyaiḥ pūraṇaṃ karṇe bhāskare'stamupāgate |

ab.seg: Dī. mūtrairiti | bahuvacanatvenātrāṣṭānāṃ mūtrāṇāṃ madhye'nyatamena kaduṣṇena karṇapūra: kāryaḥ | tathāca tantrāntare ‘aṣṭānāmapi mūtrāṇāṃ mūtreṇānyatamena vā | koṣṇena pūrayetkarṇaṃ karṇamūlopaśāṃtaya’ iti | mūtrāṣṭakaṃ yathā - ‘mūtraṃ gonāgamahiṣīhayājāvikharoṣṭraka’miti | snehairiti | ghṛtatailādibhiḥ pakvairapakvairveti pracāraḥ | atrāpi koṣṇairiti saṃbandhaḥ | rasairiti svarasaiḥ | tena sadyorasaiḥ kvathitarasairveti vyavahāraḥ | yatastrividho raso'tra rasakalpanāyāṃ pratipāditaḥ tattatraiva jñātavyaṃ atrāpi īṣaduṣṇairiti yojyam | atha yāvatkālaṃ karṇapūraṇaṃ dhāryaṃ tāvatkālapramāṇamāha - pūraṇamatra tailamūtrādibhiḥ | śataṃ pañcaśatāni ceti mātrāviṣayaṃ | mātrālakṣaṇaṃ tu ‘yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇe jānumaṇḍalam | nimeṣonmeṣakālena, samaṃ mātrāsya sā smṛtā’ iti | śrotrakaṇṭhaśirogada iti | śrotragade kaṇṭhagade śirogade iti | etena kimuktaṃ śrotragade śatamātraṃ | kaṇṭhagade pañjaśatamātraṃ | śirogade sahasramātramityabhiprāyaḥ | hadānīṃ karṇapūraṇasya tailarasaviṣayatvātkālavibhāgamāha - rasādyairityādigrahaṇāt kvāthakalkapuṭapākādibhiḥ | bhojanātprāk prātaḥkālādyairiti ādiśabdānmūtraghṛtakṣīrādibhiḥ | bhāskarestamupāgate iti sāyaṃkāle || 128-131 ||

Gū. atha karṇapūraṇam | kiṃcitpārśvaśāyinaḥ nuḥ manuṣyasya kīṭadeśaṃ svedayet, tataḥ śrotraṃ karṇaṃ mūtrādyaiḥ prapūrayet | nuriti nṛśabdasya ṣaṣṭhī | mūtraiḥ gomūtrādyaiḥ snehaiḥ tailādyai rasaiḥ auṣadharasaiḥ koṣṇairīṣaduṣṇaiḥ karṇapūritaṃ kiyatkālam ityāha - śrotraṃ karṇaṃ, kaṇṭho galaḥ, śiraḥ prasiddhaṃ tadroge mātrāṇāṃ śataṃ pañcaśatāni vā sahasraṃ vā pūritaṃ karṇaṃ rakṣayet | mātrālakṣaṇamāha - svajānutaḥ kareṇa sparśanācchoṭikayā lakṣaṇayā karāvartaṃ hastasaṃkocaṃ kuryāt | eṣā mātrā ekā bhavet | idaṃ bastikarma ādau tailāvagāhanādau pramāṇam uktaṃ īdṛśī śatamātrā'vadhārayet | rasādinā pūrṇakālamāha - rasādyaiḥ auṣadharasādyaiḥ bhojanātprāk prathamaṃ tailādyairbhāskare sūrye astaṃ gate prāpte sati praśasyate || 128-131 ||
karṇaśūle yogāḥ - pītārkapatramājyena liptaṃ vahnau pratāpayet || 132||
tadrasaḥ śravaṇe kṣiptaḥ karṇaśūlaharaḥ paraḥ | karṇaśūlāture koṣṇaṃ bastamūtraṃ sasaindhavam || 133 ||
nikṣipettena śāmyanti śūlapākādikā rujaḥ | śṛṅgaberaṃ ca madhukaṃ madhu saindhavamāmalam || 134 ||
tilaparṇīrasastailaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ nimbukadravam | kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayordeyametadvā vedanāpaham || 135 ||
kapitthamātuluṅgāmlaśṛṅgaberarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sukhoṣṇaiḥ pūrayetkarṇaṃ karṇaśūlopaśāntaye || 136 ||
arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktāṃllavaṇānvitān | saṃnidadhyātsnuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛte || 137 ||
puṭapākakramaṃ kṛtvā rasaistacca prapūrayet | sukhoṣṇaistena śāmyanti karṇapīḍāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||138||

Dī. saṃprati karṇapūraṇārthaṃ yogavarānāha - pītaṃ pītavarṇaṃ yadarkasya patraṃ tat ājyena ghṛtena liptvā vahnau pratāpya tadraso grāhyaḥ | pītatvamatra paripākādbhavati | karṇaśūlāture śate | atrādipadaṃ luptaṃ jñeyaṃ tena ityādiśabdāt saśabde | karṇaroge'sya pracāraḥ | śṛṅgaberamārdrakaṃ, tadabhāve śuṇḍīti sarvatra | madhu cetyasya sthāne madhukapāṭhaḥ saṃgataḥ | tatra madhuyaṣṭī śuṇṭhyādīnāṃ pratyekaḥ prayogaḥ kāryaḥ | kecittu śṛṅgaberaprabhṛtīnāṃ kalkena tailaṃ saṃpācya deyamiti vyākhyānayanti | kapitthādīnāṃ svarasena karṇapūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ taccātra vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā grāhyam | kapittho dadhiphalaḥ | mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ | amlo'mlavetasaḥ | śṛṅgaveramārdrakam | śubhairityanena teṣāṃ sadyorasaiḥ na tu śṛtapīḍanādijanitaiḥ | arkāṅkuro'tra komalapallavaḥ tatsaṃbhavatvāt | amlapiṣṭāniti | amlaḥ kāñjikaḥ | tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavam | lavaṇaḥ saindhavaḥ, snuhī sehuṇḍaḥ tacchadāḥ sehuṇḍapatrāṇi | puṭapākakramaṃ puṭapākavidhānena boddhavyam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 132-138 ||

Gū. pītārkapatraṃ pītavarṇamarkapatram ājyena lepayettalliptaṃ punaḥ vahnau agnau taptaṃ kārayet punastadrasaṃ niṣkāsayet tadrasaḥ śravaṇe karṇe kṣiptaḥ śūlaharo bhavati, bastaḥ chāgaḥ karṇasya śūle pāke ca, śṛṅgaberaṃ śuṇṭhī ārdrakaṃ vā, madhu kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ lavaṇam āmalam āmalakaṃ tilaparṇī śākavarge, tailaṃ kaṭutailaṃ, ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ, nimbukadravaḥ nimbūrasaḥ, kaduṣṇam īṣaduṣṇaṃ karṇayoḥ pūraṇe deyam etadvedanāśūlaharam | karṇaśūle mātuluṅgaḥ amlo amlavetasaḥ, śṛṅgaberamārdrakaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat | karṇaśūle - arkāṅkurān amlapiṣṭān amlaṃ nimbukādi, punaḥ lavaṇānvitān prāptān kṛtvā korite chidrite snuhīkāṇḍe sehuṇḍakāṇḍe tat chadā ghṛte tatpatrāvṛte mṛllipte puṭapākakramaṃ kuryāt tadrasaḥ karṇe pūrayet | iti karṇe rasapūraṇam || 132-138||

div.ab: dīpikātailam | mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍānyaṣṭāṅgulāni ca | kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya saṃsicya tailenādīpayettataḥ || 139 || yattailaṃ cyavate tebhyaḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ tena pūrayet | jñeyaṃ taddīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||140|| evaṃ syāddīpikātailaṃ kuṣṭhe devatarau tathā |
Dī. mahatpañcamūlasya pratyekam aṣṭāṅgulamitāni kāṣṭhāni | mahatpañcamūlaṃ yathā ‘bilvo'gnimanthaḥ syonākaḥ kāśmaryaḥ pāṭalā mahat’ iti | devatarurdevadāruḥ || 139 || 140 ||

Gū. karṇaśūle - mahataḥ bṛhataḥ bilvādeḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍāni aṣṭāṅgulāni kṣaumeṇa veṣṭayetkāryasamaye vā punaḥ tailenā'sicya punardīpayet jvālayet | tataḥ yattailaṃ cyavate taddīpikātailaṃ tena pūrayet ||139|| 140||
syonākatailam | tailaṃ syonākamūlena mande'gnau paripācitam ||141|| haredāśu tridoṣotthaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ prapūraṇāt |

ab.seg: Dī. syonākamūlasya kalkakvāthenetyarthaḥ ||141||
Gū. syonākaḥ araluvṛkṣaḥ tanmūlakalkena tailaṃ pacet iti karṇaśūle syonākatailam || 141 ||

div.ab: yaṣṭīvasā | kalkakvāthena yaṣṭyāhvakākolīmāṣadhānyakaiḥ ||142|| śūkarasya vasāṃ paktvā karṇanādārtināśinī |

ab.seg: Dī. kalkakvāthenetyādi yogaḥ, sugamam ||142||
Gū. atha karṇanāde yaṣṭyādikalkakvāthena kalkena paktvā śūkaravasā snehaḥ karṇanādaharo bhavati | dhānyakaṃ prasiddham | māṣo māṣānnam || 142 ||
svarjikātailam | svarjikā mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ hiṅgu kṛṣṇāsamanvitam ||143||
śatapuṣpā ca taistailaṃ pakkaṃ sūktacaturguṇam | praṇādaṃ śūlabādhiryaṃ srāvaṃ karṇasya nāśayet ||144||

div.ab: Dī. svarjiketyādi | svarjikā kṣāraviśeṣaḥ, mūlakaṃ prasiddhaṃ tacca śuṣkaṃ grāhyaṃ, kṛṣṇā pippalī, hiṅgu rāmaṭhaṃ, mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ śuktaṃ kāñjikā sā ca caturguṇā grāhyā | svarjikādīnāmatra jalena kalkamāhuḥ | eke hiṅgukṛṣṇāsamanvitamityasya sthāne hiṅgukṛṣṇāmahauṣadhamiti paṭhanti | mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhīti pracāro'sādhuḥ || 143 || 144 ||

Gū. karṇanāde - svarjikākṣāraḥ, mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ grāhyam | hiṅgu, kṛṣṇā pippalī, śatapuṣpā | idaṃ kalkadravyaṃ tailāccaturthāṃśaṃ, śuktam amlaviśeṣa āsavoktaḥ | etattailaṃ vrāṇādīn nāśayet | iti svarjikādyaṃ tailaṃ karṇanādādau | apāmārgabhasmajalaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā vastrapūtaṃ kārayet tajjalena kṣārameva kalkitaṃ kākarūpaṃ kṣipet tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ bādhiryaṃ jayet || 143||144 ||

ab.seg: apāmārgakṣāratailaṃ bādhirye - apāmārgakṣārajale tatkṣāraṃ kalkitaṃ kṣipet | tena pakvaṃ jayettailaṃ bādhiryaṃ karṇanādakam || 145 ||

Dī. apāmārgaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya kṣārodake kalkitaṃ tatkṣāramiti | apāmārgapañcāṅgakalkaṃ tatra gholayitvā tena tailaṃ vipācya deyamityarthaḥ | tantrāntare'pi apāmārgakṣārajalena tatkṛtakalkena sādhitaṃ tilajamityādi paribhāṣoktatvāt | kṣārodakaṃ tailāccaturguṇaṃ deyam | kalkaṃ tu caturthāṃśamiti || 145 ||
śambūkatailam - śambūkasya tu māṃsena pacettailaṃ tu sārṣapam | tasya pūraṇamātreṇa karṇanāḍī praśāmyati || 146 ||
Dī. śambūko jalaśuktiḥ syāttanmadhyagatamāṃsaviśeṣeṇa tailāccaturguṇena māṃsakvāthajalenetyartha: | māṃsaṃ tu tailasāmyamiti vyavahārāt || 146 ||
Gū. śambūko jalaśuktiḥ, tanmāṃsena tailaṃ pacet tailāccaturthāṃśaṃ māṃsam iti | śambukatailaṃ karṇanāḍīṣu || 146 ||
karṇasrāve yogāḥ - cūrṇaṃ pañcakaṣāyāṇāṃ kapittharasameva ca | karṇasrāve praśaṃsanti pūraṇaṃ madhunā saha || 147 ||
tindukānyabhayā lodhraḥ samaṅgā cāmalakyapi | jñeyāḥ pañca kaṣāyāstu karmaṇyasminbhiṣagvaraiḥ ||148||

div.ab: Dī. cūrṇaṃ pañcakaṣāyāṇāmiti | cūrṇamityeko yogaḥ | kapittharasena madhuyuktena dvitīyaḥ | eke pañcakaṣāyāṇāmeva cūrṇaṃ kapittharasenāloḍya madhuyuktaṃ ca karṇapūraṇamāhuḥ | pañcakaṣāyāṇi yathā - tinduketi | eke āragvadhaśirīṣajambūaśvatthasarjānāṃ pañcakaṣāyatvaṃ kathayanti || 147 || 148 ||

ab.seg: Gū. karṇasrāve | tindukaṃ vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ abhayā harītakī lodhraḥ samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā āmalakī ete kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ eṣāṃ cūrṇam asminkarmaṇi karṇapūraṇe || 147 ||
svarjikārasayogaḥ - svarjikācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ bījapūrarasaṃ kṣipet | karṇastrāvarujādāhāḥ praṇaśyanti na saṃśaya: || 149||
Dī. bījapūraphalasvarasaṃ, tatra manāk svarjikākṣāraprakṣiptaṃ deyam || 149 ||
Gū. svarjikākṣāraḥ, taccūrṇaṃ tathā bījapūrarasam || 149 ||
āmrāditailam | āmrajambūpravālāni madhukasya vaṭasya ca | ebhiḥ saṃsādhitaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇopaśāntikṛt ||150||

Dī. atra jambūpatrāṇi jambvāmrayostaruṇapatrāṇītyartha: | evaṃ madhukasya vaṭasya ceti | tailamatra nimbakarañjasarṣapajanitamapi deyam | tathāca - ‘etaiḥ śṛtaṃ nimbakarañjatailaṃ sasārṣapaṃ srāvaharaṃ pradiṣṭam’ iti | nimbādīnāṃ tailaṃ jalena sādhyaṃ militatvāt ||150||
Gū. karṇasrāve - āmrajambūnāṃ patrāṇi madhukasya vaṭasya ca pallavāni ebhiḥ sādhitaṃ kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇarogaśāntikṛt | pūtikarṇe pūraṇamiti sugamam || 150 ||
karṇakīṭe hīratālādiyogaḥ - pūraṇaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ param || 151 ||

Dī. mūtrayutena haritālenaiko yogaḥ | kevalasārṣapatailena dvitīyaḥ | asmatsaṃpradāye tu gomūtreṇa haritālaṃ saṃpiṣya tena kaṭutailaṃ vipācya tattailaṃ grāhyamiti pracarati | ‘athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakaṭiharaṃ param’ ityasya sthāne ‘dhūpanaṃ karṇadaurgandhye gugguluḥ śreṣṭha ucyata’ iti kecitpaṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 151 ||
karṇakīṭe – śigrusvarasādiyogaḥ - svarasaṃ śigrumūlasya sūryāvartarasaṃ tathā | tryūṣaṇaṃ cūrṇitaṃ caiva kapikacchūjaṭārasam || 152 ||
kṛtvaikatra kṣipetkarṇe karṇakaṭiharaṃ param | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe lepādividhirnāmai- kādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
Dī. sūryāvartā suvarcalā | sā dvidhā ekā mocalīśabdavācyā | aparā brahmasauvarcalīti | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukam | kapikacchū vānarī | śeṣaṃ subodham || 152 ||
iti śrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracite śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe lepamūrdhatailakarṇa- pūraṇā'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

Gū. karṇakīṭe - śigru: śobhāñjanam, tasya svarasaḥ sūryāvartā suvarcalā tasyā vā svarasaḥ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭucūrṇaṃ tathā kapikacchū vānarī | sadyoniḥsṛtasvarasaṃ | sudāruṇaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ karṇapūraṇāt || 152 ||
iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthapikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne lepanādi- vidhirapyāyaḥ ||11||

div.head: atha raktamokṣavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha śoṇitavisrāvavidhiradhunā vidhīyate atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ yathā lepādayo dehakāntikarāstadvacchoṇitavisrāvaṇamapi | ataḥ śoṇitasrāvaṇamāha - śoṇitaṃ srāvayejjantorāmayaṃ prasamīkṣya ca | prasthaṃ prasthārdhakaṃ vāpi prasyārdhārdhamathāpi vā || 1 ||
śaratkāle svabhāvena kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ | tvagdoṣagranthiśothādyā na syū raktasruteryataḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: Dī. prasthamatra sārdhatrayodaśapalāni | tathācoktaṃ ‘vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe | sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prasthamāhurmanīṣiṇa’ iti | nanu tantrāntare prasthaṃ prasthadvayaṃ ca krameṇa raktasrāvaṃ kathitaṃ tathāhi - ‘jaghanyamadhyaprabaleṣu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau | daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthastathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe ca’ iti | tatkkāthamatra prasthaṃ prasthārdhaṃ ca kathitaṃ, katham ? ucyate | tantrāntare yadidaṃ tadbahudoṣasyāvajinaḥ puruṣasya paraṃ pramāṇamāmananti | atra tu saśeṣadoṣaraktaṃ rakṣaṇīyamityālocyācāryeṇa prasthādisaṃgrahaḥ kṛta ityadoṣaḥ | tathāhi ‘raktaṃ svabhāvādṛtuvihitatvādanāturasyāpi raktasrutiḥ praśastā’ iti | yataḥ pittaṃ śaradi kupyatīti vacanādraktasyāpi kopo bhavatīti niyamaḥ | tathāca pittaprakopeṇaiva śoṇitaṃ ca prakupyatīti| tasmāccharadi śoṇitavisrāvaṇaṃ vihitam | tatsrāvaṇāt tvagdoṣādayo'pi na syu: | tvagdoṣā aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni nyacchanīlikādayaśca | granthayo vātādimilitvā śirāgranthiśca | śothā doṣaduṣṭibhavā vraṇaśothādayaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt anye'pi śoṇitajā rogā raktagulmavidradhivisarpādayaḥ || 1 || 2 ||

Gū. atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma: | āmayaṃ raktajanyaṃ kuṣṭādyaṃ rogaṃ prasamīkṣya dṛṣṭvā janto: prāṇinaḥ śoṇitaṃ srāvayet | kiyatparimitaṃ srāvayedityāha - prasthaṃ mukhyaṃ prasthārdhaṃ madhyaṃ prasthārdhārdhaṃ nyūnaṃ vā kadā raktaṃ srāvayet svabhāvena raktasrāvasvabhāvena śaratkāle raktasrutiṃ srāvaṃ kuryāt, kutaḥ ? tvagdoṣā granthiśothādyā raktasruteryato na syuḥ kuṣṭhavātaraktādayaḥ | granthirvraṇādigranthiḥ || 1 || 2 ||

ab.seg: ādau raktasya rasavarṇaguṇādīnāha - madhuraṃ varṇato raktamaśītoṣṇaṃ tathā guru | śoṇitaṃ snigdhavisraṃ syādvidāhaścāsya pittavat ||3||
visratā dravatā rāgaścalanaṃ vilayastathā | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāmete raktaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 4 ||

div.ab: Dī. atha śoṇitasya prakṛtiṃ vaktumāha | madhuraṃ varṇata iti | makṣikāpipīlikādīnāṃ prācuryamupasarpaṇānmādhuryamasya pratītam | varṇato raktamiti | raktamāraktam indragopaprakāśamityeke, tadevapadmālaktaguñjāphalavarṇamapyuktam | athavā vastrādilagnaṃ satprakṣālyamānamapi na vivarṇatāṃ yātītyapare | aśītoṣṇamiti | na caikāntataḥ śītaṃ nātyuṣṇamiti | yato'gnīṣomīyādraktasya tattulyaguṇayoramlaśītayorabhilāṣo raktakṣaye bhavatīti darśanāt | athavā prakopo'sya doṣaireva tanmūlatvadoṣānurūpamanuṣṇaśītam | tathāhi - ‘yasmādraktaṃ vinā doṣairna kdācitprakupyati | tasmāttasya yathādoṣaṃ kālaṃ vidyātprakopanam’ iti | snigdhavisraṃ syāditi | snigdhaṃ vikṣuṇṇaṃ visramāmagandhi vidāhaścāsya pittavaditi pittasya yena vastunā yathā vidāhastena vastunā tathā vidāhaḥ śoṇitasyāpītyarthaḥ | atha śoṇite pāñcabhautikatvaṃ pratipādayannāha - yasmādeti visrādaya: pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇāḥ śoṇite dṛśyante tasmādraktaṃ pāñcamautikamiti | tatra visratā vigandho bhūmiguṇaḥ dravatā dravabhāgo'yamambuguṇaḥ | rāgo raktatā tejoguṇaḥ | calanaṃ naikatra sthitiśīlatvamayaṃ vātaguṇaḥ sādanamityapare | vilaya iti vilayanopyākāśaguṇaḥ | eke vilayasthāne laghuteti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāmiti | ādiśabdena aptejovāyvākāśāni gṛhyante ||3 || 4 ||

Gū. raktam ādau rasato madhuraṃ, varṇato raktaṃ, guṇata aśītoṣṇaṃ, tathā gurumātrayā guru, tathā snigdhaṃ, sacikkaṇaṃ, visram āmagandhi, vidāho dāhakartṛtvaṃ ca asyāpi tadeva | rakte bhūmyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ guṇāśca santi tānāha - visratā āmagandhitā bhūmiguṇaḥ sacchidratā vā | ete guṇāḥ bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāṃ kramātsmṛtā: ||3||4||

ab.seg: duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe kiṃ bhavatītyāha - rakte duṣṭe vedanā syātpāko dāhaśca jāyate | raktamaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūḥ śothaśca piṭikodgamaḥ || 5 ||
vṛddhe raktāṅganetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā | gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ nidrā mado dāhaśca jāyate || 6 ||
kṣīṇe'mlamadhurākāṅkṣa mūrcchā ca tvaci rūkṣatā | śaithilyaṃ ca sirāṇāṃ syādvātādunmārgagāmitā ||7||
aruṇaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu śīghragam | askandi sūcinistodi raktaṃ syādvātadūṣitam ||8||
pittena pītaṃ haritaṃ nīlaṃ śyāvaṃ ca visrakam | askandyuṣṇaṃ makṣikāṇāṃ pipīlānāmaniṣṭakam ||9||
śītalaṃ bahalaṃ snigdhaṃ gairikodakasaṃnibham | māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ skandi mandagaṃ kaphadūṣitam || 10 ||
dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ triduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhakam | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate || 11 ||
viṣaduṣṭaṃ bhavecchyāvaṃ nāsikonmārgagaṃ tathā | visnaṃ kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ bahu || 12 ||

Gū. idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasyā'pi lakṣaṇamāha - rakte duṣṭe iti | vātādidoṣadūṣite vedanā pīḍā pāko dāhaśca vraṇeṣveva prācuryamasyābhihitam | raktamaṇḍalateti raktavarṇamaṇḍalotpattiḥ | kaṇḍūḥ pāmāviśeṣaḥ, śotho vraṇaśothaḥ, piḍakā granthādayaḥ | atha raktātivṛddhau satyāṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadāha -raktāṅganetratvamiti | tena raktāṅganetratā ca bhavati, sirāṇāṃ pūrṇatā tatheti | sirāścātra raktavahā jñeyāḥ, tāsāṃ pūrṇatā raktatetyarthaḥ | medo medovṛddhiḥ prāyeṇātrāsthigatamedovṛddhiḥ syādityatra viṣayaḥ yataḥ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu satataṃ meda ucyata’ iti | kṣīṇe'mlamadhurākāṅkṣeti | śoṇitakṣaye sati vātavṛddhau satyāṃ tatpratīkārārthatvādamlarasecchā | tathā raktasya dravatvāttatkṣaye sati tejovṛddhau satyāṃ madhuraprārthanā | eke kṣīṇe'mlaśītalākāṅkṣeti paṭhanti | tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | tvagvirūkṣateti vātavṛddhitaḥ sirāṇāṃ raktavahānāṃ ca śaithilyaṃ bhavati | atiraktatvāt | ghātātprahārāt unmārgagamitā raktasyetyarthaḥ | idānīṃ duṣṭaraktasya vātādīnāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇānyāha | aruṇādyuktalakṣaṇai: kṛtvā vātadūṣitaṃ raktaṃ jānīyāt | tatrāruṇamīṣadraktaṃ kṛṣṇābhāvaṃ vyākhyānayanti | phenilaṃ phenayuktaṃ paruṣamapicchilaṃ, tanu acchaṃ, śīghragamāśupravṛtti ata evāvaskandādīni | askandi styānarahitam | sūcībhiriva nistodanaṃ gātreṣu pittena yadā duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ syāttadā etādṛśaṃ bhavati kiṃ tatpītamiti|| pītaṃ pītavarṇam | tacca nirāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | haritaṃ śyāmavatpratibhāsam | nīlaṃ haritaśyāvam | tacca sāmāvasthāyāṃ bhavati | śyāvaṃ haritakṛṣṇam | visrakamāmagandhikam | askandi ceti styānarahitam | bhakṣikāpipīlikānāniṣṭamiti | aniṣṭamapriyam | yataḥ tāsāṃ mate'nusaraṇādaniṣṭatvamavagantavyaṃ kaphadūṣitaṃ raktamīdṛśaṃ bhavati śītalaṃ sparśādvīryāt bahalaṃ dhanaṃ gairikodakasannibhamiti pāṇḍulohitaṃ kathitam | māṃsapeśīprabhamitistyānatvāt | pāṇḍulohitamiti bhāvaḥ | ata eva skandi kathitam | skanditvādevamavargatvamasyoktam | atha saṃsargasannipātānvitaraktavikṛterlakṣaṇānyāha - dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ śoṇitamiti śeṣaḥ, yato dvābhyāṃ doṣābhyāṃ dūṣitaṃ tatsaṃsṛṣṭamiti kathitam | etena dvābhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ militaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | triduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sannipātadūṣitaṃ kathitaṃ tribhirdoṣairdūṣitaṃ triduṣṭam | tacca pūtigandhikaṃ bhavati | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktamiti | sarveṣāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ lakṣaṇairyuktamiti | tadeva kāñjikābhaṃ ca bhavatīti | idānīṃ viṣaduṣṭasya raktasyākṛtiṃ darśayannāha - viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ tena duṣṭaṃ dūṣitamityarthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ kena lakṣitaṃ tadāha - śyāvamiti | haritakṛṣṇaṃ varṇato bhavati | nāsikonmārgagaṃ tatheti | nāsikayā unmārgagāmi bhavati | tena nādhaḥ pravartate iti tātparyārthaḥ | viṣaprabhāvāt nāsikopalakṣitatvāttena mukhunetrakarṇairapi pravartata iti bhāvaḥ | visramityāmagandhi | sarvakuṣṭhakaramiti viṣaprabhāvāt | tathāhi ‘viṣeṇa dūṣitaṃ raktaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ matam’ iti || 5-12 ||

Gū. duṣṭe kupite rakte vedanā pīḍā syātpākādayaśca jāyante | raktavṛddhilakṣaṇamāha - vṛddhe rakte raktāṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati raktāṅgatvaṃ raktanetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ dhamanyādīnāṃ pūraṇaṃ raktenaiva, gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ gurutā, madaḥ pūgabhakṣaṇavat, dāha uṣṇatvam | kṣīṇe rakte kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha -kṣīṇe idaṃ bhavati - amlamadhurākāṅkṣā spṛhā, mūrcchā mūrcchitaṃ kṣīṇe tvaci rūkṣatā śaithilyaṃ vātasyaiva unmārgagāmitā ca | vātaduṣṭaraktalakṣaṇamāha - vātadūṣitaṃ raktam evaṃvidhaṃ syāt | kiṃbhūtaṃ tadāha - aruṇaraktaṃ phenilaṃ phenavat, rūkṣaṃ sneharahitaṃ, tanu adhanaṃ, paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ, śīghragamanaṃ śīlaṃ askandi, ghanatvarahitaṃ, visrāvaviśeṣaḥ srāvayuktaṃ, pittadūṣitaraktamāha - pittena dūṣitaṃ pītaharitādivarṇaṃ raktaṃ bhavati tadāha - visrakaṃ srāvagandhi askandi cāñcalyarahitaṃ makṣikādīnāṃ aniṣṭakaṃ bhakṣaṇe hitaṃ na | kaphadūṣitaraktamāha - kaphadūṣitaṃ śītalādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha - śītalaṃ śītaguṇaṃ sparśena vā śītalaṃ, bahulaṃ bahutaraṃ, snigdhaṃ sacikkaṇaṃ, gairikodakasannibhaṃ gairikajalasadṛśaṃ, punaḥ māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ granthirūpaṃ, skandi ghanatvasadṛśaṃ, mandagaṃ mandagamanaṃ, dvidoṣatridoṣaduṣṭalakṣaṇamāha – dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭadvidoṣalakṣaṇamāha - dvidoṣaduṣṭasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvidoṣalakṣaṇayuktaṃ bhavati triduṣṭaṃ tridoṣaduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhaṃ durgandhaṃ tathā kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate | viṣaduṣṭamāha - viṣaduṣṭaṃ viṣayuktaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ bhavet nāsikāgandhaṃ tathā unmārgagam | visram āmagandhi, kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ kāñjikatulyaṃ tathā sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ, tathā bahu adhikam || 5-12 ||

div.ab: prakṛtistharaktalakṣaṇamāha - indragopaprabhaṃ jñeyaṃ prakṛtisthamasaṃhatam |

Dī. atha vikṛtaraktamabhidhāya prakṛtisthaṃ darśayannāha - yaḥ prāvṛṭkālajo jantuviśeṣaḥ indravadhūriti loke | sa cānekaprakāravarṇaḥ, atra tu rakta eva gṛhyate | asaṃhatamiti nātyacchaṃ nātighanaṃ na styāyatītyanye ||
Gū. indragopo vīravadhūṭī tadvat raktaṃ tathā asaṃhatam astyānam evaṃbhūtaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ raktaṃ jñeyam ||

ab.seg: yeṣu raktasrāvo vihitastānāha - śothe dāhe'ṅgapāke ca raktavarṇe'sṛjaḥ srutau || 13||
vātarakte tathā kuṣṭhe sapīḍe durjaye'nile | pāṇiroge ślīpade pade ca viṣaduṣṭe ca śoṇite || 14 ||
granthyarbudāpacīkṣudrarogaraktādhimanthiṣu | vidārīstanarogeṣu gātrāṇāṃ sādagaurave || 15 ||
raktābhiṣyandatandrāyāṃ pūtighrāṇāsyadehake | yakṛtplīhavisarpeṣu vidradhau piṭikodgame ||16||
karṇauṣṭhaghrāṇavaktrāṇāṃ pāke dāhe śiroruji | upadaṃśe raktapitte raktasrāva: praśasyate || 17||
eṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgairvā jalaukālābukairapi | athavāpi sirāmokṣaiḥ kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ || 18 ||

Dī. atha raktasrāvo yeṣāṃ vihitastānāha - śothe vraṇaśothe ekāṅgaje'pi srāvyaḥ | yataḥ sarvāṅgaśotho niṣiddhaśca sa vāmlabhojananimittaḥ | pāṇḍurogyarśasodariśoṣigarbhiṇīnāṃ ca śvayathau, aṅgadāhe aṅgapāke ca | raktavarṇe'sṛjaḥ srutāviti kevalaraktapitte | sapīḍe durjaye'nile iti | tathāhi - ‘uṣṇāmlalavaṇādervātaharasyopayogātkupitena śoṇitenāvṛto vāto yadā vedanākārī tadā sirāvyadha iti | pāṇiroge dāhādau tena bāhurogo'pi gṛhyate | yaduktaṃ -śoṇitāvṛtavātajanitayorbāhuśoṣāpabāhukayorapyaṃśayorantare sirāvyadhaḥ | apacyāmiti | utpannamātrāyāmityarthaḥ | na tu rūḍhāyāṃ tasyām | kṣudrarogeṣu arūṃṣikādiṣu | vidradhāviti ṣaḍvidhavidradhiṣu madhye pacca visrāvyāḥ taduktaṃ - ‘srāvyā vidradhayaḥ pañca bhaveyuḥ sarvapādata’ iti | upadaṃśe iti | upadaṃśagrahaṇāt parivartikaśūkadoṣaśukavyāpatsu ca meḍhramadhye sirāvyadhaḥ | raktapittamiti | romakūpodgatamityeke | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha śoṇitavisrāvaṃ yairvastubhiḥ kuryāttāni darśayannāha - eṣu pūrvokteṣu śothaprabhṛtiṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgādicatuḥprakārā yathāyogyānurūpato yojyā | śṛṅgaṃ tu gośṛṅgaṃ tacca saptāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ bhavati | tathāca ‘srāve tu śvetagośṛṅgaṃ vakraṃ saptāṅgulāyataṃ | kṣiptvāntaḥ picupeśīkaṃ yojyaṃ vātayute'sṛji | aṅguṣṭhamūlavanmūlaṃ chidramagre'sya mudgavat | vastrapaṭṭāvanaddhaṃ ca raktamācūṣaṇāddharet’ iti | jalaukāḥ prasiddhāḥ, tāśca dvādaśadhā bhavanti | tāsāṃ ṣaṭ saviṣā: tāvantya eva nirviṣāśca | vistāro'pi tāsāmanyatrasaviṣalakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāśca yāḥ| saviṣā varjayettābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramaḥ’ iti | jalamokaḥ sthānaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ | dvividhā striyaḥ puruṣāśca | tanvaṅgyo'tyantamṛdavaḥ striyo viparītāḥ puruṣā | striya: sukumāreṣu asukumāreṣu puruṣā yojyāḥ | jñātavyaḥ | atra granthagauravabhayānna likhitaḥ | alābukā tumbīśabdavācyā | tasyā lakṣaṇaṃ kenaciditi darśitam | tadyathā - aṅguṣṭhāṅgulapariṇāhā ca - turaṅgulā'nāśasaṃmitā sumukhā kṛṣṇamṛdāliptatanuḥ śreṣṭhā raktā ca sevane'lābūḥ | sāntardīrghamayutā tayā ca visrāvayedraktamiti | śirāmokṣairiti śirā raktavahāstāsāṃ mokṣaḥ śastreṇa kuryāditi | mokṣo rudhirasyeti || 13-18 ||

Gū. śothe dāheti śothādirogeṣu nṛṇāṃ raktasrāvaḥ praśasyata ityanvayaḥ | raktavarṇe dehe asṛjaḥ srutau sādisrāve sapīḍe pīḍāsahite anile durjaye jetumaśakye gātrasādo gātraśaithilyaṃ raktābhiṣyandam āraktanetraṃ, spaṣṭamanyat | eṣu rogeṣu kena raktaṃ srāvayedityāha - jalaukā nirviṣā purātanāśca ‘mahyakāṃ vājayavanayājyapautanayā (?) śubhā’ iti suśrutoktatvāt alābu tumbīśirā tadvidhānasthānaṃ taddvidhā nipuṇairvaidyairjñeyam || 13-18 ||
yeṣu sirāmokṣo niṣiddhaḥ tānāha - na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛśasyātivyavāyina:| klībasya bhīrorgarbhiṇyāḥ sūtikāpāṇḍurogiṇām ||19||
pañcakarmaviśuddhasya pītasnehasya cārśasām | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānāmudaraśvāsakāsinām ||20||
chardyatīsāraduṣṭānāmatisvinnatanorapi | ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya gatasaptatikasya ca || 21 ||
āghātasrutaraktasya sirāmokṣo na śasyate | eṣāṃ cātyayike roge jalaukābhistu nirharet ||22||

Dī. atha yeṣāṃ sirāmokṣaṇaṃ na syāttānāha - kṛśasya kṣīṇasya puṃsaḥ | klībo napuṃsakaḥ | pañcakarmeti | vamanavirecananiruhānuvāsananasyāni taiḥ śodhitasya puṃsaḥ | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānāmiti | sarvāṅgatvena vraṇaśothā ekāṅgatā api gṛhyante | āghātātprahārādinā srutaṃ raktaṃ yasya sirāmokṣo dvividhaḥ pracchannaḥ sirāvyadhaśva | ‘na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛtasyātivyavāyina’ ityādivyākhyā pūrvaṃ pratipāditā | adhunā'pi viśeṣamāha | kṛśasya garbhiṇīnāṃ copakṣīṇadhātutvāddehabhayāt | ativyavāyino vātaprakopabhayānna vidhyet | klībasya pradhānadhātukṣaye alpasatvena ca niḥsṛtavināśāt | bhīrośca tamobahulatvāllohitadarśanena mūrcchābhayānna vidhyet | sūtikāyā garbhiṇīvat | pañcakarmaviśuddhasyetyādi | vāntaviriktayoraktasarjanayorapītasnehayorvamanavirecanānantarameva vātaprakopabhayācchirāṃ na vidhyet | āsthāpitajāgaritayormarutprakopabhayānna vidhyet | anuvāsitasya mande'gnau bhūyo'gnimāndyabhayāt | anye vyadhā anumānato nirūpaṇīyāḥ | sirāmokṣo na śasyata iti dvirukte sati viśeṣeṇa sirāniṣedhaparatvāt vācyaḥ, ātyayike tu śṛṅgālābujalaukāprabhṛtiparatvāccāvekṣya | athātyayike kṛśādīnāmapi śoṇitavisrāvaviṣayaṃ vaktumāha - eṣāmiti| pūrvoktānāṃ kṛśādīnāmapi yadi āthātyayike roge sati tadā jalaukābhirnirharet | paramasukumārayogatvānnirharedvisrāvayecchoṇitamiti śeṣaḥ | atyayo'vināśo bhavatyasmādityātyayiko vidradhyādirananyasādhyaḥ | tathā viṣajuṣṭānāṃ puruṣāṇāmapi jalaukābhistu nirharaṇaṃ kartavyam | na kevalaṃ jalaukābhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇāpi viṣaprabhāveṇa sakalaśarīradūṣitatvāt sarvaṃ raktaṃ dūṣitameva | ata eva sirāmokṣaḥ | yataḥ ‘sirāsarvāṅgaśodhinī’ iti vacanāt || 19-22 ||

Gū. kṛśasya durbalasya ativyavāyinaḥ atistrīsaktasya pañcakarmāṇi vamanadīni tacchuddhasya atisvinnatanoḥ atisveditasya ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya bālasya gatasaptatikasya ata ūrdhvaṃ vṛddhasyetyarthaḥ | āghrāṇena nāsikayā raktaṃ srutasya eṣāṃ ca ātyayike na kāryaṃ jalaukāmī raktaṃ na haret || 19-22 ||
vātādiduṣṭaṃ kena srāvayedityāha - tathā ca viṣaduṣṭānāṃ śirāmokṣo'pi śasyate | gośṛṅgeṇa jalaukābhiralābubhirapi tridhā || 23 ||
vātapittakaphairduṣṭaṃ śoṇitaṃ srāvayedbudhaḥ | dvidoṣābhyāṃ tu saṃduṣṭaṃ tridoṣairapi dūṣitam ||24||
śoṇitaṃ srāvayedyuktyā sirāmokṣaiḥ padaistathā | gṛhṇāti śoṇitaṃ śṛṅgaṃ daśāṅgulamitaṃ balāt ||25||
jalaukā hastamātraṃ tu tumbī ca dvādaśāṅgulam | padamaṅgulamātrasya sirā sarvāṅgaśodhinī || 26 ||
śīte niranne mūrcchāyāṃ tandrābhītimadaśramaiḥ | yutānāṃ na sravedraktaṃ tathā viṇmūtrasaṅginām ||27||

Dī. atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa śṛṅgādiviṣayaṃ vibhajannāha - bhiṣagiti grahaṇāddṛṣṭakramo jñeyaḥ | tena vātaduṣṭaṃ śṛṅgeṇa, yataḥ ‘uṣṇaṃ samadhuraṃ śṛṅgaṃ gavyaṃ snigdhaṃ prakīrtitam | tasmādvātopasṛṣṭeṣu hitaṃ tadavasecane’ iti | pittaduṣṭaṃ tu rudhiraṃ jalaukābhirnirharet | tathāhi ‘śītādhivāsā madhurā jalaukā vārisaṃbhavā | tasmātpittopasṛṣṭe tu hitā sā tvavasecane’ iti | kaphaduṣṭaṃ tu - alābubhiriti | athātivyastamabhidhāya pittadoṣaduṣṭasya raktasyāvasecanopāyamāha - dvidoṣābhyāmityādipadaiḥ krūrapradhānaiḥ yuktetyanena yathāyogyānurūpaṃ yojyam | tena padopalakṣitatvācchṛṅgālābupracāro'vagantavyaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘sarvāṇi vātapittakaphaduṣṭāni śoṇitāni’ | sarvairiti śṛṅgādibhiryathāyogyamityabhiprāyaḥ | atha śṛṅgādīnāṃ kiyaddūre pracārastaṃ darśayannāha - daśāṅgulamityubhayataḥ | tena caturdikṣu daśāṅgulamiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra viṣayapadaṃ pracchannam | ata evāha kaścit - ‘avagāḍhe jalaukā syātpracchannaṃ piṇḍite hitam | sirā ca vyāpake rakte śṛṅgālābu tvaci sthite’ iti | atha śoṇitaṃ na srāvayettānāha - śīte iti | śīte śītārdite deśe puruṣe ca niranne iti laṅghite | atitandrā nidrānāśaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘madamūrcchāśramārtānāṃ vātaviṇmūtrasaṅginām | nidrā'bhibhūtabhītānāṃ nṛṇāṃ nā'sṛk pravartate’ iti | viṇmūtrasaṃgināmiti | viṇmūtrādīnāṃ saṃgo pravṛttistadyuktānāmityarthaḥ | viṇmūtragrahaṇenaiva vātasaṃgasyāpyavarodhaḥ || 23-27 ||
Gū. śṛṅgādīnāṃ śoṇitagrahaṇe pramāṇamāha - sugamam | yeṣāṃ raktaṃ na srāvayet tānāha - śīte śītakāle viṇmūtrasaṃgināṃ apravartinām || 23-27 ||
rakte vidhānamāha - apravartitarakte ca kuṣṭhatrikaṭusaindhavaiḥ | mardayedvraṇavaktraṃ ca tena samyakpravartate || 28 ||

Dī. idānīmapravartitasya śoṇitasya cikitsāyogaṃ vaktumāha - yadā śītādihetubhirna sravettadā trikaṭukādicūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vraṇaṃ gharṣayet | trikaṭukaṃ śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, saindhavaṃ ca, śeṣaṃ sugamam || 28 ||
Gū. vraṇavaktraṃ vraṇamukhaṃ, śoṇitasamayavidhānaṃ cāha, sugamam || 28 ||
idānīṃ sukhavisrāvaṇārthaṃ hitopadeśamāha - tasmānna śīte nātyuṣṇe na svinne nātitāpite | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasya srāvayecchoṇitaṃ budhaḥ ||29||

Dī. tasmāditi pūrvoktāpravartitaraktaviṣayadarśanāt | na śīte nātyuṣṇeti sādhāraṇakāle | ata evoktaṃ suśrute - ‘vyabhre varṣāsu vidhyeta grīṣmakāle tu śītale | hemantakāle madhyāhne śastrakālāstrayo matā’ iti | na svinne iti svedite | nātitāpite iti śramādibhiḥ saṃtapte | sūryatāpādityanye | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasyeti | yavāgūratra tilayavāgū: tasyāḥ sadyaḥ snehanīyatvāt | raktotkleśakāritvācca | anye tu yavāgūrviraladraveti bahusṛtām | tṛptasyeti kathanāt || 29 ||

div.ab: atha kena hetunā raktātipravṛttistaddarśayannāha - atisvinnasyoṣṇakāle tathaivātisirāvyadhāt | atipravartate raktaṃ tatra kuryātpratikriyām || 30|| atipravṛtte rakte ca lodhrasarjarasāñjanaiḥ | yavagodhūmacūrṇairvā dhavadhanvanagairikaiḥ || 31 || sarpanirmokacūrṇairvā bhasmanā kṣaumavastrayoḥ | mukhaṃ vraṇasya baddhvā ca śītaiścopacaredvraṇam || 324|| vidhyedūrdhvaṃ sirāṃ tāṃ ca dahetkṣāreṇa vāgninā | vraṇaṃ kaṣāyaḥ saṃdhatte raktaṃ skandayate himam ||23|| vraṇāsyaṃ pācayetkṣāro dāhaḥ saṃkocayetsirām | vāmāṇḍaśothe dakṣasya karasyāṅguṣṭhamūlajām || 34 || dahetsirāṃ vyatyaye tu vāmāṅguṣṭhasirāṃ dahet | sirādāhaprabhāveṇa muṣkaśothaḥ praṇaśyati || 35 || viṣūcyāṃ pārṣṇidāhena jāyate'gneḥ pradīpanam | saṃkucanti yatastena rasaśleṣmavahāḥ sirāḥ || 36 || yadā vṛddhiryakṛtplīhnoḥ śiśoḥ saṃjāyate'sṛjaḥ | tadā tatsthānadāhena saṃkucantyasṛjaḥ sirāḥ ||37|| rakte duṣṭe'vaśiṣṭe'pi vyādhirnaiva prakupyati | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ raktaṃ nātikramo hitaḥ ||38|| āndhyamākṣepakaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ timiraṃ śiraso rujam | pakṣaghātaṃ śvāsakāsau hikkāṃ dāhaṃ ca pāṇḍutām ||39|| kurute'tisṛtaṃ raktaṃ maraṇaṃ vā karoti ca | dehasyotpattirasṛjā dehastenaiva dhāryate || 40 || vinā tena vrajejjīvo rakṣedraktamato budhaḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. atisvinnetyatyarthaṃ svedite puruṣe deśe vā | soṣṇakāle grīṣmartau śaradṛtau vā | atisirāvyadhāditi ajñaprayuktena śastreṇāvagāḍhavyadhanādraktātisrutirbhavati | pūrvamuktaṃ tatra kuryātpratikriyāmityataḥ tāṃ pratikriyāṃ darśayannāha - atra sarjaraso rālaḥ| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yacca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ rasāñjanasaṃjñaṃ keciditi vyākhyānayanti | sarjaḥ śālabhedaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ tadeva | dhavo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | dhanvano dhāmana iti prasiddhaḥ | lodhrādibhiścūrṇīkṛtābhirvraṇamukhamavacūrṇyāṅgulyagreṇāvapīḍayediti pracāraḥ | sarpanirmokaḥ sarpakañculikā | kṣaumavastrayorbhasmeti | paṭāmbaradagdhabhasma kṣaumam atasībhavam | taddagdhvā bhasmakāryam evaṃ vastrasya vastragrahaṇāt kārpāsasaṃbhavaṃ bhasmāpi mukhavraṇasya | badhveti yathoktavraṇabandhanadravyairgāḍhaṃ badhnīyādityarthaḥ | śītaiścopacaredvraṇaṃ śītācchādanabhojanāgāraiḥ śītaiḥ pradehapariṣekaiśca vraṇaṃ śastrādijanitaṃ yadyupacaret | vā pakṣāntaraprakāramāha - vidhyedūrdhvamityādi | prāktanavyaktāt parasthāne tāmeva pūrvaviddhāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet | raktagaticchedanārtham kṣāreṇāgninā vā dahediti vastrādipadābhiprāyaḥ | atha lodhrādīnāṃ śoṇitātipravṛttau prayuktānāṃ pratyekaphalamāha -kaṣāyo'tra lodhrasarjarasāñjanaprabhṛtikaḥ | sa ca vraṇagharṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvamevātra darśitaḥ | anye tu harītakyādiḥ pañcavalkalādikaḥ | etena kimuktam, ayaṃ kaṣāyaḥ vraṇaṃ śastrāghātajaṃ rudhiraṃ saṃdhatte nivārayedityarthaḥ | vraṇagrahaṇena jalaukāmukhakṣatajamapi grāhyam | himaṃ śītalam | raktamityatipravartitaṃ skandayedastyānībhūtaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | kṣāro'tra vihito'pāmārgādijanitaḥ kṣaumādijanito vetyatra vihitaḥ, sa ca vraṇāsyaṃ vraṇamukhaṃ pācayet | tenātipravartitaraktaṃ saṃsthāpya samyakprarohayedityabhiprāyaḥ | dāho'gnikṛtaḥ śalākāpravṛttibhiḥ sa ca śirāṃ raktavahāṃ saṃkocayet | tenātipravartitaṃ samyagavatiṣṭhate | idānīṃ raktātisrāve upadeśaṃ darśayannāha | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ iti | sāvaśeṣaṃ doṣaraktaṃ punaḥ saṃśamanādibhirjayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yathātiyoganiḥsṛtasya raktasya vyāpadaṃ darśayannāha | āndhyamandhatām | atrordhvajatrugatarogaṃ śirasyatipravṛttaṃ raktaṃ karoti | śeṣaṃ subodham | atha raktasrāvaṇe bhūyobhūyotikramo na karaṇīya ityāha | utpattiriti | upasthitipralayeṣu śoṇitameva hetuḥ śoṇitena | etenaiva dhāryate sthāpyate | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 30-40 ||

Gū. atisvinnasyeti sugamam | atipravṛtte kriyāmāha - atipravṛtte rakte evaṃ kuryāttadāha -lodhraṃ, sarjo rālaḥ, rajāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, yava kāṣṭhadhanvanaḥ | sarpanirmokaṃ sarpakaṃcukaṃ vastraṃ cīraṃ kṣaumaṃ paṭṭavastram | śītaiḥ śītopacāraiḥ tāṃ śirāṃ bāhu ūrdhvaṃ vidhyet | ūrdhvaṃ tasmāt śirābandhāt ūrdhvam | tathāca vāgbhaṭe ‘tāmeva vā śirāṃ vidhyedbandhāttasmādanantaram’ iti | kṣāreṇa dahet lipetkṣāreṇa ṭaṅkaṇādinā kṣāreṇa vahninā vā daheddāhaṃ kuryāt | kaṣāyaḥ kaṣāyadravyaṃ rodhrādi vraṇaṃ saṃdhatte saṃnahanaṃ saṃkurute| himaṃ śītalaṃ candanādidravyaṃ raktaṃ skandayate śoṣayati sthāpayati vā, kṣāraḥ vraṇaṃ pācayati, dāhaḥ śirāḥ saṃkocayet dāho yathā sugamam | visūcyāmiti sugamam | duṣṭe rakte niḥsṛte kiṃcidavaśiṣṭe'pi vyādhirna kupyati ataḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ srāvyam | atikramo na hitaḥ | raktasya niśe:ṣasrāve doṣasrāvaṇāttadāha - atisrutaṃ atiniḥsṛtaṃ raktasya jīvasya sāmye | taddehasyotpātādīnāha - sugamam || 30-40 ||

div.ab: srute rakte'pi doṣakope pratīkāramāha - śītopacāraiḥ kupite srutaraktasya mārute || 41 || koṣṇena sarpiṣā śothaṃ savyathaṃ pariṣecayet | kṣīṇasyaiṇaśaśorabhrahīraṇacchāgamāṃsajaḥ || 42 || rasaḥ samucitaḥ pāne kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitāḥ |

Dī. atha śoṇitāvaśeke paścāt karma darśayannāha | śītopacārāḥ sekādyāḥ | etena kimuktaṃ, anatiśītādikaṃ prayatnataḥ upācaraṇīyamiti subodham| ata eva koṣṇena sarpiṣeti | īṣaduṣṇena sarpiṣetyarthaḥ | atha raktātikrameṇa kṣīṇasya puruṣasyānantaraṃ bheṣajamāha - kṣīṇasyeti | raktakṣīṇapuruṣasyetyarthaḥ | eṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaḥ | urabhro meṣaḥ | hariṇastāmravarṇo mṛgaḥ | eṣāṃ māṃsaiḥ saṃsruto rasa iti| eke hariṇacchāgasaṃbhavaḥ raktaḥ samucita iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitā iti | kṣīrādisiktamodanaṃ bhuñjītetyabhiprāyaḥ || 41 || 42 ||

Gū. srute rakte vraṇasthāne kupite dāhāditvāt śītopacāraiḥ upacaretsrutaraktasya mārute kupite savyathaṃ śothaṃ koṣṇena sarpiṣā secayet | rakte kṣīṇe kriyāmāha - kṣīṇasya raktasrāvaṇakṣīṇasya puruṣasya eṇādīnāṃ māṃsarasaḥ hitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhikāyuktaṃ kṣīraṃ vā hitam | eṇo hariṇaḥ, śaśaḥ, urabhro meṣaḥ, hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo mṛgaḥ, eṇo raktavarṇaḥ chāgaḥ || 41 || 42 ||
atha raktasrāvaṇāt samyak śuddhilakṣaṇānyāha - pīḍāśāntirlaghutvaṃ ca vyādherudrekasaṃkṣayaḥ || 43 || manaḥsvāsthyaṃ bhaveccihnaṃ samyagvisrāvite'sṛji |

ab.seg: Dī. pīḍāśāṃtirvedanāvyapagamaḥ | laghutvaṃ śarīrasyeti | etacchārīraṃ visrāvitaliṅgam | manaḥsvāsthyamiti manasaḥ prasādaḥ | etena mānasaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam ||43||

div.ab: Gū. samyak srutaraktalakṣaṇamāha - asṛji rakte samyakvisrāvite sati pīḍāśāntyādilakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti yojanā | pīḍā vyathā tacchānti: laghutvaṃ dehasya vyādheḥ rogasya punaḥ udreka ādhikyaṃ tasya saṃkṣayaḥ samyak nāśaḥ manaḥsvāsthyam || 43 || raktamokṣe niṣedhavargamāha -

ab.seg: vyāyāmamaithunakrodhaśītasrānapravātakān || 44 ||
ekāśanaṃ divāsvapnaṃ kṣārāmlakaṭubhojanam | śokaṃ vādamajīrṇaṃ ca tyajedābaladarśanāt || 45 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitaśārṅga- dharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitasrāvavidhi- rnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

Dī. idānīṃ raktasrute: kiṃ tyājyaṃ taddarśayannāha - atrātiśayaṃ niṣiddhaṃ na tu sakṛdeva | śokaṃ dhanabandhunāśādijanitam | vādamityatibhāṣaṇam | ābaladarśanāditi | raktasrutasya yāvadbalo na bhavati tāvadvyāyāmādayo niṣiddhā ityabhiprāyaḥ || 44 ||
45 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyabhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitavisrāvavidhiradhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

Gū. vyāyāmaṃ śramaṃ, maithunaṃ strīsevāṃ, śītaṃ jalaṃ, tena snānaṃ, pravāto bahuvātasevanam, ekāsanam, ekabhojanam, amlo amlarasaḥ, kaṭu kaṭurasaḥ; kṣāro yavakṣārādiḥ, na saindhavaniṣedhaḥ tasya kṣārābhāvāt vādaṃ vāgvādam ajīrṇaṃ bahubhojanajanyaṃ yāvat balādhikyaṃ bhavati tāvat etān tyajet || 44 ||
45 || iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne raktamokṣavidhi- rnāmādhyāyaḥ ||12||

div.head: atha netrakarmavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - śirāvyadhenā'pi netraprasādanaṃ bhavati, tadvatsekādibhirapi | ata āha - tāni kāni karmāṇītyāha - seka āścotanaṃ piṇḍī biḍālastarpaṇaṃ tathā | puṭapāko'ñjanaṃ caibhiḥ kalpairnetramupācaret || 1 ||

Dī. athedānīṃ netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | seko'tra dhārādinā svedarūpaḥ | āścyotanaṃ netramadhye tailādikṣepaṇarūpam| nimīlitonmīlanākṣibhedena sekaāścyotanayorbhedamāhuḥ | piṇḍīti prasiddhā | akṣṇorbahirlepaḥ sa biḍālasaṃjñaḥ | tarpaṇamiti netratṛptikaraṃ karma tacca netrabastiriti prasiddham | puṭapāka iti | puṭapāka uktyā dravyasya raso netraprasādane vihitaḥ sa puṭapākaḥ kathitaḥ | asyāpi dvividhaṃ karma vyācakṣate | ekaṃ tarpaṇavat kāryam aparaṃ āścyotanavaditi | añjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tacca nānāvidham cakārāt śastrakarmāpyatra boddhavyamiti kecit | na svamatam | tadanyatra jñātavyam || 1||
Gū. atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi | ebhiḥ sekādibhiḥ kalpairnetrarogam upācaret | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vakṣyati || 1 ||

div.ab: sekavidhiḥ | sekastu sūkṣmadhārābhiḥ sarvasminnayane hitaḥ | mīlitākṣasya martyasya pradeyaścaturaṅgulāt ||2 || sa cāpi snehano vāte rakte pitte ca ropaṇaḥ | lekhanaśca kaphe kāryastasya mātrā'dhunocyate || 3 || ṣaḍvākśataiḥ snehaneṣu caturbhiścaiva ropaṇe | vākśataiśca tribhiḥ kāryaḥ seko lekhanakarmaṇi ||4|| kāryastu divase seko rātrau cātyayike gade |

ab.seg: Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ seka āścyotanapiṇḍītyādikam | tatra tāvatsekavidhiradhunā vidhīyate sūkṣmadhārā netrāñjanaśalākā'nurūpaṃ nirgatā dravapātrāt | sarvasminnayane iti sarvākṣiroge yathā doṣāpekṣayā vā sarvagrahaṇaṃ | samastanetramaṇḍale ityeke | caturaṅgulamiti caturaṅgulaṃ yathā syāt tena caturaṅgulotsedhaṃ dhārāṃ kṛtvā secayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā yathā sukhotsedhaṃ secayedityapi | athavā caturaṅgulenākṣivistāraṃ yāvat tāvanmaryādīkṛtya dravyakalkaṃ kṛtvā karpaṭe badhvākṣisekaḥ kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘avyakte'kṣigade kāryaṃ plotasthairguṇḍanaṃ bahiḥ’ ityādi | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa sekasya karmaviśeṣamāha - vāte kevalānilajanite'kṣirogaḥ, snehanaḥ snehakṛtasvedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | yathā - ‘sarpirmāsavasāmajjābhedaḥ syādauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | snehana iti vikhyātaḥ’| raktapitta iti vyaste milite vā ropaṇaḥ svedaḥ | ropaṇastu tantrāntare yathā - ‘stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravayācitaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ śītaśca svedaḥ kāryo'pi ropaṇam’ iti | kaphe kaphaprāye'kṣiroge lekhanaḥ sveda iti lekhano doṣalekhana iti, sa ca snigdhasya vihitaḥ | tathāhi - ‘sneho hitotirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ| jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravasaṃyutaiḥ || kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaḍkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ | lekhane lekhanasvedo vihitoyaṃ bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ iti | tasyeti trividhasekasya mātrāparimāṇaṃ kāryaṃ kālaṃ vā adhunā idānīṃ tasya mātrā'dhunocyate ityuktaṃ prāk tadidānīṃ tanmātrāviśeṣamāha - srehaḥ teṣu svedeṣu ṣaṭśatavākyāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat snehasvedaḥ kartavya ityabhiprāyaḥ | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā | tathāhi ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā cchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | atraikaladhvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāgiti paṭhanti | ropaṇe svedaścaturbhiriti catuḥśatavākyaiḥ lekhanakarmaṇīti lekhanasvede | ekaśatavākyaiḥ kṛtvā tāvat svedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | athākṣisvedasya kālamāha - ātyantake gade prakupite'kṣiroge rujādibhiḥ pīḍita ityarthaḥ | rātrau vetyatra vāgrahaṇāt niśāyāḥ, prathamo yāmo'bhipretaḥ | tathāhi - ‘snigdhoṣṇairvātajaḥ pittaraktato mṛduśītalaiḥ | tīkṣṇarūkṣoṣṇaviśadaiḥ praśāmyati kaphātmakaḥ | tīkṣṇoṣṇamṛduśītānāṃ vyatyāsāt sānnipātikaḥ | tasya kālo divā sarvo yāmaḥ syāt prathamo niśi’ iti || 2-4 ||

Gū. atha sekaḥ | mīlitākṣṇa: mudritanetrasya puruṣasya sekaḥ pradeyaḥ | seka: secanaṃ, sa sekaḥ sarvasminnayane caturaṅgulāt sūkṣmadhārābhihitaḥ | dhārāśabdo dugdhādivācakaḥ | sekasya snehādibhedena trividhatvamāha - sa eva sekaḥ secanaṃ vāte ca ropaṇaḥ kaphe lekhanaḥ tasya sekasya mātrāpramāṇam adhunā ucyate tāṃ mātrāmāha - sneheṣu ṣaḍvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kāryaḥ | caturbhirvākśataiḥ ropaṇe sekaḥ kāryaḥ | lekhanakarmaṇi tribhirvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | sekaḥ kadā kārya ityāha -sekastu divasa eva kāryaḥ | anyadapi asādhuko rātrāvapi || 2-4 ||

div.ab: atha trividhākṣisvedānāṃ prayogadvāreṇa karma darśayannāha - sa yathā - sa yathetyādinā darśayati granthakāraḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlaiḥ śṛtamājaṃ payo hitam ||5|| sukhoṣṇaṃ secanaṃ netre vātābhiṣyandanāśanam | pariṣeko hito netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam || 6 || rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye || 7 || śuṣkākṣipāke ca hitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | sābaraṃ madhukaṃ tulyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitam ||8|| chāgakṣīre ghṛtaṃ sekātpittaraktābhighātajit | triphalālodhrayaṣṭībhiḥ śarkarābhadramustakaiḥ ||9|| piṣṭaiḥ śītāmbunā seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | lākṣāmadhukamañjiṣṭhālodhrakālanusārivāḥ || 10 || puṇḍarīkayutaḥ seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | śvetalodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ paṭavisrutam || 11 || uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekācchūlaghnamambake |

ab.seg: Dī. eṣa ca vātābhiṣyande praśastaḥ | abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ sarasapākarujaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣirogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | tathāhi ‘vātāt pittāt kaphādraktādabhiṣyandaścaturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākara’ iti | eraṇḍapatretyādiyoge kṣīrasādhanaṃ kṣīraparibhāṣayaiva boddhavyam | tantrāntare'yamadhimanthanāmnā vihitaḥ tatra kaṇṭakārīyutamiti paṭhanti | tathāca -‘kaṇṭakārīśiphairaṇḍamūlatvakpatrasādhitam | kṣīramājaṃ hitaṃ seke cakṣu:spandādhimanthayoḥ’ iti | anyacca ‘pariṣeke hitaṃ netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam | rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye | śuṣkākṣipāke vihitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | pariṣekaṃ sekābhidhānaṃ payotrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā mānuṣamiti kecit | koṣṇamīṣaduṣṇam | saindhavamiti sasaindhavacūrṇaprakṣiptam | athavā rajanīdārusiddhaṃ paya iti yogaḥ | kṣīrapākamatra kṣīraparibhāṣayā kartavyam | rajanī dāruharidrā | eke rajanīdārudravyadvayaṃ vadanti | tatra rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru | mārutaparyāyepi hitametat | mārutaparyāyaṃ tat sarvāṅgam akṣiroge paṭhanti | tadyathā ‘vāraṃ vāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīvrāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | śuṣkākṣipāke ca idameva secanaṃ sadā sarvasminkāle kṛtau vā hitamityarthaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākamapi sa cākṣigata eva boddhavyaḥ | tadyathā ‘yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃlakṣanetrāviladarśanaṃ yat | sarūkṣaṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi’iti | idānīṃ raktapittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha -pittābhighātobhiṣyanda eva | yaṣṭīmadhu yaṣṭī bhadramustakaḥ śreṣṭhamustaḥ nāgaramothā iti loke piṣṭa iti kalkīkṛtaḥ | ayaṃ poṭṭalakaḥ baddhena chedo vihitaḥ | poṭṭalakadvāreṇaiva tadadharāseka ityanye | tagaraṃ, sārivā āsphotā, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ tadabhāve tadbījānyatra gṛhyante | atra kvātharūpeṇa seko boddhavyaḥ | athākṣisādanaharayogamāha | ayaṃ dhārābhidhānopi svedaḥ poṭṭalakena badhvā kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | ambake netre || 5-11 ||

Gū. sa yathā - sukhoṣṇam ājaṃ payaḥ netre secane hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ payaḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlai: śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandam āgataḥ pākaṃ netraṃ | vātābhiṣyande sekaḥ, anyacca pariṣeke secane sasaindhavaṃ koṣṇaṃ payaśchāgīdugdhaṃ netre hitaṃ, rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru saindhavena samanvitaṃ tatsiddhaṃ ca hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ tathā mārutaparyāyeṇa roge | tathā śuṣkākṣipāke hitaṃ vātābhiṣyande vātaparyaye śuṣkākṣipāke sāvaraṃ lodhraṃ madhukaṃ yaṣṭī etat tulyaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ chāgīkṣīre sthitaṃ sekāt secanāt pittaraktābhighātajidbhavati | abhighāto netrābhighātaḥ | netrābhighāte sekaḥ śarkarā sitā'bhiṣyande kālānisārivā kalisāri | puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, raktābhiṣyande paṭavisṛtaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, punaḥ uṣṇāmbunā marditam, ambake netre sekātsecanāt śūlaghnaṃ bhavati netraśūleti ||5-11||

div.ab: āścyotanam | athāścyotanakaṃ kāryaṃ niśāyāṃ na kathaṃcana ||12|| unmīlite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye bindubhirdvyaṅgulāddhitam | bindavo'ṣṭau lekhaneṣu snehane daśa bindavaḥ || 13 || ropaṇe dvādaśa proktāste śīte koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ | uṣṇe ca śītarūpāḥ syuḥ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||14|| vāte tiktaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam | tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca kaphe kramādāścyotanaṃ hitam ||15|| āścyotanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mātrā syādvākśataṃ hitā | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyośchoṭikā'thavā || 16|| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ |

ab.seg: Dī. athāścyotanamāha - āścyotanaṃ netrasecanaṃ, taccādāveva sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇām | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmādāvāścyotanaṃ hitam | rūkṣoṣṇakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharoganibarhaṇam’ iti | atrādāviti nirāmāvasthāyāṃ vātapittavajjñeyam | nirāmāvasthā ca rūkṣādyupalakṣitā jñeyā | uktaṃca videhe - ‘abhiṣyande'vamanthe ca netrayoḥ kaphasaṃbhave | utpanna eva kartavyaṃ netrayoḥ kaphanāśanam | lākṣyāścākṣṇoḥ parīṣekastīkṣṇaścāścotanādikam iti | atra sāmanirāmalakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā - ‘udīrṇavadanaṃ netraṃ rāgadveṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāsrayuktamāmānvitaṃ viduḥ | mandavedanatākaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhastu prasannatā | praśastavartmatā cākṣṇoḥ saṃpakvaṃ gadamādiśet’ iti | niśāyāṃ na kathaṃ cana iti | rātrau na kartavyamevetyanena divā kartavyatā'sya pratipāditā | dvyaṅgulāditi | dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ kṛtvā dvyaṅguloccenopādeyamityarthaḥ | bindubhiriti | binduparimāṇaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulaparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt| yāvatpatatyasau bindurdṛśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te’ iti | lekhanādiṣu bindusaṃkhyāmāha - bindava iti | bindavo lekhane'ṣṭau, snehane daśa, ropaṇe dvādaśa | te śīte koṣṇarūpiṇa iti | te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle hemante śiśire ca koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ koṣṇāḥ | evam uṣṇakāle śītarūpiṇaḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatra lekhanādau jñeya: | vātādikramāt snigdhādikamāha - vāta iti | vāto'tra netrābhiṣyandādau tiktarasaprāyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca hitam | pitte madhuraśītalaprāyaṃ, kaphe tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca āścyotanaṃ netrasecanarūpam iti | athā'ścyotanaṃ mātrāsvarūpamāha - āścyotaneṣviti | sarveṣu lekhanādiṣu vākśatamiti | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk netrasecane tu snehanādiṣu mātrāviśeṣaḥ proktaḥ | atra tu netramadhye bindukṣepaṇatvena sarveṣu vākśatamātrameva | kecidatra mātrālakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā -‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā choṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu nāsti || 12-16 ||

Gū. athāścyotanam | athānantaram āścyotanaṃ kathyate tat āścyotanaṃ niśāyāṃ rātrau na kāryaṃ kathaṃcana | tallakṣaṇamāha – unmīlita uddhāṭite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye dvyaṅgulāt bindubhiryaddīyate tadevāścyotanam | lekhanādau kiyanto bindavo deyāstadāha - te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ uṣṇe uṣṇakāle śītarūpa eṣa niścayaḥ | vātādau kīdṛśā āścyotanā deyāstadāha -sugamam | āścyotananāmānyāha - budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ iyaṃ vāṅmātrā smṛtā | keyaṃ tadāha sarveṣāṃ āścyotanānāṃ vāṅmātrā hitā nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ nimeṣo netranimeṣastanyaunmeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā aṅgulyācchoṭikī gurvakṣaro dīrghākṣarastasyoccāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ vāṅmātrā ekā || 12-16 ||

div.ab: athāścyotanārthaṃ yogānāha - bilvādipañcamūlena bṛhatyeraṇḍaśigrubhiḥ || 17 || kvātha āścyotane koṣṇo vātābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | ambupiṣṭairnimbapatraistvacaṃ lodhrasya lepayet || 18 || pratāpya vahninā ṣiṣṭvā tadraso netrapūraṇāt | vātotthaṃ raktapittotthamabhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet || 19|| triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam | strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit ||20|| kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ vāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet |

ab.seg: Dī. araṇi: agnimanthabhedaḥ tadabhāve agnimantha eva dviguṇaḥ kārya iti paribhāṣoktatvāt | athānyaprakāramāha - lodhro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak tvaca eva lodhrasaṃjñā vikhyātā | atra strīdugdhaṃ saṃmiśryāścyotanaṃ kāryamiti vyavahāraḥ | tantrāntare'pi ‘nimbasya patraiḥ parilipya lodhnaṃ svedāgninā cūrṇamathāpi kalkam | āścyotanaṃ mānuṣadugdhayuktaṃ pittāsradāhāpahamagryamukta’miti | aparamapi ‘triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam’ | triphalāścyotanamiti kvātharūpam | athavāhimakaṣāyarūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ kalkarūpamityeke | yaduktaṃ ‘jātā rogā vinaśyanti na bhavanti kadācana | triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa prātarnayanadhāvanaḥ || strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit | kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ cāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet’ | kṣīrasarpiriti dohanamātreṇaivotpannaṃ taṃ haiyaṅgavīnamityāhuḥ | kṣīramatra gavyam | tathāca ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpi karṣaṇa’miti | yadvā kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrasarpiḥ ghṛtamiti kevalaṃ gavyamājaṃ vā grāhyam | strīstanyādiyogoyamapi āgantujadoṣe praśasta ityāhuḥ | tantrāntarīyoktatvāt | yaduktam ‘āgantudoṣaṃ prasamīkṣya kāryaṃ vaktroṣmaṇā svedanamāditastu | āścyotanaṃ strīpayasā ca sadyo yaccāpi pittakṣatajāpahaṃ syāt’ iti || 17-20 ||

Gū. tadyathā - bilvādipañcamūlena ‘bilvāgnimanthasyonākapāṭalā kumbhakārā bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī vātābhiṣyande ambu jalaṃ tatpiṣṭairnimbapatrairlodhrasya tvacaṃ lepayet | tāṃ tvagninā pratāpya piṣṭvā tadrasaḥ netrapūraṇād abhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet | raktavātapittābhiṣyande kṣīrasarpirdugdhaghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ manthanotthaṃ, āścyotane abhiṣyandaśūle || 17-20 ||
idānīṃ piṇḍikāvidhānamāha - piṇḍī kavalikā proktā badhyate paṭṭavastrakaiḥ ||21||
netrābhiṣyandayogyā sā vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyate | abhiṣyande'dhimanthe ca saṃjāte śleṣmasaṃbhave ||22||
snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya śirastīkṣṇairvirecayet | adhimantheṣu sarveṣu lalāṭe vyadhayecchirām || 23 ||
aśānte sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet | abhiṣyandeṣu sarveṣu badhnīyātpiṇḍikāṃ budhaḥ ||24||

Dī. vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyata iti | vraṇamatra śastrakṣārāgnikṛtaṃ jalaukāpātanakṛtaṃ vā tatraiva boddhavyam | anyadvraṇaṃ ca yannetrayordoṣajanitam | tathāgantuje piṇḍīvihitā athāsyāgre'bhiṣyandādhimanthayoḥ karmāntaroktaṃ ślokadvayamāhureke | etaddvayaṃ ca prakaraṇāntaroktatvenāsmābhirapi nātra varṇitam | asaṃgatatvāt | atha sarvābhiṣyandipiṇḍikāviṣayamāha - sarveṣviti | vātapittakapharaktasvarūpeṣu | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyaṃ dravyādikaṃ vicārya badhnīyādityarthaḥ | ata eva vātābhiṣyande snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā deyā | evaṃ pittaraktādike madhuraśītetyabhiprāyaḥ || 21-24 ||

Gū. atha piṇḍikā vastrapaṭṭakaiḥ badhyate sā piṇḍikā balikā ca proktā sā netrābhiṣyandayogyā | vraṇeṣvapi sā badhyate | athābhiṣyande śirovirecanamāha śleṣmasaṃbhave abhiṣyande tathādhimanthe netraroge snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya puruṣasya śirastīkṣṇairnasyairvirecayet srāvayet | snigdhakṛtatailābhyaṅgasvinnaṃ sveditam uttamāṅgaṃ mastakaṃ yasya saḥ | tasya adhimanthānyākriyāmāha - sugamam || 21-24 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ piṇḍikārthaṃ prayogavarānāha - vātābhiṣyandaśāntyarthaṃ snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā bhavet | eraṇḍapatramūlatvaṅnirmitā vātanāśinī || 25 || pittābhiṣyandanāśāya dhātrīpiṇḍī sukhāvahā | mahānimbaphalodbhūtā piṇḍī vā pittanāśinī ||26|| śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmābhiṣyandanāśinī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmapittaharā bhavet || 27 || triphalāpiṇḍikā proktā nāśane śleṣmapittayoḥ | piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyena ghṛtabhṛṣṭā ca piṇḍikā ||28|| lodhrasya harati kṣipramabhiṣyandamasṛgbhavam | śuṇṭhīnimbadalaiḥ piṇḍī sukhoṣṇā svalpasaindhavā ||29|| dhāryā cakṣuṣi saṃyogācchothakaṇḍūvyathāpahā |

ab.seg: Dī. tatra vātābhiṣyandanāśanī yathā (vāteti) | atrairaṇḍasya patrāṇi mūlaṃ tvak cāṅgatrayaṃ saṃgṛhya kalkamāhuḥ | kalkārthaṃ cātra payaḥ ityapare | sāmānyatvena jalaṃ deyamiti sarvatra | vātanāśinītyanenaiva kevalaṃ vātābhiṣyande kathitaṃ kintu adhimanthādīnāṃ vātarujāyāmapi śastametat | evaṃ pittakaphayorapi boddhavyam | atha pittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ piṇḍīyogamāha - dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kāñjikaṃ jalaṃ vā sarvatra | mahānimbo nimbārkaḥ sa ca vakāṇaniṃbaśabdavācyaḥ | atrāpyanukte jalam | eke śigrupatrakṛtetyādikaṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti ‘śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍo śleṣmābhiṣyandahāriṇī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī vātapittavināśinī’ iti śleṣmapittayoriti | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande yogamāha | śigruḥ sobhāñjanakaḥ triphalā haritakyādikam| atrāpi kalkārthaṃ yathāyogyaṃ vihitaṃ dravaṃ deyam | atha raktābhiṣyandārthaṃ yogamāha - piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyeneti | kāñjikadravabhāgena| tadabhāve jalamatra grāhyam | tena pūrvaṃ lodhraṃ kāñjikena saṃpiṣya paścāt ghṛtena saṃpācya piṇḍikā kāryā | athābhiṣyandādīnāṃ śothakaṇḍūharaṇārthaṃ yogottamamāha | atra śuṇṭhīnimbadalāpekṣayā svalpo deyaḥ | svalpasaindhaveti śuṇṭhīmānāllaghutaram saṃyogo piṇḍīviśeṣaṇam | tena saṃyogayuktā vastrapaṭṭādibhiḥ susaṃhatā ityarthaḥ | eke saṃyogāditi pañcamyantaṃ paṭhanti | tatrāsyāḥ saṃyogādeva śothādayo yāntīti bhāvaḥ || 25-29 ||

Gū. athābhiṣyande kriyāmāha | atha vātādināśe piṇḍikāmāha - mahānimbaphaleti | vāte pitte ca piṇḍī | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande piṇḍī śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ | atha śleṣmapittaraktābhiṣyande piṇḍī ghṛtamṛṣṭā kāñjikapiṣṭā lodhrapiṇḍikā asṛgbhavaṃ raktabhavam abhiṣyandaṃ harati | śothakaṇḍvādau piṇḍī nimbadalaiḥ nimbapatraiḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 25-29 ||

div.ab: atha biḍālavidhiḥ | biḍālako bahirlepo netre pakṣmavivarjitaḥ || 30 || tasya mātrā parijñeyā mukhalepavidhānavat |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ biḍālakaviṣayamāha - mukhalepavidhānavadityanena yathā mukhalepavidhistadvadatrāpi boddhavyaṃ, mukhalepavidhistu pūrvādhyāye lepanamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇākhye jñātavyaḥ || 30 ||

div.ab: Gū. atha biḍālaḥ netrapakṣmavivarjite bahirbhāge yo lepaḥ sa biḍālaka ucyate tasya mātrā mukhalepamātrā mukhalepavidhānavadvijñeyā || 30 || atha lepaḥ |

ab.seg: sa yathā - dī. - atha lepamāha - sa yathetyanena yogān darśayati gnanthakāraḥ | yaṣṭīgairikasindhūtthadārvītārkṣyaiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ ||31||
jalapiṣṭairbahirlepaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ | rasāñjanena vā lepaḥ pathyāviśvadalairapi || 32 ||
kumāri kāgnipantrairvā dāḍimīpallavairapi | vacāharidrānimbairvā tathā nāgaragairikaiḥ || 33 ||
dagdhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭayute ghṛte | piṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpaham || 34 ||
lohasya pātre saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbaphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepānnetrabādhāṃ vyapohati || 35 ||
saṃcūrṇya maricaṃ keśarājasvarasamardanāt | lepanādarmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karotyeṣa prayogarāṭ || 36 ||
svināṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhinnāmañjananāmikām | śilailānatāsindhūtthai: sakṣaudrai: pratisārayet || 37||

Dī. yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī | eke yaṣṭīsthāne pathyāṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pathyā harītakī sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ dārvī haridrā tārkṣyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidrā dviguṇā grāhyā taddravatvāt aparamapi vakṣyamāṇacatuṣṭayaṃ sarvanetrāmaye vihitamiti śeṣaḥ | kiṃ tadāha - rasāñjanena lepa eko yogaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ | viśvādalairapi pathyā viśvadalairapi dvitīyo yogaḥ | pathyā harītakī viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī etayordalāni patrāṇi athavā dalasthāne jaleti pāṭhaḥ | tatra jalaṃ vālakaṃ | vacā haridrā viśvaiḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyo yogaḥ | nāgaragairikaiścaturthaḥ viśvānāgaraśabdābhyāṃ śuṇṭhī kathitā | badhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭaghṛtapiṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ saindhavamatra manāk deyam | madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sikthakam | loke momaśabdavācyam | ghṛtamatra gavyaṃ lepotra punarjalena pracarati añjanaṃ tu ghṛtenaiva vyavahāraḥ | sadyo netrarujāpahamiti | abhiṣyandodhimanthādīnāṃ vedanāpahamiti | ayaḥ ‘lohapātreṇa saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbūphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepo netrabādhaṃ vyapohati’ | nimbūphalarasastu lohapātre prakṣipya tadanu lohadaṇḍenāpi gharṣayet yāvat ghano bhavati | eke lohapātreṇetyasya sthāne kāṃsyapātreṇeti paṭhanti mānayanti ca | netrabādhāmiti netravyathāṃ tenābhiṣyandādīnāmityarthaḥ | athārmanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha | keśarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ | armātiraktārmasaṃjñaṃ, netrābhyantaresya pracāra ityeke | prayogarāṭ prayogaśreṣṭhaḥ | svinnāṃ bhitvā viniṣpādya bhinnāmañjananāmikāṃ śilailāmanasindhūtthaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet | pratisārayedityanena śilācūrṇaṃ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa saṃplāvya yojyaṃ | kutra yojyaṃ tadāha añjananāmikāmiti | guhāñjanīti loke | sā ca paṭalante pakṣmasamīpe bhavati | svinnāmiti tāṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsvedya paścāt śastreṇa bhitvā vidārya tadanu niṣpīḍyata iti pūyamānīya paścāt pratisārayet| ata eva bhinnāmiti viśeṣaṇamasyāḥ śilailanatasindhūtthairiti śilā manaḥśilā elā kṣudrailā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam || 31-37 ||

Gū. sa yathā - yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, dārvī dāruharidrā, tārkṣyaḥ kharparaṃ, samāṃśakaiḥ samabhāgaiḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ sarve ye netrāmayā abhiṣyandādayastān hanti | anyacca rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, pathyā harītakī, viśvā śuṇṭhī, dalaṃ patrajaṃ, kumārī, agnipatraiḥ etaiḥ ṣaḍyogāḥ | anyacca lodhraṃ saindhavaṃ agnau dagdhvā madhūcchiṣṭe ghṛte kṛtam etatpiṣṭam añjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ bhavati | anyacca sugamam | athārmasu lepaḥ maricaṃ saṃcūrṇayitvā keśarājo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, tasya svarasamardanāt punaḥ lepanāt eṣaḥ prayogarāṭ armaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karoti | arma vraṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇam añjananāmikāṃ svinnāṃ sveditāṃ punaḥ bhitvā vidārayitvā punaḥ viniṣpīḍya pīḍayitvā śilā elā nataṃ tagaraṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ sakṣaudrairetaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt | netrāñjananāmikā netrapiḍakā || 31-37 ||

div.ab: tarpaṇam | atha tarpaṇakaṃ vacmi netratṛptikaraṃ param | yadrūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkaṃ ca netraṃ kuṭilamāvilam || 38 || śīrṇapakṣmaśirotpātakṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutam | timirārjunaśukrādyairabhiṣyandādhimanthakaiḥ || 39 || śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāṃ yuktaṃ vātaviparyayaiḥ | tannetraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ netrarogaviśāradaiḥ || 40|| durdinātyuṣṇaśīteṣu cintāyāsabhrameṣu ca | aśāntopadrave cākṣṇi tarpaṇaṃ na praśasyate || 41 || vātātaparajohīne deśe cottānaśāyinaḥ | ādhārau māṣacūrṇena klinnena parimaṇḍalau || 42 || samau dṛḍhāvasaṃbādhau kartavyau netrakośayoḥ | pūrayedghṛtamaṇḍena vilīnena sukhodakai: || 43 || athavā śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrajena vā | nimagnānyakṣipakṣmāṇi yāvatsyustāvadeva hi ||44|| pūrayenmīlite netre tata unmīlayecchanaiḥ | dhārayedvartmarogeṣu vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śataṃ budhaḥ || 45 || svacche kaphe sandhiroge mātrāpañcaśataṃ hitam | śukle ca ṣaṭśataṃ kṛṣṇaroge saptaśataṃ matam ||46|| dṛṣṭirogeṣvaṣṭaśatamadhimanthe sahasrakam | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣu dhāryamevaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 47 || svinnena yavapiṣṭena snehavīryeritaṃ tataḥ | yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena kaphamasya viśodhayet || 48 || ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vāpi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param | tarpaṇe tṛptiliṅgāni netreṣvetāni bhāvayet || 49 || sukhasvapnāvabodhaṃ ca vaiśadyaṃ varṇapāṭavam | nivṛttirvyādhiśāntiśca kriyālāghavameva ca ||57|| atha sāśru guru snigdhaṃ netraṃ syādatitarpitam | rūkṣamasnāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ netraṃ syāddhīnatarpitam || 51 || rūkṣasnigdhopacārābhyāmetayoḥ syātpratikriyā |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ tarpaṇavidhānaṃ darśayannāha - athetyādi | biḍālānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanakaṃ karma vacmi | kīdṛśaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇayogyaṃ bhavati tadāha - yadrūpamityādi | yādṛśaṃ rūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkamiti vātābhiṣyandādeva | āvilaṃ kaluṣaṃ śīrṇapakṣmeti romaśātanaṃ śirotpāta iti yathā - ‘avedanā vāpi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyaṃti ca yāḥ sa tādṛgvyādhiḥ śirotpāta iti pradiṣṭa’ iti | kṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutamiti kṛcchronmīlanaḥ ākuṃcanasaṃjñaḥ | yathā -‘vātādyā vartmasaṃkocaṃ janayanti gatā yadā | tadā draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti kuṃcanaṃ nāma tadviduḥ’iti | timirārjunaśukrādyairiti timiraṃ tu liṅganāśasya mūlameva | yataścaturthapaṭalagato doṣastimiraṃ karoti tacca nānārūpaṃ bhavati | arjunamiti śuklabhāgagatarogaviśeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamaśca binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tadarjunaṃ vadantī’ti | śukramiti kṛṣṇabhāgagataṃ tacca trividhaṃ śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ ceti | śukramatra puṣpaśabdavācyaṃ phūlīti loke | ādigrahaṇādetādṛśairanyairapi | abhiṣyandādhimanthakairiti abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ | ayamapi sarvanetrarogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | adhimantho netre śotharūpo rujāvāṃśca bhavati sa ca vṛddhenābhiṣyandenaiva kriyāvatāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ caturvidho jāyate | śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāmiti śuṣkākṣipākaḥ sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā - ‘yatkūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃdahyate cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yatpratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣī’ti | śotha iti | śothajanetrapākaḥ | yataḥ -‘kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakkodumbarasannibhaḥ | saṃraṃbhī pacyate yastu netrapākaḥ sa śothaja’ iti | vātaviparyayairyuta iti vātaviparyayo netrarogaviśeṣaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ | yathā ‘vāraṃvāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīkṣṇāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | taṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyamiti yatpūrvoktarogaviśeṣe varṇitaṃ tannetramityarthaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | atha tarpaṇakriyāyāmayogyaviṣayamāha - durdinātyuṣṇaśītairityanena śītoṣṇavarṣāsvarūpaṃ kālaṃ tarpaṇavihitam | prāptiniṣedhatvāt | durdinamiti varṣā meghavṛṣṭyākulaṃ dinaṃ niṣiddhaṃ nānyat | evamatyuṣṇamiti | grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitadivasam | atiśītaṃ vātādivyāptaṃ dinamiti saṃbhrameṣviti bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ | aśāṃtopadrave cākṣṇīti | āmadoṣajananopadravasahitaṃ nākṣi tarpayedityabhiprāyaḥ| tadyathā - ‘udīrṇavedanaṃ netraṃ rāgaśoṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāśruyuktamāmānvitaṃ vidu’riti | idānīṃ tarpaṇasya kartavyavidhāvapi karmavidhānamāha - tarpaṇārthī puruṣaḥ prathamameva śobhanaṃ sthānamanvicchet | tatra vātātaparajorahite iti| etayorlakṣaṇatvenāgnidhūmarahite iti grahaṇaṃ | yaduktaṃ - ‘pratisūryāgnirahite nīrujo dhūmamārute | gṛhe sukhe nirābādhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca samācaredi’ti | uttānaśāyinetyanena niścalasya vītakrodhatayāsya cāvarodhaḥ tantrāntaradarśanāt ‘uttānaśāyinaḥ kāryaṃ niścalasya yathāsukham | tarpaṇaṃ netrayugale vītakrodhabhayasya ce’ti | atha paścātkarmāha - ādhārau māṣacūrṇena netrakośayoriti netrapuṭayoḥ | dvau ādhārau kuryāt | ādhāro māṣapiṣṭīmayaḥ palīsaṃjñaḥ | klinnena māṣacūrṇeneti | klinnaṃ jalena marditam | kathaṃbhūtāvādhārāviti | parimaṇḍalau pari samantato bhāvena maṇḍalākārau tenārdhāṅgulotsedhaḥ dvyaṅgulavistāraṃ yathā syāt kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi ‘ardhāṅgulo'rdhavistāraṃ yathā syānnākṣirodhakṛt’ iti | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtāvādhārau | samāhitau na viṣamaiḥ | dṛḍhāviti na śīrṇau | asaṃdhāviti saṃdhirahitau | etena tannipuṇena kāryāvityarthaḥ | idānīṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ dravyaviśeṣamāha - pūrayennetrādhārāviti śeṣaḥ | kena pūrayettamāha - ghṛtamaṇḍenetyādi | vilīnaghṛtasya ghanībhūtasyoparitano bhāgo ghṛtamaṇḍa ityucyate | kīdṛśena sukhodakaiḥ kṛtvā vilīne | eke sukhodarkairevākṣipūraṇamāhuḥ | tadasaṃgatam | athavetyanena dravyāntaramāha - dhautena sarpiṣetyarthaḥ | kṣīramathanātsamudbhūtaṃ navanītaghṛtaṃ kṣīraghṛtamityucyate | kṣīramatra gavyaṃ grāhyaṃ tadvihitatvāt | tathāhi - ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaśreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpakarṣaṇa’miti | atha kiyatparimāṇena pūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tamāha - eke tu ‘pakṣmāṇi yāvanmajjanti romavattā yadā bhruvo’riti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tata unmīlayecchanairiti | unmīlanaṃ tu śanaiḥ kuryāt | śanairityanena karmāntaraṃ sūcayati | kathamunmīlayettadāha carakaḥ - ‘tato vastreṇa pītena nīlena haritena vā | patrairācchādya nayane tataḥ paśyedyathāsukhami’ti | atha tarpaṇasya dhāraṇaṃ kiyatkālena kāryaṃ tadāha - vartmarogeṣviti kṛcchronmīlanapakṣmaghātaprabhṛtiṣu | vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śatamiti| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk teṣāṃ śatamityarthaḥ| athavāṅgulyoḥ choṭikāsvarūpaṃ vāṅmātrātmatvena kathitam | tathāca ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṃgulyācchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhairi’ti| svasthe kaphe iti prakṛtisthe kaphe athavā svasthe puruṣe nīroge, nirupadrave ityanye ata eva sopadrave doṣe tarpaṇaṃ na vihitamiti pūrvoktameva | saṃdhirogajalasrāvaprabhṛtike kṛṣṇaroge śuddhaśukraśirāśukrapramukhe kaphe ca vikārābhipanne ata eva ṣaṭśatamityarthaḥ | pañcaśatān dṛṣṭirogeṣviti pitte nakulāndhyaprabhṛtiṣu dṛṣṭirogeṣviti bahuvacanatvena pittaje raktaje vā'ṣṭauśatāni kuryāt | adhimanthe sahasrakamityasya sthāne adhimanthe navaśatamiti paṭhanti | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣviti bahuvacanatvenāpi sannipātātmake vyādhau sahasramātraṃ yāvaddeyaṃ | tantrāntare saptaśatamātrābhiḥ sannipāte vihitam | tathāca ‘vācāṃ sahasramātrā syāddhārayenmārutavyathe | pittaje raktaje vā... ...niva | sannipātātmake saptapañca svasthavidhau tathe’ti viṣayovagantavyaḥ | atha kaphasnehopanayanaṃ kuryāttamāha - idānīṃ doṣādiviśeṣeṇa tarpaṇaviśeṣasya dināntaramāha - ekāhamiti | ekadināntaraṃ granthakāradarśanāt| tathā ca - ‘ahanyahani vātotthe pittarakte dināntaram | tarpaṇaṃ sannipātotthadvyantaraṃ tryaṃtaraṃ kaphe’ iti | tatra pittaraktādidoṣe tarpaṇaṃ kāryam | vāgrahaṇena vātotthepi ahanyahani kāryaṃ dvitīyavāgrahaṇenāpi dvyantaraṃ boddhavyaṃ sannipātaviṣayaṃ eke kaṭūṣṇamiti paṭhanti | tryahamiti tridināntaraṃ tacca kaphetyanukte svasthādāvapi | pañcāhamiti pañcadināntaram | atha tarpaṇaliṅgāni yasya bhavanti tānāha - sukhaṃ yathā syāt | svapnāvabodho bhavati | vaiśadyaṃ netrasyeti | varṇapāṭavamiti varṇaṃ śvetakṛṣṇādikaṃ tasya pāṭavaṃ nirmalatvam etena vyaktavartmane bhavataḥ | nivṛttiravalokanapracāro dṛḍhataro bhavati | kriyālāghavamiti sūkṣmāvalokanepi samarthadṛṣṭirbhavatītyarthaḥ | athātitarpitasya lakṣaṇānyāha - atheti sugamam | atha hīnatarpitasya lakṣaṇamāha - rūkṣamasnigdham, asrāvilam asrairnetrajalairāvilaṃ kaluṣīkṛtaṃ rāgamāraktatāṃ hīnatarpitanetramiti | atha hīnātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakāramāha - etayorhīnātitarpitayoḥ | tenātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakārato rūkṣakriyāhīnatarpitā snigdhā kriyetyabhiprāyaḥ || 38-51 ||

Gū. atha tarpaṇam athānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ cikitsitaṃ vacmi kathayāmi | tarpaṇakaṃ netratṛptikaraṃ | keṣu rogeṣu tarpaṇaṃ kriyate tānāha - yannetraṃ rūkṣaṃ bhavati | śuṣkaṃ kuṭilaṃ vakram āvilaṃ malayuktaṃ śīrṇapakṣma śīrṇaṃ gataṃ | pakṣma netrarogaṃ yasya tat | ete vātaparyantādayo netraroganidāne jñeyāḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ | netrarogaviśāradairvaidyaiḥ yatra tarpaṇaṃ na vihitaṃ tadāha - sugamam | yatra tarpaṇaṃ na hitaṃ yena vidhānena vā tadāha - vātādīnāṃ hīne rahite deśe uttānaśāyinaḥ puruṣasya netrakośayoḥ uparibhāge klinnena ārdreṇa māṣacūrṇena parimaṇḍalau maṇḍalākārau samau dṛḍhau asaṃbādhau kartavyau | tatra netre vilīnena drutena ghṛtagaṇḍena pūrayet | sukhodakairvā athavā | śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrotthitena sarpiṣā vā yāvat akṣipakṣmāṇi nimagnāni bhavanti tāvat kāryaṃ | mīlite netre pūrayet | pūraṇānantaraṃ tataḥ śanaiḥ unmīlayet | dhāraṇe pramāṇamāha - vāṅmātrālakṣaṇaṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktameva | sugamaṃ cānyat | tarpaṇe dāhakaphādhikye pratīkāramāha - tataḥ snehavīryeṇa īritam asya kaphasvinnena yavapiṣṭena yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena viśodhayet | tarpaṇaṃ kiyaddinaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - ekāhaṃ tryahaṃ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā iṣyate | atha tarpaṇe tṛptilakṣaṇamāha - tarpaṇe netrasya sukhasvapnādīni tṛptiliṅgāni bhāvayet vicārayediti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sukhena svapnatvaṃ sukhena bodhatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā netrasya | varṇasya pāṭavaṃ paṭutvaṃ nirvṛttirnirāvṛttiḥ spaṣṭadarśanatvaṃ vyādhiśāntiḥ | kriyālāghavaṃ nimeṣonmeṣakriyālaghutvam | atitarpitamāha - sāsru-asruyuktaṃ guru snigdhaṃ ca | atha hīnatarpitanetramāha - rūkṣam asrāvilaṃ raktāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ rogayuktaṃ hīnatarpitaṃ netram evaṃ syāt | atitarpitahīnatarpitayoḥ pratikāramāha - rūkṣopacāreṇātisnigdhasya na hīnasnigdheneti yāvat || 38-51 ||
puṭapākaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - tarpaṇoktavidhānakriyāvyāpattisamānadharmatvaṃ puṭapākamāha - ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākasya sādhanam ||52||
dvau bilvamātrau māṃsasya piṇḍau snigdhau supeṣitau | dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ ||53||
tadekasthaṃ samāloḍya patraiḥ supariveṣṭitam | puṭapākena tatpaktvā gṛhṇīyāttadrasaṃ budhaḥ || 54 ||
tarpaṇoktavidhānena yathāvadupacārayet | dṛṣṭimadhye niṣecyaḥ syānnityamuttānaśāyinaḥ ||55||
snehano lekhanaścaiva ropaṇaśceti sa tridhā | hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ ||56||
dṛṣṭerbalārthamitaraḥ pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | sarpirmāṃsavasāmajjāmedaḥsvādvauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 57 ||
snehanaḥ puṭapākaśca dhāryo dve vākśate dṛśoḥ | jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravyasaṃyutaiḥ || 58 ||
kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaṅkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ || 59 ||
lekhano vākśataṃ dhāryastasyaitāvadvidhāraṇam | stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravyapācitaḥ || 60 ||
lekhanāttriguṇo dhāryaḥ puṭapākastu ropaṇaḥ | vitarettarpaṇoktāṃ tu kriyāṃ vyāpattidarśane || 61 ||

Dī. atha puṭapākavidhānamāha - atha puṭapākasya traividhyamāha - sa puṭapākaḥ | atha teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye kaḥ kasya vihitastamāha - atirūkṣasya puruṣasya snigdhasyāpi puruṣasyeti śeṣaḥ | lekhano lekhanaḥ puṭapākaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ dṛṣṭidṛḍhīkaraṇārtham itaro ropaṇapuṭapākaḥ | sa eva pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | vraṇavātādayo netragatā eva boddhavyā: | idānīṃ snehanapuṭapākamādau pradarśayannāha - vasāmāṃsāśritaḥ | sneha iti śeṣaḥ | tathāca ‘śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā’ majjā mastakamajjā sthūlāsthiṣu ca bhavati | bheda udarasthatvagasthiṣu ca | tathācoktaṃ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyata’ iti | dṛśa iti | dṛśi madhye niṣevya iti viṣayaḥ | atha lekhanapuṭapākamāha - jāṅgalānāṃ jantūnāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairiti | yakṛtkālakhaṇḍaḥ | yadyapi jāṅgalavargo'ṣṭavidha: kathitaḥ | tadyathā jāṅgalā viṣkirāḥ pratudā guhāśayāḥ | prasahā: parṇamṛgā bileśayā grāmyāśceti | tathāpi keṣāṃcinmate paṃcaiva śreṣṭhatamā: jāṅgalaviṣkirapratudaparṇamṛgabileśayāśca te ke jāṅgalādyāstān keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthamāha - eṇahariṇaparṇakuraṅgādayo jāṅgalāḥ | lāvatittirakapiñjalavartīrurvādayaḥ | viṣkirāḥ kapotapārāvatakaliṅgādayaḥ | pratudā: siṃhavyāghravṛ(ṣā?)śvakaśṛgālamārjārādayo guheśayāḥ | kākakaṅkakuraracāṣabhāsādayaḥ | prasahā: mṛdubhūrivakavṛkṣaśāyikāvānaraprabhṛtayaḥ | parṇamṛgāḥ śvāvicchaśagodhānakulādayo bileśayāḥ| aśvāśvataragokharoṣṭrabastorabhramedaḥpucchaprabhṛtayo grāmyā iti jāṅgalavargaḥ samāsena proktaḥ | yadyasya doṣasya vihitaṃ tattatraiva jñātavyam | lekhanadravyasaṃyutairiti lekhanadravyairvakṣyamāṇakṛṣṇaloharajaḥprabhṛtikaiḥ īdṛśaiścetyabhiprāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajaḥkṛṣṇasāravarṇatāmrarajaśca vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ siṃdhujaṃ saidhavaṃ kāsīsaṃ dvividham ekaṃ bhasmasadṛśaṃ kiṃcidamlalavaṇarasaṃ, dvitīyaṃ puṣpakāsīsam īṣatpītaṃ tuvaraṃ tadbhavameva srotoñjanamiti | rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham | ekaṃ srotoñjanakṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛti dravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākvāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ | mastu dadhnastoyaviśeṣam | tathāca ‘dadhnastu yadadhastoyaṃ tanmastu parikīrtita’miti | athāto ropaṇapuṭapākamāha - stanyaṃ strīdugdhaṃ tadabhāve gavyamājaṃ vā | jāṅgalaśabdena jāṅgalaprāṇināṃ vasā majjā medo grāhyaṃ ropaṇakriyāyāṃ vihitatvāt | madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakagavyaṃ niṃbaprabhṛtikaṃ lekhanatriguṇo dhārya ityanena vākśatatrayaṃ sūcitam | atha puṭapākavyāpatticikitsāmāha - vitarediti | puṭapākavyāpattidarśane hīnātiyoge tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ cikitsāṃ kārayet | etena tāni lakṣaṇāni atrā'pi jñeyāni iti granthakṛtā sūcitam | tathāhi -‘tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyārhe na ca yojayet | yāvantyahāni yuñjīta dvistato hitabhāk bhavet’ iti || 52-61 ||

Gū. atha puṭapākaḥ | ataḥ ūrdhvam ataḥ paraṃ puṭapākasya sādhanaṃ vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmi | tatsādhanamāha - māṃsasya jāṅgalamāṃsasya bilvamātrau dvau piṇḍau snigdhau sucikkaṇau tathā supeṣitau sūkṣmapeṣitau bilvadravyāṇāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ dravaḥ kuḍavayutaḥ | phalaṃ tanmāṃsauṣadham ekatvaṃ samāloḍya samyak melayitvā patrairjambvādibhirveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ mṛttikāṃ veṣṭya puṭapākayuktyā tadrasaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tarpaṇoktavidhānena avacārayet | tasya grahaṇavidhānamāha - saḥ snehādibhedena tridhābhūtaḥ | uttānaśāyino nityaṃ niṣevyaḥ syāt tasya kiṃvidho hitastadāha - sugamam | snehamāha - sarpirghṛtaṃ māṃsādīni medāṃtāni jāṅgalāni svādvauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ kṛtasnehanastena puṭapākaḥ īdṛśaḥ iṣyate vāṅmātrā dve śate dhāryāḥ | lekhanamāha - lekhanadravyāṇi kṛṣṇalohādīni kṛṣṇaloharajaścūrṇaṃ siṃdhusrotoñjanaḥ cūrṇaṃ dadhimastu dadhijalaṃ lekhano vāk śataṃ dhāryaḥ | etāvadeva tasya dhāraṇam | atha ropaṇamāha - stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ jāṅgalaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsaṃ madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakadravyāṇi kaṭukyādīni taiḥ pācitaḥ lekhanāt | ropaṇaḥ triguṇapramāṇo dhāryaḥ | lekhane vākśatādidhāraṇaṃ vyāpattidarśane upadrave tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ vitaret || 52-61 ||
añjanam | atha saṃpakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamācaret | hemante śiśire caiva madhyāhne'ñjanamiṣyate ||62||
pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate | varṣāsu nābhre nāpyuṣṇe vasante ca sadaiva hi ||63||
lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva tathā syātsnehanāñjanam | lekhanaṃ kṣāratīkṣṇāmlarasairañjanamiṣyate || 64 ||
kaṣāyatiktarasayuksasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam | madhuraṃ snehasaṃpannamañjanaṃ tu prasādanam ||95 ||
guṭikārasacūrṇāṃni trividhānyañjanāni ca | kuryācchalākayā'ṅgulyā hīnāni ca athottaram ||66||
śrānte prarudite bhīte pītamadye navajvare | ajīrṇe vegaghāte ce nāñjanaṃ saṃpraśasyate || 67||
hareṇumātrāṃ kurvīta vārtiṃ tīkṣṇāñjane bhiṣak | pramāṇaṃ madhyame'dhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu mṛdau bhavet ||68||
rasakriyā tūttamā syāttriviḍaṅgamitā hitā | madhyamā dviviḍaṅgā syāddhīnā tvekaviḍaṅgikā ||69||
vairecanekacūrṇaṃ tu dviśalākaṃ vidhīyate | mṛdau tu triśalākaṃ syāccatasra: snaihike'ñjane ||70||
mukhayoḥ kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṣṭāṅgulonmitā | aśmajā dhātujā vā syātkalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||71||
tāmralohāśmasaṃjātā śalākā lekhane matā | suvarṇarajatodbhūtā śalākā snehane matā || 72 ||
aṅgulīva mṛdutvena kathitā ropaṇe budhaiḥ | sāyaṃ prātarvāñjanaṃ syāttatsadā naiva kārayet ||73||
nātiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ saṃpraśasyate | kṛṣṇabhāgādadhaḥ kuryādapāṅgaṃ yāvadañjanam || 74 ||

Dī. atha añjanaprakāramāha - athaśabdo'trāmadoṣānantaraṃ sūcyate | tenāparipakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamapraśastamityabhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ ‘añjanaṃ pūraṇaṃ kkāthapānamāme na śasyata’ iti | prāptamañjanamiti yadyasya samayasyoktaṃ tattatraiva yojyamiti prāptaśabdena varṇitam | atha kathamācarettadāha -
