hemanta ityādyaṃ janaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo yathā | atha trividhāñjanamāha -śukrādiṣu ropaṇaṃ kledakaṇḍūpakṣmaprarohaṇādiṣu snehanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ tacca timirādiṣu atha trayāṇāṃ sāmānyena dravyāṇyāha - kṣārādivastunirmitaṃ lekhanāñjanaṃ kathitaṃ kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraprabhṛtikaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ maricādikam amlarasam amlīkamātuluṅgapramukhaṃ ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu | kaṣāyādinirmitaṃ bhavati | kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ tikto nimbādiḥ | sasnehamiti | snehaṃ ghṛtatailādikaṃ prasādāñjanaṃ tu snehanasaṃjñaṃ kathitam | tattu madhurādinirmitaṃ bhavati | madhuraṃ madhurarasaprāyaṃ dravyam | madhuraṃ ghṛtaguḍādisnehasaṃpannamiti snehārtham | ata eva snehanaṃ kathitam | atha trividhāñjanasya rūpamāha -guṭikārasacūrṇādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tattrividhaṃ tu śalākayā aṅgulyā vā yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt | añjanamiti tāni yathottaraṃ tu hīnāni jñātavyāni yo yasmāduttaraṃ yathottaraṃ tena guṭikāñjanādrasakriyāñjanaṃ hīnaṃ rasāccūrṇāñjanamiti | atha yeṣāṃ rogiṇāmañjanaṃ na praśastaṃ tānāha -śrānte puruṣe | śrāntatā ca chardanavāhanajā bhavati | prarudite prakarṣarodane kṛte | bhīte bhayayukte pītamadye pītaṃ madyaṃ yena ajīrṇe āmājīrṇe viṣṭabdhe tu śūlādau vihitametat | vegāghāte mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ cakārādbhuktavati rātrijāgaraṇe ca nāñjanaṃ vihitaṃ tathācoktam - ‘bhuktavāṃstu śiraḥsnātaśrāntaśchardanavāhanai: | rātrau jāgaritaścāpi nātijvarita eva ce’ti | athāñjanasya parimāṇamāha - hareṇumātramiti | hareṇustripuṭaḥ | kalāyaḥ reṇuketyapare | madhyame'ñjane sārdhaikapramāṇaṃ yathā syādvartiṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛdāvityañjane dviguṇaṃ hareṇudvayaṃ yathā syāttathā vartiṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | atha rasakriyāñjanamāha - rasakriyā vakṣyamāṇāñjanasamūhāñjanaviśeṣo'vagantavyaḥ | uttamamātrā mṛdvañjano viḍaṅgo dravyaviśeṣo vyākhyātaḥ | madhyameti na tīkṣṇe mṛduriti hīneti tīkṣṇāñjana ityarthaḥ | ekaviḍaṅgaparimitā rasakriyā vartermātrā boddhavyā | taduktaṃ - ‘viḍaṅgamātraṃ tvapare madhyaṃ dvāvuttamatrayaṃ | rasakriyāṇāṃ vartīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam’ iti | athāparāñjanānāṃ mānamanyattadāha - vairecanikaṃ cūrṇamañjanaprastāve boddhavyaṃ | tacca tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ kathitam ata eva dviśalākonmitameva mṛdāviti mṛducūrṇāñjane snehaneñjane catasraḥ śalākāḥ | tena catuḥśalākonmitāñjanaṃ proktamityarthaḥ | śalākālakṣaṇaṃ vidhānamapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | athāñjanaśalākāmāha – mukhayoriti | śalākāyā ūrdhvādhobhāgagatayoreva mukhaśabdo vācyaḥ | tau tu kuṇṭhitau vigatadhārau kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tena mukulākārāvityapare | tathāca ‘vakrāṃte mukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍale’tyādi | ślakṣṇeti | sarvatraiva ślakṣṇā kāryā mṛdutvena sasnigdhetyarthaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭabhiraṅgulaiḥ kṛtvā parimitā kāryā aśmajā sphaṭikādipāṣāṇaracitā | na kevalaṃ pāṣāṇajanitā dhātujā vā | dhātuśabdena suvarṇādikaṃ gṛhyate | tena suvarṇaraupyatāmrakāṣṭhāsthimayāḥ | kṛtā śalākā añjane śastā aṣṭāṅgulamitā śubhā iti | kalāyaparimaṇḍaletyanena parisamantādvartulā kāryā ityabhiprāyaḥ| kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ || asyāgre keciditi paṭhanti ‘vāme karatale kṛtvā sajalaṃ nikaṣopalam | dakṣiṇenāñjanaṃ nītvā kareṇa nikaṣecchanaiḥ || tena kalkena matimān śalākāgraṃ pralipya ca | utthāpya cottaraṃ vartma vāmenāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇā || vartma śuklāntare cālpāṃ śalākāṃ supravartayet | prathamaṃ savyanetraṃ ca paścādañjyāttu dakṣiṇaṃ | śalākāṃguṣṭhadeśinyā navāṃtarnayanaṃ spṛśet’ ityādi kaiścittaṃtrāntarādavagamyātra likhitaṃ na svamataṃ | lekhane lekhanāñjane snehane snehanāñjane | ropaṇe ropaṇāṃjane | ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu dṛṣṭisādanaṃ | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyam anyavastujanitā śalākā yojyā | athāñjanakarmaṇaḥ kālamāha - sāyaṃprātaḥ ityanena sāyaṃ tīkṣṇāṃjanaṃ kuryāt | prātaḥ gaṇḍūṣānantaraṃ yathā sadācāre rasāṃjanādikaṃ tadvadanyadapi sadā sarvakāle tadañjanaṃ na kārayedityarthaḥ | yataḥ | cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāt | ‘yojayetsaptarātre tu sravaṇārthe rasāñjanami’ti | tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ yathā ‘divā na tu prayoktavyaṃ netrayostīkṣṇamañjanaṃ | virekadurbalā dṛṣṭirādityaṃ prāpya sīdati | tasmāt sāyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu dhruvamañjanamiṣyate | rātrau svapnaguṇādakṣipuṣṭā hyañjanakarṣiteti’ | na kevalaṃ sarvakālaṃ niṣiddhaṃ kiṃtu yadā atiśītoṣṇavātābhraṃ ca bhavati tadā tasyāṃ velāyāmapi nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | kutra sthāneñjanaṃ kuryāttadāha - kṛṣṇabhāgādityādi sugamam || 62-74 ||

Gū. athāñjanaṃ atha athānantaraṃ pakkadoṣasya puruṣasya divasapañcakānantaram āgatapāke'kṣṇi añjanam ācaret | idānīṃ sādhāraṇāñjanavidhimāha - hemante ityādau | hemante śiśire madhyāhneñjanam iṣyate grīṣme śaradi ca pūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe varṣāsu anabhre abhrarahite | nātyuṣṇe na uṣṇasamaye vasante sadaiva iṣyate | lekhanādibhedenāñjanabhedānāha - lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ ca prasādanaṃ cetyaṃjanabhedaḥ | lekhanaṃ tatra kṣārādirasaiḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ | prasādanaṃ guṭikādibhiḥ | trividhamañjanamāha - guṭikādīni trividhānyaṃjanāni śalākayā aṅgulyā vā kriyate | yeṣu añjanaṃ na deyaṃ tānāha - vegaghāte | mūtrādyavarodhe vartyādau | añjanapramāṇaṃ tīkṣṇe'ñjane hareṇumātrāṃ vartiṃ kurvīta | hareṇu reṇukā kalāpo vā madhyame tīkṣṇānmadhyārdhāṃ hareṇumātrātaḥ ardhārdhaṃ sā hareṇumātrā mṛdau tīkṣṇānmṛdau dviguṇaṃ hareṇuto dviguṇaṃ sakriyā | uttamādi pramāṇamāha - sugamam | vairecanādau kiyantyaḥ śalākā ityāha -yato vairecanikaṃ cūrṇaṃ netre bahusrāvakaraṃ tadvairecanikam añjanaṃ vāradvayaṃ śalākayā dīyate | snehakāle catasra: śalākā vidhīyante | śalākāpramāṇaṃ yathā kasya śalāketi | ca mukhayodvaryoḥ | kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṅgulonmitā | mukhayordvayoḥ kuṇṭhitā na tīkṣṇā ślakṣṇā sundarā aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇā aśmajā pāṣāṇajā dhātujā svarṇādidhātujā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā | kalāyo vartulakastatparimāṇā sthūlā | lekhanādau kīdṛśī śalākā vidhīyate tāmāha - sugamam | kasminkasmin samaye kasmin bhāge añjanaṃ kuryādityāha - sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyāṃ prātaḥ vā añjanaṃ syāt | añjanaṃ tadā na kārayet | tat añjanam atiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ na praśasyate | atiśīte atyuṣṇe kāle nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ || 62-74 ||

pūrvamuktaṃ lekhanaropaṇasnehanabhedena trividhāñjaneṣu vartirasacūrṇatrividharūpaṃ, tatrādau lekhanīvartiradhunā vidhīyase | candrodayā | śaṅkhanābhirvibhītasya majjā pathyā manaḥśilā | pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam ||75||
chāgīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya vartiṃ kṛtvā yavonmitām | hareṇumātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya jalaiḥ kuryādathāñjanam || 76 ||
timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalamarbudam | rātryāndhyaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ vartiścandrodayā jayet ||77||

Dī. iyaṃ candrodayā vartirlekhanī kathitā | rātryañjanayogena candrodayābhidhānamasyāḥ | tīkṣṇāñjanatvāt | śaṅkhanābhiriti madhye āvartatvena laghucakrākāraṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ samudrajaṃ śaṃkhaṃ śaṅkhanābhiśabdena vācyamtanna samīcīnaṃ, sarvatra śaṃkhanābhernetrāṃjanayogyatvāt | śaṃkhanābhiśca śodhitā grāhyā | dī. | athavā śaṅkhasya nābhirmadhye grāhyam | atinirmalatvāt | vibhītakasya vibhītakaphalamajjā pathyā harītakī | yavonmiteti | yavaparimāṇāṃ vartiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | añjanārthaṃ tu hareṇumātrā saṃghṛṣyāñjayet | lekhanāñjanatvāt jalairityanena pūrvaṃ vartiḥ kṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya kāryā paścādañjanasamaye pānīyena saha ghṛṣyāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | māṃsavṛddhirarmādijanitā śeṣaṃ sugamam || 75-77 ||

Gū. atha vartiḥ | śaṅkhanābhiḥ śaṅkhamadhyabhāgā | etānsaṃpiṣya yavonmitāṃ vartiṃ kuryāt | hareṇumātrāṃ reṇukāmātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya añjanaṃ kuryāt | asyāñjanasya candrodayāvartiriti saṃjñā timirādīn jayet | vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ varṣaprabhavaṃ jayet | iti candrodayāvartiḥ || 75-77 ||
karañjavartiḥ | palāśapuṣpasvarasairbahuśaḥsaptavāramityarthaḥ | paribhāvitā | karañjabījavartistu dṛṣṭeḥ puṣpaṃ vināśayet ||78||
Dī. atha puṣpārthalekhanīvartidvayamāha - palāśapuṣpaṃ kiṃśukābhidhānaṃ bahuśaḥ ityanena saptavāramityabhiprāyaḥ | karañjabījavartiriti| karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ ||78||
Gū. atha lekhanīvartiḥ palāśapuṣpasvarasena karañjī bījareṇuḥ bahuśaḥ bhāvitā tadvartiḥ śukrādīn samullikhet dūrīkuryāt || 78 ||
samudraphenādivartiḥ | samudraphenasindhūtthaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍavalkalaiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukādīṃśchastravallikhet || 79 ||

Dī. anyadyogamāha - samudraphenetyādi | samudraphenaṃ prasiddhaṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ śaṃkhaṃ prasiddhaṃ dakṣāṇḍavalkalairiti | dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ tasyāṃḍatvageva grāhyā | eke samudraphena ityādikaṃ viparītaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā - ‘samudraphenadakṣāṇḍatvaksindhūtthaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ |atra saśarkarairiti pāṭhaḥ | caṃdraṭo'pi tathaiva paṭhati | śaṃkhaḥ śaṃkhanābhiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukraghnī śigruvāriṇe’ti | vyākhyānayanti tatra mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ śigruvāriṇā śigrusvarasena śastravallekhanena lekhanī kathitā || 79 ||
Gū. anyacca samudraphenaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍakukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaiḥ śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tadbījaiḥ tadvartiḥ śukraṃ puṣpaṃ lekhanī vartiḥ || 79 ||

div.ab: dantavartiḥ | dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragohayājakhurodbhavaiḥ | śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutaiḥ sarvairvicūrṇitaiḥmaricapādikairiti paṭhanīyaṃ vāgbhaṭasaṃvādāt | || 80 || dantavartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇā śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī parā |

ab.seg: Dī. atha lekhanīdantavartimāha - dantī hastīti rūḍhiḥ, varāhaḥ śūkaraḥ, uṣṭraḥ kramelako'pi govṛṣabho'pi, hayo ghoṭakaḥ, ajo bastaḥ chāgasaṃjñaḥ | kharo gardabhaḥ eteṣāṃ dantairityarthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutairiti | śaṅkhaśabdena sarvatra śaṅkhanābhirgrāhyā | muktā mauktikaṃ ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ ślakṣṇā iti sūkṣmatvena saṃsnigdhā yathā syāt | parā utkṛṣṭā atrānukte peṣaṇārthaṃ jalameva grāhyam || 80 ||
Gū. atha lekhanī dantavartiḥ dantī hastī tadādīnāṃ dantaiḥ ajaḥ chāgaḥ kharo gardabha ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ | dantavartiḥ lekhanīvartiḥ || 80 ||

div.ab: nīlotpalavartiḥ | nīlotpalaṃ śigrubījaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā || 81 || etatkalkaiḥ kṛtā vartiratinidrāṃ nivārayet |

ab.seg: Dī. nīlotpalamityādi | iyamapi lekhanīvartiḥ kathitā | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyamiti | sarvatra kalkārthamatra jalamāhuḥ | anuktatvāt || 81 ||

div.ab: puṣpavartiḥ | tilapuṣpāṇyaśītiḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulāḥ ||82|| jātī kusuma pañcāśanmaricāni ca ṣoḍaśa | sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭvā jale vartiḥ kṛtā kusumikābhidhā ||83|| timirārjunaśukrāṇāṃ nāśinī māṃsavṛddhihṛt | (etasyāścāñjane mātrāprakṣiptam | proktā sārdhahareṇukā ||84||)

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ ropaṇīvartividhānamāha - tileti | iyaṃ ropaṇī kusumikāvartiḥ kathitā | atra tilapuṣpāṇi aśītisaṃkhyākāni pippalītaṃḍulāḥ pippalīmadhyagatabījāni sarṣapākārāṇi ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāni grāhyāṇi | jātī sumanāḥ tasyāḥ puṣpāṇyapi pañcāśadgaṇitāni maricāni ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākānītyarthaḥ | jalairiti bahuvacanatvena kutrāpi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | timiropalakṣitatvena gataṃ cakṣuḥ nivartayedityapi yojyaṃ ropaṇatvāt | kecidasyāgre iti paṭhanti | etasyāścāñjane mātrā proktā sārdhahareṇukā etatpūrvaṃ kathitameva tasmādbahubhirna svīkṛtaṃ paunaruktyabhayāt | eke ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulā ityasya sthāne ‘ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ kaṇāḥ smṛtā’ iti paṭhanti etanna manoharam || 82-84 ||

Gū. atha ropaṇīvartiḥ | aśītiḥ tilapuṣpāṇi | kaṇā pippalī tasyāḥ kaṇikāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ | jātīmukulāni puṣpāṇi pañcāśat | iyaṃ kusumikā vartiḥ | tasyā mātrā sārdhahareṇukā | kusumikā vartistimirādau || 82-84 ||
rasāñjanavartiḥ | rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve mālatīnimbapallavā: | gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktā vartirnaktāndhyanāśinī || 85 ||

Dī. athānyāṃ ropaṇīvartimāha - rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyaṃ tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ | haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā mālatīpallavā nimbapallavā iti | mālatī jātī nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ etayoḥ pallavāni komalapatrāṇi | gośakṛdrasa iti gopurīṣasvarasaḥ | śakṛdityasya sthāne yakṛditi pāṭhāntaram || 85 ||
Gū. rasāñjanaṃ dve haridre haridrā, dāruharidrā, mālatī jātī nimbaḥ tayoḥ pallavāḥ komalapatrāṇi gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaṃ jalaṃ tena vartiḥ kṛtā naktāndhyaṃ rātryāndhyaṃ jayet || 85 ||

div.ab: dhātryādivartiḥ | dhātryakṣapathyābījāni ekadvitriguṇāni ca | piṣṭvā vartiṃ jalaiḥ kuryādañjanaṃ dvihareṇukam || 86 || netrasrāvaṃ haratyāśu vātaraktarujaṃ tathāasyāgre - pārāvatamalaṃ niṣkaṃ maricaṃ māṣamātrakam | ghṛṣṭvā ca nimbavartīnāṃ toyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ jayet || naktāṃdhyaṃ cirakālasthaṃ haṃti sājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śvetaṃ palāṇḍusvarasaṃ haṃti naktāṃdhyamānavam || saurāṣṭrīkarṣamekaṃ tu tatsamaṃ kharpare nyaset| | ṭaṃkārdha tutthakaṃ yojyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā sa caikataḥ || kāṃsyapātreṇa tāmreṇa gharṣayennimbukadravaiḥ | caturthadinaparyantaṃ mardayecchodhayetpunaḥ || ghṛtena saṃhitāṃ yustvā vaṭikāṃ kārayedvudhaḥ | nāryāḥ stanyena vartiḥ sā netradṛṣṭiprasādinī || ājanmagatavartmānaḥ punareva bhavaṃti ca | kaṇḍūsrāvaṃ harecchīghraṃ gṛdhradṛṣṭirbhavennaraḥ||’ ityadhikamupalabhyate kutracit || |

ab.seg: Dī. idānīṃ snehanīvartiṃ darśayannāha - dhātryakṣeti | iyaṃ snehanī vartiḥ kathitā | ekadvitriguṇāni yathākramaṃ yojyāni | vātaruktarajaṃ tathetyanena vātajanitāṃ raktajanitāmabhiṣyandādīnāṃ rujaṃ haratītyanye vyākhyānayanti | saṃmatoyamanyatroktatvāt | yathā ‘pathyākṣadhātrīphalamadhyabījaistridvyekabhāgairvidadhīta vartiḥ | tathāñjayedaśrumatipravṛddhamakṣṇorharet kaṣṭamapi prakopamiti ||86||
Gū. dhātrī āmalakī akṣaṃ vibhītakaṃ pathyā harītakī krameṇa ekadvitriguṇāni etāni dvihareṇumātram añjanaṃ kuryāt | netrasrāvaṃ harati snehanī vartikā netrasrāve || 86 ||

div.ab: rasakriyā | tutthamākṣikasindhūtthaṃ sitāśaṅkamanaḥśilāḥ ||87|| gairikodadhiphenaṃ ca maricaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | saṃyojya madhunā kuryādañjanārthaṃ rasakriyām || 88 || vartmarogārmatimirakācaśukraharāṃ parām |

ab.seg: Dī. atha rasakriyāmāha - iyaṃ ca lekhanīsaṃjñakā rasakriyāñjanārthaṃ vihitā, atra tu mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā śarkarā, śaṅkaṃ śaṅkhanābhi:, udadhiphenaṃ - samudraphenaṃ ceti cūrṇayediti | anena samānamānameteṣāṃ grāhyam | saṃyojya madhunā kuryāditi ko'rthaḥ | etaccūrṇaṃ madhūktaśalākayā saṃgṛhya śukrādideśaṃ gharṣayedityabhiprāyaḥ | madhuplāvitāṃ vartimāhureke ||87-88||

Gū. atha lekhanīrasakriyā tutthaṃ mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā sitopalaṃ, śaṃkhaṃ, manaḥśilā, gairikam, udadhiphenaṃ, maricaṃ, madhunāñjanam imāṃ rasakriyāṃ rasānāṃ tutthakadīnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā, yadvā rasaviśiṣṭā yataḥ puṣpaharī rasakriyāyāṃ dhātuḥ nāsti karpūramevāsti || 87-88 ||

div.ab: tathāca lekhanī rasakriyā -- vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyukto mukhyaḥ karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ || 89 || kṣipramañjanato hanti kusumaṃ tu dvimāsikam |

ab.seg: Dī. athāparāṃ lekhanīṃ rasakriyāmāha - karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ karpūrajaḥ śakalaḥ tena karpūraśakalaṃ saṃgṛhya vaṭakṣīreṇa saha saṃghṛṣyāñjayedityarthaḥ | mukhya ityuttamaḥ | yataḥ kaṃrpūrastrividho bhavati | tadyathā ‘īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāsa iti sa tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ | lakṣaṇenāpi ‘īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñastathāṅkura: | śvetaḥ potāśrayaḥ sarve rasavīryavipākataḥ | prabhāvenāpi te proktāḥ pūrvapūrvaguṇādhikāḥ | tatrāpi yo navakṣudra: sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ’ iti mukhyaśabdena vyākhyātaḥ | eke ‘vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karpūrajaṃ rajaḥ | kṣipramañjanato hanti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva’ iti paṭhanti || 89 ||
Gū. atha puṣpaharī rasakriyā sugamam || 89 ||

div.ab: atinidrāyāṃ yogaḥ - kṣaudrāśvalālāsaṃghṛṣṭairmaricairnetramañjayet ||90|| atinidrā śamaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva |

ab.seg: Dī. kṣaudraṃ madhu aśvalālā ghoṭakavaktrajanito dravaviśeṣaḥ | atinidrāpi sannipātajvarajanitā boddhavyā | iyamapi lekhanī rasakriyā kathitā || 90 ||
Gū. athātinidrāyāmañjanaṃ sugamam || 90 ||

div.ab: prabodhanāñjanam | jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca maricaṃ kaṭukī vacā || 91 || saindhavaṃ bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ tandrāghnamañjanam | śirīṣabījagomūtrakṛṣṇāmaricasaindhavaiḥ || 92 || añjanaṃ syātprabodhāya sarasonaśilāvacaiḥ |

Dī. tatra jātīpuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣṣaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ kaṭukā kaṭurohiṇī, bastamūtraṃ chāgamūtram | śeṣaṃ subodham | iyamapi gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtya vartisvarūpā lekhinī rasakriyā kathitā | athavā kṛṣṇā pippalī | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śirīṣabījādibhiḥ sarasonaśilāvacairiti | rasono hlasunavācyaḥ | śilā manaḥśilā vacā vikhyātā etāni dravyāṇi atra godhūmaṃ vihāya samamātrāṇi grāhyāṇi | gomūtramānaṃ tu kalkārthaṃ yāvat | prabodhāyetyanena sannipātajvarajanitaṃ tandrīvināśanāyāñjanamatrāhuḥ || 91 -92 ||

ab.seg: Gū. atha nidrāyāmañjanaṃ, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, kaṭukī vacā | bastaśchāgastanmūtreṇāñjanaṃ, atha sannipāteñjanam | śirīṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadbījaṃ kṛṣṇā pippalī rasonaḥ lasunaḥ śilā manaḥśilā vacā etairañjanam || 91-92 ||
dārvyādirasakriyā | dārvī paṭolaṃ madhukaṃ sanimbapadmakotpalam || 93 ||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ caitāni pacettoye caturguṇe | vipācya pādaśeṣaṃ tu śṛtaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet ||94||
śīte tasminmadhu sitāṃ dadyātpādāṃśikāṃ nara: | rasakriyaiṣā dāhāśruraktarāgarujo haret || 95 ||

Dī. idānīṃ lekhinīrasakriyāmabhidhāya ropaṇīrasakriyāmāha - dārvīti | dārvī dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ| padmākha iti loke | yatra padmamasti tatra kamalaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvatra, kamalā'bhāve padmabījamiti | sarvatracaturguṇatā ca kvāthyadravyāṇām | kkāthyadravyaṃ tu dārvyādikaṃ ca samamātraṃ deyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ caturthaṃ suśṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ tacca pādaśeṣaṃ punaḥ pacedityarthaḥ | sāndrībhūte himasadṛśe tasmin | sitā madhu ca melayitvā pādāṃśaṃ kṣipediti | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthaśeṣāt | nara iti vaidyaḥ | iti ropaṇī rasakriyā proktā | dāhādayo'tra netrasyeti saṃbandhaḥ || 93-95||

Gū. atha ropaṇīrasakriyā | dārvī dāruharidrā, paṭolaṃ, madhukaṃ, yaṣṭī, nimbaṃ, padmakam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ prapauṃḍarīkaṃ tadraktam; etāni tulyāni caturguṇe toye jale pacet | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kkāthaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet | madhusitā sitotpalam | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthāt | eṣā rasakriyā dāhādiharī rasarūpaikā kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā rasānāṃ tutthādidhātūnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā dravyāṇāṃ kriyā rasakriyā aśrusrāvādau || 93-95 ||
rasāñjanādirasakriyā | rasājanaṃ sarjaraso jātīpuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||96||
etatsamāṃśaṃ madhunā piṣṭvā praklinnavartmani | añjanaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam || 97 ||

Dī. iyamapi ropaṇīrasakriyāñjanasamūhe vihitā | tatra rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sarjaraso'gnivallabhaḥ | loke rāla iti | lavaṇamatra saindhavaṃ netrahitatvāt | tathāca - ‘madhu yavapādāsaṃga: śatāvarīmudgasaindhavāmalakī cakṣuṣya: saṃkṣepādvargaḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirayam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||96-97||
Gū. atha pakṣmaprarohaṇādau kriyā | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkkāthodbhavam | sarjaraso rālaḥ | jātī mālatī tatpuṣpaṃ praklinnavartmani, kledaḥ klinnatā, spaṣṭamanyat ||96-97||
guḍūcīsvarasaḥ karṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ syānmāṣakonmitam | saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ syātsarvamekatra mardayet || 98 ||
añjayennayanaṃ tena pillārmatimiraṃ jayet | kācaṃ kaṇḍūṃ liṅganāśaṃ śuklakṛṣṇagatāngadān ||99 ||

div.ab: Dī. athānyā ropaṇī rasakriyā api darśayannāha - guḍūcītyanena | latāyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyamiti | kṣaudratulyaṃ māṣaparimitaṃ mardanamasya kāṃsye tāmraje vā pātre ityasmadīyasaṃpradāyaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 98 || 99 ||
Gū. atha pakṣmarogādau timirādau armamasūratimirādau
punarnavārasakriyā | dugdhena kaṇḍūṃ kṣaudreṇa netrasrāvaṃ ca sarpiṣā | puṣpaṃ tailena timiraṃ kāñjikena niśāndhatām ||100|| punarnavā jayedāśu bhāskastimiraṃ yathā |

ab.seg: Dī. atra kṣīrādīnāṃ vyastena kṛtvā sarvaropaṇī rasakriyā jñātavyā dugdhasya strībhavaṃ sarpiratrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ kāñjikaṃ śuktaviśeṣaṃ prasiddham | punarnaveti punarnavāsvarasaḥ || 100 ||
Gū. atha punarnavānupānamañjane punarnavā dugdhādinā kaṇḍvādīn jayet yathā bhāskarastimiram ||100||

div.ab: babbūlarasakiyā | babbūladalani:kātho lehībhūtastadañjanāt || 101 || netrasrāvaṃ jayatyeṣa madhuyukto na saṃśayaḥ | hiñjalarasakriyā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā pānīye nityamañjanam ||102|| cakṣu:srāvopaśāntyarthaṃ kāryametanmahauṣadham |

Dī. babbūladalāccaturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā niḥkkāthya pādaśeṣaṃ paṭe visrāvya nītā punarvipacet yāvat sāndro bhavati | paścāt pādayuktena madhunā saṃsrāvyāñjayedityabhiprāya: | iyamapi ropaṇī rasakriyā vyākhyātā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ katakaphalamiti prasiddham | etanmahauṣadhamiti mahāñjanavarametadityartha: | ayamapi yogo ropaṇīrasakriyāyāṃ kathitaḥ ||101||102||

Gū. atha netrasrāve'nyaḥ prayogaḥ sugamam | babbūladalaṃ patraṃ tasya kvātho lehībhūtaḥ lehākārastasyāñjanaṃ hijjalo hiṃgoṭhaḥ tatpalaṃ pṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā pānīyenāñjanam || 101 || 102 || idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā
idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā katakarasakriyā | katakasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā madhunā netramañjayet || 103 || īṣatkarpūrasahitaṃ smṛtaṃ netraprasādanam |

ab.seg: Dī. netraprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭisādanam | tasyāḥ prasannatvena netrasyā'pi prasannatvam | tathācoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena yathāhi - ‘kanakasthānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vividhātmanām | dhautānāṃ vimalā śuddhistaile velakarādibhiḥ | evaṃ netreṣu vartyā ca añjanāścyotanādibhiḥ | dṛṣṭirnirākulā bhāti nirmale nabhasīnduvat’ iti || 103 ||
Gū. atha snehanī rasakriyā | katakaphalaṃ nirmalī iti loke prasiddhā | kiṃcit bhīmasenakarpūreṇāñjayet | netraprasādanaṃ netraprasannakaraṃ, netraprasādane || 103 ||
atha śirotpāte rasakriyā | sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ cāñjanaṃ syācchirotpātasya śāntaye ||104||
gū. - sarpirghṛtam || 104 ||
Gū. sarpirghṛtam || 104 ||
kṛṣṇasarpavasārasakriyā | kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkha: katakātphalamañjanam | rasakriyeyamacirādandhānāṃ darśanapradā || 105 ||
lekhanāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvakśilākācaśaṅkhacandanasaindhavaiḥ | dravyairañjanayogo'yaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanaḥ || 106 ||
kaṇārasakriyā | kaṇā chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā | acirāddhanti naktāndhyaṃ tadvatsakṣaudramūṣaṇam ||107||
cūrṇāñjanam| śāṇārdhaṃ maricaṃ dvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayo: | śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavaṃ śāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt ||108||
piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ śubham | kaṇḍūkācakaphārtānāṃ malānāṃ ca viśodhanam ||109||

div.ab: Dī. atra vividharasakriyāmamidhāya saṃprati cūrṇāñjanaviṣaye kaiścit pratipāditāmekāṃ rasakriyāmāha - añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaprabhṛtīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ sarpavasāktaśalākayā paścāt cūrṇaliptayāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | kutracidrasāñjanaṃ vinā pracarati tatrāñjanaśabdena kajalametat kāryamiti śeṣaḥ || 105 || atha lekhanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, candanamatra raktaṃ netrahitakaratvāt | dakṣāṇḍatvagityādiyogaścūrṇāñjanam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu madhūktaśalākayā ca gṛhītvāñjanaṃ kāryam evaṃ sarvatra | cūrṇāñjane eke saindhavairityasya sthāne gairikairiti paṭhanti, dravyairañjanayogo'yamityasya sthāne tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyamiti kathayanti | etatpadadvayamapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt| tathāca - ‘dakṣāṇḍatvakśilāśaṅkhakācacandanagairikaiḥ | tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanam’ iti || 106 || aparamapi lekhanāñjanamāha - kaṇā pippalī, chāgayakṛt chāgakālakhaṇḍam | paktvā | kecit ‘paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā’ ityasya sthāne ‘paktvā tadrasapeṣitā’ iti paṭhanti | tatra tadrasapeṣiteti tat svedāmbunā piṣṭvā ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadvaditi chāgayakṛnmadhye ca svinnaṃ tadrasasupiṣṭaṃ ca ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ kṣaudramatra yogadvaye'pi pracarati | kecinmadhunā saha bhakṣaṇayogadvayamidamāhuḥ | keṣāṃcinmate yakṛdityupalakṣaṇatvena tallagnaṃ pittaṃ grāhyam | tanmadhye pippalī maricaṃ melayitvā dhāryaṃ paścāt śuṣkaṃ tanmadhunā saṃghṛṣyāñjayediti na svamatam || 107 || athānyacca lekhanāñjanamāha - śāṇārdhaṃ māṣakadvayamitaṃ maricamiti pippalyarṇavaphenayośca dvau śāṇau tena pratyekaṃ śāṇamitamityarthaḥ| arṇavaphenaḥ samudraphenaḥ | eke dvāvityanena militvā śāṇaikamāhuḥ | tanna manoharaṃ | sauvīrakāñcanānnava śāṇā grāhyāḥ | śāṇaṣṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ | sa caturmāṣakapramito jñeyaḥ | sauvīrāñjanaṃ suvīrāśabdavācyaṃ tacca kṛṣṇanadīsaṃbhavaṃ bhavati | tadabhāve rasāñjanameva grāhyaṃ, malaśca netrasaṃbhava eva ||108 || 109 ||

Gū. athacūrṇāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvak iti | dakṣāṇḍatvak kukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, kācaṃ śvetakācaṃ śaṅkhaṃ candanaṃ saindhavam ebhirdravyaiḥ piṣṭairayamañjanayogaḥ puṣpādilekhanaḥ | puṣpādau naktāndhye - kaṇā pippalī chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā punastadrasapeṣitā tadrasaḥ yakṛdrasaḥ | acirāt śīghreṇa naktāndhyaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭimandatāṃ hanti | tadvat ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ ca kṛtam | sakṣaudraṃ madhusahitam | naktāndhye cūrṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇarūpamañjanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam | arṇavaphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ maricaṃ śāṇārdhaṃ pippalyarṇavaphenayordvau śāṇau pratyekaṃ śāṇāṣṭakaḥ saindhavam ardhaśāṇaṃ sauvīrakāñjanaṃ navaśāṇaṃ citrāyāṃ citrānakṣatre sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavati | kaṇḍvādau ||105- 109 ||

idānīṃ ropaṇacūrṇāñjanamāha - (mṛducūrṇāñjanam) śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvā samyagāplāvya vāriṇā | gṛhṇīyāttajjalaṃ sarvaṃ tyajeccūrṇamadhogatam || 110 || śuṣkaṃ ca tajjalaṃ sarvaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ bhavet | vicūrṇya bhāvayetsamyaktrivelaṃ triphalārasaiḥ || 111|| karpūrasya rajastatra daśamāṃśena nikṣipet | añjayennayane tena sarvadoṣaharaṃ hi tat || 112 || sarvarogaharaṃ cūrṇaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakāri ca |

ab.seg: Dī. etanmṛducūrṇāñjanatvena ropaṇatvena kathitaṃ śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvetyādi | śilāyāṃ pāṣāṇaghaṭitā peṣaṇārthaṃ pātraviśeṣaḥ | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ tacca tutthabhedaḥ | khaparīyāśabdavācyo loke | samyagāplāvya vāriṇā ca | asmāt saṃpradāye tu tadrasakaṃ jalenaiva dṛṣadi saṃpeṣya paścānnirmalapātre bahujale saṃplāvya muhūrtaṃ vilambya tadupari svacchaṃ jalamapanīyādhaḥsthitaṃ tat parpaṭasaṃnibhaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tadgrāhyamityarthaḥ | karpūracūrṇaṃ tu daśamāṃśaṃ parpaṭīsvarūpadravyāt | sarvadoṣamiti vātapittakapharudhiraṃ | sarvarogamiti netrābhiṣyandādhimanthaprabhṛtikaṃ | cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakārītyanena dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ kathitam || 110-112 ||

Gū. atha prasādanāñjanaṃ cūrṇam | rasakaṃ kharparaṃ śilāyāṃ piṣṭvā vāriṇā samyak āplāvya cālayitvā vāriṇā jalena tat pātrāntare gṛhṇīyāt | adhogataṃ pāṣāṇādikaṃ tyajet | tat śuṣkaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ punaḥ saṃcūrṇya trivelaṃ triphalārasena bhāvayet | daśamāṃśena karpūrarajaḥ kṣipet | spaṣṭamanyat || 110-112 ||

div.ab: prasādanāñjanam (sauvīrāñjanam) agnitaptaṃ hi sauvīraṃ niṣiñcettriphalārasaiḥ ||113|| saptavelaṃ tathā stanyaiḥ strīṇāṃ siktaṃ vicūrṇitam | añjayettena nayane pratyahaṃ cakṣuṣorhitam || 114 || sarvānakṣivikārāṃstu hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ |

Dī. atha snehanābhidhaṃ prasādanasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - agnitaptaṃ sauvīramiti | sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ tacca suramāśabdavācyaṃ triphalā harītakyādikaṃ tasyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ kvathitaraso vā tathetyanena strīdugdhenāpi saptavelamāhuḥ | stanyairiti bahutvenājaṃ gavyaṃ vā kṣīraṃ grāhyaṃ | siktamityatrāpyagnitaptamiti saṃbandhaḥ || 113 || 114 ||
Gū. anyacca sauvīraṃ suramā strīṇāṃ stanyairdugdhaiḥ spaṣṭamanyat || 113 || 114 ||

ab.seg: atha dṛṣṭiprasādanī nāgaśalākā vikhyātā, tāmapi darśayannāha - triphalābhṛṅgaśuṇṭhīnāṃ rasaistadvacca sarpiṣā ||115||
gomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ sikto nāgaḥ pratāpitaḥ | tacchalākā haratyeva sarvānnetrabhavāngadān || 116 ||

div.ab: Dī. tadvadityanena pūrvoktasauvīrāñjanavidhānavadatrāpi | saptavāraṃ pratyekaṃ triphalādidravyeṇa nirvāpaṇamāhuḥ | uktamanyatrāpi - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | anyatroktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | ‘triphalasalilayoge bhṛṅgarājadraveṇa haviṣi ca viṣamiśre kṣīra ājye madhūke | pratipadamabhitaptaṃ saptadhā sīsamekaṃ praṇihitagatipaścāt kārayettacchalākam || timirapaṭalakaṇḍvāsrāvaraktaprakopāmupacitabahu-doṣānnarmasaṃjñāṃstu rogān | saviturudayakāle sāñjanā vyañjanā vā harati nayanarogān śodhyamānā śalākā’ iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyamajāpayaḥ | yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtva: pṛthak pṛthak || taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā vyañjanā vā | taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti’ iti ( vā. u. 13|34|35) || 115 || 116 ||

Gū. atha sīsakaśalākā | triphalā bhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ śuṇṭhī eṣāṃ rasaiḥ jalaiḥ sarpiṣā ghṛtena gomūtramadhu ajā kṣīraiḥ etaiḥ saptasaptavāraṃ siktaḥ secito nāgaḥ | sīsakaśalākā netrarujaḥ haret | triphalādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ rasaiḥ sapta saptadhā sikta ityarthaḥ | tathāca suśrute - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | triphalādīnāṃ samāhāraḥ dvandvātpratyekaṃ rase niṣecanamiti dhvanitam | iti sīsakaśalākā || 115 || 116 ||

ab.seg: pratyañjanam | gatadoṣamapetāśru saṃpaśyansamyagambhasi | prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ ||117||
na vā'nirgatadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ saṃprayojayet | pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇatapte netre cūrṇaṃ prasādanam || 118 ||
nayanāmṛtāñjanam | śuddhe nāge drute śuddhaṃ tulyaṃ sūtaṃ vinikṣipet | kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ tayostulyaṃ sarvamekatra cūrṇayet || 119 ||
daśamāṃśena karpūraṃ tasmiṃścūrṇe pradāpayet | etatkṛtāñjanaṃ netragadajinnayanāmṛtam || 120 ||

div.ab: Dī. idānīṃ cūrṇāñjanāntargataṃ pratyañjanavidhānamāha - akṣi prakṣālya tataḥ pratyañjanaṃ kāryam | netre tīkṣṇapratapte prasādanaṃ cūrṇaṃ hitam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||117 || 118 || atha prasādanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ nāgaśuddhistu pūrvaṃ dhātuśodhanā'dhyāye kathitā | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ śuddhamiti śodhitaṃ | śuddhirasasya pūrvaṃ rasaśodhanādhyāye pratipāditā | kṛṣṇāñjanamiti rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākkāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ tayostulyamiti pāradasīsakasāmyaṃ rasāñjanamityaryaḥ | trayāṇāṃ daśāṃśenātra karpūramiti | idaṃ nayanāmṛtaṃ nāma prasādāñjanacūrṇaṃ prasiddhameva kṛtāñjanasthāne pratyañjanamiti pāṭhāntaram || 119 || 120||

ab.seg: Gū. pratyañjanakaraṇe vidhānamāha - sīsakaśalākayā vahnitaptayā añjane kṛte doṣanāśe pratyañjanaṃ kartavyamityāha - gatadoṣaṃ tathā nayanāstraṃ gatanetrajalam akṣi netram ambhasi saṃpaśyan | tataḥ akṣi prakṣālya yathā doṣānurūpaṃ pratyañjanamañjanaṃ sadoṣe netre dhāvanaṃ netramityapyāha -anirvāntadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ na prayojayet | na kārayet | pratyañjanaṃ kārayet| prakṣālanaṃ vinaiveti dhvanitārtha: | tīkṣṇaṃ tannetre prasādanaścūrṇo vā kārya: | sa yathā - śuddhe tailādibhi: śuddhe vā śalākākāreṇa śuddhe nāge sīsake sati drutaṃ vahninā drāvitaṃ nāgaṃ śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ hiṅgulotthaṃ aṣṭakarmaśuddhaṃ vā tulyaṃ nikṣipet | tayo: sīsakasūtakayostulyaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇayet | tata: sarvamekatra cūrṇayet | tasmina cūrṇe karpūraṃ bhīmasenākhyaṃ daśamāṃśena pradāpayet | etatpratyañjanaṃnāma netragadahā nayanāmṛtaṃ pratyañjanaṃ cūrṇam ||117||
sarpaviṣe saṃjīvanāñjanam | jayapālabhavāṃ majjāṃ bhāvayennimbukadravai: | ekaviṃśativelaṃ tu tato vartiṃ prakalpayet ||121||
manuṣyalālayā ghṛṣṭvā tato netre tayā'ñjayet | sarpadaṣṭaviṣaṃ jitvā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||122||

div.ab: Dī. atha netraprakaraṇapāriśeṣyāt viṣaharī vartimāha - jayapālaṃ dantibījaṃ prasiddham | tanmadhyagatā majjā grāhyā | majjeti meṅgīśabdavācyā sarpadaṣṭaviṣamapi viṣasādharmyāt sthāvaraviṣatakṣaṇepyasyā: pracāra: | eke sannipātaviṣaye'ñjanamasyā: pravadanti || 121|| 122 | |

ab.seg: Gū. atha sarpaviṣaharamañjanam | sugamam ||121||
atha dṛṣṭiprasādanārthaṃ sārvakālikaṃ yogadvayamāha - bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣordīyate yadi | jātā rogā vinaśyanti timirāṇi tathaiva ca ||123||
śītāmbupūritamukha: prativāsaraṃ ya: kālatrayeṇa nayanadvitayaṃ jalena | āsiñcati dhruvamasau na kadācidakṣi- rogavyathāvidhuratāṃ bhajate manuṣya: || 124||

Dī. bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi sugamam | jātārogā ityādi padadvayaṃ kecidanyathā paṭhanti | yathā ‘acireṇaiva tadvāri timirāṇi vyapohatīti’ dvitīyayoge prativāsaraṃ pratidinaṃ kālatrayaṃ prātarmadhyāhṇāparahṇādikam | jaleneti mukhagaṇḍūṣajanitena āsiñcatītyanena vāraṃvāraṃ secanamabhihitam | tathācoktaṃ ‘jalagaṇḍūṣai: prātarbahuśombhobhiḥ prapūrya mukharandhram | nirdayamañjannakṣi kṣapayati timirāṇi nāsādya’ iti | eke bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi yogadvayaṃ nātra paṭhanti | nāsaṅgatamiti manyamānairasmābhirapi likhitam || 123-124 ||

div.ab: atha trikhaṇḍānāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kavirapi khaguṇaprakarṣatāṃ solluṇṭhavacanena dyotayati -- āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayam | jñātvā kaiścidbudhaistaistu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitāḥ ||125|| kiṃcidarthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā | kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamasyāṃ kurvantu sādhavaḥ || 126 || vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ | vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 127 || alpāyuṣāmalpadhiyāmidānīṃ kṛtaṃ samastaśrutipāṭhaśaktyā | tadatra yuktaṃ pratibījamātra- mabhyasyatāmātmahitaṃ prayatnāt || 128 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmavidhi- rnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |

Dī. atha netraviṣaya-pradhānatvena tadarthaṃ sarvakālaṃ yanna vidheyamiti matvā tat pratipālanārthamupadeśamāha – ‘cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatna: kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā | vyartho loko'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne'pi vitte ||’ ayamapi tantrāntarādāhṛtya kenāpi likhitaḥ na svamatam | asyārthastu sugama eva || dī. - āyurvedasamudrasya arthamaṇisañcayaḥ | gūḍha eva gūḍho guptaḥ, yathā samudre maṇisamūhaḥ pracchannaḥ sarvaireva na dṛśyaḥ tathā'yurvede'pi artho'bhiprāyaḥ | sarvaireva nādhigata ityarthaḥ | ata eva kaiścidbudhairjñātaḥ | arthamaṇisaṃcaya iti saṃbandhaḥ | yaireva jñātastaistu vividhā saṃhitāḥ kṛtāḥ | vividhasaṃhitā hārītasuśrutabhṛgvagniveśādayaḥ | atha kaviḥ svātmīyaviṣayamāha –kiṃcidarthamityādi | tata iti saṃhitāsamūhāt | mayā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa kiṃcidarthaṃ svabuddhyā ekadeśīyaprayojanaṃ nītvā āhṛtya iyaṃ saṃhitā kṛtā nibaddhetyabhiprāyaḥ | na tu khakapolakalpitā | etena munipraṇītatvaṃ saṃkṣepatvaṃ ca darśitam | atha kavivijñaptimāha - kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamityādi | asyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ sādhavaḥ sajjanāḥ kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kṛpayā kaṭākṣasya dṛṣṭeḥ kiṃcidbhāgasya nikṣepaṃ kurvantu | anumatārthakriyā avaśyameveti bhāvaṃ sūcayati | tenāvaśyameva kaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kurvaṃtu | yataḥ kaṭākṣamātrā'valokanenā'pi hṛdayaṃgamā kṣamā bhavati kimuta sakaladṛṣṭyā | etena granthasya samīcīnatā darśitā | idānīṃ kavireva nijagranthasyotkṛṣṭatvamāha - yā iyaṃ saṃhitā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīriva yogaratnaiḥ prayogamaṇisamūhaiḥ kṛtvā vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ karoti | vividhagadānāṃ vyādhīnām ārtireva dāridryaṃ tasya nāśanaṃ yathā lakṣmīrbahudhanapradānena akiṃcanapuruṣasya daridranāśaṃ karoti tathā iyamapi saṃhitā suyogaiḥ kṛtvā nānārogajanitapīḍāṃ hantīti bhāvaḥ | etenāsyāḥ prayogasāphalyaṃ darśitam | tat prayogasāphalyasya vyāpāramāha - vilasatvityādi | sā saṃhitā, saṃhitā niruktistu pūrvādhyāye darśitā | śārṅgadharācāryasya sā saṃhitā śārṅgadharācāryanirmitā sā ityabhiprāyaḥ | nānyā | etena granthasya sarvamatānubandhatvaṃ darśitaṃ, sarojanirmaleṣu kavihṛdayeṣviti vilasatu vilāsaṃ karotu kamalanirmalahṛdayapuruṣeṣu sthitiṃ karotvityabhiprāyaḥ | na tu piśunahṛdayeṣu teṣāṃ hṛdayānāmanirmalatvāt na tasyāḥ sthiteravakāśaḥ | yataste svabhāvavaśagāḥ kathaṃ paraguṇamavadhārayituṃ samarthāḥ | tasmāt sajjanahṛdayeṣveva vilāsa iti bhāvaḥ | sahṛdayatvāt | etena granthasya nirmalatvaṃ sūcitaṃ yato nirmalasya nirmalaiḥ saha saṃbandhaḥ sukara eva || 125-128 || vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsuprasiddhāḥ, sumatiduravabodhāste mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ | tadapi gurusakāśādyacchrutaṃ tadvyalekhi hyaḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || 1 || abhinavanibandharacanāṃ śrotuṃ kaḥ ko'tra lolupo bhavati | yaḥ kṛpayā parakāvyaṃ paśyati sudṛśā sa vai dhīraḥ ||2|| ekādaśasahasrāṇi tathā.... ...... ... | śakānāmāḍhamallo hi pañjikāyāṃ vinirmame ||3|| govardhanoddharaṇahṛṣṭasamastagopa- nānāśrutiśravaṇalajjitamānasasya (?) | indukalāsamānaṃ daṃṣṭrodyuti kṣitihareravatu smitaṃ vaḥ || 4 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātma- jenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharapyaṃhitāyāṃ dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmādividhi- radhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||

Gū. atha samāptau granthakāraḥ svakīyaṃ vinayaṃ karoti | sugamam | vinayaṃ kṛtvā autkṛṣṭyamāha - śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā kavihṛdayeṣu vilasatu viśeṣeṇa lasatu prakāśatu | kathaṃbhūteṣu hṛdayeṣu | sarojanirmaleṣu kamalavat śuddheṣu | sā kā ? yā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīriva yogaratnairvividhagadārtidaridranāśaṃ karoti | yujyanta iti yogāḥ kvāthacūrṇādīnāṃ gaṇā rasādayaśca, taiḥ nānāvidhajvarādirogāṇāṃ ārtiḥ pīḍā tasyā yo daridrastannāśaṃ karoti || 125-128 || śrīmat śāhasalemasya rājye kanyāgate ravau | ... .... ..... .. ... .. .... ... .... .. ... .. ... || 1 || kāśīrāmabhiṣagvaro madhukaraḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādābjayoḥ prācāṃ granthakṛtāṃ nibandhakusumādāhṛtya mādhvīmiva | vaidyānāmupakārakṛttanubhṛtāṃ rogaprahāre kṣamāṃ saśrīśārṅgadharaprabandhaviśadavyākhyāmakārṣītsvayam|| 2 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne netrakarmaprasādananāmādhyāyaḥ | iti trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śārṅgadharasaṃhitā samāptā |
